core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/t.description: A Taunted creature must use all their attacks on the target of the taunt, and must include the target in all of their special attacks (Spells, Su, etc.). A taunted creature can only move if the movement puts them closer to the creature that taunted it.A creature taunted by 2 or more creatures may decide which they'd like to attack (assuming they attack at all).More extreme forms of taunt may restrict the types of actions the creature can take while taunted.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/t.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Taunted.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/t.title: Time Out
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/t.description: A creature in Time Out has lost the will to fight, and has surrendered to you. They cannot inflict harmful effects on anybody or anything. They also cannot cast spells without your permission. They meekly follow your commands (ex. follow me), but won’t do anything against their ethos (kick that puppy) or that is dangerous (jump off that cliff) without extreme circumstances. If you or your allies attack the creature or cast a harmful spell on it, the condition ends.Treat it like a slightly more convenient form of unconsciousness if you want to interact with the creature after the combat. Many minion type creatures will acquire this status effect when their leader is defeated.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/t.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Time Out.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/u.title: Unassailable
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/u.description: Creature ignores penalties that result from Circumstance or Status, like the +Perception👀 penalty from being blind.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/u.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Unassailable.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/u.title: Unstoppable
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/u.description: Creature cannot be moved by force, and can move and take actions normally regardless of any Status like stun or entangle.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/u.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Unstoppable.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/u.title: Untargetable
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/u.description: Creature cannot be targeted, such as if it has Total Concealment.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/u.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Untargetable.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/w.title: Wet
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/w.description: Gain weakness to Electric and Cold Damage. When a wet creature takes Electric or Cold damage, the condition ends.Being wet is something that can come up often in the environment. Only by being drenched in heavy rain, submerged in water or something similar can one be considered wet to the point where this has a mechanical effect.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/w.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Wet.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/air.html.title: Air
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/air.html.description: Effect manipulates air to produce its effect.This is a non-Damage elemental tag.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/buff.html.title: Buff
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/buff.html.description: An effect with the buff tag grants a boon to a creature, or a shared effect. If an unwilling creature has a buff or used on it, it can choose to deny it.You can end a buff effect on yourself as an instant action, unless the buff says otherwise.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/charm.html.title: Charm
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/charm.html.description:
Charm effects allow the creature inflicting it to exert some degree of control over others. All charm effects are also Mind-Affecting.
See the charmed status effect.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/companion.h.title: Companion
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/companion.h.description:
In media it's very common for creatures to have minions, squires and sidekicks. This is what the companion system is for. Like most other content, the companion system is ill-suited for large quantities of creatures, like armies. It's meant to be more compact. Something to take with you on the go for your adventure. This could also reasonably extend to temporary allies that join your party.Companions are generally tied to your class, abilities and items. Any such ability is marked with this tag.If an ability has the companion tag, it summons an ally, or otherwise serves some kind of interpersonal function. You can only have 2 companions, or 1 if you have -1 CHA.
Companions always act on your turn if you are present. There is no separation between your turns, you all act in the same Initiative. Companions gain bonuses or penalties based off of your CHA.
If you are not currently sharing your teamwork feat gained through CHA with anybody, or you hate them and like your Snow Man better, you can grant it to a companion that you summon as a free action as part of creating them.
If a feature generates a specific type of companion, like a Beast Companion🐶 or Mud Buddy, then you cannot have another companion of the same time unless otherwise specified. If a companion is generated temporarily (such as through a technique or a Su ability), then it has a "leash" range of 120 ft. In addition, you need line of sight to your companion. The first turn it exists beyond this range it slowly starts to fade away. At the end of the second it disappears.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/concentrati.title: Concentration
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/concentrati.description: An effect with the concentration tag requires some degree of upkeep from the caster and typically has a duration. Concentration effects end if the caster is Defeated, Stunned, put Asleep, or otherwise completely prevented from taking any actions. You can also cease concentration Instantly. If you cast a spell with concentration, you must hold the staff in order to maintain your concentration. Being disarmed of a staff you are using to concentrate ends the effect. You can normally only have once concentration effect at a time.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/contingent..title: Contingent
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/contingent..description: The effect can be cast ahead of time with a specific trigger for when it activates. A creature can only have a single contingent effect active on them at once.The effect manifests itself in a very obvious way. A creature can identify what the contingency is without seeing it in action with an appropriate skill check, usually Identify Active Spell, but with a +5 increase to the DC.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/crush.html.title: Crush
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/crush.html.description: Crush is a Damage type Tag, which represents bludgeoning attacks, shockwaves, and blunt force trauma.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/curse.html.title: Curse
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/curse.html.description: Curse effects inflict permanent debilitating conditions on creatures. Curses cannot be dispelled, but they all have some way to get rid of them. This usually requires some convoluted action most people wouldn't do unless prompted. Can be identified using the "identify curse or affliction" feature in the +Medicine💉 skill.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/dismissible.title: Dismissible
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/dismissible.description:
Dismissible (D) effects can be ended prematurely by the user as a Standard Action.
Note that voluntary effects (such as buffs) can be dismissed Instantly without this tag.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/earth.html.title: Earth
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/earth.html.description: Spell manipulates earth to produce its effect.This is a non-Damage elemental tag.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/elusive.htm.title: Elusive
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/elusive.htm.description: This action doesn't provoke an AoO.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/emotion.htm.title: Emotion
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/emotion.htm.description: An Emotion effect is a Mind-Affecting effect that relies on manipulating the target's emotions.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/fear.html.title: Fear
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/fear.html.description: Usually inflicts Shaken or Frightened. All fear effects are also Mind-Affecting.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/figment.htm.title: Figment
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/figment.htm.description: Figments create creatures, objects, and terrain that don’t truly exist. As long as the creature does not directly interact with a figment, it believes it to be real. If a creature figures out that it's fake and tells its allies, or demonstrates by moving through it, they no longer believe it to be real. Directly interacting requires doing things like walking into a wall or attacking a creature, upon which the creature rolls a Will save. A failure indicates the creature will try to run around an obstacle or that they missed a creature.If used to satisfy the conditions of a surrender (such as making a spooky monster), the creatures affected get a will save to negate it. They have +6 on this save if they saw you cast the spell.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/fire.html.title: Fire
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/fire.html.description: Fire is a Damage type Tag, representing destruction through heat melting metal or cooking flesh.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/glamer.html.title: Glamer
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/glamer.html.description: A Glamer changes a subject’s sensory qualities, making it look, feel, taste, smell, or sound like something else, or nothing at all.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/holy.html.title: Holy
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/holy.html.description: Holy is a Damage type Tag, representing attacks against the soul or convictions, or divinely-sourced retribution. Usually particularly effective against Undead and Fiends.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/language-de.title: Language-Dependent
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/language-de.description: Language-Dependent effects require the target to understand your spoken words, or requires some form of clear communication that mimics language (like Telepathy).

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/light.html.title: Light
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/light.html.description: Effect either creates light, or has special interactions when in it. If unspecified, it creates Bright Light in its area of effect for one round, or on the spaces where something was targeted.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/martial.htm.title: Martial
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/martial.htm.description: Martial effects allow the user to deliver the effect using the Attack and Damage and On-hit effects of a wielded Weapon, even if it mentions using another form of attack.Martial techniques and Special Attacks by default ALWAYS have the martial tag. It is not listed to save time/space.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/mind-affect.title: Mind-Affecting
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/mind-affect.description: Mind-Affecting effects are a more general group that include things like Fear effects, Charms, and more. Creatures that are Mindless cannot be affected by mind-affecting effects.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/necrotic.ht.title: Necrotic
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/necrotic.ht.description: Necrotic is a Damage type Tag, representing the decay of flesh, poisons, and the organic disruption of life processes. May bolster Undead.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/pattern.htm.title: Pattern
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/pattern.htm.description: Like a Figment, a Pattern creates an image that others can see, but a pattern also affects the minds of those who see it or are caught in it. Common effects include Fascination or Blurred Vision. Pattern effects are also Mind-Affecting.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/persistent..title: Persistent
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/persistent..description: Persistent Effects have an initial effect and an effect that persists over time. This type of effect cannot deal its persistent effect on the same round as its initial effect. Persistent effects end preemptively if the user is Defeated.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/pierce.html.title: Pierce
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/pierce.html.description: Pierce is a Damage type Tag, and represents force applied across a small surface area, usually by pointed objects.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/polymorph.h.title: Polymorph
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/polymorph.h.description: Polymorph effects transform creatures into other creatures. Many of the features granted from polymorph effects are based off the Shapeshifter's class features. You retain the ability to speak while polymorphed. When transforming using a polymorph effect, it can fall under one of the following to determine the nature of your transformation (some can be multiple).Chimeric Polymorph - Your form stays roughly the same, but acquires some features of the new creature that you're transforming into, such as claws, fur, a long tongue etc. When you chimeric polymorph, you do not lose access to any of your gear.True Polymorph - Your form completely changes to the form mentioned in the ability. You completely lose access to all of your equipment. There are only a handful of features recognizable from your previous self, such as eye color.Baleful Polymorph - This form of polymorph is inflicted upon you rather than willingly used. It functions very similarly to true polymorph, but provides fewer tangible benefits and often include debilitating Status. You lose access to your equipment and cannot speak.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/psychic.htm.title: Psychic
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/psychic.htm.description: Psychic is a Damage type Tag, representing an assault one a creature's mind. Usually ineffective against Mindless creatures.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/scrying.htm.title: Scrying
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/scrying.htm.description:
Scrying effects create a specific type of magic sensor, often from remote locations, usually for the purpose of spying on people. The sensor allows you to see and hear anything with any of your senses, so long as it is in the specified range the effect mentions.While scrying, your body is Stunned. You can return back to your body as a standard action. You are aware of any physical sensation your body experiences while scrying.
Scrying sensors bit tied directly to creatures are clearly visible to the naked eye. They usually take the form of an eye. Sensors that can move can use the caster's +Stealth bonus to hide as they move.
Scrying is a Concentration effect.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/sigil.html.title: Sigil
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/sigil.html.description: The effect puts magical text on a surface with some kind of delayed effect, usually triggering when a creature walks within a certain radius of the sigil. A sigil must be clearly visible in order to function. If it is obscured, then it is deactivated until it is unobscured. Most sigils have the ability to apply a passphrase that, when spoken aloud, allows a user to move through the area without triggering the sigil.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/slash.html.title: Slash
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/slash.html.description: Slash is a Damage type Tag, and represents damage dealt by cuts, chops, and slices with a sharp or thin weapon.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/subtle.html.title: Subtle
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/subtle.html.description:
The effect has a chance for nobody to notice it. If the target creature fails its save, then the effect goes unnoticed. The DC to Identify Spell with the subtle tag increases by 5.
If someone is watching you and suspects you are using a subtle spell in their presence, they can use Detect to get a +Perception👀 check at -10 against the Identify Spell DC of the effect.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/tag.html.title: Tag
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/tag.html.description:
Tags are descriptors that let you apply general rules to similar effects. Tags are not just limited to spells, but spells do commonly use tags. Certain tags may only effect specific parts of an ability. Use discretion when needed.See:School tags Abnegation

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/teleportati.title: Teleportation
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/teleportati.description: Teleportation effects allow the user, and sometimes their allies, to instantly travel between two locations. Teleportation tends to be very limited in scope, bringing you to very specific predetermined places or being wildly off-course if not. You must have line of sight to the location you are teleporting to.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/water.html.title: Water
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/water.html.description: Effect manipulates water to produce its effect.This is a non-Damage elemental tag.

feats/teamwork-feats/escape-route.html.title: Escape Route
feats/teamwork-feats/escape-route.html.description: Requirements -Leaving threatened spaces also threatened by your allies (other than you of course) is elusive.

feats/teamwork-feats/pack-tactics.html.title: Pack Tactics
feats/teamwork-feats/pack-tactics.html.description: Requirements -As long as you are threatening the same creature as an ally, you gain Flanking regardless of position.

index.html.title: Index
index.html.description:
Nick Nacks is my very own fantasy tabletop role-playing game (TTRPG). My biggest sources of inspiration are Pathfinder 1e and Divinity Original Sin 2.
Most of the rules in Nick Nacks are centered around combat. I expect you to be traveling through dangerous wilderness, delving into dungeons and stealing treasure from dragons. Some rules, such as Skills and +Minigames, allow you to resolve actions outside of combat. The +Chase and Drinking Contest are examples of such things.
Where I think Nick Nacks shines is its customization options for players and GMs alike. Instead of having traditional spell lists, I made techniques for both martials and mages, each with their own group loosely centered around a theme such as Pyromancy🔥, unarmed👊 fighting or necromancy💀. Anybody can specialize in any list using a pool of limited points.I have plans to make far, far more classes, subclasses, bestiary creatures, feats and more!

classes/+class-details/+class.html.title: +Class
classes/+class-details/+class.html.description:
Classes are the fundamental basis from which you obtain abilities.Classes get a set of numerical bonuses to aid them. Every class has listed +HP, Skills, Memory, and at least one Save bonus. Stats can be flat front-loaded amounts, per-LvL bonuses, or both.
Most characters will get their core abilities front-loaded at level 1. All classes get access to some type of techniques, which can be martial techniques or spells. Technique points granted through class usually have some form of restriction.Even levels are mostly dedicated to class features that directly increase the classes power. This includes gaining access to new combat abilities, increasing the power of old ones, and getting their own special attacks.
Odd levels are mostly dedicated to getting the next tier of techniques. As such, class features are usually sparse. If any are included, they are usually minor increases in power or they are flavorful inclusions. You also get a feat every odd level.
Most classes require selecting an Archetype at level 1, which grants more specific thematic abilities.

classes/+class-details/archetype.html.title: Archetype
classes/+class-details/archetype.html.description: A +Class Archetype is a specific branch of thematic abilities that are added to the original class. Unless otherwise stated, nothing is lost or replaced by selecting an Archetype.

classes/alchemist/archetypes/plague.html.title: Plague
classes/alchemist/archetypes/plague.html.description:
Plague alchemists use their mastery over toxic substances to melt their enemies. They have incredible damage potential in drawn out fights without healers.Whenever a creature fails a saving throw against one of your spells that deals damage, or On-hit, it applies a stack of Toxic. For the next minute, they take poison damage equal to the stacks of toxic they have at the start of each of their turns. Toxic damage also applies an additional toxic stack each round, but it does not extend its duration.
Toxic damage cannot kill creatures, it only defeats them if it drops them to 0. The toxic stacks persist while defeated, but do not accumulate further.
This can be removed with first aid or by washing a creature clean, such as by being submerged in water. Any effect that removes Venom can also remove toxic stacks.
You can deliver toxic to creatures without them noticing using +Sleight of Hand outside of combat. In such cases, the damage is delayed for a few moments for you to make some distance.
You gain Poison Jab as an innate technique.Whenever a creature fails a save against one of your toxins, they also gain a stack of toxic.As a standard action, remove all toxic stacks from all creatures within 60 ft of you. Creatures take 3 true damage for each stack of toxic they possesses.You can choose to either make it deadly or nonlethal. Nonlethal expunges can only defeat creatures, not kill them.
When done out of combat, this ability has the Subtle tag. If you choose to lethally expunge outside of combat and it defeats a creature, they die Fortitude negates.
When you successfully Hide from a creature and attack them or cast a spell on them, you can make an additional simple attack against them as a swift action.When you are defeated, you can expunge as an immediate action.
You gain Corrupting Mist as an innate technique, usable 1/minute. At level 10, you can upcast it.

headers.heading: 1 - Toxic to the Touch (Su) (Poison)

classes/alchemist/archetypes/potion-man..title: Potion Man
classes/alchemist/archetypes/potion-man..description:
Potion man, sitting at your stand trying to expand, but they taste so bland. You are a master of using potions to aid you allies. You can bottle your own techniques into potions to share them with allies.You can spend a point of alchemical inspiration to bottle your knowledge. Choose a single technique you possess with the buff or Prepared tags. You can give an ally access to this technique as though using the Administer Potion action.If it is a prepared technique, it lasts for 10 minutes. If it is a buff, it lasts its usual duration. Effects that are normally only target "self" are usable on others through extracts.
Health potions you create using alchemical inspiration heal an additional 3 hp. You can throw a healing potion at an ally or a spot on the ground to have its healing juices wash over them, affecting a 5 ft radius around its impact zone.
Mana potions also share this explosive quality, but restore no additional mana.Extracts you create with the prepared tag now last until rest. Your ally no longer needs to take a immediate action to consume the extracts.

classes/alchemist/major/alchemist-majors.title: Alchemist Majors
classes/alchemist/major/alchemist-majors.description:
Making your own class features can be tough, both maintaining balance and a cohesive theme. This section should help provide guidelines for not only the types of things you should be thinking about studying for your alchemist, but also the power of the mechanical effects.In general, majors can be separated into a few categories.
## 1 - Major
The main thing that you should be focusing on for your major is thinking about a completely unique thing that your character specializes in. It should be specific and limited in scope.Idea Phase:
"I specialize in transforming into animals" is a bit too vague and is too similar to the shapeshifter class. If we are on the cutting edge of new techniques, we want something that isn't just another class's features."I specialize in grafting beast parts to people" is more specific, and falls more closely in line with what you imagine a fantasy scientist would do. For me at least, it's easy to imagine Frankenstein's monster type alchemist that has slowly replaced his body with more optimal animal parts to become a completely unique creature.Mechanics Phase:
Sticking with the idea of grafting animal parts, this idea lends itself well to an enhancer type play style. You might gather the parts during your adventures by purchasing them or killing the beasts yourself, but gaining benefits requires work you do ahead of time.Crafting rules are elsewhere, where you can find how long it takes, how much it cost and how difficult it should be. Right now we are concerned with the mechanics. What should a grafted part do? Considering you are fusing parts onto yourself you could give yourself noteworthy parts from other animals to gain permanent abilities: Dog nose for scent, bull horns for a natural attack, fins and gills for aquatic adventures. Considering you're replacing your humanoid parts, there might also be some drawbacks. Lion claws aren't the best for grasping things like opposable thumbs are, for example.An ability like this can open up opportunities for limitless power as long as you keep pouring resources into it, so it should also have some hard limitation. Limiting yourself to only mixing and matching 3 parts for example. Considering the mechanical effect is similar, perhaps use shapeshifter's point system as a basis for how powerful the individual parts can be.Thesis marks the point where few have developed their research to this point. This should be the point where you start bending rules and creating increasingly ridiculous items with your craft.Continuing with the idea of grafting animal parts, this is where you might add a second tier to your crafting. No longer are you just replacing parts, but you can add completely new ones, doing things like turning people into centaurs of all kinds of creatures, giving yourself an additional limb, maybe an extra beast head.Up the limit of how many parts you can give a creature, so long as they are willing to accept tier 2 augmentations.Grand discovery marks the point where only the best, brightest and most insane push their research to the boundaries of what should be possible. This is the point where you should be breaking rules and doing things once only thought imaginary.By combining different animal parts from dead creatures, you can create entirely new creatures. You can make alterations to yourself to make you completely unrecognizable from when you began. Once upon a time you were a man. Now you are a massive spider from the waist down allowing you to climb any surface with ease, your torso is covered in thick chitin to protect your vitals, your head is covered in beady eyes to allow you to see in all directions.

classes/alchemist/major/boomkin.html.title: Boomkin
classes/alchemist/major/boomkin.html.description:
You have created a fragile companion meant to run in, tank some hits, and go out in a blaze of glory. Use beast tamer's beast companion🐶 as a baseline for what your creature should be with the following changes… It can be a plant, ooze, humanoid, fey, or cryptid. It gains 2 initial adaptation points and gains none from leveling.
It's base HP is 10+4*LVL. It's intelligence is -2 and it can speak a language of your choosing, but not very well It loses the evasion, scent, lost companions and one liner features of beast companion It gains the following special ability...
Kaboom (fire/Poison) - Using your standard action, or when it is defeated, your creation explodes violently. Deals (10+3*lvl) fire or poison damage (chosen when exploding) in a 10 ft radius to ALL creatures (reflex halves).
You have evasion vs your creation's explosions. You can recreate your companion by spending 3 rounds crafting, good as new. It maintains its memories and harbors no ill will towards you for its repeated destruction. You grow accustomed to your research blowing up into your face. You make it blow up in new ways, adding more variety. When your creation explodes, you can choose one of the following explosion types.
Earthshatter earth - Damage changes to crush. Groundborne creatures are knocked down (reflex negates) Bigger Boom (fire/poison) - AoE increases to 20 ft radius
Cold Snap frost - Damage changes to frost. Creatures are frosty (reflex negates).
You are immune to your creation's explosions Recreating your companion takes 2 rounds T

headers.heading: 1 - Major - Friend Crafter (companion)

classes/alchemist/major/mutant.html.title: Mutant
classes/alchemist/major/mutant.html.description:
Your research is a bit self-centered. You were the only person who was willing to be a test subject for your research. Unfortunately it seems as though your research has developed a mind of its own, and in order to access its power, you need to share your body. In this particular example, your mutation enhances your physical prowess, but only when you let out this inner beast. This works very much like pointing a dog at an enemy, then unchaining them.As a free action, unleash the beast, gaining the following benefits +Athletics🏊 and +Acrobatics⚖ get a +4 bonus
The unarmed combatant feat with a Multiattack of 2 attacks Grow to large size
Increase Land Speed by 10 And the following drawbacks Any turn you do not attack or destroy something during your turn, you take 3 true damage
Disadvantage on saves vs taunt After being out of combat for 1 minute, you must roll a will save against your class DC. If you fail, you attack the nearest creature. To end your rampage, you must consume an item you craft with Alchemical Inspiration. If you run out mana, your rampage lasts until you are defeated or you rest. You start to learn more about your instinctual side, and learn to cooperate better with it. You've achieved greater mastery over your physical augmentations and creative ways to use them.Gain the following additional benefits when you transform
You are constantly under the effects of the Shockwave technique
You gain a 1st level martial Innate Technique, usable at will Remove concentration and skill restriction debuff You have mastered your transformation. You gain the benefits of it constantly and maintain full mental acuity, removing all drawbacks. And other stuff...It is a capstone after all

headers.heading: 1 - Major - Enhancer poly, chimeric

classes/alchemist/major/nekomancer.html.title: Nekomancer
classes/alchemist/major/nekomancer.html.description:
Your feline fascination drives your research forward. You can distill the essence of cats to be complimentary with humanoids. You can use alchemy to create "catgirl potions" for 50g with the following effects. Nightvision Claw attack (d8 slash)
Reduce fall damage to 1 per 10 ft fallen. You cannot become drained from falling.
Compression The ability to speak with cats Cosmetic changes such as cat eyes, ears, tail, whiskers, some fur
The effects of the potion last 1 hour. You have Advantage on any skill checks against any creature affected by one of your nekomancy potions. Your nekomancy potions last 24 hours. When you make a nekomancy potion, you can choose to add one of the following benefits…
Cat Form (poly, true) - Gain the ability to assume the form of any type of cat and back. Transforming is a standard action. Your size changes as appropriate. Your claw damage increases to 2d6 while transformed. You can speak while in cat form.
Ideal Form (poly, true) - Gain the ability to assume the form of an attractive female human with secondary cat features and back. Transforming is a standard action. Your size changes as appropriate. You get advantage on purrsuasion while transformed.

headers.heading: 1 - Major - Enhancer (poly, chimeric)

classes/alchemist/major/purifier.html.title: Purifier
classes/alchemist/major/purifier.html.description:
You fix and heal, but not in the traditional sense. Your area of expertise is in reversing the irreversible. It is not all too uncommon to find individuals who are victims of a forced Reincarnate from Frogg Saran🐸 or that are being changed by some kind of alien mutation or profane corruption. You aim to turn back time to where the creature was healthy whole and themselves again...eventually.Using 100g of materials and 1 minute of time...
You can fashion a prosthetic limb or organ fitted to a specific creature's needs. When inserted or attached, the organ assumes normal functionality, albeit with some getting used to. Limbs inflict clumsy 1 and organs inflict sickened 1. These debuffs are considered Permanent Status and persist for 1 week. At the end of the week, the limbs are mostly indistinguishable from the originals, leaving only connecting scar tissue.
You can also create a foil to the effects of a Styx Serum, or other effects that remove memories or sense of self. A year comes back to them for each day that follows them drinking your memory potion. Anything reasonably close to these abilities in terms of power/effect Using a laboratory, 1,000g of materials and 1 minute of time... Limbs/organs you replace do not apply debuffs
You can reverse the effects of a Reincarnate spell, returning the creature to its previous form. If a creature is corrupted but not yet completely consumed by some malicious force, such as a creature part way through transforming into a fiend, you can reverse the direction of this corruption. Over time after administering your solution, the creature reverts back to its old self, assuming it does not continue to actively corrupt further. Anything reasonably close to these abilities in terms of power/effect
What counts as "corruption" is intentionally left vague, because alchemists are supposed to break rules, not be bound by them. In fantasy, any number of things can "corrupt" for greater power or as a consequence of associating with evil. You can counter the GM Magic if you manage to capture corrupted allies or save otherwise unwilling enemies.Using a laboratory, 10,000g, 1 rare materials and 1 minute of time you can restore a creature back from nearly anything short of death.A rare material is again, intentionally vague, because its not an item that exists in the game, but is something that should exist in the world. These ingredients should be extracted from creatures that have incredible restorative properties, are immortal or something similar.
A phoenix feather
A shard from an ancient monolith
Blood from a Celestial or a powerful troll By using a laboratory, 100,000g, 2 different rare materials and 2 weeks of active labor, you can create a clone of a creature you have a piece of (such as a blood sample, hair or a limb). This clone requires a full year to gestate before it grows into an adult.
The clone is inert until the original dies. When they do, they wake up in the body of the clone a few minutes later. Their max +HP is permanently reduced by 10 and they are Drained 20. Roll on the Resurrection Chart. Clones cannot be reborn as clones.
A creature trained in +Medicine💉 that is giving treatment to a clone can discern the strangeness of this body with a DC equal to 10+The alchemist's Alchemy bonus.

classes/alchemist/alchemist.html.title: Alchemist
classes/alchemist/alchemist.html.description:
Alchemist is a hybrid class with the potential to branch in many directions depending on the desired play style. Using the power of SCIENCE you can create friends, enhance your friends, yourself or you can manipulate the world around you in a variety of creative ways.You have Magical Specialization and Martial Specialization You gain two technique points at level 1, then another two points every 2 levels after. These technique points can be used on the alchemy tree. Choose another tech tree. They can also be used on that tree.
You get the Alchemy skill for free and a +4 bonus to alchemy checks.
The Save DC of the items you create, even ones without alchemical inspiration, increase to your save DC (if it is higher).You can make AND drink, administer, activate or throw an alchemical item as a standard action.
You can use this feature with items that have a craft DC of 10+your alchemy bonus automatically. Anything higher requires a roll. Failures consume materials.
You have Resistance to poison damage, as well as saves vs envenomed and +Toxins.Every alchemist is defined by their (often nonsensical) specialization. In order to make you, the player, feel like you are on the cutting edge of research, you can break the usual rules of the game and create entirely new class features with a specific focus. This can include things like researching how to gain additional limbs or genetically engineered catgirls.
More details in the Alchemist Majors section.Upgrade! Abilities granted by your major are improved, loosening the restrictions.Abilities granted by your major are perfected, eliminating all but the most extreme restrictions.

headers.heading: 1 - Alchemical Inspiration Mana Burn

classes/barbarian/rage-powers.html.title: Rage Powers
classes/barbarian/rage-powers.html.description:
Despite the name, rage powers, unless explicitly stated, do not require you to be raging to use.Choose a skill. You gain a +2 bonus to that skill and can use it while raging.By spending 30ft of movement, you can make an demoralize a creature. If you successfully demoralize a creature that is already shaken, in addition to increasing the shaken penalty, you also frighten them for one round. A creature frightened in this way cannot be frightened again for 1 minute.
Gain ferocity.When you are defeated, it only takes 1 minute for you to regain 1 hp.
You are staggered after you are healed from 0 hp instead of dazed. You only become drained 2 when defeated.
When an enemy creature leaves your threatened spaces, you can spend an immediate action to chase after them up to 60 ft.
When a creature attempts to avoid AoO, you get a +4 bonus to your reflex save for the opposed check.
Get a +4 bonus to attack made as AoOs.
Once per rage, add (2+lvl) to an +Athletics🏊 check as an instant action.
Whenever you defeat a creature with a melee attack, they are automatically entangled as you smash them into the ground. If they regain consciousness, they must first escape before they can move. They can Breakout as a swift action. Failure means they stay entangled.An instance of damage must be at least higher than your level (after reduction) in order to defeat you. When this ability procs you take no damage.
Gain powerful charge. You can move through creatures and difficult terrain during your charge.

classes/beast-trainer/archetypes/magical.title: Magical Beasts
classes/beast-trainer/archetypes/magical.description:
Beast Trainer Archetype.Magical Beasts use their casting to enhance their beast companions. They are able to combo their spells with their beast. This archetype replaces Tandem Strike
Your beast companion benefits from any technique you have prepared with the prepared tag.
Whenever you use a technique with the Buff tag, you can also affect your beast companion with it.
The DC for your spells is 2 higher against any creature your beast companion has attacked this turn. You get advantage on spell attacks against any creature your beast companion has attacked this turn.
You automatically exclude your beast companion from any damage or CC that your techniques inflict.Choose a magical technique tree. You gain a technique point in this tree at level 1 and every two levels after.
Whenever a creature fails a save against one of your techniques, it Provokes from your beast companion.

classes/beast-trainer/archetypes/prey-se.title: Prey Seeker
classes/beast-trainer/archetypes/prey-se.description:
Beast Trainer Archetype.Prey seekers use beast companions to harass their opponents, keeping them at a distance so you can hit them from afar. Your companion can rush back to your aid when needed.
Your movement is Elusive against creatures your beast companion threaten.Your beast companion gains the following special attack. Special Attack: To My Side - The beast companion can move 30 ft closer to you and attack a creature threatening you. If its current speed is less than 30 ft, this special attack's additional movement decreases to that reduced speed.
You gain a technique point in the Marksman🏹 tree at this level and every two levels after.
Attach a tasty treat to your next ranged attack. On hit, apply a treat. Your beast companion gains Seeking against the creature for 1 minute. Your beast companion heals (3+LvL) on hit on their first attack against this creature.
Your beast companion gets the Sentinel feat.
You get a +2 bonus to Attack against creatures your beast companion threatens, as though you were Flanking. Your beast companion gets the following special attack.
Special Attack: Bother - Your companion taunts a creature On-hit.

headers.heading: 2 - Special Attack: Baited Arrow (healing)

classes/beast-trainer/beast-companion.ht.title: Beast Companion
classes/beast-trainer/beast-companion.ht.description:
Beast companions are primarily for the beast tamer class, but the rules can be adjusted for use in other classes, as well as the Pet feat.Your animal companion understands one language of your choosing (usually common). Its size is small or medium. For ease of play reasons, it is assumed that your beast companion generally does as you wish and you are allowed to control all of its actions in combat, though it does still have a will of its own.
All companions have the following set of ability scores and armor, chosen on character creation. Add DEX to this armor value.All companions have the following traits...

classes/beast-trainer/beast-trainer.html.title: Beast Trainer
classes/beast-trainer/beast-trainer.html.description:
You form a close bond with a beast companion and mold your fighting style around fighting in tandem with it. You gain special abilities that allow you to establish a closer bond with them. Fighting individually you are fairly weak, but together you can unleash powerful combo attacks.Art by me!
You have magical specialization and martial specialization.
You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the Shroomlette🍄 and pupper trees.
You gain the service of a specific animal to aid you on your journey. It grows more powerful as you do. More rules on beast companions in the Beast Companion🐶 section.
When you take the attack action, your beast companion can also use its attack action to attack the same creature. You both get +2 to Attack. This bonus also applies if you make an AoO against the same creature. This attack counts as one attack for the purposes of applying DR. Some forms of offensive actions that don't require an attack roll, such as maintaining a Grapple, can reasonably also grant this boon to the other member of the duo.When you use this feature and one strike is enough to defeat the creature, the other is consumed and you cannot use your companion's strike on another.All special attacks gained through this class deal an additional d6 per odd LV dmg if you and your beast companion both land an attack using tandem strike. You cannot combine these special attacks with other special attacks, even if your companion is the one performing the "special" part of the attack.
If one of your attacks is a Crit, then you crit this additional damage as well.
Gain a teamwork feat. Your beast companion shares all of your teamwork feats.Select one of the following options that will shape your companion. Mount - Beast companion grows to size large. You can ride bareback (no saddle) without issue.
Guard - Companion gains the Bodyguard feat.
Watch - Companion gains the Ready for Anything feat.
Lucky - Companion gains +1 LUK
You learn the secret language, druidic. In text form it can only be seen by other creatures that know druidic. You can essentially write secret messages by touching your finger to any natural object (typically boulders and trees) and writing. Any message written in this way can be erased by a creature that knows druidic with ease.
Gain the Convenient Companion feat.
You start play with 10 GBP for the Earth Mother🍃, unless your WIS is -1 or lower.When traveling through natural terrain that restricts your movement, such as thick snow or dense jungle, you and your beast companion's speed are not affected. All allies that can see you or your beast companion also gain this benefit. After not seeing either of you for a few minutes, your allies lose this benefit.You can speak with your beast companion as though you shared a language. Other creatures cannot understand you unless they can speak with animals.
You can mana burn any amount to grant an equal number of adaptation points🧬 to your beast companion indefinitely. When you rest, this adaptation fades and you must reapply it.

classes/bender/archetypes/airbender/airb.title: Airbending Style
classes/bender/archetypes/airbender/airb.description:
Features with a number require being at least that level. (16 total features) Reminder: All effects are Su and have the air tag.Your elemental blast can deal pierce, crush and slash damage interchangeably.You can use elemental blast to perform combat maneuvers from a range. All combat maneuvers you do with your blast get a +8 bonus.As a standard action, you can move 30 ft (even into the air) with a sudden burst of wind and make a blast attack against a creature within reach along the way.
As a swift action, bend a ball of air and ride it around. While on an air scooter, you hover, your movement is elusive, your speed increases by 10 and you can use your hover speed along any surface. You must move at least 30 feet each round to maintain air scooter. If you are poise broken while riding an air scooter, it ends and you are knocked down in addition to any other effects.You take half damage from reflex saves. If you pass a reflex save, it deals no damage and has no other additional effect.When an attack misses you, or when you pass a saving throw, you can move 15 ft as an instant action.You can slow the falling of up to four creatures within 30 ft of each other or in a 10x10 area as an immediate action. This negates fall damage they take and lets them land on their feet.
As long as you maintain a (mostly) shaved head, you gain +Blindsense (Tremorsense 5ft). It treats open air as though it was water.
Whenever you use your elemental wave feature, creatures are made clumsy 2 on a failed save.
When you land your elemental blast, creatures are clumsy 2. You cannot benefit from this if you use a technique to augment your elemental blast.Remove the mana cost of elemental wave. Creatures that fail their save against your elemental wave are pushed away from you or pulled towards you 10 ft (your choosing for all affected creatures).By falling 20 ft and landing on the ground after jumping into the air or flying, you can cannonball as a standard action. Creatures within 20 ft of you take you're blast damage and are knocked to the edge of the AoE (fort halves damage and negates pushback). Until the start of your next turn, get +4 ac vs ranged attacks.
When you take flight, enemies within 10 feet of you become clumsy 1.
Ride inside of a wheel shaped air current through the battlefield as a FRA. Move 40 feet using your hover speed without provoking AoOs. Any creature whose space you move through takes blast damage and is knocked down (reflex halves damage and negates knock down).Air within 30 ft rapidly starts to spiral, carrying anything within. Creatures within the area are immediately caught in the whirlwind (fort negates, putting them out of the AoE at nearest point). When the creature is caught, and every round thereafter, they take your blast damage and are thrown around in a very random fashion (roll dice to determine which side they end up on).Each round a creature can attempt an athletics check as a FRA to escape the whirlwind's area.You are immune to the effects of your own whirlwind.
Pull the air directly out of the lungs of a creature within 30 ft. The creature is staggered for 1 minute. Each round at the end of their turn for the next minute they gain a stack of doom (fort negates). At 3 stacks they gain the defeated condition for 10 minutes and you can choose to end the effect.As a standard action you can encase yourself in powerful winds, forming a powerful barrier for 1 minute. Any attacks made against you that miss are rerolled against the creature that made them.Unleash a powerful wave of wind capable of eroding mountains, uprooting trees and sending creatures flying. In a 60 ft cone in front of you, or a 120 ft line, each 30 ft tall (pushing or pulling), unleash a current that automatically deals your blast damage to any creature in its area or any creature that walks into the area. Creatures that take blast damage are launched outside of the areas aoe in the direction you chose (fort negates). Creatures not knocked away by the effect still treat the area is difficult terrain. This area persists for one minute.
Ranged attacks made through the hurricane force are automatically negated. Creatures cannot fly through the area.You can pass through your hurricane force freely.

classes/bender/archetypes/earthbender/ea.title: Earthbending Style
classes/bender/archetypes/earthbender/ea.description:
Features with a number require being at least that level. (19 total features) Reminder: All effects are Su and have the earth tag.Your elemental blast can deal pierce, crush and slash damage interchangeably.You can use elemental blast to perform combat maneuvers from a range. All combat maneuvers you do with your blast get a +8 bonus.
You permanently memorize the Fog Cloud technique, but it also gains the earth tag. By spending a standard action each turn, you can cause it to follow your movement, or the movement of another creature of your choosing within 30 ft.You can also spend a standard action to increase its size, essentially adding another fog cloud adjacent to the first one.
As an immediate action, decrease the damage of an attack roll or AoE effect affecting you by your LvL. Can also be used to defend an ally touching the ground within 30 ft of you.You can walk along any surface primarily consisting of earth without penalty, even along walls and ceilings, though it is considered difficult terrain. If poise broken, you plummet and take appropriate fall damage. You can start concentrating on this ability as a free action. If you concentrate as a standard action, you can move at full speed, and cannot be knocked off when poise broken.
Increase your jump distance by 10 feet. You can give an ally a jump action as an immediate action by spending 1 mana. they also receive this boost.
Your Burrow speed increases to 30 the first turn you start burrowing. By spending 1 mana, you can make an explosive entry, giving your next melee attack gets a +2 bonus if you burrowed that turn.
You can also Hide as part of burrowing.
You permanently have a Mud Buddy. It does not have the Mana Burn tag.
It can use your elemental blast, but only against an adjacent target that is Clumsy, Knocked Down or Entangled by an Earth effect.
Cause a 30 ft long, 10 ft wide, 30 ft deep chasm to appear in a spot on the ground, the starting point needs to be within your natural reach. Creatures inside the AoE fall inside and take appropriate fall damage (reflex negates). A creature can opt to catch fall instead of their reflex save. A creature that's successfully saves can choose which side of the chasm they end up on.
At any point thereafter, you can close the fissure as a standard action, crushing anybody inside. They take your blast damage and are entombed. Breakout as a FRA (Class DC+5).After 1 minute the fissure closes automatically.
Cause a 20 ft radius of earth within 30 ft to turn soft and unstable. Only the center needs to be within 30 ft. Creatures inside the AoE sink inside, entangling them (reflex negates). Regardless, the area is still difficult terrain. Creatures that enter the quicksand are entangled (reflex negates).
Breakout to escape as a swift action, or automatically as a standard action. If a creature is entangled by this effect at the end of their turn, they take your blast damage.You cannot be entangled by your own quicksand. The quicksand reverts to its previous form after 1 minute.
Whenever you use your elemental wave feature, creatures are made clumsy 2 on a failed save.
When you land your elemental blast, creatures are clumsy 2. You cannot benefit from this if you use a technique to augment your elemental blast.
Cover yourself in a layer of protective earth. You reduce your speed by 15 but gain DRA 3. You can dismiss this armor as a swift action.
Creatures you damage with elemental wave or blast are grounded for 1 turn.By falling at least 20 ft and landing on the ground, you can cannonball as a standard action. Creatures within 20 ft of you take your blast damage and are clumsy 2 (reflex halves damage and clumsy).
This also negates your fall damage.
As a swift action, you can use earthbending to create terrain that lasts until the end of your turn, or until the end of your next turn. This can be used to make things like bridges, ramps and stairs or Total Cover.Cause a creature within 30 ft to sink into the earth. They are entangled and take blast damage (fort halves damage and negates entangle). Breakout as a swift action to escape.If the creature was already entangled, they are instead entombed and take blast damage (fort halves damage and negates entomb). Breakout (Class DC+5) to escape as a FRA.
Ride a wave of earth through the battlefield as a FRA. Move 40ft. Any creature whose space you move through takes blast damage and is knocked down (reflex halves damage and negates knock down).Use earth to bind a creature within 30 ft. Two of their arms (or similar limbs) become completely unusable and they drop whatever is in their hands (reflex reduces to one arm, their choice). Breakout as a swift action to break bindings. A creature with only one arm restrained can automatically remove the bindings on the other as a swift action. Creatures with more limbs can potentially do this as well, even if 2 arms are restrained. If used outside of combat, the breakout DC to break the cuffs increases by 10. Cannot be used in consecutive rounds.Cause a 40 ft radius, the center of which must be within 120 ft of you, to shake with such intensity that it destroys structures and cracks the earth. Creatures in the area immediately take blast damage (fort halves). All creatures are clumsy 4 and staggered while inside. Creatures inside of structures or underground are entombed (fort reduces to entangle). Lasts 3 rounds.
Whenever you move, you can choose to spend a swift action to stomp and shatter the ground in front of you. Deal (LvL) damage in a 15ft cone and stagger enemies for 1 round (fort negates).
Smash the ground in front of you, causing it to flip up into the air like a broken floorboard, flinging foes towards you. Target a 60 ft cone. Creatures within the area take blast damage and are flung adjacent to you and knocked down (fort halves damage and negates movement/knockdown).

classes/bender/archetypes/firebender/fir.title: Firebending Style
classes/bender/archetypes/firebender/fir.description:
Features with a number require being at least that level. (17 total features) Reminder: All effects are Su and have the fire or zap tag, as appropriate.By manifesting a mote of flame, a fiery halo, flaming hair etc, you can give off light in a 20 ft radius. By spending a swift action, you can increase the radius of the bright light to 60 ft for 1 round. You can turn this ability on or off 1/round as an instant action.By spending 1 mana as a swift action, you can end this ability to blind all creatures within your natural reach for 1 round (reflex reduces to blurred vision). This part of the ability can only be used 1/combat.As a standard action, you can move 30 ft (even into the air) with a sudden burst of fire and make a blast attack against a creature within reach along the way.
Whenever you are Entombed, frosty, wet, entangled or something similar, you can spend an immediate action to automatically melt any solid material that contains you, removing the condition. If the effect is intangible magic, attempt to dispel it (as though using elemental counter, even if you don’t have it yet).If you start your turn grappled, deal blast damage to all grappling creatures as a free action.When you take the dash or disengage action, you can leave behind a trail of flames. Creatures that walk through these spaces are set ablaze (reflex negates).
Your elemental blast causes foes to glow vibrantly and applies a -10 penalty to +Stealth On-hit for 1 minute. Further attacks against this creature ignore partial concealment and treats total concealment as partial concealment.Your elemental wave feature also applies this effect on a failed save.
When you successfully feint a creature, they are set ablaze.
You permanently memorize the Fake Out technique.Your elemental wave feature is persistent until the start of your next turn. You cannot change its direction, even if you move during it.A random space occupied by the target of your elemental blast is set on fire. Creatures that move into this space are set ablaze. The creature you initially attacked is only set ablaze immediately if they end their turn in this space.
You can fire an elemental blast that doesn't require an attack roll and doesn't do any damage. It leaves a tiny flame behind that you can choose to explode at any point within the next minute as an instant action. The explosion does blast damage in a 10 ft radius (reflex halves). If you don't choose to make it explode within a minute, it fizzles.You can singe a fiery rune onto a surface that lasts until it is activated. Common things include things people frequently interact with like doors and books. When a creature gets within 5 ft of this rune and there is line of effect, it explodes in a 5ft radius, dealing blast damage (reflex halves). You can have a number of runes equal to your level and you are mentally alerted which one activates when they explode or are disabled.
A fiery rune can be avoided by covering it, scratching at it with a long object or destroying the object it's written on. +Perception👀 DC is your DC to notice when put in plain sight.
You can create a display of colorful fire so beautiful it fascinates creatures. Sighted creatures within 30 feet of you become fascinated for up to 1 minute (will negates).
As a Special Attack, you can cause your zap blast to jump to an additional target within 15 feet of the original, requiring a separate attack roll. If you charge the blast, you can target a third creature.
Create a barrier made out of fire. Creatures cannot see through the wall. You can make this barrier in different shapes. At least one section of the wall must be within natural reach.Castle: 5 ft radius wall 15 ft high. Wall: 15 ft tall, 30 ft wide If you charge, you can increase the castle radius by 5 ft and its height by 10 ft. You can increase the wall's length by 30 ft and its height by 10 ft.
Every time a creature moves through the barrier, they take your blast damage (reflex halves). Creatures 5 ft from the barrier take your LvL in damage each turn.You take no damage from existing near your wall or passing through it.
Targets of your fire elemental blast on-hit and elemental wave on a failed save are set ablaze.
When you or an ally within natural reach are targeted by an effect you can use your elemental counter feature against, you can use it as an immediate action. If you are successful, you can redirect it as though you had used the effect, using your class DC. If you fail, you become the target (or center of the effect).
Launch an immense fire blast into the sky, the center of which lands on a space within 120 ft of you. Creatures within 5 ft of the impact zone have Disadvantage on their save. Deal blast damage in a 40 ft radius and set all creatures ablaze (reflex halves damage and negates ablaze). The meteor's AoE sets creatures that walk through it ablaze (reflex negates).
See Lava🌋 for more details.You smash the ground violently, and magma pours from the impact, rapidly filling a 20 ft radius around you with magma rapidly. Creatures in the initial area of the spell take blast damage and have lava cling to them (reflex halves dmg and negates lava cling).
The AoE left behind is Difficult Terrain functioning as semisolid lava, and creatures that move through it have lava cling to them (reflex negates). You ignore all the negative effects of your roiling magma.

classes/bender/archetypes/waterbender/wa.title: Waterbending Style
classes/bender/archetypes/waterbender/wa.description:
Features with a number require being at least that level. (24 total features) Reminder: All effects are Su and have the water or frost tag as appropriateYour elemental blast can deal pierce, crush and slash damage interchangeably.You can use elemental blast to perform combat maneuvers from a range. All combat maneuvers you do with your blast get a +8 bonus.
You can also parry attacks aimed at allies within your blast range. When you successfully parry an attack, you can make an attack against the creature as an instant action, including using your blast. You can riposte against any attackers within 30 ft of you.Using clean water, touch a creature to heal (blast damage) hp. This ability has a 1 minute cooldown.
You can choose to give this the overheal tag, but it also gains mana burn.
Clean water counts as a medicine kit for you.
You permanently memorize the Fog Cloud technique. By spending a standard action each turn, you can cause it to follow your movement, or the movement of another creature of your choosing within 30 ft.You can also spend a standard action to increase its size, essentially adding another fog cloud adjacent to the first one.
As a swift action, give a creature within range of your Elemental Blast the wet condition. If it is an enemy (reflex negates). This can effectively wash a creature clean for any features where that is relevant.
You can move loose vegetation with your bending such as vines or other long flexible plants. This does not function against particularly dry plants like tumbleweed or dead plants. Against plant creatures, your blasts have a +2 bonus to attack or the DC as appropriate.As a standard action, you can bend water around the head of a creature within reach. A protective bubble forms around it, allowing it to breathe freely underwater for 1 hour.
You can use water bending to manipulate any liquids in the Alchemical Items section as though using the Catapult technique, but it deals your blast damage instead of its standard damage.
When you use the Administer Potion action, you can use waterbending to administer it as a swift action. This also makes it so it does not consume the target's immediate action.
Completely freeze over a surface in slick ice. Freeze a 10 ft radius, centered on a point within 30 ft, or a 30 ft cone. Creatures inside of this radius take blast damage and are knocked down (reflex negates). Moving through an iced space knocks down creatures (reflex negates). You can avoid falling by treating icy spaces as difficult terrain or by rolling to Balance.
Creature within 30 ft takes blast damage and is made frosty or entangled (reflex halves dmg and negates status).
Breakout to escape entangle as a swift action. 1 fire damage frees the creature automatically.
Whenever you use your elemental wave feature, creatures are made clumsy 2 on a failed save.
When you land your elemental blast, creatures are clumsy 2. You cannot benefit from this if you use a technique to augment your elemental blast.A wave of water gently washes over you and allies within 30 ft of you. All allies heal hp equal to half your blast damage. Allies can choose to ride the waves to the edge of the radius of this ability, moving directly away from the origin you used this ability from.You can use the repositioning effect of this ability whenever you like, but a creature can only be healed by this ability once each minute.Remove the mana cost of elemental wave. Creatures that fail their save against your elemental wave are pushed away from you or pulled towards you 10 ft (your choosing for all affected creatures).
You permanently memorize the Snowscape and Rain Dance techniques without costing memory. During rain or snow, you can use your Swim speed, regardless if it is heavy enough to make puddles.
Your water attacks are considered to be of adamantine toughness for the purposes of Breaking Objects.Create a barrier made out of ice with enough water. Creatures cannot see through the wall. You can make this barrier in different shapes. At least one section of the wall must be within reach.Igloo: 10 ft radius dome, complete with door. Castle: 5 ft radius wall 10 ft high. Wall: 10 ft tall, 30 ft wide.
Creature can use Brute Force as a standard action to break through a 5x5 section of a wall (or more for larger creatures). Alternatively an attack that does 10 crush damage or 5 fire damage destroys a 5x5 section of the wall.
As a swift action, you can use waterbending to create icy terrain that lasts until the end of your turn, or until the end of your next turn. This can be used to make things like bridges, ramps, stairs or to create Total Cover.
You permanently memorize Aqueous Orb without spending memory. The orbs speed is 60.
You can freeze a defeated creature, giving them stasis permanently. Must take at least 30 fire damage to unfreeze. You can unfreeze them as an instant action if they are within 30 ft.Choose a point on the surface of the water within 60 feet of you. Water within 30 ft rapidly starts to twist and turn toward that point, carrying anything within. Creatures within the area are immediately caught in the whirlpool (fort negates, putting them out of the AoE at nearest point). When the creature is caught, and every round thereafter, they take your blast damage (crush) and are pulled closer to the center at a random speed (roll dice to determine which side they end up on). After the second round of being caught, they are completely submerged underwater.
Each round a creature can attempt to Breakout as a FRA to escape the whirlpool's area. You are immune to the effects of your own whirlpool. All creatures in the area are made wet.
Creatures with a Swim speed get Advantage on saves against whirlpool.
Special: If you use this outside of a body of water, its DC decreases by 2 and its radius decreases to 15 ft.
Entomb a creature in ice (reflex reduces effect to frosty). An attack that does 10 crush damage or 5 fire damage destroys the ice and frees the creature. An entombed creature can breakout as a standard action to escape.By spending 1000g to perform a special ritual, requiring 10 minutes of concentration, you can bless a small vial of water with incredible healing capabilities. You can use this blessed water to bring a creature back from the dead at 1 hp if it died within the last minute. You can innately tell when a creature is too far gone to heal with this. You can only have one vial of this blessed liquid at a time.As a standard action, enter octopus stance for 10 minutes, causing 8 tendrils of water to form around you. As an instant action, you can take a shield action or parry by sacrificing a tentacle.Cause an enormous and powerful wave of water to wash over the world. Form a wave 60 ft wide and 30 ft high that originates from your space and launch it in a direction. It moves 60 feet each round on your turn for 3 rounds before crashing. When the wave passes over a creature, it gets picked up by the wave (fort negates). When it gets picked up and every round after it takes blast damage and is entombed in the wave. A creature can attempt athletics with a -4 penalty as a FRA to escape, getting deposited somewhere near where they were trapped. If a creature is within the wave when it crashes, it takes 50% increased damage and is stunned for 1 round.You can choose to ride the wave if you wish. The wave deals massive damage to structures and carries objects unless they are securely rooted in the ground. All creatures in the area are made wet.Special: If the waves starting point is outside of a body of water, its DC decreases by 2, its height decreases to 15 and its width decreases to 30.
Take control of the body of creature within 30 ft of you (assuming a significant portion of its body composition is made of water like humanoids), stunning it for 3 rounds (fort reduces to stagger for 3 rounds). As part of initially using the ability, and each round it is staggered/stunned by this ability as a swift action, you can cause the creature to attack its friends. If the creature is stunned, you can move it up to its speed and make simple attacks or take the Charge action. If it is staggered, you can only force it to make a simple attack.

classes/bender/oddball-spells.html.title: Oddball Spells
classes/bender/oddball-spells.html.description:
Because the technique progression of the Bender class is awkward, I have gone out of my way to take the work out of finding what techniques work for your element outside of the technique trees I recommended. I will also include a handful of spells I feel are thematically appropriate even if they do not have matching tags since there isn't enough content for some tags. You can still cast any of these spells without staff components.Just as a reminder, some of these techniques you won't have access to until certain levels, since firebenders and waterbenders don't unlock the variants to their blasts until levels 5 and 3 respectively.The techniques are listed in order of their level. Any cantrips are permanently memorized without consuming memory.Air - Feather Fall, Second Wind, Euphoric Cloud, Gust,
Earth - Stubbed Toe, Living Roots, Call of the Grave, Pocket Sand, Frenzied Leap, Quake, Toe Smasher, Mud Buddy, Ups and Downs, Iron Man, Man Drop
Fire - Catch Flame, Shocking Grasp, Fired Up, Endothermic Touch (though this one is already covered by what the base firebending ability does), Hidden Power, Spontaneous Combustion, Flame of Destiny, Hot Potato, Solar Power, Elemental Shield, Prismatic Body, Rod of Roasting
Water - Icicle, Free Swim, Wave of Darkness, Hidden Power, Enhance Water, Fog Cloud, Blanket of Snow, Ice Skating, Frost Armor, Snow Fort, Ice Lance, Shadow Weapon, Powder Snow, Liquefy, Elemental Shield

classes/bender/when-can-i-bend.html.title: when-can-i-bend
classes/bender/when-can-i-bend.html.description: In order to be balanced, some limitations are required to determine when you can and can't bend your particular elements. Treating every moment in a piece of media as canon that you can mimic in game can pose some problems.For example, King Bumi earthbending when inside of what is essentially a coffin when only his head is exposed. Allowing that kind of power while completely restrained can create problems.In general, I'd say that anything that can prevent you from making unarmed attacks can also prevent you from using elemental blast/wave/techniques. Some exceptions can be made (like firebending's melt feature), but in general, standard methods of restraint should be sufficient to prevent most abilities from functioning.In the show, elemental attacks can originate from places other than directly where the attacker is standing.I have simplified elemental blast to always be ranged from a range, and letting you choose to make it ranged or melee when creatures are within your natural reach. Most abilities require you, or a spot near you, as the origin point.

classes/fiend-shifter/archetypes/destroy.title: Destroyer
classes/fiend-shifter/archetypes/destroy.description:
Destroyer shifters are the most monstrous of all fiend shifters. They specialize in destruction, feats of strength and striking fear in the hearts of their enemies. Destroyer abilities are inspired by fiendish, animalistic and monstrous creatures with little more than the desire to kill.Your have Martial Specialization.
Your technique trees are Barbarism💢 and Cataclysm🌋.
When you break the first seal, you increase to large size and increase your Land Speed by 10. If there isn't enough room for you to grow, you can roll +Athletics🏊 as an instant action to make room. When you transform you can willingly choose to give yourself the taunted condition against one enemy that you can see. You can also choose to immediately take the Focus action against them. You get +4 to d20s (attack, skills, saves etc) against enemies that taunt you. You can choose to automatically fail any effects that taunt.Whenever you use this self-inflicted taunt and you do not attack or otherwise attempt to cause harm to the creature that you are taunted by, you take 3 psychic damage and the taunt ends.When you break the second seal, you increase to huge size. As part of the action to break the seal, and every turn after as a swift action, you can dash, as long as you are taunted. If the creature you are taunted by is defeated, leaves combat, is devoured, or you otherwise aren't taunted, you can choose to be taunted by another creature as an instant action.When you break the final seal, you increase up to massive size. Any creature you are taunted by must make a will save or be frightened for as long as you are taunted by them (will negates).Numbers indicate level requirements (10 total)
You can demoralize creatures up to 60 ft away. When you break the seal, you gain a +4 bonus to intimidation and can demoralize a creature as part of doing so.
You gain the fearsome finisher featYou gain the rend monster ability (2 claws). Deals 2d6 (7) sonic damage.
As a standard action, or at the end of a Charge, deal 2d8+lvl (9+lvl) sonic damage to all creatures within your natural reach and stagger all creatures for one round (fort halves damage and negates stagger).
You gain an extra long and dexterous tongue capable of grasping and finely manipulating objects as well as your hands. You can also use it to make attacks with +10 reach during your turn (deals crush damage).Gain a special attack
Grasping Tongue: - Kidnap your foe. If the attack lands, make an additional drag attack.Whenever you land a tongue attack, or just lick someone, you learn a tidbit of information about the creature. This information is one of the few things: A random piece of personal information (such as a love interest), something that weighs heavy on the creature's mind (such as upcoming important events) or the creature itself (as per one section of monster lore). If you've already learned about the creature through monster lore (even from an ally or previously licking the creature) you can instead learn about another category.
Your claws are considered to be of adamantine toughness for the purposes of Breaking Objects. You get a +4 bonus to athletics checks to break things.
Whenever you take the Charge action, you automatically destroy obstacles, cover and difficult terrain that is of solid or lesser toughness. Anything harder you get a free attempt to break it. You can charge directly into the air and are immune to fall damage any round you charge. You have resistance to all damage when you charge.You gain the swallow monster quality. Deals 3d8 (13) poison damage.
You get DRA 3 vs swallowed creatures. You can also swallow creatures you successfully drag with your grasping tongue special attack instead of dragging them.Once per minute you can inhale with such sudden force as to evacuate the air in its proximity, causing a sudden wave of air pressure from the implosion. All creatures and loose objects within 30 feet of the you take (2d6+d6/odd lvl) sonic damage and are pulled adjacent to you (fort halves damage and negates pull). Swallowed creatures are also affected and automatically fail their save.You become a pure destructive force of the universe to such a degree that you can manifest the Endless Abyss. This takes the form of a black hole that is integrated into your body somehow (replaces eye, in the back of the throat, or something more exotic like the dark star skins in league) and is immediately recognized as dangerous by most.You can choose to annihilate objects that you comes into contact with, absorbing them into the abyss, as long as you are larger than them. You can concentrate for 1 minute to allow the Abyss to consume a defeated creature within reach. Add 1 to your soul counter. For every soul consumed, you can regurgitate an annihilated object or creature. Regurgitated creatures and objects are in the same state they were in when they were annihilated.
Whenever a creature within reach is defeated, you consume a piece of its soul and recover 10 hp. If they are within 60 ft of you, you can teleport adjacent to them as an immediate action to get a nibble of that soul. You can only munch a specific creature's soul 1/day.
