classes/fiend-shifter/archetypes/succ.ht.title: Succ
classes/fiend-shifter/archetypes/succ.ht.description:
Succ shifters are the schemers of the fiend shifters. They know when you've been naughty. Succ shifters have altered base stats.You have Magical Specialization.
Your technique trees are Shira💋, Brazzeria (T) and Psionics🤯. You get an additional technique point at this level and every odd level after.
When you break the first seal, creatures are much less resistant to your gentle caress. When you Grapple a creature, you do not need to spend any actions to maintain the grapple and your speed is reduced to 15 instead of 0, allowing you to carry along your new friend. Your claws give you a +4 bonus to grapple attacks while your hands are empty.
You gain the Maneuver Versatility feat.
When you break the second seal, You gain constrict. Initiating a grapple and every turn you maintain it thereafter inflicts drained 5 on your target and you heal 5 hp.
Whenever you succ a creature like this, the creature is also charmed for 1 minute (will negates). You can apply either or both effects with a normal kiss.When you break the final seal,Numbers indicate level requirements (8 total)As a swift action, you can attempt to charm a creature within 30 ft permanently (will negates). If you do not want to take companion slots, it functions as the spell charming gaze. These creatures do not gain the companion attack bonus.Whenever a creature makes a promise (verbally, written, etc) to you, you can unknowingly curse them (will negates). Whenever the cursed creature breaks that promise, you know. As a standard action, you can scry on them. You can do this indefinitely. You can remove this curse at any time as an instant action. If the creature breaks the promise, it must apologize to you and provide some form of penance to remove the curse.
Gain the Tangled feat. Whenever you rest with another creature(s, max three others), you and the creature(s) gain (2*lvl) temp hp, lasting until they are lost.
Your CL increases by 1.
By decreasing your speed by 30 and chanting in a fiendish tongue, you can increase the CL and DC of the effect of spells you cast this round by 1.
A creature can perform the aid action to increase your CL by 1 if they also chant in a fiendish tongue. They need not be in reach, you only need to hear them.You gain an extra dimensional space as a part of your body. You can access it by reaching into your chest if you're feelin lewd, or through something more exotic like a literal drawer integrated into your body (a la Ava's Demon). This space has an unlimited quantity of volume, allowing you to put and pull out comically large objects, but anything stored within counts against your carry weight. Gain 100 carryweight. A creature can only remain inside for 1 minute before being forcefully ejected. It cannot enter again until you rest. Other creatures can access your cache while you are defeated, dead or asleep (with sleight of hand). Though it may require a lot of searching to find the desired object.
You are constantly under the effects of Detect Thots. It does not have the concentration tag. By making skin to skin contact with a creature (or whatever you/they have that replaces skin), you can learn one piece of information. Prolonged contact gives you multiple chances to gather more information. One kink or fetish the target has The name and appearance of the creature the target is most attracted to The name and appearance of the creature the target most recently did something lewd with
You can transform to match the appearance of a creature you learn about from this ability as a standard action, even if it isn't humanoid. If you successfully +Disguise yourself as this creature, you have advantage on all Skill Check made concerning this creature. Depending on the target's familiarity with the creature, it may be difficult to disguise as them, or benefit from the transformation at all if their relationship soured post intercourse.
You can telekinetically manipulate objects within 60 ft, limited by your carry weight. You can hold a large quantity of smaller/lighter objects if they are all close together. These are essentially treated as an additional limb that requires concentration to use.Gain a +1 bonus to one of your ability scores (max +3). You can confer this benefit on up to 3 willing creatures. Gifted creatures also receive other effects.
You can use Telepathy to communicate with these creatures over any distance. They are permanently charmed by you, which cannot be removed without first removing the gift.
As a standard action, you can scry on these creatures. You can do this indefinitely. This portion of the ability has the scrying tag
You form a Summoning Contract📜 with these creatures. You can summon one as a standard action. You can only have 1 summoned at any given time. This portion of the ability has the [companion] tag, but only when the creature is summoned.

classes/fiend-shifter/archetypes/unchain.title: Unchained
classes/fiend-shifter/archetypes/unchain.description:
Unchained shifters are all about inflicting as much pain upon themselves and others as possible. They take their favorite parts of other creatures and add it to themselves.You have Martial Specialization.
Your technique trees are Barbarism💢 and Pupper.When you break the first seal, 4 spiked chains burst from your back that you can make attacks with (deals crush damage). They function as additional opposable limbs that can be used to hold objects, climb walls, grapple creatures etc. The chains have an additional 5 feet of reach during your turn.
When you break the second seal, your chains now have an additional 10 ft of reach during your turn. You can innately cast Shackles of Pain as a swift action, taking up one of your shackles while the effect persists. Instead of its usual range, it has a range of reach. It also has an altered effect. It does not reduce any of the damage you take, but instead causes chained creatures to take half the damage you take as true damage.When you break the final seal, your chains now have an additional 15 ft of reach during your turn. Your share my pain feature can target up to 4 creatures within reach at once.Numbers indicate level requirements (9 total)By spending 1 mana when you land an attack against a creature with your chains or claws, you can shackle them. One of your chains pops out of your body and stays put at the point they were at when you attacked them. At the end of their next turn, they are pulled back to that position and your chain returns to you. The chain immediately breaks if the creature gets more than 60 feet away, or if someone uses athletics to break it as a standard action.In any case, escaped chains reappear attached to you.After a battle, you can peruse the bodies of your defeated foes for pieces of them you like, such as their eyes, teeth, feathers, scales etc. You can surgically remove them with your claws and add them to yourself after 1 minute, either replacing that part of your body or you somehow make room. Increase your max hp by 1 each piece. The parts need to be fresh, so waiting for more than 5 minutes ruins their potency. Unchained shifters are a bit picky and will only add pieces of creatures of their level or higher (though they won't retroactively remove pieces as they level up).
You can have a maximum of (3+3*LvL) pieces.
Gain combat reflexes as a bonus feat.
Whenever you provoke an AoO, the attacking creature provokes an AoO from you. The act of provoking isn't enough and the creature can simply opt to not attack you to deprive you of your AoO.
When you are Defeated, you only become Drained 2. When recovering from being defeated, you are Staggered instead of Dazed.Whenever you take damage, keep a running tally of how much damage you have taken. After 1 minute of not taking damage, restore half of this value as hp.You can attack yourself, dealing damage as normal, requiring no attack roll. You gain +2 attack and +10 speed for 1 minute after doing so. If an ally attacks you, or includes you in the AoE of an effect that deals damage, you also get this bonus. Any damage you take during your turn has 100% effectiveness against creatures shackled by share my pain.While at or below 50% hp, you have +2 AC, +2 to all DCs you inflict and +2 to all saves.
On-hit your attacks apply a stacking debuff (similar to shaken/sickened, max 4) called pain. Pain gives a creature weakness 1 to all damage types. Any healing effect removes all pain stacks.You can use your share my pain feature on allies. Instead of its usual effect, it causes them to take half damage, redirecting the mitigated damage back to you. You can sever these chains as a free action.Whenever an enemy within 60 ft of you fails a skill check, fails to even graze with an attack or fails a saving throw, you restore 5 hp.

classes/fiend-shifter/archetypes/youkai..title: Youkai
classes/fiend-shifter/archetypes/youkai..description:
Youkai shifters have a powerful being sealed inside of them. As their relationship deepens, so too does their power. Youkai abilities are inspired by Japanese folklore.By concentrating, you can enter your own mind, allowing you to communicate directly with your youkai spirit in its prison. Youkai spirits tend to be powerful fiends👿 unwillingly sealed inside of creatures, either to harness their power, or seal it away.
You have Martial Specialization
Your technique trees are Protector🛡 and Scoundrel.
When you break the first seal, you gain FH 1 while below half hp. When you roll a natural 1, your youkai spirit intervenes, allowing you to Reroll it as an immediate action. You can break the first (second and final) seal as an immediate action to activate this reroll ability.When you break the second seal, your FH increases to 2 while below half hp, and you gain FH 1 when at or above half hp. Even when you are deprived actions (such as being staggered, dazed or defeated), your youkai spirit can take any of the actions listed in the below abilities. Spirit Siege Spirit Guide Spirit Guardian Spirit Simulacrum
When you break the final seal, your FH turns into regeneration, converted back to FH by poison or fire damage. Through you and your youkai spirit acting in tandem, you gain an additional swift action each turn.Numbers indicate level requirements (8 total)Note:
If you are not missing hp or are not bleeding, you cannot use this ability.
By taking 1 True Damage for each attack, you can make a Thrown claw attack by digging your claws into your wound and throwing blades of blood at an enemy.
Your youkai spirit is always watching over you, even when you do not manifest it. You get a +4 bonus +Perception👀 and Signature Skill for profession. You cannot be surprised by enemies ambushing you.
In combat your spirit actively participates to defend you. You cannot be flanked. Your spirit can possess your body and move with a 30 ft hover speed and automatically spend your standard action to disengage🏳, even if you lack those actions from being stunned for example. When you are defeated, creatures must still beat your AC or poise break you to attack/move you.
When you grapple a creature, your spirit also grabs a piece of their soul, making them fatigued. If you are not poise broken by the start of your next turn, your spirit devours this piece of soul. The creature you grappled becomes exhausted and drained 5. You regain (the creature's LvL) HP. A creature can only be affected by spirit snatcher 1/day.
The creature remains Exhausted for as long as they have the drained condition.
You can tap into the wisdom of the powerful spirit sealed inside of you. You get +History and +Insight🤔 as bonus skills, each with a +4 bonus.
You can offer yourself up to the spirit, causing you to be Drained 5. This allows you to Reroll a Skill Check.As a standard action, you can "free" your youkai spirit. At least that's how everyone around you interprets it. With a dramatic flourish, like an explosion, lightning crashing or something similarly flashy, your youkai spirit emerges from you to give your enemies a scare.
All enemies within 60 ft are Frightened (will reduces to shaken 1) for 1 round. A creature that passes itself cannot be frightened or shaken by this ability for 1 hour. Even when revealed to be fake, the hysteria induced status remains.
You get a +10 bonus to coercion and can do so untrained. This bonus applies to uses out of combat, and to creatures you defeat in combat after using this ability.
You grow a third eye, giving you the Innate Technique Glimpse of Truth 1/day.
As a swift action, you can fire a laser beam from this eye. Roll a d4 to see what you get, then choose a target. Make an Thrown attack. It deals 3d6 (10) damage with a random type and bonus effect.
You can decide which eye beam you would like to use, but doing so closes your third eye, disabling this ability for 1 minute. You cannot use this ability while blinded or while you have blurred vision, but you also negate any other penalties from such status.Your youkai spirit plays a much more active role in combat. It is capable of dashing around the battlefield before quickly returning to defend you once again. As a swift action, limited to once each round, you can command your spirit to do one of the following actions. Turn into a high level fiend?

classes/fighter/archetypes/basic-bitch-f.title: Basic Bitch Fighter
classes/fighter/archetypes/basic-bitch-f.description:
Fighter⚔ Archetype.For when you really don't want to think about complicated class features.You gain a bonus feat every level. Every time you gain a technique point, you can choose to instead turn it into a feat.You get access to the following feats, each of which can be taken any number of times.
Ability Increase - Increase an Ability Score by +1 (up to +3)
Super Strength - Increase STR by +1 (up to +5).
Super Armor - Gain +1 AC (up to +3).
Power Stance - Gain +3 Poise.
Paladin Cosplay - Get a +1 bonus to Saves (up to +3).
Superior Genetics - Get an additional major feature from your race🏁.

classes/fighter/archetypes/bloody-finger.title: Bloody Finger
classes/fighter/archetypes/bloody-finger.description:
Fighter⚔ Archetype.Suddenly end fights with the power cause creatures to explode into bloody chunks long after you cut them with your blade. Gank people from across the realm who dare intrude upon your territory.
by Kero
Any piercing or slashing weapon you wield gains the bleed property. On-hit with a bleed weapon (even if it does no damage), keep a running tally of how many times the creature was hit. This number is referred to as "bleed stacks" and is separate from other bleed effects. Crits apply 2 bleed stacks. Bleed stacks are visible on the creatures body and last until you rest.Even if a creature cannot bleed, it can still gain bleed stacks.
Sheathe your weapon(s) as a standard action. Creatures that have bleed stacks (no matter the distance) lose all stacks and take 2d6 (7) True Damage. Creatures with 5+ stacks take 8d6 (28) true damage. Creatures with 10+ stacks take 16d6 (56) damage. This damage continues to double every 5 stacks infinitely.One of the bloody finger's fingers is always a crimson red. It can be used to write in a bloody ink.You can dual wield one handed weapons using dex or strength as long as the weapon has a Japanese name. If you wield a Japanese weapon in two hands, it applies 2 bleed stacks on hit, or 4 on a crit.This attack deals 0 apparent damage. Roll damage anyway and take note of it. The next time you use hemorrhage, any creature you struck with delayed doom takes all of this stored damage.You can use this special attack at will.
You can inscribe your name, or a symbol of significance to you on a surface using your bloodied finger. When a creature triggers the sigil, you get a glimpse of the surrounding area briefly. Anytime it is triggered, you can choose to crawl out of the sigil as though you were using a Summoning Contract📜 to summon yourself, causing the sigil to disappear. You can stay summoned this way for 5 minutes before you return to your body.
You cannot use this feature while you have summoning sickness. If you create a sigil while you already have one, the old one disappears.As a standard action, slash the air rapidly, causing many bloody projectiles to fly out in a 30 ft cone in front of you. Creatures in the area take 6d6 (21) slash or pierce damage and get 4 bleed stacks (reflex halves damage and bleed stacks).This ability recharges when you use your hemorrhage ability against a creature with 5 or more bleed stacks.
Gain Scent (120 ft) and Seeking against wounded creatures. Whenever a creature takes bleed damage within 30 ft of you, they gain a bleed stack.

classes/fighter/archetypes/full-attacker.title: Full Attacker
classes/fighter/archetypes/full-attacker.description:
Fighter⚔ Archetype.Feeling nostalgic about 3e, 3.5e or PF1e? Well here's me doing my best to recreate that experience in a slightly less heavy handed way than BB fighter. The full attacker is the fightiest guy, all about gaining insane amounts of movement speed and then using that speed to gain more actions. Woe to those who dare to stand in your face.If you defeat an enemy and don't have enough speed to reach a new enemy, you can move until you threaten the next closest enemy, unless your speed is 0.Any turn you spend your standard action to make an attack, can make an additional MELEE superior attack a turn by sacrificing 45 speed once per turn.You cannot use techniques or special attacks after full attacking. If you use a special attack or technique during your turn, you cannot full attack.
During combat, your speed increases by 15 this level and another 5 every level after. You must always end your movement with an enemy in reach. If you ever end your turn without an enemy in reach for any reason, you become clumsy 1.Each one can be used in place of a superior attack and they all share a global cooldown, only able to be used 1/round. You cannot sacrifice superior attacks gained from baby slayer to use these abilities.
5 Steps Ahead (elusive) - Prepare for an incoming attack. While preparing you can trigger this ability as an immediate action, moving up to 30 feet to the opposite side of a creature that affects you with a harmful effect. You get a +4 bonus to AC and saves against this effect.
Random Bullshit Go - Throw an item that isn't a weapon. Improvised weapons can still be used. If you throw a harmful item, such as a toxin, it applies on hit (then forcing saving throws as normal). If you throw a helpful item, such as a potion, its effects function as normal, ignoring any broken vials that may get involved. If for whatever reason an effect requires multiple rounds to take effect, that is still the case for this ability.
Cunning-ish Action - You can disengage🏳, Jump, aid, focus or make a +Combat Maneuver.
Brute Force - Roll a Brute Force check. When you full attack, you can sacrifice an additional 45 speed to make an additional attack with the same restrictions.

classes/fighter/archetypes/iron-knuckle..title: Iron Knuckle
classes/fighter/archetypes/iron-knuckle..description:
Fighter⚔ Archetype.Your armor is a second skin to you. Your armor is also your first skin. The iron knuckle has 2 "phases" to their battles. The first is a walking tank with multiple layers of armor, durable and stubborn until you get to the squishy single layer of plate armor underneath. The second is a nimble warrior that gets a boost of adrenaline, feeling light as a feather just after their outer shell is cracked open.Iron knuckles are practically invincible to being attacked head on while layered up, and must be ganged up. Mages will find a much easier time breaking the outer layer.
Iron Knuckle, as it appears in the LoZ seriesYou are fused with a set of standard metal plate armor. You can enhance this armor with new metals and enchantments with a more involved process. You are permanently treated as though you are wearing heavy armor. It is part of you and cannot be separated without causing permanent life-threatening damage to you.
Because this armor is a part of you, it being destroyed hurts you. Whenever your armor is destroyed/degraded you are Drained 10.You add construct to your creature types. You gain proficiency in the profession (blacksmith) skill.You can choose to put on an additional layer of heavy armor over the first, providing you with the following benefits after 1 minute of preparation. +4 AC
You benefit from the Quake technique constantly
While layered up you also take a -10 penalty to your speed and cannot fly or hover. Enemies can remove layer up by dealing damage that drops you below half hp. It takes 3 rounds to remove layer up manually. It requires a set of heavy armor in order to use layer up. When an enemy removes layer up, you cannot use that particular set of heavy armor to layer up again until you repair it. Be sure to pick it up after the battle!After carrying the weight of incredibly heavy metal armor during the heat of battle, to have the burden removed suddenly fills the iron knuckle with new vigor. When an enemy removes layer up from you, you become light as a feather, gaining the following benefits.
You gain (10+2*LvL) temp hp (healing), potentially preventing you from dying from single instances of damage.
Your speed and jump distance increases by 10 until combat ends (or you layer up again)
You are affected by the Unbreakable Advance technique until combat ends (or you layer up again). You gain access to the sudden strike special attack until combat ends.
Special Attack: Sudden Strike - Advance 10 ft towards an enemy (elusive) and make a melee attack. On-hit the target is pushed back 5 feet and knocked down. On a graze the target is only pushed back 5 ft. Deals an additional d6/odd lvl damage.
You gain the Power Pose feat. When you use it, it deals 15 poise damage instead of 10.
If you are layered up then you can use it as an instant action 1/turn. You can use power pose against AoOs an unlimited number of times as an instant action.
You can choose if you want to leave a creature at 1 poise, or poise break them with this ability. If a creature is poise broken by this ability then they are made clumsy 2, or you can push them 10 ft back.While light as a feather, when a creature misses you with an AoO, or you successfully use acrobatics to evade AoOs, you can make a bully attack as an instant action.If you are layered up, when you shove a creature, you can move with them to increase the shove distance by your remaining movement.
While light as a feather, you gain powerful charge.
If you are layered up then you are immune to fatigue.
You gain the innate technique adrenaline burst while light as a feather.
You are immune to attack rolls made by minions while layered up. Any minion that attacks you is instead set to 1 poise automatically as it bounces off of your metal body. This is treated as a miss.
While light as a feather, you gain resistance to damage from failed saving throws.
Whenever a creature misses or grazes you, they are knocked back 10 ft. If you also poise break them with Power Pose as part of the same attack, you can push them 20 ft.Strike at a foe, dealing an additional 6d6 (21) damage. If you are layered up, gain temp hp and poise equal to the total damage dealt. If light as a feather, also immediately layer up again until this temp hp is lost.This poise recovery cannot exceed your poise maximum.

classes/fighter/archetypes/kazekenshin.h.title: Kazekenshin
classes/fighter/archetypes/kazekenshin.h.description:
Fighter⚔ Archetype.Wind Swordsman are focused on being annoying and slippery with an incredibly powerful signature attack: Steel Tempest. Their abilities are centered around mobility to get into a better position to use this attack.Once per round when you land a melee attack against a creature, gain a stack of gathering storm. With two stacks of gathering storm, you can use this special attack. This special attack can be used any number of times in a combat.
Your attack whips up a whirlwind, targeting all enemies in a 60 ft line. Compare your attack roll to the ac of all creatures in the line. Enemies are Staggered On-hit for one round and take an additional d6/odd lvl damage.You cannot gain gathering storm stacks in the same turn you use steel tempest.
Keep a running tally of how far you move. Every time you move 60 ft, you gain a protective barrier that gives you DRA (3+1/2xLvL) for the next instance of damage you take.Once per enemy per round, unless your speed is 0 or you are unable to make attacks, you can choose to dash in a straight line through a enemy within reach as a free action, appearing directly on the opposite side of the creature adjacent to them. This movement doesn't count against your movement each round. Any movement around a creature you target with this ability is also elusive for this turn.You can combine sweeping blade with steel tempest, creating a new unique effect. You can either attack a 60 ft line as usual, or you can choose to attack a 10 ft radius around you at your destination.
You can innately cast Wind Wall. You can use wind wall as an immediate action, but its size is decreased to a 15x15 square, its duration changes to 1 round and its range decreases to reach. It does not impede you or your allies' movement or attacks.
The penalty to ranged attacks also applies to the DC of any ability that must physically pass through the wall. It would not apply to a spell like charming gaze, but it would apply to an effect like bestial claw.You can only use this ability again after 1 minute passes.You can use sweeping blade against a single target you attack with steel tempest, appearing on the opposite side of them from your current position.As an immediate action, you can teleport adjacent to any creature you can see within 30 feet that gets inflicted with a debilitating status effect (such stagger, poisoned, sickened) and make a simple attack against them. This ability must be used in response to the status being inflicted, it cannot be used against a creature that merely happened to be status'd.
Creatures hit by steel tempest are dazed for one round (fort reduces to stagger).Steel tempest's line attack increases in width. Instead of a 60 ft line that is 5 ft wide, it is 15 ft wide, essentially targeting all spaces adjacent to the line.When combined with sweeping blade, the AoE increases to a 20 ft radius around you at your destination.

classes/fighter/archetypes/standard-figh.title: Standard Fighter
classes/fighter/archetypes/standard-figh.description:
Fighter⚔ Archetype. Rally your allies around a point and fight together. Your standard is an annoying attack that you can to enhance allies on the battlefield. All of your class features are centered around rallying around and the manipulation of this standard.
As a swift action, summon a flag from the sky and have it slam down onto an unoccupied space within 30 ft of you. Enemies within 5 ft of it take (1+LvL) Force damage. You can choose to automatically pick up your flag by moving into its space, recharging this ability. A creature can knock over your flag by rolling athletics as a swift action (DC 10+your athletics bonus), causing it to disappear and recharging this ability. The flag automatically disappears after 1 minute.
While within 60 ft of your flag, your allies share your Teamwork Feats. Your flag counts as an ally to you for the purposes of fulfilling teamwork feat conditions.Gain a teamwork feat at lvl 1, 4 and 8.You speak the language of flag twirling. When communicating, you do it letter by letter, limiting its use to simple messages unless you spend a very long time.Your flag bears the mark of a country, guild or religion of significance. Members of the countries army or officials of the country, important members of your religion or guild etc. intuitively understand your messages.Before you make any attacks on your turn, you can decide to forfeit the ability to make combat maneuvers until the start of your next turn. When you do so, attacks deal poise damage equal to the hp damage they deal until the start of your next turn.
Once per round in place of an attack, you can slap some sense into a creature suffering from a Mind-Affecting effect or is Asleep. They take 1 True Damage and get an additional save against an effect of your choosing. If the effect had no DC, use the creature/entities offense trait DC/class DC.Make a charge attack targeting your flag from any distance, as long as you can see it and there is a direct path. Any creature in your path is automatically pushed out of your way on either side of you (your choice). You can melee attack any creature within reach once during this charge. You can choose to superior attack during the charge as well, allowing you to strike one particular creature twice.
You can use the aid action as a swift action. If your flag is within your natural reach when you use this feature, you use the aid action to give the same bonus to all creatures in your flag's aura.If you summon your flag and a creature is defeated by it, you can summon it again at a new location as a free action. Usable 1/turn.
When you summon your flag, and at the start of each of your turns, choose an ally to grant a divine shield. Can only happen 1/turn, regardless how many times you summon your flag.When you summon your flag, you can choose to activate this ability or not for its duration.The outer radius of your flags aura has a visible barrier around it. Creatures can pass through it freely, but attacks, spells, offense traits, thrown objects, weather effects and plenty of other things cannot. Any AoE effects are halted along the barriers edge. Even persistent ones like darkness or wall of fire are cut off. Whichever side of the barrier had more of the effect or it center is where it persists.
In general, creatures on opposite sides of the barrier have line of sight, but do not have Line of Effect.You can choose to decrease the size of the aura to 30 ft as part of summoning it.

headers.heading: 1 - Martial Standard (Su) (Force)
4 - Slap Sense (Healing)
6 - Swag Flag (recharge)

classes/fighter/archetypes/swashbuckler..title: Swashbuckler
classes/fighter/archetypes/swashbuckler..description:
Fighter⚔ Archetype.Swashbuckler are the best duelists around, with their signature parry and riposte ability giving them an edge over virtually all martial combatants, especially in melee. Their swift action is incredibly valuable, and can be spent in a number of ways that are powerful in their own ways.With a light weapon in your main hand and a buckler in your offhand, you can parry at any time. If you choose to use an unarmed strike or natural attack, you need a buckler in your off hand and a completely free main hand. Parry functions in 2 different ways.Prepare to Parry - You can choose to forgo any number of attacks during your turn. Until the start of your next turn you can parry as an instant action a number of times equal to the number of attacks you decided to forego. If you successfully negate an attack, you can riposte and make a melee attack against the creature as an instant action.
You get Advantage on any attacks made to parry or riposte when you prepare to parry.Reactive Parry - You can attempt to parry an attack without preparing by spending 1 mana. If you successfully negate an attack, you can riposte make a melee attack against the creature as an immediate action.If your foe attacked with a ranged attack, or with a weapon that has the reach property, you can only retaliate if they are within your reach. You can parry without a buckler, but take a -4 penalty to attack when you parry.When wearing light or no armor, and wielding a single light weapon, get the following benefits.
+3 bonus to AC
(4+½ LvL) bonus damage with light weapons
You gain +Deception as a skill. You get a +4 bonus on deception checks to feint, and an equal bonus on +Insight🤔 checks to resist feint. You can feint as a swift action by spending 1 mana.
You can innately cast It's Time to Duel!.You speak the language pirates. While not a secret language, it is incredibly difficult to understand despite it only being a modified version of common. A creature must be trained in linguistics to see past the many layers of slang that typify pirate lingo.The first time you use luck to add to a d20 roll each round, it can be done as an instant action. By spending 2 mana, you can reroll a save as an immediate action.
When you are hit or grazed by an attack, spend 1 mana as an immediate action to gain a +4 bonus to AC against a that attack and move 5 ft.
As a standard action, automatically feint a creature. It is feinted for all allies as well until the end of your next turn. A creature you use superior feint against becomes immune to it for 1 minute.
You can take the focus action as a swift action. While you focus, you get a +4 bonus to...
AoOs made against this creature
Reflex saves against the creature's +Acrobatics⚖ to avoid AoO
+Perception👀 against this creature
By spending 2 mana, choose a specific body part to target to gain a bonus effect On-hit (fort negates). Special: This special attack can be used more than once a combat by spending more panache.Reactive parry requires no mana. When you riposte after a reactive parry, it is an instant action instead of an immediate action.

classes/hero/runescape-skills.html.title: Runescape Skills
classes/hero/runescape-skills.html.description:
For clarity's sake... Everything written in Green is a skill. Everything written in Red is a combat talent you can unlock under that skill. Everything written in Blue is a utility talent you can unlock under that skill. Abilities that are preceded by a number have a level requirement.Prayer (Knowledge Religion) Protection Prayers Su - Gain an additional point of prayer and 5 GBP in a god of your choice, or Frogg Saran🐸 if your WIS is -1 or lower. When you would harmed by an attack or fail a saving throw, you can choose to negate the attack or pass the save by spending prayer as an immediate action.
Piety (Su) - Gain an additional point of prayer and 5 GBP in a god of your choice, or Frogg Saran🐸 if your WIS is -1 or lower. By spending prayer as a swift action, you can give yourself a +2 bonus to all d20 rolls until the start of your next turn. Magic (Knowledge Arcana)
Magical Specialization - Gain magical specialization.
(6) Magic! - Gain access to the telekinetic lift and Alchemize techniques as 1/day innate techniques.
(5) Antimagic - Gain access to the teleblock and superstitious techniques as 1/day innate techniques. Herblore (Knowledge Alchemy)
Quick Brewski - You can craft an alchemical item for 10% of its original price with 1 hour of work 1/day. You must still be able to meet its craft DC. You must still be able to provide odd specific ingredients, such as the tongue in a tongues potion.
(5) Chug - You can drink a potion once per turn as a free action. Fishing (Profession Fisher) Reel 'em In - You can use a fishing rod to finely manipulate objects. You can manipulate anything you could normally carry, replacing any sleight of hand check with profession (fisher). Range 30 ft. Patience - You get a +2 bonus to attack when you attack as part of a prepared action. (4) Fish are Friends (Su) - Using the power of fishing, you can convert aquatic creatures into friends. By catching a specific type of fish with a DC 30 profession (fisher) check, you can get a bonus to an +2 associated skill check when using the fish as a tool, as though they successfully used the assist other action. Unique fish might be able to assist in other ways, this is meant to apply to anything, within reason. This fish transcends its fishy existence to survive outside of water to assist you. It cannot be attacked, but it can be stolen. This kills the fish. A few examples of weird fish upgrades below… Hammerhead - Smithing, construction, you name it Pufferfish (or other poisonous) - For use in creating poisons Monkfish - Good for meditation Archerfish - You can trip with your ranged attacks Sharks - Underwater tracking Bass - Good for dropping sick beats Seahorse - Makes for a good underwater mount Woodcutting (Profession Lumberjack)
One With Nature (Sp) - You gain tree shape as an at will innate techniqueique. You can speak with plants. Axe Man - You gain a climb speed equal to your land speed. If you wield an axe, this speed doubles. Treebane - While wielding an axe, you can make a profession (lumberjack) check to cut down a tree within your reach without even swinging at it as a standard action. DC 10 for medium sized trees, then 10 higher per size above medium. Sentient trees are immune to treebane.
Whenever you use profession (lumberjack) to make money, you're essentially Taking 20. Cooking (Profession Chef)
Amazing Food (healing) - Turn mundane food into AMAZING FOOD. It takes you 1 hour of work and 100g of supplies to cook 5 pieces. They heal 10% hp when eaten on as a swift action, or double that if "savored" as a standard action. If you make more food, the pieces of food made previously perish, but they otherwise remain fresh forever. Tick Eating healing - When you take hit point damage that would defeat you, you can eat a piece of AMAZING FOOD as an immediate action, causing you to instead be set to 10% hp. Must have amazing food to use. Feast [healing] - Mining (Profession Miner) Shaft Mining - As a standard action, you can mine a 5x5x5 ft cube, effectively allowing you to burrow underground. You can only use this ability on unworked stone/earth etc. You must wield a pickaxe to do so.
Whenever you use profession (miner) to make money, you're essentially Taking 20. Break In - You can use profession miner as a substitute for athletics to break things as long as you wield a pickaxe. You get a +4 bonus to do so.\
(8) Vibrations (Su) - As a standard action, you can slam a pickaxe into the ground to gain blindsense (Tremorsense 30 ft) for 1 round. This allows you to see the general shape of things like buildings and caves, even through walls and floors. Construction (Knowledge Engineering) Bridge the Gap (Su) - While you wield a hammer, you have a “bridge speed” equal to your speed that lets you quickly nail together planks and walk along them. This bridge is solid enough for creatures to walk on and lasts until the end of your turn, or the start of your turn if you want your allies to follow. Costs 2g per foot bridged (30ft=60g). You can continue the bridge indefinitely, even as previous sections fall, effectively ignoring gravity, but you must at least start attached to something. Affordable Housing - With an hour of work, you can build a makeshift house with natural materials like dirt, wood and stone. You can remove T1 afflictions with general cures by resting in such a house. (3) Comfort - By creating a home worth at least 2k gold, you can get a boost by resting in this home. You and any allies get temp HP equal to half your skill roll. By spending the gold again, you can make home improvements to improve roll again to gain more temp hp. You can spend 40k gold to take 20 and maximize your comfort. Hunter (Survival)
Speak to Me (Su) - You gain the Wild Empathy feat. You can speak with animals. (3) Box Trap - With 10 minutes of preparation you can set a box trap for a specific creature, or a type of creature. You leave a trail of desirable substances to a box with a stick propping it up. The creature makes a perception check (DC 15+your survival bonus). If they succeed then they notice the unusual and untrustworthy setup. If they fail they are trapped in the box for one minute. Creatures with 0 or more int get advantage on their perception check, and can escape the box using any means at their disposal. Athletics DC to break is equal to the perception check to notice. Agility (Acrobatics) Boost - You can dash as a swift action. You can dash as a free action, but it makes you fatigued. Endurance Training - +10 speed. Parkour - You can jump as a free action 1/turn. When you jump, you ignore fall damage from 60 ft of falling. When you take fall damage, you take 1 damage per 10 ft you fall. (4) Shortcut (Su) - You can squeeze through the tightest of spaces and the smallest of cracks. Even with only a centimeter of space, you can slide through it. You can even comfortably sit in spaces like these indefinitely. You can't effectively navigate while squished in this way, making it only usable to get through very thin surfaces with gaps, like doors and windows. Fire Making (Profession Arson)
Fireproof - You gain resistance to fire damage. You take no damage or penalty to AC while ablaze. You can snap your fingers to spontaneously combust as a free action. The fire is cosmetic and provides light, but no heat.
Meltation - You gain the Melt Firebending Style ability. If you don't have the elemental blast feature, your blast damage is (d6+d6/odd lvl).
Pyrotechnics - You gain a technique point in the pyromancy🔥 tree. You can select this boon multiple times.
Dubstep Ignite recharge - When a creature survives one of your attacks with 5 or less hp, you know. You can spend an instant action to deal 5 true damage to them. Usable 1/minute.\
(5) Solves Everything (Sp) - You gain fire blast as a 1/day innate technique. You increase its range to 120 ft. At level 9 this is usable at will.

classes/lunatic/wild-magic.html.title: Wild Magic
classes/lunatic/wild-magic.html.description: When you trigger wild magic, first roll a d4 to determine which chart you roll on. 1 is red, 2 is yellow, 3 is purple and 4 is green.After that, roll d20s until you get a result on the chart. Hopefully eventually there will be more than 20!

classes/martial-artist/archteypes/monk/m.title: Monk Vows
classes/martial-artist/archteypes/monk/m.description:
Monk vows cannot be broken, even while under the influence of charm effects, possession etc. Monks have trained their bodies to react to certain things by instinct, making things like being unconscious irrelevant.Restriction - You cannot speak. You have trained your body to such an extent that it does not even remember how to make sound, even when you are in pain. Certain actions that require communication may become difficult, such as persuading people, without creative ways to circumvent these restrictions. Benefit - You get +Linguistics㊙ as a bonus skill and sign language as a bonus language. You also gain the Psychic (C) class's psychic casting feature.
Restriction - You refuse to ingest anything. Even if you were to eat or drink something, your body would reject it, causing you to vomit. This means you are unable to consume helpful potions, such Jizzle Physicks.
Benefit - You do not need to eat or drink. You only need peaceful meditation for 1 minute for nourishment. After such meditation, you heal to your max hp and gain 10 temp hp that persists until lost.
Restriction - You refuse to get close to others. Literally. The touch of other intelligent creatures makes you reflexively recoil. You cannot initiate anything that requires prolonged contact, such as a grapple, a handshake or a hug. If such a creature tries to initiate prolonged contact, they must poise break you. Benefit - At the start of your turn, you automatically escape a creatures unwanted touch.Restriction - You cannot return romantic feelings. You have completely shut of the part of you that feels romantic attachment to the point where even pretending feels unnatural and uncomfortable. You cannot perform acts of physical intimacy such as intercourse, kissing or other culturally significant acts typically reserved for lovers. You can't even pretend, giving you a -10 penalty on any skill checks related to any romance-related tasks.
Benefit - You get a +2 bonus on saves against charm effects. You are immune to effects with the Lewd tag.

classes/martial-artist/archteypes/barroo.title: Barroom Brawler
classes/martial-artist/archteypes/barroo.description:
To some, drinking isn't just a something they do at parties, its a lifestyle. Barroom Brawlers have developed an unusual fighting style that combines the unnatural movements while drunk with the pain numbing effects of alcohol to be as annoying as possible to take down.In a neutral scenario (aka one where you aren't actively being attacked), you can goad someone into a drinking contest with you (will negates). If you've already challenged someone, it won't work again.If you are in a location where alcohol is sold, the DC is 2 higher.Whether you carry it around, sling it onto your back, you have a large source of basic booze you keep with you at all times. To you it weighs nothing, but to anybody else it weighs 200 lbs full and 20 empty.Your keg is enough to last you a week before you must return to civilization and craft a refill. With an empty keg, you cannot chug. If you spend 3 days crafting, you can fill your keg with moonshine.Take a swig to grant yourself (4+½ lvl) temp hp. You can take up to 3 drinks in one turn to increase the temp hp you gain by the same amount. You can drink as a standard action, swift action, and by spending 30 ft of movement.Any turn you chug, you only have access to one of your hands while the other is used to shotgun your drink from the keg.Chug has a unique form of cooldown. See tip below for more details.Note: You must use a form of alcohol processing in order to begin recharging chug, after which it is on cooldown for 1 round. A helpful way to remember if you can chug is to recall what you did last round. The sequence goes... Chug Processing Nothing Chug TL;DR - If you chugged or processed the alcohol last turn, you cannot chug this turn. At any point the turn after using chug, you can do one of the following actions. You must do one of the following to begin recharging chug. Chug is on cooldown for 1 round after using alcohol processing.Rest and Digest (healing) - As a free action, heal equal to your remaining temp hp from chug. If you have no temp from chug remaining, you can still use this ability, but it provides no healing and only recharges chug.
Belch sonic - As a standard action, burp in the face of a creature within reach. They take 5 sonic damage and become staggered for 1 round (fort negates stagger).
Vomit poison - As a standard action, release the contents of your stomach onto a creature within reach. They takes (2d6+d6/odd lvl) poison damage and are sickened 1 (reflex halves dmg and negates sicken). Exotic Flavor - As a free action, appreciate the fine details of an exotic beverage you've obtained via the Taste Test quest. Gain its benefits until you chug again.
Gain the Blind Fight feat.Standard booze can only get you so far. By traveling around the world and finding different types of alcohol, you can gain new bonuses from alcohol processing. These bonuses apply until you chug again.These beverages can usually be obtained from different cultures, races or master craftsman. Some examples…As an instant action, you can cause all damage you take to be delayed until the end of your next turn.Recharges after using chug.
You gain resistance to poison damage, toxins and Venom.You take half damage from fortitude saves. When you pass a fort save, it deals no damage and has no additional effect.
When you use an improvised weapon, you can give yourself +2 attack, but the item breaks and becomes unusable after.Jump onto your keg and roll around on it as a standard action. Every time you move adjacent to an enemy this turn, shove it 10 feet and gain an additional 10 speed. You cannot affect the same creature multiple times with barrel roll.1/day when you chug, allies within reach gain the same temp hp you do.As an instant action, you can move 5 feet. If you use this in response to being attacked, a creature can move to follow you if they have the movement available to keep you in range, otherwise the attack automatically misses.Recharges when you chug.Note: This might not seem like much, but consider this.As an instant action you can step out the AoE of effects, like a line attack. You can instantly move behind cover in response to a ranged attack. You can retreat into the warm embrace of your shield brother for protection. Instant movement in a turn-based game is better than you might initially suspect!Chug no longer requires alcohol processing in order to recharge, allowing you to use it every other turn.Basically all you ask yourself is "did I chug last turn?" If you did, no chug. If you didn't, chug away!

headers.heading: 1 - Chug recharge healing

classes/martial-artist/archteypes/mercif.title: Merciful Monk
classes/martial-artist/archteypes/mercif.description:
Merciful monks have transcended the need to deal any damage at all, optimizing their fighting style to turn an enemies force against them and aid allies who are in danger.Your first unarmed strike you land on a creature has a bonus On-hit effect. This effect can only be applied to a creature 1/day.
Pacify a creature for 1 round on hit.
You have taken a vow to never directly harm another creature. You cannot deal +HP damage with attacks, spells, items etc (or effects that cause similar results like inflicting drained). You can still make attacks in order to inflict other effects (see Fighting Styles or the above first strike).
Despite dealing no damage, you attacks still apply, On-hit effects, unless the effect is damage.
Your unique approach to life gives you a +2 bonus to attack, the +Persuasion skill and a +4 bonus to persuasion.
Gain a (3+lvl) additional Mana Reserves. All abilities marked with Ki cost 1 mana.
You can parry without a buckler. When you successfully parry, you can make a bully attack against the foe that attacked you, as long as they are within 30 ft of you.This ability has a different effect depending on if you target an enemy or an ally. You can only tether one creature at a time. Enemy - A visible tether appears between you and a target within 30 ft, bonding you together for 3 rounds (will negates). As long as this creature is within 60 ft of you, any damage that it deals to creatures that aren't you is halved and the creature takes half the damage. If the creature gets more than 60 ft away from you, the effect ends.
Ally mana burn - A visible tether appears between you and a willing ally within 30 ft, bonding you together indefinitely. As long as this creature is within 100 ft of you, it gains 15 speed. Other allies that pass through the tether gain an additional 15 speed for 1 round. This tethers bonus can be inflicted on creatures by moving around them and having the tether pass through them.When an attack misses or grazes you and there is another creatures threatening you, you can redirect the attack to any other creature that threatens you as an immediate action, automatically hitting.
On hit apply Siphoned for 1 round (fort negates). Alternatively you can disable a creatures limb for 1 round. Targeted wings disable flight, legs decrease speed by 15 and arms render them unusable etc (fort negates).As a standard or swift action, taunt an enemy. If they land an attack against you or break your poise, the taunt ends. If successful, you can parry as part of the same action by spending an additional 1 mana.
As a swift action, you can dash up to 30 feet to appear adjacent to an ally. You grant yourself and your ally 10 temp hp. You restore 10 poise for you and your ally.
You can parry attacks directed at your safeguarded ally until the start of your next turn, provided they stay within reach. This ability cannot be used in successive turns.
Whenever you land an unarmed attack against a creature, it takes a stacking -1 penalty to attack.

classes/martial-artist/archteypes/strike.title: striker
classes/martial-artist/archteypes/strike.description: CrustYou dribble around a ball constantly using anything but your arms, using it to accentuate your unique fighting style using it. Using all types of kicks, bumps and headbutts, you slam this ball repeatedly into your foes until they drop.You use mostly your feet to kick around a ball. You can kick it to make a thrown weapon attack [elusive] against a creature (deals unarmed damage) and have it immediately bounce back to your feet. In order to steal your ball, a creature must somehow catch it mid-attack, or disarm you. If a creature ever grabs the ball with their hands/arms/opposable limb of choice, they immediately take 2d6+lvl (7+lvl) true damage, and the same damage at the end of each turn they continue to hold it.If you do not move before attacking, you can make a ball attack at a creature within 40 ft at no penalty.If you move through every space adjacent to a creature in a circle around them (usually provoking in the process), you feint them.Gain endurance as a bonus feat.

classes/martial-artist/archteypes/the-bo.title: The Boss
classes/martial-artist/archteypes/the-bo.description:
Being the boss is all about getting into the middle of the fight, taking and dealing blows and equal measure and using their enemies as their weapons.Every second unarmed strike you make a turn gets Advantage.
While below half hp, gain FH 1 and access to haymaker.
Special Attack: Haymaker Su force healing recharge
Gain (10+2*LvL) as temp hp until the start of next turn. Deal the same value in force damage in a 30-foot cone (reflex halves). You can also make a melee attack against a creature to have the cone erupt from them. On-hit the creature takes a -2 penalty to their save against haymaker. Can only be used 1/minute.
Whenever you provoke an AoO, get a +2 bonus to attack until the end of your turn.
If you land an unarmed attack or break poise against two creatures that are within reach, you slam them together, stunning them for 1 round (fort negates). If you are already grappling a creature, you only need to land an attack or poise break 1 other creature within reach. If you are grappling two creatures, this happens automatically. Once a creature is stunned by this ability (or negates the stun), it is immune for 1 hour.
When grappling a creature, you can cause the grappled creature to be the target of an attack roll instead of you as an immediate action.
You know the barbarism technique Foe Toss and automatically memorize it without consuming memory.
You know the magical technique Command and automatically memorize it without consuming memory. You can use it without a staff.Years of fighting hand to hand has given you insight into the things that make creatures tick merely by exchanging blows. Whenever you land or are hit by an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 mana as an instant action to glean information through contact. You cannot choose what you glean, rather it gives you insight into buried feelings, lifelong goals, insecurities and things of that sort. Whatever is most relevant to the creature is what you learn.
If one of your unarmed attacks defeats a foe, you can choose to launch them d100 miles in a random direction. This does not cause them additional harm, only puts them far away from you, unless the location they land is inherently hazardous.
Perform an unarmed strike and uppercut your foe into the stratosphere (fort negates). While airborne, the target is considered thousands of feet away from the battlefield and is entangled. At the end of your next turn they land in the space they were launched from, taking 20 crush damage from falling and are knocked down.
You gain the wrestling move of the same name (see Wrestling Moves for more details). It can also be a finisher.
The initial target and creatures in the impact zone instead take 7d6+lvl (24+lvl) crush damage and are staggered for 1 round (fort halves damage and negates stagger).Can only be used 1/minute.

classes/martial-artist/fighting-styles.h.title: Fighting Styles
classes/martial-artist/fighting-styles.h.description:
When a creature misses you with an attack, you can move 10 ft directly closer to it elusive. If this movement puts you within your natural reach, it Provokes. This AoO must be an unarmed strike.
Snake Sidewind - When you would be hit or grazed by an attack, you can spend an immediate action to parry the attack. This makes it count as a miss for snake style if successful.
You cannot be flanked. When you would normally be flanked, gain a flanking bonus against the creatures threatening you.
Your movement is Elusive as long as you do not leave an enemy's threatened zone
Cerberus Snare - When you hit a foe with an unarmed strike, its speed is reduced by 15, it is Anchored and Grounded for 1 round On-hit.
You get Powerful Charge. You also get a +2 bonus to damage when you Charge attack. You can turn up to 180 degrees once during your charge.
Tenderize - Whenever you succeed on a drag or shove attempt, deal 10 crush damage if you move them at least 10 ft.
Get a +2 bonus to Grapple attacks. You only have -15 speed while grappling a creature. Grabbing Everything: When you make a grapple attack, or maintain a grapple, you can make a grapple attack or maintain a grapple on another creature.
Whenever you make an Unarmed Attack, you can move 5 ft (Elusive) after the attack, so long as you still Threaten the creature you initially attacked. This movement is in addition to your standard movement.
Flurry of Blows - When you make an unarmed strike, you can choose to deal half damage to instead make 2 against the same target. Each has all of the original effects of the attack, such as bonus effects granted by techniques or On-hit effects. Any status effect duration does not stack. The bonus Flurry attack already does half damage and is incompatible with this feature.
You get a (1+1/2 LvL) bonus to +Athletics🏊.
Your unarmed attacks add 2*STR to damage.
Special Attack: Dragon Roar Su Sonic - Make an unarmed attack against a creature. It also unleashes a devastating roar that erupts from them. Creatures in a 30 ft cone take 2d6+2LvL (7+2LvL) sonic damage (fort halves). On-hit the DC for the initial creature is increased by 2.
You gain a Climb🧗 speed and a "crawl" speed equal to your Land Speed.
You can remove the Knockdown condition as a free action.
Monkey Madness - On-hit with an unarmed strike or after you break a creature's Poise, you can start riding them as an instant action. You follow their movement automatically until you are knocked off by poise breaking or otherwise. You have cover while riding. If an attack grazes you, it instead targets your ride at full effectiveness, as though it had hit them. You cannot ride creatures smaller than you. Other ideas
Every time you poise break a creature or land an unarmed strike against it, it gains a stack of pummel. Each stack increases your unarmed damage by 2, including poise damage. You also ignore DR against creatures with stacks of pummel. Pummel stacks last until the end of combat.

classes/mesmerist/painful-stares.html.title: Painful Stares
classes/mesmerist/painful-stares.html.description: Effects with a number require a specific level.Your stare is painful in the most literal sense. When triggered, the creature takes an additional d6+CL (3+CL) pierce damage.Your stare fills the creatures nostrils with a powerful stench. When triggered, the creature becomes sickened 1.Your stare causes the creature to believe they are hemophiliac. The immediately begin bleeding for d6 damage.The creature believes ice creeps across its body. When triggered, the creature becomes frosty.Your gaze holds a deep unsatisfied hunger for the creature so powerful it forces them to avert their gaze from you. When triggered, they are DD against you specifically until the end of your next turn.

headers.heading: 6 - Ice Cold Stare frost

classes/mesmerist/psychic-implants.html.title: Psychic Implants
classes/mesmerist/psychic-implants.html.description: Effects with a number require a specific level. All of these effects have the contingent, subtle and companion tags. They are all (Su) abilities. Unlike other contingent effect, there is no visual indicator.When you inflict the implant, you give the creature a simple suggestion and a trigger. Something is simple when it requires little effort, isn't dangerous and only requires a few minutes. This won't make a creature act against its ethos, but can make them do something unusual for them. "Don't lock the door on your way out. Vouge for me when I speak to the elder." Etc You can also leave the implant's suggestion blank, and make a suggestion later by verbally making it.When you activate the implant, you cause the creature to not notice you and your allies while you exist nearby for 10 minutes. The creature treats your actions as normal as long as they are not violent and does not remember what you and your allies did during this time.When you activate the implant, you can sense through the creature for up to 10 minutes. You see through its eyes, hear with its ears etc using all of its senses from their PoV. You are effectively stunned while you do this and can choose to redirect your senses back to your own body if you take damage or are otherwise harmed.When you activate the implant, the implanted creature gains 5+(your level*3) temp hp. This forces them to push past their bodies usual limits, so it also inflicts drained 1.What you activate this implant, the creature suddenly finds themselves in a cloud of darkness that they cannot escape. This darkness lasts one minute.Does not work against creatures with darkvision.When you activate this implant, you can choose another creature that the implanted creature can see and have them appear to transform into a more to fearsome version of themselves. They stay the same size, but you can make them appear more fiendish, undead, they grow a bunch of tentacles, etc. Their exact appearance is up to you. The transformation lasts 1 minute.Reactions may vary from directly attacking the creature to causing a scene. No matter what though, the creature is automatically shaken 2 during the transformation.When you activate this implant, you can have the creature appear to die to all others. The creature actually turns invisible, as per the spell. Creatures get a will save to disbelieve the illusory corpse when they interact with it.

classes/rogue/rogue-talents.html.title: Rogue Talents
classes/rogue/rogue-talents.html.description:
Using your cunning action, you can cause an unfortunate event to occur against a creature within 30 ft of you. This event is harmful and sudden, such as a lightning strike on a clear day, a large creature falling on them from the sky or a brick falling loose from the wall next to them. They take 2d6+lvl (7+lvl) and are clumsy 1 (reflex halves dmg and negates clumsy). The damage type depends on the effect, but the damage can never be something that the target has resistance or immunity to.
The DC increases by 2 if you use this ability after the target says something like "that would never happen" or "may the gods strike me down if my cause is not righteous" or something to that effect.Recharges after 1 minute or when you roll a natural 1.
If you miss or graze a creature while threatening another creature, you can choose to instead roll a new attack against the second target as an immediate action. If the initial target was DD, so is the secondary target.
You can escape manacles, vines, webs, rope, grapples and more using +Sleight of Hand instead of the usual method. If you would normally escape through +Athletics🏊, then use the athletics DC. If you are grappled, then roll sleight of hand opposed to the grappling creatures reflex save. If there is not predetermined action type for the effect, it is a standard action.You gain advantage on this check while nobody is watching you. You can also use this to assist an ally to escape from these conditions too.
When a creature you can see fails a skill check, you can spend 1 mana to "try it yourself." You automatically achieve their result and add your LUK to it. If you succeed, you remove the mana burn.Certain places are well known for particular events. Markets have big sales, shady bars have fights, lively inns have parties etc. You can roll an appropriate skill check in order to spark such events. Roll profession to start a fire sale, roll intimidation to goad some drunkards into a scrap or roll perform to get people dancing. This can apply to any number of situations and skill rolls like prison riots, chanting crowds, sea shanties etc.The DC is 20. The effect is usually to stir people up in public places, so without others present, this doesn’t do much. These events are usually temporary only lasting a few minutes.1/day, choose a location, person or item you can see with 60 ft. Whenever an event of significance happens to the thing you chose, such as a creature cracking at your safe, walking into an abandoned building or petting your dog, you can choose to roll serendipity to happen to be in the nearby area to witness it happen. What is considered "significant" can have a higher degree of specificity, such as "an orc pets my dog," but it increases the DC.This usually only allows you to attend to things in your nearby area, such as in your city. When you succeed on serendipity, you happen to wake up to use the bathroom, you do a late night milk run or you got a tip in advance. Typically the DC is 10, with circumstances such as distance, specificity, what you are doing when the event happens and how accessible what you chose to keep your eye on can increase the DC, with unfavorable circumstances adding +2, and downright ridiculous ones (like being in a prison after visiting hours) adding +4, up to a maximum of DC 20.Certain physical limitations, such as being unable to keep tabs on something a country away, can make using this ability impossible. You can keep tabs on (1+luck) things at a time.
As a free action, end the Knockdown condition.By spending 1 hour doing research or practicing, you can become proficient in a particular skill for the rest of the day. Certain skills may require facilities or equipment in order to properly practice (such as a library for knowledge skills, or thieves tools for sleight of hand).You can sell any item, no questions asked, so long as you are in a place you could consider a city. While inside of a city, you can also spend a few hours to figure out the kinds of illegal things that people sell there such as things related to forbidden magic, or human trafficking, and where you can purchase said items.You have enough street cred to trade with such vendors without requiring any checks. If you unearth this operation, such as by telling proper authorities or the public, you lose this street cred. This also happens if an ally you bring does so.Whenever you sell an item, you get 60% of the items value instead of 50% by default.You can spend a daily use of Stroke of Luck to cause an unattended, loose handheld object within 60 ft to instantly end up in your hands. The way this happens is usually very dramatic and unlikely, changing based on the scenario. A plank in the floor goes loose, catapulting a key towards you when someone steps nearby. A leak springs in your ship next to you, causing the item to spill out.You never need to roll to achieve the desired result.

classes/blood-hunter.html.title: Blood Hunter
classes/blood-hunter.html.description:
The first Blood Hunters were unique types of gunmen who, much like vampires, were obsessed with blood. Their research has led them down a divergent path where their unique affinity for manipulating life forces is well-suited for combat. If it bleeds, they can kill it.You have Martial Specialization and Magical Specialization. You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the marksman🏹, Vampirism🧛 and scoundrel tree.
Make two attacks, one of which must be a Gun attack.
You can reload your gun as an instant action by taking 1 true damage.Whenever you take at least 3 damage, the next time you deal damage back to an enemy, you heal 3 hp.
You can parry with a gun. Your parry attacks have a +2 bonus. In addition to parry's usual effects, when you successfully parry, you also deal the guns damage and the enemy's turn immediately ends.
By spending a swift action, you can examine a creature, living or not, and tell how much +HP remaining it has.
You gain +Survival🐾 as a bonus skill, with a +4 bonus.
Gain Point Blank Master as a bonus feat.
When you are Defeated, you can instead feign injury. To all others it looks like you have been defeated, but you do not gain the defeated condition until the end of your next turn. During your next turn you are knocked down, but you can make a single firearm attack. If you are healed before you make the attack, this ability is immediately recharged.
When you land a gun attack, spend 1 mana to also inflict d6 bleed On-hit. You can instead take 1 true damage to apply this effect.
You get a +4 bonus on +Survival🐾 checks to track creatures your allies have injured within the last week. This bonus increases to +8 your allies inflicted bleed damage on them during the encounter.
You have advantage on attack rolls until you deal damage in a combat.

classes/hunter.html.title: Hunter
classes/hunter.html.description:
Crust Hunters are marksman trained to hunt down a specific type of creature with impunity. They specialize in using weapons that are otherwise inconvenient for most creatures to use as their main weapon, such as crossbows and firearms.
You have Martial Specialization. You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the marksman🏹 and pupper trees.
Gain a Multiattack. Make two attacks, one of which must be a ranged attack.
You are trained to hunt a specific type of creature. Choose a type of creature, such as Beasts🐻 or Humanoids. You get a +4 bonus to attack against them. You also gain the associated +Knowledge🧠 skill to identify this creature type with +Monster Lore📖, and a +4 bonus to the skill.
Whenever On-hit against one of these creatures, you get a single point of Mana Reserves. You can only ever have 1 point accumulated in such a way.
You gain rapid reload and lightning reload as bonus feats.
You gain +Survival🐾 as a bonus skill, with a +4 bonus.
Make a carefully aimed ranged attack at a creature, granting it Seeking. On-hit, you mark them. You can only have 1 creature marked at a time. You get a +4 bonus to survival checks against a marked creature. Choose one additional effect your hunters mark has while the mark persists.
Reveal - Creature glows slightly, giving it a visible colorful aura. Creature takes a -10 penalty to +Stealth and and all attacks against it have Seeking.
Taunt - The creature you strike is taunted by you until it damages you, upon which the mark is removed.As an immediate action when a creature makes an attack against a marked creature, you can transform that attack into a crit. Using this function of Hunter's Mark causes the ability to be unusable until you rest. Otherwise this special attack can be used at will.

classes/maligner.html.title: Maligner
classes/maligner.html.description:
Maligners are master manipulators that worm their way into positions of power through deceit and cunning. They use enchantments to force cooperation, illusions to misdirect, lies to spread rumors, and polymorphs to imitate. While there are Maligners that start off benevolent, they most often find themselves engaging in morally abhorrent behavior while impersonating enemies just to keep their stories straight.Note: This class is a pretty odd fit for this game, mostly because it has basically zero combat related abilities as part of the class. The role a Maligner will play in a party will probably be akin to that of a rogue. They are much more impressive out of combat than in combat. You gain 3 technique points at level 1, then another 2 points every 2 levels after. These technique points can be used on the Shira💋, Moogen (T)👁 and one other tree, chosen at character creation.As a standard action, you can assume an alternate persona of your creation. You fabricate a backstory, connections, race, appearance, clothes, voice, the works - this alternate form is completely unique. When you have an alternate persona, you have no "true" form.Your alternate persona has all of your abilities and statistics, but you can decide to swap up to 2 of your skills for any others, and your race may be different. If these changes cause you to no longer qualify for a feat or class feature upon assuming the other form, then you lose access as normal.It takes a week of work to fabricate a new form, and a week to "kill off" an old form. These personas consume your Companion slots, and you may have more than one if you have enough slots. You start off with one alternate persona.
Gain +Deception and +Disguise as bonus skills, each with a +4 bonus.Upon engaging in conversation with a creature for at least one minute, you can call out one detail of its appearance, recent activities (within a day), or mannerisms as a free action. You instantly learn its mental state and intentions as they relate to the detail, within the scope of the totality of information you have on the creature (will negates).Essentially, you correctly guess why a creature did or is doing something. Part of this ability is speaking your guess to the creature, and judging your accuracy off of its response; if it passes its save, you guess wrong, may look silly, and can no longer use this ability on the same creature until you rest.You may substitute the DC with Insight, and the target may substitute its Will save with Deception.
You start play with 10 GBP for Shira, the She-Devil💋 and Moogen, The Murderer👁. Unless your WIS is -1 or lower.As a free action, name a rumor. You gain a sixth sense for who has heard or spread this rumor. If you see the people they told or heard it from, they appear to glow white or red to you, respectively. If you interact with the creature, you can see a literal trail of ethereal energy to the people they either heard the rumor from, or who they told the rumor.Using this ability again negates the previous use.
You can amputate a helpless, willing, or recently deceased (within an hour) race🏁's face, and spend 500g and 8 hours of labor to convert it into a Maligner's Mask attuned to that specific creature. Most creatures will die or go blind upon having their face amputated without immediate medical attention.When you wear this mask, you partially transform into that creature, which counts as a disguise and grants a +4 bonus skill checks to appear as that specific creature. Putting it on is a full round action, but removing it is a Swapping Gear action. It does not change your clothes or equipment. Other creatures may wear these masks.While you possess a mask, you can use Faceless Monster to create a persona of a person whose mask you possess. If the persona you steal still lives, or is absent for long periods of time, it can cause problems.You can attempt to spread a rumor throughout a small town or larger settlement by attempting a deception check. The difficulty depends on the size, ranging from 10 for a small town to 30 for a metropolis, though this difficulty may be modified if the population as a whole tends towards skepticism or insanity.It takes a week for a rumor to spread. If you succeed by 5 or more, the time is reduced to 3 days. If you fail by 5 or more, the rumor mutates into a competing theory.Each of your personas may only have one rumor brewing at a time.After a minute of concentration, you can enter a state of calm where you deepen your connection with your collection of masks. You can communicate with the fragments of the persons soul left behind within. The masks appear to speak to you, and you can inquire things about these people as though you were a neutral party. As such, they are usually willing to tell you some things, but hesitant for others, usually requiring skill checks. Once you try and pry into something secret and fail, the information is lost forever. The masks are unable to form new memories, and therefore always treat you as they would a stranger, no matter what you ask.

classes/mana-addict.html.title: Mana Addict
classes/mana-addict.html.description:
Crust A mana addict is an antimage who is well and truly addicted to the power of mana flowing through them. They get various abilities that function differently depending on how much mana they have.
You have Martial Specialization You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another 2 points every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the Arc and Pupper trees.You have a mana pool vaster than even that of most practiced mages. You gain an additional point of mana this level and every even level after.All your points of mana reserves are instead converted into maximum mana, unless they are tied to specific items.You can manifest a shimmering barrier of volatile energy that protects you and snaps at those who disturb it.
As a standard action, you can grant yourself temp hp equal to your current mana. Keep note of this value. Whenever a creature deals +HP damage to you, they also take this value as force damage, regardless of how much of the temp hp you actually have left.
Mana barrier lasts indefinitely. Anything that decreases the temp hp you gain when you initially use this ability, like being Bone Chilled, also reduces the counterattack damage.
Whenever you take +HP damage, you can spend mana as an immediate action to reduce the damage. You can spend 1 mana to reduce the damage of an effect on you by 3. If you decrease the damage of an effect to zero, it still activates the force damage counterattack from Mana Barrier.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, reduce the damage you take from an effect by 3.
You can innately cast the Mana Ramping cantrip.
Whenever you inflict mana burn, even when inflicting it on yourself, you restore 1 mana.
You can also use the mana burn you inflict on another creature to cure your own at a 1 to 1 ratio. As a standard action, you can cause an adjacent helpless creature to mana burn 2, but you are drained 3 for every mana burn you cure.
Gain Arcana as a bonus skill with a +4 bonus.
You can spend 1 mana to speak the magic words of similar spells while another creature casts a spell to confuse them while they cast (will negates). This functions as the Tongue Twister technique with a few key differences: You can only use this as an immediate action to a creature casting a spell. If the creature fails its save, it only suffers the effects of tongue twister for the spell it is casting. If it has already spent any actions that tongue twister would normally consume, they are instead staggered until the end of their next turn.
While at or above half mana, you have a +10 bonus to your Land Speed, Advantage on +Perception👀 and Immunity to fatigue.While below half mana, but not out of mana, you gain the following special attack usable an unlimited number of times per combat.
Special Attack: Mana Leech - On-hit, steal (½ lvl) mana from the target and they mana burn an equal amount.
When you are completely out of mana, you become fatigued, but you gain resistance to damage that originates from an effect than can be dispelled (ie Su/Sp effects). You recover 1 mana at the start of your turn.
You gain Psionic Backlash as an at-will Innate Technique. When you use it, the creature is mana burned 2 (will halves).
