classes/virtuoso.html.title: Virtuoso
classes/virtuoso.html.description:
Death should never be quick. It should be an opera. The virtuoso is a creature of cadence and cruelty. All of their abilities are as flashy as they are deadly. They primarily focus on dealing damage from range using a special type of firearm. Anybody familiar with a virtuoso fears the power behind the fourth shot of this gun.You have Martial Specialization and Magical Specialization. You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another 2 point every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the scoundrel, Moogen (T)👁 and marksman🏹 trees.
You can transform a single standard pistol into a special weapon just by holding it in your hands. You need to reload it after making 4 shots instead of 1
You can only fire once per round, making you incompatible with some multi-shot abilities (such as Snap Shot)
You get +2 to attack when you attack using this gun. Bullets fired out of combat do not consume ammo. The 4th shot gets +10 to attack and deals 2x damage on a crit instead of 1.5x. Reloading always requires a standard action, even it feats, techniques and such say otherwise.
When you Crit, gain +2 AC, 20 Land Speed Elusive movement until the end of your next turn.
As a swift action, place a trap in an unoccupied space that quickly camouflages with the surrounding terrain and blends into the terrain (DC 20+LvL +Perception👀 to notice). If an enemy steps on a trapped space, it blossoms. Blossomed traps create an area of Bright Light and Difficult Terrain in a 5 ft radius around its space until the end of the triggering creatures turn. At the end of the turn of the triggering creature, it explodes, dealing (2d6+d6/odd lvl) pierce damage to the area made into difficult terrain.You can have 2 traps out at once at any given time. If you place another while 2 are out, one of your choosing disappears. You are mentally alerted when a trap is triggered, and which one. You gain +4 perception against any creature that has triggered a trap since you last rested.
Whenever you defeat a creature, you can choose to trigger a flowering trap beneath them that explodes at the start of your next turn. This trap doesn't count against your total.
By spending 1 mana as swift action, you can target a creature within 60 ft to have a spotlight focus on for 1 minute. The light around the spotlight artificially dims for dramatic effect (but no mechanical effect). That creature takes a -10 penalty on +Stealth and is persistently in an area of Bright Light. The creature also has Advantage on +Profession🧑‍🌾 checks to "put on a performance".While a spotlight is active, you can increase the volume of your voice to echo over even large crowds.
You have an alternate ego that forms while masked, with its own name. Magical means to detect things treat you as two different creatures (such as Caught Red-Handed). If a creature takes off your mask, you can spend 1 mana as an instant action to cause the mask they remove to be a temporary copy that lasts 1 minute, revealing another mask underneath.
+2 to +Disguise while masked. While your face is obscured, such as with a mask or in darkness, you can make your voice sound like anyone you have heard.You gain a unique special attack. Finale - Deal an additional 1 damage with a pistol attack. If this ends the combat, permanently increase the damage of finale by 1. If it does not end the combat, decrease the damage of finale by 1 (minimum 1).You cannot stack finale in mock combats, training, or passively during down time hunting wolves etc.
You gain 10 GBP for Moogen, The Murderer👁, unless your WIS is -1 or lower.
By spending 2 mana as swift action, you can target a 60 ft line. The very first enemy within this line is entangled for 1 round (reflex negates). If a flowering trap you can see is triggered, you can activate this as an immediate action against a creature within the radius of the blossoming trap.
You can innately cast the Ghost Sound cantrip as a free action, but only to make the sounds typical of an audience, such as clapping, laughter, gasping etc.You can cast this as an instant action when you successfully end a combat with finale.Your pistol gets a variety of new benefits.
Shots deal True Damage.
They ignore Cover, and Improved Cover, but not Total Cover.
They cannot miss and always Graze, even if they are deflected via something like parry or Block. When you kill a creature with your pistol, you can choreograph how their blood splatters. You can cause it to form a pool of a specific shape, with enough precision to write in text, but usually no more than 2 sentences. You can also cause it to make patterns on the deceased's skin.
When you defeat a creature, you can spend 2 mana as an instant action to cause a pair of curtains to appear and close in between you and your victim directly adjacent to you. These curtains are 20 ft tall and 20 ft wide. It lasts for 1 minute, or until they are opened.You can open the curtains as a free action from any distance, and an enemy can open the curtains as a standard action if they are adjacent. It is not difficult for any creature to simply move past the curtains by going through or under without opening them.When you kill someone, you can write a eulogy for them, provided you have the means to physically write one. You can drop this eulogy off on the corpse, the creature's previous home or simply a nearby settlement. This eulogy naturally multiplies, finding itself in newspaper stands, cafes, waiting rooms etc. The less important the creature, the less it spreads. This results in the eulogy being pretty common knowledge for well known people, and the talk of the town for beloved or reviled creatures.You can choose to write or draw anything on this eulogy, but cannot attach any kind of magical spells/traps to it. It must be concise enough to fit on a single standard page.By spending 1 mana as a free action, you can roll out the red carpet for 1 minute. This carpet is 10 ft wide and 60 ft long. It must be placed on a mostly flat, though not necessarily solid, surface. It can also be placed on any surface where carpet is commonly found (such as a staircase). It can be placed on the surface of still(ish) water. It can be used as a bridge to cross a chasm, provided the gap is mostly level.While walking on this carpet, creatures ignore difficult terrain. If you make another carpet, the previous one disappears.
You can extend your hand towards a creature and offer to show them the world (or something to that effect). If they willingly take your hand, they are automatically Fascinated for up to 5 minutes. During this time you completely obscure their senses from the outside world and take them on a magical journey of your imagining with catchy songs and pretty visuals straight out of a Disney movie.To the outside world it merely looks like you are holding hands with the creature. You can even decide to move the creature around as though you were going for a walk, or dancing at a party. If you move more than 60 ft away from the creatures location, then the fascination ends.By spending 2 mana as a swift action, drop a peculiar grenade on a creature within 30 ft of you that deals 4d6 (14) crush damage to it and then bounces up to 10 ft to a target of your choosing, dealing this damage again. If it defeats the enemy, you can choose another creature within 30 ft for it to bounce to and its damage increases by 2d6 (7). The grenade can hit a maximum of 4 creatures.When you kill a creature, you see their life flash before your eyes, learning one piece of information. Greatest regret Deepest secret Closest companion
Choose a direction and reduce your speed to 0 at the start of your turn. Until you move or are Poise broken you can only shoot in that direction (180 degrees), but you can increase the range of your pistol to 200. Once you need to reload, this effect ends.

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Advantage
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: There are many abilities in the game that allow you additional odds success in some limited capacity. These are usually represented through rerolls and advantage.Rerolls do as they might suggest; they allow you to roll dice again after you didn't like the result. Whenever you use a reroll on a dice roll that you have advantage or disadvantage on, you make that reroll with advantage or disadvantage.Advantage allows you to roll 2 dice and take the desired of the 2 results. Inversely, disadvantage forces you to roll 2 dice and take the lower of the 2 results. Multiple instances of advantage allow you to roll the dice more, 3, 4, maybe even 5 times and take the desired result. Advantage and disadvantage cancel each other out.If that’s confusing, treat advantage as +1 and disadvantage as -1 in the chart below.When you take 10 on a skill when you have advantage on it, assuming it is a constant bonus (like from Skill Focus), you instead effectively take 15.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Advantage.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Crust
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: Crusty Content is content that I believe is still too early in development to be worth your time. It will often be incomplete and imbalanced.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Crust.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: GM
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: Game Master (GM): The person running the game. This person is the arbiter of the rules, tasked with creating the world, playing all NPCs, and ensuring a fun and fair experience for the players.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/GM.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Mana
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description:
Mana is the resource that enables all sorts of things. For the purposes of this explanation, mana is primary used to fuel techniques. It also fuels mana class abilities and is a crafting component. Mana itself has value.Mana Basics In order to use a technique, you must spend mana equal to the tier of technique. Cantrips have an effective tier of 0 and do not cost mana. While not in immediate danger (such as combat or a chase), you regenerate 1 mana per turn, or 10 mana per minute.Mana Reserves Mana reserves function exactly like your base mana, except they disappear after used, and only regenerate after you rest. Mana reserves are gained through having positive intelligence, are sometimes given to mage classes and through magic items, often with particular restrictions on their use.
See Mana Burn for how effects can reduce your mana.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Mana.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Memory
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: Memory determines how many Techniques you can have at your disposal at once. At the start of each day, you can prepare a number of techniques equal to your memory, chosen from any technique trees you have technique points invested into.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Memory.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: On-hit
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description:
On-hit effects only happen when you successfully match or exceed a creature's AC and deal damage to a creature (AKA it is not negated by DR/Resistance). The effect does not occur on a graze.
When a creature has an on-hit effect that has a saving throw attached to it like the Grounding, weapon quality, the creature makes the save only once if they are hit multiple times. Each application beyond the first applies a -2 penalty to the save.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/On-hit.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Poise
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Poise.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Technique Point
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: A technique point gives you access to the next tier of a technique tree equal to the number of points you have invested in it, from 1 to 6. Most classes get technique points on odd levels, and all player characters get technique points on even levels.You are capped at how many technique points you can put into a tree by your LvL. Level 1 characters can only have access to tier 1 tech, level 3 get tier 2 and so on.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Technique Point.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: True Damage
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description:
True damage cannot be reduced resistance, DR and similar effects that reduce damage.
The most common source of true damage is Bleeding
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/True Damage.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/ability-scores/p.title: Prayer
core-rules,-how-to-play/ability-scores/p.description: You get a number of uses of prayer equal to (WIS+1).The default use of prayer is praying. Praying requires 1 minute of uninterrupted concentration.You gain impressions from the future about something in specific. When you initially start praying, you must mention a specific action (attack the bandits, pet the dog etc.). When the prayer is complete, gain a nugget information about whether this action will bring favorable or unfavorable results to you within the next half hour. The answer does not take into account consequences into the future past 30 minutes.
core-rules,-how-to-play/ability-scores/p.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Ability Scores/Prayer.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.title: Focus
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.description:
Choose a creature you can see. For 1 round you gain the following benefits... Your movement is elusive to them You can take an immediate action as an instant action 1/turn in response to their actions. You cannot be denied instant actions and immediate actions against the focused creature, even while DD.
While you focus on a creature, you pay less attention to all other creatures, and are automatically DD to them. You can choose to continue or end focus on a creature on subsequent turns as a free action. Special - In organized duels, it is assumed both characters start the combat in this state. In such circumstances, they ignore the "you are DD to others" portion of this action (for companions and such).
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Common Actions/Standard Actions/Focus.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.title: Get Down!
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.description: Throw yourself into the way of an attack made against a helpless creature. This could mean a minion, someone who is asleep or defeated. You can choose to become the target of all danger aimed at them, including AoE, spells and attacks. Such attacks automatically hit you and you get no saving throws against spells.You naturally need to be aware of an attack to protect against it. If a creature manages to give you the slip with stealth, then you can't protect.If the attack was originally a crit, it crits you instead automatically. AoE effects harm you twice.
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Common Actions/Swift and Immediate Actions/Get Down!.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.title: Jump
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.description:
Jump in a straight line. This can only be used in combination with other forms of movement such as walking or charging.Jump is also a static distance. By default, your Jump is 5. This is a measure of distance, specifically for horizontal jumps, while vertical jumps are half. This does not give you additional movement, and thus it is limited by your Land Speed. It can be used to avoid Difficult Terrain, but not if you're already in the Difficult Terrain.
You can only jump once with this action. If you Dash, you can jump twice. These jumps do not need to be consecutive.
Jump distance increases by 5 ft per point of STR (and DEX with +Acrobatics⚖).
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Common Actions/Swift and Immediate Actions/Jump.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.title: Use Potion
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Common Actions/Swift and Immediate Actions/Use Potion.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/combat.title: +Combat Maneuver
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/combat.description:
Combat Maneuvers are attacks that target Poise. When making a Combat Maneuver, you must decide which specific form it takes, such as a Topple, Dirty Trick, Shove etc. A successful Combat Maneuver will inflict a condition based on the form you chose.
You can combat maneuver an ally automatically. This allows you do things such as to Drag or shove an ally out of danger, but it sets their poise to 1.
You can apply bonuses to combat maneuvers to any maneuver you make, even if it doesn't originate from you directly. This means when you successfully shove a creature with Grasping Corpse and you have the Maneuver Master feat, it Provokes from all your allies. The one exception to this rule is effects that make companions. Since they are their own creatures, they don't have your features.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/combat.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Combat Maneuvers/+Combat Maneuver.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/combat.title: Bully
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/combat.description: Deal poise damage to a creature that cannot reduce them below 1 poise, with the intention to combo. Bully uses the highest bonus you have to a specific combat maneuver. So if you have a +4 bonus to attack to shove and +8 to grapple, bully is rolled at +8.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/combat.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Combat Maneuvers/Bully.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/combat.title: Grapple
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/combat.description: Your foe is entangled and Held Down. Your speed is reduced to zero and you pull the creature adjacent to you. The creature cannot Threaten. Each round you can spend your standard action to keep the target in place, dealing the damage of a held weapon automatically. If you don't, the creature is freed.If you are moved out of reach from the target, have your poise reduced to zero, or are otherwise unable to maintain your grip, the target is freed. Multiple creatures can grapple one creature. The bonus to attack against a target that is entangled from a grapple increases by 2 per additional creature. You must use at least one prehensile limb to initiate and maintain a grapple on a creature, unless your weapon has the CM Grapple property. Creatures ignore the attack penalty from partial and total concealment against creatures that they are being grappled by or are grappling.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/combat.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Combat Maneuvers/Grapple.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/attack.title: Attack Progression
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/attack.description: Creatures that aren't Dual Wielding have only 1 attack by default. When you use your standard action to make multiple attacks, it's called a Multiattack. You can distribute the attacks to creatures as you see fit, move in between them, before and after them (for certain AoE attacks like cleave, you usually need to stand still). By default a standard attack is considered a simple attack.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/attack.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Attack Progression.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/graze..title: Graze
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/graze..description: Graze is an attack that is not a complete miss. When you roll below the targets AC, but not by more than 5, then the attack does half damage. A graze does not apply any on-hit effects, like bleed.

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/simple.title: Simple Attack
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/simple.description: Simple attacks are only rolling attack and damage, typically with no special effects tied to them. Special attacks allow for more versatility in play style. Unique weapons, class abilities, techniques and feats can grant these special attacks. Special attacks can usually only be performed once per turn.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/simple.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Simple Attack.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/specia.title: Special Attack
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/specia.description:
Special attacks allow for more versatility in play style. Weapons, class abilities, techniques and feats can grant these special attacks. Special attacks have a global cooldown of 1 round, meaning they can usually only be performed once per turn.
Special attacks universally have the martial tag.
A special attack that does not originate from a technique also has the recharge tag, with a cooldown of 1 minute (unless otherwise stated). The most common form is the Base Special Attacks. When used out of combat (for the utility), you can use them an unlimited number of times. With no cooldown.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/specia.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Special Attack.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/death-and-resurr.title: +Death and Resurrection
core-rules,-how-to-play/death-and-resurr.description:
Let's be honest, the purpose of resurrection in TTRPGs is primarily for the benefit of the players. If a GM makes frequent use of the resurrection spells for entities that the players went to great lengths to kill, it heavily undermines their effort and feels terrible, even if plausible. If all it takes is a bunch of money and a cleric, then rich high level players live in a world without death as a consequence for anybody, and that just aint cool in a game about storytelling.Now that we all agree about that, why does resurrection have an expensive material component cost? To punish the players for being unlucky? Why is it locked behind high-level magic? To make playing cleric mandatory? If we only consider the players, then these things become very obvious problems. Players shouldn't be shoehorned into playing specific classes, nor should the money that they worked hard to obtain be required to continue playing the game.The powers that be should instead be very particular about the who gets a second chance. If the players are the main character of the story, then the game's resurrection mechanics should treat them as such. As a replacement for most resurrection effects, use these rules instead. Or don't use resurrection at all. It's your game. Whatever.IMPORTANT NOTE: Please make sure your players are on board with whatever you decide. Nobody likes surprise mechanics.Isn't this just plot armor?
The basic premise of this system of resurrection is that you want player death to have immediate consequences: Not being able to complete a mission or delaying the players long enough so that way the villain can complete the ritual. But you don't want them to have long-term consequences: Not being able to play your character. Having to go on lengthy multi-session quests to find someone willing and able to cast the correct spell to bring you back can be fun, but after a few times, it can get old.So in order to achieve the former and avoid the latter, it's recommended that you bake the reason for the players coming back from the dead into the story. Death still matters or course, after all the players will have allies (:<If your players aren't too attached to their characters, then who needs plot armor? Let 'em die. If they are, consider some of the options in this section.
core-rules,-how-to-play/death-and-resurr.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Death and Resurrection/+Death and Resurrection.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/hitpoints/+hp.ht.title: +HP
core-rules,-how-to-play/hitpoints/+hp.ht.description: How much hp a player has is largely determined by their class. Creatures have a base hp value of 20, and then a value that they add each LvL, including level one. Classes and creatures all fall under one of the following categories based on their play style.

core-rules,-how-to-play/saving-throws/+s.title: +Saving Throw
core-rules,-how-to-play/saving-throws/+s.description:
Decide the effectiveness of abilities or effects that do not require an Attack Roll. It is typically the affected creature that rolls the save. In order to consider a saving throw a pass, the affected creature must match or roll higher than the DC of the effect.The DC of a Saving Throw is usually 12 plus the Level of the effect.
Saves come in 3 forms: Fortitude saves (based on STR), Reflex saves (based on DEX), and Will saves (based on WIS).
core-rules,-how-to-play/saving-throws/+s.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Saving Throws/+Saving Throw.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/d.title: DD
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/d.description: "Denied Dodge" Creature is unable to respond effectively to attacks due to +Stealth, Feinting, or some other status or Circumstance. Attacks made against a Surprised creature get a +4 bonus.This status effect is also a Circumstance that can be determined on a per-creature or per-attack basis, but can also be a condition that applies to all incoming attacks.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/d.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/DD.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/d.title: Divine Shield
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/d.description: A shimmering barrier forms around a creature. They are immune to Poise damage and cannot be Grazed while it persists. The next instance of hitpoint damage they suffer is negated in its entirety, also preventing any additional effects that damage would inflict (such as On-hit effects).
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/d.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Divine Shield.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/f.title: Frosty
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/f.description: Creature is covered in ice. Creature has Resistance to Fire Damage and -15 Land Speed. Attacks against a frosty creature get +2 Attack. This status ends when they take physical or fire damage.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/f.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Frosty.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/m.title: Mana Burn
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/m.description:
An ability that reduces maximum Mana. Many features throughout the game allow for more powerful effects, but do so at the cost of mana burn. Unless otherwise specified, mana burn decreases only your maximum mana and is not an additional cost to an ability. For example, something like cure wounds costs 1 mana. You decided to mana burn to overheal, it still only costs 1 mana, but your max mana is also reduced by 1.The default value for mana burn is 1.
Mana burn can stack with itself, eventually reducing your max mana to 0. Having 0 max mana inflicts the mana starvation Affliction.An ability with no mana cost that has mana burn decreases your current mana by an equal value as well.
Bestiary creatures that don't use mana instead drain equal double to the amount they mana burn.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/m.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Mana Burn.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/s.title: Summoning Sickness
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/s.description: Creature is drained 10 and cannot be called from Summoning Contract📜 again until they are no longer drained.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/s.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Summoning Sickness.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/force.html.title: Force
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/force.html.description: Magic is a Damage type Tag, which represents damage that is supernatural in origin, forces rending and unmaking through means that cannot be described by physical processes.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/poison.html.title: Poison
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/poison.html.description: Poison is a Damage type Tag, representing an toxic or caustic substance that melts away the body as well as objects.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/prepared.ht.title: Prepared
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/prepared.ht.description: This technique does not require any form of activation to use. It provides its benefit constantly.If a tag is Sp or Su, it can be dispelled. In such a case, the ability must be reactivated as a swift action.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/recharge.ht.title: Recharge
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/recharge.ht.description: Recharge abilities have a specific criteria or time required until they can be used again.If no such criteria or duration is listed, then it is assumed that the recharge is resting, making it a 1/day ability.

classes/+class-details/quick-character-c.title: Distributing Ability Scores
classes/+class-details/quick-character-c.description: Read Ability Scores in order to get a better understanding of the function of each ability score. Every character gets starting 6 points to invest in their ability scores as they wish. Every point you increase in ability score counts against this total. You can decrease an ability score to -1 in order to gain an additional point. The maximum points you can invest is 3. The minimum is -1.
classes/+class-details/quick-character-c.sourcePath: Classes/+Class Details/Quick Character Creation Guide/Distributing Ability Scores.md

classes/+class-details/quick-character-c.title: Main Character Status
classes/+class-details/quick-character-c.description: Have you ever wanted to write an epic story for a character you made? How they survived a bloody conflict, went through incredibly rigorous training to become the best and brightest mage, was chosen by god or some other equally astonishing development. Then the game says "you die in one hit to a goblin."While not entirely unrealistic, it doesn't make for very satisfying gameplay to have your character feel like they are made out of paper and are one stray crit away from instant death. A game like DnD 5e remedies this by making KO'd a state your character falls in and out of multiple times as a result of "le nat 20," spammable low action healing and a lack of negative hit points.If you want the player characters to be invincible compared to monsters of a similar level, I say skip the pretense. Player characters are of a different breed and are hardened by their previous adventures, granting the following benefits…HP - Your hp is increased by 10. Defeat - You do not have a chance to instantly die when you fall unconscious, instead you receive a stacking debuff called doom (see Defeat). You also accumulate Afflictions.With this change, a measure of how worn down you are can be more easily tied to how much hp you have. There are obviously other factors, but you can't ever keep adventuring without hp. Mana is the general resource system tied to using special abilities, and it naturally recharges when not used.In general healing that keeps you at full HP all the time is intended to be more scarce, and usually come at the cost of reducing your max mana until you rest.In general, only PCs will have this buff. But BBEGs, legendary creatures and other major bosses intended for use at the end of major story beats could also receive a similar version of this buff. Then you can get the juicy "phase transition" threshold to give your big boss encounters more punch.
classes/+class-details/quick-character-c.sourcePath: Classes/+Class Details/Quick Character Creation Guide/Main Character Status.md

feats/combat-feats/antagonize/scapegoat..title: Scapegoat
feats/combat-feats/antagonize/scapegoat..description:
Requirements - Antagonize
When you use the antagonize feat to taunt a creature, you can instead make it taunted by any ally the enemy can see.

feats/combat-feats/point-blank-master/sn.title: Snap Shot
feats/combat-feats/point-blank-master/sn.description:
Requirements - Point Blank Master
You threaten spaces within your natural reach with ranged weapons.

feats/combat-feats/rapid-reload/lightnin.title: Lightning Reload
feats/combat-feats/rapid-reload/lightnin.description: Requirements - Rapid ReloadYour hands are a blur while reloading, cranking back crossbows and loading bullets with such incredible dexterity it borders superhuman. For crossbows, you can spend 1 mana as an instant action. Reloading with your crossbow no longer requires any actions for 1 round. For firearms, you can reload your gun as an instant action by spending 1 mana for each shot.

feats/combat-feats/shield-focus/the-wall.title: The Wall
feats/combat-feats/shield-focus/the-wall.description:
Requirements - Shield FocusWhen you wield 2 shields You can use the shield special attacks (shield bash/endure) any number of times per battle.
Gain a +2 bonus to AC against any enemy you attack with a shield for 1 round.
Tank Up does not cost any movement to activate and it does not reduce your speed, effectively allowing you to always tank up, but still only ever in 1 direction.

feats/combat-feats/ambrosia.html.title: Ambrosia
feats/combat-feats/ambrosia.html.description:
Requirements - Wis +1 or a Deific Boon from Frogg Saran🐸
Tags: Healing
You are gifted a pouch from your deity. At the end of each rest, if the pouch is empty, it is filled with food from your god. The ambrosia can be eaten using the same action as Use Potion on yourself or administer potion on another creature.
It heals (7+2*LvL) and nourishes as a full meal.

feats/combat-feats/back-to-the-wall.html.title: Back to the Wall
feats/combat-feats/back-to-the-wall.html.description: Requirements - You cannot be flanked as long as you are adjacent to a wall. You are considered flanking a creature that is adjacent to a wall.

feats/combat-feats/blind-fight.html.title: Blind Fight
feats/combat-feats/blind-fight.html.description:
Requirements - You are not DD while blinded.
You have no Attack penalty when attacking a creature with partial concealment.
You only have -2 attack penalty when attacking a creature with total concealment.

feats/combat-feats/bodyguard.html.title: Bodyguard
feats/combat-feats/bodyguard.html.description:
Requirements - When an ally is moved out of your natural reach (via its own volition or not), you can move as an instant action so that it is again in your natural reach.
You can use the Get Down! action as an instant action. Any movement you take using this feat counts against your movement for your next turn. If you cannot reach your ally, you can move as close as you can get. You can position yourself in the most advantageous way around your ally, assuming you have the movement.

feats/combat-feats/bullseye.html.title: Bullseye
feats/combat-feats/bullseye.html.description: Requirements -Carefully line up a ranged attack and increase the action required to make it to a FRA. Ignore the Attack penalty for shooting in the second range increment.If your target is in the first increment, instead gain +2 attack.For effects that don't have range increments, such as spells, you can increase the action to cast to a FRA to gain the +2 bonus to attack.

feats/combat-feats/butterfly-sting.html.title: Butterfly Sting
feats/combat-feats/butterfly-sting.html.description: Requirements -Whenever you Crit a creature, you can turn it into a regular hit instead and choose another ally you can see. The next attack they land becomes a crit On-hit.

feats/combat-feats/clustered-shots.html.title: Clustered Shots
feats/combat-feats/clustered-shots.html.description: You learn to strike at a foes weak spot after making an opening. Requirements -On-hit with a Ranged Attack, apply a unique Status to the foe. Your ranged attacks beyond the first that applied this status ignore DR and Resistance for the remainder of attacks this combat.

feats/combat-feats/combat-step.html.title: Combat Step
feats/combat-feats/combat-step.html.description: Requirements - Dex +2Reduce your speed to 10 this turn to make your movement elusive. If your speed is 10 or lower, you cannot combat step.

feats/combat-feats/defensive-training.ht.title: Defensive Training
feats/combat-feats/defensive-training.ht.description: Requirements -Increase your poise by 5.

feats/combat-feats/diehard.html.title: Diehard
feats/combat-feats/diehard.html.description:
Requirements - STR +1
The first time per day your +HP would be reduced to 0, instead reduce it to 1.
When actually reduced to 0, you make make a simple attack immediately before you are defeated. This has a cooldown of 1 minute.

feats/combat-feats/divine-interference.h.title: Divine Interference
feats/combat-feats/divine-interference.h.description:
Requirements - WIS +1 or a Deific Boon from Frogg Saran🐸
As an immediate action you can expend a use of prayer to Reroll an Attack directed against you or an ally within 30 ft.

feats/combat-feats/dual-wielding-versati.title: Dual-Wielding Versatility
feats/combat-feats/dual-wielding-versati.description:
Requirements - You can dual wield with any 1h weapon, not just light weapons.
When dual wielding, you can sacrifice your "off hand" attack to gain Advantage with your "main hand" attack.
You can also sacrifice your "off hand" attack to Feint a creature. You must use your "main hand" to attack the creature you feinted.

feats/combat-feats/fearsome-finisher.htm.title: Fearsome Finisher
feats/combat-feats/fearsome-finisher.htm.description: Requirements -When you defeat an enemy, gain a +4 bonus to +Intimidation😱 checks for the rest of combat. Whenever you defeat a creature, you can Demoralize another creature as a free action. If they were already shaken, they instead are Frightened for 1 roundThis free demoralize attempt can only occur once each round.

feats/combat-feats/fleet-footwork.html.title: Fleet Footwork
feats/combat-feats/fleet-footwork.html.description:
Requirements - Increase your land speed by 5ft.
Your movement is elusive against any target you have attacked this turn.

feats/combat-feats/ghostbuster.html.title: Ghostbuster
feats/combat-feats/ghostbuster.html.description:
Requirements - +Religion Proficiency
You treat incorporeal creatures as though they were corporeal.

feats/combat-feats/innocuous-bending.htm.title: Innocuous Bending
feats/combat-feats/innocuous-bending.htm.description:
Requirements - Elemental Blast, +Sleight of Hand
You can use sleight of hand's conceal item feature with your elemental blast. It does not require a swift action to use, but it only works once in a particular encounter.

feats/combat-feats/matador.html.title: Matador
feats/combat-feats/matador.html.description:
Requirements -When a creature grazes you or misses you after moving up to you, you can force them to continue their movement 10 ft past you as an immediate action, but you cannot AoO them.
If they impact a solid surface, they take 5 crush and Poise damage, or 10 if they Charge.

feats/combat-feats/parting-shot.html.title: Parting Shot
feats/combat-feats/parting-shot.html.description: Requirements -When you take the disengage🏳 action, you make a simple ranged attack.

feats/combat-feats/power-pose.html.title: Power Pose
feats/combat-feats/power-pose.html.description:
Requirements - DRWhen you are damaged with an effect that your DR applies against, you can increase that DR by 5 as an immediate action.
If the creature is within Reach, it takes 10 Poise damage.

feats/combat-feats/ricochet-toss.html.title: Ricochet Toss
feats/combat-feats/ricochet-toss.html.description:
Requirements - Whenever you make a thrown weapon attack, the weapon you throw returns back to your hand immediately, allowing you to continuously make attacks with the same weapon(s) in the same turn.
You also ignore the attack penalty from using thrown weapons in their second range increment.
If a weapon's special effect requires being on the opponent to function (such as a Net), then you cannot ricochet them.

feats/combat-feats/suppressing-fire.html.title: Suppressing Fire
feats/combat-feats/suppressing-fire.html.description: Requirements -As a standard action, you can prepare to cover an ally's movement using a ranged weapon you can make ranged attacks with. They are treated as though they took the disengage🏳 action on their next turn.

feats/combat-feats/toughness.html.title: Toughness
feats/combat-feats/toughness.html.description: Requirements -Increase your max +HP by 5+LvL.

feats/combat-feats/trick-shot.html.title: Trick Shot
feats/combat-feats/trick-shot.html.description:
Requirements - You can make combat maneuvers👐 with ranged attacks at a -4 penalty.
You are limited to bully, shove, topple, disarm.

feats/combat-feats/tumbling-charge.html.title: Tumbling Charge
feats/combat-feats/tumbling-charge.html.description:
Requirements -When you Charge, you can choose to charge through an enemy, rolling around them or running straight through them. This is elusive against the target of your charge. You can end your charge on the opposite side of the creature instead of ending it when you meet the creature. You must still have the movement to do so.
You gain Flanking against a creature you tumbling charge for the rest of your turn.

feats/combat-feats/unarmed-combatant.htm.title: Unarmed Combatant
feats/combat-feats/unarmed-combatant.htm.description:
Requirements -Even while unarmed you threaten with punches, kicks and elbows. Your unarmed strikes deal d8 dmg, or 2d6 if your hands are empty and intact.Gain 2 special attacks usable with unarmed strikes.
Blunt Force Trauma - On-hit stagger your target for one round (fort negates). If this attack defeats the target, make a thrown weapon attack using the defeated creature as ammunition.Power Fist - On hit stagger your target for one round (fort negates). If this attack defeats the target, it flies 1,000 ft into the air and gently lands on the ground one minute later. With a low roof, the creature is launched less high, but for just as long.

feats/combat-feats/unconventional-mount..title: Unconventional Mount
feats/combat-feats/unconventional-mount..description: Requirements -You have adapted your riding style to accommodate for smaller creatures. You can mount creatures that are the same size as you.You can mount any willing creature, even those without the proper hardware to facilitate mounting.

feats/combat-feats/weapon-focus.html.title: Weapon Focus
feats/combat-feats/weapon-focus.html.description:
Requirements -Choose one: slash, pierce or crushYou can use the default special attacks of these weapon types (cleave/lacerate, lunge/pierce defense, backbreaker/concussive strike, snipe/maim) at-will.You also gain a new one depending on the type you chose, usable 1/combat.
Slash: Great Cleave - Attack all creatures currently within reach.Pierce: Impale - Creature struck takes your base weapon damage if they move by the start of your next turn.
Crush: Pulverize - stagger On-hit (fort negates)
The default and newly acquired special attacks also add your LvL to damage.Special:
If you have the unarmed combatant feat, then you can apply the effects of weapon focus (crush) to the special attacks granted by it instead of the standard crush attacks.

feats/general-feats/demolitionist.html.title: Demolitionist
feats/general-feats/demolitionist.html.description: Requirements -Gain a +4 bonus to athletics checks made to Breakout and Brute Force.

feats/general-feats/lead-by-example.html.title: Lead by Example
feats/general-feats/lead-by-example.html.description: Requirements - Whenever you perform a skill check you are proficient in, such as sneaking past someone or swimming across a raging river, anybody that follows your lead on their next turn gets a +10 bonus to the same check.If the task requires more than one turn for you to perform, your allies still get the bonus. If you fail the skill check, your allies do not get the bonus.

feats/general-feats/photographic-memory..title: Photographic Memory
feats/general-feats/photographic-memory..description:
Requirements - +2 INT
By spending a memory slot as a free action, you can memorize everything you are currently looking at, as though taking a photo. When looking back at this memory, you can comb it for further details, such as reading text or inspecting faces in a crowd.You can only memorize one such scene at a time.If you already have your memory slots full, you can forget something to use this feat.

feats/general-feats/taking-prisoners.htm.title: Taking Prisoners
feats/general-feats/taking-prisoners.htm.description:
Requirements -Whenever your actions Defeat a creature, you instead inflict Time Out
As a standard action against a defeated creature, you can perform a series of nonlethal blows in key places so they are put in time out, and to make it so they cannot lose the condition until they rest or someone performs a +Medicine💉 check against them.

feats/general-feats/wild-empathy.html.title: Wild Empathy
feats/general-feats/wild-empathy.html.description: Requirements -Gain proficiency in +Persuasion, but only for use against Beasts🐻. If you are already proficient in persuasion, gain a +2 bonus when using it against beasts. Base DC is 10+(creatures level). Add +2 to DC for things like the following: protecting young, is only beast adjacent (magic cow), abused by humanoids, starving, unfamiliar environment, mating season etc.Succeeding on a wild empathy check makes the creature friendly to you temporarily, allowing you to make simple requests. Beasts are dumb so their help is limited (which one of these guys hurt you, lead me to x). The most obvious use case is to inquire about strange things in the nearby area that have happened recently. Interacting with the same animal over time can give you bonuses or cause you to not need to make a check anymore.

feats/magic-feats/callous-casting.html.title: Callous Casting
feats/magic-feats/callous-casting.html.description:
Requirements -As a swift action, increase the DC of an instantaneous spell you cast this turn by 2 if you include any non-minion allies (including yourself) in its AoE.Special: If you have an ability to effectively not include allies in an AoE, then you do not get the bonus of this feat.
If the ally is immune or has Resistance to the effect, then you do not get the bonus of this feat.

feats/magic-feats/magic-initiate.html.title: Magic Initiate
feats/magic-feats/magic-initiate.html.description: Requirements -You gain access to 4 +Cantrips

feats/magic-feats/matryoshkasting.html.title: Matryoshkasting
feats/magic-feats/matryoshkasting.html.description:
Requirements - Level 3When you use a level 2 or higher Spell, the next spell of a lower level that you cast costs 1 less mana. This can chain together until you spend 0 mana on casting a spell.If a spell you cast is of the same level or a higher level than the one you cast last, the effect ends.
For the purposes of this feat, a spell is considered of a higher level when you upcast it.

feats/magic-feats/mm-caster-minion.html.title: MM Caster Minion
feats/magic-feats/mm-caster-minion.html.description:
Requirements - INT +2
While using a feature with the scrying tag through a Companion creature, you can use your actions and the creature's actions to have them be the origin point of your spells.

feats/magic-feats/mm-coax.html.title: MM Coax
feats/magic-feats/mm-coax.html.description:
Requirements - INT +1
Your spells with the Mind-Affecting tag can affect Mindless creatures.

feats/magic-feats/mm-elemental-shift.htm.title: MM Elemental Shift
feats/magic-feats/mm-elemental-shift.htm.description: Requirements - INT +1When you cast the spell that deals an elemental damage type, you can choose to transform it into a different element, choosing between fire, frost, zap and force.

feats/magic-feats/mm-explosion-anticipat.title: MM Explosion Anticipation
feats/magic-feats/mm-explosion-anticipat.description:
Requirements - INT +0
You are immune to the effects of your own AoE spell, provided it does not have a listed duration.

feats/magic-feats/mm-focused-blast.html.title: MM Focused Blast
feats/magic-feats/mm-focused-blast.html.description:
Requirements - INT +1
When you cast a spell that deals damage and targets multiple creatures, choose a "primary target." The DC of the spell for that creature is 2 higher.
If the spell allows attacks against multiple creatures (such as Gloom Bolt), you also get a +2 bonus to your Spell Attack against this creature.

feats/magic-feats/mm-intensify.html.title: MM Intensify
feats/magic-feats/mm-intensify.html.description: Requirements - Int +1Increase the CL of the spell by 2.

feats/magic-feats/mm-latent-curse.html.title: MM Latent Curse
feats/magic-feats/mm-latent-curse.html.description:
Requirements - INT +0
Your spells with the curse tag can also be cast on items. The first creature to activate or put on this item is afflicted with the curse (save negates). If the save is successful, the curse is lifted. For items that aren't activated or worn (such as a rock) the creature must possess the item or at least 1 minute for the curse to take hold.With curses that allow for a creative uses, the parameters must be set at the time the spell is cast.Special: You can only curse three items at a time. When a curse afflicts a creature that plays with your protected items, it no longer counts against this total. If you cast another latent curse with 3 already active, you choose which item is no longer cursed.You have an innate sense when one of your latent curse spells is triggered.

feats/magic-feats/mm-persistence.html.title: MM Persistence
feats/magic-feats/mm-persistence.html.description:
Requirements - INT +1
When you cast a spell that has recurring saves each turn (like an upcast Mind Crush), you can choose to give it the Concentration tag (if it doesn't already have it) in order to increase the DC of recurring saves by 2.

feats/magic-feats/mm-residual-damage.htm.title: MM Residual Damage
feats/magic-feats/mm-residual-damage.htm.description:
Requirements - INT +2
When you cast a spell that deals damage that doesn't already have a duration, add a damage over time effect On-hit or on a failed save. The creature takes your CL in damage at the end of its turn. The type of damage matches the damage of the spell.

feats/magic-feats/mm-saviors-arrow.html.title: MM Saviors Arrow
feats/magic-feats/mm-saviors-arrow.html.description:
Requirements - INT +1
You can fire the effect of a spell with the healing tag using the range of a ranged weapon. If the healing spell can target multiple creatures, you can make as many attacks as you like, but cannot target an ally more than once. You can also choose to target a space to be the origin point of your spell. You can use ranged weapons to cast spells with the healing tag with this feat.

feats/magic-feats/spell-ambush.html.title: Spell Ambush
feats/magic-feats/spell-ambush.html.description:
Requirements - +Stealth Proficiency
Your spell DC is 2 higher against creatures you successfully hide from using stealth (aka if they would normally be DD from hiding). This only applies to the spell's initial save.
This does not apply to other ways to cause a target to be DD, such as if you blinded them or feint them.
Within reason, some abilities that similarly can only be used on the opening turn of combat to deceive or fight dirty against an enemy can also use this ability (like the Succubus' Sudden Betrayal ability).

feats/magic-feats/spell-sharing.html.title: Spell Sharing
feats/magic-feats/spell-sharing.html.description: Requirements - When you cast a single target spell with the buff tag, you can cast it on a companion creature and yourself, or all of your companion creatures (provided they are in range and valid targets). This functions even if the spell has a target of self. If the spell does not have a listed range, its range for determining when you can buff your companions is reach.

feats/magic-feats/threatening-illusion.h.title: Threatening Illusion
feats/magic-feats/threatening-illusion.h.description:
Requirements -When you create a figment effect that creates a creature (such as Imagination), it also threatens and provides Flanking as long as creatures have not saved to disbelieve.
As a standard action, or as an AoO, you can have the figment attack a creature. The creature takes d8 per spell level psychic damage (will negates and creature disbelieves illusion).

feats/multiclass/bending-initiate.html.title: Bending Initiate
feats/multiclass/bending-initiate.html.description: Requirements -You can use the Bender elemental blast feature as a character of (LvL-2). It is a Special Attack that is usable any number of times a combat.The element you choose cannot be changed.

feats/multiclass/ex-guardian.html.title: Ex-Guardian
feats/multiclass/ex-guardian.html.description: You used to be a light guardian a long time ago, or you dropped out of your training early.Requirements -You gain the Light Guardian🌞 Light Binding special attack. You can only use it once per combat. You do not gain any of the other class abilities that enhance it.

feats/multiclass/flurry.html.title: Flurry
feats/multiclass/flurry.html.description:
You can mimic the Martial Artist👊 ability to weave punches and kicks into their combos.
Requirements - Unarmed CombatantYou gained the Martial Artist's Flurry feature, but it costs 1 mana to use.

feats/multiclass/light-steps.html.title: Light Steps
feats/multiclass/light-steps.html.description:
Requirements - Level 3 Tags: Concentration
Light steps requires concentration, and you can start concentrating on this ability as a free action by spending 1 Mana💎. As long as you only move during your turn and take no other action, you can walk along any flat continuous surface. This can include things that aren't even otherwise solid such as water or lava. It can also include things such as walls or ceilings.You can use this ability for only part of your turn to get to a location, but if you attack, cast a spell etc, then you need a surface you would normally be able to stand on or you plummet.

feats/multiclass/unarmored-defense.html.title: Unarmored Defense
feats/multiclass/unarmored-defense.html.description:
Requirements - STR +0You've trained your body in such a way to allow you to effectively respond to attacks by intercepting blows and dodging projectiles.
Your AC while unarmored is 14+LvL. If you have at least +1 DEX, this number increases to 15+lvl.
Gain 4 Poise.

feats/teamwork-feats/as-one/tandem-charg.title: Tandem Charge
feats/teamwork-feats/as-one/tandem-charg.description:
Requirements - As oneDuring an ally's turn, if they make a Charge attack, you can spend an immediate action to charge along with them and make a simple attack. You must charge attack the same creature they attackYour speed is zero on your next turn.
Turn based games make movement awkward, but the idea is you are moving together, so other positional effects, such as escape route or shield actions, can treat moving allies as within reach for the duration of the movement in circumstances where allies converge on a location or start in positions that are close to each other.

feats/teamwork-feats/artillery-team.html.title: Artillery Team
feats/teamwork-feats/artillery-team.html.description:
Requirements -You can use the Aid action to reload an allies weapon with the reload property (like crossbow or Gun). You can aid them preemptively to allow them to shoot more than once during their turn.
Also siege weapons when I get to it.

feats/teamwork-feats/cooperative-casting.title: Cooperative Casting
feats/teamwork-feats/cooperative-casting.description: Requirements - The ability to cast spellsYou can use the Aid action on an ally within 30 ft to increase the CL ally by 2 for 1 round. When you do this, you can also spend 1 Mana to decrease the mana cost of their next spell by 1.If your level is higher than the creature you are assisting, the CL boost increases to 3.

feats/teamwork-feats/feint-partner.html.title: Feint Partner
feats/teamwork-feats/feint-partner.html.description: Requirements -If your ally Feints a creature, you can make an AoO against it if it is within Reach. It is DD for this attack.

feats/teamwork-feats/gang-up.html.title: Gang Up
feats/teamwork-feats/gang-up.html.description: Requirements -Gain a +4 bonus to attack with combat maneuvers👐 if an ally has rolled an Attack against the creature you are attacking since your last turn.

feats/teamwork-feats/harmonize.html.title: Harmonize
feats/teamwork-feats/harmonize.html.description: Requirements -When you roll a Group Skill Checks with the +Profession🧑‍🌾 skill to sing, play instruments or otherwise put on some kind of group performance (such as with sports), every ally proficient in a the skill beyond the first (ie you and another performer) gives a +4 bonus (max +12).

feats/teamwork-feats/perfect-positioning.title: Perfect Positioning
feats/teamwork-feats/perfect-positioning.description:
Requirements -You can move into an allies space. When you do, they can move into yours as an instant action. This movement is elusive.
While adjacent to an ally, you cannot be flanked.

feats/teamwork-feats/shield-bros.html.title: Shield Bros
feats/teamwork-feats/shield-bros.html.description: Requirements -Gain +2 AC when you are within the natural reach of an ally that wields a shield. This can increase up to +4 ac if 4 shield bros are involved. This basically functions as and does not stack with the Block action.Due to how spaces work on grids, having groups of 4 adjacent to each other can be difficult. So for groups, as long as each member is adjacent to another member, that should suffice for gaining this feats benefits.

feats/teamwork-feats/spotter.html.title: Spotter
feats/teamwork-feats/spotter.html.description:
Requirements - When you give the Aid action to grant a bonus to Attack to a creature firing a Ranged weapon or siege weapon, the bonus increases to +4, but you can no longer have multiple creatures aid that creature to grant attack bonuses.
You also passively give allies (other than you) a +4 bonus when to +Perception👀 checks when travelling with them. This bonus doesn't stack with itself.

gods/gods/demigods/anime-jesus.html.title: Anime Jesus
gods/gods/demigods/anime-jesus.html.description: Anime Jesus is the anime god of order. He primarily concerns himself with the purging of corruption and evil in the realms beyond his own.The followers of AJ call themselves The Golden Order. Many that follow him mimic his powerful offensive magic in order to destroy aberrations, demons, undead and the mortals that serve/create them. Anime Jesus is not just concerned with the evil that exists on Nack, but also that which lies beyond the stars. A radioactive and corrupting force permeates the galaxy known as ligmanium. It twists and transforms all it comes into contact with, eventually spreading between planets. Destroying this substance at its source is the prime directive of AJ and his followers.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/life-aft.title: Life After Death
gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/life-aft.description: When a person dies in the world of Nack, their soul separates from their body and is quickly pulled down into the Underworld. Most people plunge into the Styx immediately, losing all sense of self and becoming an amorphous unrecognizable spirit before washing up on a line in front of Hades' desk. Depending on the type of life they lived, they are sent to different areas of the Underworld. Many are given tasks to perform, the most popular of which are record keeping and patrolling the halls for those who would steal Hades' treasure or try to escape the Underworld.Particularly strong-willed people are able to resist the pull towards the Styx for a bit longer, and are able to maintain most of their appearance, albeit a bit more ghostly. Creatures that curry favor with Hades are given access to the bodies they had in life and are still privy to many of their core memories.Any and all attempts at resurrection show up on Hades' desk after the fact, and he decides how he wants to approach them on a case by case basis. Acts performed by other gods are out of his control, but noted for future dealings. Every instance of resurrection is considered a debt that must eventually be repayed. Sometimes when creatures cheat death, Hades will instruct his followers to hunt them down.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/the-unde.title: The Underworld
gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/the-unde.description: The Underworld is a physical location in the mortal realm, though its entrance is never something that stays in the same place for very long. Usually when too many people catch wind of its location, Hades will change it to another location. The entirety of the Underworld is Hades' domain, and he takes great care to make sure that he does not get unwanted guests, and that people do not escape.The underworld is split up into several parts.The River Styx in omnipresent throughout the Underworld. Wherever you stand, you can always see it snaking through the terrain. The entire Underworld is shaped around this mystical river. The liquid that flows through it changes based on the region of the Underworld. Pure in Elysium, lava in Asphodel and a crimson blood-like liquid in most other places.Exposure to the waters of the Styx has a variety of effects that depend on circumstances. Creatures who have lived exceptionally long lives are particularly resistant to the effects of the Styx while younger creatures are wiped clean very quickly. Taking a sip from the waters will not get rid of much but taking a plunge for just a minute can wipe away years of life. Typically more important memories are more resistant to the power of the Styx: Childhood memories, cherished loved ones, sense of self and important deeds.Starting from the entrance/exit is the precipice. Guarding the exit is the mighty three-headed beast Cerberus, standing as the Underworlds eternal guardian. He freely allows creatures to enter, but never allows them to leave. The precipice largely consists of twisted caves where the River Styx snakes around. Spirits of the dead often linger in the precipice as long as their will allows before inevitably passing through the Styx and washing up in front of Hades' desk. Creatures from the mortal realm wander into the Precipice quite frequently, filling its halls with beasts or mischievous creatures who like to desecrate Hades' altars and commune with lost spirits to lead them astray. This region.This region.This regio

gods/gods/heavenly-deities/brazzeria/bra.title: Brazzerian Purification
gods/gods/heavenly-deities/brazzeria/bra.description: The art of purification involves turning a fiend into mortal form, purging them of their inherently sinful natures. To do this requires a lot of time and effort to be successful. The bare minimum required in order to conduct the ritual is... Mana. 100*(creature's lvl)^2. (1=100, 2=400, 3=900...12=14,400) Proficiency in planes. The creature's name before it transformed. With all of the above ingredients, you can draw the magic circles required, power it, and initiate the ritual. The person in charge of performing the ritual rolls a DC 17 luck check to guess the creature's true name: A word in an ancient tongue meant to represent who a person is at the core of their soul. If successful, then it transforms into a hellion😈. If it fails, it is evaporated, leaving only a silhouette and any of its gear/clothing behind.Because this is such a slim chance of success, and creatures only get one shot, Brazzerian priests have done a great deal of research on how to improve the likelihood of a rituals success. Each of the below things can improve odds, adding additional bonuses to the luck check. (+1) Double the mana cost. This can stack, but it must be doubled each time. (+2) Convince the creature to be willing to transform, usually requiring appealing the the creatures ethos. (Up to +3) Have detailed information on who the creature was in life. Major things, like events they regret, cherished family/friends, major accomplishments contribute more. (Up to +3) Have items significant to what the creature was in life. Items like childhood treasures, wedding rings and signature weapons/armor contribute more. (+2) Perform ritual in sanctified area. Such areas are rare instances where Brazzeria has visited the realm of mortals to perform miracles, and are closely guarded treasures. Other things can add to the bonus that aren't listed here as appropriate.In very rare instances, creatures can be born fiends, such as when they are the child of a demon lord. Such fiends ignore most of the aforementioned rules: They can automatically succeed on the ritual if they are willing, and it always fails if they are not.Their changes tend to be less dramatic, allowing them to maintain most aspects of their fiendish form and powers, making them very rare catches for Brazzerians.

gods/invoking-deities.html.title: Invoking Deities
gods/invoking-deities.html.description: Deities can give their favor in specific ways, but invoking their name can give you a more general boon. Whenever you would perform a task that falls in line with the god's ethos, goals or tenets, you can choose to invoke their name as a free action.This could mean a contest of strength for The Cataclysm, a persuasion check made against a fiend for Brazzeria🌖, or a survival check to track down a hunter exterminating wildlife for the Earth Mother🍃. The DM is the final arbiter to decide if your request is answered. When you invoke a deity, you expend a use of prayer and gain a d8 to any single d20 roll (minus something like a random chart).If you invoke and your deity disapproves, you lose that use of prayer, and you get an impression of why your request for aid failed.You can only invoke a deity that you have curried favor for in most circumstances. When you invoke, you cannot do so again for 1 minute.

random-charts/character-creation/abnorma.title: Abnormalities
random-charts/character-creation/abnorma.description: Another feature that can help you decide if your character is a weirdo or not. If you want a relatively average character, don’t roll this.Roll a d20, then roll a d3. The d20 represents what feature is in question and the d3 represents whether the abnormality tends towards being positive (1) unusual (2) or negative (3). You can roll a few times to decide a few unusual features, decide you want a specific number of each feature, then roll a few d20s, or not roll at all.Depending on the race, some of the features described as weird or negative may actually be positive or completely normal. Some features may be completely absent from your race. An easy way to create a new negative feature is to completely remove or damage certain features (one eye).Feel free to go down the whole list if you're a mad lad (though the ladies might not appreciate some of the hair options)

random-charts/character-creation/age.htm.title: Age
random-charts/character-creation/age.htm.description: Roll a d100 and add 20. The result you get is the percentage of the way through your life essentially. Multiply this value by the average lifespan of your chosen race.Example - Human with a roll of 7570(.75)=52 years oldThe added 20 is to basically make sure you aren't a child.

random-charts/resurrection-chart.html.title: Resurrection Chart
random-charts/resurrection-chart.html.description: When a character is resurrected, roll a d4.After that roll your respective chart. Characters with positive LUK can decide to Reroll their result. Characters with negative luck roll twice and have the GM decide what effect happens.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Catapult
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description: Level 1 Alchemy (T) Tags: - Action: StandardThe end of your staff manifests into a sling or catapult like device. You can load it with any handheld item weighing up to 10 lbs and launch it at a creature. The creature takes d8+CL (4+CL) damage and is also affected by the item catapulted (reflex halves and negates effect of item). The type of damage varies depending on the object thrown.The creature must also make any appropriate save against catapulted items if they fail their save. Even if a creature passes its save, the item is assumed to land in the creatures space, so if the item activates on impact, the creature may still have to deal with an explosion, grease or whatever other fun stuff gets tossed.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Endothermic Touch
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 1 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Prepared, Fire Action: Standard
You are much better at conducting heat in a controlled manner. In general you can exist in hot environments comfortably. One of your limbs glows like heated metal and can be used to touch solid objects that are sources of large heat. Up to a 1 ft cube can be affected at a time. By maintaining contact with an object (one FRA) you can store its heat. Later you can choose to diffuse this heat into the air around you, or transfer it to another object. The effects of which depend on the object. Many things simply burn, but others like stone and metals can be softened.If used as a melee attack, it deals 2d6+CL (7+CL) fire damage.If you desire, you can immediately diffuse the heat as you touch the hot object continuously. You can affect a 1ft cube per round of contact. Prolonged exposure to heat bothers you less during this spell, but in enclosed spaces, your allies, and eventually even you, can be overwhelmed by heat.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Lab Rat
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 1 Alchemy (T)
Tags: poly, baleful, Curse Action: StandardPrepare a creature for transport, or prevent them from being a continued nuisance thanks to healing. The creature transforms into tiny white rodent that can fit in the palm of your hand.The creature is automatically transformed back into its original form when a creature says "ratatouille."

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Long Arms
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 1 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Buff Action: SwiftThe target's arms lengthen, more closely resembling prehensile tentacles. Its natural reach increases by 5 ft.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Rubbery
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 1 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Prepared Action: -
Your body is incredibly bouncy and flexible. You only take 1 damage per 10 ft you fall and cannot be drained from falling. You can take the jump action as a free action whenever you take fall damage. You gain compression.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Venom Transfer
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 1 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Poison Action: Swift
You jab your staff into a creature that is currently envenomed and borrow some of the venom for yourself. Using the venom as a catalyst, you can charge your next attack this round with an additional d8 (4) poison damage.The envenomed creature you absorbed the venom from can immediately make a save to end the condition. If they fail, it does not advance the venom further.Note: You can also use this technique against a defeated creature that is venomous. They get no benefit or drawback from it.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Euphoric Cloud
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 2 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Concentration, Persistent, Air Action: Standard Focus: A smoke pipe
You take a deep hit from your pipe. When you exhale a cloud of colorful fragrant smoke fills the area. The smoke does not obscure vision significantly enough to give concealment.
Any creature within the area is fascinated by its incredible colors and tantalizing aroma while it persists (will negates).

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Liquefy
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 2 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Buff, poly, true, Water Action: StandardTransform target creature into a puddle of water. This prevents them from interacting with objects, unless they are buoyant enough to move as a puddle. As a liquid, they can slip into places they otherwise might not be able to.The spell ends if the liquefied creature takes fire damage, or if they form back into their previous shape as a standard action.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Nauseating Trail
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 2 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Poison, Persistent, Concentration Action: Standard
Immediately dash and disengage, leaving behind a toxic trail in your wake. For the rest of your turn, spaces you move through are filled with a toxic gas that lingers. The gas spreads slightly up into the air, causing the spaces 5 feet above you to also be affected.
Any creature that moves through one of these spaces experiences its stench and caustic properties. They take 3d8+CL (13+CL) poison damage and are sickened 1 (fort halves damage and negates sicken).

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Third Leg
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 2 Alchemy (T) Tags: - Action: Standard
You cause a creature to grow an additional oversized and unwieldy limb. The creature is clumsy 2 (fort negates).
The additional limb does not disappear over time and must be removed manually. When the creature takes at least 5 slashing damage, the limb quickly withers away. The limb can also be safely removed with first aid.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Alchemize
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description: Level 3 Alchemy (T) Tags: - Action: 1 minuteYou instantly turn a hunk of metal into gold. The object can be no larger than a 3x3x3ft cube, and it must be something you are able to hold (in its entirety) in one hand. As long as the item you hold is mostly made out of metal, you convert it to gold equal to 60% of its total value.This spell can also be used to convert gold into base metals.Note: I'm currently thinking about the implications this spell has on world building. It's a complex web that makes you consider the value of metal, how the crafting system works and how the world replenishes resources consumed by magic.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Blood to Ichor
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 3 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Poison, Companion, Recharge, Mana Burn Action: StandardSummon an ooze inside of a creature. The ooze immediately tries to melt its way out. The affected creature takes 2d8+CL (9+CL) poison damage (fort halves).
The ooze then fights to aid you. It is Taunted by the creature it originally emerged from.This spell can only be cast 1/minute.Creature stats TBD

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Chimp Out
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 3 Alchemy (T)
Tags: poly, chimeric, Curse Action: Standard
Transform a creature so they become a more ape-like version of themselves (fort negates). They gain a Climb🧗 speed of 30, have their Land Speed reduced by 15 and are effectively silenced, only capable of making animal noises.They gain the following special attack.
Special Attack: Poop Toss Poison - Make a thrown Natural Attack. The creature takes 2d6 (7) poison damage and becomes sickened 2 On-hit.Curse can be removed by eating a banana or using poop toss.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Caustic Blood
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 4 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Poison Action: ImmediateWhen a creature deals crush, slash or pierce damage to you, spray them with a nasty surprise. They take 3d8+CL (13+CL) poison damage (reflex halves)

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Caustic Suprise
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 4 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Poison, Contingent Action: StandardWhile this contingency is active, your skin seems to bubble and pop, with the frequency and intensity increasing as your hp depletes.
When you die or are defeated, this contingency triggers and you briefly live on, ignoring these conditions. You are unable to take any actions, including dashing, other than movement while in this state, and you ignore all movement impairing effects. At the end of your next turn, your skin explodes in a caustic brine, dealing 5d8+CL (21+CL) poison damage to all creatures in range (reflex halves)

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Iron Man
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 5 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Buff, Dismissible Action: StandardYour body undergoes a rapid and temporary transformation to be completely made of metal. You gain the following benefits…
You do not possess biology, and therefore cannot be envenomed, bleed, suffocated etc. Any non-permanent instance of these effects immediately ends on cast. Permanent instances are suppressed for the duration.
Resistance to all physical damage unless it originates from a weapon of adamantine or greater toughness
Resistance to all poise damage And the following drawbacks…
You are silenced You speed is 30, but cannot be decreased or increased You cannot swim, fly or hover. You automatically sink when submerged in water. Your weight increases to be 100x heavier.
If you have the anime🎌 theme song racial feature, it changes during this transformation.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Magic Dart
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 1 Arcane
Tags: Force, Upcast Action: Standard
Make a ranged attack with a dart that deals 2d8+CL (9+CL) force dmg. The dart sticks inside of them, magnetizing other magic effects to it. Creatures get a +2 bonus to spell attacks against this creature within 1 minute.
This dart can be removed as a swift action while wielding a Staff Component by making a DC (5+CL) Caster Level check. If the attack was a Crit, it cannot be removed. It is automatically removed if targeted with Dispel Magic.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Scholars Shield
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 1 Arcane
Tags: Prepared Action: -
A shield made of vibrant magical force rotates around your body. You can take shield actions, but only against spell attacks. Gets a few additional options
Can also be used to block force effects that normally automatically hit (such as lucky star and magic missile) as an immediate action
Can also be used to grant a +2 bonus to a +Saving Throw against a spell as an immediate action
Special: This technique is compatible with the Shield Focus feat.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Arcane Arc
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 2 Arcane
Tags: Force, Upcast Action: StandardFire a wide projectile that affects an area in front of you, dealing 3d8+CL (13+CL) force damage to creatures it contacts (reflex halves)Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Crystalline Explosion
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 2 Arcane
Tags: Force, Upcast Action: Standard
