Make a Ranged Spell Attack by firing a magical crystal at a creature, dealing 3d8+CL (13+CL) force dmg. Regardless if it hits or misses, it explodes in the targets space, knocking down all creatures within 10 ft (fort negates).
If your attack is a Crit, the target gets no save against the knock down effect.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Exasperating Evocation
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 3 Arcane
Tags: Force Action: StandardFire a magical projectile that homes in on a specific target and follows it around, damaging each time it passes through. The projectile moves 30 ft each round and stops when it reaches the target's space, dealing 3d8+CL (13+CL) force damage (reflex halves). If the target does not move out of range, it takes the damage repeatedly at the start of each of your turns.The projectile moves in a straight line from its starting position to the target. If it impacts solid terrain during its travel, it dissipates harmlessly. It cannot harm any creature other than the original target.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Floating Spell Blade
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 3 Arcane
Tags: Elusive, Force, Upcast Action: Swift Focus: 1 melee weapon
You can cause a copy of a held melee weapon made entirely out of magic force to form slowly, float above your head and follow you at a fixed distance. At any point on your next turn, launch it at a target of your choosing within 30 ft. Make a Ranged Spell Attack. It deals the damage of a standard melee attack but as force damage.By casting this spell as a standard action, you can reduce its mana cost to 1.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage of the sword by d8 (4).

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Arcane Cannon
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 4 Arcane
Tags: Force, Mana Burn
Action: FRA
You form a literal cannon made out of shimmering magical force that is immobile and automatically comes loaded with mana from casting this spell. As part of casting the spell, you can fire the cannon, dealing 5d8+CL (22+CL) force damage in a 10 ft radius at the point of impact (reflex halves). These cannon shots count as siege weapons.You or any ally can spend 4 mana as a standard action to again fire the cannon at a new point (still using your CL). But the cannon can only fire once each round.You mana burn 4 mana while this spell is active. When the spell ends, the mana burn reduces to 1.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Wall of Force
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 5 Arcane
Tags: Force Action: Standard
You create a wall of shimmering force. It is transparent, giving you line of sight, but blocks line of effect and absorbs all attacks that attempt to pass through it. It has 50 hp and dissipates if this hp is lost.A creature can attempt to pass through the wall by making a reflex save as a swift action. Failure deals 2d8+CL (9+CL) force damage to them and prevents them from passing through.
A wall of force can be destroyed with Brute Force with a DC of 40.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Crimson Confession
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 1 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: 1 minuteYou touch an object and infuse it with a curse to help you keep track of creatures who mess with it. When you lay this curse you can name creatures that circumvent the curse out loud.Afterwords, if any creature touches or directly moves the object, including through gloves, telekinesis or a long stick, their skin turns a bright crimson color (will negates). If their skin was already crimson, they turn blue. Once a creature has passed their save against this effect, they are immune to further touches against the same cast.If you cast this spell on an object while you already have a crimson confession active, the previous one disappears.The creature must either admit to touching the object to the caster , or they must manually cover their body in paint of their previous skin color to remove the curse.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Feast and Famine
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 1 Corruption
Tags: Healing, Overheal, Upcast Action: Standard
You wave your staff in a circle to absorb the life from any inanimate plants in the area. You heal yourself for 6+CL hp and automatically end all bleed effects. This kills the plants.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, heal 4 more hp.Note: This spell only functions if you are not in a form of desolate terrain. This could include places like, arctic terrain, dessert the surface of deep ocean or many urban areas.
If it's iffy, you can always roll a Luck Check! (with a DC dependent on terrain)

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Fish out of Water
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 1 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: StandardCurse a creature so they can no longer breath air, and must inhale water in order to breath.Unless there is a sizable water source nearby to submerge themselves in, cursed creatures must spend a swift action each turn to breathe, dunking their heads in puddles, or guzzling water. They must have some form of liquid on their person or nearby in order to do this otherwise they begin to suffocate.
While suffocating, the creature is silenced. If they end their turn suffocating, they are drained 5.This spell has no effect on creatures that are aquatic, amphibious, or that do not need to breathe (such as a skeleton).In order to end this curse, a creature must drink a glass of iced tea.Note:
If its iffy as to whether or not there's water sufficient enough to stave suffocation, roll a luck check for the victims, with a DC dependent on terrain.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Life Drinker
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 1 Corruption
Tags: Buff Action: SwiftYou emanate an aura that absorbs energy from creatures attempting to heal. This aura follows you as you move. Creatures other than you are bone chilled while within this aura, and for 1 round after they leave it.Upcast - By spending 4 mana, you also gain any healing you negate from the bone chill you inflict with this aura.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Never Lucky
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 1 Corruption
Tags: Upcast Action: Standard
Cause a creature to be unlucky. They next time they roll an Attack or saving throw, they roll it at Disadvantage.
Outside of combat, this has the subtle tag, but only affects skill checks, ability checks and luck checks.Upcast - By spending 3 mana, the creatures next 2 rolls are at disadvantage. By spending 5, the creatures next 3 rolls are at disadvantage.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Poison the Well
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 1 Corruption
Tags: Curse, Upcast Action: 1 minute Focus: One gold pieceYou stand at the edge of a well and fill a coin with malefic energy. By dropping the coin into the well, it subtly causes it to become poisonous. Creatures that drink from it become drained 1 (fort negates).This curse can be removed by removing the coin from the well.Upcast - You can affect larger water sources by spending more mana. At 2 mana you can effect larger bodies of water, such as lakes and creeks. At 3 mana you can effect large lakes and 1 mile of river. At 6 mana you can effect an entire river, regardless of its length.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Enfeeble
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 2 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: StandardWith heavy arms, the creature struggles to bring the full force of their attacks and spells. Whenever the creature deals damage, that damage is decreased by 2 (unless it is true damage).
While a non-minion creature within 60 ft is afflicted with this curse (and you are its caster), you get advantage on fortitude saves.In order to remove this curse, a creature must sheathe and unsheathe a sword 3 times without doing anything else. In combat this requires a FRA.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Harvester
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 2 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: 1 minute Focus: 1 inert mana crystalThe curse of the harvester is a tool used by creatures to remotely collect mana. Because of the cast time, the creature must either be willing or defeated to be the target of this spell. You link a creature to the inert mana crystal used as a focus. You also specify a time of day.
Every day at the specified time, the target is Mana Burned until they only have 1 mana left, as though they had donated mana. The harvester receives (this mana value-1), which they can use as they see fit.This curse can only be removed by destroying the inert mana crystal used as the focus for the initial casting. The harvest-ee can innately tell if a crystal is bound to them by looking at it, feeling it etc.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Retributive Reparations
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 2 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: StandardCurse an object to reject its owner, unless that owner is you. The first time a creature picks up this item it is inflicted with a curse (will negates).
The curse causes them to be unable to separate from the item, unless it gives it back to you, and makes it exhausted them until it does. If the creature tries to use the item, like unlocking a door with a cursed key or swinging a cursed weapon, they become drained 5.The creature doesn't need to hold the item per se, but it does need to be on their person. If they try something clever like putting the key in a backpack, then taking the backpack off, the backpack defies logic and stays on, just like the key would.The creature can return the cursed item to you as a swift action, removing the curse. Alternatively, if you spend 1 week more than 1 mile away from this creature, the curse naturally fades.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Violent Accident
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 2 Corruption
Tags: Curse, Subtle Action: StandardNote: You must speak directly to a creature to inflict this curse, or otherwise have its attention.You inflict an omen upon the creature. At some point within the next 24 hours, they will encounter a dangerous scenario that will deal 20 damage to them (reflex negates). The damage type could be something falling on them for crush damage, getting struck by lightning for zap damage etc.
A creature trained in arcana that is the target of this spell can identify it (DC 17). If successful, it can diffuse the omen by treating you with kindness.If a creature trained in arcana witnesses the deadly effect of violent accident, they can make an arcana check to identify the origin of the effect. If they happened to be present when it was inflicted, they also are able to identify who cast it.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Wither
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 2 Corruption
Tags: Concentration Action: StandardCause a creature to atrophy over 3 rounds. This has no immediate effect, but at the start of the creatures turn it withers (fort negates). The first failure fatigues the creature and reduces their speed by 15. The second and third failure reduce their speed by an additional 15.
This effect continues for three turns, regardless if the creature passes its save (unless it has Stalwart).

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Caught Red-Handed
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 3 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: StandardDrawing upon the spiritual link between a corpse and its killer, you reach out across space to brand the killer of the corpse you targeted with this spell, creating a physical manifestation of the killer’s guilt.The killer’s right hand is stained a crimson red, and this stain can’t be removed (though it can be hidden by mundane means such as by wearing gloves). If the killer doesn’t have a right hand for some reason, the spell instead causes a red stain in the shape of a hand to appear elsewhere on the creature’s body (typically on the arm).
This spell affects only the creature that directly killed the targeted corpse. Other individuals that contributed to the target’s death are unaffected. If the victim did not die from violence or died indirectly (for instance, if the creature died from suffocating after someone trapped it in a room filling with water), then the spell fizzles. Once a corpse has been the target for red hand of the killer, it can never act as the focus for another casting of red hand of the killer, causing the spell to fizzle immediately if tried.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Corrupting Mist
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 3 Corruption
Tags: Poison, Persistent, Concentration, Upcast Action: StandardYou cause a purple or green mist to spread over and area. Creatures inside cough and wheeze, becoming sickened 1 the first round of exposure. If the creature is already sickened, then they instead take 3d8+CL (13+CL) poison damage (fort halves).
You have Immunity to your own cast of corrupting mist.Upcast 5 - You can increase the duration of the spell to 1 hour. Every round it persists, it spreads an additional 10 ft. It only spreads in one direction 180 degrees.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Vulnerability
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 3 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: Standard
The curse softens hide, weakens bones and lowers the creatures pain threshold. While afflicted with this curse, a creature has weakness 2 to all damage (will negates).To remove this curse, a creature has to give themselves a paper cut or break a glass window.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Curse of Blindness
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 4 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: Standard
The target's vision wanes permanently as the world disappears around it. It is blinded (will reduces effect to blurred vision for one round).Removed by consuming the raw eyes of a freshly killed creature.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Rotting Alliance
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 4 Corruption
Tags: Curse, Upcast Action: Standard
You curse up to 4 creatures with a rot that accelerates their demise when they exist near one another. When a creature with this curse exists within 15 feet of an ally that is also cursed during its turn, it takes 4d6 (14) necrotic damage and is drained 5. This is a persistent effect.Each cast of this spell is not mutually exclusive. Multiple castings of this spell have the potential to include more creatures in this effect.This curse is removed by the cursed creatures all signing their name on something like paper or parchment without damaging each other in the process, and then burning it.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, affect an additional creature.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Blanket of Snow
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 1 Cryomancy❄ Tags: - Action: StandardA shadow appears beneath the target, and a blanket of snow falls upon them immediately after. The creature takes 2d8+CL (9+CL) crush damage and has to spend 30 ft of movement to dig themselves out of the snow (reflex halves dmg and getting buried).
While buried, the creature has its speed reduced to 0, has resistance to fire damage and has cover. Creatures they attack while buried also have cover.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Frost Armor
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 1 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Upcast Action: Swift
You cover yourself in a thin protective ice barrier. You gain resistance to the next instance of +HP damage that is not crush, slash or pierce.
Once you take damage from any source, minus damage over time effects like bleed or self inflicted damage, the ice barrier shatters and frost armor ends.
If you are ablaze when you cast this spell, instead of the usual benefits, put out the flames.Upcast 4 - This spell becomes an immediate action.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Frost Breath
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 1 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Frost, Upcast Action: Standard
You exhale and fill the area with ice cold air. Creatures inside take 2d8+CL (9+CL) frost dmg and are made frosty (fort halves dmg and negates frosty).Upcast - Increase the size of the cone by 10 ft per additional mana spent.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Ice Skating
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 1 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Buff Action: Swift
You coat the bottoms of your feet/footwear etc. with ice, allowing you to slide along cold terrain with ease. While moving across ice or snow, your gain a "skating speed" of 40 or equal to your Land Speed if it is faster. You ignore the negative aspects of moving across Frosty Terrain❄.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Snow Fort
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 1 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Concentration, Upcast Action: Swift
You cause a snowy barrier to appear to protect a creature. The barrier appears all around the creature, protecting them from all sides, but not from attacks from above. They gain cover as long as they do not move from their space. If you stop concentrating or if the fort is hit with fire damage, it crumbles.Upcast 2 - You can target large creatures, or 2 medium or smaller creatures. The barrier improves to shield from airborne attacks. At 3 mana you can target huge creatures, 2 large creatures, or 3 medium or smaller creatures. The barrier now grants improved cover. At 4 mana you can target up to 4 creatures of any size.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Snow Man
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 1 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Companion, Mana Burn, Frost, Upcast Action: Standard
You sculpt snow into a more friendly shape, and your new friend does his best to aid you. A snow man is an elemental that shares all of your ability scores, AC and saves. He has half of your max hp and 20+CL poise. He shares your LvL, but is always treated as a minion.
He cannot wield weapons, and his only form of attack is a single snowball Thrown attack every turn that deals 2d4 frost dmg. If there is no snow present, he must take 3 true damage to throw this snowball. He has a 30 land speed, but when not moving along snowy or icy surfaces, his speed is 15.You mana burn equal to the mana spent on this ability. When the snow man is destroyed, or when the spell ends, the mana burn is removed (but it does not restore current mana).Upcast - Deals an additional d4 frost damage per mana spent.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Snowball
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 1 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Frost Action: Standard
You toss a snowball at a creature, aiming for their weak points. Make a ranged attack that does 2d8+CL (9+CL) frost damage. They also suffer one of the following effects (fort negates).
Eyes - Creature has blurred vision for 1 round.
Mouth - Creature is staggered for 1 round.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Chill Metal
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 2 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Frost, Concentration Action: Standard
Rapidly chill a metallic object. If it is not currently attended, it automatically happens. Creatures that touch this item for whatever reason are made Clumsy 1 by rapidly spreading frost.
If the object is attended, then the creature can choose to drop the object as an instant action to negate the effects of the spell. If they do not drop the object or cannot, such as with metal armor, the creature takes (CL) frost damage and making them Clumsy 1 at the start of each of their turns and the item cannot be separated from them until heat is applied or you cease concentration.You can also use this spell to target a creature that is made of metal, functioning as though they cannot drop the object.Sometimes creatures have features that rely on heated metal. Such features are disabled while they are affected by this spell.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Creeping Ice
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 2 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Frost, Concentration, Persistent Action: Standard
You drain the heat from the air, coating an area in frost. The radius of the AoE increases by 10 feet each round on your turn. Creatures in the AoE at the time of casting or that enter/end their turn in the AoE take 2d8+CL (9+CL) cold damage and are staggered for 1 round (fort negates stagger).

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Powder Snow
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 2 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Concentration, Upcast Action: Standard
Snowflakes permeate the air, chilling creatures to the bone. The spell leaves behind a cloud that persistently inflicts weakness 5 to frost damage to all creatures without frost resistance in the cloud.Your allies gain frost resistance while within the area of powder snow.Upcast - Per each additional mana spent, increase the weakness the spell inflicts by 2, and increase its radius by 5 ft.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Glacial Advance
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 3 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Frost, Elusive Action: Standard
Unless your speed is 0, rapidly advance forward in a straight line riding along a tiny glacier, dealing 4d8+CL (18+CL) frost damage and an equal amount of poise damage (reflex halves). If a creature is poise broken from this, they are pushed 15 ft away from the line in a direction of your choosing.
The area of the spell becomes icy, causing creatures that move through it to fall prone unless they treat it as difficult terrain or roll acrobatics to Balance. It melts in 3 rounds, 1 if it is particularly warm, or never if it is particularly cold.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Ice Beam
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 3 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Frost Action: Standard
Fire a ray of ice at a foe. Make a ranged attack. It deals 4d8+CL (18+CL) cold damage and makes them frosty and entangled on hit. If they are already frosty or entangled, they are instead entombed. Creature can Breakout as a swift action to escape entangle, or as a standard action if entombed.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Icy Spears
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 3 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Frost Action: Standard
You jam your staff into the ground and thin streams of ice advance towards your foes. Choose three creatures within 15 ft of each other. A series of pointed ice spears erupt from the ground directly beneath them, dealing 4d8+CL (18+CL) frost damage, as well as entangling them (reflex halves damage and negates entangle). Target can Breakout as a swift action.
Pass or fail, the spaces occupied by the spears are considered impassible terrain until they are destroyed or melted. A successful reflex save also means the creature can choose any space within 5 ft of the spell effect to move to elusive. Larger creatures create more impassible terrain and dodge farther.If there are multiple creatures in the same space, you can target the larger creature and hit all creatures in the space, but you cannot target both the creatures to double up on damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Snowscape
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 3 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Recharge, Weather Action: 1 minute
A bunch of clouds roll in and start to deposit large amounts of snow. Temperatures decrease and the area of the spell becomes difficult terrain after 1 minute. Certain gear can allow you to traverse snow unimpeded. Creatures cannot see beyond 100 ft.If you cast this spell in an area where snow is normally impossible, incredibly unlikely or out of season, the spells duration decreases to 1 minute.All weather inducing spells do not function underground.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Blizzard
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 4 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Frost, Air, Upcast Action: Standard
Pelt your foes with a wave a frigid air in a wide area. Creatures take 5d8+CL (22+CL) cold damage and makes them frosty and entangled (fort halves dmg and negates entangle). If they are already frosty or entangled, they are instead entombed. Creature can Breakout as a swift action to escape entangle, or as a standard action if Upcast - Increase the size of the cone by 10 ft for each additional mana spent.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Snap Back
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 1 God Mode⏰
Tags: Elusive Action: StandardReverse time ever so slightly, only doing so for 1 particular creature. They move back to the position they were in at the start of their last turn. If used on an enemy (will negates).If you are in combat, it has no effect on a creature that has not acted in combat.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Steal Years
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 1 God Mode⏰
Tags: Concentration Action: StandardYou cause a creature to age rapidly and then you use that energy to bolster yourself. The target looks superficially old and you appear superficially in your prime, or even younger.
The target is fatigued. As long as they are fatigued from this spell, you can spend an immediate action to Reroll a d20 roll.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Tardiness
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 1 God Mode⏰ Tags: - Action: Standard
Delay a creature so that way their spot in initiative is moved to be dead last (will negates). If the creature has already acted in this round, it does not get an additional turn.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Time Bomb
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 1 God Mode⏰
Tags: Force Action: StandardYou cause a rapidly ticking down unstable looking clock to appear above a creatures head. At the end of that creature's turn, it explodes, dealing 2d8+CL (9+CL) force damage to all enemies within 10 ft (reflex halves dmg).You can place this time bomb on an ally or an enemy. The time bomb never damages allies.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Blink
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 2 God Mode⏰
Tags: Buff, Teleportation, Recharge Action: Swift
You sporadically blink out of the mortal plane into a private demiplane. At the end of your turn, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, you blink out of existence, putting you in stasis until the start of your turn. When you reappear, the spell ends.This spell cannot be used in consecutive turns.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: On the Clock
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 2 God Mode⏰
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard
Cause magic circle that resembles the face of a clock to appear on a surface. As long as you concentrate, enemies treat this area as difficult terrain, even if they attempt to jump/fly over it. Allied movement through this area is elusive.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Portal Jump
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 2 God Mode⏰
Tags: Teleportation Action: SwiftA portal opens up beneath you, bringing you to the target location. You cannot move, but you may take your turn from your new position. At the end of your turn, you fall back into the portal and return to the initial position.
Other creatures cannot pass through your portal, even when they prepare actions.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Borrowed Time
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 3 God Mode⏰
Tags: Recharge Action: Free
Borrow some time from your future self. Gain an additional swift action, but you lose your swift action next turn. You can choose to Mana Burn 3 to not consume your swift action next turn.Can only be used once a turn.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Fast Forward
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 3 God Mode⏰
Tags: Recharge Action: StandardThe creature you target moves at incredible speed, allowing them to immediately take an additional turn after yours. This does not affect their position in initiative.
On the creatures next turn they are dazed.A creature cannot be the target of this spell for 1 minute after being affected by it.
The magic of this spell is a bit unstable and can sometimes go overboard. After the daze ends, an affected creature must make a DC 8 luck check or age 1 year.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Multiverse Theory
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 3 God Mode⏰
Tags: Companion, Recharge Action: Standard
You call out into the multiverse your own name, and you answer the call. A version of yourself from an alternate timeline appears before you to speak to you or aid you with tasks. This alternate version of you does not have access to its mana pool, is Siphoned, cannot attack and has 5 hp.
The primary use of this spell is to give you a different perspective on things. It can give you a +2 bonus to skill checks, as though using the aid action, and it can do simple item interactions, such as pulling levers or lifting things. Because of how different your dimension is from theirs, they cannot perform tasks on their own.If this alternate version of yourself ever takes damage, you also take that damage, ignoring any temp hp you have. If the alternate you is out of your sight for longer than a minute, it disappears.If you cast this spell again, the previous alternate you disappears.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Switcheroo
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 3 God Mode⏰
Tags: Teleportation Action: StandardYou can target any combination of 2 enemies, allies and unattended objects of up to roughly humanoid size. You target allies and objects freely. If you target an enemy (will negates).

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Dimension Door
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 4 God Mode⏰
Tags: Teleportation, Concentration Action: StandardTouch a mostly flat solid surface and cause a incomplete portal to appear on it. At any point after as a standard action, you can touch another solid surface within 120 feet of the original and turn the portal on. For as long as you concentrate, creatures can walk into one portal and appear out of the other.You can see through the portal as though it were a window leading to its destination.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Retro Visions
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 4 God Mode⏰
Tags: Concentration, Recharge Action: StandardYou gaze into the past of the location you stand. You can make weeks, months, or even years pass by within minutes, but you always intuitively have a sense of how far back into the past are. You can see and hear events as they occurred. Things that are visually striking or loud are blips on your radar that give pause and allow you to watch in real time. Otherwise you need to have a roundabout idea of when the event happened.The radius of the spell represents how far you can move around while observing.
You can freely travel (5*CL) years back into the past looking for anomalies. If you have the exact date of an event, you can go twice as far back.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Slow Time
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 4 God Mode⏰
Tags: Recharge Action: Standard
Cause time to stop almost completely for all creatures other than you. Everything else in the universe is essentially in Stasis until this effect ends. You can spend a standard action to move an unattended object you would normally be able to manipulate (with great difficulty), but other than that, your options are limited for what to do with your extra turn to things that do not affect the rest of the world.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Hostile Teleportation
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 5 God Mode⏰
Tags: Teleportation Action: Standard
Choose any creature and teleport it anywhere within the spells range. If the creature is an enemy it also makes them clumsy 2 (will negates teleportation).

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Inner Sanctum
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 5 God Mode⏰
Tags: Teleportation, Concentration Action: 1 minute
Focus: Tuning Fork
Create a portal that brings you to your own private dimension (aka demiplane). The first time you go to this dimension, it is empty, and the tuning fork used as the focus attunes to this plane. Every time you cast this spell after the first, you come back to this dimension.The range, concentration and teleportation aspects of this spell refer to the portal you create to get to your inner sanctum. The portal acts as a window between the 2 dimensions, and stays open as long as you concentrate. Whenever you exit your inner sanctum, you always appear from where you entered it.The sanctum itself is a large empty void filled with a dark clay-like substance. Using your mind alone, you can form this clay into the shape of anything you like, such as furniture, statues, trees etc. This substance always has a texture of sturdy but malleable clay. It cannot create living things or complex objects like clocks, only facsimiles of such things. The substance always has a dark, almost space-like color to it. You cannot bring this substance out of your sanctum, but you can freely bring real objects in and out of it.The sanctum's dimensions are 100x100x100 ft.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Chronobreak
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 6 God Mode⏰
Tags: Force, Teleportation, Recharge, Healing, Contingent Action: Instant
While this technique is prepared a ghostly afterimage of yourself mimics your actions and movement, but at a delay of several seconds. It is Invisible unless you are in combat.At any point while you can take standard actions, you can choose to revert back to the time your afterimage represents. You return back to the position you were in at the beginning of your last turn.
When you do, you burst in magical force, dealing 7d8+CL (31+CL) force damage to all enemies (reflex halves). You also restore 3d8+CL (13+CL) hp and cleanse all non-permanent status effects.Pro Tip I recommend using a token to refer to the position you were in, updating it at the start of each of your turns.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Blessing of Goom
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄 Tags: Prepared Action: -
You exude an aura that allows creatures to exist in worlds they are unaccustomed to. Every creature that can see you (or sense you) gains the amphibious quality, allowing them to comfortably adapt to either land or sea, no matter which they normally prefer. Sea creatures gain a 30 ft land speed and land creatures gain a 30 ft swim speed.
This quality persists for as long as they stay near you, but it does not immediately disappear. The boon persists for (10*CL) minutes after the creature cannot see you.
Most places of worship dedicated to Shroomlette🍄 are persistently affected by this aura.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Bubble
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Water, Concentration Action: StandardBlow a bubble large enough to carry the target(s) of the spell. The bubble can carry any amount of weight, and can even hold sharp objects without popping. The bubble trails behind you, matching your speed, automatically avoiding obstacles and bouncing against surfaces. You can toggle whether the bubble follows you on and off as a free action.The only way the bubble can be popped is ceasing concentration, dispel magic or a creature spending a standard action to poke the bubble.Upcast 3 - The bubble carries up to 10x10x10 of space At 5 mana, the bubble carries up to 15x15x15 of space

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Bubble Break
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Concentration, Water Action: Standard
You blow a big bubble. Affected creature is trapped inside of a bubble for 3 rounds (reflex negates). The bubble is completely indestructible and cannot be popped, moved or altered in any way from the inside. Trapped creatures are free to take any actions they please, the only restriction being that they cannot affect creatures outside of the bubble. They can use Teleportation to escape or use the reprieve to heal and buff.The reverse is also true: Creatures outside of the bubble cannot affect creatures inside of the bubble without first popping it. Bubbles can only be popped by taking 1 pierce damage.Because of the defensive properties of the bubble, hitting allies with it to protect them is a viable strategy. Allies do not need to roll a reflex save. They can choose to be affected by the spell or not, even while defeated.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Gooball
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Concentration Action: Swift
Your throat swells as your mouth fills with bile. You spit a glob of goo at a creature as a ranged attack roll. Their speed is reduced by 15. A creature can remove this goo automatically as a standard action, or they can Breakout with athletics.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Message in a Bottle
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Teleportation, Water Action: StandardYou take a bottle and you think of somebody that you have met personally and know by name you place it into a source of water: A bucket, a lake, a toilet, as long as the bottle can be submerged, it counts. This bottle disappears and then appears near the creature you thought of and floats towards them in a bubble. If the creature is near no suitable water source, then it only appears when the creature gets nearby one. After (presumably) reading the message, the creature can write their own message and send the bottle back to you.Anything that can reasonably fit into a tiny bottle can also be included. This spell does not function across planes.This spell does not require line of sight.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Splatter
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Concentration Action: StandardSpit a slimy ball at the ground that splatters on impact. Creatures in the spells area at the time of casting, or that walk into the spells area are affected by it.Choose one:
Greasy - Creatures are knocked down (reflex/acrobatics negates). Treating the grease as difficult terrain while moving through it prevents the creature from being knocked down.
Gooey - Creatures are entangled (fort negates). Athletics as a swift action to remove snare.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Stick Together
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Prepared Action: -Your skin oozes a gooey substance. Whenever you touch a willing creature (free action), your initiative now matches theirs. This does not give you an additional turn, but you can use any movement you have left to ride into battle with the touched creature. Simply by touching them, you can allow a creature of any size to mount you as though you were appropriately sized. You ignore their weight as though it were your own. Any effects that create forced movement automatically moves all attached creatures if you are affected, and have no effect on mounted creatures if you aren't affected.If you attach to multiple creatures, you all must choose one creature's initiative to attach to.You can also use the carry action without making allies clumsy.By applying a solvent or making an athletics check (spell dc) as a standard action you can be forcefully separated. The caster can choose to release stuck creatures at any time as a free action.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Mushroom Dance
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description: Level 2 Goomshroom🍄 Tags: - Action: 3 roundsChoose an adjacent creature to start dancing around. If you remain adjacent to the creature for the entire cast time, you learn about their lifestyle by gleaning one of three general categories.Sin - They kill, lie, cheat, steal or deal with demons/undeadNeutral - They have no strong tendencies towards sin or virtue, or roughly equal measures of bothVirtuous - They are honest. They save the lives of innocents and lend aid to the weak and downtrodden"Mushroom dance. Mushroom dance. What could it mean?"

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Nap Time
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 2 Goomshroom🍄 Tags: - Action: Standard
You inflict a wave of drowsiness on a creature, causing it to fall asleep (will reduces to Drowsy).

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Osmosis
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 2 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Concentration Action: StandardAs long as you maintain concentration and contact with a body of written text, you can continue to absorb information from it. You can effectively summarize a book without even opening it at a rate of 10 standard pages a minute, even if you don't understand it's language.If the text is encoded, you only interpret its literal meaning. This spell allows you to get the gist of anything written in a secret language.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Overflow
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 2 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Water, Concentration Action: Standard
You cause a hemisphere of water to suddenly form in an area. This water has no inherently negative effects, but Aquatic Combat can be a problem for some and a boon for others.Upcast - By spending 4 mana, the diameter of the sphere increases to 25ft.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Aqueous Orb
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 3 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Water, Concentration, Persistent Action: StandardYou open a portal to the elemental planes to generate a large size (10x10 ft) orb of water. Immediately upon casting the spell, and as a swift action each turn, you can move the orb up to 30 ft in a straight line. If the orb moves through a creature's space, then it is carried along for the ride and made wet (reflex negates).When picked up or at the end of each turn it is carried, creatures take 2d8+CL (9+CL) poise damage and are made clumsy 2. Spell DC athletics as a swift action to escape.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Bubble Breath
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 3 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Water, Concentration Action: StandardYou blow a bunch of bubbles. Affected creatures are trapped inside of a bubble for 3 rounds (reflex negates). The bubble is completely indestructible and cannot be popped, moved or altered in any way from the inside. Trapped creatures are free to take any actions they please, the only restriction being that they cannot affect creatures outside of the bubble. They can use teleportation to escape or use the reprieve to heal and buff.The reverse is also true: Creatures outside of the bubble cannot affect creatures inside of the bubble without first popping it. Bubbles can only be popped by taking 1 pierce damage.Because of the defensive properties of the bubble, hitting allies with it to protect them is a viable strategy. Allies do not need to roll a reflex save. They can choose to be affected by the spell or not, even while defeated.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Dog Pile
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 3 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Elusive Action: Standard
Cover the ground underneath your foe in sticky goo, entangling them for 1 round (reflex reduces to -15 speed).Your allies are magnetized to this enemy. Any allies can move 30 ft closer to a creature targeted by this spell as an instant action.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Rain Dance
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 3 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Recharge, Weather Action: StandardYou dance a jig. After you complete your dance, clouds roll in and it starts to lightly rain after 1 minute. After the spell ends, the weather returns back to what it was before casting.All weather inducing spells do not function underground.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Serenity
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 4 Goomshroom🍄 Tags: - Action: Standard
You compel the enemies around you to cease fighting. Enemies are pacified (will negates). They get a new save against this effect each round.If you or one of your allies ally harms a pacified enemy, the effect ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Fairy Ring Retreat
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 6 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Teleportation Action: 1 minuteYou conjure up an extra-dimensional meadow that can be accessed from a single entrance on the plane from which the spell was cast. The entry point looks like a circle of toadstools enclosing a 10ft circle. The meadow itself is a one mile radius. Only those you designate can enter through the portal. You can designate a creature by carving its name into a special tree inside of the meadow. As a standard action you can banish a creature from your dimension.Once a visitor has passed through the entry point, they find themselves in an idyllic twilight meadow decorated with mushrooms surrounded by an impassable grove. The atmosphere is clean, fresh, and warm.The caster can configure the meadow into any shape desires with rolling hills and flowing rivers. The place is comfortable and temperate. The trees can provide enough food to sustain 20 people a day. A staff of 10 spectral animal or fey-like servants wait upon all who enter. They can perform simple tasks and can go anywhere in the meadow.Since the place can be entered only through its special portal, outside conditions do not affect the meadow, nor do conditions inside it pass to the plane beyond.A caster can only have one instance of this spell active at once. If they cast the spell again, it only moves the portal. Because this is a physical tangible location, things can be brought in and out of the portal. Like all extra-dimensional spaces, creatures can use plane shift (wild card 4) to teleport directly into the plane.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Bush
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 1 Earth Mother🍃 Tags: - Action: Swift
You cause a bunch of tall grass to spring up. This space is overgrown and is considered difficult terrain. It also provides cover to any attacks made into or through it. Despite being only a 5x5x5 ft patch of dense brush, a creature of an size can fit inside of it.
You can take the hide action in or behind this bush as a free action the turn you cast this spell.The bush withers and fades after 1 minute, or 3 rounds if the environment couldn't otherwise sustain it. Dealing any slashing or fire damage to it destroys the bush.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Hibernate
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 1 Earth Mother🍃 Tags: - Action: Standard
You cause a creature to enter a catatonic state akin to a deep sleep. Nothing short of taking damage can awaken the creature from its slumber. The creature gains the benefit of resting and is staggered for 1 minute after waking up if it slept the full duration.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Pollinate
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 1 Earth Mother🍃
Tags: Poison, upcast Action: StandardShower a foe with a thick cloud of toxic plant dust. Creature takes d6+CL (3+CL) poison damage. The powder also has an additional effect (fort negates).Choose One: Poison Powder - Creature takes an additional (3+CL) poison damage at the end of its turns (fort ends effect).
Rage Powder - Creature is taunted by you for one round.The spell instead deals 2d6+CL (7+CL) poison damage. You gain new options.Choose One:
Sleep Powder - Creature is put Asleep (fort reduces to Drowsy).
Stun Spore - Creature is dazed for 1 turn. Deadly Poison Powder - Creature takes an additional 2d6+CL (7+CL) poison damage at the end of its turns (fort save after damage is taken ends effect).

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Speak with Animals
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 1 Earth Mother🍃
Tags: Prepared Action: -
You can speak with Beasts🐻 as though you share a common language. They are able to much better articulate their feelings as though they possessed the intellect of a simple humanoid, but their instincts, desires and attitude toward you remain largely the same.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Tree Shape
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 1 Earth Mother🍃
Tags: poly, true Action: StandardTransform into a young living tree, a large shrub or dead tree. The type of tree, as well as its appearance, is under your control. While in tree form, you can observe the world around you just as if you were in your normal form. You can dismiss tree shape as a free action.You get a +10 bonus to stealth/disguise while in tree form and can use either skill to evade detection, otherwise people will think something is fishy about this tree. You cannot move or take any actions while in tree form, but you can speak.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Wild Growth
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description: Level 1 Earth Mother🍃 Tags: - Action: StandardEnemies within the spell's area have plants suddenly grow in the chinks of their armor and around their feet, tangling their joints. They have their speed reduced by 15. The plants can be destroyed by dealing 1 slashing or fire damage to them, or 10 damage of any other type.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Ants in your Pants
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description: Level 2 Mother Earth🍃 Tags: - Action: StandardYou launch a stream of ants that get your opponent MOVING (reflex reduces effect to only damage for 1 round). They take a (3+CL) pierce damage at the start of their turn. They must start each of their turns by moving 10 ft in a random direction. Being immersed or drenched in water, taking any AoE damage or something else suitable can reduce the duration of this spell or remove the ants completely. The ants automatically disperse if the foe is defeated.
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.sourcePath: Techniques/Magical Techniques/Mother Earth/level-2/Ants in your Pants.md

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Arboreal Army
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 2 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard
All the nearby plants snap to attention, ready to receive orders. As a swift action each turn, you can command a nearby inanimate plant to Bully a nearby creature by bending its trunk or swinging its branches. Its bonus is your CL. It gets Advantage if the creature is currently inside of the attacking tree, bush etc.
The spell name assumes trees, but it can be any type of vegetation, even the grass someone stands in. What the Reach of the plant is, is based on its size. Trees are generally pretty tall, giving them ~15 feet of reach while bushes, tall grass and such have much less.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Fairy Dust
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 2 Mother Earth🍃 Tags: - Action: StandardYou borrow some fairy dust from the fey wilds and toss it at your enemy, with a variety of effects.Choose One:
Sparkles - Coat creatures in brilliant sparkly particles. Attacks made against a creature covered in sparkles have Seeking. Sparkly creatures have a -10 stealth penalty. Flashy - The dust sparkles so brightly that it blinds creatures for 1 minute (reflex reduces to blurred vision). At the end of a creature's turn, they can make an additional save to reduce the condition. Blind>blurred vision>normal.
Rainbow pattern - Targets are fascinated for 1 minute (will negates).

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Fetch
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 2 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Concentration Action: Standard
Spell Focus: 1 Stick, Ball or Similar Object
You wiggle an object at a creature in range and toss it to a space within 30 feet of it and you. The creature must spend all of its actions to retrieve this object and bring it back to you (will negates). If you ever get more than 30 feet away from the object, you are no longer visible to the target or the creature successfully brings it back to you, the spell ends. If there is something that impedes the creature's movement, it can reasonably spend its actions dealing with this obstacle (a wall of sheep, creature is grappled etc).If the creature does not retrieve the item after the first turn, then it gets an additional save at the end of each of its turn to shake off the compulsion to fetch.
This spell’s DC is 2 higher when targeting Beasts🐻.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Nourish
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 2 Mother Earth🍃 Tags: - Action: StandardYou infuse plants with life, with a variety of effects.Choose one:
Cultivate (recharge) - You cause a single dying plant to become vibrant, putting it on the correct path for future growth. If you Mana Burn, you can even accelerate its growth one stage. Seed>seedling>sapling>adult.
If you target creatures that are Plants🪴, you can instead grant them 5+CL Temp HP. This gives the spell the Healing tag. Fertilize (recharge) - Tracts of land become more habitable for plants, enriching soil and removing contaminants, assuring future growth. You target 1 square mile. Contaminators might not be too happy…
Constrict - An enemy within 30 ft must roll a reflex save or be entangled. Creature can spend a standard action to breakout.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Power of the Sun
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 2 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Psychic, Fear, Dismissible, Persistent Action: StandardYou temporarily instill great fear of the sun to a creature. Every turn the creature starts its turn in an area lit with sunlight or moves into a sun-lit area, it takes 2d6 (7) psychic damage and is shaken 1.
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.sourcePath: Techniques/Magical Techniques/Mother Earth/level-2/Power of the Sun.md

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Queen Bee
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 2 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Buff Action: SwiftYou summon a swarm of bees that intuitively follow your orders without need for speech. The bees won’t enter water. You must maintain a tether to them using the swarm almost like an additional limb that if separated, immediately disappears.
You take a -5 penalty to +Stealth checks and you have a hover speed of 30.The bees hover around you and can perform a few sets of tasks... Interact (action varies) - The bees can perform tasks with a high degree of precision such as picking up objects and opening doors. They can perform any task you could perform with your hands (including skills like SoH) at a range of 20 feet
Sting (standard) Venom - Automatically deal (2+CL) pierce damage to a single creature within 10 feet. They are also staggered for 1 round (fort negates). Protect (immediate) - The bees move to block an attack, giving you a +4 bonus to ac or +4 bonus to a reflex save. This subtracts 5 rounds from the duration of the spell

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Wall of Sheep
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 2 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard
You summon a flock of sheep that quickly pile up on top of each other to form a fluffy impassable barrier. If you summon the wall in a space occupied by a creature, the creature can choose which side of the wall they end up on. The sheep are completely impervious to all forms of attack unless it is a +Combat Maneuver. The wall has 20 poise. When poise broken, a 5x5 section of the wall falls apart and the sheep that occupied that space disappear. If the creature who broke through the wall was larger, the hole is also large enough for them to fit (10x10 large, 15x15 huge etc).
In order to interact with the wall, it requires maneuvering through the unruly sheep. You must beat the casters spell DC to balance on or climb the wall.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Floristry
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 3 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Companion, Upcast Action: Standard
You cause a vibrant thorn spitter to sprout from the ground. It does not have access to any special attacks. It mindlessly shoots your enemies for the spells duration, focusing a target you choose when you cast, or the nearest creature if the first target leaves the flowers range. It loses 10 hp each turn. When it is defeated, it wilts and crumbles to dust.If the flower is summoned in an area that otherwise wouldn’t sustain it, such as underground or in stone, it loses 25 hp at the end of each of its turn.Upcast 4 - The flower gains access to its special attacks.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Mad Monkeys
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 3 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Companion, sonic Action: Standard???

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Oaken Summons
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 3 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Companion, Healing, Recharge Action: Standard
You grow bark on the exterior of your skin and to summon a treant to your aid. Gain (3*CL) temp hp when you cast this spell. The treant understands druidic and does its best to aid you.When you lose this temp hp, the treant disappears.This spell can only be cast 1/minute.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Persistent Pranksters
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 3 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard
You summon a group of playful fairies that fly around the battlefield and bother your enemies. They do not have any hp, but they do have 25+CL poise. If they are ever poise broken, they disappear.
On your turn they can fly at a speed of 30 feet and make a +Combat Maneuver against a creature. The result of the combat maneuver is always 20+CL. You can direct them to focus on specific creatures.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Sunny Day
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 3 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Recharge, Weather Action: 1 minute
The clouds part and the sun shines brightly. All plant creatures in the area gain +2 Attack and FH 1.You cannot cast this spell at night.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Leech Seed
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 4 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Healing, Necrotic, Concentration Action: Standard
Shower a foe with seeds that take root inside of their skin (reflex negates). At the end of your turn, they take (5+CL) necrotic damage and you recover hp equal to the damage if you are within 30 ft. As an immediate action, you can divert the flow of energy to bestow this healing upon another creature within 30 ft of you.If neither you nor an ally is within 30 ft of the seeded creature, the damage does not occur.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: String Shot
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 4 Mother Earth🍃 Tags: - Action: Standard
Shoot a precise string of webbing/vines at a creature. They are entangled and you may slam them against the ground into any position within the spells range to deal 5d6+CL (17+CL) crush damage (fort negates damage and repositioning effect). Creature can remove this automatically as a swift action or Breakout as a swift action to remove entangled.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Voice of the Forest
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 4 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Upcast, Scrying Action: 10 minutesNote: This spell can only be cast in a densely forested area (such as a rainforest or woodland).You enter a trance while you slowly become one with nature over the cast time. Once you have completed the cast time, your spirit separates from your body and it is free to wander and explore.There is no limit on on how long you can remain in this trance, but staying in for many hours leaves your body hungry and tired. While in spirit form you have a sixth sense for detecting water sources and when the forest is being significantly damaged within the spells area. Someone cutting down a tree isn't enough to trigger this, but a large scale lumber organization cutting away is. When you detect one of these things, you can appear overhead to observe. Other creatures cannot see you unless they can also see invisible creatures or ghosts.
At any point, you can decide to speak. You can make your voice soft or loud and you can make it seem to emanate all around the area, giving you advantage on +Intimidation😱. You can also cause any of the nearby creatures to exhibit any behavior natural to them, such as being completely silent, making noise or perching overhead. They won't engage with dangerous situations at your request.Upcast 6 - The AoE of the spell increases to 100 miles.
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.sourcePath: Techniques/Magical Techniques/Mother Earth/level-4/Voice of the Forest.md

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Rebirth
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description: Level 5 Mother Earth🍃 Tags: - Action: 1 minute Material: 5k worth of rare herbs and spicesThis spell can be used by creatures hoping to change themselves.After the cast time completes, the creature falls unconscious to dream about its new self as a cocoon forms around them. 24 hours pass and they awaken in their new form. The creature can change its race, its gender and its physical appearance to its liking. The creature has complete control over all features such as racial traits, height, age, skin color etc as long as it falls within reasonable parameters for the race.If the cocoon is destroyed, the spell fails and the creature inside is killed.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Savage Roar
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 5 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: Standard
Let out a powerful roar to inspire savagery and anger in your allies. All allied creatures make a melee attack against a creature within reach. Beasts🐻 and any creature that can understand druidic get a +4 to Attack.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Solar Eclipse
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 6 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Light, Concentration, Recharge, Weather Action: 1 minute
You alter the composition of the heavens in such a way to mimic the effect of a solar eclipse. All creatures caught in the radius of the spell when it is first cast without proper eye protection are blinded for the duration of the spell (reflex reduces to Blurred Vision). Creatures in the spells radius take a -4 penalty on +Perception👀 even if they aren't blinded.What constitutes protection either covers the eyes completely, or are glasses specifically designed to block the powerful light of the eclipse. The caster can create a pair of these glasses for 100g.
Solar eclipse ends automatically if Lunar Eclipse is cast in its range, cancelling each other out.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.title: Foxdie
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.description: Level 1 Nack🎉 Tags: - Action: StandardYou summon a relatively average looking fox at a point you can see. At your command, you can cause it to make noises typical fox. After which, it explodes violently in a tiny fiery mushroom cloud.This does not cause damage to anybody or anything, nor does it dirty anything.If you do not cause it to make noise, it disappears within 1 minute.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.title: Pants
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.description: Level 1 Nack🎉 Tags: - Action: StandardYou undo belts, buttons and zippers on a creature's pants as they are forcefully removed and folded into a pile next to them.This spell does not work when used against heavily armored targets.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.title: X-ray
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.description:
Level 1 Nack🎉
Tags: Buff Action: SwiftWhile this spell is active your eyes gain and unusual swirly quality to them that overlaps over your usual features. The spell allows you to see through clothing/armor while it is worn by a creature.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.title: Big Head Mode
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.description:
Level 2 Nack🎉
Tags: poly, chimeric Action: StandardYou increase a creatures head to be double its original size, doing little more than inconveniencing and embarrassing them (fort negates). A creature cannot be the target of this effect more than once each day.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.title: Pornportions
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.description:
Level 3 Nack🎉
Tags: poly, chimeric Action: StandardYou cause a creature to have incredibly exaggerated proportions, focusing primarily on the sex characteristics. Women get incredibly curvy or impossibly thin, men get enormous members, or you can mix and match features of the creature to match a particular taste. This spell cannot give creatures parts they do not have, only alter the ones they do.Get advantage on sex checks...If you roll that kind of thing.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.title: Kaijumorph
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.description:
Level 4 Nack🎉
Tags Concentration Action: StandardYou grow to be 100 ft tall, proportions changing as appropriate. This does not give you extra carry weight, strength, or destructive capabilities. It does not even increase your reach. You still possess the same exact weight.If you are targeted with a harmful effect, take damage or cease concentration, you immediately shrink back to your normal size.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.title: Power Word Fun
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.description:
Level 5 Nack🎉 Tags: - Action: StandardSpecial: This spell can only be cast while the caster is deprived of a standard action or otherwise unable to cast spells.
You temporarily and partially negate CC on yourself and nearby creatures. For creatures who are stunned, dazed, in stasis, in time out etc. This spell does not end the cc, but it allows creatures who are affected by them to do anything that could reasonably be considered "not mechanically beneficial" such as singing, dancing, juggling (unless these actions could somehow be mechanically beneficial) or casting a Nack spell. This does not allow movement, attacks, defensive features etc. that you would normally be deprived of. This is a meme. If you try to anyway, you are put in time out until combat ends.Any creature in range, regardless if they are CC'd, adds extra flair in all their actions, or emotes like they're in a video game. Even if they try not to, they can't help but bob their head and tap their feet.The caster can immediately use any other Nack spell as a free action.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.title: Awaken
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.description:
Level 6 Nack🎉
Tags: Recharge Action: StandardYou give a plant or animal sentience. Its intelligence increases to +0. If it is a plant, it gains a 30ft speed and the ability to uproot without killing itself. Creatures gain big goofy eyes and a mouth to speak with. They learn common.What happens after that is largely based up to it. Certain types of creatures may have certain mannerisms. Predators tend to be more aggressive, for instance. Beavers are more industrious. They can look upon their past and present with great clarity, recognizing mistreatment and caring.This spell has a 1 week cooldown.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Blight
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 1 Necromancy💀
Tags: Necrotic, Upcast Action: Standard
You briefly allow a creature to experience the joy of decomposition. They take 2d8+CL (9+CL) necrotic damage and are sickened 2 (fort halves dmg and negates sickened).Upcast - For each additional mana you spend, deal an additional d8 damage. If you spend at least 3, increases the sickened duration to 1 hour.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Bone Shaker
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 1 Necromancy💀
Tags: Necrotic Action: StandardNote: The spell cannot target creatures that are BONELESS. A successful monster lore check against a creature reveals if it has bones.The spell's effect varies depending on what you target.Living Creature - The creature takes 2d8+CL (9+CL) necrotic damage and is staggered for one round (fort haves damage and negates stagger).Willing or Mindless Undead - The creature spends an immediate action to make an attack against a creature within reach or move 30 feet in a direction of your choosing.Unwilling Undead - Functions as willing undead (will negates)

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Call of the Grave
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 1 Necromancy💀
Tags: Upcast, Earth, Concentration Action: Standard
Cause several arms to erupt from the ground and grab onto a creature. The creature is entangled (reflex negates).
The hands share your AC, and have poise equal to their AC. On-hit, when the hands are poise broken, or with a successful Breakout as a standard action (DC=their AC) they retreat back into the ground.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, target an additional creature in range.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Decomposition
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description: Level 1 Necromancy💀 Tags: - Action: StandardYou cause a group of corpses to rapidly experience decomposition, turning in them into skeletons almost instantly. Perfect for cleanly storing in your closet.If cast on an undead creature, they instead take 2d6+CL (7+CL) true dmg. This can happen accidentally if you happen to target an undead buried amongst corpses. If you target multiple undead accidentally, 1 randomly takes the damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Grave Robber
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 1 Necromancy💀
Tags: Prepared Action -You gain an innate sense for when corpses are nearby. You can sense them buried up to 30 feet underground. You can read the text written on tombstones and similar things, even if the text has long since faded. If you can see a corpse, you know what its name was in life.As a standard action, you can reach into the ground and pull out an entire corpse if it is not inside of a container of some sort.
Undead creatures have a visible aura around them unless they are your LvL or higher.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Halt Undead
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 1 Necromancy💀 Tags: - Action: Standard
You command an undead creature to bend to your will, and you will it to stand still. It is entangled (will negates). An intelligent undead creature gets a new save at the end of each of its turns.
If an undead Companion is affected by this spell, you can aid them if they are within 30 ft to free them, barking a new command.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Life Transfer
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 1 Necromancy💀
Tags: Healing, Upcast Action: StandardYou transfer fundamental life energy between yourself and the target. Choose one.Heal
You can inflict drained upon yourself in order to heal the target. You become drained 5 and you heal 10 hp, or remove 5 drain stack from the target.Harm
Alternatively, you can Mana Burn to inflict drained stacks you possess onto another creature. This requires an attack roll and removes 1 drained stack from yourself to inflict it on your target on hit. If you miss, you do not mana burn. You must be drained to use this variant of the spell.Upcast - When you heal, you can increase the number of drained stacks you accumulate by 4 for each additional mana spent. For each stack of additional drain you accumulate, you can remove an additional stack of drain from the target or heal an additional 7 hp.When you harm, each additional mana spent allows you to increase the stacks of drain you pass on to your enemy by 1. You must possess drained stacks equal to the amount you are inflicting.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Mr Skeltal
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 1 Necromancy💀
Tags: Companion] Action: Standard Focus: 1 instrumentRaise a skeleton from a corpse whose only calling is to jam. Give it the instrument used as the focus of this spell and it will play it with a bonus of (CL+2) whenever you ask. When not playing, it follows you around.If you give the skeleton a trumpet, its bonus increases to (CL+4).
Doot.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Animate Dead
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 2 Necromancy💀
Tags: Companion Action: 3 roundsYou lay your hand on a corpse, reanimating it with profane power into a zombie, or tearing the skeleton from its body. The creature is mindless, but it does understand your orders. It will protect you when you are in danger or carry out simple manual labor. Animated dead act on your turn in initiative, meaning they are automatically surprised if you are. If given no orders, they mindlessly follow you.
Defeated Undead💀, Constructs🤖, and Elementals🔥 cannot be targeted by animate dead. If a creature has multiple types and includes one of these types, it cannot be targeted by animate dead.
You Mana Burn equal to the number of total Levels of undead you control with animate dead (minimum 1 per undead). When these undead are defeated, you lose this burn, but mana is not restored.First, choose one of the following
Skeleton - Weakness (crush 2) Zombie - Weakness (slash 2)The spell has complex rules on how this changes the creatures stats.Special: The spell is going to be cast on a wide variety of creatures, some of which don't exactly fit the mold. Certain features you may want to get rid of and keep something from the creature. Some features might be too powerful on certain creatures and should be removed. DM discretion.Ex. The creature is blind and senses only using tremorsense. Keep the tremorsense, don't give night vision.Special: If you die, your undead act instinctively, usually attacking whatever is close at hand at random (including your allies).Special: You can create multiple companion creatures of the same type with this technique.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Bone Cage
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 2 Necromancy💀
Tags: Buff Action: SwiftNote: The spell cannot target creatures that are BONELESS. A successful monster lore check against a creature reveals if it has bones.
You tear the bones out of a corpse and use them to shield yourself. You get +2 AC. If a creature poise breaks you, it can choose to break this bone armor instead of the usual effects.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Gloom Bolt
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 2 Necromancy💀
Tags: Necrotic Action: Standard
You shoot a ray of necrotic energy that interferes with the creature's vision. Make a Ranged Spell Attack that deals 3d8+CL (13+CL) necrotic damage and blinds On-hit for 1 round.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, fire an additional ray at a different creature.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Asphyxiate
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 3 Necromancy💀
Tags: Concentration Action: StandardNote: Because this is a concentration spell, it requires you hold your staff. Because it also detaches a hand, it requires you also have a free hand.
One of your hands detaches and flies over to a creature to choke it and lift it into the air (fort negates). They take 2d6+CL (7+CL) crush damage. The creature is silenced, entangled, cannot ingest consumables and takes the same damage again at the end of each of its turns as long as you stay within 30 ft of them. If the target passes its save, you move more than 30 ft away from the target, or the spells duration expires your hand flies back and reattaches automatically.
Your hand can be targeted using all of your statistics, but it has cover.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Corpse Explosion
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 3 Necromancy💀
Tags: Necrotic, Upcast Action: VariesThe effect, range and cast time of this varies depending on what you target.Allied Undead (Immediate) - You can cast this freely on any undead you control, even in response to one being destroyed. The creature bloats and cracks before bursting, dealing 3d8+CL (13+CL) necrotic damage (reflex halves). This kills the undead.A Corpse (Standard) - You can cast this spell on any corpse. Its range increases to 60 ft, its AoE increases to 10 ft but its cast time increases to a standard action.
Upcast - By spending 5 mana, you can cause the the initial explosion to deal 5d8+CL (22+CL) necrotic damage. In addition, you set off a chain reaction, causing all corpses in the spell's AoE to also explode, and the corpses they effect and so on. A creature can still only be damaged by a single explosion.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Corpse Transposition
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 3 Necromancy💀
Tags: Teleportation Action: SwiftBriefly vanish in a pool of blood before exploding violently out of the target corpse/minion. If you targeted an allied undead, this kills the undead.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Drain Soul
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 3 Necromancy💀
Tags: Healing, Upcast Action: Standard
You borrow a piece of creature's soul. They are drained 10 (fort reduces effect to 10 necrotic damage). You regain 10 hp.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase drain by 5 and healing by 5 (with passed saves instead dealing necrotic damage).

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Going Ghost
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 3 Necromancy💀
Tags: Upcast Action: Standard
Turn Incorporeal until the end of your turn.Upcast 5 - Until the end of your next turn.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Unholy Frenzy
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 3 Necromancy💀 Tags: - Action: Standard
Give your undead companions within the spells area a +4 bonus to Attack this turn.
