Choose one specific creature within range of the spell. All undead under your control rush this target down, moving up to it and making a Simple Attack. If the undead can make ranged attacks, it need not move. This is in addition to whatever actions they take on their turn.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Corpse Possession
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 4 Necromancy💀
Tags: Scrying, Upcast Action: 1 minute
This spell spell functions as animate dead, but changes as follows.It raises the creature as a zombie version of itself. Upon completion, your spirit leaves your body and inhabits the zombified corpse. You can inhabit this corpse indefinitely, and speak through it in the creatures voice, your own, or a raspy mixture of the two.You can choose to no longer inhabit the corpse at any time, returning back to your body and causing the magic animating it to leave. This kills the zombie.While you animate this corpse, any other undead you have animated enter a coma, and reanimate once you return.Upcast 5 - You can choose to animate the corpses of 3 similar creatures at once, such as members of a town guard.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Haunted
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 4 Necromancy💀
Tags: Scrying, Subtle Action: StandardTake a creature or an object for a ride. Detach your spirit from your body, causing it to look like you are napping or have your head in the clouds. Attach your freed spirit to a creature or object within range (will negates against creatures). If the object is worn or possessed by a creature (ha), then you are effectively targeting the creature and it still gets a save.If you are successful, you can swap between using your own senses and the senses of what you are attached to. The creature remains unaware of your presence unless you make it known. You can telekinetically move objects within 30 ft around while haunting. Objects weighing less than 5 pounds can be tossed and objects under 100 lbs can be slowly dragged. You can also telepathically speak to the creature, making your voice sound vague and ghost-like or your own voice.
A creature with arcana or +Religion recognizes the moving objects or voices as a possession with a DC 14 check. By uttering a prayer or drinking Holy Water, the spell immediately ends. You can also choose to end it willingly at any time.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Vile Vigor
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 4 Necromancy💀
Tags: Mana Burn, Healing Action: Standard
You can remove practically any non-Permanent Status ailment at the cost of your own magic. You mana burn to remove it, increasing in amount based on the status ailment.1 - Minor Status - Asleep, bleed, blurred vision, charmed, entangled, fatigued, fascinated, grounded, knocked down, shaken/sicken/clumsy stacks, frosty, wet.2 - Major Status - Bone chilled, ablaze, blinded, confused, envenomed, frightened, staggered, silenced, taunt.3 - Extreme Status - Dazed, pacified, stun, stasis.
You can change the mana burn into drain to cast this spell as a swift action.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Final Hour
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 5 Necromancy💀
Tags: Buff, Curse Action: Swift
A surge of necrotic energy imbues an undead creature, giving it a very noticeable aura. It takes a -5 penalty to +Stealth and becomes Invincible. It is afflicted with a curse that destroys it at the end of its second turn.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Shackles of Pain
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 5 Necromancy💀
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard
You share your pain with another creature, represented by ethereal shackles that connect you two (will negates). While within 60 ft of this creature, you take half damage, and the other half of the damage is transferred to it as true damage. If the creature leaves this range, the shackle breaks.
Spaces moving away from the caster are considered Difficult Terrain to the target.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Beyond Death
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 6 Necromancy💀
Tags: Prepared, Recharge Action: -
When you are defeated or killed, you can choose to spend 6 mana to enter a ghost state. While in this state, you can freely speak, use Supernatural abilities and cast spells, but your speed is 0 and you cannot make Weapon Attacks, Natural Attacks or Unarmed Attacks.At the end of your next turn, your spirit reunites with your body and this effect ends.Your ghost remains tethered to your body. You cannot move on your own without the aid of magic, but other creatures can physically move your body to adjust the position of your ghost.This effect can only happen once each day.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Possession
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 6 Necromancy💀
Tags: Concentration, Recharge Action: Standard
You turn incorporeal and siphon into a creatures mouth to take control of their body (will reduces effect to Staggered for 1 round). On each of your subsequent turns, you can play as that creature using all of its abilities and statistics except hp. In order to use activated abilities, you must have seen the creature use them, or succeed on a +Monster Lore📖 check (DC 15+lvl of creature). If you do not, then you must spend 1 week to accommodate yourself to the new body. Creatures under your control like summons or undead still recognize you as their master.
When you are defeated, dispelled etc, you appear in a space adjacent to the possessed creature and are staggered for 1 round and the creature is drained 3.If cast on a defeated creature, there is no save. Because the spell uses your vitality to sustain the creature, you can immediately stand up and start fighting.
You get a plus +8 bonus to +Disguise checks to pretend to be this creature. You can swap between your voice and the creatures voice at will.The spell cannot be cast again until you rest in your real body. When you rest while possessing a creature, you regain your hp, but no other benefits from resting.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Skelepathy
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 6 Necromancy💀
Tags: Concentration, Recharge Action: StandardNote: The spell cannot target creatures that are BONELESS. A successful monster lore check against a creature reveals if it has bones.Speak directly to a creature's skeleton, setting it free from the tyranny of its fleshy host.
This spell functions as animate dead, but with a few bonuses… You can target creatures that aren't dead (including undead, but not undead that are only bones) Its level is set to the level of the creature the spell is cast on Its max HP is the current HP of the creature at time of casting
It has the +Profession🧑‍🌾 (dance, trumpet) skill (bonus=CL+4)

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Blazing Palm
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description:
Level 1 Prismancy🌈
Tags: Fire Action: Standard
You fire a shining ray to melt your foe. Roll a ranged attack that deals 2d8+CL (9+CL) fire damage. On a hit applies glowing.

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Sacred Flames
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description:
Level 1 Prismancy🌈
Tags: Prepared Action: -Your heat is infused with holy light. Whenever you cast a spell that does fire damage, its damage counts as fire and holy. The spell's tags change as appropriate.

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Flame of Destiny
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description:
Level 2 Prismancy🌈
Tags: Light Action: 1 minuteYou create a stationary bonfire whose flames move in slow motion, and illuminate an area of 100ft. It can be put out like any standard fire.By resting next to the fire and gazing into its flames for at least 10 minutes, your deity shows you visions of a prominent creature that it wants you to defeat or apprehend. This creature is always a similar level to you, and is a leader of some sort at the forefront of operations in opposition to your deity: a necromancer, bandit chief, cult leader etc. This creature is also somewhat close by in terms of proximity, only targeting creatures you can realistically find within a week of travel using your current means of transportation.

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Solar Flare
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description:
Level 2 Prismancy🌈
Tags: Light, Fire, Recharge Action: StandardClose your eyes and unleash a blast of solar energy that deals (CL) fire damage to all creatures and blinds them for 1 round (reflex negates).
If you have High Ground⛰, the DC is 2 higher.

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Blazing Beam
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description:
Level 3 Prismancy🌈
Tags: Fire, Upcast Action: Standard
Fire a beam that magnetizes to Glowing creatures. Make a Ranged Attack. The target takes 4d8+CL (18+CL) fire damage. If they are not glowing, they begin glowing. If they already are glowing, this attack has Seeking and deals an additional 10 damage. This removes the glowing.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, the spell deals an additional d8 dmg.

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Radiance
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description:
Level 3 Prismancy🌈
Tags: Light Actions: StandardYou cause the target of the spell to emanate an exceptionally bright light. The area within 60 ft of the target is bathed in bright light.
You can use the spell effectively as dispel magic against a spell with the dark tag. If you succeed, the light spell consumes the dark.

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Plasma Blade
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description:
Level 4 Prismancy🌈
Tags: Buff, Fire, Light, Concentration Action: SwiftImbue a weapon in hand with searing light, changing its damage to d6+CL (3+CL) Fire damage. It becomes weightless. It gives off bright light within 20 feet.
As part of casting this spell, you may make a simple Spell Attack with this weapon. Every turn after, you can make another simple attack as a swift action. If you make any additional attacks with it, it consumes an additional 4 mana with each swing.
Apply glowing for 1 round On-hit with this weapon.If the plasma blade leaves your possession, this spell ends after one round.

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Rainbow Beam
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description:
Level 5 Prismancy🌈
Tags: Light, Fire Action: Standard
Fire a rainbow that deals 6d8+CL (27+CL) fire damage and applies Glowing to enemies (reflex halves dmg). If the enemy was already glowing, they instead have Disadvantage on all d20 rolls for 1 round.
Instead of harming allies, it grants them a Lucky Rainbow - visible as an aura around them. They may consume this rainbow to Reroll any one attack, save, skill check or ability check within a minute, after which it disappears.A creature may only have one Lucky Rainbow on them at a time. It lasts one minute.Also creates bright light in its area for a round.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Blazing Bulwark
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 1 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire Action: ImmediateSpecial: Must be wielding a shield to cast
As part of casting the spell, take the Block or Shields Up action. The attacker is set ablaze (reflex negates).

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Bouncing Blast
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 1 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire, Upcast Action: StandardYou toss a mote of flame that hungers for more if it successfully consumes its target. Make a
Ranged Spell Attack against a creature that deals 2d8+CL (9+CL) fire damage. If it defeats the creature, it automatically deals the same damage to another creature of your choosing within 30 ft of the target. This can continue indefinitely.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Forbidden Flame
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 1 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire Action: StandardConvert all of your mana into heat with a spark. Cause the air to explode in a creatures face, dealing 2d8+CL (9+CL) fire damage. You automatically spend all of your mana, including any reserves, when you use this technique. For each mana spent beyond the first, increase the spells CL by 1.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Pillar of Flame
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 1 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire, Concentration, Upcast, Persistent Action: StandardIgnite a circle on the ground and cause a pillar of flame to erupt from it. Creatures in the area of the pillar take 2d8+CL (9+CL) fire damage.Upcast - Increase damage by d8 (4) for each additional mana spend. At 3 and 5 mana, create an additional pillar.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Self Immolation
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 1 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire, Buff, Persistent, Upcast Action: SwiftYou light yourself on fire and the fire hungers for things to burn. At the end of your turn, you take 4 fire damage. Whenever a creature is within 5 ft of you, they take 4 fire damage.
Your land speed increases by 5 ft.
Upcast - The damage increases by 2 and your speed increases by 5 per additional mana spent. If you spend at least 3 mana, your movement is elusive.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Soulfire
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 1 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire, Upcast Action: Standard
Your mana ignites and you release this uncontainable energy at an enemy. They take 2d10+CL (11+CL) fire damage (reflex halves). Your Memory decreases by 1, forcing you to choose a technique to forget. If that spell was currently active as a buff or concentration effect, it immediately ends.
This debuff ends when you rest.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d10.Pro Tip: For creatures with innate techniques, consider rendering one of their at will abilities inaccessible.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Boiling Blood
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 2 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Concentration, Fire Action: Standard
Ignite a creatures insides, making them convulse in pain. They are staggered and take (CL) fire damage each round at the start of its turn (fort negates stagger). At the end of each turn, save again.
Creatures that are already ablaze take a -4 penalty to their save.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Flame Cleanse Me
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 2 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Healing Action: Swift
You hold a flame to your chest that burns away your ailments. You take 5 True Damage and remove any non-Permanent Status from yourself.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Hot Streak
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 2 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Buff Action: Swift
Supercharge your staves, decreasing the mana💎 cost of all abilities with the fire tag by 1, but increasing the mana cost of all other mana expenditure by 2.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Backfire
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 3 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire Action: Standard
This spell functions exactly like dispel magic, except when you successfully counterspell or dispel a buff, the creature you target takes 4d8+CL (18+CL) fire damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Fire and Brimstone
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 3 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire, Persistent, Concentration Action: StandardThe flames of hell are unleashed through a portal you open up. A line of hellfire that continues until it hits a solid object deals 3d8+CL (13+CL) fire damage to creatures within. The portal remains open for 3 rounds, continuing to damage creatures that move through it.
Fire created by this spell ignores fire resistance.This spell has great potential for destruction considering its immense AoE and the fact it persists for several rounds, potentially burning holes through creatures and structures alike.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Fire Blast
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 3 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire, Upcast Action: Standard
You throw an enormous ball of fire that attaches to something, then explodes forcefully, dealing 4d8+CL (18+CL) fire damage and knocking down creatures struck (reflex halves dmg and negates knock down).
You can target one specific creature with a ranged spell attack. If you land it, the creature's space is the center of the explosion, and the DC is 2 higher for that creature. If you miss, the fire falls directly down and then explodes when it first impacts a surface.This also destroys flammable undergrowth, sends small objects flying, starts fires, disperses atmospheric conditions, and otherwise causes the effects one would expect from a fiery explosion.Upcast - Every additional mana adds 20 range, and 5 radius.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Hellfire
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 3 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Fire, Upcast Action: Standard
Temporarily borrow some fire from the demon realm, burning yourself in the process. You explode violently dealing 4d8+CL (18+CL) fire damage and setting creatures ablaze (reflex halves dmg and negates ablaze). This spell and the fires it causes ignore fire resistance.
The area of the spell is scorched for 1 minute, causing the land speed of any fiends👿 walking inside of it to increase by 20 for 1 round.You yourself take (CL) fire damage from the burst, and ignore being set ablaze.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, the spell deals an additional d8 (4) dmg.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Fire Snake
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 4 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Persistent, Concentration, Fire, Upcast Action: StandardCause a flaming serpent to erupt from your staff. It moves along the ground 30 feet, capable of bending around obstacles and terrain. It continues to occupy that 30 feet of space, burning any that it passes through, or that pass through it. Creatures engulfed by the fiery serpent take 5d8+CL (23+CL) fire damage (reflex halves).As a standard action on subsequent turns, you can move the snake another 30 feet.Upcast 6 - As a swift action on subsequent turns, you can move the snake another 30 feet.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Inferno Sphere
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 5 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Buff, Fire, Persistent Action: Standard
The area around you is pelted with a whirling storm of flame. All creatures (except you) within 15 feet are instantly and persistently set ablaze. Creatures that start their turns in range or move into range take (CL) fire damage.Your speed is reduced to by 15 while buffed by this spell.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Charming Gaze
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 1 Shira💋
Tags: Charm, Subtle Action: Standard
You lock your eyes onto a target and make them Charmed (will negates). If you're currently engaged in combat with the creature, the spells duration is 1 minute. If you are not, the spell's duration is 8 hours. Entering combat against them shortens the remaining duration to 1 minute.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Darting Duplicate
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 1 Shira💋
Tags: Figment, Subtle Action: SwiftAn illusory duplicate of yourself leaves your square, which moves at up to your speed each round and takes a path of your choosing. It can go around corners if you know where to turn to not hit terrain or creatures. It cannot replicate any actions besides moving and smiling smugly.
Creatures that are threatening you when you cast this spell must make an AoO on the duplicate (will negates).If the duplicate enters a creature's space or impassable terrain, any creature that witnesses it instantly disbelieves it. A creature that identifies your spell when you cast it instantly disbelieves it.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Lip Service
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 1 Shira💋
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Subtle, Prepared Action: -You can make a creature think you said something you didn’t. You can implant simple ideas that require no more than two sentences to convey (I think your hat looks lovely. Where did you get it?) into their head that they think that you said in the middle of a conversation, while masking what you actually said during the few seconds it would take to speak.In essence you can speak to different people at the same time and one of them different things than the others.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Role-playing
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 1 Shira💋
Tags: Glamer Action: Standard
You instantly Craft Disguise and apply it to the target creature.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Tongues
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 1 Shira💋
Tags: Buff Action: Standard
Creature can speak and understand all spoken non-secret Languages. Has no effect on written text.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Unspoken Name
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 1 Shira💋
Tags: Recharge Action: StandardWhen you cast this spell, designate a word, phrase, or name. If a creature within 1 mile of you uses that word, phrase, or name to refer to you, you immediately learn that creature’s name, appearance, and location. This discharges the spell.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Command
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 2 Shira💋
Tags: Language-Dependent, Mind-Affecting Action: Standard
You give the subject a single command, which it obeys to the best of its ability at its earliest opportunity (will negates). You may select from the following options. The spell specifies whether the creature can take other actions, or if their actions provoke AoOs.Approach - On its turn, the subject moves directly towards you 30 ft, provoking AoOsDrop It - On its turn, the subject drops whatever it is holding. It can’t pick up any dropped item on the same turn it drops it.
Kneel - The subject is knocked down. It may act normally but takes any appropriate penalties.Begone - On its turn, the subject moves 30 ft directly away from you, provoking AoOs.
Praise Me - The subject babbles on about your greatness, effectively making them Silenced them for 1 round.If the subject can’t carry out your command on its next turn, it defaults to kneel.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Sense Motives
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 2 Shira💋
Tags: Prepared Action: -
You gain a +4 bonus to +Insight🤔 checks. Whenever you glean something using insight, you can transfer the knowledge you gain to any creature you can see as vague impressions, effectively treating it as though they had also succeeded in using insight.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Stage Fright
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 2 Shira💋
Tags: Fear, Psychic Action: Standard
The fear of failure looms over the target creature (will negates). They take a -2 penalty to Attack and opposed skill checks. Whenever they graze, miss or fail an opposed skill check they initiated, they take d6+CL (3+CL) psychic damage.
Outside of combat this gains the subtle tag and gives creatures disadvantage on their next skill check made in front of a crowd. Its duration changes to 24 hours. Once they roll the check, the spell ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Stunt Double
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 2 Shira💋
Tags: Glamer, Buff Action: Standard Action
You instantly Craft Disguise and apply it to the target creature that causes them to appear identical to you.While standing adjacent to a creature that looks identical to you, attacks and targeted spells roll to randomly target among everyone (will save per attempt negates, passing this save causes an attacker to be immune to the same cast of the spell).

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Tongue Twister
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 2 Shira💋
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: Standard
You add an extra load to all mental actions related to a creature’s speaking, causing their speech to be slowed and slurred (will negates). In order to speak at all, the creature must spend a swift action instead of a free action (ex sharing information with +Monster Lore📖). In order to cast a spell that normally requires a swift action, the creature must spend a standard action. In order to cast a spell that normally requires a standard action, the creature must spend a FRA.This increase in action cost can reasonably apply to any other actions based on speech as well.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Overstimulate
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 3 Shira💋
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: Standard
You flood the creatures senses with stimuli, overloading them (will negates). They have -15 speed, blurred vision and any +blindsense they have is disabled. They have weakness 2 to all damage.
An affected creature can make an additional save at the end of each of their turns. If wet, this additional save has advantage.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: The Hand that Feeds
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 3 Shira💋
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Upcast Action: Standard
You bring forth all of the negative memories and feelings a companion has for its leader. The target companion is taunted by its leader for 1 round (will negates). It does not use any recharge abilities while taunted in this way. This ability removes all other taunt effects currently affecting the companion creature if the spell is successful.Upcast - You can target an additional companion creature for each additional mana spent.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Venomous Promise
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 3 Shira💋
Tags: Poison, Subtle, Scrying Action: StandardYour words are poison, but they don't know that. Whenever you share information and get a creature to promise not to tell anybody (or something to that effect), you can infect the creature with a venomous promise.
From that point after, if they share any information related to what they promised about, they succumb to the effects of the spell. They are immediately envenomed. You are aware of when this happens, who triggered it and what they said and can immediately begin scrying, sensing through the creature that broke the agreement.You can do this for up to 10 minutes. At any point during the scrying, including when it ends, you can deal 40 poison damage to the creature. This damage is nonlethal and does not immediately kill them (though the venom might).

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Domination
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 4 Shira💋
Tags: Charm, Concentration, Recharge Action: Standard
You link your mind with a creature and enforce your will upon it. For the duration of the spell the creature is Dominated (will reduces effect to staggered 1 round). You can telepathically give orders to the dominated creature. They must follow these orders unless they are very obviously self-harming (ex. KYS NOW). For all intents and purposes, this creature is considered your ally as long as they are dominated. If you know of the creature's abilities, you can command it to use them, otherwise they use their normal tactics, but to aid you.At the end of each turn, the creature gets a new save against the effect.The spell ends if any of your allies harm the target (including you).This spell can only be cast 1/minute.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Order 66
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 4 Shira💋
Tags: Charm, Contingent, Language-Dependent Action: 1 minute
You plant subconscious cues into a helpless or willing target. After completing the cast time, you cause the target to forget you cast this spell. At any point during the following month, you can trigger the true effects of this spell by speaking a passphrase in a manner where the target can clearly hear you as a standard action. For 1 minute the creature is Dominated, aiding you in combat, attacking your enemies as you direct them. Once this effect is triggered, the contingency ends.The contingent aspect of this spell applies to the caster, not the target creature. A tattoo of the number 66 appears somewhere on the creatures skin where it is visible. If covered, it moves position until it is not. If completely covered, the spell ends.
The spell leaves behind subtle cues, allowing those trained in +Insight🤔 to realize the creature is affected by this spell (caster's DC+4). Creatures only ever get 1 check to realize this enchantment is in place.Upcast 6 - The duration of the subconscious order is permanent.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Authority
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 5 Shira💋
Tags: Charm, Language-Dependent, Concentration Action: 1 minuteYou link the minds of all creatures with intelligence higher than -2 that can hear the sound of your voice and see you. For the duration of the cast time, you must speak and stand relatively still. What you talk about during the minute cast time is of little importance, all that matters is that you speak. You automatically catch the attention of every creature if nobody is under duress for the duration of the cast time.
At the end of the cast time, all minion creatures are automatically charmed by you. For non minions (will negates). A creature of your lvl or higher needs not make a save at all. After the minute, you can move around, ensnaring more people in your speech as long as you continue speaking.While charmed, creatures will follow you around and agree with basically everything you have to say. You can parade them around, have them protest, have them clap at your performances etc. They will not avoid actively engaging in obviously dangerous activities, like jumping off cliffs, attacking people or walking into a war zone.
Stopping the spell or playing beautiful music can break this spell's effect. The +Profession🧑‍🌾 DC to do so is the spell's DC+5.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Thrall
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 6 Shira💋
Tags: Charm, Companion Cast Time: 1 minute
Worm your way deep into a creature's psyche and take control of their body. Functions as Domination, but must be cast on a or helpless creature. The domination lasts indefinitely. The creature does not receive new saves and must be freed through other means, magical or otherwise. Thrall is considered a Permanent Status.
If a friend, ally, respected superior, family member etc spends a standard action to sway the creature, it gets a will save against the effect with Disadvantage. If at least three creatures spend their turn doing this at once, the save is not at disadvantage. Certain types of people, such as people related to the controlled creature's destiny or true love can give a creature advantage on their save.You cannot cast this spell on allies for the companion boost to attack. Fuck you.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Amnesia
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 1 Arc Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
You hit a creature in the head hard enough to cause it to forget its own training. On hit the creature forgets a technique of your choosing. In order to remove a specific technique, you must have seen the technique get used, hear about a specific creature's technique from someone who has seen it or succeed on a +Monster Lore📖 check against the creature to reveal its offense traits.For creatures with class levels that prepare techniques this can be a bit awkward since they can swap techniques so you're gonna have to play it by ear.
If you don't have a specific technique in mind, the creature forgets one of its highest tier techniques known if it prepares them, or a 1/day innate technique (that it hasn't used yet) if it doesn't. Move down the list until you get something that fits, with the idea being remove most important and powerful tech first.A creature with Amnesia can spend a standard action to try and remember the technique. Martial techniques require a DC 5 intelligence check while magical techniques require a DC 20 intelligence check.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Mana Drain
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 1 Arc
Tags: Su, Buff, Upcast Action: Swift
You radiate a 10 ft aura that drains the mana from living things. Every time a creature spends mana within this aura, it spends an additional point of mana. If the ability costs no mana, such as an innate spell, its CL is reduced by 2.Upcast 4 - Double the penalties of the aura (+2 mana expenditure, -4 CL for innate spells).

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Pressure
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 1 Arc Tags: - Action: Immediate
Cause a caster to falter in the final moment of its casting with annoying distractions or a sinister gaze. The DC of the Spell the creature casts decreases by 2 (will negates).

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Silencing Strike
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 1 Arc
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
Strike at a creatures throat in order to silence them for 1 round (fort negates).Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Psionic Backlash
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 2 Arc
Tags: Su, Psychic Action: ImmediateWhen you hear magic words or see magic at play, you can respond by making the creature's mana manipulation unstable. They take d6 (3) psychic damage for each point of mana they spend (or would spend with innate casting).

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Trace Teleportation
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 3 Arc
Tags: Su, Prepared Action: -
You gain a 6th sense allowing you to detect when a Teleportation effect has happened in the area recently. Such spots appear as silhouettes of portals. While adjacent to such a space, you can inspect it more closely to over a few minutes to glean further details.You can automatically tell the distance and direction of the teleportation effect. If the effect teleported the creature to another plane, you know what plane instead of the distance. You can roll an arcana check (DC 10+CL of the effect, or 10+the creatures level for non spell effects) to gaze into this pseudo portal to see exactly where the creature teleported to, as though looking through a window to their destination. You see it as it currently is, not as it looked when they went, using your full visual acuity.If you are capable of getting to this destination while the same use of this ability persists, you need not make further checks to see any chain of teleportation that may have occurred from the same caster.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Trigger Word
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 4 Arc Tags: - Action: Immediate
You have trained your body to react to magic words with violence. When an enemy you threaten casts a spell, make a Simple Attack against them. On-hit the spell fizzles (fort negates).

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Covetous Aura
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 5 Arc
Tags: Su, Buff Action: Standard
Whenever a creature uses a supernatural ability or spell on one of its allies within the aura, you can decide to become the target of the effect as an immediate action. For AoE effects (like Healer's channel energy), you can only steal the effect from one target.
Unless you identify it with +Monster Lore📖 or Identify Spell Being Cast, you're gambling. Any effect that requires a saving throw that you steal (like a Blight) you automatically fail.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Highway Patrol
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 6 Arc
Tags: Su, Buff Action: Swift
You are a master at negating teleportation, but why not play along a little? Every time a creature within 60 ft of you teleports, you can redirect them to another position within 60 ft of you as an instant action and cause them to become clumsy 2 (will negates redirection).

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Blood for Blood
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 1 Barbarism💢 Tags: - Action: Immediate
When you provoke an AoO, you can retaliate after the attack is resolved with a simple attack.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Bloodletting
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 1 Barbarism💢
Tags: Recharge Action: Free
Shed your own blood, taking 5 true damage and offering it to the gods. They repay you by granting you 1 mana.You can only use bloodletting once a turn.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Carnage
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 1 Barbarism💢
Tags: Buff Action: Swift
The more blood that flows from battle, the more you are pushed forward with reckless abandon. When you defeat an enemy, you take a -1 penalty to AC and get a +2 bonus to Attack. This can stack up to 3 times.Note: You cannot receive another buff effect or end this buff while under the effects of carnage.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: War Paint
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 1 Barbarism💢
Tags: Buff Action: SwiftWipe the blood, sludge or ectoplasm off of a creature and apply it to yourself to get yourself in the mood for battle. You must initially target a defeated creature or yourself if you are below 10 hp.
After you apply the blood to yourself, gain +15 speed, a +4 bonus to +Intimidation😱 checks. When you crit, you deal an additional 5 damage.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Foe Toss
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 2 Barbarism💢
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
Make a grapple attack. Instead of grappling them, you make a bonus thrown weapon attack using the poise broken creature as ammunition.
The attack always deals full damage to the poise broken creature. If you graze the secondary target, it does not change the damage against the initial target. If you crit, both targets are both crit. All creatures affected take an additional d8 (4) damage.If you are already grappling the creature when you initiate the attack, you don't need to grapple them again.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Spartan Kick
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 2 Barbarism💢
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
A swift kick in the abdomen sends your opponent reeling backwards. The attack automatically pushes them back 10 ft on-hit and deals an additional d8 (4) damage. If the opponent was clumsy or Knocked Down, they take double fall damage (6 damage per 10 ft).Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Technology
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 2 Barbarism💢
Tags: Prepared Action: -
You can activate things using the +Athletics🏊 skill that normally require another skill. This could mean twisting the doorknob off of a door to open it, forcing open a book that requires a password gleaned through arcana or activating a portal that normally required +Planes.This usually involves damaging or breaking the object."We aren't cavemen. We have technology!"

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Ups and Downs
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 2 Barbarism💢
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special AttackOn hit deal an additional d8 (4) damage and smash a creature into the ground, or throw them directly up into a low roof within 10 ft. In either case, the creature is entangled until they use athletics to escape as a swift action. If you throw the creature into a roof, they are also unable to see and interact with the floor below until they escape.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Blood Armor
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 3 Barbarism💢
Tags: Buff Action: SwiftSpecial: Can only be used while below 50% hp or bleeding.
Bathe in your own blood. While below 50% hp or if you took bleed damage this turn, gain +2 AC. If you stop bleeding, or heal above 50% hp, the buff remains, but you lose the AC bonus until you meet the techniques requirements.If you are below 10 hp, gain +4 AC.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Exist
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 3 Barbarism💢 Tags: - Action: Instant
As part of the initiative roll you can choose a creature within range. That creature is taunted (will negates). To that creature, your very existence infuriates them and you must be stopped at all cost. At the end of each of their turns, they get a new save to end the effect.
If you are at or below 50% hp when this ability triggers, increase the DC by 2. If on subsequent turns, you take no actions on your turn other than movement, the DC increases by 2.If this creature is defeated, then you may choose a new creature to affect with this ability (no action required, happens immediately).

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Forget Me Stick
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 3 Barbarism💢
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special AttackNote: You need to defeat the creature on the same turn that you land this attack for it to have its effect. The creature is never killed by your attacks this turn.You deal an additional 2d8 (9) damage. The target forgets anything that happened while defeated, and anything that happened a minute before being defeated.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Firmly Grasp It
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 4 Barbarism💢 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Make a disarm attack with a +4 bonus. Instead of knocking the weapon out of the creatures hand, you violently stab it into the creature's hand, dealing 3d8 (13) additional damage. The creature cannot use that hand or weapon until the weapon is removed as a standard action via
Breakout.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Most Annoying Sound
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 4 Barbarism💢
Tags: Sonic
Action: Special Attack
Screech into your enemies ear to confound them with a horrific noise. Make a grapple attack with a +4 bonus. Gain Constrict 3d8 (13) sonic while it persists. While grappled, the creature is also confused.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Walk Around
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 4 Barbarism💢
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Concentration
Action: FRA
You can walk around. You spend all of your actions moving and doing nothing else, ending your movement at some point within 30 feet of where you started walking around. Naturally this behavior befuddles the creatures around you. All enemies within 60 feet of this initial starting point are confused (will adds 2 to d10 roll).
The DC is 2 higher for creatures that AoO you as part of this movement.You may continue spending your turns walking around to continue confusing new creatures as long as you want, the same creature cannot be confused more than once.This has no effect on creatures not engaged in combat with you.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Armed Robbery
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 5 Barbarism💢 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Make a grapple or disarm attack with a +4 bonus. If successful, instead of the usual effects, tear off your opponents arm causing, them to bleed 2d6 (7) damage and be drained 5 (fort removes drain/bleed and reduces "disarm" to dislocated arm, which deals 5 True Damage to you every time you use it, such as to attack with a weapon in that hand, cast a spell with a staff in that hand or take a shield action with a shield in that hand. First aid can fix this condition).
If you successfully disarm or grapple, make a Simple Attack against them with their own arm as a free action. This counts as a light weapon. If your hands are already full, you can choose to sheathe or drop weapons/items in order to make this extra attack.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Man Drop
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 5 Barbarism💢
Tags: Recharge, Earth
Tags: FRA
Leap with incredible strength 300 ft into the air and crash down onto an area. Creatures within 30 ft of your landing position take 6d8+lvl (27+lvl) crush damage and are staggered for 1 minute (fort halves damage and reduces stagger to 1 round). Creatures get a new save against the stagger effect at the end of each of their turns.Usable 1/combat.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Undying Rage
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 6 Barbarism💢
Tags: Contingent, Prepared Action: -Your eyes glow and your resting emotional state is angry.
The first time you are defeated and the effect is not negated or delayed by another feature, such as ferocity or Diehard, this contingency activates.
You become completely immune to death/defeat. Any hp damage in excess of your current hp is instead converted into Drained and increased by 5 (22 damage? 27 drain. 1 damage? 6 drain). When your drain matches your max hp, you instantly die.When combat ends, or as an instant action, you can choose to end the effects of this technique. You are defeated and unconscious until you are no longer drained.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Bear Arms
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 1 Beastmode
Tags: Prepared Action: -
While this technique is prepared, your arms get coated in a thick fur and your fingers get claws at their ends, granting you a Natural Attack. The claw attacks deal d8 slash damage, or d10 if your hands are empty. They have the CM (disarm) and CM (grapple) weapon properties. If you already had claws, these qualities are only in addition to what you already had. AKA, cannot decrease your claw dmg.
While wielding a gun, you get DR 20 vs disarm attacks.
You can make grapple and disarm attacks as AoOs with your bear arms, as though you you possessed the Maneuver Versatility feat.You gain a multi-attack option: Bear Rights - Make 2 attacks with your bear claws.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Frenzied Leap
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 1 Beastmode
Tags: Upcast, Earth Action: Swift
Take the Jump action and crash upon your foes with a shockwave. Creatures within 10 ft of your landing position (or your natural reach) are clumsy 1.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase your jump distance by 5.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Pack Attack
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 1 Beastmode Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Keep up the pressure on an opponent by making it appear like many copies of you are attacking it at once. On-hit, an ally (other than yourself) has advantage on their next attack against the target in the next round.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Pouch
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 1 Beastmode
Tags: Prepared Action: -
While you have this technique prepared you have a single large pouch in your skin, or other methods of storage on the exterior of your body. You gain an extra 100 carry weight and natural pockets to place things in.
You can use the pouches to conceal items with advantage.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Shells Up
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 1 Beastmode
Tags: poly, chimeric, Prepared
While this technique is prepared, you have a large shell on your back. You cannot be flanked.
By spending 1 mana when you take the total defense action, you can slip into your shell completely. This prevents you from taking any instant or immediate actions, but increases the the defense granted by the action to DRA 4.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Kindred
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 2 Beastmode
Tags: poly, true, Mana Burn, Dismissible Action: StandardTransform into a beast creature you can see. You do not copy their appearance exactly, only their species. You gain the creature's senses, movement types and natural attacks, but nothing else. A pattern appears in your fur/scales etc that matches the symbol of Mother Earth.How others of the species react to you depends on the species. Some creatures are territorial, others are social and others don't care.If you mana burn you can increase the duration to 10 minutes.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Rapid Recovery
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 2 Beastmode
Tags: Prepared, Healing Action: StandardYou can detach and regenerate lost limbs/organs, and in general recover much faster.
You can cause pieces of your body to detach as a free action, such as your hands or legs. Basically anything that isn't your head or your torso. When you do so, you are drained 3. If you are able to re-attach this limb, you recover the drain.
You recover 2 stacks of drained every days instead of 1, as though receiving long term care (stacks). A lost limb/organ regrows within 3 days.
When you are defeated, you automatically regain 1 hit point after 10 minutes.As a swift action, you can heal 10 hp, regrow a limb instantly and make yourself drained 5.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Rend Vision
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 2 Beastmode
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
Grow a beak and poke at a creature's eyes. On-hit the creature is Blinded for 1 round.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Blood Spurt
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 3 Beastmode Tags: - Action: Immediate
While you are bleeding, or whenever a creature within your natural reach deals slashing or piercing damage, you can respond by squirting some of your blood at them. You take 2 true damage and the target is blinded for 1 round (reflex reduces to blurred vision).

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Feast
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 3 Beastmode
Tags: Healing, Upcast
Action: Special Attack
Grow rows of jagged teeth, unhinge your jaw and take a meaty bite out of a creature, dealing an additional 2d8 (9) dmg. If after the attack is resolved, the creature is defeated or dead, gain (2*lvl) temp hp.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Octolock
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 3 Beastmode Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Grow several tentacles and make a grapple attack with a +4 bonus. While grappled in this way, attacks against the target get a +4 bonus, you have resistance to poise damage and you constrict them for 3d6 (10) damage each turn, including the turn you initiate it.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Return to Monke
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 3 Beastmode
Tags: poly, true Action: StandardAssume the form of a tiny monkey indefinitely. You can exit this transformation as a standard action.
While in this form, you gain the following traits from the Polymorph List🧬 Speed - Climb Smol - Tiny Prehensile - Tail Attack - Bite (P) BotherWhile in this form, you gain 2 abilities. Both usable as a standard action.One of Us (poly, true) - While in monkey form, you reach over and touch a creature with your tiny monkey hands. The creature also turns into a tiny monkey (fort reduces to stagger 1 round).
Ohhh Banana Mind-Affecting - You procure a shiny golden banana that hovers in the air for 1 minute. All creatures you turned into a monkey are automatically fascinated. Other monkey/ape-like creatures are fascinated (will negates).

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Unseen Predator
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 3 Beastmode Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
While you hide, leap 30 ft, requiring a jump action. You appear suddenly next to the creature and make a melee attack against them that deals an additional 2d8 (9) dmg. If the target fails its
+Perception👀 against your stealth, instead deal 3d8 (13) additional dmg.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Death Roll
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 4 Beastmode Tags: -
Action: Special AttackNote: Can only be used against a grappled or knocked down creature.
You chomp down onto a creature with excessive force and spin them around. If the creature is grappled, they are knocked down and take an additional 3d8 (13) damage and are made clumsy 2. If they are knocked down, you initiate a grapple, they take an additional 3d8 (13) damage and are made clumsy 2. In either case, they are also Held Down.If the target is neither grappled nor knocked down, you can attempt one such maneuver as a free action on hit.
When you maintain a grapple against a creature after using this technique against them without the grapple ever being broken, they are made clumsy 2.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Peacocking
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 4 Beastmode
Tags: Mind-Affecting
Actions: Swift Action
You grow an elaborate and colorful set of feathers, patterned wings or a wide hood like that of a snake to temporarily entrance your enemy. The creature you direct this display towards becomes fascinated for 1 round (will negates).You cannot use this technique against a creature you have attacked this round.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Devour
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 5 Beastmode Tags: -
Action: Special AttackThis move functions differently based on whether you target an ally or an enemy.Enemy
Against a creature you are grappling, this attack automatically works. If not already grappling, roll a grapple attack with a +4 bonus. If successful, you swallow the creature whole. While devoured, the creature inside is in stasis.You gain access to the following special attack.
Spit Up - Spit out a devoured creature, hurling them up to 30 feet. The creature takes 6d8+lvl (27+lvl) crush damage and is knocked down. Creatures within 5 ft of the impact location are also knocked down (reflex negates).If you do not use spit up on the following turn, the target is disgorged with no negative effects at the end of that turn.Ally
Devour a willing ally, giving them Total Cover. They can hang out inside your stomach indefinitely, hearing muffled versions of things happening outside. As a free action, they can exit your stomach.
If you become sickened, you automatically vomit them out.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Hive Mind
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 5 Beastmode
Tags: Prepared Action: -You establish a connection to an ally with 1 minute of intimate contact, adding them to your hive mind. While part of the hive mind, you are able to speak telepathically with them. You can choose to telepathically communicate with one, some or all members. All members of the hive also get an intuitive sense of each member's direction and distance.
You can form a hive mind with a number of creatures equal to your LvL.If you ever stop preparing this technique, your hive mind disappears.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Blood Hunt
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 6 Beastmode
Tags: Prepared Action: -
While this technique is prepared, you can smell everything as long as it bleeds. You gain the Shirshu Elite Tracker and Sightless Blindsense traits. These only function against wounded creatures, or against creatures whose blood you have smelled before.
You see a faint misty red trail leading directly to whatever you track, automatically succeeding on survival checks to track creatures whose blood you have smelled before.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Wallop
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
Level 6 Beastmode
Tags: Recharge Action: Standard
Grow long bestial arms to scoop up your foes and toss them in a specific direction. Choose a direction, then make a shove attack with a +8 bonus and apply it to against all creatures within range. Creatures successfully shoved are moved 20 ft in the direction you chose. If they impact solid terrain, they take 7d8+lvl (31+lvl) damage and are stunned for one round (fort reduces stun to daze).

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: 5G
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 1 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Buff
Action: Swift ActionIncrease the effects of gravity on your body, causing you to stay firmly planted on the ground, sometimes to your detriment.
You cannot hover or Fly. You gain Advantage on any save that would physically move you from your position or knock you down. Creatures have Disadvantage on attacks made against you that would move you from your position or knock you down.If used underwater, you sink to the bottom 60 ft per round.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Quake
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 1 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Prepared, Earth Action: -You drastically increase the weight of your footsteps, causing each one to echo and the ground to shake.
You gain a +2 bonus to +Intimidation😱 and creatures get a +10 bonus to +Perception👀 to detect you. The bonus to intimidation increases to +4 if you wear heavy armor.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Roar
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 1 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Fear, Sonic, Upcast Action: Standard
You roar loudly, sounding more monster than man. Creatures within the range take d6+lvl (3+lvl) sonic damage. They are frightened for one round (will negates).Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d6 (3).

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Sonic Boom
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 1 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Sonic, Upcast Action: StandardYou clap your hands together with violent force. Creatures in the area take 2d8+lvl (9+lvl) sonic damage and are pushed back 10 ft (fort halves damage negates pushback).Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Thunder Stomp
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 1 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Earth, Upcast
Action: Special AttackSpecial: You and your target must be touching the ground to use this technique.
You smash the ground violently, causing a shockwave under the target. Roll a topple attack with a +4 bonus. If successful, the creature takes full damage instead of graze damage as they fall onto sharpened ground.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase the range by 15 ft.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Crater
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 2 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Earth, Upcast
Action: Special AttackSpecial: You must have high ground on your opponent to use this technique. A jump is sufficient to meet this criteria.Slam your opponent into the ground with such force that the ground underneath you cracks and splinters upwards, dealing an additional d8 (4) dmg. A 10 ft radius circular wall of earth forms with you and your opponent at the center inside. The wall is 20 ft tall on the inside and sloped on the outside.
A creature can break through the wall with Brute Force as a standard action. You can break through it as a free action (1/turn) with the same check.If you or your opponent is larger than medium, than the walls radius increases by 5ft per size category above medium.Upcast - For each additional point of mana spent, deal an additional d8 (4) dmg and increase the DC to destroying the wall by 2.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Ferocious Howl
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 2 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Sonic, Fear, Upcast Action: Standard
Shout at your enemy to create a sonic projectile and scare them off. Make a thrown attack that deals 3d8+lvl (13+lvl) sonic damage. The target is frightened for one round (will reduces to shaken 1).Upcast - Every point of additional mana spent on this ability increases the damage by d8 (4).
If you spend at least 3 mana, its range increases to Short
If you spend at least 5, Long🏹.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Gift of the Cataclysm
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 2 Cataclysm🌋
Swift: Buff Action: Swift
Your devotion manifests into gifts from your fiendish patron. Get a +2 bonus to +Athletics🏊 checks and damage made with unarmed attacks and natural attacks.
As part of using this technique, you must make a DC 15 check to Brute Force destroy a nearby or handheld object. If you fail, the buff immediately ends.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Gut Check
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 2 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
You make an unarmed strike or natural attack against a creature, aiming straight for the abdomen while shouting "GUT CHECK." The attack does an additional d8 (4) dmg and On-hit if the creature has just swallowed something recently, they vomit it out, negating its benefits or drawbacks.Also ends pregnancies (fort negates).
Upcast - If you spend at least 3 mana, the creature is also sickened 1, and cannot consume anything without getting rid of the sickened first.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Earth Shatter
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 3 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Earth, Upcast Action: StandardNote: You must be touching the ground to cast this spell.
You smash the ground violently, causing it to crack and crumble under your strength. The area becomes difficult terrain. Creatures on the ground or hovering in the area take 4d8+lvl (18+lvl) crush damage and are knocked down (reflex halves damage and negates knock down).Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Fracture
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 3 Cataclysm🌋 Tags:
Action: Special Attack
On-hit or after grappling a foe, crack a creature's bones in one of their limbs in order to impede them and cause great pain. The creature takes 2d8 (9) true damage and has one of their limbs rendered useless (fort turns damaged limb into Staggered for 1 round).Arm - Creature is unable to use arm
Leg - Creatures speed is reduced by 15. Clumsy 1 permanently.
Wing - Creature is unable to fly. Note: Other limbs can be selected, disabling natural attacks like tentacles and such. These are just the most common examples.
The damaged limb can be healed with a DC 25 +Medicine💉 check, taking 1 minute.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Shockwave
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 3 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Buff, Earth Action: Swift
You empower yourself with thunder thighs. You can take the jump action as part of using this technique. Whenever you take the jump action, creatures on the ground within reach of your destination are staggered for 1 round (fort negates). Creatures that were already staggered are knocked down (fort negates).

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Artillery
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 1 Marksman🏹
Tags: Prepared Action: -
All ranged weapons you wield become Long🏹 range weapons. If it already is a long range weapon, increase the range increments by 20.
You cannot benefit from this technique if you move more than 10 ft during your turn. If you benefit from this range increase before you move, your movement is reduced to 10 ft (applying speed debuffs like Knockdown to this new 10 speed).

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Butterfingers
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 1 Marksman🏹 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Make a Ranged disarm attack with a +4 bonus. If successful, the disarmed item continues flying along with the projectile until it lands, either in a surface, or in the ground at the end of its range. Attacking from different angles can cause different behaviors, like with High Ground⛰ it won't go particularly far. It requires a swift action to yank it free.You can also use this technique against unattended objects for a similar effect.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Curved-shot
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 1 Marksman🏹
Tags: Upcast
Tags: Special Attack
Ignore cover, but not Improved Cover or total cover, for one ranged attack.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Dive
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 1 Marksman🏹
Tags: Elusive Action: Free
Move 10 feet and get Knocked Down until the start of your next turn.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Empty Quiver
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 1 Marksman🏹 Tags: -
Action: Special AttackSlam your ranged weapon into an opponent and catch them off guard. Your weapon deals damage as a weapon of its handedness (2h 2d8, 1h d8) and has the light property for this attack.
Your movement is elusive against this target this turn.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Headshot
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 1 Marksman🏹 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Carefully line up a shot on a creature you specify. A red laser appears on their head, giving you a -10 penalty to +Stealth.
At the start of your next turn, shoot them as a free action with a +10 bonus to Attack and a bonus 2d8 (9) damage.
If the creature takes Total Cover or you are otherwise made unable to fire, this attack fails. This shot you take has effectively infinite range, only the initial targeting requires the creature be within 120 ft.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Pin Down
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 1 Marksman🏹 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Hit your opponent with a projectile in such a way to pin them to the ground or a wall. They are entangled On-hit until they spend a swift action to remove it.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Eagle Eye
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 2 Marksman🏹
Tags: Prepared Action: -
You gain a +4 bonus to +Perception👀. You can see incredibly small details incredible distances, like a mouse running through a field hundreds of feet away.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Lights Out
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 2 Marksman🏹
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
Make a ranged attack, dealing an additional d10 (5) dmg. If this attack is enough to defeat the target, regain the mana cost of this ability and reload your weapon.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, deal an additional d10 dmg.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Long Shot
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 2 Marksman🏹
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
Make a ranged attack, adding 20 range and d8 (4) dmg. If you graze the target, you instead miss completely.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, deal an additional d8 (4) dmg and add an additional 10 range.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Piercing Shot
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 2 Marksman🏹
Tags: Upcast Action: StandardFire a single powerful shot, targeting a 60-ft line in front of you and dealing 3d8+lvl (13+lvl) pierce damage (reflex halves).
If you increase the action of this ability to a FRA, gain +2 to its DC.This technique automatically loads your weapon, and it automatically reloads it again after use.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, deal an additional d8 (4) dmg and increase the line by 10 ft.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Shot From the Air
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 2 Marksman🏹
Tags: Upcast Action: Standard
Prepare yourself for incoming fire.
When a ranged attack enters the first range increment of a ranged weapon you currently wield, fire at it. If your attack roll meets or exceeds theirs, the attack is negated.Upcast 4 - Usable as an immediate action.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Tumble
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 2 Marksman🏹
Tags: Elusive Action: FreeMove 10 feet.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Called Shot
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 3 Marksman🏹 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack Fire an arrow that deals an additional 2d8 (9) damage and embed it into a key spot on the targets body on hit with a variety of effects.
Hand - Creatures suffers a -2 penalty to Attack using weapons/casting spells through that hand while the arrow remains.
Leg - Creatures land speed is reduced by 15 and it cannot dash, jump or Charge while the arrow remains. Etc - You can target other regions of a creature's body, such as their jaw, or a tentacle to apply the -2 attack penalty to that attack specifically, or a wing/fin to restrict the movement of a swimming or flying creature.
The arrow can be removed as a standard action without issue. It can be removed as a swift action by taking 2d8 (9) true damage. If you have +Medicine💉 proficiency, removing as a swift action deals no damage.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Snatch
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 4 Marksman🏹
Tags: Su Action: Immediate
When attacked by a ranged projectile weapon, roll a Reflex save against the creatures DC. If you succeed, you negate the attack entirely. If you are wielding a ranged weapon, transform the projectile into something that fits it and then fire/throw it back as an instant action.
Particularly odd weapons (like the Ray Gun) require a near exact matching weapon to fire back.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Fan the Hammer
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 5 Marksman🏹
Tags: Recharge Action: StandardUse a reload weapon to make 6 simple attacks at a -5 penalty. The weapon becomes unusable until repaired, costing 10% of its cost.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Noble Sacrifice
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 1 Protector🛡
Tags: Elusive Action: ImmediateWhen a creature harms another within 30 ft, you can immediately move adjacent to the ally, become the new target of the effect, and automatically get hit by the attack. If you use this technique against an effect that also targets you or includes you in its area, you suffer the effects for both yourself and the target you spared, potentially taking damage or suffering other consequences twice.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Shield Brother
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 1 Protector🛡
Tags: Elusive Action: Instant
You can move 10 ft closer to an ally. If that puts them within your natural reach, you can use a shield action on them.
You can also move 10 ft while using Tank Up to help protect as an immediate action.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Bouncing Bulwark
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 2 Protector🛡 Tags: - Action: ImmediateSpecial: You must be wielding a shield to use this technique.
As part of using the technique, take the Block action. If the foe attacked with a melee weapon, they are made clumsy 2 (fort halves).

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Courage
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 1 Pupper
Tags: Prepared, Healing Action: -
You hold yourself with such confidence that your mind has no choice but to follow suite. You get advantage on saving throws against Fear effects.When you pass a save against such an effect, you and allies that can see you gain 5 temp hp.
If you fail a save against a fear effect, or otherwise become Shaken or Frightened, this technique's effect is suppressed for 1 minute.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Long Stride
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 1 Pupper
Tags: Prepared Action: -
While this technique is prepared, you move with a spring in your step and a sense of urgency. You get a +10 bonus to your land speed while in combat.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Persevere
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 1 Pupper
Tags: Prepared Action: -You start each day ready for anything. You get a +4 bonus to the first saving throw you make. This ability refreshes after 1 minute out of combat.You can confer this bonus to another creature by touching it as a standard action. When the ability refreshes, it refreshes on you.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Sprint
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 1 Pupper Tags: -
Action: FRA
Get down on all fours and take the Charge action with 4x speed instead of x2. Ignore difficult terrain.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Burst of Speed
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 2 Pupper Tags: - Action: Swift
The thrill of battle pushes you forward. Increase your speed by 20 this round. Your movement is Elusive.
If you do not end your turn threatened by an enemy, you become fatigued.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Crash
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 3 Pupper Tags: - Action: ImmediateWhen a creature moves into melee range of an ally within 30 ft of you, you can immediately
Charge to intercept them. You make a single +Combat Maneuver👐 attack against them. If you poise break them, instead of the usual effect, reduce their speed is zero until the start of their next turn just outside of the ally's reach.Your speed is 0 on your next turn.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Exploit Weakness
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 3 Pupper
Tags: Elusive Action: Immediate
When an enemy suffers from a negative status effect that restricts their actions or movement, such as if they are Entangled, staggered or stunned, move to threaten them, unless your speed is 0. You can choose any position around them.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Unbreakable Advance
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 3 Pupper
Tags: Prepared Action: -You are protected as long as you are on the move. You gain the following benefits while in combat.
You take no penalty to AC from taking the Charge action.
You ignore difficult terrain.
During your turn you are immune to damage and Poise damage, unless it is from a damage over time effect, like bleed. This effect ends for the current combat until you do not move at least 10 ft on your turn. It returns at the start of the next combat.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Backstab
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 1 Scoundrel
Tags: Elusive
Action: Special Attack
Dash to the direct opposite side of a creature you threaten and make an attack. They are DD for this attack, or both attacks if Dual Wielding.Cannot be used if your speed is zero, or if the spot opposite of the creature is occupied.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Kidnap
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 1 Scoundrel Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Make a drag attack with a +4 bonus. If successful, dash as a free action.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Pocket Sand
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 1 Scoundrel Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Gain a +4 bonus to your next dirty trick. It blinds for 1 round instead of its usual effect.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Denied
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description: Level 2 Scoundrel Tags: - Action: ImmediateWhen a creature attempts to manipulate an item, such as drinking a potion or opening a door, stop them. You automatically slap the item out of their hands onto the ground, jam the door or otherwise prevent the creature from utilizing equipment that can't be used to make attacks or cast spells.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Feign Defeat
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 2 Scoundrel Tags: - Action: ImmediateNote: Can only be used while at or below 50% hp, and only in response to taking damage.
Inflict Knockdown on yourself and roll +Disguise/+Deception with a +2 bonus. The nearest creature rolls +Perception👀 against you to determine if you're down for the count and everybody else takes their assessment as fact. You lose the knockdown status at the start of your next turn and your next attack against a creature makes them DD.
This ability only works once each combat. Creatures that have seen you do it in other combats get advantage on their perception.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Adrenaline Burst
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 3 Scoundrel
Tags: Recharge Action: FreeNote:
You cannot use this ability while fatigued.
Take a standard action. You are fatigued when your turn ends. You take a -2 penalty to AC until this fatigue wears off.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Garrote
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 3 Scoundrel Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Make a grapple attack with a +4 bonus that also makes them bleed for 2d6 (7) if successful. While grappled your target is also silenced and cannot remove the bleed.
You do not need to spend any actions to maintain this grapple. Your drag attacks automatically succeed against them while grappled. This resets the creatures poise.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Assassinate
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 4 Scoundrel Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Make an attack roll against a DD creature. The effect varies depending on how much hp the target has remaining.
Not Full HP - Staggers them for 1 round (fort negates) and deals an additional 3d8 (13) damage.
Full HP - Stun them for 1 round and deal an additional 4d8 (18) damage.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Bullet Time
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 4 Scoundrel
Tags: Elusive Action: InstantNote:
Cannot be used while fatigued.
You react instantaneously to the unseen, giving you a +8 bonus to +Perception👀 and a +4 bonus to AC for 1 round. Each time an attack is made against you during this time, you can move 5 feet.After bullet time ends you are fatigued.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Achilles Heel
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 5 Scoundrel Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
