Strike at a creature's tendons dealing an additional 4d8 (18) dmg and applying a unique Status (fort negates). For every 5 feet they move, they take 2 True Damage. If the target is DD, this has no save.Certain effects like teleportation, telekinetic movement or anything else not based on physical locomotion can bypass this effect.
This wound can be healed with a DC 25 first aid check, or by succeeding on a DC 25 CL check with a healing spell/effect.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Clothesline
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 1 Unarmed👊 Tags: -
Action: AoO
When a creature provokes an AoO from movement, you can make a simple Unarmed Attack against them. On-hit, their speed is reduced to zero.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Focus Punch
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 1 Unarmed👊 Tags: - Action: Free
Focus your energy into a mighty punch. For 1 round you take a -10 penalty to +Stealth from you powering up.
If you do not take +HP damage or get poise broken by the start of your next turn, you can make an Unarmed Attack with +10 Attack that deals an additional 2d8 (9) dmg at any point during your turn as a free action.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Improvise
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 1 Unarmed👊 Tags: - Action: Immediate
Scramble to find something to take the hit for you against an incoming attack. Decrease their Attack by 2 and the object breaks. They maintain this -2 attack penalty as their weapon gets stuck in the object. They can remove it as a swift action.Note: Must have a free hand to use this ability. There must also be suitable object with which to block the attack, such as a piece of furniture.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Sucker Punch
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 1 Unarmed👊
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
This functions as though you automatically succeeded on Sucker Punch (P).
Make an unarmed strike against an unassuming creature. They are DD for this attack.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Wake-Up Slap
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 1 Unarmed👊
Tags: Healing Action: Swift
Help an ally snap out of it with the back of your hand. Deal 1 true damage and immediately wake them up from Sleeping or free them from Fascination. If they are confused, add 2 to their rolls.
If they are charmed or frightened, they get a new save against the effect.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Body Slam
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Leve 2 Unarmed👊 Tags: -
Action: Special AttackNote:
This attack must be performed from above the target or combined with a jump action.
Crash onto your foe. This attack inflicts Knockdown on you and your target and deals an additional d8 (4) dmg. If the target is already knocked down, it is instead staggered and takes an additional 3d8 (13) dmg.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Drop Kick
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 2 Unarmed👊
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
Jump into the air and kick your foe with both legs at full force. They take an additional d8 (4) damage. If they are not clumsy, they become clumsy 1 On-hit. If they are clumsy, then you can choose to make them knocked down On-hit instead of making them more clumsy. Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Toe Smasher
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 2 Unarmed👊 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
On-hit smush a creature's toes to limit their movement and deal an additional d8 (4) dmg. They cannot move farther away from you for 1 round. If you are poise broken or forcefully moved out of reach, this effect ends.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Crush Joints
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 3 Unarmed👊 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Bend your foe in ways that cause permanent damage and strike at vulnerable joints. The creature takes an additional d8 (4) crush damage and is made clumsy 2 On-hit. They cannot remove clumsy stacks until it receives first aid.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Roundhouse
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 5 Unarmed👊 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Make a shove attack against a creature with a +8 bonus. If the shove is successful, they are shoved 30 ft. If the shoved creature impacts a creature or terrain, their movement is halted and they both take 6d8+lvl (27+lvl) crush dmg and are knocked down.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Five-Finger Death Punch
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 6 Unarmed👊
Tags: Concentration, Recharge Action: Note:
You can only activate this technique On-hit after landing an unarmed strike
Creature feels their heart stop and gain a stacking debuff (fort changes to Staggered 1 round). For every 5 feet they move on their own, they gain a stack of doom, dying when they reach 5.Wears off after 24 hours.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Super Sandwich
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 6 Unarmed👊
Tags: Buff, Healing, Recharge, Teleportation Action: 1 roundNote: You must decide to use this ability at the start of your turn, and can perform no other actions.
During this turn you shout incredibly loudly and charge your power, creatures cannot exist within 10 ft of you, and are automatically pushed directly away if they try. You are also unstoppable.Once the charging is complete, you immediately regain this abilities mana cost and lose the unstoppable and pushback aura. You have a persistent glowing yellow aura around you and the following benefits…. You can fly and cannot be made clumsy You can teleport instead of moving You gain 30 extra speed You gain 30 temp hp Multiattack: Make 3 unarmed attacks

techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.title: Staff Component
techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.description: Staves, Seals, Wands etc. In general the staff component serves much the same function no matter its shape, but there are some small differences.Staves - Staves are usually long and sturdy pieces of wood. Most of the magical components of the staff are attached to the end of it. Staves can universally be used as weapons.Seals - Seals have an enormous amount of variety to them. But they are typically compact: Some small handheld object, often of spiritual significance. Seals are ineffective unless they are the only thing occupying the hand.Wands - Wands are usually small pieces of wood about in the rough shape of a pencil, but usually a bit larger. Wands come pre-built in with a cantrip.Other sufficiently magical things can potentially be used as magical foci with their own unique benefits such as books giving access to more spells. Dual wielding these items gives +1 CL.Some seal examples...

races/+races.html.title: +Races
races/+races.html.description:
Races don't give ability scores. Now you can choose your race based on what features you want. Bring out the jacked fairies and the clumsy elves!Most races have a racial language, but also know common.All creatures are assumed to have a base speed of 30ft.Keep in mind a lot of the lore I use to describe races is used to differentiate a given race from the others. I personally don’t appreciate when elves are just long pretty people. I also make it to give people a starting point if they don't know how to roleplay or world build with a specific race.The descriptions you find here (or in any source really) are specifically tailored to a setting, or are the brain child of some other fantasy obsessed weirdo. They do not need to match how a specific race exists in your world if you have something else in mind.For example... In the world I built my Lore around, Nack, elves primarily live in a continent known as The Land of Storms which has an absurdly high level of rainfall. As such, they developed a spell to combat it called Umbrella, which Elves often inherently learn, separate from any additional magic training. Doesn't make much sense for a subterranean elf now does it?Note Races very often offer skill bonuses. Skill bonuses from race do not stack unless the two features are a pair of minor and major features. So you couldn't pick goblin and get perception from mixed blood elf's "nice ears" for instance.
The only exception to this is if the skill bonuses only apply to specific circumstances, such as a cyborg's sentinel build.

races/dwarf.html.description: The short and stocky beard dude race

races/human.html.title: Human
races/human.html.description:
The default race.
Humans with the mixed blood major trait replace the traditional half breed races. Other races with the minor mixed blood feature are predominantly the original race, only slightly resembling the other parent. Humans are purposefully designed to be pretty generic.

classes/healer/healer.html.title: Healer
classes/healer/healer.html.description:
Healers are mages that combine natural talent, a breadth of experience, and a compassion for life that results in abilities that lift spirits and mend wounds, both literally and metaphorically. A healer's mere presence commands a high degree of respect, as even a single healer behind the scenes can turn the tides of a battle. For this reason, healers are often involuntarily pulled into conflicts that do not concern them, as every government, army, church, and adventuring group seeks out their abilities, and every enemy of said groups seek to eliminate them.You have Magical Specialization. You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the Brazzeria (T) and goomshroom🍄 trees.
Touch a creature to heal (3+CL) hp. If you Mana Burn 1, you may touch yourself as a swift action. Temp hp granted by this ability lasts 10 minutes.You can unleash a pulse of energy at your maximum power, healing all allies within 60ft for
(5+2*LvL) hp.As a standard action, conjure a magic bow and make a ranged attack with 20ft range. The target takes holy damage equal to Healing Touch. If this attack passes through allies, apply healing touch to them. Holy arrow also heals yourself. This can be used through a staff. This ranged attack counts as being made from a bow.
You are proficient in the +Medicine💉 skill and get a +4 bonus to it.
You can innately cast death ward
You start play with 10 GBP for any gods that are not Demon Lords👿, or are otherwise overtly evil, unless your WIS is -1 or lower.

classes/paladin/archetypes/dashing-hero..title: Dashing Hero
classes/paladin/archetypes/dashing-hero..description:
The ultimate knight in shining armor. Dash into battle with blinding speed to pluck your allies from danger while riding on your noble steed. Your enemies will regret ignoring you to attack innocent bystanders.You gain a point in the pupper tree this level and every two levels after.
You gain Sanctuary as an innate technique, usable at will. As an instant action, you can use sanctuary when an innocent bystander would be directly targeted by an enemy by an offensive ability or attack.
You gain the Pet feat. It also gains the Beast Trainer special training feature. Specifically the mount bonus.
When you Charge attack a creature, any ally or innocent noncombatant it threatens can immediately step away from that creature until they exit its reach. Their movement is elusive. You can use this special attack at will.
Make 2 attacks against a creature threatening an ally that isn't yourself or your noble steed. Make 3 attacks against a creature threatening an innocent noncombatant. You can also make this multiattack against a creature who targeted a creature with a harmful ability and you saved them with Heroic Dash or if you used Sanctuary on an innocent.
As an immediate action, you can move up to your speed, or your mounts speed if mounted, in response to an ally (other than you/mount) being subject to an attack or is caught in an AoE effect. You can move your ally as though taking the carry action as part of this movement. If this places the ally out of range of the attack or AoE of the effect, then they suffer no harm from it.This ability can be used once a minute. If you target an innocent non-combatant, it has no cooldown, and can be used while on cooldown from saving another creature.You can take the carry action as a swift action.Note: Even if something does not directly harm an innocent bystander, doing something like torching a house, or doing some comically evil villain thing like activating a slow moving cage into lava could still qualify.
You can take the Carry action as a free action.
When you carry an innocent bystander, you immediately Dash. You must drop them off in a location they have Total Cover from all enemies. They gain a Divine Shield, are affected as per Sanctuary and do not become Clumsy. If they are defeated, you can use Lay on Hands as a free action on them.

classes/paladin/archetypes/inquisitor.ht.title: Inquisitor
classes/paladin/archetypes/inquisitor.ht.description: Inquisitors heavily lean into ganging up on a single creature, defeating them as quickly as possible before smiting them and doing it all over again.Mark an enemy within 30 feet for judgement as a swift action. Some type of glowing visual effect manifests on the creature while they are judged. All allies get a +2 Attack against this creature.When this enemy is defeated, this ability and smite immediately recharge. If you are unable to defeat this creature within a minute, the mark of judgement disappears from your target and judgement recharges.Make 2 attacks against a creature you have marked for judgement.While in a settlement, you can see a faint glowing trail leading to anybody who shares your faith. If one exists, you can also see a path leading to a place of worship, such as a temple or an altar dedicated to your deity. These paths are visually distinct from one another.By spending a standard action to examine a creature, you can tell whether or not they share your faith.Apply an additional effect to creatures you mark for judgement. Ligma

classes/paladin/archetypes/invincible-ch.title: Invincible Champion
classes/paladin/archetypes/invincible-ch.description:
Invincible champions always heal and never die. Invincible champions are pure tanks with superb ability to draw aggro.Invincible champions get lay on hands at level 1, and it replaces the base feature.You can use the Bloodletting technique at will. It does not pop your divine shield.
As a swift action, spend 1 mana to heal yourself for (5+LvL) hp.
Your constant boasting of how impossible you are to defeat irks your enemies. Allies get +2 Attack against creature taunted by you
Make 2 attacks against a taunted creature. If your first attack taunts, then you can make the second attack.
Make a Charge attack against an enemy. On-hit the target is Taunted for 1 minute. At the end of each of the taunted creature's turns, they can make a Will save to end the effect. You can use this special attack at will.
By spending 1 mana as a standard action, shout out to any enemies within 20 ft of you, insulting them for their weakness or cowardice. They take a -2 penalty to attack against any creature other than you until they deal damage to you. While this penalty persists, they treat all spaces moving away from you as Difficult Terrain.By spending 2 mana, you can target a single creature with this ability as a swift action, but (will negates).
This ability counts as a taunt to fulfill your multiattack condition.

classes/paladin/chivalrous-boons.html.title: Chivalrous Boons
classes/paladin/chivalrous-boons.html.description:
Whenever you stay inside of a settlement, you are able to find lodging through sheer good will. You and up to five creatures can stay at a denizen's house. You are fed and given basic supplies. They are even willing to protect you should danger come knocking, but not risk their lives. Using this feature for many days in a short time frame in the same settlement makes the settlement incompatible with this ability. Certain monstrous or dangerous creatures may be off limits (such as giant carnivorous beast companions) without some convincing. In general you are an ally to the common folk and you will be privy to usually hidden information such as rising civil unrest, local crime usually kept quite through intimidation or secret passageways.1/day you can conjure 6 shiny golden spectral horses. The horses have a speed of 60 and are intelligent enough to follow complex instructions given by the zealot. The horses last until you rest. These steeds can be mounted or dismounted as a free action 1/turn. They otherwise function as the horse bestiary entry, save for they cannot stampede or attack.
As an immediate action when a creature makes a statement (I did not kill the child, the food isn’t poisoned, my name is Bob), you can dispense judgment. You shout and your eyes glow as you point at them dramatically. The creature rolls a will save (with Disadvantage if you passed an +Insight🤔 check to Detect Truth). If they pass nothing happens. If they fail, the truthfulness of their statement is revealed. They glow golden for a few seconds if the statement is truthful, they glow red if they are withholding pertinent information and they glow dark purple if they speak an outright lie. If the creature glows gold, this ability goes on a 10 minute cooldown. Otherwise it is put on a 1 minute cooldown.As a free action you can decide to increase the distance your voice carries. Your voice can be easily heard as though you were shouting nearby from a distance of 500 feet. Once per hour you can cause your voice to be heard 10 miles away for up to 1 minute. Creatures can tell the general direction your voice comes from with this ability. Overuse of this ability will draw the ire of local citizens or creatures.When you perform a task that could be reasonably considered “keeping watch” such as at night on the road or as a guard to a party, you gain a +4 bonus to perception. You do not need to sleep in order to gain the benefits of rest, but the activities you do cannot be intense (reading, patrol, etc.).You can bind creatures to their word. As part of a one minute ritual you can make a request to a willing creature (no killing people, no eating pizza, you must return home). The creature must verbally agree (or the creature’s equivalent like telepathy) for the sacred vow to take hold. You can set additional parameters (you must return home by x day, on foot, go through the trench not over it) as needed for the request to function. The creature who accepted the vow is now bound by their word. If they take an action that is in direct violation of their vow, they must roll a will save or be unable to perform it for 24 hours. The zealot is aware of when the creature takes such an action, and whether they pass or fail the save against this effect, as well as some psychic impressions on the details (they decided to take a vacation on the way home, interrupted by bandits, death by snu snu). They are immediately able to use sending to express their disappointment. This vow can only be removed by the zealot.
You can use your authority to make keeping an enemy alive as prisoner much easier. With a one minute ritual requiring physical contact, you can give a creature the time out condition for 24 hours. A mark appears on the creature akin to a timepiece to indicate roughly how long is left before the effect wears off.
You gain a glowing halo. This can vary in appearance based on your patron deity. In any case, it shows your unquestionable loyalty towards upholding good and honorable behavior. You are unable to roll +Deception to Convince Truth to creatures. In return, you will never be accused of committing crimes without direct clear involvement. You won't be looked upon with suspicion by law enforcement and will always be treated with respect by authority. Your words carry a great weight in matters concerning diplomacy, extermination of evil. and public safety, allowing you audience with powerful leaders such as commanders, kings and such with ease.When an enemy decides to attack or use a harmful ability (defined as something the creature wants to resist) on an ally that is unconscious, a noncombatant, hostage or something similar while they can see the you (or sense you if the creature is like a slug or something), they must roll a will save or be taunted by the you for 1 minute. During this minute, the "innocent" is immune to damage/being moved by this creature. The basic idea is it will interrupt their turn before they already used their actions/movement, so try to be lenient so that way the zealot can get the pain they’re due for protecting innocents. GMs may want to consider having mercy on the zealot in something like a warzone, limiting this ability to only affect the immediate area.
You can even use this ability while Defeated, though doing so will likely result in your death.

lore/planes/feywilds.html.title: Feywilds
lore/planes/feywilds.html.description: Wonderland, the Emerald Dream, the Wild Lands. The Feywilds has many names, but it all refers to the same place. A long time ago, a group of elven druids dreamed of a better world. One where humanity did not, and could not, corrupt the beauty found in nature. They developed magic to visit each other in dreams and create entirely new worlds to exist in while the slept. Sleep was so cumbersome that they eventually developed a technique called trance that would function similarly to sleep, but that could be slipped in and out of much more easily.The waking and dreaming world blurred for some. This caused problems in the mortal realm as many of their people grew increasingly disconnected from what only some considered reality. In secret, the dreamers gathered the research and mana required to perform an elaborate ritual that would forever blur the line between the real and the imaginary. This ritual to create this "dream world" was disturbed and violence ensued. For many, the dream turned into a nightmare. The thoughts, feelings, desires and fears on that day shaped what the Feywilds would become. The dreamers were successful at creating their own world, but not in exactly the way they had hoped.The Feywilds is a plane that is entirely untamed wild land, usually filled with lush green and other bright colors. Any attempts to disturb this natural order by clearing out trees and building structures causes negative feedback from the plane itself. Such structures never last long. The types of creatures that exist in the Feywilds, known as fey, are born from the imaginations of the dreamers. Due to how the ritual went awry, some areas of the dream became nightmares. Many of the dreamers' fey creations were capricious, but those born from the nightmares are outright despicable. The regions they inhabit are dark forests and mist filled swampland that one can never feel safe in.The most well known creatures from the Feywilds are fairies. They are creatures with a wide array of sizes, shapes and purposes. The typical fairy can fit in the palm of your hand and loves to lead people astray for the fun of it. Others work to protect the purity of creatures, conveniently censoring areas considered inappropriate. Then tooth fairies are sinister creatures with an obsession for collecting teeth, especially straight out of a living creature's skull. A few fairies, known as the great fairies due to their size, power and influence, create havens inside of the Feywilds and the mortal realm. These are the most well known ways to get to and from the Feywilds.Other noteworthy creatures include the eternal and hags. The eternal are a race of creature imagined with many of the positive traits of elves, such as their ability to physically change through adulthood, their ability to introspect and learn from long periods of history. They exist in small groups, harmoniously with nature and their communities. The hags are much more sinister creatures. Witches of the wild, hags often live for hundreds of years, using magical rituals to even evade death. They keep in touch with their sisters and gather when they want to perform powerful magic. They have a soft spot in their hearts for mortals, whom they will assist, but always at a greater cost.

lore/planes/the-demon-realm.html.title: The Demon Realm
lore/planes/the-demon-realm.html.description:
You can read more about demons and how they came to be in the bestiary section for Fiends👿In short, certain negative events can cause creatures to transform into entirely different hostile creatures with new outlooks, powers and appearances known as fiends, or more colloquially, demons, devils, daemons etc. Fiends, generally speaking, don't care for much other than to consume, enslave, seek vengeance and destroy what other creatures hold beloved. As such, they are near universally reviled by all. Only the most sinister creatures who seek to direct fiendish hatred towards their enemies think otherwise.Demons can generally be expected to cooperate with each other, or evildoers who align with their interest. Such alliances are generally shaky however, and often result in backstabbing and betrayal, with the terms being renegotiated whenever the demons see an opportunity. Particularly monstrous fiends are virtually impossible to tame.The realm of the demons was created by ancient demon lords looking to escape their would-be hunters in the mortal realm. It was purposefully created to be as hostile to mortals as possible, with complex tunnels, oceans of blood and seemingly endless freezing desserts. The worst of the mortal realm is the norm in the demon realm. The creation of this realm was a double edged sword however. A group of mortals that later became known as the light guardians figured out how to forcefully send demons to this world, effectively turning it into a prison. Banishment, while not a permanent solution, is often the easier one when fiends pour into unprepared villages in droves.
Getting to and from the demon realm can be a bit of a chore without the correct magic. This is by design. The demon lords don't want mortals to freely move in to hunt their forces down. The mortals don't want hoards of demons destroying their countrysides. Only through mortals that betray their kin, or the direct intervention of a demon lord can portals between the realms be opened permanently. Temporary means such as Plane Shift, or for Brazzerians, seeking to purify demons, Hell and Back, also exist as methods to go to and escape the demon realm, but demons are almost never capable of using such magic.
The demon lords themselves vary between the ages, but they tend to fall into 3 distinct categories: Destruction and strength, stealth and slaughter, subversion and subjugation. You can read more about the current demon lords in the Deific Boons section. Each of them has their own domain (large swathes of land thousands of miles wide) where they and their minions reside.

lore/the-world-of-nack.html.title: The World of Nack
lore/the-world-of-nack.html.description:
Where to start? Nack is my version of earth.Nack is filled with humanoids of varying sizes, shapes and lifespans. It has plants and animals, some of which you will recognize, and many you won't. There are plenty of other types of creatures that break our IRL classifications entirely: Elementals that are composed of normally inanimate substances, aliens from other worlds looking to steal our cows and creatures raised from the dead.The various regions of the world all have a story to tell. The Land of Storms is named such because there is a persistent drizzle over the continent, often increasing in intensity in storms. The Underworld is a place hidden away in the darkest reaches of the world, constantly shifting its position to prevent people from trying to get in to bring others back to life.The universe is suffused with magic! Those with the talent to use mana can bend the world to their will. Wizards can use it to conjure fire from their fingertips, healers can use it to cure those burns and warriors can use it to cause the earth to quake beneath their feet. Everybody is born with access to mana, and history is made by civilizations that know how to use it wisely.Gods are tangible creatures that can be interacted with. By acting in your gods name, you can receive insight into situations and special powers. Gods each have their own special interests in the world, such as maintaining the natural order, increasing the quantity of happiness in the world, or killing people just for the fun of it. Particularly dedicated followers may even get the chance to meet their god in person.There are bits of lore scattered all around the website already. The dedicated lore section is more for the world itself, its culture, history, cosmology and noteworthy people.
Each race has its own lore section, gods have lore written in their sections, and eventually so will each bestiary entry.

minigames/chase/random-events.html.title: Random Events
minigames/chase/random-events.html.description: The 1st and 3rd round the DM should roll for events before strategies. These events only last one round. These events can vary wildly based on environment, time of day, weather etc. Events might not do anything, give one side advantage, or create entirely new strategies.Here are some examples.

minigames/chase/win-condition.html.title: Win Condition
minigames/chase/win-condition.html.description: The first thing you must determine in a chase is who is chasing and who is running. This will establish what strategies are available. Chases happen in rounds, with each round of a chase usually representing around 3 rounds of normal combat or ~20 seconds. At the start of each round, one side decides on a strategy for that particular round, determined first by who has advantage, then alternating each round. Strategies often require skill rolls, saving throws etc. Whoever is more effective that round earns a Win.In order to win a chase (either escaping or capturing), you need to earn 3 Wins. When you win as a chaser, it is assumed you manage to corner, bind and otherwise secure the escapees. When you win as the runner, it is assumed you evade your captors in a significant enough way that they are unable to find you without you pulling some dumb shit to get you caught again.

minigames/arm-wrestling.html.title: Arm Wrestling
minigames/arm-wrestling.html.description: Arm wrestling contests are tests of strength that utilize the athletics skill. Each "round" of an arm wrestling contest is effectively like a round in combat for the purposes of determining how long single round buffs last.Each round calls for a contested athletics check, however you start off with lower dice, progressing to higher dice each round with the following progression.Subtract the lower roll from the higher roll. That is how many points the winner of that round gets. The loser of each round gains no points. Once one creature hits 20 points, they win.

minigames/drinking-contest.html.title: Drinking Contest
minigames/drinking-contest.html.description: DC 10 check that increases by 1 for each drink. You add your strength to this roll.On 3 fails you lose.Bonuses that apply to poison/venom also apply to drinking games. Poison resistance gives a +2 bonus on these checks. Immunity is cheating.

classes/druid/archetypes/beast-whisperer.title: Beast Whisperer
classes/druid/archetypes/beast-whisperer.description:
Most druids have a way with animals, but you are truly their maestro. When you succeed on a wild empathy check against a beast, you can communicate a complex set of instructions that are unusual, even uncomfortable, but not physically impossible for the creature. This can include things like a cat or dog walking on 2 legs for a short period, a rat making an unusually large amount of noise squeaking or a fish jumping out of water to do a barrel roll. This beast can also serve as an emissary to its kind in the surrounding area. If you are willing to wait 10 minutes (and the beast in question has a substantial local population), this singular beast can multiply into dozens, or potentially hundreds to perform incredibly unusual activities. A bunch of local cats marching in the streets to your marching orders, a band of differently sized rats squeaking a simple jingle you orchestrate or an entire school of fish moving to make shapes of your choosing as you speak (ex finding nemo).You can only call a group of beasts in this way 1/week.You can always find a general category of beast (something smart, a swimmer, something rideable, beast of burden, a reptile etc) by spending 5 minutes to look around your environment, provided there is one that exists.If you [mana burn], you can will a general category of beast to come to you immediately, even if it isn't native to this environment, so long as it wouldn't quickly die existing where you are.You can never call upon a specific type of creature when you use this feature. Generally speaking, weaker creatures and herbivores are the first to respond.You get advantage on wild empathy checks when used against beasts.As a swift action, you can copy any animal you can see within 30 ft. This transformation gives no boons, merely changes your size/appearance. You can speak normally while in animal form. This transformation lasts indefinitely, but can be ended as a swift action.While transformed you have advantage on disguise checks to go unnoticed if the animal could reasonably be there (dogs in urban areas, birds perched on trees, but not horses in an inn or a dinosaur in the arctic).You can call beasts and magical beasts to your side to aid you in battle. The type of help they provide is something they must be able to do naturally. The entire effect must happen within 60 ft of you and the AoE is a 20 ft radius or a 60 ft line. Each effect that deals damage always does 3d6+CL (10+CL) damage.The effects are not limited to, but should be no more powerful than…This ability has a 1 minute cooldown.
You get the Pet feat.Force a serendipity check, so long as the result includes animals as a major component. You must decide what you want to happen first, then your DM tells you its DC. Negotiate a simpler task if you think the DC is too high.Some examples of what you can accomplish…If you fail the check then nothing happens, potentially making you look like an idiot depending on the setup.Gain a new option with Nature Strikes
You summon a cat/kitten to a spot you can see within 100 ft. The cat immediately starts doing something silly or adorable, like eating a cheeseburger or existing with a silly outfit. Creatures within 30ft of this cat are fascinated for 1 minute (will negates). Creatures that are minions to you get no save.Creature doesn't need to be a cat. Can easily be some other silly animal. Cats just have a high concentration of silly.You get an honorary crown, befitting of a king of beasts.All beasts treat you with the reverence usually only afforded to royalty by their subjects and servants. Unless a beast is under direct control from another creature, or a higher level than you, it will not harm you or otherwise impair you. Nature Strike can be used every other round and commanding large groups of beasts using Band of Beasts can be performed every day.If you stay in the same roundabout area, such as a forest or a valley, all your beast subjects will come to you when your kingdom comes under siege. This could mean the destruction of habitat, hunting on a large scale or particularly ominous creatures moving in. They can give you detailed descriptions about unnatural phenomenon or strange creatures as well as their general location.

classes/druid/archetypes/hive.html.title: Hive
classes/druid/archetypes/hive.html.description:
Your body has transformed to be a suitable home for a specific type of insect. Your symbiosis with this hive gives you the ability to command them. You protect them, they protect you.+2 vs any save with the mind-affecting tag.Mark a location as your territory by allowing your hive to build structures there over the course of a few days. This location is a 100ft radius, centered on a point. Your territory gives the following benefits You have regeneration 1 in your territory You have +4 perception in your territory You have +1 priority in your territory
Your hive watches over the area constantly, using your perception. If they detect something, you know what they see as though you had seen it yourself, even if you are not there (Su). Parts of your body are constantly shifting and moving, making it difficult to pinpoint where your weak points are. You have the amorphous quality, which means to crit you, the enemy needs to roll your AC+12.You can command your hive to attack any creature within your natural reach as a standard action, automatically dealing (2d6+CL) pierce damage.Become the hive. As a standard action, turn the entirety of your body/gear into a large swarm, gaining the following features.You can speak but you are unable to wield a staff in hive form, making you unable to cast spells. You can revert back to your original form as a standard action.You can also choose to host ground borne insects, such as ants. You lose the fly speed and gain a land and climb speed of 40. Your swarm attack damage increases to 3d6.
Any hive of insects under your control also protects your allies. While within the swarm, you allies are treated as though they have cover.When you attack with hive body, you can attack all creatures within your natural reach. Your hive attack applies sickened 1.The size of your territory expands to a 1000 ft radius.Your hive attack staggers for 1 round (fort negates).
You can lose your hive mind and hive body features and have your hive separate from your body as a standard action. Treat it as an insect swarm. It cannot be more than 100 ft away from you, or else it immediately returns. If it is ever defeated, it returns to you and this ability is disabled until you rest. While reunited with you, your swarm has regen 1.If you share a space with your swarm, you can choose to absorb it as an instant action. Your hive is always half your level.You always have a bonus hive defending your territory, functioning exactly as hive separation, but it cannot leave your territory. Your territory increases to a 1 mile radius.

headers.heading: 2 - Hive Consumption poly, true
8 - Hive Separation companion

classes/druid/archetypes/mushroomancer.h.title: Mushroomancer
classes/druid/archetypes/mushroomancer.h.description:
Infect willing, Sleeping or defeated creatures with parasitic spores as a standard action. You can also inflict this upon a creature you have skin to skin contact with as a standard action. This infection deals no damage and has no noticeable side effects or visual symptoms at all.
While a creature is infected, you get a +2 bonus on skill checks made against it. You also know the direction they are from you. You can infect up to 5 people at once. Infecting more forces you to decide to free another. You can remove an infection as a free action.
This infection can be identified and removed with first aid against your DC.You don't just grow mushrooms, you become the mushroom. Every day you can grow 3 mushrooms on your body that contain magic within them that is unleashed when plucked and eaten. The magic is chosen when they are plucked. Plucking and eating/feeding is a single swift action. You can choose to grow new mushrooms with new powers on the following days, but growing new ones drains the magic from the old ones. Mushrooms can be preemptively plucked and handed out to allies so they don’t need to be next to you to consume.In addition to spreading your infection, the mushrooms can have the following effects…By touching a surface, you can cause a tiny toadstool to sprout at that location. In less than ideal environments, they quickly perish. You can choose to leave behind a trail of these tiny toadstools behind when you while you walk.
You can telepathically communicate to any creatures infected by your spores.
1/minute when you fall below half hp, you release a cloud of toxic gas within a 10 ft radius. While within the gas, creatures not infected by your spores are sickened 1 and have blurred vision. These effects persist for 1 round after leaving the cloud.As a swift action, you can cause your creations to glow with bio luminescence. Any creatures you have infected with spores as well as any mushrooms you create with Power Up or Mush Touch glow with a bright light in a 5ft radius.This isn't particularly useful in bright places, but in darkness it can light the way.
Glowing creatures take a -5 penalty to +Stealth and cannot use Darkness to Hide.You can cause dead or decaying organic matter to be overtaken by fungus and accelerate the decomposition process. This can be used to target things like corpses, fallen trees and leaves, or even wooden doors. This typically has the effect of damaging the structural integrity of the object. For something like a small wooden barrier, it only takes a few rounds. For something much larger like a wall or an enormous fallen tree, it can take minutes.This provides sustenance to you, and thus limits its usability. Decomposing something about your size like a door is more like a snack, but a particularly large object like an ornate wooden staircase is like eating a feast all on your own. You may need to wait until you are hungry again to fully decompose such objects.By spending 1 mana, you can animate a tiny mushroom to have little legs and eyes. They perish if attacked, have a speed of 30 and use your perception/stealth scores. You can give them telepathic orders, but they can do little more than keep watch or wander in general directions. They will mentally alert you (waking you up) if you they see something unusual, like an intruder, or something dangerous/scary. You can teach them a specific creature if you wanted them to find someone or something in specific.If they touch a creature, they can transfer your infection. This is usually only possible against incapacitated, friendly or willing creatures. Against an unwilling creature, you must succeed on a melee attack against a DD creature (uses your attack bonus).You can scry through the mushmen. You cannot recover the mana as long as the mushman persists, even if you rest. If the mushman returns to you safely, you recover the mana burn. If it dies, you must rest to restore it. You can willingly dismiss a mushman.
When you get the wet condition, you instead increase 1 size category. Further applications of wet apply normally. You shrink back to normal size after you rest or with exposure to direct sunlight for a few minutes.You can create an additional Power Up each day. Gain additional options.Target a creature more than 30 feet away from. A dangerous and toxic mushroom pops out of your hand and relentlessly follows them for 1 minute. It flies at a speed of 30 at the end of each of your turns, moving in a direct line towards its target. This can lead to the mushroom getting "caught" on solid terrain.
If it ever enters the space of the target creature, or if another enemy enters its space, it is immediately infected. The creature then takes d6 per LvL poison damage (fort halves) and is dazed for 1 round.
Make a mushroom that you can feed to a creature that has died in the last minute to restore them to 1 hp. They become drained 10. Usable 1/month.

classes/druid/archetypes/vegetable.html.title: Vegetable
classes/druid/archetypes/vegetable.html.description:
Your body is host to a variety of plant life. You have wooden parts, blooming flowers, leafy hair, roots growing along your body or moss growing on your face. You add plant to your creature type(s).Gain the following benefits... You are constantly under the effects vine whip, you can use these vines to make a Multiattack Multiattack: Make 2 simple vine attacks You have advantage on stealth in areas with suitable vegetation.
When in direct sunlight, you gain regeneration 1. As a swift action, you can copy any inanimate plant you can see within 30 ft. You can speak normally while in plant form. You can also have the face of someone you know appear along the surface of the plant in leaves or bark. This transformation lasts indefinitely, but can be ended as a swift action.
While transformed you have advantage on +Stealth, +Perception👀, +Disguise and +Deception. If a creature saw you transform or is already very familiar with your voice, you lose the advantage on deception, disguise and stealth.
You have advantage on +Persuasion checks against plant creatures.You can cause the vegetation that grows on you to become dangerously pointy as a free action. Creatures you are currently in contact with take 2d6 (7) pierce damage. Creatures you initiate prolonged contact against, or that initiate contact against you also take this damage.
"Contact" usually refers to extended physical interaction, such as with Grapple or Drag. Brief contact, like with an Unarmed Attack doesn't proc this damage.
You are constantly under the effects of arboreal army, but it lacks the Concentration tag. Their attack increases by 2. If you yourself are currently transformed into a tree, you can use arboreal army with your own tree body.You can use them to perform any combat maneuvers instead of only bullying.You can cause a vegetation to grow instantly. You can choose to grow brush or a young tree.
Tree: Choose an unoccupied space within 30 ft. A tree 20 ft tall with a handful of sturdy branches to climb erupts from the ground. Any enemies within 10 ft of the tree take 20 Poise damage and become Clumsy 2.
Brush: Choose a space within 30 ft. Thick brush forms in a 20 ft radius burst. The area becomes Difficult Terrain. Any enemies in the area take 20 poise damage. Either choice provides suitable vegetation with which to use Arboreal Army, albeit the brush has limited reach. The type of vegetation that grows is native to the area. If no native plants exist, it withers away in a few minutes.
You get to decide what lives and dies. With your touch, you can cause inanimate plants to grow rapidly, functioning as the cultivate function of the Nourish technique, but without the Mana Burn or Recharge tags.You can also cause inanimate plants to wither away and die at a similar speed, dehydrating and losing all color very quickly.
Simply by moving around you can cause the vegetation in the terrain to adjust to your needs as a free action. Branches move to allow you to effortlessly Climb🧗. Grass grows to give you a place to Hide. Flowers bloom to accompany your approach etc. This ability can do anything that an inanimate plant could reasonably do, given time and cultivation, instantly.

headers.heading: 1 - One With Nature (Su) (poly, true)
2 - Bramble Back (persistent)

classes/druid/druid.html.title: Druid
classes/druid/druid.html.description:
Druids focus on the supernatural side of nature: with the ability to commune with it as though it were a person. They choose a specific aspect of nature to focus on, such as plants or animals. The abilities granted to them by Mother Earth🍃 allow them to interact and manipulate these things to a sometimes comical degree.
You have Magical Specialization You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another 2 points every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the Mother Earth🍃, Lunar🌙 or Shroomlette🍄 tree.
You learn the secret language, druidic (see Linguistics). In text form it can only be seen by other creatures that know druidic. You can essentially write secret messages by touching your finger to any natural object (typically boulders and trees) and writing. Any message written in this way can be erased by a creature that knows druidic with ease.
You can speak with animate plants🪴 and Beasts🐻 as though you share a common language. They are able to much better articulate their feelings as though they possessed the intellect of a simple humanoid, but their instincts, desires and attitude toward you remain largely the same.You can also interact with inanimate plants, but these creatures only have the most basic of ideas, only able to give single word answers like yes/no or a direction.When traveling through natural terrain that restricts your movement, such as thick snow or dense jungle, your speed is not affected. All allies that can see you also gain this benefit. After not seeing you for a few minutes, your allies lose this benefit.
Gain the Wild Empathy feat. Its usable on any creatures you can speak to with nature tongue, allowing you to influence plants.You need not roll against inanimate plants, but their influence is incredibly limited, only able to help by shaping their growth for instance. If multiple druids try to influence the same plant, they roll to establish dominance permanently.
Get +Nature🍃 as a skill with a +4 bonus.
You start play with 10 GBP for the Earth Mother🍃, unless your WIS is -1 or lower.

classes/hero/hero.html.title: Hero
classes/hero/hero.html.description:
The Hero is someone who is born for adventure. They have an incredibly diverse skill set to accomplish their goals. The quests of the world seem to gravitate towards them, making sure they are never idle.Choose one of the following 3 options to specialize in...Melee - You gain 10 hp per level instead of 8. Gain martial specialization. Choose a martial technique tree. You gain a technique point in it at this level and every odd level after. You also gain a Multiattack.
Multiattack - Make 2 melee attacks.Ranged - Gain martial specialization. Choose a martial technique tree. You gain a technique point in it at this level and every odd level after. You also gain a multiattack.
Multiattack - Make 2 ranged attacks.
Magic - Gain magical specialization. Choose 2 magical technique trees. You gain a technique point them at this level and every odd level after. Increase your memory by 2.By spending a week in a specific location, such as a house, clearing, or guild hall, you can designate it as home. By spending 1 minute concentrating on a ritual, you can teleport yourself and up to 8 creatures in physical contact with you back home.Requires 1 week to recharge. If the ritual is interrupted, this ability does not require recharge. Does not require line of sight.
Gain 3 skill proficiencies. You gain the Advantage on skill checks you are proficient in. Every level you also gain a skill proficiency from the list below. Each of these is associated with a particular Runescape skill. You must be proficient in a skill in order to gain its skill unlocks.At this level and levels 3, 5, 7, 9 an 11 gain a skill unlock from the combat skills. At this level and levels 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10. gain a skill unlock from the utility skills.
Skills: +Profession🧑‍🌾 (Arson, wood cutting, mining, fishing, cooking, farming), +Knowledge🧠 (+Religion, Arcana, Engineering🤖, Alchemy), +Survival🐾, +Acrobatics⚖Heroes are called to adventure, but there are a handful of quests that are rites of passage for true heroes. More information can be found in the quest subsection.Every hero proudly presents their finest victory in the form of a pet ditto: An ooze creature that can mimic the appearance of a creature that the hero has defeated in battle. It functions as a familiar. It knows a number of transformations equal to your level. If you choose to teach it a new form and it has no more slots, it forgets a previous one permanently. New transformations must at least match the level of its highest known transformation. It starts play only knowing 1 transformation of a level 0 creature. A ditto can never transform into a creatures with class levels.
Your ditto becomes a level 0 copy, losing all defense traits (outside of base stats), offense traits (outside of its attacks) and feats. Its stats are adjusted to be a level 0 creature, effectively subtracting its LvL from things like AC, saves, poise etc. Its hp is 20. Its size is always tiny. It can only communicate in methods the creature it transforms into could.
If it aids you in combat, it gains the companion tag. You can also use your familiar to do a handful of other useful things.
Spying (scrying) - You can sense through your companion at will. Assistant - Your companion can use the aid action to assist you for any skill checks you are proficient in. To My Side (teleportation) - You can concentrate for 3 rounds to teleport your companion to your side.You can choose to also swap any worn equipment, such as armor or magic items, when you take the swap gear action.Gain a new upgrade based on the combat style you chose at level 1, or choose a different combat style you did not choose at level 1.
Melee - As a swift action, you can enter one of 3 stances as a buff. They last until you gain another buff and you can swap between them whenever you like.
Aggressive - Deal 10 poise damage On-hit with melee attacks, or 20 with 2h weapons.
Accurate - Get a +2 bonus to attack with melee attacks.
Defensive - Get a +2 bonus to ACRanged - As a swift action, you can enter one of 3 stances as a buff. They last until you gain another buff and you can swap between them whenever you like. Long Range - Increase your range by 15 on all ranged attacks. Accurate - Get a +2 bonus to attack with ranged attacks.
Rapid - You can make a Simple Attack as a swift action.Magic - As a swift action, you can enter one of 3 stances as a buff. They last until you gain another buff and you can swap between them whenever you like. Long Range - The listed range of your spells increases by 10.
Accurate - Get a +2 bonus to attack with spell attacks
Rapid - You gain the Quicken Spell trait, usable with any cantrip.

classes/hero/hero's-quest.html.title: Hero's Quest
classes/hero/hero's-quest.html.description: Crust The quests for heroes are not always set in stone, you can feel free to come up with new ones, but these are things that exist inside of Oldschool Runescape (the game this class is based off of).Dragon Slayer - Tzhaar Champion - Monkey Business -

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Magical Specialization
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: Characters with magical specialization start play with 6 +Cantrips. They also get points in the Academy📖 technique tree equal to how many technique points they have in their highest tier magical technique tree.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Magical Specialization.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Mana Reserves
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: Mana reserves function exactly like your base mana, except they disappear after used, and only regenerate after you rest. Mana reserves are gained through having positive intelligence, are sometimes given to mage classes and through magic items, often with particular restrictions on their use.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Mana Reserves.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Martial Specialization
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: Characters with martiaa specialization get points in the Warfare⚔ technique tree equal to how many technique points they have in another magical technique tree.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Martial Specialization.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/upcast.html.title: Upcast
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/upcast.html.description:
By spending more mana, you can increase the effectiveness of abilities with the Upcast tag. The degree to which varies by ability. Just because you have enough mana in your pool does not mean you can upcast an ability.
In order to upcast, you must meet a certain level requirement (see mana) in addition to increasing the mana cost. For example Imagination has options up to upcast 5, effectively making that option a level 5 technique, requiring you to be level 9 to use it.

gods/gods/demon-lords/demon-lords.html.title: Demon Lords
gods/gods/demon-lords/demon-lords.html.description: The entities that have the largest degree of influence over the Demon Realm. To say they rule over it would be giving them too much credit. The demon realm is a disgusting and dangerous twisted realm that is beyond control. The demon lords tend to spend a lot more time focused on the mortal realm, always looking to spread their influence among mortals willing to eat the forbidden fruit. In particular many spend a lot of time in their mortal forms to blend in and mingle with mortals, delivering their sales pitch directly to the ears of their would-be followers.Demon lords are themselves demons, but they break the mold, bending the rules of what the typical demon can and can't do. They can transform other creatures into demons against their will, reproduce on their own, teleport long distances and create portals to other realms, among other things atypical of lesser fiends.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/hades.ht.title: Hades
gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/hades.ht.description: Hades is the god of the dead, and the dutiful arbiter of the underworld. Hades and those who work under him attend to the souls of the dead, carefully cataloguing and maintaining records of any souls that pass through the underworld and river Styx. Hades is an entity that takes his job very seriously, and has strict rules that apply to any inhabitants.He is often worshiped by initiate necromancers, much to his dismay. Hades despises necromancy, as it only causes problems for him. More adept necromancers understand the ire their activities bring to him, and tread lightly when around his worshipers.Hades is a massive humanoid with long dark hair and an exceptionally long mustache. Clad in the bones of the fallen, he wears a crimson toga and covers himself in other forms of regalia such as gold and jewels.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/+earthly-deiti.title: +Earthly Deities
gods/gods/earthly-deities/+earthly-deiti.description: Those that reside directly in the realms of mortals. Their domains tend to be much smaller and can often be physically visited, with the potential to even meet the deity in person.

gods/gods/heavenly-deities/brazzeria/bra.title: Brazzeria
gods/gods/heavenly-deities/brazzeria/bra.description:
Her Smoliness the Goddess Brazzeria is the goddess of redemption, often revered by the Hellion😈 her followers create. Brazzeria is unique in that she and her followers can see the good in all but the most depraved of souls. More importantly, they also believe such creatures can be saved. They often form close intimate and personal relationships with people and creatures that many find unsavory. Combine that with their tendency towards acceptance of sexual deviancy and Brazzeria has a mixed reputation.Regardless of what mortals think, the immortal fiends of the world fear Brazzerian priests and priestesses more than anything. Brazzerian missionaries will travel to the fiendish infestations in the world to capture as many as possible for conversion, even traveling into the demon realm itself to keep a steady flow of purification rituals.
Brazzeria is depicted as a light-skinned, small catgirl with feathered wings. Her skin is mostly bare with a few golden tattoos. She wears minimal clothing, preferring to wear the coif portion of a nun's habit, and an ill-fitting one that allows her golden hair to spill out of it. Outside of that she wears stockings and sleeve warmers, leaving a censorship fairy to cover up the rest.

gods/gods/heavenly-deities/heavenly-deit.title: Heavenly Deities
gods/gods/heavenly-deities/heavenly-deit.description: Those that typically reside in realms deemed higher than the realms of mortals. These realms have a greater degree of order and prosperity than most others, with some variety in appearance and structure depending which god calls it their domain.

minigames/chase/advantages.html.title: Advantages
minigames/chase/advantages.html.description: When the chase first starts you need to determine advantage. Whoever has more advantages gets to decide their strategy in the first round of the chase. The party with advantage also gets a flat bonus to their saves, skill checks etc equal to the number of advantages they have over their opponent.Advantage can only be given to one party, so instead of applying to both, it applies to neither. Common forms of advantage include…Note: Each round typically lasts long enough where these circumstances could realistically change. The guards might be familiar with the city, but what about the sewers underneath or the forest outside? Numbers can dwindle as one side gains the upper hand. Etc

random-charts/boons.html.title: Boons
random-charts/boons.html.description: For every point of luck you possess, roll on this chart. Permanent increases to luck also include a bonus boon. You can roll multiple of the same result (for most results), but you can reroll if you aren't feeling like +15 hp is your thing.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: +Cantrips
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description: The magic basics. Cantrips don't cost mana and essentially count as level 0 spells.Cantrips are separated into 2 categories: combat and utility.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Alarming Sigil
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 1 Academy📖
Tags: Sigil Action: StandardYou inscribe a magic rune on the surface of an object. Whenever a creature of at least tiny or larger size enters this area, the sigil triggers, creating one of 2 effects you decided on casting. In either case, you are mentally alerted and awakened if sleeping.Silent Alarm - Only you are mentally alerted. Loud Alarm - A loud sound starts to play and repeat, like beeping. Creatures within 300ft can hear it in ideal conditions.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Amplify
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 1 Academy📖
Tags: Upcast Action: StandardThe touched creature gains the ability to increase their volume much higher than what is normal. Good for getting the attention of crowds, shouting for lost friends and announcing for sports.Upcast 5 - The spell doesn't increase your volume further, but rather allows your voice to carry extreme distances. You are capable of speaking to entire towns, large battlefields and small islands miles wide.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Arcane Lock
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 1 Academy📖
Tags: Dismissible Action: StandardThe spell can only be cast on medium (or smaller) sized objects, like a chest, an average door or a dresser. A visible padlock appears on the object decorated with magic sigils, usually near the point where it needs to be opened. While the lock persists, the object cannot be opened.
As a standard action, a character can get rid of the lock and pop open the object with Brute Force or Thievery. The DC is a flat 23.Any previous instance of this spell disappears if cast again.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Arcane Pocket
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description: Level 1 Academy📖 Tags: - Action: StandardYou create an extradimensional space that can store numerous small items. When you gaze inside you see nothing but a starry sky. It creates a 5x5x5 ft space that can hold 100 lbs of items. The item need not fit into the entrance of the pocket/pouch, only the extra dimensional space. Any excess you attempt to put in spills back out immediately. As long as you know what you're looking for, you can effortlessly pull it out of the space without looking inside. If you turn the pouch/pocket inside out or this spell ends, all of the items spill out.This spell can be made permanent by sewing phase spider web into the fabric (3k gold). You no longer need to prepare a permanent arcane pocket.Any previous instance of this spell disappears if cast again.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Embiggen
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 1 Academy📖
Tags: Buff, Upcast Action: StandardYou increase to large size. If you are already large or larger, the spell has no effect.Upcast - By spending 2 mana, this effect can target an ally with a range of reach.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Feather Fall
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 1 Academy📖
Tags: Air, Upcast Action: ImmediateUsed to save people from deadly falls. The target gently falls 60 ft per round and safely lands on the ground. The spell ends early if the target lands.Upcast 2 - Target up to 4 creatures within 30 ft of each other with the spell.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Free Swim
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 1 Academy📖
Tags: Buff, Water Action: Standard
You gain a swim speed equal to your land speed and the amphibious quality, allowing you engage in underwater combat without a penalty.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Gear Up
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 1 Academy📖
Tags: Concentration, Upcast, Force Action: StandardYou create a magical copy of a non-magical shield or weapon that you think of that doesn't require ammunition, such as a light weapon or a 2h weapon. It deals force damage instead of its usual damage.
If you have an open hand, you can cause the weapon to appear in your hand and you can make a simple attack with it as part of casting the spell.If you cast this spell while you have already conjured gear, the previous gear disappears.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, create an additional piece of gear

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Hidden Power
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 1 Academy📖
Tags: Upcast and 1 elemental damage type Action: StandardUnleash a wave of elemental energy that homes in on a creature, dealing 2d8+CL (9+CL) damage (reflex halves). The damage type can be any elemental damage type and is chosen when cast.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, deal an additional d8 (4) damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Dimensional Anchor
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 2 Academy📖
Tags: Dismissible Action: Standard
You fire an anchor-shaped projectile a creature. Make a Ranged Spell Attack. On-hit, the target is Anchored.The DC to dispel this effect is 13+CL.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Dispel Magic
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 2 Academy📖 Tags: - Action: StandardThe spell can be used in two different ways.
Dispel - You roll a Caster Level check to immediately end a magical effect. The DC is (11+CL of the effect).
Counter Spell - You roll a caster level check to prevent a spell from being cast. This must be done as a prepared action in response to a spell being cast. The DC is (11+CL of the spell). If the spell the creature is casting has a higher caster level than your to dispel magic, you have Disadvantage on your caster level check.
You can use dispel magic on supernatural features, labeled (Su). The creature's CL is treated as (lvl+2).
Passive supernatural effects or prepared innate spells can be reactivated as a standard action.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Mirror Images
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 2 Academy📖
Tags: Figment, Buff, Recharge4 illusory copies appear within your space and mirror your actions. Increase your AC by 1 for every clone you still have. If this bonus AC prevents an attack from hitting or grazing you, you lose a clone.You can only cast this spell once every minute.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Shrink Ray
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 2 Academy📖
Tags: Dismissible Action: StandardThis spell has a different effect depending on what you target. Ally - Creature shrinks down to the size of an action figure, only a few inches tall. It is unable to effectively damage creatures of small or larger size due to its diminutive nature. Their speed is reduced by 15. Any creature can say "big mode" to increase back to their normal size as a standard action.
Enemy - Requires a Ranged Spell Attack. The target creature shrinks to small size on-hit. If already small or smaller, no effect. Object - Targeting an unattended object shrinks it down to 1/10th of its original size. Divide its weight by 100. The object can be no larger than 5x5x5 ft. No matter the target, shrink ray can only affect 1 creature or object at a time. If you cast the spell again then all previous instances of it end.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Elemental Shield
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 4 Academy📖
Tags: Buff and 1 elemental damage type Action: Swift
While this spell is active, you are wreathed in an elemental damage type of your choosing. You gain resistance to this damage type. 1/turn when you take damage, you can cause the spell to retaliate as an instant action, dealing (CL) damage of your chosen damage type to the creature that did the damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Plane Shift
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 4 Academy📖
Tags: Teleportation Action: 1 minute
Focus: A tuning fork
You concentrate for a minute on your destination, then appear in a location on another Plane. The recipients of this spell must be in physical contact with each other.
You must have an idea of where you would like to go in order to use this spell. Roll a +Planes check and subtract your result from 40. That is how many miles you appear off course from your desired location. The minimum distance is 1 mile off course.Tuning forks are made out of material native to the plane. They are difficult to obtain without first visiting that plane or purchasing them from specialized vendors.This spell does not require line of sight.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/ac.title: Academy
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/ac.description: The generic magic techniques available to all mages. Includes many generally useful spells, as well as spells that help branch into other technique trees like hidden power.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/arc.title: Arcane
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/arc.description: The magic-y magic that has no real life analogue. Primarily focused around dealing force damage using projectiles, conjured weapons and S P A C E magic.

techniques/magical-techniques/brazzeria-.title: Circle of Sealing
techniques/magical-techniques/brazzeria-.description:
Level 2 Brazzeria (T)
Tags: Mana Burn Action: 1 minute
You move around to inscribe a circle on the ground, then infuse it with mana to cause a tangible but transparent barrier to appear, sealing the fiend inside of it. The fiend is unable to pass through this barrier, or go under/over it. It is anchored and siphoned while inside. Otherwise the fiend may act as they wish.
If the barrier is ever damaged from the outside, it automatically breaks, and so care must be taken to protect trapped demons. Brazzerians usually use this spell to interact with the fiend to get to know them better to prepare for Brazzerian Purification.
This spell functions only on Level 4 or lower fiends👿.Upcast - Each additional mana spent increases the level of the fiend you can trap by 2.

techniques/magical-techniques/brazzeria-.title: Head Pat
techniques/magical-techniques/brazzeria-.description:
Level 2 Brazzeria (T)
Tags: Healing Action: Swift
You roll a caster level check to immediately end a harmful status effect. The DC is (10+CL of the effect). For non-spell effects its (10+inflicting creature's LvL). If the status is removed, the creature heals 5 +HP. If you do not remove a status effect, it does not heal hp.
This spell cannot be used in order to remove permanent status effects, like drain, exhaustion, a curse or an affliction.

techniques/magical-techniques/brazzeria-.title: Simp
techniques/magical-techniques/brazzeria-.description:
Level 2 Brazzeria (T)
Tags: Curse, Charm Action: Standard
You inflict the curse of the simp on a defeated or willing creature. The creature is permanently charmed. All interactions between you and the creature are inherently positive to the creature. Stepping on them is a massage, insulting them is advice etc. When the creature is asked about you, they have nothing but positive things to say and you can do no wrong.
While they are not compelled to do anything that you ask necessarily, they do go out of their way to help in ways that don’t require much effort on their part, and they are very easy to convince. You get advantage on any skill check versus this creature.If you affect the creature with an effect that deals damage or otherwise harms them, then they get a will save against the curse (also applies if they see/find out you told someone else to do so).By going outside and touching grass, the curse ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/brazzeria-.title: Brazzeria (T)
techniques/magical-techniques/brazzeria-.description: Brazzeria embodies the struggle people face when their beliefs clash with reality and their desires clash with their duties. She has a reputation for normalizing what would otherwise be considered taboo in most other types of relationships. In the eyes of her followers, almost no evil is too great to be beyond redemption. As such, it isn’t uncommon to find her followers frequenting the same place as fiends on the mortal plane. It is a constant battle of wills; satisfying your deepest desires while avoiding the descent into deepest depths of profanity.Brazzeria spells are a mix between useful spells for battling fiends, healing and horny spells.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Fog Cloud
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 1 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Air, Water, Concentration, Upcast Action: Standard
Cause a fog cloud to roll into the area and linger for a bit. Creatures outside of the fog cloud can only see 5 ft into it. Creatures inside of the fog cloud can only see 5 ft in front of them. Even still, such creatures have partial concealment.
Creatures beyond 5 ft of fog have total concealment.
Upcast 4 - The fog becomes much thicker. Creatures treat it as difficult terrain. It can also soften falls.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Lightning Rod
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 1 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Prepared, Zap Action: -
As an immediate action, you can choose to direct any effects with the zap tag to yourself, provided you are within range 30 ft the effect's origin or destination.You can use yourself as a target for any effects that require multiple creatures to chain zap effects and are immune to allied zap effects without reducing the number of creatures it effects.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Lightning Strike
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 1 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Martial, Zap, Concentration, Upcast Action: Swift
Electrify a melee weapon, natural attack or unarmed strike. Concentrate until you land an attack with it. On hit the electricity arcs to another target within 15 ft. All secondary targets take the entirety of the attacks damage as lightning damage (reflex halves). They do not suffer any of its on-hit or additional effects. You choose the targets.If you are disarmed of the weapon you cast this spell on, you cease concentration and the spell ends.Upcast - Every additional mana spent allows you to increase the number of additional targets by 1.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Storm Stomp
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 1 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Air Action: SwiftYou take a step forward and whip up winds around you knocking any creatures within range back 5 feet (fort negates).

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Finger Gun
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 2 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Air, Upcast Action: Standard
You point your finger at someone and then snap your fingers with your thumb pointing towards the sky. You unleash a powerful concentrated stream of air at a creature, requiring a Ranged Spell Attack. The attack deals 3d8+CL (13+CL) crush damage. The creature is staggered for 1 round (fort negates).Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Wind Wall
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 2 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Air, Concentration Action: Standard
All ranged attacks passing through the wall take a -4 penalty to Attack unless they originate from a +Siege Weapon. Exceptionally small creatures such as insects cannot pass through the wall. The wall can also reasonably protect against things stopped by wind like swarms or harmful gases.
Moving through the wall costs 15 ft of movement. Creatures that opt to stand inside of a wind wall are clumsy 2 until they exit.You can choose to make the wall in 2 shapes. Wall - 20x40 rectangle Castle - 10ft cube

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Call Lightning Storm
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 3 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Concentration, Upcast, Zap Action: StandardAs part of casting the spell, and as a standard action every turn after, you call down a lightning bolt to strike a specific creature within 60 ft of you. The creature takes 2d8+CL (9+CL) zap damage (fort halves).Upcast - For each additional mana spent, target an additional creature with each lightning strike.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Lightning Bolt
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 3 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Zap, Upcast Action: Standard
Lightning erupts from your fingertips and bounces around the battlefield from enemy to enemy. You initially target a single creature, then the lightning bounces from that target to another target of your choosing (that you can see) within 10 ft. You affect a total of three creatures. Each creature affected takes 4d8+CL (18+CL) zap damage and is staggered for one round (fort halves damage and negates stagger).Upcast - For each additional mana spent the lightning bolt bounces to an additional target. The additional targets can also be 5 ft further away.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Storm Step
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 3 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Upcast, Air Action: Standard
The direction of the wind changes to briefly haste you. As part of casting the spell, dash and disengage🏳. Creatures within your natural reach at the end of your turn take 3d8+CL (13+CL) crush dmg (fort halves) and poise damage.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Temperamental Tempest
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 3 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Air, Concentration, Persistent Action: StandardYou create a tornado about the height of a man that rapidly moves around the battlefield tossing around foes. Immediately after casting and for an additional 2 rounds at the start of your turns, it barrels in a line of your choosing 30 feet.
