Enemies within its path are tossed in a random direction 10 ft, take 2d6+CL (7+CL) crush damage and are knocked down (fort negates dmg, knockback and knocked down).

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Tempest
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 6 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Recharge, Air, Weather Action: 1 minuteYou bend the wind to your will, and you will it to destroy. Over the course of the cast time, the weather worsens, giving creatures the opportunity to run and hide. Wind speeds increase to the extent where even heavy objects get picked up and tossed around. All but the most sound structures are damaged and weak structures are outright destroyed within minutes.
You gain a fly speed (60) while within the area of the spell and cannot be made Clumsy. Other flying creatures are automatically clumsy 4 and all ranged attacks have a -4 penalty to attack.
Creatures without proper protection, that don't take shelter and lack proficiency in the +Athletics🏊 skill are whipped up by the winds and tossed 30 feet in a random direction every turn, taking 2d6+CL (7+CL) crush and poise damage. Creatures that take shelter are generally safe, while those that have protection and/or have athletics can roll checks (spell DC) each turn they move through an open area affected by this spell or they are tossed.In areas where numerous loose objects are plentiful, you can use a standard action to command the winds to blow them at your enemies. The objects deal 4d6 (14+CL) physical damage (reflex halves), with the AoE being determined by the size of the object (max huge).You are immune to the effects of the wind and any objects that might get tossed your way.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Clairvoyance (T)
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description: Clairvoyance is leader and mother to all cloud giants. She and her children dominate the mountainous northern region of the world plagued by all manner of windstorms and blizzards. She covets wealth in all of its forms and regularly uses her power and influence to steal from those that think they can live in her cold and desolate corner of the world.Clairvoyance’s spells are centered around the manipulation of wind, storms and lightning.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Corruption
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Demons, fey, undead and all manners of evil mages manufacture malefic methods of harming their enemies and the world around them. The corruption tree focuses on making everybody else miserable. Curses are their favorite method of delivering this suffering.
Curses are permanent debilitating status effects that sometimes have a degree of freedom over the types of curses are inflicted. All but the most powerful of curses have some finite, actionable and often unusual way to lift them (which can be found out by using the "identify affliction" function of +Medicine💉

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Cryomancy
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-snowflake" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><line y2="12" x2="22" y1="12" x1="2"></line><line y2="22" x2="12" y1="2" x1="12"></line><path d="m20 16-4-4 4-4"></path><path d="m4 8 4 4-4 4"></path><path d="m16 4-4 4-4-4"></path><path d="m8 20 4-4 4 4"></path></svg>
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description: Ice magic! Frequently slows and restricts movement.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Fraudgg
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 1 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: StandardYou enchant a friendly frog to give off an aura of excellence, as though it were rich, famous or well renowned. People treat this frog as though it were a person of high importance, accommodating for its small stature whenever they can.You can give this frog a set of simplistic orders such as "enter that restaurant and buy a steak" or "pretend to be a lifeguard at the beach." It will dutifully perform these tasks to the best of its ability.
Only creatures that directly interact with the frog get a save against the enchantment (ie the waiter or someone the lifeguard saves). Creatures who minions to you do not get a save.If you cast the spell again, the frog harms anyone or someone kisses the frog, the spell ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Lucky Star
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 1 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Force, Upcast Action: StandardYou point at your foe and a star-shaped projectile unerringly falls upon them, dealing d20 force damage.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, the star bounces, affecting an additional creature within 10 ft of the previous.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Oh my Frogg
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 1 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Contingent, Mana Burn Action: 1 minuteThis spell manifests itself as a rainbow box floating above your head with a question mark on it.
Before you would normally be affected by a hostile (non-cantrip) spell, you change the nature of the magic into something completely different (will negates). The spell changes to another spell of the same level with you as the primary target or origin point of the spell, regardless of its typical range/targeting. Make saves as appropriate.Some spells may have other restrictions like material components. Ignore them.
Upcast spells count as spells of a higher level.Level 1 (d4)
1 - Time Shudder
2 - Charming Gaze
3 - Bloodbath (caster immediately takes bleed damage)
4 - Cure WoundsLevel 2 (d4)
1 - Hysteria
2 - Dead Silent
3 - Detect Thoughts
4 - Mirror ImagesLevel 3 (d4)
1 - Enfroggen
2 - Ice Beam
3 - Cosmic Cage
4 - Afterimage (afterimage always cosplays a frogg)Level 4 (d4)
1 - Call Cheese Storm
2 - Curse of Blindness
3 - That's All Folks!
4 - Sacrificial Heal (transfers CL hp)Level 5 (d4)
1 - Doom
2 - Rainbow Beam
3 - Telekinetic Thrust
4 - Inferno SphereLevel 6 (d4)
1 - Rod of Roasting
2 - Elden Memes
3 - Possession
4 - Invisibility

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Plague of Frogs
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 1 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Upcast, Poison Action: StandardYou conjure a spectral frog that slowly jumps towards an enemy. Each round it moves 20 feet closer to the target. Once it moves into the targets space, it explodes in a cloud of toxic gas, dealing 2d8+CL (9+CL) poison damage (fort halves). If it survives its first turn without hitting its target, it deals an additional 10 damage when it explodes.The frog does not take into consideration difficult terrain, and will hop directly into the air towards a foe. It cannot pass through walls and will move around them if the target moves out of sight.If any creature enters the space of a frog, willingly or unwillingly, then it immediately explodes.Upcast - For each additional mana spent (max 2 additional mana) add another frog that targets a different creature.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Power Overwhelming
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 1 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Buff Action: Swift
Cause the creature to surge with unbelievable power as their body rapidly deteriorates. They get a +4 bonus to all d20 rolls, non-Spell Attack damage rolls and CL. This bonus cannot be added to something twice. After the buff ends, they take 50% of their max hp in true damage.
If the creature is not Defeated from this damage, they become Drained 2.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Spontaneous Combustion
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 1 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Fire Action: Swift
Randomly set a creature ablaze. All enemies within 30 and yourself are suitable targets. You are always lit ablaze on a 1.Pro Tip: Consider using a dice larger than the number of creatures for uneven numbers and then re rolling unsuitable results.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Tentacles for Arms
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 1 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: poly, chimeric Action: Free
One of your arms transforms into several muscular writhing tentacles, reaching for nearby creatures autonomously. At the end of each turn, they roll a grapple attack with a +4 bonus against a random creature within your natural reach, even if you are unable to act. If you do not threaten a creature, then they grapple you.You cannot willingly end a grapple made by the tentacles.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Time Shudder
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 1 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Concentration Action: SwiftYou emit waves of entropy, hindering or helping ALL creatures nearby (including you). Immediately upon casting and at the start of your turn unleash a pulse to determine the effects of the spell for one round. There is a 50% chance to Hinder and there is a 50% chance to help.
Hinder - Creatures are staggered
Help - Creatures gain an additional 30 speed and their movement is elusive

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Hysteria
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 2 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: Standard
You laugh maniacally and revel in the chaos. All creatures in the radius of the spell MUST make a simple attack against the nearest creature. If they do not have a means to attack, such as not being in range, then the spell does not affect them. The order that creatures make the attacks is as follows: The caster, their allies, neutral parties, their enemies.
The caster is allowed to use a special attack instead of a simple attack.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Laser Pointer
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 2 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Light, Concentration Action: Standard
You use your finger to point at something and a little red light appears on the surface in the space of a creature. The creature is Fascinated by this tiny red light (will negates, mindless creatures and animal intelligence get a -2 penalty to this save). If the creature is not in combat then it follows the light with a playful curiosity, trying to catch it. The creature will not go anywhere it is incapable or that is inherently dangerous.You must spend a standard action each turn to maintain the light. When you do, you can move the light up to 30 feet a round to guide the creature's movement.If the creature is currently engaged in combat, they spend their move action following the light, but still have any other actions.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Mind Maze
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 2 Frogg Saran🐸
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: StandardYou alter a target's perception to make it think it needs to move in specific directions around invisible walls in order to reach it's intended location. At the start of the creatures turn, it moves 15 ft in a random direction, even if that brings them to a very dangerous position, such as off a cliff.
Aside from this movement, the creature is unable to move further. If something prevents the creature from moving, such as being Entangled, then it does not move.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Reincarnate
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 2 Frogg Saran (T)🐸 Tags: - Action: Standard
You transform a race🏁 into another random race. They are (usually) reborn as a completely different race. They replace all of their previous racial traits with the racial traits of the new race, making the same choices they had during character creation for things such as alternate racial features.Use the following chart determine what race the spell transforms the creature into. Campaigns where more races are present, feel free to add more options to the chart. If the race is incompatible with your campaign, then reroll until you find an appropriate race.
Special: A Lunatic that casts reincarnate gains a luck dice 1/day.
Special: You can reasonably cast this on any creature, changing it into another similar type of creature (ogre into troll) for instance. This can create some complications, even if LvL is adjusted, since they get more powerful abilities. Choose carefully what gets changed.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: WonkaS
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 2 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Teleportation Action: SwiftYou open up a portal underneath yourself and a random enemy within range you can see. The portal violently sucks the creature into it, forcing the creature to swap places with you.
If the creature is Anchored, roll a new target.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Confuse Ray
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 3 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Light, Pattern, Persistent, Concentration Action: Standard
A ray of light shines down on a point, and mysterious motes of light fly around and distort creatures' perception of the world around them. Any creature that starts its turn inside of, or moves into the ray of light becomes confused (will adds 4 to confusion rolls).You can direct this light as a standard action on subsequent turns, moving it 20 feet in a straight line. All creatures along its path are subject to its effect.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Enfroggen
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 3 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: poly, baleful, Curse Action: Standard
You transform a creature into a frog. The caster is unable to attack, cast any spells that affect this frog or otherwise harm it in any way, even when magically compelled to do so. The creature gains the following qualities from the Polymorph List🧬.
Another creature must spend their standard action to kiss the frog to transform it back. The un-frogged creature is dazed on its next turn and charmed by the creature who kissed it for 8 hours. This secondary effect is a charm effect.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Eye of Sneko
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 3 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Curse Action: Free
You change the pupils of your eyes to match that of the mysterious serpent Sneko, afflicting you with its curse. Whenever you spend mana, roll a d4.
1 - The mana cost is decreased by 2. Gain a luck dice that persists until the curse is removed. 2 - The mana cost is decreased by 1 3 - The mana cost is increased by 1 4 - The mana cost is increased by 2You can choose to spend mana in excess to your current mana as long as you could potentially reduce the mana cost to your remaining mana or less. If the mana cost exceeds your remaining mana, you mana burn the excess. If the mana reduction exceeds the mana cost, you regain mana.To remove the curse, you must T-pose and perform no actions for 1 full round.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Hot Potato
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 3 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Fire Action: StandardYou cause a smoldering potato to appear in a creatures free hands, in their pocket, or otherwise lodged on their person. It is uncomfortable to the touch, but does not deal damage. It vibrates and pulses with greater intensity as time passes, culminating into a powerful condensed explosion on the 3rd round, dealing 6d12+CL (33+CL) fire damage to whoever is holding it.
The potato must be possessed by someone, and can only be removed by the creature who currently has it giving it to someone else as a standard action, requiring its own successful Attack Roll roll or poise break, or else the transfer fails.For clarity... Turn 1 - Cast Spell Turn 2 - nothin' Turn 3 - Explodes violently at the end of your turn

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Taste the Rainbow
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 3 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Force, Upcast Action: Standard
You launch a beam of energy at a creature that rapidly changes between the seven colors of the rainbow. Make a Ranged Attack against a creature that deals 4d8+CL (18+CL) force damage, then roll to see which effect happens on-hit.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, shoot an additional ray at a different creature.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Call Cheese Storm
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 4 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard Material: 1000g of cheese, weighing at least 100lbs
You make a cheesy sacrifice to the god of madness. He blesses you by generating a storm of cheesy goodness. Cheese wheels fall from the sky, damaging friend, foe and terrain alike. Any creature without some kind of cover from the harsh weather takes (CL) crush damage at the start of each of their turns.The effect on the surrounding terrain varies based on how durable it is. Many settlements will experience broken windows and plenty of casualties. But with great sacrifice comes great reward: This spell generates a mountain of edible cheese.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Chimpanzee Bolt
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 4 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Companion, Recharge Action: Standard
You summon a chimpanzee, functioning as a medium sized harambe, and it immediately flies at high speeds towards the target of this spell. Make a ranged attack that deals 5d8+CL (22+CL) crush damage.Hit or miss, the chimp lands adjacent to the target. During the first turn you summon it, you can command it to better strategize. Every turn after it attacks creatures randomly until it is defeated, focusing on whatever creature is closest.This spell can only be cast 1/minute.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Self-Destruct
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 4 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Force, Recharge, Upcast Action: StandardYou explode violently, setting yourself to 0 hp. All creatures within 20 ft of you take 30+CL force damage and are knocked back 20 feet (reflex halves).
Caster gains a T2 affliction.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by 7.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Doom
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 5 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Necrotic Action: StandardDrain the life from the world around you in a massive burst that has a rebound effect proportional to the number of creatures you hit with it.
Deal 7d8+CL (31+CL) necrotic damage to creatures other than you in the spells radius. For every creature you hit, you take d6 (3) true damage and gain 1 mana reserve that lasts until you rest.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Rain of Frogs
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 5 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tag: Concentration Action: StandardA bunch of storm clouds roll in, even while indoors, and rain hundreds of frogs upon the area. The situation grows more dire with each passing round at the start of your turn.Round 1
A mere frog drizzle. The area is considered difficult terrain to any non frog creatures. Creatures with at least T1 Deific Boons from Frogg Saran🐸 also ignore this difficult terrain.Round 2
A frog downpour. The area is considered impassable terrain for any non frog creatures. Any non frog creatures still in the area are entangled, unable to effectively move through the lake of frogs. Creatures with at least T2 Deific Boons from Frogg Saran🐸 also ignore this entangling.Round 3
A frognado. The frogs, and any creature in the area of the spell is lifted into the air and thrown 30 feet in a random direction. The frogs quickly dissipate afterwords. Any non-frog creatures and objects are staggered for 3 rounds and take 6d10+CL (33+CL) crush damage. Creatures with at least T3 Deific Boons from Frogg Saran🐸 also ignore damage/stagger (but not the knockback).

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Tastier Rainbow
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 5 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Force, Concentration, Persistent Action: StandardYou launch a wave of rainbow of energy. All creatures in the area take 6d8+CL (27+CL) force damage, then roll a bonus effect for each individual creature (reflex halves the damage and negates the additional effect).The rainbow persists for three rounds, creatures that enter the area of the rainbow or end of their turn inside of it must make additional saves. You can walk on the rainbow as though it were a solid object without issue.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Madness Consumes You
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 6 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Recharge, Mind-Affecting Action: Standard
All creatures in the radius of the spell become confused. All results of "confusion ends" are instead treated as "babble incoherently."

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Mystery Box
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 6 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Recharge Action: Standard
You form a direct conduit with Frogg Saran🐸 himself, allowing his magic to flow through you. Roll to select a random spell list, using the born again believer list, then cast a random spell of each spell level on that spell list (up to fifth level). Targets of these spells are chosen randomly from all legal targets. If a spell generates an area of effect then it chooses a creature randomly to center this effect on. If a spell does not have a suitable target then it fizzles, producing no effect. You do not need to concentrate on any of these effects.You are always considered a willing and available target for all effects that can affect your creature type. Frogs and frog-like creatures are fair game for this spell.
A target is considered "legal" if its targeting is allowed. For example, if you roll the Frogg spell list and get lucky star, you count the number of creatures in range, then roll randomly to see who gets targeted. However, if you roll necromancy and get corpse explosion, but you don’t control any undead, there are no corpses within range and you aren't undead yourself, then that particular spell fizzles.You can only ever cast this spell once.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Rod of Roasting
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 6 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Fire, Healing Action: Standard Focus: 1 staffYou plant your staff into the ground and it ignites in flames. The flames take the shape of a frog and start laughing maniacally, telling a joke or saying proverbs unfit for the current situation.At the end of each of your turns, the frog launches an intense fire blast at a creature the rod has line of sight to within 60 ft, chosen randomly between all creatures. Creatures takes 10d8+CL (45+CL) fire damage (reflex halves). Touching or trying to physically move the stick also triggers this effect on the creature that touched it.
If you are the last one standing within a 60 ft radius of the rod when the spell ends, you refund the the mana cost of this spell, you gain a luck dice, your staff returns to you and you gain 60 temp hp.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Frogg Saran (T)
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description: Ever since his rebranding from the god of death back in the old days, Frogg has grown a lot more popular.Frogg Saran is chaos incarnate. He is known to give blessings and curses in equal measure. Frogg Saran🐸 is a very active force in the world of Nack, worming his way into many peoples lives whether they like it or not. All this god seeks is to increase the amount of entropy in the universe. His followers start riots and revolutions merely to change the status quo. They reincarnate people for funsies just to see the reaction to their new body.Frogg spells are categorized by their randomness and propensity to inflict madness or strange behavior, generally favoring the caster.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/g.title: God Mode
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/g.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-alarm-clock" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle r="8" cy="13" cx="12"></circle><path d="M12 9v4l2 2"></path><path d="M5 3 2 6"></path><path d="m22 6-3-3"></path><path d="M6.38 18.7 4 21"></path><path d="M17.64 18.67 20 21"></path></svg>
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/g.description: God mode magic involves manipulating things people generally perceive as constants, such as time and distance.

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Disc of Light
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 1 Golden Order
Tags: Light, Holy, Persistent, Upcast Action: StandardYou throw a disc of light that boomerangs back to you at the start of your next turn. Make a
ranged attack and compare the result to every creature within a 30 foot line. Each creature takes (6+CL) holy damage.The disc persists at the end of its range, automatically dealing its damage to creatures that move through that space. At the start of your next turn, the disc returns very quickly in a line directly back to you dealing half the damage again automatically, requiring no roll.If you spend an immediate action, you can catch the disc, allowing you to throw it again at no cost. If you do not throw it again on your next turn, it disappears.If the disc impacts solid terrain (such as a wall) on either the way out or the way back, it halts in place.The discs give off light in a 20 ft radius.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by 4.

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Epitaph of Finality
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 1 Golden Order
Tags: Concentration, Upcast Action: Swift
You sing out to the creature, inflicting drained 1. If it is defeated while this spell is active and it does not have regeneration, it is instantly and utterly consumed in holy flames, leaving behind only ashes. If it has regeneration, this spell will cause them to become dazed for one turn upon revival.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase drained stacks by 1.

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Oath to Order
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 2 Golden Order
Tags: Buff, Language-Dependent, Light Action: Swift
You recite an oath with your target, bolstering their courage in the face of darkness. The target sheds light out to 20 feet, granting them a +4 bonus to +Intimidation😱 vs Aberrations👽,
Undead💀 and Fiends👿
Allies within this light get resistance to fear, darkness, and effects that inflict the Blinded or Blurred Vision status effects.

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Radiant Burst
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 2 Golden Order
Tags: Holy, Light Action: StandardYou manifest a shining light and cause it to flash brightly before extinguishing. Creatures are blinded for two rounds (reflex negates). A creature can make a new save against this effect at the end of its turn.
Aberrations👽, undead💀, fiends👿 and creatures with light sensitivity take 10 holy damage (no save).

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Repelling Light
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 3 Golden Order
Tags: Light, Concentration Action: Standard
You create a globe of bright light. Aberrations👽, undead💀, Fiends👿 and creatures with light-sensitivity that start their turns inside or attempt to enter this zone immediately recoil, using their movement to escape the zone if possible (will negates), or suffering -2 Attack if they do not.

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Rings of Light
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 3 Golden Order
Tags: Holy, Persistent, Light, Upcast Action: StandardYou throw many radiant rings that deal 4d8+CL (18+CL) holy damage (reflex halves).The rings persist at the end of the cone, forming a line that automatically deals their damage to creatures that move through their spaces. At the end of your next turn, the rings return very quickly directly back to you in a straight line, dealing half the damage again automatically (no save).If any of the rings impact solid terrain (such as a wall) on either the way out or the way back, they halt in place. Any that don’t continue on their usual path.The discs give off light in a 20 ft radius.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Deific Presence
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 5 Golden Order
Tags: Concentration, Holy Action: StandardYou assume a position akin to prayer before you throw your arms to the side and assume the pose of deific power. You radiate intense waves of holy energy that ramp up over time, damaging all enemies within 20 ft. You move at -15 speed while casting this spell. You must spend a standard action each round to continue concentrating.Round 1 - 5d6+CL (17+CL) holy damage (reflex halves).Round 2 - 5d8+CL (22+CL) and increases the DC by 4.Round 3 - 5d10+CL (27+CL) and no longer has a save.
Any creature that fails its save (or automatically on round 3) versus this spell is staggered for 1 round.

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Threnody of Vengeance
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 5 Golden Order
Tags: Buff, Concentration Action: ImmediateNote: Maintaining concentration on this spell consumes your swift actions.
You cast this spell in response to an ally being dominated, frightened, defeated, or killed. The ally is stunned for as long as this spell persists, but a golden flaming duplicate of themselves emerges from their space, able to act in their stead. The ally controls the copy, and still consumes its resources if the clone uses any.
The copy has half of their maximum hit points, has no negative conditions copied over, and is taunted by whatever caused them to be the target of this spell. If the effect is not a result of a particular creature, or the original creature is defeated, it is instead taunted by the nearest enemy.If the stunned condition is removed, the ally is no longer dominated/frightened/defeated/slain, the copy is slain, or the ally wills it to end at any point, the spell ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Elden Memes
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 6 Golden Order
Tags: Holy, Concentration
Action: FRA You create a condensed ball of divine energy and release it into the world. Every round on your turn, the ball of light gently floats towards a target you designate at the time of casting at a speed of 30 feet. If the ball gets within 30 feet of the original target, it starts to gently circle around them clockwise instead of moving towards them. All enemies within 30 feet of the ball at the end of its movement each turn automatically take (CL) holy damage from projectiles that rapidly fire in all directions around it.If the original target is ever defeated, then a new target can be selected as an instant action.On the 3rd round, the ball advances rapidly towards the original target and explodes in their space. If the original target is dead, unconscious or has managed to get more than 300 feet away, it instead explodes immediately. The explosion deals 7d8+CL (31+CL) holy damage (reflex halves) in a 20 ft radius to all enemies.

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Golden Order
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description: Golden order spells are focused around unleashing divine power in the form of holy spells and punishing the wicked.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Goomshroom
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description: The Shroomlette🍄 is an entity that represents the bond between gooms, a breed of squishy draconic creatures, and shroomkin, a race of people with close ties to fey and mushrooms. These two groups live in tandem with each other with one main goal: increase the quantity of happiness in the world. The tactics they use to do so is to subdue creatures that decrease happiness and physically change the world around them to make it a better place to live.Shroomlette spells either inspire teamwork or incapacitate creatures in some way, often through the manipulation of water. Includes many oddities mimicking the special abilities of gooms and shrooms.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Dark Lure
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 1 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Subtle Action: StandardA nearly invisible whip of shadows emerges from your staff and wraps around a target. The target is pulled towards you in a subtle way that makes it feel like it is of their own volition. On their next turn, they spend all of their movement to move closer to you and cannot move away.
The DC increases by 4 if the target is DD.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Imagination
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 1 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Figment, Concentration Action: StandardYou create an illusory object or creature that to all senses appears real. The size of what you create is limited to a 5x5x5 ft cube, but other than that, there are few limitations. You can create a fire, and it (seems to) gives off heat. You can create a dog and it bounces around in its space and barks. You can create a door that creaks as it swings on its broken hinges.When you initially cast the spell, you decide a type of behavior that your imaginary creation exhibits, and change it to suit your needs. Maybe you want your person that you made to dance, but then the party you're at the music stops. You can spend a standard action concentrating on the spell (as long as you have line of sight to your imagination) to have it change behaviors to instead bow before a king. You cannot change what you imagine, but you can change what your imagination does.Your imagination isn't limited to the laws of physics, so you can have it do incredibly unusual things, like having a person swim through air or a rock doing flips. However, when creatures see unusual stimuli like that, they get a save to disbelieve it. If someone points out it’s a fake, other creatures automatically see through it and it appears translucent to them.When used in combat, creatures may waste their time attacking the imaginary creature, but instead of rolling attacks or the imagination rolling saves, the attacking creature rolls a save. Failed saves indicate they miss or the creature resists the attack. Passed saves indicate they see through the ruse, and they can communicate this to their allies, making them automatically disbelieve it, causing the illusion to appear translucent to all.The "concentration" part of the duration allows you to indefinitely maintain this imagination as long as you concentrate each turn as a standard action. You must have line of sight to the imagination to concentrate on it. If you do not concentrate on the spell for 1 minute, it disappears.Upcast - Each additional mana you spend increases the dimensions by 5 ft on all sides, to a max of 4 mana and 20x20x20 dimensions.
By spending 5 mana, the duration also changes to permanent, no longer requiring concentration. Dispel magic automatically succeeds against permanent imaginations.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Living Shadow
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 1 Moogen, The Murderer👁
Tags: Concentration, Figment, Teleportation Action: Swift
Your shadow detaches and forms a copy of you in your current space. It looks like you, but made of a shadowy mist with your eyes. It is stationary and mimics your attacks/gestures. You can use this shadow as the origin point for your spells and attacks. It can also make AoOs.You still must have line of sight to the target of your attacks/spells.As a swift action, you can teleport to this shadow if it is within 30 ft of you, ending the spell.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Vanish
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 1 Moogen, The Murderer👁
Tags: Glamer Action: Swift
Functions as Invisibility but only lasts until the end of turn.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Ventriloquism
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 1 Moogen, The Murderer👁
Tags: Prepared Action -You can cause your voice to sound as though it is originating from a location you can see within 30 ft of you whenever you speak.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Wave of Darkness
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 1 Moogen, The Murderer👁
Tags: Dark, Concentration Action: SwiftYou slash at the air with your staff and a dark cloud washes over the area in front of you. The area is in total darkness while the spell persists. This also coats the casters space(s) in darkness.
You can increase the cast time of this spell to a standard action to have it deal 2d8+CL (9+CL) cold dmg when you initially create it (fort halves). This also gives the spell the Frost tag.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Alone
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 2 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: Standard
You cause the target creature to be alone. All of the creatures allies and neutral parties disappear to all the senses for the target. They are unable to interact with allies directly or target them with specific effects. They can't use anything that requires teamwork like flanking, using buff abilities, +Teamwork Feats etc. The benefits of such effects immediately end. They might be able to infer the position of their allies based off of how their enemies are acting.
When a creature that possesses companions is targeted by this spell, they are unable to effectively coordinate with them. Their companions temporarily lose the teamwork feats and their commander's charisma bonus to attack while this spell persists. This also applies to individual companions targeted by this spell.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Hellscape
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 2 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Curse, Glamer, Psychic Action: Standard
You alter a target's perception, causing it to perceive the world around it as though it were made entirely out of flesh, blood and viscera (will negates). It is shaken 2 while the curse persists. If it interacts with the environment, such as opening a door or climbing a tree, the shaken penalty increases by 1.If the creature is shaken 4 and has its shaken penalty increased through any means, it instead takes 2d8 (9) psychic damage.To remove the curse you must hug a child.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Nearsighted
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 2 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Dark, Upcast Action: Standard
You cause a shadowy mist to cover a creatures eyes and reduce their vision range to 15 ft (will negates). All attacks made against the creature from beyond this range are made as though the target was DD.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, target an additional creature.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Shadow Puppets
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 2 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Subtle, Concentration, Figment Action: StandardBy holding your hands in the air and making some silly hand gestures, you can create sinister shadows along the ground and walls. As long as you concentrate, you can continue to make these innocuous shadow puppets for entertainment and such.
Any creature proficient in arcana immediately gets a check to Identify Active Spell (DC 17) if they can see the puppet show.
At any point (including immediately when you cast the spell) you can cause the shadows to come to life and take a bite or otherwise attack a creature. Even if you play with the shadows a bit and delay the attack, it still requires a standard action. The creature takes 3d8+CL (13+CL) slash or pierce damage and is frightened for one round (will halves damage and negates frightened).
If a creature successfully identifies the spell during a show and either they are the target or they warn the creature that is, they get advantage on their saving throw. If the creature is unaware of the danger the shadow puppets hold and they are the target of the spell later, they have disadvantage on their saving throw. Both of these situations can only happen if the caster chooses to delay the negative effects of the spell.Tl;dr - You can cast the spell as a standard to play with shadows or attack. If you decided to play with the shadows for a bit, you must still spend a standard action to use the attack. Playing with the shadows can just be for flavor, or it can be a risky method to enhance its power against those not trained in arcana.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Afterimage
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 3 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Glamer, Figment Action: Swift
Functions as Invisibility but only lasts until the end of your turn. In addition, you leave behind an illusory copy of yourself in your current position that repeats a simple type of movement you perform right before vanishing. This can be something like shadowboxing or crouching while looking around. This figment lasts for 1 round before disappearing.If a creature sees you use this technique, they know something is up. If they don’t see you use it, they treat it as the real you (will negates). A creature can identify your afterimages if they have seen one on another occasion.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Encroaching Darkness
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 3 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Dark, Concentration Action: Standard
A cloud of black mist emerges from your fingertips. This mist absorbs all natural light and leaves the area where it covers in complete Darkness. At the end of each of your turns, the darkness spreads an additional 10 ft.
You can use the spell effectively as dispel magic against a spell with the light tag. If you succeed, the dark spell consumes the light and takes hold.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Eyes Everywhere
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 3 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Subtle, Scrying Action: StandardYou pluck one of your eyes from your head and seal the empty eyelid. After, you place the plucked eye onto a surface. It melds into that surface and closes. By placing your hand over your other eye(s), you can open the plucked eye and gaze/hear through it instead of where your body is.
By forcefully opening the sealed eye, you end this spell. If a creature pokes the eye, whether its open or closed, the spell ends. Otherwise, it lasts indefinitely. They eye appears as Moogen, The Murderer👁's eye instead of yours.
Whenever the eye is open, creatures present can roll +Perception👀 to notice it each day. The DC is either your spell DC, or 15+(your +Stealth bonus).

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Gutwrench
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 3 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: Standard
Inflict a creature with a staggering pain in their stomach. When they look down, they see a blade inflicting a horrible wound upon them, either emerging from their stomach, or grazing their waist. What they see is what they believe, and what they believe manifests into reality. The creature takes 4d8+CL (18+CL) pierce damage and causes them to bleed d6 damage for 2 rounds (will halves damage and negates bleed).
While a creature is bleeding from this spell, they are also effectively silenced as they cough up blood.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Illusory Wall
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 3 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Figment, Upcast Action: StandardYou create a wall, floor or ceiling of any type that can appear to be made of anything. It blends seamlessly with the nearby terrain to appear as natural as possible. If you cast a new illusory wall, the previous one disappears. If the wall would take any damage then it immediately disappears. If a creature attempts to move through the wall or otherwise interact with it meaningfully, then it quickly fades over a second.Upcast 5 - Previous illusory walls do not disappear when a new one is cast. You cannot chain cast illusory walls to make a bigger wall.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Death Mark
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 4 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Curse Action: StandardA red mark appears along the creatures neck(s) resembling a bloody wound (will negates). They gain weakness 2. As an immediate action over any distance, you can "pop" the mark, removing the curse and dealing 5d8+CL (23+CL) true damage.
This curse is removed by killing (not defeat, killing) another creature.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Nightmare
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 4 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Fear Action: Standard
When you cast this spell, you fall into a catatonic state until your target falls asleep. You can choose to leave this state if you feel they are taking too long. When it falls asleep, it's dreams are plagued by horrific imagery of your choosing. When the creature wakes up from this dream, it is --drained 10 and Exhausted (will negates). This spell has no mechanical effect against a creature that is already drained, but you can still haunt their dreams if you want.
If you know the creature well enough to know about some deep-seated fear that they have, the creature has Disadvantage on their saving throw.
If the target is also subject to the Dream spell in the same night, they have advantage on their save. If they are subject to a dream council, then they are immune to this spell for that night.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Piercing Gaze
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 4 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Curse, Scrying Action: StandardClose one of your eyes and cause a much larger illusory copy of it to open on the ground. It swells before bursting in a cloud of sharp fragments, dealing 5d8+CL (23+CL) pierce damage and applying a curse (reflex halves dmg and negates curse).
While a creature is cursed with your piercing gaze, a tattoo of your eye appears on their back. You see their aura as a glowing outline around their person, even through total cover. You get a +8 bonus to +Perception👀 and survival checks to track them.At any point in the future, you can close your eye again (standard action) in the future to open an obvious illusory copy of your eye above a creature cursed with your piercing gaze. You can watch them through this eye indefinitely. If they attempt to move or cover the eye, it evades barriers attacks etc in order to keep line of sight on the cursed creature.This curse is removed by spending an hour to write your own eulogy, then burying it that night.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Umbral Trespass
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 4 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Elusive, Recharge Action: StandardFade away into shadowy mist and flow into the target of the spell. You disappear and enter stasis while you observe the world from the creature's PoV. On your next turn, you must spend another standard action to leave the creature's body in a violent slash, dealing 5d8+CL (22+CL) slash or pierce damage (fort halves) and dashing 15 ft away from the creature.This spell cannot be cast again for 1 minute.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Darkvault
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 5 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Teleportation Action: SwiftNote:
This spell can only be cast while you Hide.
Teleport to a location of Dim Light or Darkness.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Mirage
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 5 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Figment Action: StandardYou affect a wide area to completely change its appearance into something else. You can create an oasis in a desert, a house on a hill or make your house look like a flat piece of land. Creatures typically don't get a save to disbelieve the illusion unless something tips them off: bumping into a wall that shouldn't be there or drinking from a pool of water that holds only sand. The less suspicious and out of place the mirage is, the less likely creatures get a will save to see through it.Casting mirage a second time removes the previous one.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Shadow Projection
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 5 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Figment, Upcast, Dismissible, Scrying Action: StandardYou create an illusory duplicate that is shaped like you but it's almost entirely black, save for its eyes. You project this shadow to a location within the spells range that you can see. While occupying this shadow, you can speak and move around freely in this new illusory body. You can cast spells, but you cannot physically interact with objects otherwise.
If the shadow is ever exposed to bright light, then it disappears. If it ever takes +HP damage, is Poise broken or fails a saving throw, then you also take the damage and it disappears. It uses all of your statistics to determine its defenses.Upcast 6 - You no longer need to be able to see the position you initially project your shadow to, though you have to at least seen the place before. The spells range changes to unlimited.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Moogen (T)
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description: Moogen (T)👁 isn’t so much a creature as she is an idea. She is handily replaced by anyone who can outwit her, kill her, then take her place. She is a demon that exists in the shadows, content to play with the affairs of others (usually mortals). She regularly invites mortals into her loving arms as pawns in some kind of scheme, always ready with a knife to their back if they don’t play along.Moogen spells assist in turning off the lights, stealth, assassination and misdirection.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Mother Earth
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description: The oldest of all the deities and the creator goddess. Mother Earth is interested in the constant struggle between nature and those who would seek its destruction or exploitation. The proliferation of life and balance between all living things are what her followers preach.Mother Earth spells primarily manipulate plants, animals and other aspects of nature to aid those who seek to protect it.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/nack..title: Nack
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/nack..description: Special: Nack spells cannot be learned via technique points. They can only be learned by finding books containing their knowledge. When these books are read, you gain the spell as an at-will innate technique, and the book vanishes. Since the spell level is mostly irrelevant, it mostly just refers to the rarity.Nack is a mysterious mage who uses his mastery of magic in order to create mostly useless and niche magic. He also has enough free time to hide these books all over the world in secluded places. Very few of the spells are as powerful as one might expect of a mage, but they are usually interesting, quirky and fun. A mage with mastery over Nack spells is not more powerful because of it, but they're probably more fun to have at parties.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Necromancy
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-skull" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="m12.5 17-.5-1-.5 1h1z"></path><path d="M15 22a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-1a2 2 0 0 0 1.56-3.25 8 8 0 1 0-11.12 0A2 2 0 0 0 8 20v1a1 1 0 0 0 1 1z"></path><circle r="1" cy="12" cx="15"></circle><circle r="1" cy="12" cx="9"></circle></svg>
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description: Necromancy spells are about manipulating the dead and inflicting dead, often via necrotic damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Prismancy
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description: The prismancy tree is all about inflicting a unique status effect called glowing. This status effect can be consumed by spells in this tree to trigger bonus effects. Prismancy spells deal fire damage and light up the battlefield.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Dream
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 1 Psionics🤯
Tags: Buff Action: StandardYou enter a trance like state as you try to intercept the thoughts of a specific named sleeping creature. You can remain in this trance as long as you'd like, waiting for the target creature to fall asleep. When they do, the spells duration begins and you appear in their dreams. You can make conversation with them, but the creature is under no compulsion to speak with you and can handily boot you out of their dreams.
While interacting with a creature in a dream, you get a +2 bonus to skill checks.Note: Creatures like elves with the trance racial feature always realize when they're being contacted by a dream spell. They can take a moment to center themselves, enter trance and allow the spell to take hold.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Levitate
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 1 Psionics🤯
Tags: Prepared Action: -
You decide gravity isn't your thing. You gain a hover speed equal to your land speed.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Mind Crush
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 1 Psionics🤯
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Psychic, Upcast Action: StandardYou overload a creatures brain with information, giving them a hell of a headache. They take 2d8+CL (9+CL) psychic damage (will halves).Upcast - The target takes d6+CL (3+CL) damage again at the end of its next turn (will halves). Each mana spent adds an additional turn. A creature cannot suffer from multiple mind crushes at the same time.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Mind Link
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 1 Psionics🤯
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: StandardWith a touch, communicate a vast quantity of information by showing the target brief memories and psychic impressions. You can communicate the broad strokes of an experience you had, including important locations, people, events and feelings. The experience must be shorter than 1 hour.Casting on an unwilling creature requires an attack roll.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Psychic Reading
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 1 Psionics🤯
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Subtle, Concentration Action: Standard
You focus on a creature's aura to learn more information about them. Roll a CL check, DC 10+(creature's LvL). If you succeed, you can learn information from their aura, and even more by concentrating. Every round you learn a piece of information about it from the following list (caster's choice). Sexual Orientation Race/Species Gender Level Native Language What city/sanctuary they consider "home" Age You can only cast this spell on a given creature once per day.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Sending
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 1 Psionics🤯 Tags: - Action: StandardYou deliver a message to a creature over any distance. In order to communicate with a creature, you must have met them, and you must know their name.When you cast the spell, you telepathically communicate simple ideas that require no more than two sentences to convey (Monsters are attacking the north gate. How do we respond?). Your target can immediately reply with the same restrictions.If your message is too complex or too long, the creature is dead, or the creature is on another plane then it gets lost in the ether and the caster takes 1 psychic damage.You can only cast sending on a particular creature once each day unless you mana burn 1 each cast.
Upcast 3 - By adding Mana Burn you can instead have a conversation with this creature that either of you can cut off at any moment. The spells duration is increased to 10 minutes.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Concentrated Blast
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 2 Psionics🤯
Tags: Force Action: StandardNote:
This spell can only be cast when concentrating on something.
Release your mind from the strain of concentration, channeling this raw mental energy into a projectile you launch at a target within range. Make a Ranged Attack that deals 3d10+CL (16+CL) psychic damage. This spell immediately ends the spell you were concentrating on, immediately restoring the ended ability's mana cost (if it had one).If you are concentrating on multiple spells at once, you can end both spells to restore more mana.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase dmg by d10 (5).

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Cull the Weak
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 2 Psionics🤯
Tags: Prepared, Psychic Action: -You sense weakness in your enemies. Whenever a creature lives with 1 hp, you know. You can spend an instant action to deal 2 psychic damage to them. You can only do this to an individual once each minute.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Detect Thoughts
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 2 Psionics🤯
Tags: Concentration, Mind-Affecting, Subtle Action: StandardEvery turn as a standard action you can scan a creature you can see. You can read the surface thoughts of the creature for as long as you desire (will negates), requiring no additional action. The spell gives you the mental capacity to have a conversation with the creature and hear its thoughts at the same time.
The creature gets no save if they are Helpless.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Memory Lapse
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 2 Psionics🤯
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Subtle Action: StandardYou cause a target to forget the events that have transpired in the past 2 rounds of combat (12 seconds). Certain details may cause them to recall what you did during that time, such as seeing you in a restricted area, or an ally reminding them.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Share Memory
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 2 Psionics🤯
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Concentration Action: StandardWith a touch, you can tap into your targets memories (will negates) or your own, decided when you initiate mental contact. In any case, both parties see what is being viewed. The memory is limited to one minute duration. If gazing into another creatures memories, you must specify the type of memory or specific memory you want to look at.
Against a Helpless creature, this has no save. If you cannot maintain physical contact, the spell ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Dream Council
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 3 Psionics🤯
Tags: Buff Action: StandardYou enter a trance like state as you try to intercept the thoughts of up to 10 specific named sleeping creatures. You can remain in this trance as long as you'd like, waiting for the target creature(s) to fall asleep. When they do, you and any creatures you specify enter a shared dream space where you can make conversation with them. The creatures are under no compulsion to speak with you and can leave the dream space at any time.Using the spell typically requires coordination beforehand in order to get everybody to attend the council. The duration of the spell starts when you contact at least one creature.
While interacting with a creature in a dream, you get a +2 bonus to skill checks.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Mirror Realm
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 3 Psionics🤯
Tags: Scrying Action: Standard Focus: 1 roughly person-sized mirrorThis spell has two functions, trapping for combat and hosteling for shenanigans. In either case, you must target a mirror. When you do so, the contents of the mirror are set in stone and cease to reflect reality, instead creating its own little world that resembles what it reflected.
You cast this version on a mirror in order to create an extradimensional space with some interesting quirks. The space itself is a copy of everything within a 30ft distance from the mirror. This means the mirror realm can capture entire rooms, including things that are hidden from line of sight (such as behind furniture) This allows your extradimensional space to contain furniture for instance.No effects can come in or out of the mirror realm, but both sides can see what is on the other side of the mirror, barring any kind of physical obstructions that would prevent sight (such as drapery). By tapping on the mirror from either side you can cause the noise to carry over.On casting the spell you can include a password that needs to be spoken in order to walk into the mirror (no action). This password can be changed with 1 minute of concentration from the caster. You can also update the mirror's appearance to keep it inconspicuous should the environment change drastically. The caster can go blind and deaf temporarily to project their senses into the mirror realm at will indefinitely.Objects cannot be brought out, nor can objects be brought in aside from what the average humanoid can reasonably carry on their person. Any such objects left behind are shunted out, along with any creatures, if the mirror is destroyed or the spell ends.Can be made permanent using 2,000g worth of powdered rare metals as an addition material component during castingWhen casting the trapping form, you must target a creature AND an appropriately sized mirror (both of which need to be in range of you, but not each other). If the creature fails its save, it is immediately sucked into the mirror (with a similar setting as the aforementioned hosteling effect). No other creature can enter the mirror realm without another casting of this spell.This does not prevent it from taking actions, but it can no longer interact with anything outside of the mirror realm, nor can any creature interact with the trapped individual. The target is stranded. They can see out of the mirror by standing next to it. The only way they can escape is by having an ally destroy the mirror, or by waiting for 1 minute. In either case, the creature appears in a random space within 15 feet of the mirror's line of sight.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Telekinetic Lift
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 3 Psionics🤯
Tags: Prepared Upcast Action: -
You exert your psychic power to manipulate heavy unattended objects within 30 ft. You can lift objects weighing up to (100*CL) pounds, having them float in the air around you. Lifting objects with this spell has the concentration tag, but otherwise does not restrict your movement, occupy your hands etc.You can drop an object weighing a few hundred pounds on a creature to deal 2d8+CL (9+CL) damage (reflex halves). The damage type varies depending on what you drop, usually crush.Upcast - Increase carrying capacity to (1000 x CL) lbs. Dropped objects in the thousands of pound deal 4d8+CL (18+CL) damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Telekinetic Maneuver
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 3 Psionics🤯
Tags: Buff Action: Standard
As part of casting the spell and as a standard action for the spells duration, you can perform a +Combat Maneuver using (CL+3) as your bonus. Some maneuvers work slightly differently as noted below.Drag - Move the creature to another position within 30 ft, up to 30 ft.
Grapple - While grappling, this spell also has the concentration tag. Instead of dealing the damage of a held weapon, you instead deal 2d6+CL (7+CL) crush dmg each turn. You must spend your standard action to do this each turn or the grapple ends.Your speed is not 0 while grappling. You do not need to pull the target adjacent to you. Any damage you take while concentrating also deals poise damage. If poise broken or moved farther than 30 ft from the creature, this effect ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Malleable Memory
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 4 Psionics🤯
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Concentration Action: StandardYou root around in the targets head, removing things and adding things to their memories. This spell has 2 functions.Alter Memories - You can change details about memories, or add entirely new ones.Remove Memories - You can completely remove memories of events.In either case, you have to have at least a basic idea of what you're looking for (when they saw me break into that house, watching their spouse die in front of them). The spell can get very precise in its ability to alter memories, allowing you to remove specific items or creatures, but otherwise maintain everything else. The duration of the spell is equal to the amount of memory that you want to change. 2 minutes of fighting you want to erase? 2 minutes of concentration.For alterations that total longer than 5 minutes (including multiple strings of casts around the same time), the creature will fight to remember things that were altered or removed. When presented with contradictory evidence or otherwise prompted to think about these heavily modified memories, they get an additional save against the effect to restore their original memories.
A creature that is Helpless does not get an initial save. When you take damage or if the target moves out of reach, the spell ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Memory Movie
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 4 Psionics🤯
Tags: Mind-Affecting, Concentration Action: StandardTap into a creature’s memories and display them on a small screen so nearby creatures can also see what you experience. Memories are viewed from the target’s perspective, so if they have impaired or inferior senses, so do you when you view the memory.You must decide what specific memory or type of memory to view (ie. first kiss, 20th birthday party). After you start viewing the memory in real time, you have the ability to skip ahead and rewind minutes at a time to better pinpoint important moments.When cast on yourself or a willing creature, the duration increases to 1 hour and you can freely change what memories you look at on a whim, allowing for improved curation.
Creatures that are Helpless do not get a save against this spell. When you take damage or if the target moves more than 30 feet away from you, the spell ends.
Cannot view magically altered memories, such as those created or manipulated by Malleable Memory, or those eliminated by the River Styx.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Glimpse of Truth
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 5 Psionics🤯 Tags: - Action: SwiftYou see everything as it truly is.
You automatically disbelieve all illusions, such as figments, patterns and glamers
If a creature is under the effects of a polymorph effect, you can see the creature's true form
You can see Invisible creatures
You gain Darkvision

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Telekinetic Thrust
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description: Level 5 Psionics🤯 Tags: - Action: StandardYou can perform one of the following actions, manipulating matter with your mind.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Telekinesis
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 6 Psionics🤯
Tags: Buff Action: StandardYou exert your psychic power to such an extent that you are able to manipulate heavy objects and toss creatures around against their will. Your eyes glow and you emit a constant repulsive force pushing away loose objects nearby.
For the duration of the spell, you gain a hover speed equal to your land speed. You can use this speed to fly during your turn as a free action.Upon casting the spell, and every turn after as a standard action, you can perform one of the following actions.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/p.title: Psionics
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/p.description:
The psionics tree is something that has been developed piecemeal over long periods of time, culminating into its current form under the guidance of an entity by the name of Santa🎅.
The psionics tree uses psychic powers to gather information and out maneuver foes before the battles even begin. If it does come down to a fight, you can crush foes' minds or toss them around with telekinesis. Long distance communication is easy with spells like dream and sending. Creatures won't be able to keep secrets from you with access to spells like detect thoughts and memory movie.

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Pyromancy
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description: Pyromancy is primarily about blasting creatures with fire damage using single target attacks and AoE effects. Many spells in the pyromancy tree gain significant benefits from being Upcast.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/shir.title: Shira
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/shir.description: When you try and figure out who the most attractive lady is at a party, it's often a question of who is second best, for whenever you get a closer look at #1, it's Shira. People submit to the Cataclysm for strength, and Moogen for stealth, but this demon lord prefers subterfuge. She often exists among mortals, playing along with the politics and wars for fun. Being the least abrasive and the most approachable, Shira is the demon lord the most mortals find intertwined in their life, often not knowing that they deal with a demon.Shira spells focus on deceit as well as mental domination of both overt and subtle varieties.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/arc.ht.title: Arc
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/arc.ht.description: The techniques designed to combat and negate magic, including both spells and Supernatural abilities.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Barbarism
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description: Techniques that use raw strength to perform ridiculous and unorthodox feats. Barbarism also rewards you for putting yourself in danger and hurting yourself.

techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.title: Beastmode
techniques/martial-techniques/beastmode/.description:
The techniques surrounding using natural attacks, and briefly transforming into animals. All beastmode features are supernatural.
As a reminder, ALL special attacks have the martial tag, even if it is not listed.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Cataclysm
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description: Caldera, the Cataclysm🌋 is one of the 3 primary Demon Lords👿 of Nack. She respects raw physical strength over all else. Her followers regularly engage in contests to prove who has the most. People fear to speak her name or draw her ire and have the cataclysm fall upon them. She has reached the pinnacle of physical strength, giving her the ability to control gravity itself and literally bend physics to her will.Cataclysm spells are centered around increasing and utilizing raw physical strength, manipulating gravity, causing immense destruction and being incredibly loud.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/m.title: Marksman
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/m.description: The techniques surrounding using ranged weapons. Many marksman special attacks require using ranged weapons. As such, they use the weapon you wield's range.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Protector
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-shield" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M20 13c0 5-3.5 7.5-7.66 8.95a1 1 0 0 1-.67-.01C7.5 20.5 4 18 4 13V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1c2 0 4.5-1.2 6.24-2.72a1.17 1.17 0 0 1 1.52 0C14.51 3.81 17 5 19 5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1z"></path></svg>
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description: Niv the Protector is renowned for traveling alongside heroes of the past and making sure they live until the next encounter. Her followers strive to keep the best of the world alive, even at the cost of themselves.The Protector's techniques are focused on zone control, increasing the durability of you and your allies or taking hits for them. Many of their techniques are instant or immediate actions.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/pup.title: Pupper
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/pup.description: Cinder Tourneau is an influential adventurer that lived through not one, but two different world crises while fighting to stop it. Once upon a time she had the blood of fiends run through her veins but has since been transformed by a mad scientist and retired. Even when she was a child she would charge at foes many times her size without fear by the side of her parents. The memory of this cute pupper still inspires people to this day to fight greater evils.Pupper techniques are focused on providing useful combat buffs, aggression, speed and putting you straight into the action to slap people in melee.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Scoundrel
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description: The techniques surrounding using underhanded tactics. High in mobility and utility.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/un.title: Unarmed
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/un.description: The techniques surrounding using your own body as your weapon, often involving punches, kicks, stomps, knees and more.

techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.title: Caster Level
techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.description:
Caster level (CL) is typically equal to the creature's level, though certain effects can change it. CL determines the effectiveness of many spells.This stat is also relevant in resolving what happens when casting goes head to head with each other (such as with dispel magic), when using healing to staunch bleeding or when light and Dark magic meet.If dual wielding staff components, get +1 CL.
All boosts to CL affect +Cantrips, even if they normally only affect specific types of spells.

techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.title: Fizzle
techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.description: By default, spells have a 100% chance of being cast, but certain things can cause spell failure. When you fail to cast a spell, the resource used to cast it is consumed. A spell failing is usually shortened to "fizzles."

techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.title: Spell
techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.description: Spellcasting is a general title that applies to a specific type of magical effect, with specific rules. Spells do not encompass all magic, but it is the most common type.Spells are specifically anything that falls under the magical techniques section.

techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.title: Weather
techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.description: Certain high level spells manipulate the weather in drastic ways. If multiple casters attempt to cast different spells that affect the weather, the creature with the higher CL always wins.In the event where the caster tries to interfere with weather that is supernaturally powerful (created by a complex ritual, associated with cursed terrain etc), the DM should assign the effect an effective CL.All weather inducing spells do not function underground.

techniques/technique-rules/innate-techni.title: Innate Technique
techniques/technique-rules/innate-techni.description:
Some techniques can be granted outside of the standard progression, such as things gained from race, class, magic item, specialized training, or some kind of boon granted by another creature. Usually quite limited in scope and much more common on monsters.Innate techniques do not take up memory slots and are always memorized.Innate techniques grant creatures the ability to use a specific set of techniques. Spells do not require the staff/seal component that other casting typically requires. If a spell has a material or focus component, that is also ignored with innate casting. By default, creatures with innate techniques can use their techniques an unlimited number of times. Number values are included next to techniques that have limited uses per day.
Mana Burn still applies to innately casted spells, but in addition to reducing mana, it removes your ability to use that technique until you rest.

techniques/technique-rules/technique-pro.title: Technique Progression
techniques/technique-rules/technique-pro.description: In general, classes get access to a few technique trees. Techniques are separated into six levels, requiring 6 points of investment in order to reach the highest tier.At every even level, you get a technique point you can invest in any form of technique. For every point you invest, you get access to a new level of technique.There are some limitations. You cannot invest all of your technique points into the techniques your class specializes in to get access to high level abilities extremely early. Technique levels have a hard character level requirement, as shown below…

techniques/technique-rules/technique-rul.title: Technique Rules
techniques/technique-rules/technique-rul.description: Progression in this game is broken up into 3 main distinct categories: Class features, feats and techniques. This section is dedicated to techniques. Techniques use a point system to represent how invested you are in a specific technique, from 1 to 6.Techniques are often things that you use in combat, such as special attacks and spells.

bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.title: Space Crab
bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.description:
This alien scavenger with no eyes skitters along the ground on all fours, raising its forelegs in response to threats. Only when it is pouncing midair does its target realize the enormous mouth on its underside.Level 0 Tiny AberrationResistance - NecroticHome Field Advantage - While attached to a creatures head, the space crab gains DRA 10 and +4 AC.
Innate Techniques - Twist the Knife
Sneak Attack - Against a DD target, a space crab does an additional 4 damage.
New Home - Against a defeated creature, a space crab can attach to the creature's head and gain control over the actions of the soon to be corpse. After 1 hour, it kills the creature and reanimates it as a zombie as though casting animate dead, but the creature retains its full level. It can then spend all of its actions each turn to command this undead. Only through the space crab's or it's host's death will it detach. When the space crab is killed, the host automatically dies. The space crab must use this on a creature that is initially alive. It cannot use this ability on a creature that was already dead. Use the zombie stat block for generic humanoid host. Hosts can be anything; the space crab just has to get lucky.
What's Poppin? - A space crab can only make an attack roll in the same turn it takes the Jump action. It does not threaten.
Ability Scores - STR -1, DEX +1, LUK +1, INT -3, WIS +0, CHA +0
Senses - Sightless Blindsense, Lifesense (60 ft)
Speed - 10 Land Speed Enhanced Leap - When the space crab jumps, it moves 30 feet, regardless of its speed, as long as it is not 0.
Feats - Skill Focus
Skills - +2 +Perception👀, +5 (adv) +Stealth
