bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.title: Ayylmao
bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.description:
A small creature fused with a flying saucer floats overhead. It gazes upon the farmer's cattle as it pulls out its probes. An electrified pulse of light reflects off of the terrified cow's eyes.Level 3 Small AberrationFlyby Attack - An ayylmao's movement is Elusive against targets it has attacked this round.
Innate Techniques - Detect Thoughts
1/day - Malleable Memory
Discomfort - Ayylmao like sticking their probes in unusual places. Creatures are sent reeling and are made Clumsy 1 On-hit. Against a DD or grappled target, this increases to clumsy 2.
Tractor Beam (Su) concentration - Unleash a ray at a creature within 30 ft. It is entangled (reflex negates). DC 20 Breakout. While entangled, the creature maintains the exact distance away from the ayylmao, even if it moves. This allows the ayylmao to slam it into the ground, drag it along walls etc. Every turn it moves at least 10 feet deals 4d6 (14) crush damage. If the ayylmao chooses, it can spend its own movement to beam the creature closer, or push it away, but no farther than 30 feet away.Milkers - There's only one thing an ayylmao likes more than anal probing, and that's cows. If any cows or cow-like creatures are present, an ayylmao will always focus on kidnapping them with their tractor beams over anything else.
A substantial quantity of cow milk gives creatures advantage on checks in social situations with ayylmao.
Ability Scores - STR +0, DEX +2, LUK +0, INT +3, WIS +0, CHA +0
Telepathy
Cloaking Device - Ayylmao can take 10 on +Stealth (resulting in 22 for the average ayylmao). They are always considered to have partial concealment while the cloaking device is active. The cloaking device is deactivated when an ayylmao does anything other than movement, or it takes damage. The only exception is if the action has the subtle tag.
Speed - 10, 40 Hover. An ayylmao can use its hover speed to fly, but only during its turn. Takeoff - An ayylmao can return to the mother ship by spending 3 consecutive standard actions activating turbo thrusters. It also leaves with any creature caught in its tractor beam.
Equipment - Anal Probe
Feats - Skill Focus, Signature Skill (stealth)
Skill - +5 +Perception👀, 22 +Stealth, +8 Arcana, +12 Engineering🤖, +8 +Cryptozoology, +8 +Nature🍃

bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.title: amalgam-spawn
bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.description:
Level 0 Tiny Aberration/BeastAC 13 HP 20 Poise 13 Fort -1, Refl +5, Will +0Bite (C) +3 d8+3 (7)Jolt - Whenever a bovider takes zap damage, it immediately recoils away from the source. It and its spawn are unable to attack creatures that has dealt zap damage to it in the last 1 round.Ability Scores - Str -1, Dex +3, Lucc +0, Int -3, Wis +0, Cha +0Speed - 40 land, 40 climb. While a creature you are copying is defeated and within reach, you can absorb data to repair damage as a swift action, healing 20 hp.Unarmed (C) +7 (+2 real deal) d8+3 (7)Innate Techniques - Kidnap, Fake Out, Nice Catch 1/day - Toe Smasher, Feign DefeatReal Deal - While copying a creature, gain +2 attack against it.Copy: I'll have what she's having (Su) - As a swift action, a shadow can use it's copy ability to create a fully functional handheld object it can see within 30 ft. If the object is magical, it loses its magical properties. If the copied object gets more than 100 ft from the original, it disappears. Using copy in this way does not stun the shadow.Don't Tread on Me - Shadows are just that, shadows. Anything it copies is merely a projection. As such, it does not like it when objects interact with the shadow of its projection. It avoids people stepping on it, creatures walking over it etc. If the shadow's shadow is targeted directly, or included in an AoE effect, its DRA is ignored. If you target a shadow with a piercing melee weapon, you can embed it in the surface and entangle the shadow on hit or with a successful poise break, replacing all other effects and losing access to the weapon. Projectiles like arrows require 3 hits. Shadows cannot remove the entangling items on their own.Ability Scores - Str +3, Dex +2, Lucc +0, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +0Copy (Su) [poly, true] - As a FRA, a shadow can emit a very bright flash of light while gazing upon a specific creature within 30 ft. When it does so It adds this creature to its memory. It can choose to immediately transform into this creature as part of this action. The replication process is almost perfect, giving the shadow access to the creatures memories, skill proficiencies, personality traits, current clothing, appearance, size etc. The shadow gains all of the racial features of the creature it copies (assuming a player character) or all of the natural attacks (including multi attack options)/movement abilities if it is not. A shadow can "memorize" copies of 4 different creatures/objects (see offense traits). It can transform into one as a standard action, or revert to its true form as a free action.When copying a creature, treat its disguise roll as 26.Speed - Speed(s) of copied creature. It can choose to enter a hybrid form, foiling its disguise, in order to move at a speed of 40, or climb 40.
Feats - Unarmed Combatant, Bonded Mind, Feint PartnerSkills - +6 perception, +6 deception, +8 stealth

bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.title: Mind Flayer
bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.description:
Masters of the psionic arts, these tentacled-lipped mages are vaguely humanoid with wet undulating orifices. They scour the universe for hosts to fuel their endless hunger for knowledge...Literally.Level 8 Medium AberrationResistance - Psychic
Break Will Su Charm - As an immediate action when hit by an attack, a mind flayer can attempt to charm the attacking creature for 1 round (will negates).Tentacles (C) +10 (+4 MV) d8+2 (6)
Innate Techniques CL 10 - Mind Crush (U4), Detect Thoughts, Telekinetic Maneuver
1/day - Telekinetic Thrust
Constant - Telekinetic Lift, Tongues
Brain Blast (Su) Psychic Recharge - Creatures in a 30 ft cone take 6d6 (21) psychic damage and are stunned for 1 round (will halves damage and reduces stun to Staggered). A mind flayer must devour intellect, wait 1 minute or concentrate as a FRA to gain use of this ability again.
Displacer (Su) (Psychic) - When a mind flayer causes a creature to take Fall Damage, it takes an additional 5 psychic damage. Creature takes 10d8 (45) pierce dmg (fort halves). A mind flayer must digest for at least an hour before it can devour intellect again.
Psychic Casting - A mind flayer requires a higher degree of concentration to use many of its psionic abilities. It cannot use its supernatural abilities or its innate techniques while it is frightened, dominated or confused.

+Blindsense - Thoughtsense 30 ft

bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.title: Besmolder
bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.description:
A tiny floating eyeball shouts with glee as it chases you around. You try and hide, only for it to pop around the corner. "Found you!" It shouts as it shoots an eye beam at you, transforming you into a toy.Level 12 Smol Aberration Boss
All Around Vision - Immune to being flanked
RecoveryBoop (???) +13 ???
Innate Techniques - Dispel Magic
Gaze Su Charm - A besmolder has many eyes, but one particularly large one it uses to cancel make new friends. At the start of the besmolder's turn, it decides to focus it's gaze on a single creature it can see (free action). The creature is charmed for 1 round (will negates). It cannot use its eye stalks ability against targets it charms.Eyestalks (Su) - The besmolder's extra eyes have the ability to unleash devastating laser beams at creatures within 100 ft. As a standard action it can shoot three of these laser beams at three different creatures. The effect is rolled randomly (reroll duplicates), more details below.Outside of combat, the besmolder is able to exert more fine control over its eye stalks, allowing it to summon friends, build little villages, telekinetically move objects and disintegrate holes into things with ease. Feel free to change up a few eye beams to make your besmolder's extra special
Friend Magic! - A besmolder can use its MM Caster Minion feat with its eyestalks.Boss Actions - The beholder can perform 2 of the following actions each round. Eyebeam - Fire a random eyestalk beam at an enemy after they end their turn. Exploit - Bite a creature suffering a debilitating status from your eyestalks with a +8 bonus.
Inferior Magic recharge - Roll dispel magic to counter a spell as though you had prepared the action.
Boss Mechanics - Whenever a besmolder is staggered, instead of its usual effects, it can can only shoot 2 eyestalks on its turn. When it is dazed, instead it can only shoot 1 eyestalk. When it is stunned, its eyestalk ability is disabled, but it can otherwise act normally.
When a besmolder is siphoned, instead of its usual effects, its primary eye closes and it cannot use its gaze.
Whenever a besmolder is blinded, instead of gaining the blinded condition, its eyestalk DC decreases by 2. Blurred vision is instead converted into -1 to its eyestalk DC. Story Time! - A besmolder knows much more than even it knows. If prompted to tell stories, its knowledge of history is unmatched and it can practically "remember" anything with vivid detail, though it often exaggerates details to make the story more interesting. When it does so, its history bonus is effectively +30. By making a DC 30 history check, you can parse what parts of the story are facts and which are fiction.
Ability Scores - STR +1, DEX +2, LUK +2, INT -1, WIS -1, CHA +4 Languages - Common Band Practice - When not under duress, a besmolder can summon an instrument and play it.
Speed - 10, 35 Hover
Feats - Speak for the Dead, Defensive Training, Ghostbuster, Blind Fight, Matador, MM Caster Minion
Skill - +16 +Perception👀, +16 +History, +17 +Deception, +17 +Persuasion, +27 +Profession🧑‍🌾 (any instrument)

bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/aberration.title: Aberrations
bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/aberration.description: Terrors born from the unknowable and the otherworldly. They cannot be reasoned with or rationalized and are utterly insurmountable nightmare that humanity has no hope of escaping.From the darkest depths of space, the ocean and other mysterious realms, aberrations are often alien creatures uninterested in the conventions of traditional life. Others are strange mixes of the organic and inorganic in unfamiliar animalistic shapes.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: love-bug
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: A large bug hovers in the air, a pleasant aroma washing over you as it lands on you.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: angry-chicken
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: This unassuming beast meanders about with its kin. Only when you bother it does it reveal its menacing aura and incredible power.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: horse
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: A strange 4-legged creature with a long face trots around, its powerful legs flexing as it picks up the pace.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: stinger
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: A massive insect with an even more massive insect flies charges at you, the drone of its massive wings disorienting and frustrating you as the rest of the colony pump you with venom.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: wolf
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: An agitated canine bares its fangs at you. Before you know it, another one is to your left and to your right. The group slowly advances towards you to close off your escape.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: giant-eagle
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: A majestic bird flies overhead. As you appreciate its beauty it flies down with incredible speed and gouges out your friends eyes. The massive bird screeches as it continues its onslaught.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: harambe
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: This slow paced ape walks along its knuckles before realizing your presence. It rears up on its hind legs to show off its massive size while it makes noise and swings its arms.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: huffer
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: This aggressive boar huffs and puffs as it scrapes its hooves against the ground as you enter its territory. Its impressive speed and sharp tusks are quick to show you the error of your ways.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: macaw
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: This colorful bird draws your eye with its impressive plumage. Once it starts to copy the spells of your allies as it shouts the words of power gleefully, you realize its true power.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: piranha-swarm
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: This colorful freshwater fish is an efficient carnivore that forms schools to consume prey many times larger than it. You find out just how tenacious they can be as they munch on your limbs.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: hippo
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: A pair of eyes and nostrils looks at you from inside the lake. It disappears under the water. A moment later an angry herbivore bursts from the lake and charges you down.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: big-cat
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: A rustling in the bushes and a low growl are the last thing you hear before a giant cat pounces from the underbrush, directly onto your neck.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: insect-swarm
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: A bug lands on your arm and you swat it. Another 2, then 5, then 10. You turn and see a tsunami of insects washing over your campsite.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: Dragonslayer Hound
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description:
Clad in a bone-like exoskeleton armor, this dog sniffs you up and down before moving onto the next capture. It howls and the man next to your transforms into a dragon. The hound pounces on its quarry.Level 5 Medium BeastEvasion
Resistance - Fire
Multiattack - Whenever a dragonslayer hound takes fire damage, it gains access to this multiattack. Make 3 bite attacks.
Innate Techniques - Boiling Blood, Pack Attack, Jaws of the Beast
1/day - Blazing Beam, Feast (U3), Down to Earth (U3)
Constant - Enhanced Jump
Fire Fang Fire - On-hit with a bite attack, the foe is set Ablaze (reflex negates).
Dragonslayer - A dragonslayer hound has very specialized combat training. It gets a +4 bonus to attack against Dragons🐲, including dragon adjacent creatures or creatures with a draconic affinity.
Flash Fire - A dragonslayer hound can redirect Fire effects, similar to how the Lightning Rod technique functions as an immediate action if the effect originates within 60 ft of it. Targeted spells such as Fire Blast are now centered on the hound while AoE spells like are Fire and Brimstone are directed towards the hound instead of their intended direction.
Against dragon a breath weapon specifically, a dragonslayer hound can use this ability as an instant action. When it does so, it turns the effect into a line attack directed towards itself, regardless of the original direction and shape of the ability.
Wet Dog - A dragonslayer hound cannot use its Fire Fang ability while Wet or Frosty.
Ability Scores - STR +1, DEX +3, LUK +0, INT -3, WIS +3, CHA +0
Deific Boons - Animal Instincts
Senses - Scent 15 ft
Speed - 45 Land Speed
Signature Skill - advanced tracking
Swift Tracker - Dragonslayer hounds can always track while moving at full speed. If the hound's quarry is faster than them, they can match their speed while tracking.
Find Quarry - Dragonslayer hounds can always smell when a creature is a dragon (as per its Dragonslayer ability), even if it is under the effect of a Polymorph. As a standard action, a dragonslayer hound can bark at a polymorphed dragon within 15 ft to automatically transform it back to its true form.
Feats - Bodyguard, Signature Skill, Skill Focus
Skills - +10 (+4 scent) +Perception👀, +12 (+2 scent, adv) +Survival🐾, +10 (adv) +Acrobatics⚖
Sprite from the Infinite Fusion game by Smogon

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: String Shot Spider
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description:
You slap the webs off of your face, only to have an agitated spider staring you in the face. As you scream, it fires a sizzling string shot from its spinneret.Level 5 Large Beast Web Walker - A string shot spider cannot be Entangled by webs. they ignore the Difficult Terrain of webs.String Shot (Poison) +8 (30 ft, +2 Bullseye, cannot be used in consecutive rounds) 5d6 (17) (+Sticky Situation)
Bite (P) +8 (5 ft Reach)
2d6+3 (10) (+Venom)
Innate Techniques - Dive, Pack Attack
1/day - Tumble, Feast, Unseen Predator
Sticky Situation Poison - A string shot spider is capable of using its spinneret as a projectile weapon. The strings are coated in powerful digestive enzymes that evaporate quickly. When they land a string shot, the creature is clumsy 1 as the web sticks to them and the surrounding terrain. At the start of each turn they are clumsy from this, they take an additional 2d6 (7) poison damage. A creature can Breakout as a swift action, removing the clumsy and caustic webs.
Miracle of Life - String shot spiders try to capture some of their prey alive. They attach them to the walls and cover them in webs to lay their eggs inside of their skin. Such creatures are still alive, barely, but are unable to rest or recover from the defeated condition. Within a few days, the eggs are ready to hatch and they eat their way out of their host, forming an insect swarm, but it is large and has half as much hp.
In the days leading up to the eggs hatching, a very skilled doctor can roll a DC 30 first aid check to carefully remove the eggs without killing the host. They are drained 15 and require days of bed rest before they can fully recover.
Ability Scores - STR +1, DEX +3, LUK +0, INT +0, WIS +1, CHA +0 Languages - None
Nightvision
Nest Disturbed - Spiders create intricate webs, and the string spider is no different. They cover most surfaces in their chosen home with webs. While in contact with one of these webs, they can tell when a non-spider creature moves into a webbed area, as though using tremorsense.
Such environments are Difficult Terrain and entangle creatures that step into them (reflex negates). Breakout as a swift action.
Silk Jump - By placing a web on a surface, a spider can avoid Fall Damage when they Jump. They can also suspend themselves in midair, and climb back up this thread to return to their original starting point. This thread can be cut with any slash or pierce damage.
Speed - 45, 45 climb🧗. Can climb along any surface.
Deific Boons - Animal Instincts
Feats - Bullseye, Blind Fight, Butterfly Sting
Skills - +8 +Perception👀, +10 +Stealth, +10 +Acrobatics⚖,

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: bee-rex
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description: The ground thumps and you wonder if this region has earthquakes. You hear the sound of a tree snapping and look up to see an enormous mix of dinosaur and insect crush a small tree underfoot.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: Badger Mole
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description:
The walls crash open next to you and an enormous fluffy creature emerges from this new opening to the earth.Level 7 Huge BeastLigma - Claw (S) +10 2d6+3 (10) Earthbending (C) +10 5d10+3 (30)Innate Techniques - Thunder Stomp,
1/day - Crater,
Practiced Earthbender - A badger mole can use its earthbending damage to replace the damage of any technique with the earth tag.Shockwave [recharge] - As a standard action, huffer can slam its hooves into the ground to create a shock wave. Creatures within 10 feet of it take 2d6+2 (9) crush damage and are knocked down (fort halves dmg and negates knockdown).Stampede - A huffer can prepare to charge at the same time as another huffer. If they both charge attack the same creature, they attack with advantage.Music Lover - Badger moles will not attack any creature trained in the perform skill who is currently performing. Outside of combat, they can be calmed by a creature proficient in the perform skill such that the badger mole is willing to aid them in simple tasks.
Ability Scores - STR +3, DEX +0, LUK +0, INT -2, WIS +1, CHA +0 Languages - Understands, but cannot speak, primordial Speed - 30, Badger moles can earthbend as a standard action each turn to effectively give them a burrow speed equal to their land speed.
Earthbending - As the Earthbending Style of the same name
Deific Boons - Animal Instincts
Sightless Blindsense - Scent (15 ft), Tremorsense (100 ft) Feats - Skills - +5 perception, +9 athletics

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: Shirshu
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description:
This mix between bear and mole towers over you. It grunts and rapidly inhales through its nose as it inspects the item you presented, before it darts off to hunt for the items owner.Level 8 Huge BeastTongue (S) +13 (+Venom) 2d6+3 (10) Claw (S) +11 2d8+3 (12)Multiattack - Make 1 tongue and 1 claw attackInnate Techniques - Preparation, Break Free
1/day - Bestial Claw (U4), Burst of Speed
Venom - On-hit character is stunned. Creature can save against the effect at the end of their turn. Creatures get advantage on saves against this venom if they have saved out of it once already in the last hour. Extend - As a swift action, increase the range of tongue attacks by 30 ft for the rest of the turn. Special Attack: Tongue Swipe: You can use your tongue attack on two creatures within 10 feet of each other.Elite Tracking - Shirshu are practically extinct, with the few that still live existing in captivity. They are naturally gifted trackers and such talents are typically nourished by a knowledgeable captor.
When presented with an item that has a creature's scent on it, very little can prevent the shirshu from finding its target. It can follow its scent across continents, under water, underground etc. If the creature currently exists on the same Plane, the shirshu will follow the most direct path to reach this creature, usually informing its master of the general distance (within a mile, dozens, hundreds or thousands of miles) via gestures.If the target is dead, it will lead you to its body. If the target went to another plane, it will bring you to the portal (potentially allowing you to continue the chase) or its last location before teleporting. Other strange circumstances can also completely prevent a shirshu from smelling anything related to a creature.Only through repeated exposure to powerfully smelling chemicals (such as perfume) can a creature evade a shirshu's scent. Such exposure requires enough to fully submerge a creature, typically increasing its price 10x for medium creatures. You must submerge yourself in this fluid every day. You can also choose to make yourself smell rancid for a similar effect that instead lasts for a week, provided you don't clean up. Such a scent can easily be obtained via smearing yourself in fecal matter or taking a dip in a sewer, but you yourself are always sickened 2 while this persists.
Ability Scores - STR +3, DEX +2, LUK +0, INT -3, WIS +1, CHA +0 Speed - 45
Sightless Blindsense - Scent (120 ft)
Deific Boons - Animal Instincts
Feats - Skill Focus, Signature Skill (survival), Combat Reflexes, Sentinel, Fighter's Lament
Skills - +11 (+8) +Perception👀, +13 +Athletics🏊, +27 +Survival🐾

bestiary/bestiary/celestials/level-folde.title: cherub
bestiary/bestiary/celestials/level-folde.description: Your date with this handsome lad is going terribly, but he suddenly perks up and things go great. You see a shimmer as a little baby with feathered wings gives you a wink, before disappearing.

bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.title: boom-bot
bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.description: Just a step above a hazard, this mobile mine rushes towards you with the singular purpose of ruining your day.

bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.title: automaton
bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.description: A humanoid robot stands a few heads taller than a man with oversized arms. You see it stop the thief that rushes out of the town square by launching one of its arms as a projectile and pinning them.

bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.title: hecklebot
bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.description: This robot never shuts up, constantly throwing insults at anything that it thinks can be offended.

bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.title: monkey-gree-gree
bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.description:
Level 3 Large Construct [boss]AC 19 HP 40 Poise 25 Fort +5, Refl +4, Will +2Resistance - Poison, Psychic, Force, Mind affecting +4Unarmed (P) +5 (+4 grapple) (20/40) d10+3 (8) +d6 zap (overcharge)Multiattack - Make 2 unarmed attacks.Innate Techniques - Mad MonkeysSpecial Attack: Rocket Punch - Make a thrown weapon attack using unarmed damage. If successful, make a drag attack with no MA penalty. If the drag is successful, the creature is pulled adjacent.Aura: Stance Change - The Monkey Gree Gree swaps between three different faces: Monkey covering eyes, monkey covering ears and monkey covering mouth. It starts covering its ears, and swaps at the start of each turn after the first in a repeating loop (cover ears, cover eyes, then mouth). Each stance has an aura that radiates 60 ft with a different effect.Cover Ears - All creatures within the aura are deafened, giving them -4 perception. Cover Eyes - All creatures within the area are blinded.\ Cover Mouth - All creatures within the aura are silenced.The Gree Gree radiates this aura while hiding in plain sight. The Gree Gree is affected by its own aura.\Yes Master - When an automaton is programmed, it is done so while listening to a voice. By mimicking this voice with a DC 20 disguise check, you can give the automaton new orders. Can only be attempted once. With a DC 13 engineering check, an inactive automaton can be reprogrammed.Hand Needed - When an automaton uses its pin down technique, it loses access to the hand and its multi-attack on subsequent turns until the creature removes it and it magnetizes back.Ability Scores - Str +3, Dex +0, Lucc +0, Int +2, Wis +0, Cha +0Speed - 25 landHide in Plain SightLanguage Processing - By listening to someone speak a language, an automaton can slowly learn how to speak a language over the course of 1 minute.
Feats - Point Blank MasterSkills - +4 perception, +7 athletics, +8 engineering

bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.title: Dark Iron Enforcer
bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.description:
A mechanical dwarf stomps towards intruders. Lava seems to course through its black metal chassis. It lets off some exhaust before speaking. "Present Identification."Level 4 Medium ConstructResistance - Fire, Charm
Multiattack - Make an axe attack and an unarmed attack.
Innate Techniques - Sky Uppercut
1/day - Defensive Spin, Toe Smasher, Ups and Downs
Constant - Quake, Technology
Signature Skill - Boo, Big Shot
Stoke Flames (fire) (Recharge)- As a standard action, an enforcer can unleash a gout of flames upon creatures in a 20 ft cone in front of it. All creatures take 4d6 (14) fire damage. Any creature that wears medium or heavy armor has it softened and melted, gaining Weakness 5 crush for 1 round (reflex halves dmg and negates weakness). Recharges after using exhaust.
Exhaust (recharge) (Poison)- As a standard action, an enforcer can release a thick cloud of exhaust in a 10 ft radius around it that lingers for 1 round. This creates Total Concealment. Any non-construct🤖 creatures in the area take 4d6 (14) poison damage and are sickened 2 (fort halves dmg and sickened). Recharges after using stoke flames.
Viking - When an enforcer is made Wet, it disables its turbo thrusters and stoke flames abilities.
Dark Iron Duty - Unless Taunted or attacked first by one directly, an enforcer cannot attack a Dwarf⛏
Ability Scores - STR +3, DEX +0, LUK +0, INT +1, WIS +0, CHA +0 Turbo Thrusters - As a swift action, an enforcer can either increase their speed by 10, or take flight until the end of their turn. As an immediate action they can negate fall damage they take. For overland travel, a dark iron enforce need not sleep, and their thrusters allow them to fly long distances. They can travel 600 miles a day.
Feats - Skill Focus, Signature Skill, Unarmed Combatant
Skills - +6 +Perception👀, +13 (adv) +Intimidation😱, +9 +Athletics🏊, +7 +Local
ligma

bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.title: Turbo Frogg
bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.description:
?Level 5 Large Construct/BeastMultiattack - Make a tongue and bite attack
Innate Techniques - Laser Pointer, Crash, Pounce, Sprint
1/day - Plague of Frogs (U3), Hot Potato
Constant - Unbreakable Advance, Warpath
Turbo Charged Elusive - Whenever a turbo frogg takes the Charge action, it can continue its movement up and over the creature. It can charge into the air.
Special Attack: Electro Whip Zap - Make a tongue attack that deals an additional 2d8 (9) zap damage. The creature is Staggered On-hit (fort negates).
Crash Landing - As a swift action, a turbo frogg can augment a Jump give it some extra oomph. When the frogg lands, it deals 20 Poise damage to creatures within 10 ft. Any poise broken creatures are Knocked Down. If it uses this ability when charging, it must end the movement of the charge where it lands.Short Circuit (elusive)- When a turbo frogg takes any zap damage, their turbo thrusters activate, shooting them 15 ft in a random direction.
Ability Scores - STR +3, DEX +2, LUK +3, INT -2, WIS -1, CHA +0 Languages - Common (cannot speak)
Hoppin' - A frogg can Jump as far and as high as its speed automatically. It can also jump as a free action.
Amphibious
Speed - 40 Land Speed
Deific Boon - frog shape
Feats - Maneuver Versatility, Matador, Tumbling Charge
Skills - +6 +Perception👀, +10 +Athletics🏊, +9 +Acrobatics⚖

bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.title: boom-reaver
bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.description: This titan of a construct descends upon you with jet thrusters, delivering a message from its employer before bringing down the axe.

bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.title: froggalier
bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.description: This frog snail hybrid slithers towards you. It screams "CHARGE" but you laugh at its speed. The power of the snail comes as a surprise to you as it slams into you.

bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.title: wobbler
bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.description: A strange blue creature stares at you. You try and tap it, causing it to wobble, before rebounding and smacking you backwards.

bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.title: scavenger
bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.description: This humanoid creature has pale skin, long claws, sharp teeth and the whites of its eyes are a strange color. If feasts upon the rancid carrion left behind by a predator ages ago.

bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.title: frozen-mammoth
bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.description: A mammoth covered in frost trudges through the tundra. Each step a heavy thud even through the muffled snow. An entire group of them walks by and pays you no mind, so long as you keep your distance.

bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/cryptids.html.title: Cryptids
bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/cryptids.html.description: Cryptid is the category that any creature that doesn't fit in elsewhere goes. They often are a mix of or resemble another creature type, but don't fit in with them neatly.

bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.title: dragonfly
bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.description: A shining insect floats through the air around its draconic ally, enchanting its scales with protective wards. It flicks its tongue at you as you fail to harm it and its allies.

bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.title: whelp
bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.description: The whelp represents an underdeveloped member of a draconic species, before it gets many of the cool features typical of adult dragons. Many are frozen at this stage in development, unable to grow.

bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.title: shrubbagazzor
bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.description: The shrubbagazzor is a creature born of magical manipulation of topiary. These creatures can also be born in response to the mistreatment of the natural world to fight against corruption.

bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.title: bone-beetle
bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.description:
Level 2 Small Undead/BeastAC 23 HP 50 Poise 24 Fort +3, Refl +9, Will +3Immune - Poison, DiseaseResistance - NecroticReformation - Instead of being defeated, a bog creeper immediately dissipates into several bone beetles. These beetles act on the bog creepers turn. If any remain at the end of the bog creepers next turn (including any it summoned previously), the bog creeper reforms at the point closest to all that remain with (beetles*10) hp.Carrion Consumption [healing] [recharge] - Bog creepers often keep decaying and diseased creatures inside of its lair for later consumption. As a swift action, a bog creeper can consume such a creature to gain 20 temp hp and recharge its breath weapon.Bite (P) +10 d8+4 (8)Multiattack - Make 2 thorn attacks.Innate Techniques - Blight, Bone CageBoss Actions - Back and Better than Ever - After using reformation, use breath weapon. Freedom! - After taking damage, summon a bone beetle. Paralytic - Breath Weapon [recharge] - Bad Breath - For 1 round after using its breath weapon, or carrion consumption, a bog creeper emits a horrific stench. Creatures it bites during this time become sickened 2. Any creature within 20 ft of the bog creeper during this time is made sickened 1 (fort negates). Creatures with the scent ability have disadvantage on this save.Weakness - Slash 2, Fire 2Ability Scores - Str -1, Dex +4, Lucc +0, Int -, Wis +0, Cha +0Sightless Blindsense - Tremorsense (60 ft)Speed - 5Feats - Snap Shot, Point Blank Master, Combat ReflexesSkills - +5 perception, +9 stealth
No Man's Sky creature

bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.title: README
bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.description: A pestilent creature with creatures jittering around just underneath its scales, this dragon has bad intentions and worse breath. These creatures prefer the semi aquatic slurry of swamps to the air.

bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.title: broodmother
bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.description: An enormous female dragon covered in spines and (often) babies. Brood mothers are one of the most popular dragons since they provide a steady supply of eggs for poachers to sell as pets.

bestiary/bestiary/elementals/level-folde.title: deadbeat-djinn
bestiary/bestiary/elementals/level-folde.description: You pick up a bottle, disappointed that its empty only for a creature to pop out. This stinky humanoid has no legs, only a twisting tempest that hovers above the ground connected to the bottle.

bestiary/bestiary/elementals/level-folde.title: snowman
bestiary/bestiary/elementals/level-folde.description: A top hat rest on the snow. You go to investigate only for a snowman to emerge from the snow underneath and lob a snowball at you.

bestiary/bestiary/elementals/level-folde.title: cheezette
bestiary/bestiary/elementals/level-folde.description: A duo of cheesy ladies rest on a slice of floating pizza. They work in tandem, encouraging and enhancing each other.

bestiary/bestiary/elementals/level-folde.title: stalagmight
bestiary/bestiary/elementals/level-folde.description: I don't like the look of those spines...

bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/0.title: censorship-fairy
bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/0.description: You get a glimpse of a beautiful woman swimming naked in a lake. When you get a closer look, you can't seem to get a good look as rays of light, leaves and steam always seem to cover her naughty bits.

bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/1.title: gnome
bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/1.description: A pointed hat and thick white hair leading into a beard and mustache grace the head of this short creature. One of its allies tosses it across the battlefield and reveals the hat isn't for show.

bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/4.title: high-roller
bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/4.description: This tiny fairy carries a pack filled with dice. It regularly rolls these dice during the battle, growing more powerful the higher it rolls.

bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/4.title: satyr
bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/4.description: A mischievous pan flute playing creature with a humanoid torso and furry hooved legs prances about. Their magic music twists the nature of any magic affecting them with random results.

bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/5.title: README
bestiary/bestiary/fey/level-folder-fey/5.description: The once innocent looking old lady transforms before your eyes into a wicked monster with plant-like growths and magic fetishes covering its body. Her cackle makes your skin crawl.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: tramp
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: You open a book and read some magic words only for a short fiend to pop out. It makes some suggestive comments and would love to spend more time with you.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: imp
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: This ornery fiend is quick to change its mood, always looking for guidance from one of its superiors. Once they give the signal, they ready their claws and light themselves ablaze.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: blessings
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: This androgynous fiend wraps itself around an ally before worming its tongue into its mouth and locking lips. You see two more emerge from a pool of blood and crawl towards you, licking their lips.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: hellhound
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: A red and black dog the size of a man crunches some bones in its mouth. When it realizes you are in the room, it moves to bigger and tastier things to munch on.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: pamper
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: A pleasant creature as far as fiends go, these quadrupeds cling to their master and fulfill their every desire. Master desires your death so they rush with great speeds to tear you to pieces.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: meathook
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: This fiery fiend has chains that clatter as it swings itself across the battlefield. It laughs and squeals with joy as it slaps you and your allies around and digs its spiked jaw into your face.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: twinkubus
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: An androgynous creature with tiny horns lies in bed with some brutish looking men. It gives the order to take care of you and they do so with great pleasure, an unnatural fervor to their compliance.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: Dust Devil
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description:
A tempest of dust makes its way towards you, the shadowy demonic figure within commanding and riding the winds.Level 4 Medium Fiend (Monster)Resistance - +4 Air
Amorphous - +15Claws (S) +7 (+4 MV) 2d8+3 (12) Airbending (C) +7 (30 ft, +2 Bullseye) 3d8+3 (16)
Multiattack - Make 2 claw attacks.
Innate Techniques - Kidnap, Pocket Sand
1/week - Wasteland
Dust Storm Aura Air Recharge - Requires a standard action to activate, lasting 1 minute. 20 ft radius. Blinds all non-Fiends👿 for 1 turn (fort reduces to blurred vision). Recharges after 10 minutes.
Choking Debris (recharge) (air) - Target a creature within a Dust Storm Aura. Exhale a large quantity of dust in their direction and force it down their throat. They take 2d6 (7) slashing damage and are sickened 1 immediately (fort negates). At the end of their next 3 turns they take this damage and are sickened 1 again, then make a new save to end the effect.
Special Attack: Vacuum Wave (air) - Target a creature within 30 feet with a drag attack. If successful, drag them adjacent and deal claw damage.
Dry Spell - If a dust devil takes damage from or fails a save against a water effect, it is also sickened 1. Submerging it in water or exposing it to many gallons has the same effect.
Weakness - 3 Holy
Ability Scores - STR +3, DEX +2, LUK +0, INT -3, WIS +0, CHA +0 Languages - Understands, but cannot speak, infernal
Airbending - As the Airbending Style of the same name
Feats - Maneuver Versatility, Bullseye
Skills - +6 +Perception👀

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: hell-knight
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: You hear a loud crashing sound coming from the church only to find two hulking fiends wrestling. When they slam into one another, they release a powerful shockwave that hurts your ears.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: sudoku
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: A crazy demon laughs as it rides into battle on a unicycle, exploding out of a building every so often, blazing a trail wherever it goes.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: the-flexicutioner
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: An enormous fiendish woman sits on her throne of bones, holding a man in her bloody claws. She crushes him into a pulp and her demonic minions cheer, then sighs and gestures for you to approach next.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: README
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description: Level 10 Medium Fiend [unique] [boss] [mastermind]AC 25 HP 80 Poise 24 Fort +10, Refl +10, Will +15Resistance - +4 vs mind-affectingTouch +10 Charms indefinitely. If in combat, reduces to 1 round.Innate Techniques - Corpse Transposition, Darting Duplicate, Overstimulate, Tongue Twister 1/day - Nightmare, Domination, Order 66Power Word N (Su) [mind affecting] [language] [recharge] [subtle] - Slur'Nesh can utter a heinous word, and have it echo from the mouth of a creature within 60 feet. This word carries such vulgarity that it causes another creature within 30 ft of the original target to fly into a blind and senseless rage at the original target. They are taunted by the creature for 3 rounds, and use their deadliest most powerful abilities to kill them as quickly as possible.If the creature is a minion to Slur'Nesh, or if the secondary target has been subjugated by the race/people of the primary target, this has no save. If they are not they have disadvantage but (will negates). If the creatures have been allies for an extended amount of time, are family etc, then they do not make the save at disadvantage.Essentially, target 1 creature to taunt another with the power of racism. The two creatures relationship and races affect how difficult it is to resist.Summon Ally [companion] - 1 Living ForgeCycle of Hate - Superior Polymorph - Any successful checks to transform Slur'Nesh back into its true form instead deals 20 true damage to it.True Form - Slur'Nesh avoids its true form at all costs. If it drops to 0 hp, all remaining damage is ignored and it transforms into its true form. It cannot use its polymorph ability again until it rests. It cannot use any abilities listed in this form while in its true forms, and gets a new set of abilities and stats.Ability Scores - Str +0, Dex +0, Lucc +2, Int +3, Wis +3, Cha +3Hierarchy - When Slur'Nesh is in a settlement of intelligent creatures, it can intuitively tell certain aspects of the social hierarchy. It knows which types of people are subjugated, as well as who does the subjugation, and can generally tell how extreme said subjugation is.If the settlement is generally egalitarian, then it can intuit 3 specific creatures who break this mold.Shape Change [poly, true] - Any humanoid, including any racial features. Can be used as a free action 1/turn.Rumormonger - Slur'Nesh can attempt to spread a rumor throughout a small town or larger settlement by attempting a deception check. The difficulty depends on the size, ranging from 10 for a small town to 30 for a metropolis, though this difficulty may be modified if the population as a whole tends towards skepticism or insanity.It takes a week for a rumor to spread. If it succeeds by 5 or more, the time is reduced to 3 days. If it fails by 5 or more, the rumor mutates into a competing theory.Can only have 1 rumor brewing at once.Feats - SF Deception, SS Deception, SF Insight, SS InsightSkills - +15 perception, +19 (adv) insight, +19 (adv) deception, +19 disguise, +15 local, +15 planes, +15 history, +15 linguisticsEnvy from Fullmetal Alchemist by Jinwu

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: Balrogue
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description:
You call for your squire only to realize he is nowhere to be seen. One by one your allies seem to disappear until you are the only one that remains. The last thing you remember is a fiery whip wrapping around you as you are dragged into the shadows.Level 11 Medium Fiend (Mastermind)Resistance - Fire
EvasionWhip (fire) +15 (+8 drag, +2 topple, +4 MV) d6+4 (7) +Last Whisper
Multiattack - Make a Whip attack and a Drag attack
Innate Techniques - Achilles Heel, Assassinate, Bullet Time, Kidnap, Twist the Knife (U5), Dark Lure, Living Shadow, Invisibility, Dead Silent
1/day - Alpha Strike, Adrenaline Burst, Illusory Wall, Mirage
Cunning Action - A balrogue has an additional standard action that it can use to do anything that is not an attack, casting a spell or using a Su ability, unless it is to do the following...
Into the Shadows - A balrogue can drag a creature up to 60 ft, depositing them anywhere within Reach of their whip.
Last Whisper - Against a DD target, a balrogue's whip attacks silence for 1 round On-hit or whenever the it successfully drags a creature.
Signature Skill - stalker, dampen presence Infernal Seal -
Weakness - 5 holy
Ability Scores - STR +1, DEX +4, LUK +2, INT +3, Wis +3, Cha +0 Languages - All non-secret Speed - 55
Equipment - Whip (with elemental (fire) magic weapon property)
Darkvision
Fade Away - A balrogue can use Blur as an innate technique if it has already used all of its other actions. A balrogue can take 10 on stealth, resulting in a 34 for most balrogues.
Deific Boons - from my cold dead head, born in darkness, shadow blending
Feats - Sniper, Fleet Footwork, Signature Skill, Maneuver Versatility
Skills - +19 (+4 Invisibility, adv) +Stealth, +17 to all other non-+Knowledge🧠 skills. +17 +Local, +17 +Planes

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: the-master
