While in draconic form, you can use a breath weapon, dealing 3d8+LvL damage of a specific elemental type (chosen when you gain this boon) in either a 30 ft cone or a 60 ft line. This breath weapon has the recharge tag, and the tag of the elemental damage type you chose.You can swap forms as a standard action.If you are a dragon...
This boon gives you the ability to transform into a specific humanoid form, chosen when you gain this boon. While in this form, you lose any abilities dependent on your physical form (like Tail Swipe). You are constantly under the effect of Tongues. You can swap forms as a free action 1/round.

gods/gods/demigods/+demigods.html.title: +Demigods
gods/gods/demigods/+demigods.html.description: There exist a great many lesser or local deities that are much less popular, and therefore do not follow the same kind of rules as the other gods. They are still more mortal than divine, and are free to exert their lesser influence directly in the mortal realm. There are even rules on how a player character can become one under Ascendance.These demon dukes, demigods and other lesser deities can be killed like any man. They do still have abilities similar to gods, such as the ability to grant boons, and project their deific aspect, however their ability to perform miracles is limited. Demigods must often fight tooth and nail to not fade into irrelevance once the next generation of mortals forgets them for their deeds.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/e.title: Earth Mother
gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/e.description: Mother Earth is the god of all things untamed and natural. She is the oldest of all deities. It is said that she was the entity that created the realm of mortals. A piece of her exists inside of all living things. As such, she has no true domain. But there are locations where life is at its most dense that are considered sacred, like lush rain forests, coral reefs and the valleys between forested mountains.Many see Mother Earth as a benevolent force, but she is primarily an entity that seeks balance between sentient creatures and the rest of the world. Many great tragedies have happened to people in the past when mankind overstepped its boundaries: Floods, earthquakes and storms the likes of which the world is better off never seeing again. These stories and their lessons are passed down through those studying under the druidic arts so that way such tragedies can be prevented from happening again.She is often depicted as a resting land mass, the bends of her shoulders, knees and hips creating mountains. While out and about, she is humanoid in shape, thought she appears to be entirely composed of lush green vegetation.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.title: T1 - Friend of the Forest
gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.description:
Tags: Su
You can pacify Beasts🐻 and Plants🪴. If used out of combat, you can usually cause it to run off or generally be okay with your presence. If used in combat, it is a standard action, has a range of 30 ft, and inflicts the pacified condition for 1 round (will negates).
gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Earthly Deities/Earth Mother/T1 - Friend of the Forest.md

gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.title: T1 - Spirit Animal
gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.description:
Tags: Su, poly, true
You can transform into a specific small or smaller terrestrial or aquatic beast that must be chosen when you gain this boon. This grants you Scent (5 ft) and either a swim speed, climb speed or 40 land speed. You gain no other additional abilities a creature possesses. You can only transform into this beast. The transformation lasts until you end it. You can exit this form as a swift action.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.title: T2 - The Forest has Ears
gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.description: Tags: Su, Scrying You can touch a living tree as a standard action to project your sense of hearing into another tree within 100 ft of it, even one you cannot see.
gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Earthly Deities/Earth Mother/T2 - The Forest has Ears.md

gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.title: T3 - Nature's Vigilance
gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.description:
Tags: Sp
You can innately cast Voice of the Forest once a week. As part of speaking, you can choose to manifest your spirit as visible deific aspect of the earth mother, allowing her to speak through you instead of the usual effects.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.title: T4 - Feywilds Transportation
gods/gods/earthly-deities/earth-mother/t.description:
Tags: - The Feywilds is a place that mirrors the mortal plane, and if you know where to look, you can temporarily slip into the feywilds and back again to speed up travel. By slipping under fallen logs, climbing into tree branches and passing through waterfalls, you can always find a portal to the feywilds in a setting unmarred by civilization within 1 hour. While traveling through such areas, you can use this popping in and out of Planes to speed up overland travel and make tracking you almost impossible.
You and any you bring along can travel 1,000 miles each day through this method. Any creature that lacks this boon cannot follow you unless they roll a DC 40 +Survival🐾 check to track you. In a +Chase, you can win 1 round using this feature.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/frogg-saran/fr.title: Frogg Saran
gods/gods/earthly-deities/frogg-saran/fr.description:
Frogg Saran is chaos incarnate. He is known to give blessings and curses in equal measure. Frogg Saran is a very active force in the world of Nack, worming his way into many people's lives whether they like it or not. All this god seeks is to increase the amount of entropy in the universe. His followers start riots and revolutions merely to change the status quo. They reincarnate people just to see the reaction to their new body.Frogg Saran's odd fixation on the rubbery amphibious creature causes frogs to be revered by his followers. Special care should be taken when interacting with any frog or frog-adjacent creature, or risk unwittingly getting dragged into the machinations of this mad god. You never know when what looks like an ordinary frog could be a Giant Frog, a Lunatic🐸, or worse yet, Frogg himself in disguise.The true form of Frogg Saran is unknown, though many suspect his true form is that of a smug frog, save for its eyes are replaced with gnashing maws. It is a common way he appears before mortals, but with other common occurrences being cheese and tentacles, some depict him as an otherworldly aberration, or a rodent..
Because it is possible to have faith in Frogg with negative WIS, the traditional scaling for Prayer doesn't work. You instead get a point of prayer for each point of LUK you have, and it doesn't always work. When he does answer prayers, they are typically in unexpected ways, and tend to be useful in ways other than providing advice.This could mean the place you are looking for suddenly explodes, the handsome fellow you were interested in talking to reveals they are a homosexual, or a frog will lead the way.In any such case, the advice/assistance comes in a much more dramatic and roundabout way.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/frogg-saran/t1.title: T1 - Frog Shape
gods/gods/earthly-deities/frogg-saran/t1.description:
Tags: Su poly, true
You can change into a tiny frog. While in frog shape, you gain the following qualities from the Polymorph List🧬.You can transform into or back from frog form as a free action 1/turn.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/frogg-saran/t2.title: T2 - Born Again Believer
gods/gods/earthly-deities/frogg-saran/t2.description:
Tags: Sp, Recharge
You can innately cast Reincarnate 1/day. When you cast reincarnate, you gain access to a random innate technique that you can use once, or that is immediately Prepared for the remainder of the day. While you have this technique, you lose access to reincarnation. After you expend the technique, you regain access to reincarnation. See chart below for determining what technique you gain.
Using this technique in a particularly creative and chaotic way can potentially grant you GBP. Up to GM interpretation what qualifies. Prepared techniques might require you to use the skill bonus, or let your arm fall off for something like Rapid Recovery.When you truly believe, you are rewarded. Roll on this chart to see what technique tree, then roll d6 until you get a technique level you have access to. Then roll another dice in a similar method to determine what technique in that tier (something like a d10 should usually suffice).
Ex. I roll 12 and get Cataclysm. Then I roll d6 and get 6, but I'm only level 5 and don't have access to tier 6 techniques. I roll d6 again and get a 1. I roll d8 and get a 1, giving me access to the 5G technique.
gods/gods/earthly-deities/frogg-saran/t2.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Earthly Deities/Frogg Saran/T2 - Born Again Believer.md

gods/gods/emissaries.html.title: Emissaries
gods/gods/emissaries.html.description: Each god has a single mortal that they choose as their most dedicated, trusted and powerful follower. This follower is known as the emissary of X god. Emissaries gain extra boons, and usually a direct line of communication to their deity.

gods/gods/power-of-god.html.title: Power of God
gods/gods/power-of-god.html.description: Gods are beings that have purposefully not been given stat blocks, because fighting a god via conventional means, that being swords and magic, is impossible. An ancient and powerful pact is in place that prevents the gods from seizing mortals as puppets to enact their will, and forces them to figure out more subtle and indirect means of acquiring what they want.This same pact makes them immune to conventional weapons. Gods have so much mana flowing through them that no singular person is close to powerful enough to even scratch them. This same mana allows them to perform incredible feats, often referred to as miracles.Gods are free to walk amongst mortals only sparingly, as doing so requires a great deal of mana. As such they usually prefer only to appear in their Deific Aspects which only allow them to exert a fraction of their power, and appear as a translucent spectral version of themselves. They can also appear as a mortal, unable to exert any of their usual deific powers, and usually having a hard time gathering the attention of mortals. They also use other indirect means, such as using their followers as vessels, projecting only their voice or having their messages appear in writing via ink or blood.Gods are not all-knowing, nor are they all-powerful. They have the ability to focus their attention on many places at once, with much greater detail in places where their followers exist. They hear and answer prayers while doing other things, but often still need to defer such tasks to close allies. Certain types of things may draw their focus, such as hearing a prayer related to a matter that interests them, or a ritual in their honor conducted by one of their favorite disciples, or an enemy defacing their places of worship.Gods must carefully consider what they focus their attention on, and what they do. Their existence may seem immutable, but the countless gods lost to time suggest otherwise. They must satisfy the desires of mortals, lest they lose their source of power. As such, gods tend to only give boons to the dedicated, and only make appearances amongst mortals if it can be flashy and garner a lot of attention. A constant form of pageantry they must perform in order to maintain their power and increase their influence.

gods/gods/tiering-system.html.title: Tiering System
gods/gods/tiering-system.html.description:
So if gods come in tiers, what determines the tier of a deity? I'll do my best to describe how I conceptualize the ideas in my head to justify my choices. A god's tier is not set in stone and can change over time.These are level 12 characters with the Demigod Ascendance. They are incredibly powerful and show promise, but are very much still mortal. If they can capture the hearts and minds of enough people, they can continue to exist. Few demigods ever make a lasting impact.
Other high level creatures with great spiritual or cultural significance can also fall into this category, with local legends and reverence fueling their strength. Something like the painted lady from TLA. Kings and emperors of the past have been ascribed deific power/significance through concepts like the divine right of kings in the west or the mandate of heaven in the east.These demigods are creatures that are still mortal, but are higher than level 12. They have managed to solidify a niche on the world with a group of dedicated followers that extends past that of a single generation from a single town.
The Inevitable are considered T2 deities. They represent concepts such as death or time, and destroy those who seek to defy their authority and bend their laws. Their active role in the mortal realm prevents them from ever becoming more powerful deities.
This is where gods become untouchable to mortals. They do no have stat blocks and can no longer directly intervene in the lives of mortals. See the power of god page for more details.
Tier 3 gods are well known in many regions of the world. Entire races and countries subscribe to their way of life. Demon Lords👿 are commonly T3 gods, as their followers are forced to constantly butt heads with creatures around the world, keeping their population and influence in check.The most powerful of all the deities represent forces so fundamental to existence that they cannot help but be relevant. Basically every intelligent creatures knows of, and must respect these deities, lest they feel their wrath.Other gods bend their knees to these deities and allow their followers to abide by certain practices, such as respect for the dead or reverence for the natural world, to avoid having their followers wiped out.

gods/deific-boons.html.title: Deific Boons
gods/deific-boons.html.description:
The gods of have a vested interest in the goings on in the world of mortals, and what better way to get mortals to do your bidding then to give them your favor when they act in your interest? This system is designed to provide active incentives for characters to enact the will of the deities in the world: the more that you please a god with your actions, follow their tenets and donate to their causes, the more favor they grant to you.The amount of favor that the gods provide to you is broken up into tiers. The tier a favor that you're at is determined by the amount of God Benediction Points (GBP) you earn through various tasks. In general, you cannot earn the favor of a god by accident. In all but the most extreme cases, such as defeating the mortal enemy of a god, you must first learn about a deity to start gaining their favor. As such you cannot start accruing GBP until you have positive WIS, or speaking with priests, cultists or froggs to learn more about what the gods desire.
Some classes, and characters with positive wisdom start off with GBP, and gain it passively as they level up by doing things like Mana Donation at local religious institutions, attending services, making offerings to their god or converting others. Every 10 GBP you gain an additional boon.By performing tasks that cater more closely to a specific god's desires, you can earn actively earn more GBP. As you advance in tiers the criteria for what grants additional GBP should also increase in difficulty. The inverse is also true: If you act in such a way that your god disapproves, you can lose GBP. Such losses can often be recouped through forms of repentance. Here's another handy chart to help you determine what boons you have based on your wisdom at later levels.
Not all gods are created equal. The older and more powerful a god is, the more boons they can offer. Level 12 characters that choose the Demigod Ascendance can only grant T1 boons, while ancient deities that everybody knows and respects like the Earth Mother🍃 can grant the highest tier boons. Some gods even have multiple boons that creatures can pick and choose from at certain tiers.
Frogg Saran🐸 doesn't play by the rules of the other deities. He is the only deity you can accrue GBP for if you have negative wisdom, and you can't gain GBP from him passively. See his page for more details.When you gain GBP through leveling up passively, you can decide to distribute these points however you wish between gods you worship. You can accrue boons from any number of gods.However...Some gods are completely incompatible. Namely Frogg Saran. No god would willingly associate themselves with any who abide by his way of life. Most deities are incompatible with
Demon Lords👿 as they have conflicting ethos. Other such examples can exist, such as the eternal struggle for relevance between Brazzeria🌖 and Gods/Gods/Demigods/Artemis/Artemis🌒.If the ideals, practices and goals of the gods you worship do not conflict in major ways, then you can accrue GBP from multiple gods without incurring their wrath.

lore/planes/planes.html.title: Planes
lore/planes/planes.html.description: The world of Nick Nacks is one that is not one planet, or even one dimension. The subsections below are a list of the other dimensions, called planes, that have properties that differentiate it from the mortal realm.

minigames/chase/+chase.html.title: +Chase
minigames/chase/+chase.html.description: Battlemaps are great! They allow you to visually represent things for set piece encounters. But what happens when the battle is on the move? Things like teleportation and tons of speed feel like a cop out and doesn’t bring the kind of tension you might want when trying to evade capture or running someone down.The chase rules exist as an alternative to combat to quantify certain types of strategies, advantages and random circumstances that can make your escape/chase feel a bit more dynamic.Keep in mind, chases require a great deal of improvisation since many abilities will be used for things that are atypical. The GM will need to create randomness (like parades, ornery animals in a pet store, oil spills) that can coincidentally benefit either side etc.Can also be used for races!

skills/general-thoughts/other-skill-rule.title: Gambit
skills/general-thoughts/other-skill-rule.description: Using a rule system inherently poses limitations on the actions that a player can take. The idea of gambits is to let players take their cool ideas and let them play out despite the games mechanics. If your player wants to do something flashy and dramatic that isn't necessarily covered by the rules (or only vaguely), then it counts as a gambit.The intention behind gambits is to create situations that have incredibly high risk and high reward. Before performing a gambit, the player tosses out a few ideas on how they plan to perform the action and the GM makes suggestions and/or adjustments based on circumstance. The GM should make it clear to the player what their roundabout odds are for completing a given gambit.Benefits for performing a gambit can include things like not taking fall damage with a plunging attack, gaining extra movement by swinging on things through danger or surviving otherwise deadly circumstances.Drawbacks for failing when attempting a gambit can include things like being CC'd, losing poise, losing hp or having their actions interrupted and made impossible. In extreme cases if players do something very silly, like jumping up cliffs or battling forces of nature, they may accumulate afflictions, or other long lasting debuffs.

skills/general-thoughts/other-skill-rule.title: Group Skill Checks
skills/general-thoughts/other-skill-rule.description: In certain circumstances, creatures may want to work together perform the same task. If it is something that can tangibly benefit from group effort (pushing over a large boulder, creating a spell etc.), use the bonus of the creature with the highest modifier, then get +1 for each assisting creature and +2 for each assistant creature that is proficient in the task at hand.In other circumstances, you may want to use skills as a group when you need to, even if it less than optimal, such as group stealth with a clumsy heavy armor user. In such scenarios, you use the bonus of the weakest link as though everybody were assisting them.
skills/general-thoughts/other-skill-rule.sourcePath: Skills/General Thoughts/Other Skill Rules/Group Skill Checks.md

skills/general-thoughts/other-skill-rule.title: Taking 10
skills/general-thoughts/other-skill-rule.description: When not under duress, you can take 10 on skill checks, automatically treating your dice rolls as though you had rolled a 10. You normally cannot take 10 on opposed skill checks. Good for profession and general crafting.

skills/general-thoughts/other-skill-rule.title: Taking 20
skills/general-thoughts/other-skill-rule.description: When not under duress, and with a lot of time on your hands, you can automatically achieve the result of rolling a 20. It takes 20 times as long as the task would normally take. It is also assumed that during this time, you fail several times, making it ill-suited for a situations where there are consequences on a fail (such as smashing a wall or deactivating an explosive).

skills/general-thoughts/general-thoughts.title: General Thoughts
skills/general-thoughts/general-thoughts.description: All creatures are proficient in perception, unless they are mindlessSkill rolls are how players interact with the world without hitting it with their sword. Even if certain actions have a skill associated with them, you don't necessarily need to roll a skill check (no need to roll deception if they already believe you, no need to roll athletics in still water, etc). When one is required, it is prompted by the DM. D20 can be very swingy, creating dramatically unexpected results. That is its strong suite. As such using a skill roll as a barrier for entry can create all or nothing scenarios. There's nothing wrong with saying "the lock is too complex for you to pick," but you can't be upset when immediately after the martials of the party start smashing into the door. Just like with attack rolls and saving throws, there should be lesser versions of success. If you barely fail the DC to scale a wall, it lowers your speed instead of falling. If you barely fail a stealth check while trailing someone, they can tell someone is in the bushes, but not who. Skill bonuses by default only use the relevant ability modifier.Proficiency in a skill grants you a 2+(lvl) bonus to the skill. Certain aspects of a skill might only be available to characters that are proficient in the skill and are denoted with a (P). The most advanced part of a skill require the Signature Skill feat and are denoted with a (SS). When you have multiple spells and/or items that give bonuses to skills, only take the highest bonus.Standard skill DCs are what should be used in the absence of a set or opposed DC. They are as follows…Some skills are opposed to other skills, while other skills will include examples comparable this chart.

skills/general-thoughts/skill-check.html.title: Skill Check
skills/general-thoughts/skill-check.html.description: Umbrella term that includes all skills. Some features give bonuses to skill checks in general rather than a specific skill.

skills/skills/acrobatics/+acrobatics.htm.title: +Acrobatics
skills/skills/acrobatics/+acrobatics.htm.description: Used for making risky jumps, traversing difficult terrain, and avoiding AoOs. Most actions are made as part of movement. Uses DEX.

skills/skills/acrobatics/avoid-aoo-(p).h.title: Avoid AoO (P)
skills/skills/acrobatics/avoid-aoo-(p).h.description: Acrobatics is rolled against all threatening creatures’ reflex saves. The DC of their reflex save is equal to your acrobatics roll. If they succeed, your ,movement Provokes as normal.

skills/skills/acrobatics/balance.html.title: Balance
skills/skills/acrobatics/balance.html.description: Acrobatics can be used to cross slippery surfaces coated in things like ice or oil. The default DC is 10, but changes to a creature's DC if it originates from an ability. Failing the check gives you the knocked down condition until the start of your next turn. It can also be used to traverse or stand on incredibly small and unstable space such as a cliff side or a fallen tree branch.

skills/skills/acrobatics/example-dcs.htm.title: Example DCs
skills/skills/acrobatics/example-dcs.htm.description:
Common modifiers to make the task more difficult can include…
Things such as the surfaces you interact with are moving or are wet.
Surfaces you interact with are patchy or broken.
Common modifiers to make the task less difficult can include
Guard rails (natural or manufactured)
Appropriate equipment, such as a long object for balance

skills/skills/acrobatics/excuse-me-(ss)..title: Excuse Me (SS)
skills/skills/acrobatics/excuse-me-(ss)..description: You can move through creatures' spaces without provoking from them, but you cannot end your turn inside of a creature's space. Strafing no longer provokes AoOs.

skills/skills/acrobatics/hopping-(ss).ht.title: Hopping (SS)
skills/skills/acrobatics/hopping-(ss).ht.description: You can Jump as a free action once each turn.

skills/skills/acrobatics/improved-jump-(.title: Improved Jump (P)
skills/skills/acrobatics/improved-jump-(.description: Your default jump distance is increased by 5 ft per point in DEX or STR.

skills/skills/acrobatics/leap-of-faith.h.title: Leap of Faith
skills/skills/acrobatics/leap-of-faith.h.description: A special type of jump action. Roll acrobatics to determine your jump distance/height to see if you can jump farther than your default jump distance. The distance you jump is equal to your acrobatics roll in feet, or half that in height. This still requires a swift action to perform.

skills/skills/acrobatics/soften-fall-(ss.title: Soften Fall (SS)
skills/skills/acrobatics/soften-fall-(ss.description: When you take the jump action, you reduce falling damage by your acrobatics roll.

skills/skills/acrobatics/wall-kick-(p).h.title: Wall Kick (P)
skills/skills/acrobatics/wall-kick-(p).h.description: As long as there are 2 solid surfaces within 5 feet of each other, you can continually hop between them to ascend, requiring no action. Only the upward distance you cover counts against your movement.

skills/skills/athletics/+athletics.html.title: +Athletics
skills/skills/athletics/+athletics.html.description: Used for climbing and swimming, as well as moving heavy objects and breaking things. Uses str.

skills/skills/athletics/aquatic-combatan.title: Aquatic Combatant (P)
skills/skills/athletics/aquatic-combatan.description: With athletics proficiency, you take no penalty to Underwater Combat with melee attacks.

skills/skills/athletics/breaking-objects.title: Breaking Objects
skills/skills/athletics/breaking-objects.description: Should we push over the tree or just cut it down? Players may find themselves in situations where it is unclear whether it would be more effective to just hack at their problem with their swords or try to break it open with brute strength. A lot of that depends on what it is you're trying to break and what it is you're using to break it.As a general rule, if the substance that you're using is more tough, and could reasonably damage the object you'd like to destroy (hammers aren't good at cutting ropes for instance) then you can damage/break the object just by swinging at it. Some consideration should still be taken about the size and scale of the object. Adamantine might cut through stone like butter, but a 3-ft thick stick of butter would still take quite a bit of effort to cut through.Use the following chart to determine roundabout how "tough" something is.

skills/skills/athletics/breakout.html.title: Breakout
skills/skills/athletics/breakout.html.description: There are a large number of scenarios where a character is pinned down by something other than another creature: Getting tangled in a web, caught in a vortex or buried under rock. In such scenario you can use breakout to escape such conditions. The action used for breakout varies based on the extremity of the effect.The DC to breakout of an effect that another creature created via a spell or ability is their DC

skills/skills/athletics/brute-force.html.title: Brute Force
skills/skills/athletics/brute-force.html.description: For when there are no lockpicks or beasts of burden, you have elbow grease. The DC to break an object, such as a cage or door, is based on its material and reinforcements. You can also use athletics to represent bursts of adrenaline that allow you to surpass your normal carry weight to push over statues and punch boulders into lava.

skills/skills/athletics/catch-fall-(p).h.title: Catch Fall (P)
skills/skills/athletics/catch-fall-(p).h.description: As an immediate action, you can attempt to grab onto something to halt your falling, or to prevent an ally within reach from falling. The default DC to do this is 20. Creatures falling farther than 30 feet increase this DC even higher.

skills/skills/athletics/climbing.html.title: Climbing
skills/skills/athletics/climbing.html.description: Assuming ideal climbing conditions, no check is required, such as when climbing an average tree. Spaces you climb through are considered difficult terrain.With athletics proficiency, you climb at full speed.

skills/skills/athletics/example-dcs.html.title: Example DCs
skills/skills/athletics/example-dcs.html.description:
Common modifiers to make the task more difficult can include…
The surfaces you are interacting with are wet or moving.
You are swimming in substances other than water that are more grimy or viscous\
Extra reinforcements to enhance the structural soundness and prevent breakage
Common modifiers to make the task less difficult can include...
You are climbing at a >90 degree angle, or the surface was designed to be climbed\
Flotation devices (driftwood, floaties)
Age or fundamental flaws/weaknesses in the structure
How much of something you want to destroy can also influence how difficult it is. If you want to tear a brick out of a wall, that would make breaking the stone easier. If you want to break down the entire wall, that is much more difficult.

skills/skills/athletics/power-lifter-(ss.title: Power Lifter (SS)
skills/skills/athletics/power-lifter-(ss.description: Double your carry weight.When you carry an ally, they are not made clumsy.

skills/skills/athletics/swimming.html.title: Swimming
skills/skills/athletics/swimming.html.description: Assuming ideal climbing conditions, no check is required, such as when swimming in still water. Spaces you swim through are considered difficult terrain.With athletics proficiency, you swim at full speed.

skills/skills/athletics/triathlete-(ss)..title: Triathlete (SS)
skills/skills/athletics/triathlete-(ss)..description:
You gain an additional 20 speed each turn you can use to climb and swim.To swim in water it must be at least waist deep.
To climb a surface it must be at least as tall as you are, able to withstand your weight and continuous.

skills/skills/deception/+deception.html.title: +Deception
skills/skills/deception/+deception.html.description: Simply put, lying. This skill is almost always opposed to +Insight🤔. Uses CHA.

skills/skills/deception/convey-secret-me.title: Convey Secret Message (P)
skills/skills/deception/convey-secret-me.description: By speaking in roundabout terms and making subtle gestures, you can communicate a simple idea (we need to leave, time to strike) while in company that might scrutinize. The DC to convey this message is 15. The intended recipient automatically understands the message. For anybody else listening, its insight DC to read between the lines is (10+your deception bonus).

skills/skills/deception/convince-truth.h.title: Convince Truth
skills/skills/deception/convince-truth.h.description:
Speak falsehoods to cover your ass or to soften the truth.Common modifiers to make the task more difficult can include…
The person you are deceiving witnessed events you are lying about firsthand
The claims you are making are incredibly outlandish or outright impossible (angels and demons are the same, the sky is green)\
The person you are deceiving is knowledgeable on the subject matter.
Common modifiers to make the task less difficult can include
The person you are deceiving is inattentive. They are sleepy, drunk or in a hurry
The person you are deceiving is a friend or close ally

skills/skills/deception/create-diversion.title: Create Diversion
skills/skills/deception/create-diversion.description: As a standard action, you can shout something at your enemies to briefly get them to look the other way so you can give them the slip. Out of all creatures currently attending you, roll deception against the creature with the highest +Insight🤔. If you succeed, you are able to hide and people don't know where you went. This does not prevent people from being unable to find you again using perception.

skills/skills/deception/enigma-(ss).html.title: Enigma (SS)
skills/skills/deception/enigma-(ss).html.description: You have resistance against any effects that would read your thoughts or otherwise pry into your mind.

skills/skills/deception/feint.html.title: Feint
skills/skills/deception/feint.html.description: In place of an attack, roll deception against a creature within reach. DC (10+lvl) or (10+creatures +Insight🤔 bonus) whichever is higher. If successful, your opponent is DD until the end of your turn.

skills/skills/deception/inception-(ss).h.title: Inception (SS)
skills/skills/deception/inception-(ss).h.description: Convince a creature that one of your ideas is their own idea. By speaking with a creature over the course of a few minutes you can plant an idea in their mind that they then act on as if it was their own. You take a -10 penalty to your deception check vs their insight.

skills/skills/deception/sucker-punch-(p).title: Sucker Punch (P)
skills/skills/deception/sucker-punch-(p).description: If you are in some kind of standoff where you aren't quite fighting your enemy yet, you can use this skill as a replacement for stealth to surprise your enemy with a melee attack. The enemy must be aware of you in order sucker punch, otherwise it is stealth. Doesn't actually require unarmed a strike.Certain situations where you are not able to get close to your aggressors, such as having bows pointed at you on from a garrison above you, make sucker punching impossible.

skills/skills/disguise/+disguise.html.title: +Disguise
skills/skills/disguise/+disguise.html.description: Pretend to be someone you’re not. Rolled against perception. Uses cha.

skills/skills/disguise/costume-expert-(s.title: Costume Expert (SS)
skills/skills/disguise/costume-expert-(s.description: You no longer take a penalty to disguise when changing your race or gender.You can now use disguise to pretend to be a monstrous creature (skeleton, phoenix, giant). These disguises tend to be very bulky and impractical. You cannot do anything physically intensive while in such a disguise, such as +Acrobatics⚖, +Athletics🏊 or combat without the disguise falling apart.

skills/skills/disguise/craft-disguise.ht.title: Craft Disguise
skills/skills/disguise/craft-disguise.ht.description: Spend 10 minutes perfecting your makeup, outfit and wig to appear as someone you're not. Disguise checks are usually unnecessary unless you fall under scrutiny, the person knows you/what you're pretending to be or you're trying to enter an exclusive club. Creatures get bonuses to their perception if they know you or what you're disguised as particularly well.You take a -2 penalty to disguise checks when you try to change your race🏁 and when you change your apparent gender. When you initiate a disguise, you tell your DM your bonus, they apply any appropriate modifiers and roll it in secret.

skills/skills/disguise/impressionist-(p).title: Impressionist (P)
skills/skills/disguise/impressionist-(p).description: Creatures proficient in the disguise skill have the ability to alter their voice significantly. If a creature can’t see you (or while you are disguised), you can pretend to sound like someone else whose voice you have heard, or something more exotic like an animal. If a creature sees you and the voice is a mismatch, then they will quickly see through obvious facades, but can potentially be used to misdirect.You typically only roll when the creature is familiar with who you mimic.

skills/skills/disguise/zero-to-hero-(ss).title: Zero to Hero (SS)
skills/skills/disguise/zero-to-hero-(ss).description: You can change your disguise into something completely different as a FRA. If someone was looking for you, they automatically get a check to see through your disguise if they see you again.

skills/skills/insight/+insight.html.title: +Insight
skills/skills/insight/+insight.html.description: Pick up on nonverbal cues and tone of voice to glean more information. Uses WIS.

skills/skills/insight/5-steps-ahead-(ss).title: 5 Steps Ahead (SS)
skills/skills/insight/5-steps-ahead-(ss).description: When a creature fails to feint you, they are DD to you until the end of your next turn.

skills/skills/insight/detect-intrusive-p.title: Detect Intrusive Presence (P)
skills/skills/insight/detect-intrusive-p.description: You can use insight to determine when a creature is under duress from a spell or some other kind of effect that has a lasting impact on their mind, such as if they are charmed or under the effects of Possession. You must actively search for this presence by speaking with a creature for 1 minute. Roll insight vs the DC of the effect. If the effect has no DC, assume 12+inflicting creature's level.

skills/skills/insight/detect-truth.html.title: Detect Truth
skills/skills/insight/detect-truth.html.description: Whenever a creature makes a statement, you can roll insight (opposed by +Deception) to see if what they say aligns with what they think. If you succeed, you determine that something is fishy. Prying further about the deception may cause the creature to reveal the truth or become hostile depending on context.If you roll this too often, your GM can silence you. No using insight multiple times on the same thing. Don’t be silly.

skills/skills/insight/intrusive-thoughts.title: Intrusive Thoughts (SS)
skills/skills/insight/intrusive-thoughts.description: By having a conversation with a creature for one minute, you can glean into their surface thoughts as you continue this conversation. Make an insight check with a -10 penalty, if you succeed you can read their surface thoughts for the remainder of the conversation.

skills/skills/intimidation/+intimidation.title: +Intimidation
skills/skills/intimidation/+intimidation.description: Be spooky and coerce creatures. Uses the higher value of either your STR, or your CHA.

skills/skills/intimidation/big-shot-(ss).title: Big Shot (SS)
skills/skills/intimidation/big-shot-(ss).description: Any minion creature automatically starts shaken 1 while in combat with you.

skills/skills/intimidation/boo-(ss).html.title: Boo (SS)
skills/skills/intimidation/boo-(ss).html.description: When you demoralize a Minion, they become Frightened. This condition lasts until they gain Total Cover from you for 1 round and take no action other than to escape.

skills/skills/intimidation/coercion-(p)..title: Coercion (P)
skills/skills/intimidation/coercion-(p)..description: By having a conversation with a creature that lasts at least one minute, or by defeating a creature in combat, you can shape how they respond to you or anybody asking about you in the future. The strength of this creature's conviction is dependent on your intimidating prowess.You can make the creature keep their mouth shut about something you did to them. Any checks to gather information from this creature about you or your party change to (10+intimidation bonus).You can greatly exaggerate what you did to further spread fear and grand tales of your strength. Any knowledge checks that creatures make on you when hearing about information that spreads from this creature changes to this DC it would be higher than the usual DC, or else they learn false info.

skills/skills/intimidation/demoralize.ht.title: Demoralize
skills/skills/intimidation/demoralize.ht.description: As a standard action, inflict shaken 1 on an enemy that can see or hear you within 30 feet. Must have line of sight. They roll a will save vs (10+your intimidation bonus). They are shaken as long as you are nearby, and for 1 minute after. You can demoralize a creature repeatedly to increase the penalty. If they pass their save, their shaken value decreases by 1.If you are proficient in intimidation, you can demoralize as a swift action.

skills/skills/intimidation/ptsd-(p).html.title: PTSD (P)
skills/skills/intimidation/ptsd-(p).html.description: You can permanently scar a creature so that your mere presence is enough to fill it with dread. Creatures you defeat in combat are automatically shaken 1 in your presence permanently. If you successfully demoralize a creature afflicted with PTSD, you can choose to increase their shaken penalty or make them frightened.

skills/skills/knowledge/alchemy/alchemy..title: Alchemy

skills/skills/knowledge/alchemy/create-a.title: Create Alchemical Item
skills/skills/knowledge/alchemy/create-a.description: Alchemy can make all kinds of different things: common things include healing wounds, inflicting wounds, preventing sickness, adhesives, solvents, starting fires and temporary adaptations. Uncommon things include cloning and permanent transformations.All found under the Alchemical Items section.

skills/skills/knowledge/alchemy/identify.title: Identify Alchemical Item
skills/skills/knowledge/alchemy/identify.description:
Creation DC
With a quick wiff or taste, you can determine the effects of an alchemical substance.

skills/skills/knowledge/alchemy/reverse-.title: Reverse Engineer
skills/skills/knowledge/alchemy/reverse-.description:
Creation DC+5
You can take an unfamiliar substance and learn what it's made out of with the intention of creating it again in the future. A success indicates that you managed to write down the necessary ingredients and processes to create the item in the future.

skills/skills/knowledge/arcana/arcana.ht.title: Arcana
skills/skills/knowledge/arcana/arcana.ht.description: The default skill whenever magic is involved. Common uses include figuring out what spell someone is casting, determining the magical properties of items and identifying the effects of persistent spells. Identifies Dragons🐲 with +Monster Lore📖.

skills/skills/knowledge/arcana/identify-.title: Identify Active Spell
skills/skills/knowledge/arcana/identify-.description:
DC 10+spell lvl, free action 1/turn
You examine the magical effect to determine what spell it is, and what the spell does.

skills/skills/knowledge/arcana/identify-.title: Identify Magic Item
skills/skills/knowledge/arcana/identify-.description:
DC=Craft DC, +10 if cursed, standard action
You learn all of the qualities of a magic item that you are adjacent to.

skills/skills/knowledge/arcana/identify-.title: Identify Spell Being Cast
skills/skills/knowledge/arcana/identify-.description:
DC 15+spell lvl, no action
You must be able to clearly see or hear the creature in order to identify a spell that they are casting. Useful for determining whether or not you want to dispel something, or figuring out what spell a creature cast that has no immediate visible effect.

skills/skills/knowledge/cryptozoology/as.title: Astronomy
skills/skills/knowledge/cryptozoology/as.description: Cryptozoology can be used as a substitute for any kind of scientific research with regards to space, such as astronomy and astrophysics.

skills/skills/knowledge/cryptozoology/id.title: Identify Hoax
skills/skills/knowledge/cryptozoology/id.description: You can use cryptozoology in place of +Insight🤔 to glean if a creature is deceiving you or exaggerating details about the description of a creature they have encountered or heard about through word of mouth.

skills/skills/knowledge/cryptozoology/le.title: Legendary Creatures
skills/skills/knowledge/cryptozoology/le.description: Using a name or a basic description as a prompt, you can recall legends of ancient, powerful or noteworthy creatures.Such creatures usually have tales that have been written about them, or have stories that have been passed down that you can recount. Uses the "relevancy to the world" DC of (22-lvl).

skills/skills/knowledge/cryptozoology/wh.title: What do they want
skills/skills/knowledge/cryptozoology/wh.description: Creatures from the stars often have very strange interests in the mortal world. If you succeed on a +Monster Lore📖 check against such a creature, you also learn about its interests in the world, such as requiring humanoids to reproduce or a keen interest in bovines.You can also glean this information from witnessing the phenomenon itself. Using the same DC as monster lore, you can witness cattle kidnapping or host infections and glean what type of creature is doing it

skills/skills/knowledge/engineering/engi.title: Engineering
skills/skills/knowledge/engineering/engi.description: Used to determine things related to structures, such as building them, finding weaknesses or the ability to make basic assumptions about its design (ex. a factory this large needs an exhaust vent somewhere). It can also be used to identify technology such as elevators, vehicles and other mechanical objects. Identifies Constructs🤖 using +Monster Lore📖.

skills/skills/knowledge/engineering/hack.title: Hacking
skills/skills/knowledge/engineering/hack.description: Where there exists technology, there exists a method to disable or gain control of it, even if only temporarily. Hacking always requires a hands-on approach.

skills/skills/knowledge/engineering/iden.title: Identify Function
skills/skills/knowledge/engineering/iden.description: Identify the purpose of particularly complex machinery. Depending on the size and scope of what you're looking at, this could only be a glance, or it could require a few minutes, and usually requires a hands-on approach.

skills/skills/knowledge/engineering/stru.title: Structural Quirk
skills/skills/knowledge/engineering/stru.description: Large scale buildings such as castles, watchtowers, walls, factories, prisons etc. Are all built with specific purposes, facilities and defenses in mind. You can use engineering to figure out aspects of these buildings like where exhaust/waste pipes lead, how far underground you might need to take to go underneath the structure, structural weaknesses etc.

skills/skills/knowledge/history/+history.title: +History
skills/skills/knowledge/history/+history.description:
Used to recall events that happened in the past and prominent historical figures. Historians are good at identifying the flags of fallen nations, reading in dead languages and recognizing relics from the past.
Does not have a specific creature type you can use monster lore with. Can be a suitable substitute for famous or infamous creatures hundreds or thousands of years old.

skills/skills/knowledge/history/example-.title: Example DCs
skills/skills/knowledge/history/example-.description:
Common modifiers to make the task more difficult can include…
The event was specifically wiped from history, or the records of it are largely destroyed/kept secret
The text/piece you are examining is missing significant chunks
The event/entity was of little significance
Common modifiers to make the task less difficult can include
You have a specific cultural significance to this history, or you were a local who lived through the era
The text/piece you are examining is in pristine condition, or based on a language you know
The event/entity was of great significance

skills/skills/knowledge/history/identify.title: Identify Artifact
skills/skills/knowledge/history/identify.description: Certain items may be tied to creatures or entities from the past. By identifying the craftsmanship and symbols on items, you can determine their origin/purpose.

skills/skills/knowledge/history/interpre.title: Interpret Hieroglyphs
skills/skills/knowledge/history/interpre.description: Ancient people often like to communicate without using the written word. You can interpret the meaning or significance in paintings, carvings, murals, statues and the like.

skills/skills/knowledge/history/recall-p.title: Recall Past Events
skills/skills/knowledge/history/recall-p.description: Major battles, great tragedies and turning points in civilization are all of interest to a historian. With some kind of prompting, you can recall information related to these events dating back tens, hundreds or even thousands of years.

skills/skills/knowledge/history/recall-p.title: Recall Prominent Figures
skills/skills/knowledge/history/recall-p.description: There are some names that withstand the test of time due to their accomplishments, inventions and atrocities. With some kind of prompting, you can recall details about specific people, creatures or cultures. This can include things such as their names, species, class, nicknames, organizations etc.

skills/skills/knowledge/history/tell-sto.title: Tell Story
skills/skills/knowledge/history/tell-sto.description: You can use your vast knowledge pool to weave together important threads in history, making for a story that is both entertaining and informative.

skills/skills/knowledge/local/+local.htm.title: +Local

skills/skills/knowledge/local/classes-an.title: Classes and Monster Lore
skills/skills/knowledge/local/classes-an.description:
Your GM is inevitably going to pit you up against fighter⚔s and Beast Trainers and all kinds of other creatures with classes.
If you succeed, you learn the creatures level and everything about its +Class and archetype.
If you exceed this DC by 5, you learn everything about the creature's fighting style, such as feats and techniques they often use.

skills/skills/knowledge/local/recall-cus.title: Recall Customs
skills/skills/knowledge/local/recall-cus.description: When dealing with foreign cultures, you can recall information about how to conduct yourself. This can be particularly useful when trying to gain someone's favor, such as royalty. You can also recall information about holidays, festivals and ceremonies.

skills/skills/knowledge/local/recall-use.title: Recall Useful Locations
skills/skills/knowledge/local/recall-use.description: You can recall the answer to a specific simple question such as "where can I buy potions?" Or "where does the royalty live?" Or "where can I hire someone to build something?" Something along those lines. These questions can be applied to the town you're in or, with a higher DC, something much bigger like a country or continent.

skills/skills/knowledge/local/recognize-.title: Recognize Name or Face
skills/skills/knowledge/local/recognize-.description: You can attach a name to a face, or vice versa. You generally understand aspects of this creatures reputation, their affiliations, their general capabilities etc. Exceptionally high rolls might even land you some secrets or gossip related to this creature.

skills/skills/knowledge/nature/+nature.h.title: +Nature
skills/skills/knowledge/nature/+nature.h.description:
Used to detect oddities in the natural order and how to restore it. Can also be used to determine the weather, identify naturally occurring things like ores and flowers and elements unique to the Feywilds.
Identifies Plants🪴, Fey and Beasts🐻 using +monster lore📖.You know about natural processes like photosynthesis, the reproduction of creatures, and tectonic activity. You can do things like figuring out if a volcano is about to erupt, what could be causing plants to die or how long until an egg hatches.Identify Elements of NatureIf it doesn't have a stat block and it isn't man-made or magic, then it probably falls under natural element. Nature allows you to identify animal behavior. It also lets you identify types of plants and minerals and their uses/dangers. It also allows you to tell if something is unnatural.Identify WeatherPredict the weather, usually only for the day, but with higher checks, even farther into the future. You can also tell if these effects are naturally occurring or created by something unusual like magic.

skills/skills/knowledge/nature/example-d.title: Example DCs
skills/skills/knowledge/nature/example-d.description:
Common modifiers to make the task more difficult can include…
Unable to interact with object (smell, taste, touch, as appropriate for substance)
Common modifiers to make the task less difficult can include
Guides, handbooks and sketches

skills/skills/knowledge/nature/identify-.title: Identify Elements of Nature
skills/skills/knowledge/nature/identify-.description: If it doesn't have a stat block and it isn't man-made or magic, then it probably falls under natural element. Nature allows you to identify animal behavior. It also lets you identify types of plants and minerals and their uses/dangers. It also allows you to tell if something is unnatural.

skills/skills/knowledge/nature/identify-.title: Identify Natural Phenomenon
skills/skills/knowledge/nature/identify-.description: You know about natural processes like photosynthesis, the reproduction of creatures, and tectonic activity. You can do things like figuring out if a volcano is about to erupt, what could be causing plants to die or how long until an egg hatches.

skills/skills/knowledge/nature/identify-.title: Identify Weather
skills/skills/knowledge/nature/identify-.description: Predict the weather, usually only for the day, but with higher checks, even farther into the future. You can also tell if these effects are naturally occurring or created by something unusual like magic.

skills/skills/knowledge/planes/+planes.h.title: +Planes
skills/skills/knowledge/planes/+planes.h.description: Used to determine the nature of other planes. Can also be used to determine the destination of portals and where they might be located.Identifies Fiends👿, Celestials👼 and Elementals🔥.

skills/skills/knowledge/planes/disable-o.title: Disable or Destroy Portal
skills/skills/knowledge/planes/disable-o.description:
DC 30
A task that is very difficult by one's self. Failure could mean getting stuck on the wrong side of the portal or hyper charging the portal to attract extraplanar creatures.

skills/skills/knowledge/planes/find-port.title: Find Portal Location
skills/skills/knowledge/planes/find-port.description:
DC 30
Portals are strange phenomenon that tend to come and go, but there are signs that they exist miles away from where the portal is actually located, if you know where to look.

skills/skills/knowledge/planes/identify-.title: Identify Portal
skills/skills/knowledge/planes/identify-.description:
DC 10
In the presence of a portal, you can tell where its destination plane is. Rolling higher can give more specific locations, more details about the portals creation and how often it gets used.

skills/skills/knowledge/religion/+religi.title: +Religion
skills/skills/knowledge/religion/+religi.description: Used in understanding/identifying gods and their followers. Church hierarchies, religious practices, symbols and scripture are all covered by this skill.Identifies Undead💀 with +monster lore📖.It is assumed that if you are of a specific religion, you can do many of these things without rolling for your own faith. (DC 10)Followers of gods often wear regalia, use specific types of seals and put their gods symbol on their stuff. Sometimes just by looking at a building or a person you can tell where their religious affiliations lie.Recall Tenets (DC 15)When prompted by specific actions, you can tell whether or not these actions align with the deity in question. Good for finding fakers or guiding the faithful with poor memory.Accrue GBP (DC 15)You can figure out what kinds of things would appease a specific deity and earn you GBP.Identify Chosen (DC 20)Gods will often play favorites when it comes to specific people, peoples or items/places when deciding who will receive their blessing.

skills/skills/knowledge/religion/identif.title: Identify Chosen
skills/skills/knowledge/religion/identif.description:
DC 20
Gods will often play favorites when it comes to specific people, peoples or items/places when deciding who will receive their blessing.

skills/skills/knowledge/religion/identif.title: Identify Religious Symbol
skills/skills/knowledge/religion/identif.description:
DC 10
Followers of gods often wear regalia, use specific types of seals and put their gods symbol on their stuff. Sometimes just by looking at a building or a person you can tell where their religious affiliations lie.

skills/skills/knowledge/religion/recall-.title: Recall Tenets
skills/skills/knowledge/religion/recall-.description:
DC 15
When prompted by specific actions, you can tell whether or not these actions align with the deity in question. Good for finding fakers or guiding the faithful with poor memory or habits.

skills/skills/knowledge/+knowledge.html.title: +Knowledge
skills/skills/knowledge/+knowledge.html.description:
All knowledge uses INT.
What you know. Knowledge is broken up into many different skills based on subject and each one has deals with the +Monster Lore📖 of specific creature types. Monster lore isn’t its own skill, but it has its own functions separate from the rest of individual knowledge skills. If a subject or creature falls into multiple categories, then players can choose whichever they like more, but an individual character can't roll multiple checks with different skills.

headers.heading: ALL knowledge requires proficiency to roll.

skills/skills/knowledge/+monster-lore.ht.title: +Monster Lore
skills/skills/knowledge/+monster-lore.ht.description:
Adventurers are assumed to know basic things about monsters, like how constructs often lack anatomy or the properties of incorporeal creatures. Monster lore checks are for figuring out more information about specific monsters. Bestiary stat blocks are broken up into 4 sections: Defense, Offense, Weaknesses/Deep Lore and Other Traits.Rolling a monster lore check is something you can do as a free action once per turn. It is assumed that you also vocalize what you learn to your team. The base DC of a monster lore check is (10+creature's lvl). By succeeding on a monster lore check, you can figure out a creature's basic stats and one other category. Every 5 over the DC you roll, you figure out another category. If a creature has nothing in a category, you choose another.
Creatures with the unique tag in their entry increase monster lore DC by 5. Humanoids with class levels function a bit weird. See Classes and Monster Lore❓ for more details.NerdLore Dump

skills/skills/knowledge/lore-dump-(ss).h.title: Lore Dump (SS)
skills/skills/knowledge/lore-dump-(ss).h.description: You can rapidly assess the battlefield and communicate your knowledge. You can roll an unlimited number of monster lore checks each turn.

skills/skills/knowledge/nerd-(ss).html.title: Nerd (SS)
skills/skills/knowledge/nerd-(ss).html.description: When you succeed on a monster lore check, gain knowledge about an additional category.

skills/skills/knowledge/who-are-you.html.title: Who are you
skills/skills/knowledge/who-are-you.html.description: If you want to know who an individual creature is and their relevance to the world, rather than their stats and abilities, the DC is usually dependent on how popular they are. Typically (22-LvL) with additional reductions to the DC if they are famous, or in a position of power. This could also include increases to the DC if they work to keep their identity and exploits hidden, or live remotely.

skills/skills/linguistics/+linguistics.h.title: +Linguistics
skills/skills/linguistics/+linguistics.h.description: The lawyer skill that gets languages as a bonus. Uses INT.

skills/skills/linguistics/cliff's-notes-.title: Cliff's Notes (SS)
skills/skills/linguistics/cliff's-notes-.description: You can summarize 10 standard pages of written text per one minute of reading.

skills/skills/linguistics/decode-(p).htm.title: Decode (P)
skills/skills/linguistics/decode-(p).htm.description: You can write things in ways that are difficult to interpret without a cipher, such as disguising your forbidden ritual as a cookbook. The DC to your code is 10+(linguistics bonus). Creatures that know the code can read encoded text, but creatures that don't will interpret the text as something else. To read encoded text, you must first crack the code, usually requiring at least a week of research. At the end of the week, roll a linguistics check versus the writer’s DC to crack the code.

skills/skills/linguistics/interpret-text.title: Interpret Text
skills/skills/linguistics/interpret-text.description: You peruse a book, contract or other written work to quickly summarize what it says in one minute. The DC for most works is 10, but it changes based on the size and complexity of the work at hand. Failure indicates more time is necessary to understand what the text contains. Finding oddities in a contract requires an opposed linguistics check.

skills/skills/linguistics/languages.html.title: Languages
skills/skills/linguistics/languages.html.description: Racial languages are typically named after the race that created them. Names that aren't self evident are put in (parenthesis)

skills/skills/linguistics/polyglot-(p).h.title: Polyglot (P)
skills/skills/linguistics/polyglot-(p).h.description: With proficiency in linguistics you gain a new language for every level you have, and every new level you gain.You cannot learn secret languages without special forms of training.

skills/skills/linguistics/read-lips-(ss).title: Read Lips (SS)
skills/skills/linguistics/read-lips-(ss).description: With a clear view of a creature's face, you can understand what the creature is saying as long as you understand the language they are speaking in.

skills/skills/linguistics/secret-ish-(ss.title: Secret-ish (SS)
skills/skills/linguistics/secret-ish-(ss.description: You can select secret languages as bonus languages. Immediately gain 1 when you acquire signature skill.

skills/skills/linguistics/write-official.title: Write Official Documents (P)
skills/skills/linguistics/write-official.description: Make contracts, forge signatures and make (fake?) documents look official. Noticing oddities in such documents requires an opposed linguistics check.

skills/skills/medicine/+medicine.html.title: +Medicine
skills/skills/medicine/+medicine.html.description: Be a doctor in a world filled with people whose touch brings people back to life. Uses WIS or INT

skills/skills/medicine/assess-the-wounde.title: Assess the Wounded
skills/skills/medicine/assess-the-wounde.description: A creature that is wounded can be examined to determine how they were injured, how long ago it happened and whether they are in grave danger of dying. This also functions on corpses. The more complex the ailment and the longer the duration since it happened, the higher the DC. Duration may reverse in scaling in the case of diseases, where more time passing makes the symptoms more obvious.

skills/skills/medicine/band-aid-fix-(ss).title: Band-Aid Fix (SS)
skills/skills/medicine/band-aid-fix-(ss).description: You can apply first aid as a swift action.

skills/skills/medicine/first-aid-(p).htm.title: First Aid (P)
skills/skills/medicine/first-aid-(p).htm.description:
As a standard action you can cure creatures of status ailments to a creature within reach. You can remove all sickened stacks, bleed and blurred vision. The DC of removing any of these conditions is the DC of the ability that inflicted them. If they have no DC, then assume the class/offense trait DC. When you succeed in providing first aid to heal a condition, the creature heals 1 HP (Healing).
Performing first aid without a first aid kit imposes a -5 penalty.

skills/skills/medicine/frankenstein's-se.title: Frankenstein's Secrets (SS)
skills/skills/medicine/frankenstein's-se.description: Permanent devastating effects to a creature's body, such as having a limb severed or an eye gouged out can now be restored with a DC 30 check. The wound must be fresh and the body part is intact. Failure inflicts drained 2 and destroys the body part.

skills/skills/medicine/identify-afflicti.title: Identify Affliction or Curse (P)
skills/skills/medicine/identify-afflicti.description: By spending a minute examining someone who suffers from an affliction or curse, you can determine its exact effects. You also know the exact method on how to cure the affliction or remove the curse.T1 afflictions have a DC of 5. +5 to DC for each tier.Curses have a DC of 10+spell lvl. If the effect was not a spell, then DC 10+(1/2 lvl of entity who inflicted curse).

skills/skills/medicine/improvised-implem.title: Improvised Implements (SS)
skills/skills/medicine/improvised-implem.description:
You take no penalty to medicine checks when you do not have a first aid kit.
When you provide first aid, you heal 3 hp (Healing)..

skills/skills/medicine/long-term-care-(p.title: Long Term Care (P)
skills/skills/medicine/long-term-care-(p.description: Resting under the care of a creature that is proficient in medicine lets you recover 2 drain every day instead of 1. You also qualify for removing many types of Afflictions, both physical and mental.

skills/skills/medicine/prevent-recovery-.title: Prevent Recovery (P)
skills/skills/medicine/prevent-recovery-.description: If you have defeated creatures in your custody that you don't want to be waking up at inconvenient times, you can choose to treat them so that way they do not naturally recover hp (including regeneration and FH). This requires a few minutes to perform, and lasts 24 hours.

skills/skills/perception/+perception.htm.title: +Perception
skills/skills/perception/+perception.htm.description: All creatures are considered proficient in perception, unless they are mindless. Uses WIS.Perception is the mechanism through which players can notice the unnoticed in the imagination game. Traps, hidden loot, secret entrances, unusual stimuli are a handful of the many things this skill is used for. Conditions such as bad weather and listening through walls can make perception difficult, or even impossible. Sleeping gives a -5 penalty.Detect Hidden PresenceOnce a round, by spending 15ft of movement, or a swift action, you can make a perception check to find hidden creatures/objects, or their general direction if they have total cover.One Eye Open You take no penalty to perception from sleeping. You perceive and remember things that happened around you while sleeping when you wake. You can choose to automatically wake up for any reason. You are not DD by default when asleep. Quick ScanYou can Detect Hidden Presence as a free action, but still only once per turn.

skills/skills/perception/detect-hidden-p.title: Detect Hidden Presence
skills/skills/perception/detect-hidden-p.description: Once a round, by spending 15ft of movement, or a swift action, you can make a perception check to find hidden creatures/objects, or their general direction if they have total cover.

skills/skills/perception/keep-watch.html.title: Keep Watch
skills/skills/perception/keep-watch.html.description: This is a downtime activity most commonly performed by people to protect areas, such as guards to a palace or a adventurer at camp. A creature who is keeping watch can do little more than eat snacks, wonder around and make idle chatter while they keep watch.A creature who is adequately keeping watch (AKA isn't sleeping on the job or indulging in other activities), automatically gets a perception check to notice would-be intruders and adversaries. Guards also often get checks to see through the disguises of criminals, or finding concealed items if they are frisking people.

skills/skills/perception/one-eye-open-(s.title: One Eye Open (SS)
skills/skills/perception/one-eye-open-(s.description:
You take no penalty to perception from sleeping. You perceive and remember things that happened around you while sleeping. You can choose to automatically wake up for any reason.
You are not DD by default when asleep.

skills/skills/perception/quick-scan-(ss).title: Quick Scan (SS)
skills/skills/perception/quick-scan-(ss).description: You can Detect Hidden Presence as a free action, but still only once per turn.

skills/skills/persuasion/+persuasion.htm.title: +Persuasion
skills/skills/persuasion/+persuasion.htm.description: Convincing others to do things with your words. Uses CHA.

skills/skills/persuasion/contacts-(ss).h.title: Contacts (SS)
skills/skills/persuasion/contacts-(ss).h.description: You always know at least a few places in town drifters are welcome. The time to gather information is always less than 10 minutes.

skills/skills/persuasion/dice-vs-rolepla.title: Dice vs Roleplay
skills/skills/persuasion/dice-vs-rolepla.description:
Persuasion is one of those skills where you can reasonably skip past lots of dialogue in order to get the desired result more quickly and efficiently. However, this is a role-playing game. So regardless of how big someone's persuasion bonus is, no matter the suggestion, you must persuade something a creature could conceivably be willing to do on their own, in the right circumstances.On the opposite end, even if you do not possess the persuasion skill, you might still be able to convince an NPC of something if you present the right information in the right circumstances. A gruff pirate might not be interested in a -1 CHA fighter, but if he says he knows where treasure is the pirate has been hunting for decades, that can change his mind.
Role-play and dice are 2 different tools to acquire the same result, each with their own benefits and drawbacks. Neither should be dismissed as nonviable and one should not be required in order to succeed at the other. The skill is generally useful when you are uncertain about a lot with the NPC in question, like with Serendipity, or you want to advance the plot more quickly.

skills/skills/persuasion/example-dcs.htm.title: Example DCs
skills/skills/persuasion/example-dcs.htm.description:
Common modifiers to make the task more difficult can include…
Racism
Your questions/requests are offensive or closely guarded secrets
You are not well liked by the person/people you are persuading
Common modifiers to make the task less difficult can include
You are well liked by the person/people you are persuading\
You hold a position of authority over the person/people you are persuading\
The information you are looking for is well known or noteworthy

skills/skills/persuasion/mercy-breeds-co.title: Mercy Breeds Cooperation (SS)
skills/skills/persuasion/mercy-breeds-co.description: When you defeat a foe, you can instead choose to give it the time out condition for 1 hour.

skills/skills/persuasion/persuade.html.title: Persuade
skills/skills/persuasion/persuade.html.description: When you ask something of someone, such as information or aid, they may be on the fence about whether or not they should answer and persuasion gets them to your side. The difficulty of the check is based on how well you know the person, how difficult the request is and what the consequences of telling you might be.Even if you do persuade someone to do something, it may come with caveats such as favors or payment.

skills/skills/profession/+profession.htm.title: +Profession
skills/skills/profession/+profession.htm.description: The skill for the working class fellas. Defaults to WIS, but see the experienced feature.If you are ever quizzed on particular aspects of a profession and you are not proficient, you must roll an intelligence check to answer correctly (DC 10 for most professions). Proficient creatures automatically know most aspects of their profession.Hard WorkEvery day you work, you earn money. See economics for more details. Your talent could be anything from music, to craftsmanship to working as an innkeeper.Experienced (P)You can select what ability score to use to determine your profession bonus for all your professions. Your given ability score colors the approach you have to your professions.

skills/skills/profession/experienced-(p).title: Experienced (P)
skills/skills/profession/experienced-(p).description: You can select what Ability Score to use to determine your profession bonus for all your professions. Your given ability score colors the approach you have to your professions.

skills/skills/profession/hard-work.html.title: Hard Work
skills/skills/profession/hard-work.html.description: Every day you work, you earn money. See Economics for more details. Your talent could be anything from music, to craftsmanship to working as an innkeeper.

skills/skills/profession/recall.html.title: Recall
skills/skills/profession/recall.html.description: If you are ever quizzed on particular aspects of a profession and you are not proficient, you must roll an WIS check to answer correctly (DC 10 for most professions). Proficient creatures automatically know most aspects of their profession.

skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/+sleight-o.title: +Sleight of Hand
skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/+sleight-o.description: Pocket things while staying undetected. Quietly open locks and turn off dangerous devices. Uses DEX.

skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/conceal-we.title: Conceal Weapon (P)
skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/conceal-we.description: You can store light weapons in all kinds of places. As a swift action you can draw up to two concealed weapon to attack a creature with. If they fail a perception check vs your sleight of hand, they are DD this turn. If you're in a crowded area, or in some kind of standoff where you aren't quite fighting your enemy yet, you can even use this skill as a replacement for stealth to surprise your enemy. The enemy must be aware of you in order use a concealed weapon, otherwise it is stealth.

skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/disable-de.title: Disable Device (P)
skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/disable-de.description: Pressure plates and dangerous magic crystals are at your mercy if you’re able to get your hands on them if you notice them before you get roasted. You can temporarily or permanently disabled the dangerous dungeon decorations with a DC based on the complexity of the device. Simple tripwires are easy enough but a soul gem firing arcane bolts could be tricky. If you pass the DC by 5 or more, you can repurpose the trap to suit your needs. The more difficult the DC, the longer it takes to disable, with an upper limit of 30 seconds.Disabling devices without thieves' Tools imposes a -5 penalty.

skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/fast-hands.title: Fast Hands (SS)
skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/fast-hands.description: You can pick any lock and disable any devices as a FRA.

skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/is....this.title: Is....this your sword (SS)
skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/is....this.description: You can use thievery to steal sheathed and stored weapons at no penalty, and replace them with other items of similar size/shape.

skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/pick-lock-.title: Pick Lock (P)
skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/pick-lock-.description:
Open locked objects with a DC dependent on the complexity of the lock. Mages and very skilled locksmiths might have nearly impossible locks while common doors are child's play. The more difficult the DC, the longer it takes to open a lock, with an upper limit of 30 seconds. Failing a check has no consequences unless time is short or there are other security measures in place, allowing you to take 20.
Picking locks without thieves' Tools imposes a -5 penalty.

skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/thievery.h.title: Thievery
skills/skills/sleight-of-hand/thievery.h.description:
If a target is unaware of you or otherwise distracted, you can attempt to steal items loosely attached to their person or in their pockets. Rolled versus the +Perception👀 of the individual. Anybody else vigilantly standing guard also gets a check with a penalty based on circumstance. You can also pilfer unattended objects, with anybody nearby or standing watch getting a check to notice your misdeeds.
Objects that are in some way affixed to a creature, such as a sword in its hilt, take a -5 penalty to SoH when you try to steal them.

skills/skills/stealth/+stealth.html.title: +Stealth
skills/skills/stealth/+stealth.html.description: Moving around while remaining unseen. If someone is looking for you in your immediate vicinity and you don't want to be seen, you roll stealth. Uses DEX.Special: Stealth and size Size provides no numerical benefit or penalty. The only thing that size effects relative to stealth is your ability to gain cover: Larger creatures have a harder time figuring out places to hide, while smaller creatures find it very easy.

skills/skills/stealth/dampen-presence-(s.title: Dampen Presence (SS)
skills/skills/stealth/dampen-presence-(s.description: Blind sense does not function against you.

skills/skills/stealth/hide.html.title: Hide
skills/skills/stealth/hide.html.description: As long as you have total cover, partial concealment or total concealment, you can attempt to hide from your enemies as an immediate action. You remain hidden until no longer have total cover/concealment, you cast a spell, use a special ability, attack or someone spots you with +Perception👀. When you attack a creature after successfully hiding from them, they are DD until the end of your turn.

skills/skills/stealth/pass-without-trace.title: Pass Without Trace (P)
skills/skills/stealth/pass-without-trace.description: Characters with stealth proficiency can travel without leaving an obvious trail behind. Attempts to track them suffer a -5 penalty.

skills/skills/stealth/stalker-(ss).html.title: Stalker (SS)
skills/skills/stealth/stalker-(ss).html.description: Whenever you are Trailing (P) someone, you can get really up close and personal. You no longer take a -5 penalty for getting up close and personal to hear conversations and such.

skills/skills/stealth/trailing-(p).html.title: Trailing (P)
skills/skills/stealth/trailing-(p).html.description: Use hide to trail someone without them noticing you. It is assumed that you keep your distance, only observing broad strokes what they do, but not things they say, write down etc. If you want to get a closer look to find such details, you take a -5 penalty to stealth.Using stealth to stalk people can potentially become impossible without first circumventing protections against spying.How often you roll stealth checks is determined by the situation, opposed by the creature you stalk.

skills/skills/survival/+survival.html.title: +Survival
skills/skills/survival/+survival.html.description: The day to day things that need to be done when out and about adventuring far from home in the wilderness. Uses WIS.

skills/skills/survival/advanced-tracking.title: Advanced Tracking (SS)
skills/skills/survival/advanced-tracking.description: You can use survival to track creatures that Fly and swim using scent, even if you aren't aquatic. It's harder to determine "ideal conditions" in these types of environments, so the DC is mostly based off of how long ago the creature was present.

skills/skills/survival/extract-resources.title: Extract Resources
skills/skills/survival/extract-resources.description: You can skin creatures, extract organs/fluids and other resources from recently killed creatures. This usually takes 1 minute.
