You get an amount of value equal to (10+the creature's LvL).Particularly dangerous or delicate operations require proficiency and a survival check (usually 10+creature's level), with higher value multipliers. A failed attempt represents the resources being destroyed.

skills/skills/survival/live-off-the-land.title: Live off the Land (P)
skills/skills/survival/live-off-the-land.description: Characters proficient in survival can sustain themselves and 4 other medium or smaller creatures in environments with suitable sources of food and water.Each size above medium doubles its resource consumption.

skills/skills/survival/navigation.html.title: Navigation
skills/skills/survival/navigation.html.description: You can attempt to not travel in circles when moving through unfamiliar territory. Failure indicates that a lesser amount of progress is made towards reaching your destination, or arriving at an unintended destination.

skills/skills/survival/sniff-them-out-(s.title: Sniff Them Out (SS)
skills/skills/survival/sniff-them-out-(s.description: You gain blindsense (Scent 5 ft) If you already have scent, increase its range by 5 ft.

skills/skills/survival/tracking-(p).html.title: Tracking (P)
skills/skills/survival/tracking-(p).html.description: You can attempt to follow footprints, broken branches, scent trails and other disturbed natural elements to figure out where a creature has been and where it’s going. With ideal conditions you can follow trails made days or even weeks ago (if you don't believe me, look at dino footprint fossils :^). The longer it's been since the creature has been there and the less ideal the conditions, the higher the DC.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Acid Splash
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Poison Action: Standard
Your hand, or your staff/seal turn a sickly green color and start bubbling. You flick it towards a creature, making a Ranged Spell Attack, and a sticky glob of caustic goo flies at them. Deals d4+CL (2+CL) poison damage.
On-hit, this damage happens again at the end of the creatures turn unless they are wet, or otherwise remove the acid through some kind of washing.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Grasp of the Undying
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.sourcePath: Techniques/Magical Techniques/+Cantrips/Combat Cantrips/Grasp of the Undying.md

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Icicle
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: frost Action: Standard
You fire an icy projectile that briefly slows the target. Make a Ranged Spell Attack that deals d10+CL (5+CL) frost damage and embeds itself in the creature, decreasing the creatures speed by 15 for 1 round on-hit.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Living Roots
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Earth Action: Standard
Choose a creature that is standing on some form of dirt/earth/sand. Roots burst up from the ground and entangle the creature (reflex negates). They can remove this condition automatically as a standard action, or they can Breakout as swift action.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Magic Missile
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Force, outplay Action: StandardLaunch a dart of magic that unerringly strikes an enemy to deal (CL) force damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Metronome
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Recharge Action: SwiftWiggle your staff and cause a random effect from the following list. Roll a D6.
Bury yourself underground until the start of your next turn, effectively putting you in stasis against anything that isn't an earth-based attack. If you attack a foe on follow up turn, they are DD.
Confuse yourself. Immediately roll on confusion chart, then end the confusion.
Cause a banana peel to appear under a random creature within 30 ft of you. They are knocked down, (reflex negates).
Your tongue becomes long, powerful and elastic, allowing you to make a free drag attack with a range of 30 ft.
Move 60 ft in a straight line of your choosing elusive, stopping when you hit a solid surface. Creatures along the way take d6 (3) crush damage
You and an enemy within 30 ft of you are set ablaze (reflex negates for you both). You cannot cast this cantrip on consecutive turns.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Stubbed Toe
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Earth Action: StandardYou cause the ground underneath a creature to react unfavorably to their movement. If the targeted creature moves at all on their next turn, a piece of the ground intercepts their movement. They take d10+CL (5+CL) bludgeoning damage and they have their speed is reduced by 15 until they spend a swift action bitching and moaning about it.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Audio Book
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Concentration Action: StandardYou touch a book, scroll or other form of writing and give the text a faint glow. As long as you could read the text normally and you concentrate, the text is automatically read out loud. It is in your voice in a language that you can speak.After casting the spell, you can leave and go about your business and the spell continues to work its magic. You can dictate a starting point, and the pages flip all on their own, highlighting the text as it is read.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Dancing Light
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Light Action: StandardYou conjure a tiny being of light. It gently floats around the target and gives off bright light and a 20-foot radius, and dim light in a 20 foot radius after that. Casting this spell again causes any other instances of it to end.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Death Ward
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description: +Cantrips Tags: - Action: StandardA rune appears on each willing creature inside of the area. All creatures that posses a death ward cannot kill creatures that were subject to the same casting of death ward by defeating them. This spell is most often used for organized duels and tournaments to prevent contestants from dying.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Detect Pregnancy
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description: +Cantrips Tags: - Action: -By holding your hand close to the creature, you can tell whether or not it's pregnant and how far along in it's pregnancy it is.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Ghost Sound
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Figment Action: StandardYou create a volume of sound that rises, recedes, approaches, or remains at a fixed place. You choose what type of sound is created when casting it and cannot change the sound.The sound mimics whatever you want. It can sound like a cafeteria, crowd, waterfall, lion roaring etc, but cannot produce intelligible speech, or sound like a specific person. It can be very loud, but cannot be loud enough to cause harm or otherwise affect anything physically.When exposed to this sound, a creature can roll a will save to realize it is fake.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Innervate
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Recharge Action: ImmediateYou call upon the energy of all living things to empower you or an ally. You cast this spell in response to a spell being cast and it increases the spells CL by 1.A creature cannot be the target of this spell more than 1/day.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Mage Hand
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips Tags: - Action: -Standard
You create a ghostly ethereal hand that can pick up items and perform simple tasks such as opening doors, pulling up pants or tipping over buckets. It can carry up to 10 lbs and has a +0 bonus to +Athletics🏊. The hand cannot do anything that takes longer than one turn to perform unless you add the concentration tag and focus on its actions with yours each turn.
You can use the hand to perform a bully or shove combat maneuver with a bonus of +1.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Mana Ramping
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Mana Burn Action: 1 minuteYou touch your staff to the target creature and drain the mana from them. They mana burn equal to their maximum mana-1. A mana crystal appears in the creature's possession with mana equal to the amount they mana burned -1. This makes it useless on most commoners.Mages typically use this to collect from themselves for the convenience of not needing to go through other adventuring guilds, craftsmen or churches to get the mana they need for their own projects.You can also use this spell to combine all mana crystals in your possession together. The smaller crystals are absorbed by the larger crystal and you add the mana values together.Note: The target of this spell must be willing. This means it cannot be used against creatures that have no will of their own, that lack intelligence or enemies that have been defeated.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Prestidigitation
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description: +Cantrips Tags: - Action: StandardWith a flick of your wrist and some magic sparkles, you can create a variety of effects.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Scribe
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips Tags: - Action: Standard Focus: A writing utensil and something to write on
You touch a book, scroll or other form of writing and give the text a faint glow. The utensil moves on its own to copy down the content you targeted onto the paper, parchment etc. that you provided as a focus. It copies down the text at a rate of about 1 page of an average book per minute in your handwriting. If you are trained in the +Linguistics㊙ skill, you can duplicate the handwriting.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Spirit Animal
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Companion, Upcast Action: Standard
You create a small spectral animal of significance to you. This animal follows basic commands and can roll survival for Navigation using your bonus. It cannot interact with the physical world and disappears if it takes damage. Casting this spell again causes any other instances of it to end.Upcast- Increase duration by 8 hours per mana spent

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Umbrella
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Dismissible Action: Swift
You create a visible barrier above your head that shields you from the elements. You are protected from things such as rain and sunlight. Gain cover from attacks that originate above you. Creatures that huddle next to you can also share this benefit.
Certain effects that mimic weather can potentially be mitigated by this spell such as call cheese storm and solar eclipse.Average doorways are considered difficult terrain while this spell is active.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Enhanced Jump
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 1 Academy📖
Tags: Upcast Action: Swift
As part of casting the spell, you can take the jump action.
Casting this spell allows the caster to jump as high and far as their movement speed. When you jump, you ignore fall damage from a fall of 30 ft or less. If you attack an enemy that is in midair during this time, your movement is elusive when falling after jumping up to them.
Upcast 2 - You can increase the duration of the spell to 10 minutes, and it gains the buff tag.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Fool's Gold
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 1 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Upcast, Glamer Action: StandardYou touch metal and give it a shiny new coat of paint, making it shimmer like gold. This changes nothing about the metals physical properties, only its appearance.You can affect a 1ft cube of metal.
A DC 10 +Nature🍃 check reveals the gold is fake.Upcast - Per additional mana you spend, you can add 2 ft to the dimension of the cube you affect. (3 ft cube, 5 ft cube etc).

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/al.title: Alchemy (T)
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/al.description: Effects that transform you, allies, objects or enemies. Also includes poison effects and things related to chemistry.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: True Strike
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 1 Arcane Tags: - Action: Standard
Channel power into your Staff Component. The next spell attack made with a spell cast from this staff gets +10 Attack.This effect dissipates at the end of your next turn.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Achoo!
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 2 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Air, Elusive Action: Standard
Your nose twitches before you unleash a mighty sneeze. You knock yourself and a creature back 10 feet in opposite directions. They are staggered for one round and take 2d8+CL (9+CL) crush damage, or two rounds with 3d8+CL (13+CL) crush damage if they impact a solid surface (fort halves dmg and negates stagger).

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Heavens' Vengeance
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 2 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Buff, Zap, Upcast Action: SwiftA dark cloud spawns above your head that crackles with electricity. It is angered whenever you take damage, and deals 3 zap damage to the creature that inflicted the damage if it is within 30 ft.This can only happen once each turn.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by 1.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Suck
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 3 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Air, Concentration Action: StandardYou take a breath so deep that you can use it to inhale enormous quantities of air in a 40 ft radius around you. This is best used against clouds of smoke, fog or poison. As long as you concentrate, you can hold this air in your massive cheeks without any harm to yourself. When you cease concentration, you can exhale these gases as a 30 ft cone attack if they were harmful, inflicting whatever negative effect they had using your save DC. Regardless of what you exhale, the gas dissipates immediately after the attack.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Rushing Winds
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 4 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Air, Elusive Action: FRA
Fly rapidly in a direction 60 feet. Any creatures within 10 feet of you during this journey are blown in the direction of your movement 20 ft, take 6d8+CL (27+CL) crush damage and are knocked down (fort halves damage and negates push back/knockdown).

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Thunderlord's Decree
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 5 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Zap, Recharge Action: Standard
Your shout echoes like thunder across the battlefield as you call down dozens of lightning bolts to strike all enemies you can see within range. Creatures take 6d8+CL (27+CL) zap damage and are staggered for 1 round (fort halves damage and negates stagger).

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Cloud of Darkness
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 2 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Dark Action: Standard
A cloud of black mist emerges from your fingertips. This mist absorbs all natural light and leaves the area where it covers in complete Darkness.
You can use the spell to Dispel spells with the light tag. If you succeed, the darkness spell consumes the light and takes hold.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Pet Check
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 1 Earth Mother🍃
Tags: Mind-Affecting Action: Standard
You reach over to a creature and pat its head. If it resembles an animal, even superficially, it is dazed on hit for 1 turn.
If it is a defeated creature that matches this description, it gets the time out condition for 1 hour.Tamed animals (such as beast companions) can be brought back from pet heaven with a counter pet as a swift action.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Forest's Curse
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description:
Level 3 Mother Earth🍃
Tags: Curse Action: Standard
You curse a foe to wander aimlessly and suffer while in forested terrain. They take a -10 penalty to survival checks made to navigate in forest/jungle type terrain. They also lose poison resistance if they have it.In order to remove this curse, the creature must plant 3 new trees in 3 different locations.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Boasting Taunt
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description: Level 1 Warfare⚔ Tags: - Actions: StandardGoad a creature within 30 ft of you into attacking you. They are taunted for three rounds (will negates). At the end of each turn, they are allowed to make another save to shake off the taunt.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Break Free
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 1 Warfare⚔ Tags: - Action: Swift
Gain +4 bonus to your next attack against a creature grappling you or an ally this round. This bonus increases to +8 if you shove the enemy.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Bull Rush
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 1 Warfare⚔ Tags: - Action: Special Attack
Shove a creature with a +4 bonus. If successful, you can continue to move in a straight line while pushing them until you run out of movement, then push them your shove distance.If you impact another creature along your movement, you can attempt to shove them too. If you fail, your movement is halted. You and the original creature you rushed stop adjacent to the target you failed to shove.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Fake Out
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 1 Warfare⚔ Tags: - Action: Swift
Feint a creature.
Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase the bonus to the +Deception check by 2.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Reckless Charge
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 1 Warfare⚔ Tags: -
Action: FRA, Special Attack
Charge. You can move through difficult terrain and get +2 Attack. You take a -4 penalty to AC for 1 round instead of -2.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Second Wind
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 1 Warfare⚔
Tags: Healing, Air Action: Swift
Take a deep breath, for it might just be your last. Spend all of your remaining mana to gain 5+(2x mana spent) temp hp.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Blitz
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 2 Warfare⚔ Tags: - Action: Special Attack
Consume the entirety of a creature's attention with a quick flurry of attacks. The creature has blurred vision against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Brace Yourself
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 2 Warfare⚔ Tags: - Action: Standard
Shout at nearby enemies, goading them into attacking you, then take a defensive position. Taunt all enemies within 20 ft of you for 1 round (will negates) and take the total defense action.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Colossal Smash
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 2 Warfare⚔
Tags: Earth
Action: Special Attack
Make a topple attack with a +4 bonus. Apply the result to against all creatures touching the ground within 20 ft. All creatures knocked down from this effect also take an additional 2d6 (7) crush damage.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Headbutt
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 2 Warfare⚔ Tags: - Action: Special Attack
Butt heads with a foe. You deal an additional d8 (4) damage and your foe is dazed On-hit for one round (fort negates). You also must save against this effect.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Thick of the Fight
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 2 Warfare⚔
Tags: Buff Action: Swift
Being outnumbered only makes you more excited. While threatened by 2 or more enemies, gain +2 Attack.
Does not stack with Flanking.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Awesome Blow
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 3 Warfare⚔ Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Roll a shove attack. If successful, deal damage with a bonus 2d8 (9), shove and inflict Knockdown.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Taste Fear
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 3 Warfare⚔
Tags: Buff Action: Swift
You see the frightened and shaken conditions as palpable auras around creatures. You treat creatures as though they have weakness to slash, pierce and crush damage equal to their shaken penalty. Frightened creatures have weakness 4, as though they were shaken 4.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Warcry
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 3 Warfare⚔
Tags: Fear Action: Standard
Lift your weapon into the air and let out a battle cry. Enemies of a lower LvL than you are frightened for 1 round. Enemies of your level or higher are frightened for 1 round (will reduces to shaken 1).After a creature is the target of this technique, it cannot be affected by it again for 1 minute.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/w.title: Warfare
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/w.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-swords" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><polyline points="14.5 17.5 3 6 3 3 6 3 17.5 14.5"></polyline><line y2="13" x2="19" y1="19" x1="13"></line><line y2="20" x2="20" y1="16" x1="16"></line><line y2="19" x2="21" y1="21" x1="19"></line><polyline points="14.5 6.5 18 3 21 3 21 6 17.5 9.5"></polyline><line y2="18" x2="9" y1="14" x1="5"></line><line y2="20" x2="4" y1="17" x1="7"></line><line y2="21" x2="5" y1="19" x1="3"></line></svg>
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/w.description: The generic martial attacks that every warrior worth their salt knows.

classes/bender/bender.html.title: Bender
classes/bender/bender.html.description:
Gain mastery over a specific element, using it as an extension of your own body. Benders use their favored element in order to augment their attacks and movement. They also get unique quirks based off of the qualities of the elements that they bend.Benders ignore the standard technique point progression when it comes to abilities that match a tag of their favored element. They automatically know all techniques (still capped by the technique level maximum) that match the tag of elemental blasts they can use. In addition, I added a list of other techniques I thought thematically appropriate.You can replace the damage of any attacks in techniques with your blast damage (not compatible with upcast damage). You can use your blast to deliver the effects of techniques and special attacks, though they still must match the type of attack (ranged attack, melee attack etc). You ignore the staff component of any spell you gain through this feature. Techniques/special attacks that require simple attacks or have the persistent tag cannot use your blast damage.
Waterbender🌊 initially gets the water tag and @3 gets the frost tag. Most water techniques are in the Goomshroom🍄 tree and most frost techniques are in the Cryomancy❄ tree.
Earthbender🪨 gets the earth tag. Most earth techniques are in the Cataclysm🌋 tree.
Airbender🌪 gets the air tag. Most air techniques are in the Clairvoyance (T) tree. Airbenders also get access to all the techniques in the Unarmed👊 tree, with standard technique scaling.
Firebender🔥 gets the fire tag and @5 gets the zap tag. Most fire techniques are in the
Pyromancy🔥 tree and most zap techniques are in the clairvoyance tree.
Instead of a particular specialization, you ignore the Staff Component of any spells that match your elemental tag(s).At level 1 you choose an element: water, fire, earth, air. Once chosen it cannot be changed. Your elements decides many aspects of your class. In order to use any (Su) class abilities, you must meet requirements based on the element. You get a +4 bonus on saves against effects that share the same tag as your element.
As a standard action you attack a foe within 30 ft using either str or dex as your attacking stat. If the creature is out of reach, it counts as a ranged attack. If the creature is within your natural reach, you can either make the blast as a melee or ranged attack. It's damage is 2d6+STR/DEX, increasing by d6 @3 and every odd level after. The damage type is determined by your favored element.
Elemental blast inherently has a +2 bonus to Attack for the bender class.These features give your bending more options. If an ability has a mana cost, it is noted next to its name (in parenthesis), or in the description if only a specific part costs mana. Gain 1 this level and another one at level 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10.Spend 1 mana to launch your element at all creatures in a 30 ft line or in a 10 ft burst (centered on you). Deal your blast damage to all affected creatures (reflex halves). If you can change your blasts damage, you can change the damage of elemental wave as well.
You can innately cast dispel magic (CL=lvl+2), but only on effects that share the tag of your blast tag(s). You can use this to stop even non-magical effects, treating the effective CL of such effects as the attacker's LvL.The damage dice of your elemental blast increases to d8.1/day you can use plane shift to transport yourself to your corner of the elemental plane based on your favored element. At any time thereafter you can perform a similar ritual to return to the exact position you came from.The damage dice of your elemental blast increases to d10. Your blast range increases to 60 ft.

headers.heading: 1 - Favored Element Su

classes/martial-artist/archteypes/monk/m.title: Monk
classes/martial-artist/archteypes/monk/m.description:
A monk is an unarmed fighter that chooses to not only hone their body into a perfect weapon, but also their spirit. Be it through the exploration of the self or the deprivation of worldly pleasures, these warriors unlock spiritual powers that work in tandem with their highly mobile, up close and personal fighting style.Your first unarmed attack you land on a creature has a bonus On-hit effect. This effect can only be applied to a creature 1/day.
Creature is Dazed for 1 round on hit (fort negates).You have taken a vow, depriving yourself of something others might consider core to existence. Your unusual lifestyle comes with a unique benefit befitting of your dedication.
You gain the +Acrobatics⚖ skill, and a +4 bonus. You can stand on even the thinnest and weakest of surfaces without falling over and without breaking the surface. This can include flimsy bridges/branches, rope, or even wet napkins.
Draw in the energy of the universe and steel your mind as a FRA.
You regain (1+¼) your level mana, remove all shaken stacks and take the total defense action.You can start concentrating on this ability as a free action. As long as you only move during your turn and take no other action, you can walk along any flat continuous surface. This can include things that aren't even otherwise solid such as water or lava. It can also include things such as walls or ceilings.You can use this ability for only part of your turn to get to a location, but if you attack, cast a spell etc, then you need a surface you would normally be able to stand on or you plummet.Monks have a way of thinking about the world unlike any other. By simplifying complex truths into easy to understand proverbs, you can give your allies a unique perspective.
1/day you can dispense your knowledge as a standard action to a creature within reach. When the proverb finally clicks, you give your ally a Reroll on a skill check of their choosing. If they do not use it by the time they rest, the wisdom is lost.
At the start of your turn if you are shaken, confused, frightened or under some type of charm/possession effect, you can choose to immediately end all of those effects as a swift action by spending 2 mana.Knock bones into place and relax muscles with a quick jab. Spend 1 mana to touch a creature and heal (3+lvl) hp. Can be done as a swift and a standard action. Temp hp granted by this ability lasts 10 minutes.
On hit apply Siphoned for 1 round (fort negates). Alternatively you can disable a creatures limb for 1 round. Targeted wings disable flight, legs decrease speed by 15 and arms render them unusable etc (fort negates).

4 - Healing Hand (Su) healing overheal

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Attack
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description:
What you add to your Attack Rolls to beat a target's AC.
By default, you add your LV, DEX or STR depending on your weapon type, and bonuses from your +Class to your accuracy. Circumstance can also change acc.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Attack.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Dispel
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: Dispel refers to when a magical effect is negated, usually functioning as Dispel Magic. Other effects, such as techniques in the Arc tree or magic crash can also perform a similar function.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Dispel.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Luck Dice
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: A luck dice is a meta resource given to characters that allows them to bend fate in their favor, awarded by various things throughout the game, namely for the Lunatic.You can spend a luck dice whenever you don't like the result of a d20 roll you made. You can even do it retroactively after you discover your roll failed.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Luck Dice.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: LvL
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: The level assigned to a creature or effect is used to represent their relative strength in the setting. Level is added to all Rolls (Attack Rolls, +Saving Throws, proficient Skills, etc.)
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/LvL.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.title: High Ground
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.description:
A Circumstance that you get when you have an elevation edge of at least 10ft over your opponent.
You cannot gain high ground by using the Jump action.
High ground lets you ignore the Attack penalty from firing ranged attacks in the second range increment.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Types of Attack Rolls/Ranged Attack/High Ground.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.title: Long
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.description: A long range weapon's first range increment is 60ft and second is 120ft.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Types of Attack Rolls/Ranged Attack/Long.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.title: Range Increments
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.description:
Most ranged attacks have 2 listed ranges. When you make an attack at a creature within the first listed range (the first range increment), there is no attack penalty. When you make one against a creature in the second listed range (the second range increment), you take a -2 Attack penalty. This penalty can be negated with high ground⛰. Attacks beyond this range are impossible.
Whenever you have a feature that increases the the range of your attack, like Artillery, this range increase also applies to the second increment.
Some ranged attacks, like spells and the supernatural abilities like the Bender elemental blast, have flat ranges, usually 30 or 60 ft. Effects that increase the range of attacks do not affect these features.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Types of Attack Rolls/Ranged Attack/Range Increments.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.title: Ranged Attack
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.description:
A Ranged Attack is an Attack Roll made with ranged targeting. This means you can make the attack up to the listed range, not limited by the space you Threaten. These attacks can also be penalized due to Cover. Most physical Ranged Attacks have three listed ranges: Thrown, Spatial Rend and long🏹.
Making a Ranged Attack Provokes.
Abilities that function from a distance but do not use an Attack Roll are not Ranged Attacks.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Types of Attack Rolls/Ranged Attack/Ranged Attack.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.title: Short
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.description: A medium range weapon's first range increment is 40ft and second is 80ft.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Types of Attack Rolls/Ranged Attack/Short.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.title: Thrown
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.description:
A thrown attack is a Ranged Attack that can be made using either STR or DEX.
Its first range increment is 20ft and second is 40ft.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Types of Attack Rolls/Ranged Attack/Thrown.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/attack.title: Attack Roll
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/attack.description:
Attack rolls are any type of harmful effect targeting a creature that requires rolling. This can be spells, swords or trying to push your foe off a cliff.Most attacks assume you use a weapon, a Natural Attack or an Unarmed Attack.Default:d20+ (lvl) +(ability score) +/- (circumstances)
In general AC is not a zero sum endeavor. If you successfully meet the AC number, you deal full damage. if you roll 10 higher than the AC number, you Crit. If you roll under the AC number, but not by more than 5, you get a partial hit as you graze your opponent with your attack.
Generally speaking, you can only make a single attack with your standard action, but creatures with Multiattack, and special cases like Classes/Fighter/Fighter⚔ or Martial Artist, can make multiple on their turn.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/attack.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Attack Roll.md

feats/combat-feats/freedom-of-movement.h.title: Freedom of Movement
feats/combat-feats/freedom-of-movement.h.description:
Requirements - You take no penalty to speed while staggered or frosty. This can reasonably extend to other minor temporary speed Status that aren't these exact status conditions (such as the speed penalty from the icicle cantrip).
If knocked down, your speed only decreases by 15.
If you would be unable to move at all, such as being stunned or entangled, your speed is instead 5. You bring any grapplers with you.

lore/noteworthy-people/santa.html.title: Santa
lore/noteworthy-people/santa.html.description:
The Psionics🤯 tree is something that has been developed piecemeal over long periods of time, culminating into its current form under the guidance of an entity by the name of Santa. Those who are more well informed may make the connection that Santa is actually an alias for an entity known as Glass Reflection: An Elf🧝 that was a world renowned Spy🔍 once upon a time. Enough time passes and the mortals forget who you are.
Those who go to great lengths to find out more, trying to meet Santa or through dedication to the Chrimbus Spirit🎄, may even learn her true identity: Colene Larella. She goes to great lengths to keep her true identity hidden, hiding behind aliases and intermediaries for all but the most important of interactions.
Using a powerful device that amplifies her psychic powers, she scans the world for those who struggle, primarily children, and does her best to aid them in their trying times. She gives them gifts, sometimes in the form of presents, other times in companionship through a Poplin🧸 sibling.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: In Orbit
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 1 Arcane
Tags: Force, Healing Action: Swift
3 small pale white orbs emerge from your staff and float around you. At the end of each of your turns, an orb bumps into to a creature within your natural reach. A single creature can only be hit by 1 orb a turn, but can be affected by multiple over several turns.When an orb bumps into a creature, it pops. If multiple creatures are within your reach, multiple orbs pop. When all three orbs have popped, deal (3+CL) force damage to all creatures within your natural reach and gain (3+CL) temp hp.Only the orb part of the spell is a buff, not the temp hp.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Star Fall
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 1 Arcane
Tags: Force Action: StandardThe skies darken above you and tiny motes of light pepper the heavens.
You can call down stars on your foes. You automatically deal (CL) force damage to all enemies within 15 ft of you. Each time you hit an enemy with this spell, the damage increases by 3 for the next 2 rounds. Additional casts extend the duration of the increased damage, allowing it to ramp up in damage infinitely.Damage resets when you roll initiative.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Center of the Universe
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 3 Arcane
Tags: Buff, Force Action: StandardMany glowing orbs immediately move away from you and start rotating at a fixed distance of 15 ft. At the start and end of your turns, deal (CL) force damage to creatures that are exactly 15 ft away from you.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Cosmic Cage
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 3 Arcane
Tags: Concentration Actions: StandardYou create a cage like structure at the edge of the radius of this spell. Creatures can still see in and out of the cage, and still have line of effect. The cage provides no cover.
If a creature moves in or out of the cage, willingly or unwillingly, it is stunned for 1 round (fort reduces effect to dazed) and its movement is halted. A creature can only be affected by the spell once.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Dark Matter
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 3 Arcane
Tags: Force, Upcast Action: StandardYou mark a position on the ground and a dark shadow forms over it, indicating great danger to those nearby. At the start of your next turn, a chunk of condensed cosmic energy lands on this spot, dealing 4d12+CL (26+CL) force damage (reflex halves).
If a creature's speed is zero (such as from being stunned or entangled) it has Disadvantage on its save.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d12 (6).

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Meteor Shower
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 4 Arcane
Tags: Light, Force Action: Standard
Call down ray(s) of light from the heavens onto your foes. The spell’s CL increases by 2 at night with a direct view of the night sky. 40 ft around the area the spell impact becomes bright light for one minute.Shower - Target a 30 ft line in the spells area. Creatures in the area take 5d8+CL (22+CL) force damage (reflex halves).
Strike - Target a single creature. The creature takes 5d10+CL (27+CL) force damage and is blinded for 1 round. (reflex halves and reduces blinded to Blurred Vision)

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Night Comet
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 4 Arcane
Tags: Force Action: Standard
Make a Ranged spell attack as you fire a large dart of magic. The target takes 5d10+CL (27+CL) force damage. While cast in Darkness, this dart is invisible, making the target DD.
If cast as a FRA, its damage dice increases to d12.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d10 (5).

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Moonblast
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 5 Arcane
Tags: Force, Recharge Action: Standard
You gently float into the air and the cradle yourself with energy that takes the shape of a full moon. You enter stasis until the start of your next turn.As a free action at the start of your next turn, launch the moon at an enemy within range. Roll a
ranged attack to deal 6d8+CL (27+CL) force damage. The creature also gains weakness 5 to force damage for 1 minute.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Singularity
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 5 Arcane
Tags: Force, Persistent, Concentration Action: StandardChoose a point in space to manifest a dark sphere with a selective gravitational pull. Immediately upon casting, and as a swift action each subsequent turn, 3 creatures (or objects weighing less than a ton) of your choosing within 100 feet of the singularity are pulled 30 feet closer (fort reduces to 10ft). Any creature in an adjacent space is considered touching it, dealing 2d8+CL (9+CL) force damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: The Skies Descend
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 6 Arcane
Tags: Force, Recharge Action: Standard
You mark a position on the ground and a dark shadow forms over a 20 ft radius, and an bright and shining object hurtling towards it is visible from the sky. At the start of your next turn, a small star lands on this spot, dealing 7d10+CL (33+CL) force damage and stuns for 1 round (reflex halves dmg and reduces stun to Staggered).The star then sends a shockwave out to affect all enemies within a 100ft radius. They are automatically treated as though they pass their save.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Prisoner's Brand
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 1 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: 1 minute Focus: A drawing of the brandYou touch the creature and apply the brand used as the focus component. It is slightly uncomfortable when applied, but does not cause damage. You are constantly aware of the direction of this creature. You can brand multiple creatures, but you cannot tell which creature is which.Petting an eagle removes this curse and its associated brand. Other types of freedom-related creatures can potentially suffice.

techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.title: Cold Feet
techniques/magical-techniques/cryomancy/.description:
Level 3 Cryomancy❄
Tags: Frost Action: Standard
Call forth icicles underneath all of your foes. Each one is entangled and takes 4d8+CL (21+CL) cold damage (reflex halves dmg and negates entangle). A creature can Breakout of this effect as a standard action.

techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.title: Golden Move
techniques/magical-techniques/frogg-sara.description:
Level 2 Frogg Saran (T)🐸
Tags: Prepared Action: -
Frogg is always watching out for you, protecting you when you need it most. Whenever you take the Total Defense action, you also turn into a solid golden version of yourself, putting you in Stasis. At the end of an enemy's turn, roll a d6. On a 6, this stasis ends, but the total defense does not.If you do not lose this stasis by your next turn, you don't get a turn, as though you had spent it doing nothing other than using total defense again.If you are not currently in combat, you can still turn golden, but it only lasts 6 seconds.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Spatial Rend
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 2 God Mode⏰
Tags: Concentration Action: StandardTear apart time and space surrounding a creature, causing the creature to temporarily split into two different versions of itself. One is clearly insubstantial, almost like a ghost, and gets yanked into a space of your choosing within range.
Targeting this severed spirit, in all ways, is treated as though you were affecting the original creature, using all of its statistics. Persistent effects can still only effect once per turn, and AoE effects that target both still only do one instance of damage, but it gives the creature Disadvantage on its save.The spirit cannot be moved. It cannot be affected by anything other than HP damage, which is redirected to the original target of this spell. It cannot use any abilities and the original creature cannot activate its own abilities through its spirit. The target of the spell is tethered, and cannot ever be more than 120 ft from its spirit. If it moves farther, the spell ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.title: Banishment
techniques/magical-techniques/golden-ord.description:
Level 4 Golden Order Tags: - Action: Standard
You point towards a creature and send it back from whence it came (will negates), with the effect differing slightly depending on what you target. You can only use banishment on a creature who your CL exceeds their LvL by at least 3.Aberration: The creature is sent back to its original planet. If it did not have an original planet, it gets transported to the moon.
Undead: It is immediately Entombed in the ground underneath it. It can Breakout as a FRA, but the DC is increased by 5.
Fiend: The creature is sent back to The Demon Realm.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Bubble Buddy
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Concentration, Water Action: StandardYou blow a bubble in the shape of a friend. It floats gently in the air or water behind you at a static distance of 10 ft. It cannot be popped unless it takes piercing damage from a direct attack.Gives all nearby allies +2 happiness.Bubble buddy has nothing but the best intentions but often somehow finds a way to sour the mood. At any point while bubble buddy exists, you can send it into a social situation. People will generally treat bubble buddy as a real person, but it does not speak much back, only communicating vaguely through subtle item interactions. Over the course of a minute, bubble buddy will quickly inconvenience people to show what a bad possible outcome is for interacting with this specific person or type of person. Such as spilling a dwarf's drink, or poking someone very sensitive to touch.If you allow it, bubbly buddy will continue interacting with people all around a social setting, such as a party, a tavern etc and ruin the mood. Eventually, people will turn on the buddy (and the caster if they saw you cast it, see you concentrating etc).

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: To the Rescue!
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 2 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Healing, Elusive
Action: FRA
Your body oozes with a soothing and sticky goo. Take the carry action and increase your speed by 20 this turn. You ignore carried creatures' weight as though it were your own. Any creature carried recovers (5+CL) hp. You can rescue up to 2 allies. At the end of your turn, they detach in an adjacent space of your choosing, or in your possession.
If a creature is directly preventing an ally from moving, such as when being grappled, then you cannot rescue them. For situations like being stuck in a web, a suitable check (like a Breakout) can be rolled to rescue.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Nightcrawler
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 1 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Buff Action: Standard
You gain nightvision.
While in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you turn into a dark silhouette version of yourself, with only your eyes remaining the same. This is a Glamer effect. If you are exposed to bright light, your form slowly returns back to normal over 3 rounds (~20 seconds). Returning back to darkness turns you back into a silhouette. You can toggle this shadow form off/on if you want yourself to be seen.
While a silhouette, you get a +2 bonus on +Disguise and +Stealth.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Shadow Weapon
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 1 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Frost Action: SwiftYou transform a held weapon such that it appears to be made out of complete darkness, absorbing the light around it. You can also choose to transform your staff into another weapon to dual wield, making you unable to cast further spells. You can transform it back as a free action.If the weapon leaves your hands for longer than 1 round, it reverts back to its original state.
Shadow weapons deal frost damage instead of their standard damage type. When you feint a creature while wielding them, it takes (CL) frost damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Dead Silent
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 2 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard
Sound cannot be created in or enter the area of this spell. Creatures with the area are Silenced. Certain abilities dependent on sound like bardic performance, spell casting and abilities that deal sonic damage are all completely disabled.
If you cast the spell on yourself, then it stays anchored to you, but it changes to a 10-foot radius and gains the buff tag.

techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.title: Form of Waifu
techniques/magical-techniques/nack/level.description:
Level 3 Nack🎉
Tags: poly, true, Buff. Dismissible Action: Standard
You transform into a cute Anime🎌 girl/boy. You have exceptionally large eyes, wacky hair and abnormal colors. Your voice also changes accordingly.You can speak and understand manganese while transformed.

techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.title: Purge
techniques/magical-techniques/prismancy/.description:
Level 6You fire a beam of purifying light, dealing 7d8+CL (31+CL) fire damage and blinding everything it hits for one round (reflex halves dmg and negates blind). This automatically destroys objects of solid or lesser toughness, and if it's enough to break them, it continues past them. This damage area is persistent, and creatures that enter it must save against the damage.Fiends and undead creatures that fail their saves are set ablaze.You may not move while concentrating on this spell.At the start of your next two turns, the damage occurs again, and you may sweep the beam up to 45 degrees to target a new line and everything between the two lines that gets caught in the sweep. The sweep area is not persistent, but the new line is.Turn 1: line
Turn 2: sweep, new line
Turn 3: sweep, new line
Turn 4: spell ends at the start of your turn

techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.title: Wall of Fire
techniques/magical-techniques/pyromancy/.description:
Level 4 Pyromancy🔥
Tags: Persistent, Concentration, Fire, Upcast Action: StandardCause a wall of flame to ignite within range. The wall is 20 ft high and 5 ft wide. The line, does not need to originate from you, allowing you great creativity in placement. The line must be in one continuous direction, or in a circular formation. It can move along changes in elevation, so long as that elevation is not taller than the wall itself.Creatures inside of the wall when cast, or that move through it take 5d8+CL (23+CL) fire damage (reflex halves).Upcast - For each additional mana, increase the length of the line and range by 30 ft. This also increases the radius of any circular walls created by 5 ft.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Dance With Me!
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 1 Shira💋
Tags: Charm, Elusive Action: Standard
You extend your hand to a creature and offer to dance. You immediately move 15 ft in a direction of your choosing and the creature is Charmed by you during its next turn. It cannot move while tangled in your routine, but it can otherwise act normally (will reduces effect to 15 speed penalty).
Unique: If you have the +Profession🧑‍🌾 (dance) skill, then you can move 30 ft in a direction of your choosing on a failed save.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: Corpse Creeper
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description:
A crack in the wall of the cave splits open and a worm far too large to ever reasonably ever fit inside slides out. Several tongue-like tendrils wriggle around on its face until they snap to in the direction of your party. Level 7 Huge BeastReactive Armor - A creeper can use its Nice Catch technique with its body armor. It can only hold onto one such weapon at a time. It must let go of a weapon (free action) before it can use this technique again.Multiattack - Make a bite and a grapple attack.
Innate Techniques - Feast, Nice Catch
1/day - Fracture, Caustic Blood
Constant - Power Lifter, Rapid Recovery
Favored Enemy - A creeper's favorite stack is a set of tasty bones. It gets a +4 bonus to attack with its bite against any creature primarily made of bones, such as a skeleton or a Boner💀.
Bone Crusher - When a creeper maintains a grapple and harms a creature, they burrow their tendrils into the creatures body and crush their bones. This inflicts drain 2 and causes them to internally bleed, dealing 2d6 damage each turn. Creatures get Disadvantage on checks to stop this bleeding. Serrated Tendrils - When a creature escapes a grapple from a creature, they are scraped by the tendrils on the way out. They bleed d6.
Belly Scratches - When Knocked Down, creatures get a +4 bonus to Attack against the creeper instead of +2.
Ability Scores - STR +3, DEX +0, LUK +0, INT -3, WIS +1, CHA +0
Compression
Speed - Climb🧗 40
Blindsense - Scent (15 ft)
Tracking - Against a creature primarily made of bones, a creeper can track untrained, and automatically gets a result of 30 to do so, requiring no roll.
Deific Boons - Animal Instincts
Feats - Maneuver Master, Maneuver Versatility, Back to the Wall, Combat Step
Skills - +10 +Perception👀, +12 +Athletics🏊

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Venom
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description:
Inflicts the envenomed status effect with one of its attacks or abilities, which functions as follows.Venom comes in 3 stages. In order to advance from one to the next, the afflicted creature must fail a Fortitude save. The venom continues until they creature passes a fortitude save. Some creatures may have different effects for their venom, but this is the assumed default if no other details are listed.Note:
If a creature is exposed to venom again while already suffering from such an effect, they get Disadvantage on their next save against envenomed progressing.

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: Proc
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: Proc is a terminology I have only really heard in the context of games. It means that something is triggered. For instance, when I land an attack with my bleed katana, I would say that I "procced" the bleed.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/Proc.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/outplay.htm.title: Outplay
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/outplay.htm.description: This effect bypasses AC, poise and saving throws to (almost) automatically deal damage.

core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/sonic.html.title: Sonic
core-rules,-how-to-play/tags/sonic.html.description: A damage type centered around being incredibly loud.

feats/combat-feats/antagonize/antagonize.title: Antagonize
feats/combat-feats/antagonize/antagonize.description:
Requirements - You can taunt a creature for one round instead of making them shaken when you demoralize them.
You can also use +Deception just like you would +Intimidation😱 in order to achieve this effect. The opponent rolls a will save with a DC of (10+your deception bonus).You can continue this taunt by spending a swift action each turn, as long as you are still within 30 ft of your target.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Gust
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description:
+Cantrips
Tags: Air Action: StandardA gust of wind bursts from your staff to push a creature. The creature is knocked 10 ft directly away from you (fort negates).

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Imaginary Friend
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 2 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Companion, Mana Burn, Figment, Psychic, Upcast Action: Standard
A shadowy copy of yourself splits from your body. It follows you around and attacks your enemies. If you are proficient in +Stealth then it shares your stealth bonus. An imaginary friend shares all of your ability scores, AC, movement speed(s) and saves. It has half of your max hp and 20+CL Poise. It shares your LvL, but is always treated as a minion.
It's only form of attack is single swipe using whatever weapon you are currently wielding. It is not a real attack, so instead of rolling an Attack Roll it deals 2d8 (9) psychic damage (will halves). Every turn it exists in Light levels brighter than dim light, it takes 10 true damage.
Doesn't Threaten. The burn from this spell is removed if it is Defeated, but mana is not restored.Upcast - Burn an additional 1 mana to have the imaginary friend's attacks deal an additional d8 (4) damage.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Weapon Toss
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 1 Warfare⚔
Tags: Su Action: Special AttackToss your weapon, temporarily giving it the thrown property.
If it is a piercing weapon, the foe is Entangled On-hit. The creature can breakout to remove it as a swift action, or remove it automatically by spending a standard action.When you throw the weapon, a copy of it appears in your hand, hit or miss. The weapon you throw disappears on a miss or after it is removed.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Targeted
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 3 Warfare⚔
Tags: Concentration, Su Action: Standard
A prototypical target appears on your back, and on your head. Enemies with range are taunted by you (will negates). Taunted creatures get an additional save at the end of their turn.
Mindless creatures and creatures with -2 or less INT take a -2 penalty to their save. Even if they aren't taunted, creatures in the aura take a -10 penalty to +Perception👀 checks versus anything that isn’t the targeted creature.A creature that is the target of this technique cannot be target by it again for 1 minute.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Martial Challenge
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 6 Warfare⚔
Tags: Recharge, Buff, Su Action: StandardSwing your weapon around you with such force that it flings all nearby enemies away from you. All enemies within 30 ft take 10d8 (45) slashing damage and are pushed directly away from you until they are 35 feet away from you (reflex halves damage and negates push back).You can decide to not push one target in particular.
After the swipe, a visible barrier forms around you. Until the start of your next turn, you are immune to all damage that does not originate from a creature within 30 feet of you.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Dismantle
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 1 Arc
Tags: Su, Upcast Action: Standard
You create a transparent but clearly visible wall that partially unweaves magic that passes through it. Any spell or supernatural (Su) effect that passes through the wall has its Attack bonus and DC decreased by 2. If an ability requires going through the barrier to have Line of Effect, it is considered to be "going through" the barrier for targeted spells without projectiles like Charming Gaze or effects with an aura (like Targeted).You can also choose to form the barrier into a hemisphere centered on you with a radius equal to half the walls dimensions.Upcast - Per each additional mana spent, increase the dimensions of the wall by 10 ft (20x20, 30x30 etc)

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Down to Earth
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 1 Arc
Tags: Su, Upcast
Action: Special AttackYou infuse your weapon with the ability to tangle a creatures wings or the magic that holds it afloat in the air. Make a weapon attack that applies grounded for 1 round.
Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4). At 3 mana, this debuff gains the curse effect.The curse only ends when the creature consumes a creature known to fly, even if only sparingly, such as a chicken, or its egg.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Crumble Magic Minion
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 2 Arc
Tags: Su, Upcast
Action: Special Attack
If you land this attack against a magically created companion creature, such as an undead or a summoned creature, you automatically deal the attack's damage as True Damage to the creature that created the effect too if they are within 100 ft of you.
In the case of a creature summoned by a Summoning Contract📜, it damages whoever summoned them, not the real body of the creature being summoned.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4). If you spend at least 3 mana, the attack damages all the companion creatures, in addition to their creator/summoner.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Dispelling Strike
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 2 Arc
Tags: Su, Upcast, Force
Action: Special Attack
Roll an attack roll in place of a Dispel check against a magical effect you can attack. If it is attached to a creature, the attack only effects the spell, not the creature.If you successfully dispel the effect, the caster takes 2d8+lvl (9+lvl) force damage.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d8 (4).

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Mana Scorch
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 2 Arc
Tags: Su, Curse, Upcast Action: Standard
You weaken the creatures connection to the mana of the universe. They Mana Burn 2 and lose an additional 2 mana (will negates mana burn). Mana Scorch curses can stack.
Against a creature with only innate techniques, it instead removes a 1/day spell of up to 2nd level until the curse is lifted.By not casting a spell for a full 24 hours, the curse ends.Upcast - Increase mana burn and mana loss by 1 per mana spent. Or increase the level of 1/day spell that can be consumed by 1 per mana spent.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Superstitious
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 2 Arc
Tags: Prepared, Su Action: StandardYou see magical auras around mages constantly. You learn the highest level spell a creature can cast by focusing on them as a standard action.
You automatically get a check to see a creature’s true form or to see the true nature of a Figment (will save vs their DC). If you strike a creature disguising their true form, they revert back to it (will negates).

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Arcana Theft
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 3 Arc
Tags: Su
Action: Special Attack
Make an Attack against a creature and steal their magic away from them. If they are currently affected by a buff spell, you take it away from them On-hit. You remove the buff from them and grant it to yourself or an ally within 30 ft.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Blood Price
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 3 Arc
Tags: Su, Curse Action: Standard
Inflict a curse that is particularly annoying to mages (will negates). Whenever the cursed creature casts a spell, it becomes Drained equal to the spell level.The drain happens after the effects of the spell.By not casting a spell for a full day, the curse ends.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Teleblock
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 3 Arc
Tags: Su Action: Immediate
When a creature attempts to teleport and you successfully identify the effect (via +Monster Lore📖 or Identify Spell Being Cast), you can block it automatically. The creature is also anchored (will negates).

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Teleportation Trap
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 3 Arc
Tags: Su, Sigil, Upcast Action: 3 rounds
When you place this sigil, you must designate a location within its AoE on a surface visible from where it is placed. Unlike most other sigils, a teleportation trap is not triggered by moving within a certain radius of it. A creature that teleports within 120 feet of the sigil, even without direct line of effect, is immediately affected by the trap and teleported to this predesignated location instead of their intended destination (will reduces effect to clumsy 1).If you place a Teleportation Trap while you already have one active, the previous one disappears.Upcast 6 - The sigil becomes permanent and its AoE increases to 300 ft.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Siphoning Sigil
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 4 Arc
Tags: Su, Sigil Action: 3 roundsYou inscribe a anti-magic rune on the surface of an object. Whenever a creature of at least small or larger size enters this area, the sigil triggers. All creatures within 20 ft of the sigil are siphoned (will negates). At the end of each round, creatures get a new save against this effect.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Put Me In!
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 1 Barbarism💢
Tags: Upcast
Tags: Special Attack
Set an ally to 1 poise and throw them into combat. You can throw them up to 20 ft, including into the air.Upcast - For each additional mana you spend, you can throw your ally an additional 10 ft.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Cart
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 3 Barbarism💢
Tags: Su, Prepared Action: -You manifest a cart of your own design as a standard action. Every time you manifest this cart, it is the same cart. The cart is capable of holding a dozen or so people and has an extra dimensional cargo space (5-ft cube). You can cause this cart to vanish back to the cart realm as a standard action.While attached to and dragging your cart, your land speed doubles. To you, the contents within the cart are completely weightless. To anybody else, it weighs 2k lbs.The cart lasts indefinitely, but disappears while you don’t have this technique memorized.

techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.title: Flash Attack
techniques/martial-techniques/barbarism/.description:
Level 3 Barbarism💢
Tags: Su, Teleportation, Force, Upcast Action: Free
You can teleport 30 ft, as long as you appear in a threatened space. Any creatures you threaten take 2d8 (9) force damage and an equal amount of poise damage.After you activate this ability, your turn immediately ends.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Gravity Well
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 3 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Su, Concentration Action: Standard
Flex so hard you exert a weak gravitational force around you. All creatures within 60 ft are grounded and affected by T2 High Gravity. This debuff persists for the rest of the affected creature's turn after leaving the area.As a swift action, you can end the effect and pull all creatures within range 30 ft closer to you (fort negates).

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Wasteland
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 3 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Su, Sigil, Curse, Upcast Action: 1 minute
You use the ink to inscribe the mark of The Cataclysm🌋 on a flat surface. Over the course of a week, the curse will spread over the area of the spell. Plants will wither, soil will turn to sand or dust, water sources will dry up and wildlife will perish. In general, the natural terrain suffers until it is converted into uninhabitable wasteland over the course of a few months, and a toxic volcanic wasteland over a year.To remove the curse, a creature must spend 200g of summoner's ink or normal ink made with holy water to write a brief poem or prayer in druidic in a circle around the mark of the Cataclysm. Depending on how long the mark was present, it may take years for the land to recover without assistance.Using this technique removes any previous instances you use.Upcast 5 - AoE increases to 1 mileUpcast 6 - AoE increases to 5 miles.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Roar of the Cataclysm
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 5 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Fear, Sonic, Su Action: StandardYou call forth a portion of your fiendish patron to strike fear into the hearts of your enemies. Its visage overlaps your own as you let out a monstrous roar.Creatures within 30 feet of you take 6d6 (21) sonic damage.
They are also frightened for 1 minute (will reduces frightened to shaken 1). Each round at the end of their turn, creatures can roll another save to reduce the frightened condition to shaken 1.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Calamity
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 6 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Recharge, Elusive Action: 2 rounds
Material: 1 scale of The Cataclysm🌋You call forth the infinite reserves of strength possessed by your fiendish patron to lay waste to the area around you. It requires a standard action to initiate this technique and you immediately leap 5,000 feet into the air. You are still targetable through normal means, but the distance makes most forms of attack impossible. Until the start of your next turn you charge energy and gain momentum as you plummet towards the ground. To onlookers you look like a meteor rapidly approaching.
As a standard action on your next turn, you decide the area you want to unleash this gathered momentum and energy. Choose a 60 ft line in the technique's range. All but the sturdiest objects (adamantine toughness+) within 30 feet of this line are immediately evaporated by your impact, turning to dust. Creatures within 30 feet of this line take 50 crush damage, are knocked out of the area and are staggered for 1 minute (fort halves the damage). New save every round to end stagger. You end the movement granted by this technique at the end of this line and your turn ends.
The area within 30 feet on either side of this line becomes a 30 ft deep pit of roiling liquid Lava🌋 that persists for weeks, or even longer depending on environmental conditions.This technique is anything but subtle and leaves a lot to be desired when using it as a surprise attack. The impact creates an incredibly powerful shockwave that people might mistake for an earthquake. Objects such as buildings, trees and roads close by to the where this technique is cast are damaged by being in the vicinity of this impact, even if they aren't in the lava crater.

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Gravity Storm
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 6 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Su Recharge Action: StandardYou channel your power such that it forces everything nearby to bend to your might. You passively exert a tangible gravitational pull to everything within 60 ft, causing loose objects weighing less than 100 lbs to immediately be pulled into the storm, throwing them into an orbit around you. Loose objects weighing between 100 and 1000 lbs are slowly dragged towards you.
The movement of any enemy within 60 ft of you that is moving farther away from you is considered difficult terrain. All creatures within the aura are Grounded.
As part of using this technique, and at the start of every turn as a free action, you can choose to exert this force, pulling all creatures in range 10 ft closer to you. At the end of each of your turns, if a creature is within your natural reach, it must roll a DC 20 +Athletics🏊 check or buckle under its own weight, causing it to take 4d6 (14) crush dmg and gain Clumsy 1.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Flying Arrow
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 1 Marksman🏹
Tags: Su
Action: Special Attack
Make a ranged attack against a creature that gains a mind of its own. It ignores all conventional rules of weaponry and continues to follow where you aim your weapon until it strikes an additional creature within 15 ft of the original. Secondary attacks ignore range increment penalties if the first did.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, deal an additional d8 (4) dmg or the projectile flies to attack an additional target.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Gravity Bow
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 3 Marksman🏹
Tags: Upcast
Action: Special Attack
Fire a single powerful shot at a creature that crashes on impact. The target takes an additional 2d8 (9) damage and is pushed back 10 ft On-hit. Creatures within 10 ft of the impact zone are also knocked back 10 ft away from the target creature (fort negates).
This attack is considered to be from a +Siege Weapon.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase the knockback distance of both effects by 5 ft.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Named Bullet
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 3 Marksman🏹
Tags: Mana Burn, Su Action: 1 minuteHold a piece of ammunition (not just a bullet) in your hand and infuse it with your conviction to defeat a specific enemy. You must know the creatures name. If you use an incorrect name, when you fire the shot, it has no added effect.You get a +10 bonus to attack with a piece of ammunition affected by named bullet that strikes its intended target.While this ammunition holds this power, you are afflicted with mana burn 3 until you use the bullet, even if you rest.You can spend 1 minute to diffuse the power of this ammunition, removing the effects of named bullet from it and removing the mana burn. You can do this regardless of distance from it. You cannot diffuse a named bullet's power after you have already fired it.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Rain of Arrows
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 3 Marksman🏹
Tags: Su, Persistent, Upcast
Action: Standard Action
Fire a single powerful shot directly up into the air, when it falls it splits into many projectiles. The area is considered difficult terrain until the projectiles cease. Creatures in the area takes 4d8+LvL (18+LvL) damage (reflex halves).Upcast - For each additional mana spent, deal an additional d8 (4) dmg and increase the duration of the effect by 1 round.

techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.title: Reactive Shot
techniques/martial-techniques/marksman/l.description:
Level 3 Marksman🏹
Tags: Su, Concentration Action: Standard
Mark an area with a glowing circle and take aim. Until the end of your next turn, you can automatically make a simple Ranged Attack against any creature that moves into, within or out of the area, only firing a shot 1/turn. Such attacks deal an additional d8 (4) dmg.The attacks must still be within range of a ranged weapon you wield, and you must have a method of reloading after each shot.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Bond of Protection
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 1 Protector🛡
Tags: Su, Dismissible Action: StandardYou siphon your allies' pain into your own body with this bond. While your ally is within 100 feet of you, you take half of their hp damage (with odd numbers, round so you receive more damage) applying resistances and DR as usual. This technique can defeat you. You cannot take more damage than you have hp (ie if you have 1 hp and your bond takes 100 dmg, they take 99, you take 1).

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Boost!
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 1 Protector🛡 Tags: - Action: Instant
An ally can walk into a space you occupy to use a shield you wield as a springboard. You give them a jump action with additional movement and height equal to your natural reach. If they are a larger size than you, then you need to possess exceptional strength or carry weight to do this.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: It's Time to Duel!
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 1 Protector🛡 Tags: - Action: Swift
You issue a challenge towards the target to engage in an honorable duel. You and the target are taunted by each other until they deal damage to you, you deal damage to them, or the spell ends.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Sanctuary
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 1 Protector🛡
Tags: Su Action: Standard
Affected creature cannot be targeted by harmful effects such as spells or attacks. The creature can still be affected by things that are AoE, they just can't be directly affected by hostile actions.If the target takes aggressive actions, the effect ends.A creature who has been affected by this technique cannot have it used on them again for 1 round.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Crossed the Line
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 2 Protector🛡
Tags: Su, Concentration Action: Standard
You create a visible line on the ground within that serves as a warning for your enemies. When an enemy steps into a space your line is in, or otherwise "crosses" it, you can move 30 ft closer to them elusive and make an AoO against them as an instant action, as though they moved out of your threatened spaces.Even if you run out of AoOs, you can still take the movement as often as enemies walk through the line.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Elemental Barrier
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 2 Protector🛡
Tags: Buff, Su Action: Standard
You brace yourself against incoming elemental damage. Choose a damage type (other than true, slash, crush or pierce). Any ally within 10 feet of you gains resistance to that damage type.Multiple creatures using elemental barrier can overlap to grant more resistances.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Shield Slam
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 2 Protector🛡 Tags: -
Action: Special AttackSpecial: This special attack can be made as an attack of opportunity. It doesn't consume the special attack on your turn.
Slam your opponent with a shield adding d8 (4) dmg and one of the following on-hit effects. Inflict clumsy 2 Reduce a creatures speed to 0 until the start of their next turn Apply grounded for 1 turn

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Barrier
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 3 Protector🛡
Tags: Su, Concentration Action: Standard
Erect a transparent barrier that blocks movement and Line of Effect. These effects only apply to enemies and allies can freely attack and move through the barrier.
The barrier can be harmed, and has 5+(2*LvL) hp. It can also be broken with Brute Force (DC 30). When its hp is depleted or a creature otherwise breaks it, the barrier shatters completely. Unless the ability/attack in question is a siege weapons or it specifically mentions it destroys structures/barriers, like Calamity, the entirety of the attack is negated. In such cases, these attacks can target creatures on the other side of a barrier, but must deal enough damage to break through it to actually harm their intended target.
