TL;DR - If the ability doesn't mention the ability to destroy structures, then pretend it is a real wall. Even if it shatters as a result of the attack, attacks and AoE effects without a duration are halted along this barrier and to not "spill over" when the barrier is broken.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Forbidden
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 3 Protector🛡
Tags: Su, Concentration Action: StandardMark a 30 ft line along the ground within range. A line of transparent symbols or shields appears to mark that area. If any creature walks through the barrier or tries to travel over or under it, their movement is halted and they are unable to pass through for 1 round (will negates).This line must be placed horizontally, parallel to the ground.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Self-Sacrifice
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 3 Protector🛡
Tags: Su Action: ImmediateWhen a creature in range is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw, you can use this technique to transfer the wounds, as well as any other effects, to you instead of the target. You are affected as if you were hit by the attack or failed the saving throw, taking all the damage and suffering all of the adverse effects. Any resistances you have are applied normally, but you cannot otherwise reduce or negate the damage or effects in any way.If you use this technique against an effect that also targets you or includes you in its area, you suffer the effects for both yourself and the target you spared, potentially taking damage or suffering other consequences twice.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Peace Bound
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 4 Protector🛡
Tags: Su Action: SwiftYou cause a creature to internally struggle when harming creatures (will negates). Whenever it deals damage, it deals half damage. Whenever it inflicts a harmful effect that doesn't deal damage, the DC is decreased by 4.The caster also suffers this debuff while the technique persists.This effect ends if the creature spends 1 round doing nothing.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Shield Hero
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 4 Protector🛡
Tags: Prepared, Su Action: -While this technique is prepared, you can cause phantom shields to appear in between your allies and incoming attacks.You can use shield actions on any allies within 60 ft of you. You gain a new shield action.
Shield Heroism (immediate) - Reduce the damage of an incoming effect by your LvL.Note: For tower shield's tank up action, you can choose to provide the cover from any position within 60 ft of you in any direction.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Blessing of the Protector
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 5 Protector🛡
Tags: Healing, Recharge, Mana Burn Action: Standard
Bestow a protective barrier on your ally. They gain Divine Shield and 30 Temp HP.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Shine
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 5 Protector🛡
Tags: Su Action: Immediate
This ability can only be activated in response to being targeted by ranged attack. Automatically negate it and have them reroll the attack, targeting themselves with the full effect.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Guardian Angel
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 6 Protector🛡
Tags: Buff, Light, Su Action: Standard
You radiate bright light within 30 ft and a tether forms between you and any allies in the aura. You take half the damage for any ally within this aura, applying any DR and resistance you have as normal. For odd numbers, you knock off a point, lucky you.

techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.title: Stand United
techniques/martial-techniques/protector/.description:
Level 6 Protector🛡
Tags: Healing, Recharge, Concentration, Teleportation, Su Action: ImmediateIn response to an ally being harmed you can immediately grant them 30 temporary hp, increasing to 50 if they are below half hp.You must continue to actively concentrate on this ability to maintain this temp hp. If you maintain concentration for 1 full round, you can teleport adjacent to this ally as an instant action.
This ability can be used over any distance, however, you must still have some means of knowing when an ally is within danger, such as Sending or Hive Mind.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Fired Up
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 1 Pupper
Tags: Fire, Healing Action: SwiftYou coat your hand in fire and deal 2 fire damage to an ally (other than yourself) as you slap it on the back.
You can remove any condition that can reasonably be melted away, such as getting entangled by Pin Down or the creature is Frosty.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Inheritor's Smite
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 2 Pupper
Tags: Holy, Upcast
Action: Special Attack
Your attack does an additional d10 (5) holy damage. If the creature has weakness to holy damage, it also takes the attacks damage as poise damage. If this poise breaks them, they are knocked down.Upcast - For each additional mana spent, increase damage by d10 (5).

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Haste
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 3 Pupper
Tags: Su, Buff Action: StandardCreate a brief figment of a cute pupper to fill your allies with determination. Affected creatures have their speed increased by 20.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Bladed Decimation
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 4 Pupper
Tags: Teleportation, Su Action: StandardRapidly teleport forward in small increments, briefly leaving behind after images. Move in one direction 30 ft. You can attack ANY creature that is within your reach at any point along this line. Deal an extra 3d8 (13) dmg on all your attacks.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Flash Forward
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 4 Pupper
Tags: Teleportation
Action: FRA, Special Attack
Charge with a twist: You teleport back to your starting position at the end of your turn. The first attack you land during this charge deals an additional 3d8 (13) dmg.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Extreme Speed
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 6 Pupper
Tags: Recharge, Elusive Action: SwiftMove to somewhere you have line of sight to.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Fan of Knives
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 1 Scoundrel
Tags: Prepared Action: -You always have 2 non-magical light weapons on your person with the thrown property. They are in your voluminous hair, fat folds or keistered in less comfortable places...You can draw these weapons as a free action any number of times each turn if your hands are empty.Gain access to the following special attack, usable any number of times per combat. Fan of Knives - Throw up to 3 knives at up to 3 creatures within 10 feet of each other. Ignore attack penalties from attacking creatures in the second range increment.You also always have thieves tools in your back pocket, in the form of a single lockpick.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Heart Seeker
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 1 Scoundrel
Tags: Su Action: Swift
Take the hide action. While you do, you can feel the pulsing heartbeat of your foes. Gain +blindsense (Lifesense 10 ft) until you exit combat or exit stealth.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Poison Jab
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 1 Scoundrel
Tags: Recharge Action: Free
Apply a Toxin to your weapon. Usable 1/turn.

techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.title: Shadow Step
techniques/martial-techniques/scoundrel/.description:
Level 3 Scoundrel
Tags: Teleportation Action: FreeNote:
This ability must be used in space of Dim Light or Darkness.Place a symbol on the ground. You can teleport back to this spot as an immediate action at any point until the start of your next turn.
If no creatures have line of sight of you when you teleport back, immediately hide.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Resonating Strike
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 3 Unarmed👊
Tags: Elusive, Sonic
Action: Special Attack
Unleash a sonic blast at a creature as though using a thrown weapon attack that deals your Unarmed Attack damage as sonic damage. This attack has Seeking. On-hit, as long as that creature stays within 60 ft of you, you know it's exact position and gain seeking against it until the end of your next turn.
At any point before the end of your next turn, you can spend an immediate action to dash to their location and to make an simple unarmed strike against them.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Ora Aura
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 5 Unarmed👊
Tags: Buff Action: FreeRapidly unleash a flurry of punches in all directions all the time. A creature that moves into, out of or ends their turn in your natural reach is automatically attacked with an unarmed strike as an instant action, though only once per turn.

classes/martial-artist/martial-artist.ht.title: Martial Artist
classes/martial-artist/martial-artist.ht.description:
Many warriors fight with weapons or spells, but some choose to make their own body the ultimate weapon. Through grit, asceticism or flashy techniques, a martial artist's combat prowess shines without the aid of arms or armor.You have Martial Specialization You gain 1 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the unarmed👊 or barbarism💢 trees.
Gain the Unarmed Combatant feat.
You are considered to be wearing medium armor for the purposes of determining your AC. Gain 6 poise. Functions only while not wearing armor and not wielding a shield.
Make 2 attacks, one of which must be an Unarmed Attack.
Make a simple unarmed attack as a swift action. It does half damage.
+5 Land Speed per level. You can use the Jump action 1/turn as a free action. You can jump an unlimited number of times when you dash. You can dash as as swift action. Functions only while not wearing armor and not wielding a shield.Choose one from the subsection

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Power Lifter
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 4 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Su, Prepared Action: -
The Cataclysm🌋 infuses you with the power of LIFT, drastically increasing your carrying capacity. Multiply your carry weight by 2,000.
The following special attack can be used at will.
Heavy Artillery - You can throw an object weighing at least 1 ton to deal 3d12+Str (16+str) dmg, defaulting to crush dmg. This counts as a +Siege Weapon.

bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.title: Amorphous
bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.description:
In order to crit the creature, you must exceed its AC by a value higher than 10.Example:
Amorphous - +15

bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.title: Fast Healing
bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.description:
Tags: Healing
The creature gains specified amount of hp the start of their turn if they are not defeated. When the creature is defeated, this ability is disabled for 10 minutes (see prevent recovery for means to keep those pesky healers down).
If a creature with FH is Bleeding, roll a luck check (DC 10) to see if the bleeding stops at the end of their turns.

bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.title: Ferocity
bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.description:
When the creature is reduced to zero hit points, they are not defeated until the end of their next turn. On said turn they are staggered. If a creature with ferocity is healed before their next turn, the creature is not defeated at the end of its next turn, and this ability is not consumed, however they are still staggered.This ability can only activate once per minute.
FH does not function while in ferocity.

bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.title: Incorporeal
bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.description: Incorporeal creatures have resistance to crush, slash and pierce damage. They cannot be targeted with a combat maneuver without special equipment or techniques. Incorporeal creatures universally have hover speeds.Incorporeal creatures can pass through physical objects, but cannot end their turn inside of one. This allows them to ignore cover bonuses and more easily hide.

bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.title: Regeneration
bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.description:
The creature regains a specified amount of +HP at the start of their turn and ends all bleed effects before taking damage. This healing is capable of restoring lost limbs over a few days, or instantly if the limb is reattached. At the start of this creature's turn it loses the defeated condition, restores HP, and the creature is staggered instead of dazed.All forms of regeneration have some means to stop it (typically for 1 round), usually taking a specific type of damage.
If a creature is defeated while its regeneration is disabled, it is unable to regenerate for 10 minutes (see prevent recovery for other means to keep those pesky healers down).

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Attach
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description: When the creature grapples another creature it instead of the target becomes Entangled, typically due to its smaller size. Creatures with the attached property typically have special abilities that can only be used while attached.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Constrict
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description: When the creature succeeds on a grapple check, they automatically deal damage from a specified attack form. Every turn they maintain the grapple they also do this effect.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Engulf
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description: When the creature succeeds on a grapple check they can engulf the target. The target gains the entombed condition. Usually the creature can take no action other than to use Breakout to escape.Allies can use athletics to pull you out or poise break the creature to set you free.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Swallow
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description:
After successfully grappling a creature, the creature can choose to swallow its prey if it is at least one size category larger. The prey maintains Entangled condition and the swallowing creature doesn't need to take any actions to maintain the grapple. The prey gains total cover and takes a specified amount of damage the turn it is swallowed immediately and at the end of the swallowed creatures turn thereafter.
A creature cannot use its swallow quality while sickened 2 or higher. Becoming sickened 2 causes it to vomit any swallowed creatures.The prey escapes automatically when the swallowing creature is defeated.
A creature can also reasonably swallow a creature it defeats with a bite or tongue attack.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Aura
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description:
Tags: Su A creature has the ability to generate an area of effect surrounding them. Most are passive, some require activation.
All auras are persistent effects, meaning creature can only be affected by a negative aura once per round.
Creatures are immune to the effects of their own auras.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Breath Weapon
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description:
Tags: Su The creature has the ability to use a supernatural area of effect attack. Common forms include lines and cones of elemental damage.
Most breath weapons are recharge effects that have some condition to use them again.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Deathrattle
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description: An effect happens when the creature is defeated or dies (but not both), requiring no action. This typically involves exploding or releasing toxic gases.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Gaze
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description:
Tags: Su Merely by looking at another creature nearby, they can inflict some kind of effect. The gaze automatically happen to all creatures within a specific range.Anybody combating a creature with a gaze attack has a few options to try and negate it, made when they first are affected by the gaze attack.
They can choose to close their eyes (instant action), giving themselves the blinded condition until the start of their next turn, making them immune gaze attacks.
Alternatively they can choose to avert their gaze, giving them blurred vision and advantage on saves against gaze attacks. Gaze attacks can be avoided entirely by looking at the creature through a proxy, like a reflective surface.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Multiattack
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description: A creature can make multiple attacks with their standard action (or when they charge or something similar). There are often limitations to what they can use these attacks for and how many they can make.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Powerful Charge
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description: The creature gets a +2 bonus to Attack during any turn they make a Charge.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Rend
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description:
Whenever the creature lands the listed attacks (including if the attack poise breaks the creature), they inflict an additional effect, usually damage.Example
Rend - Two claws (2d6)

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Summon Ally
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description: Tags: Companion, Su Summon a lesser creature. Can potentially summon multiple creature at once.Can also grant other bonuses to summoned creatures, in addition to the companion boost to attack.

bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.title: Trample
bestiary/monster-qualities/offense-trait.description: Creature can move around through other creatures spaces. As a FRA a creature can move its speed+15, or double that speed in a straight line. It harms all creatures along its path, dealing damage and inflicting Knockdown. Creatures can choose to either AoO or make a reflex save for half damage and negate the knockdown.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: +Blindsense
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description:
This creature has extraordinary senses that allows it to sense the presence of creatures without sight. A creature with blind sense has +4 bonus on +Perception👀 against a creature to which its blindsense applies. The creature automatically receives a perception check with no penalty when a creature enters this range, even while naturally asleep, and automatically wakes up if it senses something.
A successful perception check indicates the creature has "locked on" and identified the space the creature is in. They gain Seeking against any creature "locked on." Once a creature with blind sense has "locked on" to a creature, it stays detected until it leaves the creature's blindsense range, or the creatures blind sense is disabled.
A creature with blind sense can detect hidden presence as a free action once per turn, but only the affecting the range of its blind sense.Blind sense relies on a specific sense (mentioned in the ability), usually hearing or scent, but can also include things like detecting life (with undead creatures), or feeling tremors in the ground/water. Blind sense can circumstantially be negated, based on the source.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Darkvision
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description: You can see in complete Darkness. Treat any form of darkness as Bright Light. Everything in darkness is grayscale.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Echolocation
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description: Sound based. A creature that takes sonic damage has their echolocation disabled for one round.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Greensight
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description:
Tags: Su
Can see through any form of vegetation. Creatures cannot use vegetation as a source of cover to hide against a creature with greensight.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Lifesense
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description: Tags: Su Functions against living creatures. Undead, constructs (and other similar not really alive) creatures cannot be detected with life sense.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Nightvision
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description: You treat Dim Light as Bright Light. You treat Darkness as Dim Light. Everything in darkness is grayscale.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Scent
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description:
Uses a creature sense of smell. Aquatic creatures can only use this underwater. Amphibious creatures can use it in water or land. If you have an item with a creatures scent on it, you get a +2 bonus on survival checks to track them.
Scents can be remembered similarly to how you can recognize someone's voice. Creatures with scent automatically get a +Perception👀 check (vs +Disguise) against someone impersonating a creature they are very close to.
A creature that is sickened cannot use scent.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Sightless Blindsense
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description:
In the absence of sight, blindsense is enhanced. The usual methods for preventing blindsense (sickened with super scent) from functioning impose partial concealment on all creatures that their blindsense cannot negate until the condition is removed.
Creatures with sightless blindsense instead get a +8 bonus to +Perception👀 when blindsense applies and its range is usually higher.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Thoughtsense
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description:
Tags: Su
Functions against intelligent creatures. Mindless creatures cannot be detected with thought sense. A creature that is shaken cannot use thought sense.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Tremorsense
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description:
Vibration based. Aquatic creatures can use this underwater. Amphibious creatures can use it in water or land. Only functions if the creature (and any creatures it is attempting to detect) is in direct contact with a physical surface (or continuous body of water).
A creature that is clumsy cannot use tremorsense.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Amphibious
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description: Amphibious creatures can exist comfortably on land or underwater, including the ability to breathe underwater or the ability to hold their breath for long periods of time.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Camouflage
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description: Creature can use stealth to Hide without Cover or concealment. Cannot be used while being directly observed.May come with other conditions for use.

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Compression
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description: You are able to move through spaces designed for creatures 1 size smaller than you without treating it as difficult terrain. You are able to move through spaces designed for creatures 2 sizes smaller than you by treating it as difficult terrain

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Hide in Plain Sight
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description:
Creature has the ability to hide from creatures while standing perfectly still by pretending to be an inanimate object or changing colors. If the creature is already being observed, or enemies have already been surprised by the creature using this ability recently, then it does not function.
Typically creatures do not get a +Perception👀 check to see a creature that is hiding in plain sight until they go out of their way to inspect the nearby area, or the hiding creature acts.
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.sourcePath: Bestiary/Monster Qualities/Other Traits/Hide in Plain Sight.md

bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.title: Telepathy
bestiary/monster-qualities/other-traits/.description: Tags: Su The creature can speak directly into the minds of other creatures it can see. A creature must have an intelligence score of at least -2 in order to be telepathically communicated with. A creature can telepathically project its thoughts to several creatures in the nearby vicinity, even if it cannot see them.Once a creature initiates a telepathic conversation, the other creature can communicate back using telepathy. The creature that initiated the telepathic conversation can choose to end it whenever they wish.

bestiary/monster-qualities/boss.html.title: Boss
bestiary/monster-qualities/boss.html.description: These creatures are distinct in that they command a certain degree of authority or power. Bosses are not always unique enemies, but there is a overlap. Bosses have significant boosts to their action economy. They get a handful of other bonuses as well.+Monster Lore📖 is particularly helpful against bosses. As part of a successful monster lore check, a character also learns any special mechanics of a boss creature, something more involved to defeat it. Think like a video game boss fight where you need to break its armor before you can get to the weak spot.

classes/barbarian/barbarian.html.title: Barbarian
classes/barbarian/barbarian.html.description:
Throw caution to the wind and run directly into the middle of the action. The barbarian specializes in drawing aggro and CCing enemies with a high emphasis on breaking poise. Their exceptionally high longevity assures that being focused is the only reliable way to take them down, and that’s exactly what barbarians want.You have Martial Specialization. You gain 1 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the Unarmed👊 or Barbarism💢 trees.
As an instant action, enter rage. While raging you increase your STR by +1.
While raging you can't do anything with the concentration tag or cast spells. You cannot use WIS, INT, CHA or DEX based skills aside from +Perception👀, +Intimidation😱 and +Acrobatics⚖.You can end your rage preemptively as a free action. When your rage ends (see wrath feature below), you are fatigued for 1 minute and cannot rage again until the minute passes (even if the fatigue is removed or negated).Your rage not only gives you strength and resilience, but further empowers you as your frustration grows. When you enter rage, you start off with (½ lvl) wrath, and get an additional stack of wrath every time you...
Take +HP or Poise damage (but not more than once an attack)
Miss an Attack or fail to break a creatures poise
Fail an opposed skill check You gain a bonus equal to your wrath stacks to... The poise damage you deal Your athletics bonus by your stacks of wrath.
The distance you can Shove or Drag someone
You can only maintain wrath while not wearing armor and only during combat, or other minigames like arm wrestling contests and chases. You cannot accumulate/maintain wrath when you are not in such a scenario.Note: I'm not a lawyer, so my writing is probably not without loopholes. The basic idea is to only accumulate wrath in dramatic situations. You should not be able to farm wrath by having a bunch of squires poke a barbarian for a few minutes before going into a battle.Never let your players abuse mechanics in a way that feels like exploiting the system, especially if it soils the fun.
Make an attack and a combat maneuver👐.
+10 land speed.
You have resistance to physical damage (ie slash, crush, pierce). You ignore the effects of extreme temperatures and other similar insignificant environmental effects. Only functions when you do not wear armor.Gain a rage power this level and levels 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10.
Creatures cannot flank you.You take half damage from fortitude saves. When you pass a fort save, it deals no damage and has no additional effect.
Every time you take hp or poise damage from an enemy, take note of it. The 4th instance of damage you take provokes an AoO from the creature that dealt it. If you do not threaten the creature, attack a random creature within reach. If no creature is within reach, you can make a thrown attack if you have a free hand or wield a thrown weapon. If you can do none of these things, increase your speed by 30 next turn.This counter resets when you roll initiative.Break your body against your enemy for increased effectiveness. As a free action, gain +2 attack for 1 round, but every attack roll you make during this round deals 5 true damage to you.Strength granted by rage increases from +1 to +2. You are no longer fatigued after ending rage. You can start or stop raging as a free action once per turn.

classes/bard/bard.html.title: Bard
classes/bard/bard.html.description:
Carry your party, your town, or perhaps even the whole world with inspiring tunes. Bards excel when in the middle of their team jamming away to buff their allies and bother their enemies. They also excel at manipulating others, some through clever wordplay or song, and others through magic.You have Magical Specialization You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the Shroomlette🍄, Moogen (T)👁 or Shira💋 trees.
You get proficiency in the +Profession🧑‍🌾 (musician) skill and a +4 bonus to all related checks. You can use this profession skill to make +History checks. When you make a history check using profession, you need to spend 1 minute to sing the song while playing an instrument to jog your memory.You can make these checks and generate music without an instrument by making the required movements, but you take a -4 penalty. Doing so always takes at least one hand to perform.You can use instruments as the staff component to your spell casting, but you cannot use imaginary instruments.With a week of downtime, you can create a new song and spread it across the land. The take away of a song can usually boil down to into a single phrase such as "the forest houses a dangerous witch" or "Ragnar the Red has been slain." Most messages tend to catch on quickly, unless they directly oppose common sentiments or are outright lies: The aforementioned examples wouldn’t work well if the witch is friendly or Ragnar is still kicking.The overall effect of the song is to affect the general sentiment towards specific topics or to diffuse basic information. For example, you could spread heroic tales of your adventure to let people know a deadly beast is dead. A dangerous cult could be lurking in a city and you warn the people to avoid people with a specific symbol on them.When you replace songs using your companion slots, they might not be the talk of the town anymore, being regularly performed on the streets, but they might not be forgotten. If you do a large scale organized event in the area where your song is a hit, you can make one last perform check to see if it sticks for good. See below for DCs.The distance this song spreads is dependent on your level. ## 1 - Bardic Performance (Su) (recharge) As a swift action, play an instrument to start a performance for 1 minute. After the minute passes or after using a finale, you cannot activate bardic performance again for 1 minute.Performances affect all creatures within 30 ft of you, specifying either allies or enemies. You can change the type of performance that you're doing as a swift action. A creature that steps within the radius of a performance, gains its benefit/penalties for one round, even if it only exists in it briefly.As a standard action, you can immediately end your performance to perform some kind of powerful action called a finale. Any allies that are within the area of your bardic performance before you perform your finale still gain its benefit for that round.The types of performances and finales a bard has is based on archetype.When you succeed on a save against a charm effect, the creature who inflicted it is charmed by you for the effects usual duration.
By burning 1 mana as an immediate action, you can allow a creature within 30 ft to add d6 to a d20 roll (minus a Luck Check). @6 increase to d8 @11 increase to d10As a swift action, increase the effectiveness of bardic performance for 1 round. If it targets allies, double the numerical bonuses of a bardic performance. If it targets enemies, increase the DC by 2.Usable once per performance.

classes/bender/archetypes/airbender/airb.title: Airbender
classes/bender/archetypes/airbender/airb.description:
Your damage is crush. In order to use Su class abilities, some form of open air must be present within 30 ft range. This is usually only a problem in space or while submerged in liquid.You can walk just above the ground giving you a hover speed. You can gently fall downwards to avoid fall damage as long as your speed isn't 0. If you want to hover while it is not your turn, it has the concentration tag.When you move at least 30 feet on your turn, attacks have 20% miss chance against you until the start of your next turn. Creatures that miss you with attacks as a result of this become clumsy 1.I usually go "high roll leads to best result" for these types of features, so a 9 or 10 on a d10.You can physically manipulate air within 30 ft. Unlike water and earth, air cannot create structures, nor can it lift enormous quantities of matter. You can manipulate unattended objects weighing up to (10*lvl) lbs, moving them anywhere within range, including into your hands. Like with all bending, it rewards creativity and allows you to do anything gusts of wind could reasonably do, like allowing you to jump as high and far as you can move automatically or slowing the fall of creatures in a 10x10 area.Initiating and maintaining concentration on air bending requires a standard action each turn.
You've learned how to utilize gliding technology to allow you to fly. A glider requires 50g of wood and canvas and 8 hours to make. You gain a fly speed equal to your Land Speed while using this glider. Using a glider requires one hand.
Jumping using airbending no longer requires concentration.By spending a standard action to concentrate each turn, you can fly by creating a whirlwind underneath you, even without a glider. You are limited to flying 30 ft high like this. Each round you concentrate to fly like this you also remove all clumsy stacks.
You do not provoke AoOs by taking flight. When you fly you take no penalty to speed for flying up at a 45 degree or higher angle and can do so while clumsy. When flying you are capped at clumsy 2. If you take flight while clumsy 3 or higher, it decreases to clumsy 2.When a creature gets clumsy as a result of wind stance, they also take 15 poise damage.
When you are flying at least 15 ft higher than a creature, you get +2 attack against them.You can fly without the aid of gliding technology. You cannot be made clumsy while flying. Your fly speed is your land speed+20.

headers.heading: 1 - Elemental Intuition: Airbending concentration

classes/bender/archetypes/earthbender/ea.title: Earthbender
classes/bender/archetypes/earthbender/ea.description:
Your damage is crush. In order to use (Su) class abilities, you must be standing on the ground and some form of earth (rock, sand, dirt, even mud) must be present within 30 ft range.Burrow but it works in stone, lava (which still hurts you without resistance or adaptation) and more! You move at a speed 10.Gain 5 poise. Reduce all poise damage by your level.You can physically manipulate earth within 30 ft. Bending as a whole allows for a great deal of creativity, but shouldn’t affect objects of a size greater than one 5ft cube per level. Quickly moving rubble and creating stone bridges are some examples of things that you can do. Concentration with this ability requires a standard action each round. When you cease concentration, structures you made collapse and rocks you're lifting fall.
You gain +Blindsense, Tremorsense 30 ft. In general you are more sensitive to vibrations caused by things like earthquakes, stampedes, explosions and crumbling buildings, even if they aren't within 30 ft. This cannot function in water, even if you are amphibious.You no longer need to concentrate in order to maintain the structures that you create with earthbending. You treat metal as earth for all class features.
When a creature fails to break your poise, you can bully them as an immediate action as long as they are within 30 ft.After 1 minute of concentration, you can stomp the ground to get a better view of things around you, and under you. You see the overall shape of structures and their interiors, as well as all creatures and objects of anything within 300 ft of the point of contact, so long as there is a continuous stream of earth.
While blinded, your tremorsense improves to sightless blindsense. Its range increases to 120 ft. At the start of your turn as a free action, you can choose to blind yourself until the start of your next turn.

classes/bender/archetypes/firebender/fir.title: Firebender
classes/bender/archetypes/firebender/fir.description:
Your damage is fire.Increase Land Speed by 10.
Gain resistance to fire and frost damage.You can physically manipulate fire within 30 ft. Unlike water and earth, fire cannot create structures, nor can it lift enormous quantities of matter. You can ignite objects as well as move or snuff out flames of (5 ft cube per lvl). By touching objects, you can drastically increase their temperature or absorb extreme heat.Initiating and maintaining concentration on fire bending requires a standard action each turn.
You can decrease your speed by 30 to add your Level to damage on the next (Su) ability from the bender class that deals fire or zap damage this turn. This has a distinct audio and visual effect that imposes -10 penalty to stealth.Your blast or elemental wave damage can deal fire or zap damage interchangeably. You gain resistance to zap damage. You can manipulate the flow of electricity similar to how you can manipulate fire.By spending 1 mana, you can use fire bending techniques from your mouth instead of hands or feet. Reduce elemental wave's mana cost by 1. Your elemental wave becomes a 60 ft line or 30 ft cone when used from the mouth.
As a swift action, increase your speed by 30 for one round. During this turn you gain a fly speed. At the end of your turn, you plummet.
Your flames change color. Fire damage you deal ignore fire resistance.

classes/bender/archetypes/waterbender/wa.title: Waterbender
classes/bender/archetypes/waterbender/wa.description:
Your damage is crush. In order to use Su class abilities, a gallon of water (even ice) must be present within 30 ft range. Using less turns blast and other Su attacks into a FRA. Many waterbenders carry vessels like pouches for use away from oceans, rivers or glaciers.Gain a Swim speed equal to your Land Speed+(5*LvL) ft. You can use this swim speed to surf across water's or ice's surface. You take no Fall Damage when falling into water if you can move.
You can take any of the shield actions. You can use endure and shield bash. You can use the Buckler parry feature. You only need water to perform these maneuvers.You can physically manipulate water (including ice) within 30 ft. Bending as a whole allows for a great deal of creativity, but shouldn’t affect objects of a size greater than one 5ft cube per level. Redirecting water flow and creating temporary air bubbles to hide in water sources are some examples of things that you can do. Concentration with this ability requires a standard action each round. When you cease concentration, flow you redirect stops and water you are lifting falls.You can also use all waterbending based abilities using water adjacent substances, such as fruit juice, blood or perfume. This does not include liquids of other substances, such as acids, poisons, mercury, lava etc.You can use your elemental blast to deal cold damage or crush damage interchangeably. In general, you can use water, even moisture in the air, to decrease the temperature of things, such as to freeze metal to make it more brittle.You no longer need to concentrate in order to maintain structures created by water bending.
You can carry large quantities of water with you using waterbending in order to fuel your abilities. Doing so for longer than 10 minutes without resting for 1 minute inflicts fatigue.
Your natural reach increases during your turn by 5 ft this level and every level thereafter (max 30). You can retrieve and hold objects, including wielding weapons.
You gain resistance to Frost damage. You can "swim" through ice as easily as water.You can use water walking on land with access to a 5x5x5 cube of water. Don't let your water dry up!

classes/lunatic/lunatic.html.title: Lunatic
classes/lunatic/lunatic.html.description:
Trust in the power of Frogg Saran🐸. He's playing multi-dimensional 4D chess on a cosmic scale the likes of which you cannot comprehend. You need only to enact his will and you will be rewarded accordingly. To the moon!The lunatic has a spell list filled with spells that have very inconsistent results. On top of that, every time a lunatic casts a spell, there is a chance that he receives a blessing from Frogg in the form of wild magic, further adding more unpredictable variables to their spell casting.Lunatics simultaneously have access to every single spell school, and do not prepare spells. Instead they can choose any spell to memorize permanently whenever they gain a memory slot. Additional technique points gained through natural progression or otherwise grant additional memory slots.
You can also choose martial techniques, but they consume 2 memory slots.@Lvl 1 they can only select level 1 techniques. @Lvl 3 they can select up to level 2 techniques etc.
In addition, they get 6 +Cantrips and always memorize all Frogg Saran (T)🐸 techniques of spell levels they can cast.
You can Innately Cast Metronome.
By embracing his will you have little need for your own. Instead of taking a penalty to your will saves based on your negative WIS, you gain a bonus (-2 wis=+2 will). Instead of gaining a bonus to your will save based off of your positive wisdom, you gain a penalty (+2 wis=-2 will). Decrease your wisdom by 1.
Gain 10 Frogg Saran🐸 GBP.
You gain resistance to psychic damage.Whenever a creature attempts to read your thoughts, it fails. When a creature attempts to read your thoughts or deals psychic damage to you, they take 2d6+lvl (7+lvl) psychic damage.
Whenever you roll a natural 1 on a D20, gain a luck dice. The first time you are harmed by one of your own spells in a combat, gain a luck dice.
If you use anything to Reroll a natural one, or have advantage and don't roll multiple 1s, you do not gain a luck dice. You can have an unlimited number of luck dice. With many saved up you hum/glow with power. At the start of each day if you have zero luck dice, gain one.
Whenever you cast a (non cantrip) spell, roll a DC 5 luck check. If you fail, roll on the wild magic table for a bonus effect. Every time you pass this luck check, increase the DC by 2. When wild magic triggers, reset the DC back to 5. Triggering wild magic is the only way to reduce the DC of this luck check.The effect always triggers after the casting of the spell has been resolved.Roll a d8+1. This number permanently becomes your lucky number. Whenever you roll this number on a d20, you gain a luck dice and you treat the result as 10 higher.
You are blessed! Gain the Pet feat with the following stipulations. Your pet must always be a frog or frog-like creature.
It only has 2 adaptation points🧬, but automatically gets the tongue ability.
Whenever your frog rolls a 5 or lower on an Attack Roll, it triggers Wild Magic, affecting the target of the attack instead of itself. It can shrink to tiny size. Changing to tiny or increasing in size back to the usual as a swift action. Every even level you can replace one of your spells known with another spell. By donating 1,000 gold to a frog, you can instantly replace a spell known 1/day.
You have advantage on skill checks and serendipity checks as long as nobody is watching you.As an immediate action, spend a luck dice to force a creature casting a spell within 30 feet of you to roll on the wild magic table. Usable 1/minute without spending a luck dice.You say a lot of weird things, but sometimes trapped in the madness is a grain of truth. Once per game session, you can will practically anything to be true, though how true it is varies. First you make your intention to the DM to be known."I'm good friends with the royalty in this town.""There is a secret entrance into the base through this cave.""There's someone on the other side of this door" right before you blow it up.How true it becomes depends on what the bronze senses are tingling over. Being friends with royalty is unlikely, so its much more likely you're friends with the banished prince. There may just be a secret entrance through the cave, but the tunnel has since collapsed, only allowing the smallest of creatures inside. Someone being directly on the other side of a door is context based, but in the right scenario could possibly catch your enemies off guard.

classes/slayer/slayer.html.title: Slayer
classes/slayer/slayer.html.description:
The Slayer revels in combat. He is hard to kill, mobile and has an arsenal unlike any other. He is powerful from a range, but his enemies shudder in fear when he is even close due to his ability to swiftly finish any fights he started with glorious displays of power and gore. With a handful of supernatural abilities, firepower and superhuman strength, the Slayer is a force to be reckoned with.You have Martial Specialization. You gain 0 technique points, not usable in any martial tree. You won't need them.You can ignore the 2h property of any weapon, but the base damage decreases to d8
You add STR instead of DEX to attack/dmg for all weapons created by Energy (bigger str means bigger gun)
+10 Land Speed
Gain the +Athletics🏊 skill with a +4 bonus
+2 attack, increasing to +4 against fiends👿.
You can automatically jump as high and as far as you can move.
You are immune to fall damage.
You gain the unarmed combatant and point blank master feats.
You can sense weakness in your enemies. Whenever a creature you can see is at or below an hp total equal to (9+lvl), you know. When a creature within 30 feet is at this threshold, you can spend an immediate action to dash with incredible speeds to reach it (in a straight line, even if it is airborne, if you can't fly you fall) and make an unarmed strike against it. On-hit it instantly defeats the creature. If the creature isn't a Minion, you regain 1 mana💎 and you heal (3+LvL) hp.If you so choose, though is completely unnecessary, you can brutally and spectacularly execute whatever creature you just targeted with this ability and they die...Horribly (fort negates). Killing a creature in such a way always results in some amazing feat of strength, agility and a disturbing creativity in the Slayer’s brutality.If this threshold happens to be equal to or larger than the health pool possessed by the creature, you can still use this ability even though they have taken no damage.
You can manifest a powerful double barrel shotgun with a creative attachment. Manifesting the gun is the same as the Swap Item action. Merely holding the gun does not require mana, but each shot requires 1 mana, completely ignoring the reloading process. Other abilities also cost 1 mana unless otherwise stated. The weapon stats are as follows…DMG - 2d8 P Properties - 2h
Range - Functions like a blunderbuss
Meat Hook - You can fire a grappling hook at a surface or creature within 30 ft to drag yourself to it as a standard action. If you target a creature, you must make a ranged attack. On-hit the target is set to 1 Poise. When you arrive adjacent to it, you can fire the shotgun or make an unarmed strike against the creature. Meat hook does not require energy.This ability functions as Old Friend, but instead of a shotgun you manifest an axe guitar with the following stats… DMG - 2d8 S Properties - 2h
Shred - Gain proficiency in +Profession🧑‍🌾 (guitar). Gain a +4 bonus when using the shredder. Riff of Rage - Give all allies within 60 ft +2 attack for 1 round (standard action) Special Attack: Finale - Declare an attack as a finale. If the attack ends the combat, future finale attacks gain +2 damage permanently. If it does not end the combat, lose 1 damage (minimum 0). A savvy foe can tell how many stacks you have.Note: Finale only stacks in actual combat, not training. You can never passively gain stacks.By spending 1 mana as a free action, move 10 feet, even directly into the air. Can be used multiple times to cover great distances.
Spend 2 mana to augment an unarmed strike that staggers the creature On-hit (fort negates). On-hit, enemies within 10 feet of the original target automatically take the attacks damage.This ability can be used in tandem with techniques.This ability functions as Old Friend, but instead of a shotgun you manifest a rifle with the following stats… DMG - 2d8 P Properties - 2h
Range - Long🏹 Zoom - As a FRA, make a single shot with 300 ft range and +2 attack.When you fall at least 20 ft, you release a shockwave in a 10 ft radius around you. If you fell at least 50 ft, the shockwave is a 20 ft radius. The effect this has depends on the target and their HP threshold.
Against enemy minions, it sets them to your Glory Kill threshold. If they are already within the Glory Kill threshold, they are defeated.
Against anything else (including allies), it deals 10 poise damage.As a free action during movement, but only once per turn, spend 3 mana to throw a supercharged ball of energy that explodes on impact on the ground, affecting all creatures within 10 ft of the space it lands in. You have 3 types of grenades
Fire - Set creatures ablaze (reflex negates).
Frag - Deal (3d6+LvL) crush damage and poise damage. If this breaks poise, the creature is Knocked Down (reflex halves damage).
Frost - Put creatures in stasis for 1 round (reflex reduces to frosty). This ability functions as Old Friend, but instead of a shotgun you manifest a hammer with the following stats… DMG - 2d8 C Properties - 2h
Horny Jail - As a standard action, automatically bonk a creature within reach to make them not horny for 1 hour. Immediately dispels any Lewd effects.
Hammer Down recharge - 1/combat, strike the ground as a standard action to deal your (d6+d6/odd level) crush dmg and make creatures clumsy 2 within 20 ft (fort halves dmg).
Plunging Attack - If you start your turn above a creature and are not flying/pseudo-flying, you can make a plunging attack. Plunging attack adds 1 damage per 10 feet you fall (max +20 dmg). Plunging attack can also apply to Hammer Down.
Your weapon attacks, natural attacks and unarmed attacks gain additional damage equal to their damage dice. Gain this benefit again at level 10. 2h weapon @1=2d8, @6=4d8, @10=6d8 Light Weapon @1=d6, @6=2d6, @10=3d6This ability functions as Old Friend, but instead of a shotgun you manifest a hand held ballista with the following stats… DMG - 2d8 P
Properties - 2h, +Siege Weapon
Range - 120 ft (no second range increment)
Special Attack: GET OVER HERE! - On-hit make a drag attack with a +4 bonus. If successful they are pulled adjacent to you, regardless of distance.
Siege Mode (recharge) - 1/combat as a FRA charge and release a horizontal slashing energy projectile. Creatures in a 100ft line that is 15 ft wide take (5d8+lvl) slashing damage and start bleeding for 2d8 damage (reflex halves damage and negates bleed). You can reduce the charge time, making this only require a standard action, but the line is only 5 ft wide.This ability functions as Old Friend, but instead of a shotgun you manifest a sword with the following stats… DMG - 2d8 S
Properties - 2h, Special Attack: determination Melt - As a standard action, cut a hole in a surface of solid or lesser toughness large enough for you to fit through with ease.
Special Attack: Sever - On-hit sever an limb from a creature, making them Drained 10 On-hit and severing a limb (fort negates severing limb). Arm - Creature is unable to use arm
Leg - Creatures Land Speed is reduced by 15. Clumsy 1 permanently.
Wing - Creature is unable to fly.
Other limbs can be selected, disabling natural attacks like tentacles and such. These are just the most common examples.
You gain combat reflexes as a bonus feat.
You can use glory kill an instant action by consuming an AoO (essentially 3 times a round unless you can AoO more somehow, or 4 if you spend an immediate action).You can only attempt to glory kill a particular creature once per round.
