core-rules,-how-to-play/ability-scores/s.title: Serendipity
core-rules,-how-to-play/ability-scores/s.description: When playing table top, a lot of things aren't well defined until they get into render distance, which basically means when players ask about it. When a situation pops up where your player asks for a specific circumstance like "Is the door to the armory locked?" "is there a hat store in town?" or "are there any footholds on the side of this cliff?" and you don't immediately have a response, the character in question rolls a luck check. If it's a general party question, or if you bring your lucky friend with you during your shopping trip, they could reasonably roll it instead.Again, if you already had an answer in mind, don't roll this. This is something that you should use in moderation. The moment you let your players start rolling this again and again is when all cohesion in your world evaporates
core-rules,-how-to-play/ability-scores/s.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Ability Scores/Serendipity.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.title: Climb
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.description: A creature with a climb speed can easily ascend or descend trees, walls buildings etc, provided there are ample places to place hands, feet etc. Creatures with climb speeds can even climb things without ample handholds using creative methods or exceptional biology in some cases (gecko, snake wrapping around).
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Action System/Movement/Climb.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.title: Glide
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.description: While not movement impaired, take no fall damage. When falling, move horizontally 5 feet per 1 foot fallen at a speed of 60.
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Action System/Movement/Glide.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.title: Land Speed
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.description:
Land speed refers to the generic speed most creatures use to walk around.Default ground movement speed is 30. race🏁, +Class, Equipment, and Status can change this. Some actions grant extra speed.
You may have other forms of movement that manifest in terms of different Speeds - you may use multiple forms of movement on the same turn, but only up to the maximum amount for the given speed. Any slower speeds used overlap - That is, if you have a Fly 40 and a ground speed of 30, you may walk 30 feet and then fly another 10.
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Action System/Movement/Land Speed.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.title: Swim
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.description:
Creatures with a swim speed take no penalties to fighting underwater. Most creatures with a swim speed are either aquatic or Amphibious, allowing them to comfortably exist underwater for long periods of time or indefinitely.
Proficiency in +Athletics🏊 is not the same as having a swim speed.
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Action System/Movement/Swim.md

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Anchoring Paint
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: For creatures who dislike pesky mages, plants that drain mana can be mixed with paint in order to create a liquid that can be spread over surfaces. Typically the paint comes with instructions on how you draw the magic circles required to activate its potential.A single can is enough to cover a 20 ft radius in a magic circles. Creatures cannot teleport to any surface that is warded by anchoring paint, or the air above it.After the paint has stopped an instance of teleportation, it rapidly begins to evaporate over the course of an hour.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Barbarian Chew
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: These plants are rare occurrences in mountainous regions, but stand out due to their red leaves year round. With a little bit of alchemical alteration, they inspire fury in those that chew (and often consume) them.For the rest of the day, you cannot use [concentration] effects. The next time you rage today you gain 10 additional speed. When this enhanced rage ends, you cannot rage again until you rest.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Embalming Fluid
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description:
A slightly less extreme version of flash freeze, adapted for a specific purpose. Often used by morticians to make funeral rites more pleasant.Application of this ointment on a corpse prevents its decomposition and negates its stench for 1 week.With 2 doses the embalming lasts a month.
With 3 doses, and a creature trained in the medicine skill, it can last many years.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Flare
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: By mixing fuel with an oxidizer, all you need to make light is a spark.A flare provides a source of light that doesn't rely on fire, making it an ideal short term light source, or wet adventures. With a quick twist (swift action) to activate the chemical reaction, flares gives off light like a torch (20 ft radius bright) for 30 minutes. Flares are more resilient than torches in that they can be tossed around, even in water, without worry of the light going out.With such a simple triggering mechanism, flares can easily be attached to trip wires, or have some kind of specific firing mechanism similar to a firearm to activate it while launching it high in the sky, or both (just as examples).

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Flash Freeze
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Creating flash freeze requires the scale of a frost dragon to create, but the scale is a reusable component. Only small quantities of this substance can be created and contained at once.When poured over water, the oil pools on the surface and takes 1 round to spread out from the point of origin in a 20-foot radius. At the start of your next turn, the oil flash-freezes the surface of the water, creating an ice sheet over the affected area. Any 5-foot square of this ice can support ~500 pounds of weight. Weight in excess of this amount causes the entire sheet to crack and quickly break up. This ice sheet becomes unstable and breaks up on its own after 1 hour, or faster in a hot climate.This item has no significant effect when used against creatures.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Perfume
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Perfumes are powerful mixtures of chemicals with distinct and long-lasting scents, made out of a wide variety of substances. Whether or not they are appealing is up to taste however. You can apply a dose of perfume to yourself as a standard action, and it lasts for a few hours, provided you are not drenched in other liquids or other powerful smelling substances.The first time you roll a persuasion check or deception check to lie against someone, roll serendipity. If you roll 17 or higher, the creature likes the smell, giving you a reroll against them for such checks. Creature's with the scent special quality tend to find most perfumes garish and unpleasant, increasing the DC to 20. Creatures without a sense of spell are unaffected by perfume.You can only benefit from a specific type of perfume's benefit once per creature, requiring you to spice things up during your next interaction if you want the reroll again.By succeeding on a monster lore check against a creature, or just asking people who may know such things, you can figure out a type of perfume they enjoy, bypassing the serendipity check entirely.Can also be flavor texted as a breath spray or something similar.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Salve of Slipperiness
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Oils and secretions of all kinds can be used to make these salves. They are the most effective lubricant on the market, preventing friction in all kinds of scenarios. Applying it to a creature takes 3 rounds and a thorough rub down. It temporarily gives them DR 10 vs grapples and the compression quality for 10 minutes.
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Alchemical Items/Other Utility/Salve of Slipperiness.md

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Smelling Salt
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: A form of mineral too delicate for ore processing that requires an alchemist's touch to unlock its true potential.These crystals snap people awake in a hazy stupor when inhaled. Replaces the defeated condition with the time out condition until they restore hp, they take damage or 10 minutes pass.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Super Goo + Super Solvent
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description:
Note:
This section mentions 2 different but interrelated items. Must be purchased separately.A gooey substance gathered from goo dragons condensed and then separated into 2 components. Super goo takes all of the sticky qualities of a goo dragon and amplifies them. When exposed to open air for 1 round without being disturbed, it can bind any 2 surfaces to each other permanently. Nothing is stopping the objects from being torn or destroyed, however.Super solvent can negate the adhesive properties of super goo, as well as other "sticky" things like spider webs.
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Alchemical Items/Other Utility/Super Goo + Super Solvent.md

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: +Potions
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Potions are small flasks that can be downed in one gulp and usually provide some type of positive benefit to the consumer.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Agility Potion
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Rabbit's feet are a key component in creating agility potions. Other creatures known for swiftness are sometimes used as well.Gives a +10 bonus to speed and a +4 bonus to acrobatics checks for 1 minute, after which, the creature is fatigued. This effect is a [buff].

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Allnight
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Allnight is made from crushed nocturnal insects. The stimulant is similar to caffeine, but cranked up to 11. it is very easy to tell when someone is under the effects of all night due to their constant twitching/jittering and inability to remain focused.Lasts 8 hours. You suppress the negative effects of fatigue and cannot fall asleep or be put to sleep, but take a -2 penalty to all skill checks and cannot do anything with the [concentration] tag. You also do not gain the benefits of rest while under the effects of allnight.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Antitoxin
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Anti toxin is a liquid that can be drank or directly applied to wounds as a standard action, depending on the type of poison. When administered it halts the progression of Venom for 1 hour. Using multiple antitoxins on the same creature in the same 24 hour period has no effect.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Bloodblock
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Bloodblock requires extracting toxins from creatures like mosquitoes and removing the itchiness. Many alchemists do this by crushing large quantities of common mosquitoes and using chemical separation processes.Can be used to substitute for a med kit when treating bleeding creatures. Gives a +4 bonus said checks.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Gillweed
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Gillweed is a plant commonly found in swamps at the waters edge.This potion must be inhaled instead of drank. Doing so is very uncomfortable and staggers the creature for 1 round. The potion allows a creature to breathe underwater as well as air for 8 hours.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Healing Potion
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: The jizzle when it is not acclimated to a particular creature consumes resources from the creatures body to immediately speed up recovery.Immediately restores 5 hp.By increasing the DC by 4, you can double the price and increase its healing by 5. This doubling in price/+4 DC is cumulative (DC 22 for 700g, DC 26 1400g, DC 30 for 2800g etc)T3 and above potions are considered rare items due to their high craft DC.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Mana Potion
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: By melting down mana crystals, they can be converted into a tasty sweet potion that can be addictive.Immediately restores 1 mana, but you mana burn 1, reducing your maximum mana. Normally mana burn also reduces current mana, but to keep the math simple, increase current mana by 1 and reduce max by 1.By increasing the DC by 4, you can double the price and increase its restorative effects and mana burn by 1. This doubling in price/+4 DC is cumulative (DC 22 for 700g, DC 26 1400g, DC 30 for 2800g etc)T3 and above potions are considered rare items due to their high craft DC.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Tongues Potion
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Tongues potions are made using the saliva of particularly chatty or loud creatures. When consumed, the potion allows you to sound like any creature. However, this drought is missing one final ingredient: The tongue of the creature you wish to sound like. Without this key ingredient, the potion is useless.Most tongues potions are sold without the final key ingredient, but alchemy stores tend to have a few preserved tongues lying around.Potions that already sound like a specific creature are incredibly rare and exorbitantly, but more general things like "orc" or "imp" might be available for sale. Depending on the rarity of the tongue in question, price could increase by 10% for something common like orc, or increase by 1,000% with the tongue of a prince.Roundabout numbers, decide as appropriate for situation. Big rare=big price.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Trollblood Potion
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: By scraping off the natural excretions of a troll's skin, trollblood potions can be made.When consumed, the creature gains regeneration 1 for 1 minute. This effect is suppressed for 1 turn if the creature takes fire/poison damage.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: +Thrown Concoctions
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Thrown concoctions are alchemical items that can be used as thrown weapons in combat.Some thrown concoctions explode on impact, requiring a saving throw instead of an attack.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Alchemist Fire
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Alchemist fire is one of the first things taught to alchemists and only requires a handful of common chemicals.When exposed to open air, this combination of chemicals ignites. Creatures within 5 ft are set ablaze (DC 14 reflex negates).

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Bottled Lightning
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Typically alchemists create bottled lightning on stormy days, with some type of lightning rod to attract the lightning. They treat the interior of a bottle with a thin layer of a rubbery insulator and extract the stored electrical power into it.When destroyed, the lightning lashes out at nearby creatures. Creatures within 5 ft take 2d6 (7) zap damage (DC 14 reflex negates).

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Chloroform
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Chloroform is mostly a product of a handful of mushrooms and seaweeds, its properties make it useful in a variety of alchemical creations, but the most well known use is its ability to knock creatures out. A handful of spells and plant creatures have adopted use of this "sleep powder" to incapacitate creatures temporarily. Alchemists have figured out how to manufacture chemicals that mimic this, but are significantly less powerful.Carefully sealed in glass jars, chloroform is used as a projectile weapon. Make a thrown attack against a creature or a melee attack to smash it against them. The creature must make a DC 20 fortitude save or become drowsy and a bit numb. This gives them blurred vision and 5 temp hp. If you critically strike the creature, it lands in their face and the has disadvantage on its save.By smashing a second glass jar against an already drowsy creature, they are forced to make an additional save. If they fail, they are put to sleep for 1 round.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Flash Powder
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: When thrown with enough force, a bag of flash powder reacts violently with a flash of light. Thrown at a creature's feet, it blinds for 1 round (DC 14 reflex reduces to blurred vision).When consumed it makes the user feel very fast for no mechanical benefit.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Siphoning Salt
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Mineral deposits containing salt exposed to powerful magic can sometimes cause the salt to take a blue hue, giving it anti-magic properties. Mages are hesitant to mass produce it for obvious reasons.When thrown on a spell with a persistent effect, it acts as dispel magic at CL 3.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Stink Oil
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Like alchemist fire, stink oil only requires common chemicals. It also requires a little bit of dead organic matter. Most alchemists use their own dead skin flakes to save time.Throw this vial in the space of a creature to cause it to be sickened 2 for one minute (DC 14 fort negates). Creatures with blindsense (scent) take a -2 penalty to their save. Regardless if the creature saves, survival attempts using scent get a +2 bonus until the creature washes up.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Divorce Potion
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: It's so easy to fall in love, but much harder to climb out of it. The divorce potion negates the effects of the love potion. It uses many of the same ingredients but requires organic matter harvested from the creature who the creature is in love with.The effects of the potion are instant. The creature is fully aware of everything they did while under the effects of the love potion, but views it as they would have from the day just before they drank it. Divorce potions are most commonly administered to fix accidental love potion consumption. Due to the higher DC, they are much less common.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Love Potion
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: By extracting the juices of a dead love bug, the complex process of creating a love potion can begin. The name is what everybody calls it, but its function is more in line with a toxin than a potion.Care must be exercised when using love potions, for love is not an exact science. When a creature consumes a love potion, they become charmed and deeply romantically interested in the first person they see for 8 hours. At the end of this duration, the creature loses the charmed condition. It then makes a will save (DC 20 negates) to resist the effects of the potion or the romantic feelings become permanent.In the event where the creature first seen is not romantically compatible, it instead forms a close platonic bond.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: +Toxins
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Toxins are harmful substances that usually require getting into the body of your target, either through injury or ingestion. Most of them inflict some type of debilitating status.An injury toxin can be applied to your weapon as a standard action, and typically evaporated within a few minutes. Applies its effect on-hit.

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Styx Serum
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Using a sample of water from the river Styx and some brain matter, you can create a concoction that can wipe a creature's memories of the recent past. It looks a bit foggier than water and tastes like stagnant water.The Styx serum is incredibly powerful when ingested. It wipes out the memories of the last 24 hours, including drinking the serum.Particularly important events, such as a first kiss, a loved one dying or an unexpected betrayal cannot be erased completely from the spirit by the Styx serum. Such events are instead interpreted as gut feelings, fated connections, love at first sight or deja vu,

equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.title: Alchemical Items
equipment/equipment-types/alchemical-ite.description: Come in several different categories based on their typical use case.The format includes the items name, the DC to craft it and its cost to purchase.I put alchemical items into different price brackets. One for relatively minor and commonplace items another for powerful items, and the last for things requiring incredibly rare reagents. Item DC refers to craft DC, which determines the price. The save DC is typically a base amount (or the class DC of the Alchemist class). If you want to purchase items with a higher DC, adjust the price accordingly.Cheap - DC^2-80. Then rounded up to nearest 10.Common - 100+(DC+5)^2. Then rounded up to nearest 100Expensive - 1000+(DC+10)^2. Then round up to nearest 100

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: +Backgrounds
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description: Background helps to determine what your character was doing before they got sucked up into an adventure, other than acquiring the skills necessary to go out into the dangerous world of course.Backgrounds typically give assets with a specific focus.

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: Businessman
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-briefcase" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 20V4a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-4a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16"></path><rect rx="2" height="14" width="20" y="6" x="2"></rect></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description: You are one of owners of a large business, or the primary owner of a small business. Choose a specific profession, craft or performance skill that you are proficient in, or that could be reasonably related.You have access to a location that you can perform all of the necessary tasks of your trade. This location counts as masterwork tools for whatever it is. In addition, you make 10% more money when you work here.You have to return to this business for at least twice each month for upkeep. If you have a method of long distance communication good enough to have lengthy back and forths, such as a good postal system or magic, you can also upkeep as long as you send such messages 1/week. If you don't you are replaced or the business begins to decline.

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: Family Man
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description: You are the co-owner of a house somewhere in the world, usually at least on the tangent of civilization. You lived with either your immediate family, like parents and siblings, or you made a family of your own with a spouse and children.You own a meager house in a specific place, and a handful of family members to come home to after an adventure. Your house is always considered a suitable place to rest in order to cure general afflictions.Your family generally understands you won't always be back home for dinner, but going more than a month without contact will usually cause them unease, and may eventually cause them to move.

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: Noble
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-crown" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M11.562 3.266a.5.5 0 0 1 .876 0L15.39 8.87a1 1 0 0 0 1.516.294L21.183 5.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .798.519l-2.834 10.246a1 1 0 0 1-.956.734H5.81a1 1 0 0 1-.957-.734L2.02 6.02a.5.5 0 0 1 .798-.519l4.276 3.664a1 1 0 0 0 1.516-.294z"></path><path d="M5 21h14"></path></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description: You come from an upper ring of society. Your name might not carry the same weight everywhere you go, but your gold pouch certainly does.You get a bonus 1,000 starting gold that you can spend as you wish. Your family also gives you an allowance every month of 500g. For campaigns with a faster or slower pace, such as if there are frequent time skips, consider changing how often the allowance comes in.If you are far from home, it can take up to a week for your allowance to arrive. They can only ever be picked up from settlements.

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: Tradesman
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-hammer" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="m15 12-8.373 8.373a1 1 0 1 1-3-3L12 9"></path><path d="m18 15 4-4"></path><path d="m21.5 11.5-1.914-1.914A2 2 0 0 1 19 8.172V7l-2.26-2.26a6 6 0 0 0-4.202-1.756L9 2.96l.92.82A6.18 6.18 0 0 1 12 8.4V10l2 2h1.172a2 2 0 0 1 1.414.586L18.5 14.5"></path></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description:
You worked in a job that required a specialized form of training, such as an alchemist, a doctor or a blacksmith. Over the years of your work you have accumulated a few tools of the trade. Select one of the following presets, or make one that's similar. Doctor - You start off with a masterwork medicine kit, a dose of troll oil and 3 doses of bloodblock.Alchemist - Start off with a masterwork alchemist kit. You start off with a love potion and an alchemist fire.Craftsman (weapons/armor) - Start off with a set of combat ready equipment. You can start off with...
-Heavy armor and a weapon
-Medium armor, 3 melee weapons, a ranged weapon and a shield
-Light armor, 6 light melee weapons, 2 ranged weapons and a shieldYou also have masterwork tools for crafting weapons/armor.

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: Wanderer
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description: You go wherever the road takes you. You might have had a home once, but for one reason or another you had to or wanted to leave.You start play with a standard rock. More information can be found in the bestiary. Very basically, rocks are autonomous, mass produces transportation and shipping vehicles. Most significant places in civilization will have service stations and parking available.

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: Economics
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description:
This section is dedicated to determining income, typically through the use of a skill, like profession, perform or alchemy.All income is based around a formula which calculates a yearly salary (y) based on your skill bonus (x).Salary assumes you you work for 5 days a week, for 50 weeks a year. Divide this value by 250 to figure our your daily income. Most jobs tend to have weekly payouts. The chart below does this formula for you for most expected values. Anything lower than a +0 bonus to the task at hand makes a 5k salary, 20g daily and 100g a week.This formula assumes a prosperous nation with a lot of economic opportunity and a population with thousands of people per city. In poorer and less populous regions, consider using the following multiplier for all goods and services (if you don't mind sacrificing convenience for realism, since multiplying the value every time you buy/sell can get tedious).Developing - Multiply all values by .75
Poor - Multiply all values by .5It also assumes the work provides value. If you are a butcher in a society of vegans, you will struggle to find work. Apply a multiplier in such circumstances.Service/Goods is Almost Useless - Multiply all values by .1
High Supply/Low Demand - Multiply all values by .5
Low Supply/High Demand, Novel Service - Multiply all values by 1.2

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: Mana Donation
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description: By going to specialized facilities, or by going to churches with gilded altars, a creature can donate mana. When you donate, you [mana burn] an equal amount. A creature can safely donate an amount of mana equal to their (max-1). There are usually safeguards against donating your max mana, but less savory individuals don't mind. Mana burning your max mana gives you a T3 affliction: mana starvation. This means that most common people are only able to donate 1 mana each day. Children typically do not possess enough mana to safely donate.Specialized facilities and gilded altars are incredibly expensive, typically costing 100s of thousands of gold to craft. This makes it so facilities for mana donation tend to be rather sparse, only located in sizable settlements with magical and religious influence.When mana is extracted, it is turned into a mana crystal. Mana crystals are versatile and can change between states of matter, becoming either liquid or solid for ease of storage. Each point of mana can earn 4g in a mana extraction facility. In a church, it earns 5 GBP and food/lodging for the day.Most religious services happen in the evening after work, so that way people may spend their mana as they wish during the day, and donate it at night if they wish. With large generous populations this can mean that you can amass large quantities of mana rather quickly. Because most people can only donate 1 mana, you can almost 1:1 translate a population of donors to daily mana generation. Not everybody who donates has commoner tier mana, but at the same time, not everybody can always donate! So the 1:1 ratio is generally the go-to method of determining mana generation over time.Again, not all places have the correct facilities, so this is often available in villages.

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: Populations
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description:
Settlements receive classifications based on population. More populous settlements tend to condense more wealth, have more facilities and are more cosmopolitan. Certain types of services can be expected in larger settlements, but are unheard of in smaller ones.The settlements of Nack are generally less populous than those in our world, with even the biggest of cities having only hundreds of thousands of people.Hamlet - <1000 peopleVillage - 1,000+ peopleCity - 10,000+ peopleMetropolis - 100k+ peopleSome general assumptions about the population...
About 10% of the population is assumed to be over level 0, with a skew towards early levels.
Most regions have a dominant religion, with at around half the population favoring them. Metropolises break this mold by having more variety, while hamlets tend to have a much higher skew of 1 religion.

equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.title: Approximating Gold's Value
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.description:
As a general rule, I have loosely tied the value of gold to the USD. Average laborers like farmers can be expected to make ~10-20k gold every year, with the amount increasing with more sophisticated trades such as smiths or merchants.Gold pieces are small coins and are virtually weightless due to the minting process performed by the financial wizards. Another benefit of this minting is it causes gold pieces to naturally stack into specific values (5, 10, 20, 100, 1000).
Someone can easily hold 100g in their pockets, 1000g in a dedicated pouch. Anything more and they are bulging at the seams and would be better off with a bank.
equipment/equipment-types/approximating-.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Approximating Golds Value/Approximating Gold's Value.md

equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.title: +Shield
equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.description:
Shields give you poise and additional combat options called shield actions. Shields also double up as basic 1h weapons with d8 base damage.
If you do not meet the STR requirement, you cannot use shield actions Note: If you un-equip a shield, you immediately subtract the bonus poise it grants (min 1).Special:
If you wield a shield in two hands, you increase your effective STR by two for determining if you can wield it.

equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.title: +Shield Actions
equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.description: Shields give access to a unique set of actions. See subsections for more details.Shield actions cannot be used against a +Siege Weapon without breaking the shield, rendering unusable until repaired.

equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.title: Blast Shield
equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.description: Shield Types: Tower Action: ImmediateWhen you fail a reflex save, gain resistance to the damage taken.

equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.title: Block
equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.description: Shield Types: Heavy Shield, Tower Shield Action: ImmediateDecrease the bonus to an incoming Attack by 2. If it is a graze, it instead misses completely. Can be used on attacks targeting allies within natural reach. Multiple creatures can block the same attack.

equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.title: Shields Up
equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.description: Shield Types: Heavy Shield, Tower Shield Action: ImmediateGain Resistance to any damage originating from a Ranged Attack roll until the end of the current creature's turn. Can be used on attacks targeting allies within natural reach instead, but ends if they leave your reach.

equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.title: Tank Up
equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.description:
Shield Types: Tower Action: 15 ft of movement Plant your shield to gain total cover from one particular direction. Essentially defends you from all attacks originating from a cone in that direction. A creature within 5 feet of you behind your shield gains cover, but only from a direct line. On subsequent turns reduce your movement by 15 to maintain this. You can choose to attack from behind the shield, but it gives cover instead of total cover.
Using other +Shield Actions ends tank up. You can only use tank up once per turn, forcing you to stick to a particular direction.
You cannot tank up in the same turn you Charge.

equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.title: Armor
equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.description:
Gain Poise equal to the AC the armor gives. Heavy armor imposes a -2 penalty to stealth checks.
Dex column decides how much DEX you get to add to AC. If it has no value, your dex doesn’t add or subtract from your AC. Note: If you do not meet the armor's strength requirement, your speed is reduced by 30 (minimum 5).

equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.title: Buckler
equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-circle" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle r="10" cy="12" cx="12"></circle></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/armor-and-shie.description:
Buckler doesn't count as a shield and doesn't provide any passive defensive bonuses. Instead you get access to the parry ability. You can still interact with objects with a buckler on hand, but bucklers cannot be used if the hand is occupied.Parry (standard) - Prepare yourself for an incoming attack. When you are attacked, you can choose whether or not to parry it. If you do, roll an attack as an instant action. If your attack roll is higher, the attack is negated and the enemy is set to 1 Poise. You can decide to parry an attack after the result of the roll is revealed.
You cannot parry siege weapons.

equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.title: Rock
equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.description:
Level 0 Construct (+0 init)AC 10
HP 20
Poise 15
Fort +0, Refl +0, Will +0NoneVehicle - Standard rocks are streamlined to be useful as transportation and shipping vehicles, but leave a lot to be desired in terms of their combat capabilities. If attacked, a rock is helpless to stop its attacker aside from running away. As such, rocks must be kept away from danger.Ability Scores - Str +0, Dex +0, Lucc +0, Int -, Wis +0, Cha +0Speed - 100 land, increases to 45mph out of combat.
In ideal conditions, such as well-maintained roads, a rock can travel about 1000 miles a day, assuming it travels through the night, or 600 assuming it doesn't. These speeds are halved when moving through areas without well maintained roads, and reduced to 1/4 if you are traveling through wilderness with unwieldy terrain, such as snowy, sandy, mountainous or forested biomes. Some rocks come with specific terrains in mind and ignore such penalties.Camouflage - Wherever rocks are common (most places), it requires a DC 25 perception check to notice a rock is abnormal when it is not in use. A rock can hide any kinds of custom augmentations while camouflaged, including decorative additions like paint jobs.Autonomous - A rock is programmed to move towards specific well known destinations, in cardinal directions, or to move the path of least resistance towards a set of coordinates. If the rider wishes, there is also a driver's seat that allows them to more finely control the rock's movement. The autonomous driving controls leave a lot to be desired for sleeping passengers. You can get some sleep, but you do not gain the benefits of rest unless you stop to sleep.Seating/Storage - Rocks have compartments that can be easily hidden when not in use, both for seating and for storage. Standard rocks have seating to comfortably accommodate for 20 medium creatures. Such seating is protected from the elements via a weak magical barrier, capable of stopping small insects, wind and rain, but not arrows and swords.
They can carry up to 5000 lbs in a compartment that is 8x8x8ft.

equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.title: Rocks
equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.description:
It's not a boulder, it's a rock! Rocks are the premier transportation and shipping vehicles in the world of Nack. They are incredibly fast, cheap and can plop down anywhere and look natural because they're rocks.Rocks are construct creatures that have their programming optimized for navigation and high speed transportation. More details in the stats subsection.A standard rock costs 1,500g.If you would only like to rent one, you are typically limited to predesignated paths, such as state roads. It costs 10g for short trips within 600 miles, 30g for something between 2-6 days and 80g+ for anything longer.Prices for augments are included below. Using augmented rocks multiplies adds 50g to the price to rent them, with particularly expensive ones being even more expensive or unavailable for most customers.If the rock is lost, destroyed or damaged, the owner/company that provided the service expects compensation for replacements/repairs.All prices listed are in addition to the base 1,500g price.Offroad - 2,000g
Capable of traversing a specific type of terrain, such as forest regions, snow etc. Each sold separately.Climbing/Swimming - 1,000g
Rock is capable of using its full speed while climbing or swimming. Each sold separately.Armored Plating - 10,000g
Adds +5 ac, +5 to all saving throws, +10 poise and +20 hp.Flight - 60,000g
Rock is capable of using its full speed while flying.

equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.title: Goods and Services
equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-hotel" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 22v-6.57"></path><path d="M12 11h.01"></path><path d="M12 7h.01"></path><path d="M14 15.43V22"></path><path d="M15 16a5 5 0 0 0-6 0"></path><path d="M16 11h.01"></path><path d="M16 7h.01"></path><path d="M8 11h.01"></path><path d="M8 7h.01"></path><rect rx="2" height="20" width="16" y="2" x="4"></rect></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.description: In order to adventure, you need to eat, sleep and relax after a hard day of getting munched on by wolves. These things are going to steadily eat into your wallet. This section is dedicated to quantifying these basic necessities.That being said, not all restaurants and inns are created equal. Some more expensive ones may have access to special types of services, or provide you with connections to a specific type of clientele for an enormous price hike.
equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Goods and Services/Goods and Services.md

equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.title: Teleportation Circles
equipment/equipment-types/goods-and-serv.description: A teleportation circle is an undertaking that requires a great deal of upkeep to maintain, with skillful mages on call for when things go wrong. Only the most rich and powerful nations have access to a teleportation circle, and typically only in their capital. The number of teleportation circles in a world shouldn't exceed a dozen.That being said, the process of teleportation between circles is usually an easy, painless and routine task. Teleportation between these circles costs 100g and typically only takes a few minutes of waiting in line.Certain restrictions may be in place during times of war and strife preventing teleportation while they last.In The World of Nack, the Financial Wizard guild and the Brotherhood of Steel control the circles.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Lead
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-edit-3" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M12 20h9"></path><path d="M16.376 3.622a1 1 0 0 1 3.002 3.002L7.368 18.635a2 2 0 0 1-.855.506l-2.872.838a.5.5 0 0 1-.62-.62l.838-2.872a2 2 0 0 1 .506-.854z"></path></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description:
Lead seems like an unusual item to catalogue, but it has unique properties that make it desirable despite its drawbacks. Lead has the unique property of interfering with scrying effects. Lead paint is the most convenient method of preventing scrying from would be spies, but it can also be used in other clever ways.For example if you have a treasured item you don't want a spy to see, you can use a metal box lined with lead to cause it to appear invisible to any [scrying] effects. Particularly rich and paranoid creatures, like wizards an beholders hoard lead in order to cover their entire lairs in it.It only takes a very thin sheet of lead that mostly covers an area to veil it from these pesky divinations. There are various security measures available for sale.
Lead is toxic to creatures, and using it to prevent scrying has drawbacks. When meeting the conditions for lead poisoning (as noted in the various products) the creature is immediately Drained 5 and has Disadvantage on skill checks until this drain is removed. Continued exposure increases this drained penalty until the creature dies.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Lead Architecture
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description:
Lead structures are the most expensive, but most effective way of making sure an area is safe from scrying. This is done by lining the building materials with layers of lead during construction, or as a later add on. Scrying attempts inside of lead structures always fail. Even going near the structure causes scrying magic to be faulty, obscuring the senses.A singular room costs 25,000gAn average home costs 60,000gLarge or complex structures such as prisons, dungeons or palaces have a starting price of 150,000g, which can easily increase based off the scale of the project.
As long as the building is intact, the risk of lead poisoning is basically zero. During times of strife though, the lead can poison the air, making it unsafe to breathe.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Lead Container
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-box" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M21 8a2 2 0 0 0-1-1.73l-7-4a2 2 0 0 0-2 0l-7 4A2 2 0 0 0 3 8v8a2 2 0 0 0 1 1.73l7 4a2 2 0 0 0 2 0l7-4A2 2 0 0 0 21 16Z"></path><path d="m3.3 7 8.7 5 8.7-5"></path><path d="M12 22V12"></path></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description: Lead containers are mostly made of other metals like iron, steel, or for the particularly paranoid, adamantine. There is a layer of lead that prevents divinations of the container entirely. To anybody scrying on the area, the container (and its content) is completely invisible.A small container for handheld items like books, the family jewels or light weapons costs 2,000gA medium container for sizable items like great weapons, or your rock collection costs 5,000gA larger container for very large items like humanoid bodies or golden toilets or costs 12,000gSpecial: Care must be taken when dealing with lead containers. There are methods of detecting lead and it usually indicates somebody has something to hide. In addition, if you place objects on a lead container, one could infer the location of something important since they would appear to be floating in midair while scrying.Lead containers are unsafe to carry around, and inflict lead poisoning on those that do for too long. Holding onto the container for a few days is enough to poison you.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Lead Paint
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description: Lead paint is the most convenient and cost effective way method of preventing scrying from would be spies over large areas. However it is a much more temporary solution. The high concentration of lead in the paint, as well as the additional binding agents, causes the paint to peel much more often and release a toxic gas that can cause problems over time. This requires a monthly cleaning and reapplication to maintain the anti-divination properties.A bucket of paint can cover the average sized room. Larger rooms with high roofs require many buckets.Buckets of paint are typically used for smaller private meeting rooms.Creatures that reside in rooms treated with lead paint are subject to lead poisoning within days of existing in it. If the room is poorly maintained, this can happen with only brief exposure.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Dragon Metal
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description: Dragon Metal is often referred to by what its made into rather than as a material more often than not; Something like "dragon plate armor" or "dragon great sword." It is made by combining a rare form of jewel, called dragonstone, with steel. When in the presence of a dragon, the dragonstone absorbs bits of expended mana over time and change color to match the color of the dragon's scales. The dragon metal that is created by this often superficially resembles the dragon whom the dragonstone absorbed its power.When dragon metal is made into a weapon, the weapon has a +2 flat bonus to damage. They also get a bonus special attack, selected from the attached list.When dragon metal is made into a set of medium or heavy armor, it gives resistance to an elemental damage type, based on the dragonstone used in its crafting, defaulting to fire. For light armor see dragonhide.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Dragon Weapon Special Attacks
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description:
Sever - This attack gains +2 attack. On-hit sever the connection a creature has to their deity. They cannot invoke deity nor can they use Prayer or Deific Boons until they Rest.
Similar abilities that rely on divine power like Paladin😇 smite are unaffected.
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Mundane Items/Materials/Dragon Metal/Dragon Weapon Special Attacks.md

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: +Mundane Items
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description: Things that you can usually buy in many locations around the world with the correct vendor in town. Many have real life analogues.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Caltrops
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description: Caltrops are small pointy objects designed to harm creatures that walk through areas where they are deployed. Every space a creature moves through occupied by caltrops, they take 2 piercing damage and start Bleeding for 2 damage. A creature can avoid this damage by treating it as difficult terrain.500g is the price attached to the package of caltrops that can be deployed immediately as a standard action. Treat it as a thrown weapon to determine the distance you can throw it. All spaces within 5 ft of its landing point are covered in these pointy bits.If deployed beforehand carefully over 1 minute, a similar package can cover a 10 ft radius.Caltrops can be swept up in the AoE of many effects, such as aqueous orb, causing them to be rendered ineffective.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Holy Water
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description: Holy water is an item that is regularly created by churches and sold to commoners as a form of protection against the profane. Many fiends and undead have an aversion to this substance, and can often cure diseases inflicted by them and prevent some of their supernatural abilities.The most common use of holy water is as a weapon. You can throw a small bottle of it as a thrown weapon. It deals 2d6 (7) holy damage on hit.Many uses of holy water require its direct application, such as on wounds inflicted by the profane, or directly on the remains of the profane to put their spirits to rest.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Property
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-image" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect ry="2" rx="2" height="18" width="18" y="3" x="3"></rect><circle r="2" cy="9" cx="9"></circle><path d="m21 15-3.086-3.086a2 2 0 0 0-2.828 0L6 21"></path></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description: Property is synonymous with land, and everything on it. Property can include facilities, homes or it can just look pretty. The price of property changes based on a few factors: Size, buildings, appearance, location and the overall state its in can influence its price.Small bits of land with little intrinsic value generally go pretty cheap. You can buy an acre of unworked "wild land" for 10,000gPremium land, such as places that could be good spots for attractions or farmland are a bit more expensive. You can buy an acre of premium land for 50,000gA small home that can comfortably fit a single person costs 10,000gAn average home that can comfortably fit a family costs 25,000gA luxurious home, like a mansion with many rooms for family and guests, leisure rooms for toys and sports and large outdoor yards costs 100,000gLarge or complex structures such as prisons, dungeons or palaces have a starting price of 250,000g, which can easily increase based off the contents.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Tools
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description: Tools typically come in sets catered to a specific task, such as fishing, lockpicking or medicine. Some tasks require the use of tools, others only give a penalty if you don't have tools.Tool kits weigh 10 lbs. Some tasks, such as smithing, require even more advanced tools you can't carry around like a forge.

equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.title: Torch
equipment/equipment-types/mundane-items/.description: Torches are sticks wrapped with some type of cloth, chemical or vegetable matter that is flammable. Torches give off Bright Light in a 20 ft radius around them, and Dim Light 20 ft past that.They can stay lit for up to 2 hours. Lighting and dimming a torch repeatedly can significantly decrease the amount of time they stay lit.If a torch ends up getting wet, it becomes unusable. If a torch ends up clattering to the ground from being knocked over or disarmed, roll a DC 10 luck check to see if it goes out, using the luckiest fellow benefiting from it in the vicinity if it was not wielded by anybody in specific.

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.title: +Exotic Weapons
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.description: Inherently function differently than other weapons and require a more nuanced description to describe their functionality. These weapons get no additional weapon points to customize with.

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.title: Bola
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.description:
Thrown weapon
Bolas can be used to topple from a range. Bolas can only be used once per combat as they need to be untangled to be used properly

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.title: Boomerang
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.description:
Boomerangs return to the user when thrown automatically, allowing multiple attacks with a single thrown weapon. Boomerangs curve, allowing you to hit opponents with total cover, so long as you aim for the correct space Boomerangs do not return when caught with something like a goo dragon's sticky quality
Special Attack: Wait For It... - Throw a boomerang at an unusual angle, initially missing a target. At the start of your next turn make an attack against them, but they're DD.

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.title: Gun
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.description:
Guns come in 3 variants: Pistol, rifle and blunderbuss Short range
Requires an even more complex reloading process than crossbows. Their reload requires a FRA Pistols are 1h weapons, but they cannot be used to dual wield Also comes in a 2h rifle version that has the 2h property and does 2d8 dmg (10 lbs, 800g)
Requires an even more complex reloading process than crossbows. Their reload requires a FRA
Simultaneously attacks every creature in a 15ft cone, comparing a single attack roll to all affected creatures' AC
Does not provoke AoOs from shooting in melee
Not compatible with special attacks

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.title: Harpoon
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.description:
Thrown weapon Harpoons come with a particularly strong 40 ft rope attached, allowing you to drag the weapon back to you in case you miss (standard action). Holding onto this rope after you toss uses a hand.
Harpoons stick into the target. The bleed from this weapon cannot be stopped until after it is removed with Breakout as a swift action. The target also can't move farther than 40 ft away from you without forcing you somehow.
While embedded, you can make a drag attacks against the target without penalty from being at a range. The target can do the same against you.

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.title: Lance
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.description: While mounted, a lance can be wielded in one-hand while still benefiting from 2h damage. Special Attack: Joust - When you make this attack while mounted and during a Charge, your movement is elusive against your target. On-hit dismounts the target.

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.title: Shield (W)
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.description:
A large chunk of wood or metal with handles on one side to affix to your arm. Can be used to make shield actions. Comes with the CM (shove) quality
Gives 5 poise Also comes in a tower shield variant, giving additional shield actions and 10 poise. (40 lbs, 100g)
More details under shields page

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.title: Staff
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.description: A well crafted stick either made with wood infused with magic, or has an object affixed to its end to channel magic power. Can be used to cast spells. Also comes in a light variant (d6, 2 lbs , 120g) and a 2h battlestaff variant (2d6, 10 lbs, 200g) When you wield 2 staves, or have a staff and some other Staff Component, you get a +1 boost to your CL

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.title: Whip
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/exotic.description: Whips can be used to attack with 10 ft of extra reach during your turn. You do not Threaten these spaces when it isn't your turn. You can use the whip to grab objects and pull them adjacent to you, provided you would normally have been able to lift them.

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/specia.title: Base Special Attacks
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/specia.description:
All weapons come with some of these special attacks, based on the damage type they deal, or their weapon type (ranged, melee, shield etc).Special attacks by default recharge after being out of combat for 1 minute. When used out of combat (for the utility), you can use them an unlimited number of times.You can swap weapons to gain more special attacks, but you cannot use special attacks with the same name more than once in the same combat. Most special attacks require a melee attack, unless the weapon is ranged.The ALL in these subcategories refer to only manufactured weapons, not natural attacks and
unarmed attacks.
Special Attack: Lacerate - On the hits apply d6 bleed damage for 2 turns (fort negates)
Special Attack: Cleave - Attack two separate creatures you threaten from your current position.
Special Attack: Concussive Strike - On hit apply clumsy 1.
Special Attack: Backbreaker - Deal 15 poise damage on-hit.Special Attack: Lunge - Increase your reach by 5 ft for this attack and all others made this turn
Special Attack: Pierce Defense - Ignore DR. If your opponent uses an immediate or instant action in response to this attack, gain +4 attack.Special Attack: Maim - On hit reduce the creature's speed by 15ft for one round (fort negates). Special Attack: Snipe - Ignore -2 penalty to attack for a long ranged shot
Special Attack: Endure - Slam a target with your shield and continue to hold it up, focusing on them. Gain resistance to all damage from this target for 1 round, even if you miss. Special Attack: Shield Bash - Inflict clumsy 1 on hit.

equipment/equipment-types/weapons/specia.title: Unique Special Attacks
equipment/equipment-types/weapons/specia.description:
This section is dedicated to helping you fill in the "special attack" weapon quality, or for giving unique weapons special abilities. See the Base Special Attacks section for the special attacks weapons get by default.
Special Attack: Determination - Focus your conviction. You get a +4 bonus and Seeking to your next attack with this weapon by the end of your next turn. You can also choose to not attack at all with this special attack, granting your next attack with this weapon a +10 bonus instead. If you choose to delay this bonus, Determination does not consume your special attack next round.
Special Attack: Stacking Strike - Make an attack. If this defeats the creature, stacking strike permanently gains 1 damage. Weapon specific, so you have to stack weapons individually. You cannot farm stacks passively and must gain them in combats you actually roll out.
Special Attack: Bewildering Blow - On-hit creature is confused for one round (will negates).
Special Attack: Magic Crash - Roll an attack roll in place of a Dispel check against a magical effect you can attack, including one on a creature.
Special Attack: Meteor Swing - On hit your target is unable to make AoOs for 1 round.Special Attack: Ankle Slicer - On hit your target has -15 speed for 1 round.
Special Attack: Lifesteal (Healing) - On hit heal (2+level).
Special Attack: Throat Slicer - On hit silence a creature for one round (fort negates).Special Attack: All In - On hit instead of rolling for damage, you deal maximum damage. If you graze, you instead miss entirely. When you miss, you take 20 poise damage.The above special attacks can be generalized to any type of weapon. Even the "slicer" special attacks could be achieved just as effectively if you crushed a throat or foot. In general I try to be lax with what weapons you give your character so mechanics to not interfere with flavor. However, the following weapons will specify a type of weapon you lock into, and are incompatible with each other.Special Attack: Volley - Fire many shots at once, targeting a 15 ft cone in front of you. Compare a single attack roll to all creatures in AoE. This requires a bow, which is a 2h ranged weapon without the reload property.Special Attack: Rapid Fire - Fire two shots in rapid succession at the same creature. This requires a bow, which is a 2h ranged weapon without the reload property.Special Attack: Wild Strike - Swing around a flail without concern for the consequences. Deal an additional 7 damage. If you miss or graze, you instead treat the attack as if you grazed yourself. This requires a flail, which is a 1h or 2h melee crush weapon.

You let go of the weapon as part of using this special attack. This requires a pick style weapon, which is a 1h or 2h melee pierce weapon.
Special Attack: Execution - Finish them. Against a knocked down or grappled opponent, deal an additional 7 damage. This requires a heavy sword or axe style weapon, which is a 2h slashing weapon.Special Attack: Overrun - Move your opponent 5 ft in a direction that isn't towards you on hit. feats/combat-feats/combat-maneuver-feats.description: Requirements - You shove creatures 10 ft farther If your foe impacts a solid surface or an object when you shove them, they break it if is of average or lesser toughness. feats/combat-feats/combat-maneuver-feats.title: Maneuver Master

feats/combat-feats/combat-maneuver-feats.title: Maneuver Versatility
feats/combat-feats/combat-maneuver-feats.description:

feats/combat-feats/combat-maneuver-feats.title: Mine!
feats/combat-feats/combat-maneuver-feats.description:

feats/combat-feats/combat-reflexes.html.title: Combat Reflexes
feats/combat-feats/combat-reflexes.html.description: Requirements - Gain two additional AoOs. Opponents can tell you continue to threaten past the first AoO. You can draw a weapon as part of an attack of opportunity if you have a free hand.

feats/combat-feats/fan-club.html.title: Fan Club
feats/combat-feats/fan-club.html.description:
Requirements - Level 3, Cha +1 Tags: CompanionYou use your influence and charm to gain a group of people that appreciate you. They are often willing to perform minor tasks for you, stick their neck out for you, but not risk their life for you. They are located in one specific place at first, then they may branch as you gain more levels and influence.
The size of your fan club varies based on your level. You multiply this value by your CHA.
One member of your fan club is your biggest fan. Your biggest fan is always a minion, other than that, there are no restrictions for what your biggest fan can be. When you gain this feat, you decide their +Class, race🏁, stats etc. They count as a companion if they travel with you.Your biggest fan doesn't necessarily need to be a race with a class, but those that aren't should be acquired through story related encounters rather than chosen.

feats/combat-feats/fighter's-lament.html.title: Fighter's Lament
feats/combat-feats/fighter's-lament.html.description: Requirements -When a creature teleports within your reach, it provokes an AoO. This includes if the creature teleports into your reach.

feats/combat-feats/sentinel.html.title: Sentinel
feats/combat-feats/sentinel.html.description:
Requirements - Whenever you land an AoO against a creature that attempts to move out of your threatened spaces, their movement is halted and their speed is reduced to zero for their turn
The first time a turn a creature you threaten damages an ally within your Reach (that isn't you), make an AoO against it
Sentinel SHOULD proc on things like - Any Attack Roll that deals damage, AoE damaging effects like Fire Blast, single target damaging effects like Magic Missile, high impact Persistent effects like Wall of Fire
Sentinel SHOULDn't proc on things like - Damage over time effects like Ablaze or Bleed, damage reflecting effects like Elemental Shield, low impact persistent effects like Self Immolation Note:
Because the trigger to Sentinel is the same as some reactive features (like Avenging Wrath), you cannot use this feat and such abilities to attack a creature twice. Though nothing is stopping you if your ally is harmed more than once.
See Immediate Action and Instant Action.

If left in figurine form for too long, your companion will free itself when it gets hungry, thirsty or lonely.As a standard action, you can toss this action figure up to 30 ft away to transform it back. If you apply this to an Innate Technique, then it requires a swift action in addition to its usual cast time (unless it is a swift, immediate or free action).

Requirements - Orc

Particularly destructive deaths, like guillotine or Disintegration do not function against you, leaving your head still attached and your atoms still...not a fine dust.

feats/teamwork-feats/as-one/as-one.html.description:
Requirements -During an ally's turn, if they move, you can spend an immediate action to use your movement to move along with them. You must either end this movement within their natural reach, or threatening the same enemy as them.You subtract this movement from your movement next turn.
Turn based games make movement awkward, but the idea is you are moving together, so other positional effects, such as escape route or +Shield Actions, can treat moving allies as within reach for the duration of the movement in circumstances where allies converge on a location or start in positions that are close to each other.

feats/feat-functionality.html.title: Feat Functionality
feats/feat-functionality.html.description: Feats are features in progression typically gained at every odd level. They allow your character to get bonuses to specific actions, perform entirely new actions and occasionally get general stat increases. Some feats have prerequisites, such as stat requirements or other feats. You must meet all of the requirements of a feat to take it.Feats come in a few categories.General - General feats mostly assist with some kind of out of combat task, such as things to increase the consistency of skills.Combat - A combat feat is only useful during combat, or is at least more skewed towards being useful during combat.Multiclass - This feat allows you to borrow a feature from another class. Usually such features are secondary features of the class, or are there for flavor.Teamwork - A teamwork feat requires more than one creature to possess in order to function, usually providing some kind of synergistic effect. The wording of these feats often include "all allies," but it only applies to allies with the feat.Magic - Feats that specifically apply to spells.MM - Short for meta magic. A subsection of magic feats that allow you to apply general augments to spells by spending an additional point of mana. Most require intelligence.Racial - These feats expand on racial features or play more into the unique aspects of a race that would be unfitting for a race feature.

gods/gods/demigods/ulule/t1-wishing-well.title: T1 - Wishing Well
gods/gods/demigods/ulule/t1-wishing-well.description:
Tags: Su You can use this ability by making a wish and dropping a sum of money into a well, or water sources that are or are soon to be moving underground.
Your wish along with your money will work its way back into the world in a way that will aid the creature you wish for at some point in the near future. This could be a special delivery, a discount on a purchase they planned to make or an item they uncover in the ground. Ulule💎 decides how best to use these funds to assist in your goal, and pays more attention to the intent behind the wish than the exact wording when deciding what to do.

gods/gods/demigods/ulule/ulule.html.title: Ulule
gods/gods/demigods/ulule/ulule.html.description:
Ulule is a relatively niche revered figure of earthkin Geniekin🧞. She fell in love with a mortal and wished to make a home for her new family. She found a giant beautiful tree and infused it with her own life. It turned the tree into a mix of wood, metal and stone. It later became known as the Iron Pine. This enormous tree and its roots served as the center point for these people in the heart of the Flame Empire. Her followers are generally upstanding people, albeit they keep themselves secluded away from others. Many that worship Ulule also worship the Earth Mother🍃.
The empire did not take too kindly to what they viewed as squatters and plotted to kill her. They succeeded, but the geniekin still remain to this day, cloistered in their Iron Pine, protected by its seemingly indestructible umbrella of protection that branches deep underground. The Iron Pine uniquely has a mind of its own, and its said that Ulule's spirit still resides within it. She selectively allows creatures like Earthbender🪨s to manipulate its shape to better suit their needs.Ulule is a genie composed mostly of marble and gemstones that adorn her face. Great care is taken towards statues of her, which are particularly lifelike given she herself was made of stone.The motto often repeated by her followers is "What goes around comes around."

The Shroomlette is the shroomkin god of happiness, rest and fertility. One of the few gods that exists in the realm of mortals. Her domain is a garden filled with all kinds of oddities on the clouds above a mushroom forest. Forever resting in a shiny cradle, she waits to be tucked in by a visitor. The Garden is commonly used as a place of mediation since all forms of violence are forbidden within the domain of the Shroomlette.The Shroomlette is an entity that represents the bond between gooms, a breed of squishy draconic creatures, and shroomkin, a race of people with close ties to fey creatures and mushrooms. These two entities live in tandem with each other with one main goal: increase the quantity of happiness in the world. The tactics they use to do so is to subdue creatures that decrease happiness and physically change the world around them to make it a better place to live.BoonsT1: Form of Baby (Su) [poly, true]\T2: Bubble Blowing Double Baby (Su)\T3: (Su)

meta-discussions/faqs/reactions-jank.htm.title: Reactions Jank
meta-discussions/faqs/reactions-jank.htm.description:
In NN, there are a wide variety of abilities that allow you to react to your opponents actions, like +Shield Actions, but sometimes those abilities allow retaliation. This usually works just fine since you get attacked in melee, you parry and then riposte as a Swashbuckler🤺 for instance.
But what happens when the origin of the attack is somehow technically coming from a creature but at the same time it isn't? Take for example the Arboreal Army spell. It allows you to take control of vegetation and slap your enemies with it using your stats. What's a swashbuckler to do, riposte a tree?
In such cases, when a creature is making attacks, casting spells etc. through some kind of proxy, it is still considered to be coming from the original attacker. This means that if your swashbuckler is threatening the druid while they smack you with a tree, you can parry the tree, then riposte against the attacker.
