meta-discussions/pros-and-cons.html.title: Pros and Cons
meta-discussions/pros-and-cons.html.description: For more experienced TTRPG players, you might already have a good idea of what you like in a system, so this section will (hopefully) be an easy way to figure out if you will like Nick Nacks. Customization - A robust system designed to be played over and over again with characters that feel different every time. Customization with creative character ideas is the number one thing I set out to accomplish in Nick Nacks. Balance - The second highest priority I have, that is absolutely necessary in order to make customization possible, is balance. Games that I have played struggle to maintain balance, particularly in the early/later levels and with their magic systems. I pay very close attention to features when they seem particularly powerful and particularly weak, and make adjustments as needed. Adaptive - I don't have plans to print anything for this game, and regularly update this website. If a feature ends up a power outlier, or doesn't feel how it should, I will go back and change it to make it better. No longer will you need to wait decades for a new book to come out, contact the developers on twitter or pray your GM rules in your favor. Free! - This website doesn't have a subscription and is more of a "pay want you want" via patreon. If you do what I did when I started playing, you can use dice rolling programs like rolz for your dice needs, discord for voice chat and screen sharing and your art program of choice for battlemaps. Personally I make mine in pain tool sai, then share them in gimp because its easier to move layers around. Sai isn't free, but gimp is a nice alternative for making battle maps. Incomplete - As a solo developer who cannot dedicate 100% of my time to this project, you will inevitably find certain classes and spell lists with not as much content as you were hoping. You will also find artifacts of me copy and pasting things, or me making large scale rules changes and not catching every single feature it effects. Everything I start, I intend to finish, but starting things is a lot easier than finishing them. Complex - When I make content, I always make considerations to speed up play, but inevitably if you want a robust system of customization, you increase the complexity of the game. This means that you will likely not be able to remember all the fine details of the hundreds of spells, class features and feats the game has to offer. I tried my best to organize this website as well as I could to make the process of looking things up fast, and because you're playing tabletop, you can adjust things to be more convenient on the fly and look things up later if you don't want to slow things down. No Game World - One area in particular that will take a very long time to finish that is lower on the priority list is fleshing out a game world. I have introduced several mechanics that have world-building elements built into them such as mana, races and gods. Luckily, most of you probably already have high-fantasy game worlds you like. D20 System - For the math nerds out there, this can be a problem. The d20 is exceptionally good a delivering highlights and is quite simple. It is probably the most familiar type of action resolution dice, but as a tradeoff it is not the most mathematically sound. With a soft bounded accuracy system like Nick Nacks, its less of an issue, but there will be times where you reach the extremes of the dice and foil the balance I worked so hard to achieve.

minigames/+minigames.html.title: +Minigames
minigames/+minigames.html.description: Mini games are used in order to portray non-combat scenarios where it's usually just contests of strength or skill. Some spells/abilities might have restrictions that are mostly based around combat (like rage) that should be allowed to persist through the contest.

random-charts/afflictions/afflictions.ht.title: Afflictions
random-charts/afflictions/afflictions.ht.description:
Certain monster abilities, as well as the defeated condition, give permanent debuffs to characters. These debuffs represent physical/mental wear and tear beyond the catch-all of hp. The longer you are away from home, the more debuffs you are likely going to accrue.Debuffs universally MUST have some finite method of curing them. Many of them can be cured just by taking a day off: Spend a night at the local bar or brothel, spend time with family, visit a theme park etc. Others require something more specific. Debuffs come in tiers, the higher the tier, the greater the debuff.In the heat of combat, you do not gain the afflictions. Afflictions are accumulated after combat. Roll separately for each time you were defeated in combat.How do you decide what tier you get?Roll a luck check.
If you roll below 1, you get a Tier 3 affliction.
If you roll below 6, you get a Tier 2 affliction.
Anything 6 or above and you get a Tier 1 affliction. Exceeding a 20 negates the affliction.The luck check gets a penalty to the roll equal to afflictions all added up. Tier 1 give a -1 penalty, Tier 2 gives -2 and T3 gives a -3 penalty.

random-charts/character-creation/+charac.title: +Character Creation
random-charts/character-creation/+charac.description: For when you want to let fate decide what kind of character you are playing.

random-charts/character-creation/height+.title: Height+Weight
random-charts/character-creation/height+.description: Roll a d10 and then flip a coin. The d10 represents the variance as a percentage and the coin flip decides up (heads) or down (tails). If you roll a 1 or 10, you can roll again.Example - Human are average 5'6 and weigh 150. I roll a 10 and get heads.66*1.1=72 in or 6 ft, 150*1.1=165 lbsIf you roll two 1s or a 10s, you can choose to be ludicrously tall or smol.

skills/general-thoughts/skill-proficienc.title: Skill Proficiency
skills/general-thoughts/skill-proficienc.description: Skill proficiencies are represented by a numerical value, typically based on class+INT. When you are proficient in a skill, you add 2+LvL to all skill checks related to this skill. You also get any feature underneath the skill with a label of (P).

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Mud Buddy
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Earth, Water, Companion, Mana Burn Action: Standard
You sculpt mud into a more friendly shape, and your new buddy does his best to aid you. Mud buddy is an elemental that shares all of your ability scores, AC and saves. He has half of your max hp and poise. He shares your level, but is always treated as a minion.
Mud buddy cannot wield weapons, and his only form of attack is a single +Combat Maneuver👐 every turn with a bonus equal to your CL. If you choose to grapple, he can only choose to Bully the creature to maintain the grapple. He has a 20 land speed and a 60 swim speed. He can Burrow through moist earth using his land speed.Outside of combat he can do simple tasks, such as physical labor. He is intelligent, but he lacks the ability to speak and has no skills. He can carry 300 lbs.When mud buddy is destroyed, or when the spell ends, the mana burn is removed (but it does not restore current mana).

techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).title: Shadow Tears
techniques/magical-techniques/moogen-(t).description:
Level 3 Moogen (T)👁
Tags: Dark Action: Standard
The target is blinded and leaves behind a trail of darkness wherever they walk (will reduces effect to Blurred Vision). While blinded by this spell, the space the creature occupies and every space they move into is occupied by a cloud of Darkness at least 10 ft high (adjusted based on size).After the creature moves 60 ft, the spell ends.

techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.title: Casting Components
techniques/technique-rules/spell-mechani.description:
All spells have some kind of visual effect associated with their casting before the effect occurs. Magic circles shining fingers and eyes, words manifesting into physical objects and circling the caster are all means to easily identify when a creature is casting a spell. The only exception to this being spells with the Subtle tag.All spells have a verbal component. Verbal components cannot be whispered, and you must speak them clearly. Anything that prevents the mage from speaking prevents them from casting, such as being silenced.
These rules apply to Innate Casting.---
All spells have a Staff Component. Disarming a mage of their staff prevents them from casting using it. Any spell with a material component has an item with a price associated with that is consumed on use. Anything with a focus component has an item with a price associated that is NOT consumed on use.These rules do not apply to innate casting.

bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.description:
A spider descends from the ceiling slowly on a string of silk. As it reaches the brightness of your torchlight, you see a dark elf from the waist up emerging from where the spider's head would be.Level 5 Large Cryptid/Humanoid Web Walker - A drider cannot be Entangled by webs. they ignore the Difficult Terrain of webs.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: Demon Prince(ss)
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description:
A well-dressed fiend carries itself with a great sense of importance as it struts across the battlefield. With a bow it introduces itself to you, and then invites its friends to join.Level 6 Medium Fiend (Mastermind)Resistance - Fire
Double Team Recharge Sp - A prince can use Stunt Double as a swift action. Usable 1/minute.Claws (S) +8 2d8+2 (11)
Innate Techniques (CL 8) - Dance With Me!, Venomous Promise, The Hand that Feeds, Fake Out, Spell Blade (U3)
1/day - Fire and Brimstone, Hellfire, Backfire, Mirror Images
Now its a Party! Companion Summon Ally - When a prince uses its Fire and Brimstone technique, he can also bring forth to one allied fiend (LvL 4 or lower) from the The Demon Realm to fight by his side while he concentrates on it. He can extend the duration by 1 round or change the direction of the technique as a standard action.Each round at the start of the prince's turn if he is still concentrating on the spell, then he can summon another fiend.
How Dare You! - By spitting out an insult at a prince (swift action) you can taunt him for 1 round. Subsequent attempts to do so require an appropriate skill check, opposed by the prince's will save.

bestiary/bestiary/plants/level-folder-pl.title: Shambling Shroom
bestiary/bestiary/plants/level-folder-pl.description:
A hunchback with fungus growing all over its back limps around, leaving toxic debris in the air wherever it goes. It its hand it holds a handful of sinister looking mushrooms.Level 4 Large Plant/Undead Resistance - Poison, Toxin, Venom, Necrotic
Regeneration - Stopped by Bright LightCorrupting Touch (necrotic) +7
3d6 (10) +drain 3 Unarmed (C) +7 d8+3 (7)
Innate Techniques - Mana Scorch, Tentacles for Arms, Grasp of the Undying
1/day - Colossal Smash, Ants in your Pants, Mind Maze
Constant - Mana Drain
Spores Abound Necrotic Persistent - A shambling shroom's greatest calling is to plant mushrooms wherever it goes. To do so, it is always on the move, leaving behind spores that linger in spaces it moves through for 1 minute before settling. As a swift action, a shambling shroom can shake its body to cause them to erupt around it, leaving behind a cloud within its natural reach.
Whenever a creature moves into a space occupied by these spores, they take root and start quickly growing. Undead💀 creatures are unharmed by this process. Any other creature takes 2d6 (7) necrotic damage and is Sickened 1 (fort halves dmg and negates sicken). The sickened condition is considered Permanent Status until the creature washes, burns, or uses first aid to get them off or steps in sunlight.Sunlight Bane - When in natural sunlight, a shroom shambler can't use its spores abound or corrupting touch abilities.

bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.title: Evasion
bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.description:
Take half damage from Reflex saving throws. When you pass your save, instead negate the effect entirely.
Other versions of this ability exist for Fortitude saves (stalwart), and Will saves (iron will).

bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.title: Recovery
bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.description: At the start of the creature's turn, if creature is still suffering from an effect from non-Permanent Status that affected it last turn, it ends the effect.

classes/healer/archetypes/mom/mom.html.title: Mom
classes/healer/archetypes/mom/mom.html.description:
Crust Moms exist to support their team outside of battle just as much as they do inside the battle.Mom can remove any tier 1 affliction with 1 hour of coddling.
You gain a unique T1 affliction (see Afflictions for more details). Other moms cannot remove this affliction with emotional support.When you initiate a grapple on an enemy, they are pacified for 1 round instead of the usual effects.By spending 1 mana as a standard action, you can grapple an ally to put them in stasis for 1 round and remove all shaken stacks.Mom says she doesn't play favorites, but we all know that’s a lie. Everybody must fight for Mom's favor. Mom keeps track of all the good things her children (everybody) do. This functions like God Benediction Points (see gods) with 3 tiers of favor. More details in the GBP section.
T1 good boys can innately use the upcast version of sending 1/day, but only to contact mom.
You get a unique +Profession🧑‍🌾 proficiency called Mom with a +4 bonus. You can use to to perform any type of mom-y activities, such as daycare services for children. Tangential/stereotypical features of momming, such as cooking, cleaning and other such things can use this skill, but do not receive the +4 bonus.Mom has a 6th sense for objects of significance, and often randomly picks them up for safekeeping. You can procure a specific item a creature once owned that someone mentions they misplaced, so long as you have been to a location it could be reasonably located. Ex. "Oh you guys went into Old Man's Cave? I remember going there once. Lost my wedding ring there." "This wouldn't happen to be it would it?"You can't use it to proactively search for something, like a secret entrance, or a sacred artifact, unless an ancient resurrected hero is missing their sword and it was last seen in a place you’ve been (and it wasn't closely guarded). This doesn't let you retrieve items that are in someone else's possession and the DM can choose to deny particularly unlikely circumstances.Recharges every Monday.You exude a palpable aura of love. Creature's find it difficult to harm you. Creatures who attempt to harm you must redirect their aggression for the remainder of their turn (will negates). This does not consume the action, but it does force them to alter it, such as attacking another creature, or excluding you from an AoE.Once a creature passes their save, or you deal damage, mom is on the menu and this aura is gone.
Mom can remove Tier 2 afflictions with emotional support.
Mom can remove Tier 3 afflictions with emotional support.

classes/magus/archetypes/thunderlord.htm.title: Thunderlord
classes/magus/archetypes/thunderlord.htm.description:
A thunderlord's specialty is disruption. Knocking people around with rushing wind and cacophonous attacks.Whenever you deal zap damage, sonic damage or crush damage from an air effect, you push the creature you damage 10 ft directly away from you. If the effect already pushed the creature, it pushes them an additional 10 ft.
Deal an additional d6+CL (3+CL) thunder damage and energize your foe On-hit for 1 round. They take an additional 2d6 (7) sonic damage if they move of their own volition, no matter the method.Strike an enemy, dealing no additional damage, but instead surrounding in a tempest that cuts into them as they move for one round. They take d8 (4) slashing damage for every 5 feet they move, no matter the method.
Despite not dealing any damage, this attack still procs Blown Away On-hit.At the start of your turn as a swift action, you can spend 1 mana to unleash powerful winds upon creatures within 10 ft of you, dealing 2d6 (7) crush damage (fort negates).If you spend 1 mana as an immediate action when you take damage, you can blast your attacker with a sonic blast if they are within 30 ft. They take 2d6+CL (7+CL) sonic damage (fort halves).

classes/mechanic/archetypes/pilot.html.title: Pilot
classes/mechanic/archetypes/pilot.html.description:
Pilots hop into their mechs and drive them around.Mechs must be one size category larger than you to use. In order for another creature to use your mech, they must roll a DC (20+your engineering bonus) to use it. Otherwise it is a very fancy hunk of metal to them.You are effectively treated as mounted on your mech while driving it. Any damage it takes depletes your hp and any effects targeting the mech target you (such as charming gaze). Any attacks it makes use your stats, etc. It is not a separate creature, but an extension of yourself. The only exceptions are Use the AC value of your mech while mounted in it. This can alter your Poise as well.
You use the listed Carry Weight of the mech. You do not count against this weight, but your equipment and items do.
Does not gain additional speed based on your DEX unless otherwise stated. At any point, you can eject from your mech as an instant action and appear in its space. Remounting requires a swift action, but cannot be done in the same turn you exit. Emergency exit needs to be manually recharged as a standard action while mounted to use again.Gain the pincers, sawblade or pea shooter augment as a bonus augment.Choose One

classes/mechanic/archetypes/suitor.html.title: Suitor
classes/mechanic/archetypes/suitor.html.description: Suitors wear their mech like it was a fancy suit of armor.Your mech is essentially a piece of full body armor shaped like you that you must enter to operate. It is form fitting and is operated by you physically moving your limbs. Once you put it on, you can activate it and deactivate it as an instant action 1/turn, causing it to either disappear or reappear. While it is deactivated, it leaves behind large distinct tattoos that look like wires, power sources or something similar behind.Usually because of this feature, there isn't much reason to get out of the mech outside of repairs. In order for another creature to use your mech, they must roll a DC (20+your engineering bonus) to use it. Otherwise it is a very fancy hunk of metal to them.Because your mech is a suit of armor, you can decide what type of armor it mimics (light, medium, heavy), provided you have the required strength.Many offensive suit augments require hands to utilize. Unlike a pilot who can get a more complex control scheme to activate additional limbs, you cannot use extra limbs to control the additional augments. If you take more than 2 hand augments, then you need to swap between or remove them using the Swap Item action. Hands consumed by augments can be used to hold/grab things, but cannot wield weapons/shields or perform fine manipulation. Ex. You can drag an ally to safety but you can't feed them a potion. You can open a door, but you cant lockpick it.Gain a hand augment.

classes/mechanic/mechanic.html.title: Mechanic
classes/mechanic/mechanic.html.description:
Crust Mechanics are engineers that put their heart and soul into their gadgets and gizmos, preferring one specific creation that they pilot into battle. They come in 2 main variants: pilots and suitors. Pilots are your typical mecha-style characters that hop into a larger robot and steer it around. Suitors have something more form fitting that augments their movement and fighting.
You have Martial Specialization. You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after. These technique points can be used on any martial technique tree.Mechanics start off with a specific type of mech, determined by archetype. The variety tends to come from how integrated it is into the mechanics themselves, such as a vehicle they pilot or a suit that augments themselves.
When you are defeated, this mech becomes unusable and requires repairing. This requires a (30-engineering roll) minutes (minimum 1) and appropriate tools. If you ever lose this mech, you can recreate it in (30-engineering roll) days (minimum 1) and 200g of materials like metals and comfy leather seats.Unless otherwise noted, all class features only function while mounted on/in mech.
Mechs have many powerful abilities that require the mechanic to gather power. This always has some kind of distinct audio and visual quality, such as revving engines, glowing chassis, steam erupting from every nook and cranny etc. You automatically fail +Stealth checks when charging, and creatures get a +20 bonus to +Perception👀 to notice you when charging. Rolling initiative resets your charge, requiring you to charge again.This mechanic (teehee) is designed to make it so you cannot use charge attacks on turn 1 of combat. Period. You can't use it as a surprise attack, preemptively charge and then enter combat etc. Hopefully this is airtight, but just in case, don't let players do this.Charging is a free action, but you cannot use a charge move in the same turn that you charge. Vise versa is also true; you cannot charge right after using a charge move. This usually makes every odd turn (1, 3, 5) a charge turn, and every even turn a charge attack turn, provided you have the actions and don't spend them doing other things.The terminology is a bit weird but there is a distinction between the class feature Charge and the general tag recharge. These 2 things do not interact. The mechanic has many of both types of abilities and neither interact with each others cool downs.
Abilities that require charge that are attack rolls count as special attacks.
You get Engineering🤖 as a bonus skill and a +4 bonus to it. Doesn't require mech.Gain 2 augments, one of which uses the charge feature. Augments are customizable features that can give you new abilities, add additional features to your mech's limbs and enhance your physical abilities.Gain an additional augment each even level.Some augments have level restrictions denoted by a number in (parenthesis).
Gain Point Blank Master.
As a standard action, closely examine an object or creature within 30 ft to get a +4 bonus on +Knowledge🧠 checks related to it.
You can choose a foe within 60 ft of as a swift action to hone in on a foe. Your attacks have seeking and you get a +2 bonus to attack against this foe until you dismisses this ability (free action). You automatically know the position of the creature, even if they turn Invisible or gain Total Cover.You can automatically lock on to a creature you scan, regardless if you succeed on the knowledge check. This ability does not negate cover for the purposes of attacking this foe, but you are still aware of the foe's position until it moves at least 300 ft away from you.You can lock on to only one creature at a time.

classes/mesmerist/archetypes/puppet-mast.title: Puppet Master
classes/mesmerist/archetypes/puppet-mast.description: This archetype replaces psychic implantsYou can take control of the body of a creature that gets defeated within 30 ft of you as an instant action if they are the target of your hypnotic stare, or you can redirect your stare as an immediate action if they aren't (will negates). When you take control, they gain (10+2*lvl) temp hp and you control them as the Domination spell until this temp hp is depleted, you no longer have line of sight to your puppet, you are unable to concentrate or 1 minute passes. The creature acts on your turn.

classes/mesmerist/mesmerist.html.title: Mesmerist
classes/mesmerist/mesmerist.html.description:
Mesmerists always have eye-catching irises, tattoos, masks or baubles to place more emphasis on their eyes. Through these special eyes, a mesmerist can see a creatures insecurities, or generate them where they otherwise wouldn’t exist, eroding a creatures will to make them more susceptible to their spells, skills and more.You have Magical Specialization You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another 2 points every 2 levels after. These technique points can be used on the Moogen and Shira trees.Characters with magical specialization gain points in wild card equal to their highest tier of magic technique and cantrips.You can focus your gaze on a creature within 30 ft as a swift action to apply a -2 penalty to their will saves. This lasts until the creature leaves this area, you are defeated or until you focus your gaze on another creature. This ability does not require the creature to meet your gaze.You can't use hypnotic stare while blinded. If facing a creature with a gaze attack, you must not avert your gaze, even partially, if you want to use your hypnotic stare against it.You have an eye for technique. Whenever a creature within 30 ft that you can see performs a technique, you can choose to memorize it as an instant action, provided it does not exceed the highest level technique you can cast. It takes up a companion slot while memorized instead of memory.You get the companion boost to attacks made with this technique.
You get advantage on saves against gaze attacks.Gain deception as a bonus skill with a +4 bonus.You don't need verbal components to cast spells, but to cast at all you need a still mind. You cannot cast spells while frightened, dominated or confused.Psychic implants are effects that linger in a creature's mind, from simple suggestions to something more sinister. You can spend one minute to insert a psychic implant as a standard action against a creature within 30 ft. At any point thereafter, you can activate the implant as an instant action.You mana burn while it is implanted, but when the implant ends, so to does the mana burn.Gain a psychic implant this level and another one at levels 4, 6, 8 and 10.
You can infuse your stare with figments that cause creatures to experience things that do not exist. Whenever a creature affected by your hypnotic stare takes +HP damage, you can apply the effect of one of your painful stares as an instant action.Usable once each turn.When you gain a psychic implant, you can choose to instead gain a choice from the list of painful stares.Creatures affected by your hypnotic stare take additional penalties. Choose one this level and at every four levels thereafter. All penalties apply simultaneously.You can detect creatures based off of an aura that you can physically see, even when the creature would otherwise be concealed. Gain a sight based blindsense (30 ft) while not using hypnotic stare.While using hypnotic stare, the creature cannot hide from you, even behind total cover. You see their aura through invisibility, fog etc.This ceases to function while you have blurred vision or you are blinded.As a standard action, you can touch a surface to see through it. You must spend a standard action each turn to maintain this sight, You can see through 1 ft of most substances, but only 1 inch of metal. You cannot see through surfaces with a thin sheet of lead in it. Some things, like piles, count as 1 continuous object.When you use copycat, you can choose to instantly use the technique they use by increasing its mana cost by 1. You lose any actions you spend on your next turn. If you can identify a spell before it is used (with arcana), it occurs before they use it.The range of hypnotic stare increases to 60 ft.

classes/necromancer/archetypes/medium.ht.title: Medium
classes/necromancer/archetypes/medium.ht.description:
Mediums go all in on casting. They also have several unique abilities that give them insight into the dead.You gain an additional 2 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after. The technique points can be spent on any magic tree.You gain +Religion proficiency and a +4 bonus.For 10 minutes your eyes glow with a chilling green aura. During this time you can speak to corpses of creatures with intact heads within 5 feet of you, asking 5 questions (in total, not to each creature) before the power fades.The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including languages. Answers are usually brief or cryptic. The corpse is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are hostile to it or it recognizes you as an enemy. The corpse can’t learn new information, doesn’t comprehend anything that has happened since it died, and can’t speculate about future events.
By placing an (almost complete) inanimate skeleton of a race🏁 in a creature's closet for 24 simultaneous hours, you can divine things from the skeleton afterwards.You can speak directly to the skeleton and it will tell you details about the creature. These are things that the creature is ashamed of, and goes out of its way to hide and lie about.The creature must be a current resident of the home you place the skeleton into.Touch a dead creature to perceive what happened during the last minute it was alive and conscious.Alternatively project your senses through one of the undead you control for 10 up to minutes. You can continue to give your minions orders while you observe. You can speak using your voice or a raspier one more appropriate for an undead creature.You can initiate contact with spirits of the dead that reside in the Underworld. To do so you need a few things... An artifact of significance to the creature, such as a weapon, trinket or family picture. The creature's full name 1 minute of uninterrupted concentration If you meet the conditions, and the creature's spirit is not trapped in some way (including inside of a living body) then the spirit temporarily inhabits your body, up to 10 minutes. If the ritual fails, you know why, such as the artifact not being of enough significance, the creature being alive etc. You lose access to your body, only viewing the events as though a passenger in your own body, therefore requiring a 3rd party to do the interacting with the spirit. The creature speaks in its own voice, but otherwise moves and interacts with the physical world via your body.
Whether or not a spirit is interested in speaking changes drastically from person to person. Some spirits will be happy to be able to speak with loved ones, and others will immediately leave at the sight of a past enemy. A +Persuasion check is usually in order before the spirit leaves.
The spirit is mostly limited to only what they knew in life, and they are still able to fully articulate their thoughts as though they were of sound mind. Little information about the Mortal Realm passes into The Underworld, and less still reaches the ears of the average spirit.
By spending 2 mana as an immediate action when a creature dies within 60 ft of you, you can choose to seal the creatures soul inside of a staff you wield. A tiny spectral cage forms at its tip with a miniature version of the creatures spirit inside. Until the the cage is opened with +Sleight of Hand, or you cage a new soul, the spirit is trapped inside of your staff.While trapped the spirit remains conscious and can perceive the world around it as it did in life. You can converse with the spirit, and you can silence it if it gets to loud.
When you animate dead, you can choose to set its LvL to 3 and have it not consume a companion slot. You are allowed to give it a singular order at the time of creation that it fulfills until it is destroyed.

classes/necromancer/archetypes/restless-.title: Restless Spirit
classes/necromancer/archetypes/restless-.description:
A restless spirit is a more bruiser that is designed to get in there an whack some fools. Filled with supernatural abilities that You have Martial Specialization. You gain an additional technique point at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after. The technique points can be used on any martial tree.
Shortened to DoD. Gain a pool of (4+2*LvL) to use for many of your class abilities. All abilities marked DoD cost 1 point.
By spending 1 mana a swift action, make a Thrown attack. On-hit apply a tether linking you and the target creature. At the end of your turn it takes 2d6+CL (7+CL) necrotic damage and you heal an equal amount. This tether lasts 3 up to 3 rounds. If the creature moves more than 60 feet from you, the tether breaks.When you miss, or when the tether breaks, this ability cannot be used again on your next 2 turns.
When you are defeated, you can instead choose not to be. Your body vanishes and transforms into an incorporeal and invincible spirit version of yourself, cleansing all non-permanent status. While in this form you can continue to float around the battlefield with a 30 ft hover speed. At the end of your 4rd turn defying death, you return to life at 50% of your max hp.
While in this form you can move and speak, but you can only take 2 actions: simple melee attack, or drain hope. They have unique effects while defying death. Melee attacks reduce a creatures speed by 15 on hit, but deals no damage. Drain hope immediately recharges when you enter death defied, and has its resource cost removed. It does not deal damage or heal you, but for each round you drain, you return to life 1 turn sooner.
After you use death defied, you acquire a unique Tier 3 Affliction and Drain Hope immediately recharges.Hades' Watchful Eye - You cannot use death defied.Cure - You must pay your respects to the god of death. This requires performing a 1 week ritual in a place of worship dedicated to Hades, or spending 1 week tidying up places where the dead are kept.
You can use the cleave Special Attack any number of times each combat. It is not limited to only slashing weapons. The first time you land a melee attack each round, gain a stack. When you have 2 stacks, your next attack gets the following bonuses. You can choose not to unleash this attacks power when you attack to save it for a more suitable moment.
Get a +10 bonus to attack. The attack echoes to nearby enemies. Targets all enemies within 10 ft of the original target. If the attack already hits multiple targets (like with cleave), then it cannot strike the same target twice.
You can let your spirit temporarily leave your body as a standard action. When you do, you immediately dash and become an Invincible Incorporeal spirit, similar to death defied. Your body remains in the position you used this ability from.At the end of your turn, your body teleports to the position of your spirit.
You can apply a curse to an enemy by spending 2 mana as a swift action. The curse has no effect until the creature is defeated or killed. When such condition is filled, its spirit briefly leaves its body and fights by your side. The spirit uses all of the creatures stats, but it can only use its multiattack, or make a single simple attack.
It spawns with only 50% of its max +HP and disappears after 1 minute. The spirit persists even if the creature recovers from the defeated condition or death. A spirit can only spawn from a creature once each day.
If you are not present when the spirit is summoned, you receive a mental alert and can immediately begin scrying and control the spirit. If you already have 2 companion slots filled because of your undead, one is put in stasis until the spirit leaves.The curse is removed by touching a gravestone and saying "F."
Your weapon attacks, natural attacks and unarmed attacks gain additional damage equal to their damage dice. Examples: 2h weapon @1=2d8, @6=4d8, @11=6d8 Light Weapon @1=d6, @6=2d6, @11=3d6
You can use wraith walk as a swift action, and can maintain wraith form for up to 3 turns. When you move directly through a creature, it becomes Sickened 2 (fort negates).Youuuuu

classes/necromancer/necromancer.html.title: Necromancer
classes/necromancer/necromancer.html.description:
A necromancer's primary power is the ability to give new life to corpses, adding them to their squad of undead minions. Their favorite spells aid their minions, use them as ammunition or simply kill creatures. Their other abilities aid them in gathering information through their undead or dead creatures. Some necromancers choose to sit back and let their minions do the work, and others lead them into battle.Archetype determines base stats.You have Magical Specialization You gain 1 technique point at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after.
These points must be used on the Necromancy💀 tree.Characters with magical specialization gain points in wild card equal to their highest tier of magic technique and cantrips.
Spend 1 mana to cast Animate Dead, but creatures are 1/2 your level instead of 1/3 (min 0). You start off with a single creature that you used this ability on. The creature must have been level 1 or lower. You can only control 2 undead, as per the companion system. Any in excess are automatically destroyed. As you advance in level, so do your created undead.
You do not Mana Burn from your undead. With a 3 round ritual, you can cause an adjacent destroyed undead creature you created to reform at full hp. You can also use this on undead you haven't created, but the creature has its own autonomy and memory. Undead companions are also healed to full hp if adjacent to you. You can perform either of these rituals on multiple undead creatures at once As a standard action, you can stare down a creature/object to find out a handful of details about them.
Alive, dead, neither (Undead💀, Constructs🤖, object etc.) If not dead, current and max hp. If dead, how long have they been dead. Determine if something is even a dead creature (such as a pile of ash).
Gain necril as a bonus language.
All of your controlled undead share your teamwork feats.
Gain resistance to necrotic damage.
Temporarily gain control over an undead creature. Functions as the Domination spell (will negates), but it can only target undead within 10 ft of you, it only lasts 3 rounds max and it does not share the spell's tags. Against minions and mindless undead that are not companions this has no save.
Lifesense 10 ft.
Your rejuvenation activates on yourself automatically after you die, bringing you back to life at 50% hp in 3 rounds. Creatures that succeed on a DC 30 +Religion or Arcana check can either interrupt this ritual or banish the spirits automatically as a standard action while within reach of your corpse.

classes/psychic/archetypes/fate-spinner/.title: Curses
classes/psychic/archetypes/fate-spinner/.description:
The goal here is to create things that both have some kind of general mechanical benefit while also having some kind of role play to the curse.You’re just a kid. Those afflicted with the child curse can never grow up. They have the minds of someone much older than they appear mixed with an odd assortment of child-like tendencies and interests. Benefit - You are one size category smaller than what is normal for your race. Your apparent age cannot be magically altered, even through polymorph effects.
Drawback - Whenever you try to appeal to authority to someone unfamiliar with your curse, you take a -2 penalty to any Skill Check related. You take a -2 penalty to poise. You love people. Those afflicted with the empathetic curse consider most people their friends, and find it difficult to treat others harshly, even those on the other side of the battlefield. Woe to he who makes an enemy of an empathetic oracle.
Benefit - When you cast a spell or use an ability to restore +HP, it heals an additional 3 HP. Whenever you defeat a creature, they instead gain the time out condition. Drawback - You are physically unable to intentionally and knowingly kill living creatures, even when magically compelled to do so. You can't leave a creature defeated in a dangerous scenario. Special - In scenarios where compulsively healing people equates to suicide (such as in a warzone) you can ignore the compulsion to save lives. You live for someone else. Those afflicted with the follower curse have separation anxiety turned up to 11. Whoever they are bound to is burdened with the undying loyalty of their companion.
Benefit - Choose another creature to form a permanent bond with. You can move in tandem with them if you have the movement. You can choose to be the target of a harmful effect targeting your bond as an instant action. If the effect is AoE and would target both of you, you can instead choose to automatically have them pass while you automatically fail. You get a +10 bonus to any skill checks related to your bond (+Medicine💉 to first aid, +Perception👀 to tell if someone is disguised as them etc). You can innately cast Reincarnate, but only targeting your bond. It also function on them if they are dead.
Drawback - If you have not seen your bond for 1 minute, you are shaken 1. This is considered Permanent Status as long as your bond is not around. If you have not seen your bond for 1 hour, you are shaken 3. If you have not seen your bond for 1 day, you receive the prior penalties and cannot do anything other than search for them unless physically prevented from doing so. In the event you are shown convincing evidence that your bond is dead, you attempt to use resurrection magic to get them back. If that is impossible, you are shaken 3 for one week before you must select a new curse, or a new bond. Can you quit moving? Those afflicted with the frenetic curse are excellent multitaskers. They’re always pacing around and touching things when they do anything.
Benefit - You get a +4 bonus to AC when provoking an AoO. Increase your Land Speed by 10.
Drawback - You must move at least 10 feet every round. You cannot take 20. If you cannot move, such as while grappled, you take 3 true damage at the end of your turn. You love to give to others. Those afflicted with the generous curse always tip, always take the tab and will gladly buy things for others. Benefit - Any money that you donate to charity or pay with the curses drawback is put into a “good will” fund. At any time you can call upon this fund to have some non magic positive (and somewhat realistic) occurrence to happen of your choosing. For example you could have a pair of horses delivered to you in your hour of need, then subtract the cost of two horses from your fund. If you sell these gifts then your good will fund immediately depletes and goes negative equal to double the gold gained from selling the gifts. Drawback - Whenever you spend gold (not including your good will), you spend an additional 20% more gold to make whoever you’re paying happy. You cannot intentionally and knowingly steal money or possessions from others, or participate in plans to do so. Special - Some scenarios related to this curse are left up to interpretation. If you wanna make a cool heist mission where you're stealing from a tomb then you can realistically make an exception. But if you’re just casting buffs on a rogue while they rob people blind, that’s a no go. Realistic for the benefit just means no milk delivery when cows are extinct. If the player can come up with a creative way to get what they want, then you should give it to them, or increase the cost. You just can't help but speak the truth. Those afflicted with the honest curse are rarely trusted with secrets. Their honesty is seen as a virtue to many, but it gets them into trouble quite often when they suddenly start getting quiet, or worse, when they run their mouth.
Benefit - When you surpass the DC of an +Insight🤔 check to Convince Truth by 5, they automatically blurt out the truth. You get a +5 bonus on checks to convince truth. Drawback - You cannot knowingly tell a lie. Not even a half-truth. You are compelled to answer questions to the best of your knowledge. The best you can do to not reveal your deepest secrets is to not speak at all. Your mind is often filled with lustful thoughts. Those afflicted with the horny curse often tell dirty jokes and hit on anything with a pulse. Worse yet they tend to have deviant tastes. Benefit - You gain post nut clarity. After nutting/helping someone achieve nut, you may glean information from your intimate bond. You effectively ask a question and receive an answer in three or less words. The subject does not know you gleaned this information. Drawback - Your partner also gets to glean information about you with the same restrictions. You know what they gleaned. Who are you? Those afflicted with the identity crisis curse are really good at not being themselves. Thoughtful parents give their lil’ curse bearers unisex names.
Benefit - You can assume the form of any race🏁 with a duration of one hour 1/day. It doesn’t affect your racial features. You cannot choose to look like the other you (see drawback). Drawback - Every monday morning you wake up as a new person, swapping between two different people. In your head you’re still you, but you look completely different. You still stay the same race, but you swap genders, change size and shape, eye color, all the above and more! You take a -5 penalty to any skill check to convince someone that you're still you if they haven't experienced both yous a few times or aren't a close friend, family etc. You just want to be alone. Those afflicted with the loner curse are physically drained when in the presence of other people, and thrive when left to their own devices. Confrontation is terrible, especially when they have to do the confronting.
Benefit - You get a +2 bonus to saving throws when you aren't being threatened and no allies are adjacent to you. When you aren't in the presence of other creatures you get a +2 bonus to skill checks. Something like a familiar, companion creature or a pet can be a reasonable exception.
Drawback - You take a -2 penalty to any opposed skill check. You cannot benefit from or provide flanking. You cannot perform or benefit from the Aid action. You’d love to chat, if only you could. Those afflicted with the mute curse cannot speak, but are much better at developing intimate connections with those you physically interact with. Benefit - You can cast spells while silenced. You learn sign language as a bonus language. You can telepathically communicate via touch. Your communication happens simultaneously to all creatures touched. While in direct contact with someone, you have advantage on skill checks against them. Drawback - You have no idea how bad things really are. Those afflicted with the oblivious curse have things fly right over their heads all the time, sometimes to their benefit!
Benefit - You get a +4 bonus versus fear effects. You get a +4 bonus to AC and saving throws until you act in combat. These bonuses stack. Whenever making a saving throw out of combat, also add these bonuses.
Drawback - You take a -4 penalty on +Perception👀 and +Insight🤔. You do not gain perception as a skill. You cannot gain perception or insight as skills from any source. You share your body…Literally! Those afflicted with the possessed curse have another creature's spirit inhabiting their body. Luckily this spirit has a sense of self-preservation, but it does like having some personal space…Your personal space.
Benefit - When you are stunned, Dazed, Defeated or suffering from a similar kind of status effect that prevents you from acting, you can still do anything that only requires the use of a single arm (such as drink potions, swing a one-handed weapon or manipulate an object). You still cannot cast spells while CC’d. You have a speed of 5 feet while suffering from such conditions. Drawback - You only have access to one of your arms. Your off-hand cannot be used to wear a shield, wield a weapon or perform complex tasks that generally require two hands. Special - The DM and player should consider the creature that is possessing the limb and perhaps during special moments, or while doing something the possessor likes, the spirit concedes control of the limb to its original owner. You’re always dwelling on the past. Those afflicted with the retrospective curse constantly reminisce about the great things that happened in their past. By the same token, the negative events that happen to them weigh heavy on their mind for much longer than most.
Benefit - You are immune to effects that magically alter your memory. You recall everything you have ever experienced with perfect clarity. You can innately cast Memory Movie at-will (self only).
Drawback - When you are suffering from an affliction, any numeric penalties are doubled. If it does not have a numerical penalty, it takes twice as long, or costs twice as much as normal to cure because the memory of your tragedies are so vivid. You recover 1 stack of drain every 2 days instead of 1 each day. You hate x people. Those afflicted with the racist curse generally have a disdain for creatures that don’t look and talk like them. They channel this distaste into hatred for a few in particular.
Benefit - Choose 3 +Races🏁. When in combat against them, increase your Land Speed to 120. You have Advantage on any opposed skill checks against these creatures, so long as such interactions can be considering "unfriendly." (aka, no persuasion or something like it)
Drawback - As long as a creature of this race is standing, you must end each of your turns threatening one if you are physically able. You must use all of your actions to harm and impede these creatures. If you can't, then you dash to move closer to them. You're like brothers, only closer. Those afflicted with the twinned curse come with a +1. They have 2 heads and share control over the body.
Benefit - You have a commoner attached to you that matches your LvL. You have primarily control of your body and your head has no actions of its own, but can still sense normally and speak. This gives you access to 3 more skills, one of which must be +Profession🧑‍🌾, and potentially new race features. As an instant action, your other half can shove you 5 ft 1/minute. They can also perform simple interactions such as grabbing things, opening doors etc using this same cooldown. Drawback - You must concede control of your body in order to use these bonus skills/race features. This requires a free action. Your other head can concede control similarly, or you can forcefully take control by making your other half pass a will save 1/minute. You can also shove them. When your other head is in control it uses its own stat array, skill bonuses, racial features etc. This happens automatically while you are sleeping and the other head isn't, though most loud/physical activities will wake you up. Special - Because this curse requires cooperation, using it to fuse with enemies can be very challenging. Proceed with caution.

classes/psychic/archetypes/fate-spinner/.title: Fate Spinner
classes/psychic/archetypes/fate-spinner/.description:
Many people wish they could see the future, but the fate spinners are the only ones who truly understand the nature of this burden. Fate spinners are frequently humbled by their power to see into the future and the struggle to change it. You gain unique boons with drawbacks associated with them, and a deck of cards to twist fate with on a whim.Draw a card from your deck as a swift action. See card results for more details.Fatespinners, oracles and the like tend to draw the ire from the gods for meddling with the future. They each suffer from a unique curse that provides them with unique challenges and benefits. See the curses section for more details.Your mind is plagued by visions of the future. During carefully curated rituals, speaking in tongues, wild highs on psychoactive drugs or delivered in dreams, you receive premonitions about future events. These premonitions generally focus on great tragedies soon to befall subjects that are relevant to you. This could be important people, places of significance, valuable artifacts, ancient evils and other such things.As far as fine mechanics go, the ritual requires at least one hour of uninterrupted concentration. Generally the subject of these premonitions are focused around a specific subject, sometimes of your choosing, sometimes not. The premonitions are not required to give a precise answer.This next part is as much for the DM as it is the player.As an example. You could divine things about the organization causing strife in this city. "Suddenly you are far away in the nation's capital city. You see brief flashes of the decorations of the summer festival, and a dark amorphous blob moving through the streets. You see many silhouettes moving into the kings castle. The only discernible detail you can see from them is an insignia on the hood of their robes. You hear a voice. 'Today is the day the tyrant is killed.' And then the vision transforms into a beautiful oasis filled with winged horses, before quickly fading."Some important takeaways… You ALWAYS focus on the event, not the outcome. In order to be a premonition given to presumably change the future, the information must be actionable. (the king is danger!) You ALWAYS know the WHEN of the event, down to the minute. Other details like where and who can be discovered. (its happening during the summer festival!) You ALWAYS receive some kinds of sensory clues. Voices, symbols, colors, smells, temperature must be present. (robed figures with a noticeable insignia, some large black ooze and the voice of someone important) You ALWAYS receive something that you can affect within the prescribed time. Either the vision tells you about something nearby,or the vision also includes similar types of clues for how you might get to these faraway places. (you'd never be able to get there in time…unless you could fly using a pegasus) As for the [recharge] tag. Depending on the pacing of your campaign, your premonitions might reveal information regarding events that are to happen within weeks, months or years. Generally a fate spinner should have a premonition once each major story arc. No matter what though, a fate spinner cannot have premonitions about a new subject before the events of his current premonition transpire.If you or your DM deem this ability too annoying or disruptive for play...gain an extra technique point and then another each odd level.Fatespinners have an innate sense of how far they can push fate before fate pushes back. You gain a pool of 10 luck. Whenever you add luck to a roll, you can choose to add any amount of this luck pool to the roll. You can add this luck after you fail a check, with your GM telling you how much is needed to pass the check.This pool resets to 10 when you rest.You can push your luck, going negative up to 10 points. Whenever you do, you gain a unique affliction.T3 Affliction: Out of Luck - You cannot add luck to your rolls.Cure - Pay homage to the gods to make up for meddling in their affairs. You must do this a number of days equal to your negative luck pool when you gained this affliction. Paying homage can include spending time at a place of worship or assisting leaders of a religion.Note: Because you can no longer add luck to rolls with this affliction, you also cannot use your fated luck pool. This means when you go negative, even if only -1, you cannot then later choose to go even more negative.
Choose one card result from the fortunetelling ability to remove from the pool. You replace it with a level 1 Spell you can memorize with a few restrictions... The spell cannot already be listed.
The spell cannot target an enemy or be AoE and include enemies
The spell cannot be Upcast
The spell cannot deal +HP damage The action to use the spell must be a standard, swift or free action
You must specify a particular use of the spell. This use can be slightly outside of the parameters of the spell. Such as "use Sending to send a status update to my mother in emojis" or "affect an ally with the Tentacles for Arms spell" Every even level after this, you can select a new effect to replace in your deck, and the maximum spell level you can replace increases by 1, up to 3. You can see the silvery thread that floats above a creatures head, connecting them to the heavens above. This thread is loosely connected to other people, locations and objects. Unless a creature is also a fate spinner, you can wrap this thread around your finger without bringing much attention to yourself while within 10 ft of them, tethering you to the creature. While tethered... You can always follow this thread to lead you to this person. The thread is ethereal and ignores physical terrain, leading in a direct line to this creature, causing potential problems when tracking someone in a dense building, underground or on the other side of world. When in the presence of people, places or objects of significance to the creature, you can see faint threads connecting their tether to them. The tethered creature remembers you very clearly from any previous encounter you had with them after, even events that happened before the tether. You can only tether to a single creature at a time, losing any previous ties if you tether a new creature.

classes/psychic/archetypes/spy/glass-ref.title: Glass Reflection
classes/psychic/archetypes/spy/glass-ref.description:
This ability comes online at level 1, and improves at levels 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10.By performing a 1 hour ritual using a reflective surface, such as a mirror or a pool of water, you can see and hear remote locations. To do so you must name a specific creature you have met personally (Zeus, Jake from State Farm, Boo the miniature giant space hamster). You see the target creature as though you were floating overhead, using your own senses (will negates). Your vision radius is limited to only 10 ft around the target, but you can hear things as though you were present.Passing a save against Glass Reflection (GR) gives the target an eerie feeling that they're being watched. Failing means they are unaware.Possessing a personal possession of the creature (a book, weapon, article of clothing) gives them a -2 penalty to their save. Possessing a piece of the creature, such as a hair or some of their blood, gives them a -4 penalty. These penalties do not stack.The range of this ability is finite. Generally speaking it should only function on creatures within city limits. This generally means it has a range of a few miles. You can spy on a creature for 10 minutes before the senor disappears. You can speak telepathically to creatures visible in your GR.You cannot target an unwilling creature with GR more than 1/day. A creature who has passed a save against your GR before always gets a perception check to see signs of magical spying with a DC (20+lvl) perception check when you initiate it. Without ways of interacting with magic they can do little to stop you, but they know you're there.
By contacting a creature ahead of time (such as via sending), you can automatically scry on a willing target without accepting mana burn.The first use of Glass Reflection each day does not mana burn.Any effects that prevent or otherwise interact with [scrying] effects also interact with GR. You don't need to have personally met the target of your spying, but you do still need to know their name The range of this effect increases to state. If you're within the same state, it works. This generally means a few dozen miles. You get a +4 bonus to perception while scrying a creature You gain nightvision during GR You no longer need to know the name of the creature you spy on, but you do need some kind of vague idea of who they are. Something like "the guild leader of the Fox Force" or "the orc general" suffices. The range of this ability increases to country. This generally means hundreds of miles You can spy on a creature for 1 hour The GR ritual only takes 10 minutes The range of this ability increases to continent. This generally means a thousands of miles The vision radius increases to 20ft around the target You gain darkvision during GR Creatures you have successfully GR'd before have disadvantage on saving throws and perception checks against GR You can use GR on creatures on the entire planet, other planets and other planes of existence You can spy on a creature until you rest The GR ritual only takes 1 minute The GR ritual only takes 1 standard action The vision radius limit is removed completely
You are constantly under the effects Glimpse of Truth while using GR

classes/psychic/archetypes/spy/spy.html.title: Spy
classes/psychic/archetypes/spy/spy.html.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-search" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><circle r="8" cy="11" cx="11"></circle><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"></path></svg>
classes/psychic/archetypes/spy/spy.html.description:
The spy is primarily concerned with information gathering and can do so in many ingenious ways. Their signature ability is the most powerful and versatile scrying effect in the entire game, allowing them to witness people and locations from the safety of their home.This ability and its progression are pretty complicated. See Glass Reflection subsection for details.As long as you have a clear view of a creature and you understand the language that it's speaking, you need not hear it to understand it.
Choose a level 0 creature among Fiends👿, Celestials👼 or Fey, or create a Beast Companion🐶 that is always tiny. It's level is always 0. If it aids you in combat, it gains the companion tag. You can also use your familiar to do a handful of other useful things.
Spying scrying - You can sense through your companion at will.
Assistant - Your companion can use the aid action to assist you for any skill checks.
To My Side teleportation - You can concentrate as a standard action for 3 rounds to teleport your companion to your side.
When a creature fails a save against an effect you inflict, it willingly accepts the benefits of one of your spells, or you land an attack, you can affect the creature as though you had successfully cast detect thoughts on them as an immediate action. You briefly gain insight into their current plans, something that weighs heavily on their mind, or whatever seems most relevant at the time.
Alternatively, you can roll a +Knowledge🧠 check (including +Monster Lore📖) using the creatures bonus. You intuitively know what knowledge skills it possesses.
Get a +2 bonus to +Perception👀.
You can pluck out your eye as a standard action and have it hover around autonomously with a Fly speed of 40 on each of your turns. It has a tether range of 300 ft. You can pop it back into your head as an instant action if it moves into your space. You can simultaneously see through both your eye and your detached eye without mental strain.
The eye is blurry and insubstantial so it always has Partial Concealment. To perceive it, creatures need to make a DC 20 perception check, or DC 10+your +Stealth bonus.It shares all of your statistics and is treated as you for all targeting purposes. AoE effects targeting both you and your eye only affect you once.
You are persistently under the effect of Detect Thoughts allowing you to always peer into the thoughts of others. It loses the concentration tag and gains the buff tag. If gain another buff, you can reactivate detect thoughts as a swift action.

classes/psychic/archetypes/disco.html.title: Disco
classes/psychic/archetypes/disco.html.description:
Your psyche is fragmented, rendering some parts of your brain inaccessible. This allows them to develop thoughts on their own, and chime in with their own insights when the situation calls for it. As a result, disco psychics are able maintain multiple trains of thought, giving unique insights into situations that surpass leaps of logic and enter the realm of the supernatural.Your mind is fragmented into 4 different parts: The self, the body, instinct and intellect. Each part of your mind is special in its ability to focus on specific things. The self is related to CHA, and represents an aspect of yourself that gets along with others. Things such as cooperation, empathizing and commanding others.
The body is related to STR/DEX, and represents an aspect of yourself that interacts with material reality. Repairing or breaking things, flexing on people and sleight of hand.
Instinct is related to WIS, and represents an aspect of yourself that can see the unseen. Things such as gut feelings and hunches.
Intellect is related to INT, and represents an aspect of yourself that knows information. Things such as logic, mathematics and knowledge.
As an instant action before you roll a skill check, spend 1 mana to add a d8 to it. If you fail the check, you Mana Burn 1. You cannot use this when you take 10/take 20. The fragments of your mind have much to say, but they can be pushed even further beyond. You can choose to invoke a particular fragment of your psyche by having a brief conversation with it for a minute. Roll a d8 and add the key ability score (choosing between str or dex as appropriate for the situation for the body). If the final result totals 6 or higher, you learn a far greater amount of information that you otherwise would have, or succeed in some other superlative fashion. If you fail, you glean nothing.For example if you invoke the self during a war meeting to convince an enemy to agree to an armistice you might get something like... "The general is in a very difficult position. All the posturing and propaganda surrounding the war could fall apart if he agrees to this armistice. Worse yet, he could appear weak to his people; A death sentence to any military career, and this mans ambitions are high. If you want to convince him to an armistice, you need to do so in a way that doesn't shatter his reputation. Perhaps you should bring up that common enemy you have both been on the hunt for."Another example if you invoke intellect in order to detect any patterns in an ongoing investigation on some wanted criminal you might get something like... "You are looking at the map and suddenly it all clicks. A circle! The attacks are all happening in cities along the outskirts in the country's territory. It reminds you of a much larger version of the circles you've seen with the cultists. The only part left of the circle is the center...The capital!"In any case, you receive a large degree of information that might be available to your character, or can be gleaned from the clues you have seen up until this point, but might not click in your head as a player.Your GM may want to assign bonuses or penalties based on circumstances. A -1 for previously insulting the general or +1 for studying the magic circles in a library to use the previous examples.Note: The GM is the final arbiter in deciding whether or not you can invoke psyche at all. For example, you cannot invoke intellect to figure out who is the leader of a secret organization you know nothing about session 1.You can invoke aspects of your psyche to perform incredibly unusual feats. You gain an invocation at level 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10. Each one is color coded to decide which stat applies.Shivers - The wind holds omens of the future, and you can feel it. You always invoke shivers when you want to find something. When you successfully invoke instinct with shivers, you get insight into the type of place whatever it is you are looking for is. You usually must still put clues together in order to narrow it down.Schizophrenia - The world itself speaks to you. You always invoke schizophrenia on objects of great significance. When you successfully invoke schizophrenia, the chosen object speaks to you. The frame of time it does so varies, but it typically only does so for 1 sitting. The object can relay information about creatures that have interacted with it in the past, like a piano of a musician or a sword of an ancient hero.Visualization - Reshape the scene. You always invoke visualization to piece together how something played out based on physical traces left behind. When you successfully invoke visualization, you can re-imagine an event as it happens, with the vague silhouettes of creatures and objects moving in real time to allow you to determine details like size, shape, sequence and direction.Activation - Start your engines. You always invoke activation in order to activate something. This could mean some kind of complex machine you normally couldn't make heads or tails of, how to open a door with no obvious handle or swing open a portcullis from outside of a fort. Activation may require a specific position or suitable tool to get full value.Mirror - Watch how it's done. You always invoke the mirror when you want to copy someone. You can mimic someones ability to quell an animal, speak a language or perform some type of skill. In any case, your mirror neurons can only do their magic if you have witnessed a creature in action within the last 10 minutes. You mimic the degree of success you witnessed, can speak the language for the duration of a conversation and otherwise temporarily mimic some behavior.Encyclopedia - Master of all trivia. You can invoke encyclopedia whenever you wish, and your brain produces random tidbits of information. When you succeed, you receive relatively detailed information about something specific, though it may not be what you were hoping for...Roll a luck check.Lets pretend you are walking around a museum cataloguing ancient monsters called "Big Beasties" 1-6 - Your brain produces information completely unrelated to the situation at hand. Encyclopedia decides to inform you about a loving relationship between a lady and a giant ape. 7-13 - Your brain produces information tangentially relevant to the situation at hand. Encyclopedia tells you about other large creatures that exist and how the specimens you're looking at stack up to them. 14-20 - Your brain produces rather precise information about the situation at hand. Encyclopedia informs you about one of the specimens and its historical significance while it was still living.

classes/psychic/archetypes/telekineticis.title: Telekineticist
classes/psychic/archetypes/telekineticis.description:
The telekineticist is most concerned with how their mental mastery can affect the physical world. They can manifest these psychic powers through telekinetic projections, both visible and invisible, to move things with their mind.As a standard action you attack a foe within 30 ft by flinging an sharp, pointy or heavy object at them. The attack uses either str or dex as your attacking stat. If the creature is within reach, it can be a melee or ranged attack. If the creature is out of reach, it counts as a ranged attack. It's damage is 2d6+str/dex, increasing by d6 at level 3, and another d6 every odd level. The damage type is determined by the type of object you throw at your enemy.If the item has some kind of additional effect when thrown, such as if it is an Alchemical Items, the effect only targets the creature, even if it is normally AoE.
You gain the mage hand cantrip and can use it for +Sleight of Hand.
As a free action, you can manifest a large hand that hovers within 30 ft of you. This hand can manipulate objects and carry you and your allies, but it cannot attack. It can lift (400+100*CL) lbs. Any actions it takes consumes yours, including movement. The hand must end your turn at ground level if you ride it.Start each day with (5+lvl) temp hp that lasts forever. You can recharge this barrier as a standard action by spending 1 mana.While your forcefield persists, any on hit effects have no effect (such as bleed damage on a katana). Even if the hit breaks the barrier, dealing hp damage, the on hit effects do not apply.You permanently gain a hover speed equal to your land speed. You can hover sideways up walls or upside down on ceilings by adding the [concentration] tag.As a free action, spend 1 mana. You can cause your Master hand to not consume your actions for 1 turn, allowing it to move and pick things up, but not to attack.Take hold of a creature within 30 ft with your telekinesis and toss them 20 ft in any direction, dealing your blast damage (fort negates). You can toss the target at a specific creature with an attack roll to deal blast damage to them too.The damage dice of your telekinetic blast increases to d8
You can create a 10x10ft wall made out force anywhere within 30 ft, even in mid air, though not in any occupied space. It is a transparent tangible barrier that can be seen through, but creatures, objects and effects cannot pass through. It has (5*LvL) hp. By sacrificing 5 of the walls hp, you can increase one dimension by 5 feet.As a swift action, you can create a 5x5 wall that has 5 hp.
You are persistently under the effect of the telekinetic maneuver spell, as though it was a prepared technique, allowing you to toss others around whenever.As a standard action, you can pick up unattended objects within 30 ft of you and cause them to swirl around you in a chaotic storm of debris for 1 minute. Creatures within 10 ft of you take 4d6 (14) slash, crush or pierce dmg, depending on what objects you pick up. This damage happens when a creature enters, starts or its turn in the area, but not both.The damage dice of your elemental blast increases to d10

classes/psychic/psychic-(c).html.description:
Psychics take literally the advice "you can do anything you put your mind to" by bending reality with the power of their mind. Psychics are concerned with all matters related to the internal mental states of creatures. Some focus on manipulating objects, others gaze into the minds of creatures and some can even gaze into the future.You have Magical Specialization. You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after.
These technique points can be used on the Psionics🤯 or Ligma tree.
You don't need verbal components to cast spells, but to cast at all you need a still mind. You cannot cast spells while frightened, dominated or confused.
Gain additional Mana Reserves equal to (3+LvL). All abilities marked MM cost 1 mana.
Remove all shaken stacks from yourself as a swift action.
You can Reroll a save against any Mind-Affecting effect as an immediate action.
Gain the telepathy monster quality. You can initiate telepathic conversation with any creature that fails a save against your abilities, even if you cant see them.Choose 5 creatures within 30 ft of you to establish a telepathic bond with. The group can telepathically communicate with each other freely over any distance, even if the bonded creatures cannot see each other. Any can choose to speak to only 1 specific creature they are bonded to, or the whole group. Lasts until rest.
You have Iron Will.
You can concentrate on 2 effects with the concentration tag at once.
Thoughtsense (10 ft).

classes/wizard/archetypes/chronomancer.h.title: Chronomancer
classes/wizard/archetypes/chronomancer.h.description:
Chronomancers manipulate time and space.You must select God Mode⏰ as your technique tree used with cutting edge.
Whenever you roll a Skill Check or +Saving Throw, reality branches into two possible outcomes for you. While not in combat, you can rewind to the moment just before you rolled this check and roll it with Advantage to try and reach the alternate timeline.You can also do this if you simply say or do something that you wish to undo.
You can only do this for rolls that happened within the last minute. If you drain 10, you can ignore the recharge tag.
Gain the +History skill with a +4 bonus.Your apparent age is always as though you were incredibly old, regardless of how old you actually are. Get rekt lmao
Whenever you affect an ally with a beneficial spell, like Cure Wounds or Astral Infusion, you can spend 3 mana as an instant action to also affect them with the Fast Forward spell. You can only affect 1 ally with beneficial AoE effects.
The timelines briefly converge, giving you access to another version of yourself that comes to your aid under a very specific condition. By spending 10 minutes scanning the multiverse, you can come up with a very specific set of instructions for yourself when the time is right. This essentially acts as a Prepare action that you set well in advance, but it can only be used to cast a Spell of up to level 3.While this spell is contingent, you are mana burned equal to its level. This contingency manifests as a timepiece that must exist in a visible position on the caster, such as on the wrist or around the neck.

classes/wizard/archetypes/destruction.ht.description:

For each point of mana you spend, you can increase the spells range by 10.Spells with a range of reach gain (reach+10*mana spent) range. If the spell is an attack, it turns into a ranged attack.Does not function for spells without a listed range.Whenever you cast a spell that has a listed AoE, your allies within that AoE are not targeted by the negative effects of the spell.
Woe to the destruction wizard who believes himself he has outwitted Frogg Saran by evading the many aspects of his spells that backfire. You can still use the techniques, but casting a Frogg spell demands unforeseen consequences. If you do not play along, you will make him your enemy.

classes/wizard/archetypes/financial.html.title: Financial
classes/wizard/archetypes/financial.html.description:
Financial wizards look to win battles far before they are ever fought using an enormous amount of preparationYou have a contact in the financial wizard's guild. This could be a teacher, banker or parent with connections or that works for it. You start play with an additional 1,000g worth of mundane items. Whenever you sell items, you automatically get 60% of the items value instead of 50%.The more decorated you are in your wealth, the more powerful you become. As long as you are covered in jewelry, fine clothing and other fancy mundane items worth at least (1000*LvL), your CL is increased by 1.
Whenever you take Damage, you can choose to destroy (1000*LvL) worth of items in you are wearing in order to negate it as an immediate action. Gold pieces themselves cannot be destroyed using this.Unless otherwise stated, arcane discoveries for destruction wizards only function on spells that deal damage.Whenever you would gain any kind of bonus to arcana checks outside of this class, such as from the aid action, or a bonus from the facilities at your disposal, you increase that bonus by +2 for each unique source. A unique source means something that is different from the previous ones. For example, your two financial wizard brothers would not be different sources. Those same two brothers and a dragon are 2 sources. 2 brothers, a dragon and a laboratory are 3 sources.Basically there needs to be a variety of sources of inspiration for arcane synergy to function. Each individual can still lend aid, giving a bonus depending on their proficiency. In that same example, your two brothers would collectively give a +6 bonus (2 proficient+2 proficient+2 synergy). The dragon, less versed in magic, lacks the arcana skill and gives a +3 bonus. The lab you are doing research in normally gives +2, but with synergy gives +4. So your bonus changes from +7 to +13 thanks to arcane synergy with this setup.

classes/wizard/universal-arcane-discover.description: Can be taken by any type of wizard.Whenever you cast a spell with an elemental damage tag, like Fire or Frost, you can choose to gain Resistance to that damage type. Whenever you take damage from such a tag, you can choose to gain resistance to that damage type after the effect is resolved.
