classes/wizard/wizard.html.title: Wizard
classes/wizard/wizard.html.description:
If there are any mortals that can be considered masters of magic, it can be wizards. Each one a prodigy in their own right, pushing the boundaries of what is possible with mana. Wizards are on the cutting edge of new magical items, rituals and spells, creating new ones and enhancing old classics to fit their particular approach to magic.You gain 2 technique points at level 1, then another 2 points every 2 levels after. These technique points can be used on any magical technique tree.Characters with magical specialization gain points in wild card equal to their highest tier of magic technique and cantrips.Choose a magical technique tree. This tree is the field of magic you specialize in. You get a +8 bonus to arcana when dealing with spells of this tree. You gain a technique point in this tree, and an additional technique point each odd level, all must be dedicated to this specific technique tree.Every time you gain a technique point in this tree, you can make some magic happen. You can choose one of 3 paths, depending on how much effort you are willing to put forth... You can create your own completely original spell for this spell school. This can be a bit of a daunting task, requiring a degree of trust between game master and player. Once a spell is created, the balancing does not stop there, and should be adjusted as needed to not disrupt the game too much. Alter an existing spell. Have you ever looked at a spell and wished it was just a little bit different? Perhaps you wanted a boneless Bone Shaker spell, or a snow woman instead of a Snow Man. These changes are encouraged to alter not only the flavor text, but also the mechanics. Perhaps our boneless-shaker allows you to create the boneless world you desire, tearing out a creatures skeleton leaving them a clumsy blob person. Perhaps a snow woman is more affectionate preferring to get up close and personal, grabbing creatures and keeping them frosty. In any case, the power of the altered spell should be pretty close to the original, and should serve a similar type of purpose.
You could also choose to upgrade a lower level spell. Say you thought Fire Blast wasn't explosive enough. Make a 5th level version that explodes again at the end of your next turn, forcing creatures who failed the initial save to eat another one without some extra speed or aid from allies.
If you aren't confident in your ability, or just don't have the time. Gain +1 memory.
You are proficient in the Arcana skill with a +4 bonus.
You can choose to leave up to 3 of your memory slots unused. By spending 1 minute, you can choose to prepare a spell in that unused memory slot.
If you mana burn 1, you can fill an empty slot as a free action.Choose a level 0 fiend, celestial or fey, or create a beast that is automatically tiny using the Beast Trainer's Beast Companion feature. It's level is always 0. If it aids you in combat, it gains the [companion] tag. You can also use your familiar to do a handful of other useful things.
Spying scrying - You can sense through your companion at will.
Assistant - Your companion can use the Aid action to assist you for any skill checks.
To My Side teleportation - You can concentrate for 3 rounds to teleport your companion to your side.Your mana pool is deeper than most. Add 1 to your mana pool at this level, and levels 4, 6, 8 and 10.The remainder of this class is full of arcane discoveries. These features are customizable abilities that you gain at level 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. Each archetype comes with its own.

classes/pack-mule.html.title: Pack Mule
classes/pack-mule.html.description:
Crust Pack mule is designed to give you the authentic DnD martial experience where you experience just how much of a "team game" it is by being a useless blob of defensive stats. You are almost completely reliant on your team to defeat your enemies. You scale incredibly poorly offensively, but you scale incredibly well defensively.Note: This class was intentionally designed obtusely in order to try and recreate the feeling of playing an unoptimized martial character in 5e/PF1e. Nick Nacks was intentionally designed from the ground up to make this kind of thing hard to happen by accident. So many techniques have baseline effectiveness that I had to use very heavy-handed methods to achieve the desired result.You will need to find out creative ways to be useful outside of what you're used to. Good Luck!
A silly meme related to why I made this class. I even made a video about this.
You have Martial Specialization
You gain a technique point at level 1, and another every 2 levels after.
These points can be used on the Protector🛡 tree.This class fundamentally alters how many aspects of your character scales offensively.
You only gain 1/2 LvL to Attack and CL instead of the full LvL value (minimum 0).
Your DC is 7+LvL instead of 12+LvL
Whenever you deal +HP or Poise damage, that value is cut in half. This uniquely also affects True Damage.
These effects are also applied to companions. This class also fundamentally how many aspects of your character scales defensively.
You add 2*LvL to AC
You have Regeneration equal to your LVL
When you are defeated, you only become Drained 2. You recover an additional stack of drained each day you Rest. You get a +10 bonus to luck checks to determine the type of affliction you acquire when you are defeated.
You have Recovery

gods/gods/demigods/the-spider-queen/the-.title: The Spider Queen
gods/gods/demigods/the-spider-queen/the-.description:
The Spider Queen is an entity that is worshipped almost exclusively by dark elves and other intelligent spider creatures. The original Spider Queen blessed a particularly brave Elf🧝 that delved into her lair. The original now passed, the title of Spider Queen is passed down through the dark elf Shi'Sara royal family. The Spider Queens have always encouraged competition. Even at a young age, children are encouraged to race their siblings when very young, and surpass their siblings in martial or magical prowess as they age. The only thing that matters to the subjects of the Queen is to make the most money, draw in the most followers, have the most powerful armies and make the most ground-breaking discoveries. Being talents is one way to achieve these goals, but eliminating the competition entirely isn't something that is discouraged.
All spider queens are adept at Cryomancy❄, and this manifests in their skin turning from a dull gray to a light blue. This blessing granted by the original Spider Queen comes in the form a spider body from the waist down. The Spider Queen will often have other unusual traits for an elf, like a mouth that can open particularly wide, incredibly large size and multiple sets of eyes.

classes/paladin/paladin.html.title: Paladin
classes/paladin/paladin.html.description:
Your unquestioning faith in your deity gives you unbridled strength and resilience in the face of danger. Your deity also gives you the authority to enforce their will through various supernatural powers, so long as you maintain a clean slate. Paladin excels with allies, saving them from certain death and guiding their strikes with divine intervention. Paladin is a martial class that trades raw damage for many supportive qualities.You gain 1 technique points at level 1, then another point every 2 levels after. These technique points can be used on the protector and pupper tree.Characters with martial specialization gain points in warfare equal to their highest tier of martial technique.The most powerful tool for defeating evil in the zealot's arsenal, smiting is meant to end a battle immediately and decisively. Spend 1 mana to target a creature within reach. They briefly feel the weight of their sins, as though they were creatures crawling on their back. The visual effect of smite varies depending on the zealot's patron deity, but they all involve some kind of divine intervention from the heavens above striking the foe. They take 10+(2*LvL) holy damage (will halves). If they are at or below 50% hp, they take double damage. Sinful creatures with little to no chance for redemption, like undead or fiends, have disadvantage on their save.If the creature survives the smite, you can choose to [mana burn] to [curse] them. While the curse persists, you do not recover this burned mana on rest. You automatically know the direction of the cursed creature at all times. The curse can only be removed by praying to the paladins patron deity and providing suitable penance for their actions, or by the zealot themselves.Recharges after 1 minute.
You automatically gain proficiency in +Persuasion with a +4 bonus.Whenever engaging with sentient creatures, aside from undead and fiends, you must first attempt to establish diplomatic relations, or otherwise resolve something peacefully (such as an arrest) before attacking them. If you personally have tried interacting with members of the same organization and failed to establish diplomatic relations previously, you need not attempt again. If you are attacked first, you may attack back.If you do not try to resolve things peacefully first, you instigate fights, or you hang back and let your allies do the unchivalrous behavior in your stead while you are present, you gain a unique T3 affliction.Shame - You are unable to smite or benefit from your chivalrous boons. A black marking of significance to your deity appears on your neck.Cure - Return to a place of worship and repent for 7 consecutive days, involving religious ceremonies, communal activities, sermons, prayer etc.
You gained the Bonded Weapon feat. You can generate an infinite number of copies of this weapon as long as the original is on your person. You pull these extra weapons out of your sleeve and pockets or materialize them out of thin air as a free action at any time. When you throw these copied weapons, drop them or embed them in your enemies, they persist for 1 minute before they disappear.
By spending 1 mana when you defeat a foe with a bonded weapon, you can leave it in the creature's body to make it Grounded and prevent it from benefiting from healing effects. Athletics as a swift action to remove.
While you wear heavy armor, you radiate an aura of light out to 20 ft. Allies within this light (including yourself) get a +2 bonus against effects with the fear tag and Resistance to holy damage.You can toggle this ability on or off 1/turn as a free action.
You start play with 10 GBP for any gods that are not Demon Lords👿, or are otherwise overtly evil, unless your WIS is -1 or lower.
Gain a Divine Shield that naturally reforms after not taking damage for 1 minute. As a standard action you can refresh your divine shield.
As a standard action, you can Mana Burn 1 to give an ally within reach a divine shield.Choose one of the following options. Gain another level 6 and 10.
Evasion (Reflex), iron will (Will), stalwart (Fortitude)Gain one at this level and another at level 4, 6, 8 and 10. Chivalrous boons represent your command and authority grant to you by your deity. They generally assist in out of combat endeavors by apprehending criminals, detecting falsehoods and protecting the innocent.If you act dishonorably, directly harm innocents or abuse your authority, you acquire the Shame affliction (details above).As a standard action, spend one mana to touch a creature within reach to heal (5+lvl) hp.
You can instead Mana Burn 1 to use this ability as a swift action.

core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.title: GM Magic
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.description: Sometimes I will refer to things by this term. It's a vague term meant to apply to any rules your GM makes up that aren't part of the original rules. This could mean a special type of ritual to solve a very particular problem, release Fiends👿 into the Mortal Realm or perform some other kind of incredible feat. Or it can be some type of special ability your GM gave you as a quest reward.Basically, anything your GM makes up that can have major gameplay implications.
core-rules,-how-to-play/abbreviations-an.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Abbreviations and Terminology/GM Magic.md

meta-discussions/faqs/genies!.html.title: Genies!
meta-discussions/faqs/genies!.html.description:
Here I put a bunch of soft measurements for how wishes are treated in various forms of media.
For distribution, red means its widely distributed ruining a bit of the mystique behind the wish. Green properly restricts access to wishes.
For limitations, red means that there are numerous limitations, making the wish feel a lot less wish-y with how little it can do. Green means little to no limitation.
For Intent, red generally means the wish is out to get you, and a surefire way of replacing your hopeful optimism with despair. Green is is wish does everything in its power to fulfill your desires, even if they aren't explicitly stated.
Orange is somewhere in between.Distribution Limitations Intent Distribution Limitations Intent Distribution Limitations Intent Distribution Limitations Intent Distribution Limitations Intent Distribution Limitations Intent

skills/skills/persuasion/gather-informat.title: Gather Information
skills/skills/persuasion/gather-informat.description: When in a settlement, you can roll persuasion to find the answer to a simple question by speaking to people in town. The time it takes and the difficulty scales with the size of the settlement, people's general attitude toward you and how knowledgeable they are on the subject. Asking about where someone lives in a village could take minutes, but asking in a large city could take hours.Creatures proficent in persuasion automatically find information with a DC of (10++Persuasion bonus) or lower.

techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.title: Sludge Bomb
techniques/magical-techniques/alchemy/le.description:
Level 3 Alchemy (T)
Tags: Poison Action: Standard
Toss a sizzling sphere of toxic goo that explodes on impact. Make a Spell Attack against a creature. On impact projectile explodes, dealing 4d8+CL (18+CL) poison damage (reflex halves dmg).
The original target has Disadvantage on their save and is envenomed On-hit.On a miss, the projectile still explodes in the creatures space.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Soggy Curse
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 1 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: 1 Standard Action
You place a curse on a creature whose power can only be used to minorly inconvenience a person. You cannot use this curse to provide any real form of mechanical benefit, like inflicting Status or Damage.Otherwise, the sky is the limit.This curse gets its name from the spiteful wizard who loved to inflict people with the curse of soggy socks. As such, this curse is removed by buying a new pair of socks.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Creative Curse
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 6 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: StandardYou can inflict a curse upon a creature with very few limitations, listed below.
It cannot deal +HP damage
It cannot inflict a Status effect
It cannot match a pre-existing curse Spell Once you inflict a particular type of curse with this spell, you cannot inflict it again, or anything similar (ie "you can't get within 10 ft of me" then the next time its "you can't get within 15 ft of me")
You can choose to remove the curse at an instant action at any time. Other than that, it requires a DC 40 +Medicine💉 check, or some type of incredibly powerful GM Magic.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Skeleton Crew
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 2 Necromancy💀 Tags: Action: 1 minute
Material: 1 skull of a race🏁Speak aloud a specific task and channel your energy into a skull. At the end of the duration, the skull disintegrates and around you emerge several skeletons from the ground. The exact number varies, but cannot be more that a dozen.Depending on the task you asked of the skeleton, you are granted the bare minimum number of simple laborers that are required to do things like operate a ship or move many small objects. They dutifully perform the task they were commanded when the spell was cast. When the job is complete or the spell ends, they crumble to dust.
The skeletons effectively have -1 in all of their Ability Scores and no Skill Proficiency. They cannot perform the Aid action or aid in combat at all. If they take damage, they clatter into pieces and reform after 1 round, unless that damage was Holy damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.title: Sympathy
techniques/magical-techniques/shira/leve.description:
Level 5 Shira💋
Tags: Prepared Action: -
Any creature that damages you is Charmed by you until the start of their next turn.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Blood Biography
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description: Level 1 Vampirism🧛 Tags: - Action: 1 minuteYou learn about a creature through bloodshed. The blood that is the target of the spell changes shape to form text in a language you understand. You can place the text on a surface of your choosing, such as a piece of paper in your position. If you don't choose then it forms on the surface the blood was on, or at your feet. The bloody message contains the following.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Bloodbath
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 1 Vampirism🧛 Tags: - Action: Standard
As part of casting the spell, you cut yourself with a held object taking d6 (3) bleed damage immediately and every turn after at the start of your turn. Whenever you take this damage, nearby enemies also start bleeding for the same amount.You can choose to stop bleeding as an instant action, ending the spell.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Mist Form
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 2 Vampirism🧛
Tags: poly, true, Buff Action: Standard
You transform into an amorphous mist of an unusual color indefinitely. The cloud of mist is about a 5 ft cube in volume. Creatures must roll +Perception👀 against your DC or +Stealth to realize this mist is potentially dangerous if it is clearly visible. Certain circumstances can cause the perception to not be needed, such as hiding on the surface of water, or other locations frequented by mist. Creatures need not make this check if they see you transform.
While in mist form you can perform no actions other than flying at a speed of 30 or dismissing mist form as a free action. You gain no defensive benefits while in mist form. If you take damage or fail a saving throw, you immediately leave mist form and are staggered for 1 round.
As a vapor, you can travel through very thin spaces, such as air vents pipes and such. Particularly small holes such as keyholes are still possible, but require a FRA. You are also more susceptible to wind. Moving with a slight breeze is of no issue, but moving during a storm is impossible. You take a -4 penalty saves vs air effects.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Vampiric Blood
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 2 Vampirism🧛
Tags: Healing Action: Standard
You drain the blood from a recently deceased creature and use its life force to bolster yourself and a chosen ally within range. You restore 2d6+CL (7+CL) +HP and grant the same amount to the chosen ally.The same corpse cannot be targeted multiple times with this spell.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Vampiric Touch
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 2 Vampirism🧛
Tags: Necrotic, Healing, Buff, Concentration Action: Swift
Your hand or staff gains a sinister glow. As long as you concentrate, you can make a Spell Attack as a standard action or as an AoO that deals 3d8+CL (13+CL) necrotic damage. You regain half of this damage as +HP.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Blood Ties
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 3 Vampirism🧛
Tags: poly, true Action: Standard
Material: A vial of blood from a race🏁
You drink the vial of blood, transforming you into a copy of the creature you drink from. Your physical appearance changes to match theirs and you can swap between the creature’s voice and your own. You get a +4 bonus to +Disguise to appear as this creature. You can change your appearance between your own and the creatures as a swift action.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Misty Escape
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 3 Vampirism🧛
Tags: poly, true, Instant Action: InstantSpecial:
This spell can only be cast in response to being Defeated.Briefly transform into mist and move 30 ft. You reform in your new position.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Swarm's Advance
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 3 Vampirism🧛
Tags: poly, true Action: Standard
Immediately Disengage🏳. For remainder of your turn, you transform into a swarm of ravenous beasts that can Fly, like bats or crows. You can move directly through other creatures. When you do the creature is Drained for 3d6+CL (10+CL) hp and staggered for 1 round (fort changes the drain to True Damage, halves it and negates the stagger).

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Defy Gravity
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 6 Vampirism🧛
Tags: Prepared Action: -
If you can defy death, why not gravity? Gain a Fly speed equal to your Land Speed.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Vampirism
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Vampires are creatures that have cheated death through complex arcane rituals. Their price was in blood. In order to exist, they must drink the blood of intelligent creatures. Their transformation also comes with a large number of idiosyncrasies. It is through these unique circumstances that 3 of the original vampires made new magics to aid them in circumventing these new challenges. Each spell cast still has a piece of them.Vampirism spells deal in unique effects that are traditionally ascribed to vampires. They also user clever ways to manipulate blood.Each spell is attributed to a specific vampire, mostly for flavor reasons.
Senketula - The eldest brother and the one most concerned with eternal life. His spells are largely focused on becoming a superior being through a multitude of various abilities.
Lovacious - The partner of Senketula most concerned with power over others. Her spells are largely focused on manipulation.
Vrykul - The youngest brother most concerned with raw power. His spells are largely focused on using blood as a weapon to be used against the living.

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: +Achievement
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description: Achievements are archetypal tasks that provide some kind of tangible benefit after completion. You do not need to opt into an achievement, instead they can be claimed retroactively after accomplishing a task.

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: Backstabber
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description: +Achievement🏆 Requirement - Murder 3 people you once considered allies, or who at thought you were an ally (before you turned on them). If you murder someone in a position of great power, like a powerful guild leader or king, it counts as 3.Reward - You have a 6th sense for when people trust you. By observing how they react to your presence in a brief interaction (such as an introduction), you can tell whether they trust you, are indifferent towards you or if they distrust you.

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: Battle Scars
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description:
+Achievement🏆
Requirement - Get defeated by a Crit and survive in 3 different encounters. Or get crit 3 times in the same combat and survive.
Reward - Su The scars you get from battle are deeply entrenched in your memory. Your memories of combats you have encountered cannot be magically removed. By touching them, you can perfectly recall past events, as long as they happened in the thick of combat. Other creatures can touch your scars to share in the experience of the memory
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.sourcePath: Classes/+Class Details/Progression Outside of Class/Achievements/Battle Scars.md

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: Critical Pet
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description: +Achievement🏆 Requirement - Use stealth to initiate combat on a creature by patting its head 3 times. This pat can have no mechanical effect such as delivering a spell or attacking.Reward - You unlock the "Pet" skill. It uses your stealth bonus. If you sneak up on a creature and pet their head (again, no additional mechanical effect), you establish dominance, giving you a +2 bonus to skills for the subsequent social or combat encounter. If a creature within reach is smaller than you, you can pet them as a free action 1/turn for no mechanical benefit (no save).
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.sourcePath: Classes/+Class Details/Progression Outside of Class/Achievements/Critical Pet.md

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: Ascendance
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description: Most classes stop gaining features at level 11, but every class universally has access to ascendance, which is granted at level 12. After which the content train stops. Ascendances are meant to cater to a fantasy where after a character's journey has gone on long enough, they not only acquire power, but also often prestige. Ascendances can often be summed up in a single title like Immortal, Master or Demigod.

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: Demigod
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description:
You are well known and beloved/feared throughout the land through your deeds and people worship the ground you walk on. You defeated a demigod previously and absorbed their power. Through some means you have literally ascended to godhood.Gain the following benefits… Deific Boons - Take T1 Deific Boons from another god, or make one up. You and creatures that choose you as their god gain this benefit. By achieving even greater (story/world related) feats, you can acquire greater boons.
Emissary - Form a Summoning Contract📜 with your chosen one. The creature must be level 10 or lower. You can telepathically communicate with this creature over any distance.
Prayers Answered - You can Innately Cast Sending upcast to 3rd level so long as it is to communicate with to any of your followers.
Deific Aspect - You can project yourself anywhere you have seen, as though you had been summoned via summoning contract. This requires a 1 minute cast time with a very obvious physical phenomenon occurring to indicate your imminent arrival, such as storm clouds, whirlpool, magic circle (something appropriate for you) during the cast time. You do not need to know the location if your followers pray for your assistance. You are not drained if you gain summoning sickness. Otherwise this has a cooldown of 1 day.

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: Immortal
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description: You have harnessed the power of a powerful artifact. You have received the blessing of a god. You have unlocked forbidden magics. Through some means, you have managed to figure out how to prevent aging for yourself.Gain the following benefits… Timeless - You cannot die of old age, nor can you be forced to magically age. You can alter your age to appear as a younger or older version of yourself, going anything from your prime to an elderly form. Changing requires a standard action and represents your new True Form.\ Optional - You no longer need to drink, eat, sleep, breathe or anything else tied to your biology that requires your continued operation. You must still must only do light physical/mental activity in order to rest. You can still do any of these things if you so choose. Ex Machina - Whenever you are slain, you automatically resurrect 1 day later at a pre-designated significant location, such as your hometown or primary place of worship. This ability goes on cool down for 1 month. If you die during this time, you stay dead.

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: Legendary Weapon
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description:
You have a special weapon that you use to vanquish your enemies. It's name, legendary. It's purpose, divine. This indestructible weapon will be passed down from champion to champion for all of eternity. (if dual wielding is your thing, no issue in making it twinned weapons)Gain the following benefits… Bonus Feat - Gain the Bonded Weapon feat, applying only to your legendary weapon(s). Indestructible - This weapons destruction can only be brought about through a series of complex rituals, requiring the intervention of deities or some other incredibly powerful force of destruction, determined upon ascension.
Intelligent - It may or may not be able to communicate, but it can at least understand language and perceive the world around it. Its bonded wielder can receive knowledge from it through language or psychic impressions conveying the information. It has a +20 knowledge bonus concerning monsters of a specific type (plants🪴, fiends👿 etc.). Gain Bane against this creature type. Unique Property - Each legendary weapon is unique and has something that aids and defeating its favored foe. Some examples below.
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.sourcePath: Classes/+Class Details/Progression Outside of Class/Ascendance/Legendary Weapon.md

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: Master
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description:
Through dumb luck, large quantities of practical experience or intensive research, you have reached a level of mastery demanding of respect from all mortals, and perhaps even those greater than mortal.Gain the following benefits… TECHNIQUE - Create your own school of techniques and make 6 techniques, one for each level. You automatically have all of them memorized without spending memory. Mana Cheating - You restore 1 mana at the start of each turn. Signature Technique - You can innately cast a level 3 or lower technique you could normally cast. Its DC increases by 2. If you aren't up to the task of making a bunch of content, instead gain this boon...
TECHNIQUE? - Immediately gain 3 technique points and 3 memory slots.

classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.title: Progression Outside of Class
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.description:
Just so its all in one place.Boons🍀/Banes🐈‍⬛ - Gained at level one as a result of having positive or negative luck.
Feats - Gained at level 1, and every odd level after.
Technique Points - Gain one that can be used on any school of techniques at level 2, and every even level after.
Ascendance - Unique template applied at level 12.
+Achievement🏆 - Can be gained at any time, even retroactively, when certain conditions are met, varying based on the achievement Fall Damage
classes/+class-details/progression-outsi.sourcePath: Classes/+Class Details/Progression Outside of Class/Progression Outside of Class.md

classes/+class-details/quick-character-c.title: Character Creation
classes/+class-details/quick-character-c.description: Note: Read main character status🦸! It is essential for character creation.There are several things for you to decide when deciding what you're writing down on your character sheet. Start with a theme, aesthetic, fighting style, or a particular character type you want to mimic from popular media.These are in order of necessity for actually playing the game, but not necessarily in the order that is most convenient to any individual's workflow.
classes/+class-details/quick-character-c.sourcePath: Classes/+Class Details/Quick Character Creation Guide/Character Creation.md

classes/jester/universal-talents.html.title: Universal Talents
classes/jester/universal-talents.html.description:
You can say anything you want to people, as long as its a joke. NPCs will not react negatively to anything you say, even if you call them a whore, a failure or a poopoo head. All you have to do is add a qualifying statement like "just kidding" or integrate it into a joke and all is forgiven. You get a +10 bonus to skill checks and ability checks whenever you can reasonable use your incompetence as a reason for why you did something, like +Deception to say "you didn't mean it" or +Athletics🏊 to "accidentally" break something. Creatures other than your allies need to be present for you to gain this bonus.
Whether its talking nonsense after failing a +Monster Lore📖 check or being overly dramatic about falling after failing to Balance, you can turn it around. Whenever you miss a creature with an Attack or fail a Skill Check/Ability Check, you can make it seem like it was all part of your plan to get a quick laugh out of creatures.
As an immediate action, grant an ally witnessing your failure Advantage on their next d20 roll within the next minute. You can also pretend to fail at something to grant this advantage.No matter the case, creatures other than your allies must be present to witness the tomfoolery and it always must be silly and dramatic, aka, something that will draw attention.Note: If you are not under duress, if there is no tension, you cannot fool around. This should not be read as "standard action grant advantage to every roll ever."

headers.heading: 2 - It's Just a Prank Bro

classes/martial-artist/archteypes/strong.title: Strongest Under the Heavens
classes/martial-artist/archteypes/strong.description: CrustYou know the greatest secrets of them all that the masters refuse to teach in other schools teaching martial arts. Your ability to manipulate "energy" Attacks Poison hand pressure point nonsense No touch knockout Psychic powers to block/overpower people The ability to generate photos of the creature being defeated through distracting them Preemptive strike on people will to fight, based sole-y on reputation alone "Miracle Kneel" The ability to feign defeat to get out of danger, or lul the enemy into a false sense of security that allies can exploit Taunting Seemingly immune to all status effects, but really you just delay them Skills Extreme talent, but only in contests against others Use deception for knowledge by asking leading questions Fame and fortune disproportionate of actual abilities. Hijacking the narrative Money from renown

classes/mechanic/archetypes/siege-engine.title: Siege Engineer
classes/mechanic/archetypes/siege-engine.description:
Siege Engineers use a specialized type of vehicle that excels in destruction and defense at the cost of mobility and utility.Mechs must be one size category larger than you to use. In order for another creature to use your mech, they must roll a DC (20+your engineering bonus) to use it. Otherwise it is a very fancy hunk of metal to them.You are effectively treated as mounted on your mech while driving it. Any damage it takes depletes your hp and any effects targeting the mech target you (such as charming gaze). Any attacks it makes use your stats, etc. It is not a separate creature, but an extension of yourself. The only exception to this is you use the AC value of your mech while mounted in it.At any point, you can eject from your mech as an instant action and appear in its space. Remounting requires a swift action, but cannot be done in the same turn you exit. Emergency exit needs to be manually recharged as a standard action while mounted to use again.
Your attacks always ignore Cover thanks to the angle you can fire them at.
Gain the shield action

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.title: +Siege Weapon
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Types of Attack Rolls/Siege Weapons/+Siege Weapon.md

feats/combat-feats/combat-maneuver-feats.title: The Mountain
feats/combat-feats/combat-maneuver-feats.description:
Requirements - Your Shove distance increases by 5 ft
You can make shove attacks as AoOs
You get a +8 bonus to Attack if you shove as an AoO
Whenever a creature fails to break your Poise with a combat maneuver👐, you can shove them as an AoO if they are within Reach Whenever your poise is broken, your maximum poise increases by 10 for the remainder of the combat. This effect can stack.

feats/magic-feats/mm-bouncing-spell.html.title: MM Bouncing Spell
feats/magic-feats/mm-bouncing-spell.html.description:
Requirements - INT +3Note: Only a spell that targets a single creature can be a bouncing spell. Uniquely, this feat can be applied as an immediate action and it costs 3 mana.
Whenever a creature passes a save against your spell, or when you miss/Graze a Spell Attack, you can choose to target a new creature within 15 ft of the original target to be the new target.When this happens, the original target suffers no ill effects, such as half damage from a passed save or graze.

feats/magic-feats/mm-lingering-spell.htm.title: MM Lingering Spell
feats/magic-feats/mm-lingering-spell.htm.description:
Requirements - INT +1Note:
Only an AoE spell without a duration can be a lingering spell.
A lingering spell takes a spell like Fire Blast and lets the explosion last until the start of your next turn. In the case of fire blast, any creature that enters the explosion radius must immediately make a save against the effect.
This adds the Concentration and Persistent tag to the spell.

gods/gods/demigods/ao-shin-the-storm-dra.title: Ao Shin the Storm Dragon
gods/gods/demigods/ao-shin-the-storm-dra.description:
Ao Shin is an ancient dragon, having lived his youth in The Age of Dragons. Unlike most other dragons of his age, Ao Shin has rather lofty goals, varying from age to age, but usually involving getting revenge on those that have wronged him. He enjoys destroying the structures of mortals, but tends to only do so indirectly through his followers, though his followers can sometimes tempt him or anger him enough to let loose a tornado across the countryside.
He is generally antagonistic towards other dragons, and hates Star Dragons and wish granting creatures with all of his heart. From what historians are able to gather, it seems that Ao Shin was meant to receive some type of blessing from the ancient dragons of his time, but another dragon wished upon a star and ascended to become the first star dragon in his stead.Ao Shin is pompous, spiteful and very narcissistic. Unlike many deities, he is more than happy to show himself to mortals on a regular basis. He does not bend to the wills of mortals and has a set schedule when he can be spoken to. Such meetings usually involve offerings. Fruit is his favorite. Ao Shin himself is an enormous dark blue dragon, hundreds of feet long with a majestic white beard. His scales crackle with lightning and where he resides the wind is always strong. He seems to have crafted himself a custom set of highly ornamental faded golden armor that protects the top half of his body.
gods/gods/demigods/ao-shin-the-storm-dra.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demigods/Ao Shin the Storm Dragon/Ao Shin the Storm Dragon.md

gods/gods/demigods/ao-shin-the-storm-dra.title: T1 - Air Pressure
gods/gods/demigods/ao-shin-the-storm-dra.description:
Tags: Su, Air
You can call upon Ao Shin's destructive power for the purpose of the Breaking Objects and Breakout functions of athletics. You can use your +Religion or Arcana bonus in place of +Athletics🏊 for these purposes. No matter the skill, you get a +4 bonus.During particularly stormy, rainy or windy weather, you get a +8 bonus to this check, and can destroy wide areas like fields and small structures like houses.
gods/gods/demigods/ao-shin-the-storm-dra.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demigods/Ao Shin the Storm Dragon/T1 - Air Pressure.md

gods/gods/demigods/ao-shin-the-storm-dra.title: T1 - Cloud Gazing
gods/gods/demigods/ao-shin-the-storm-dra.description:
Tags: Su, Air, Water You can manipulate the heavens such that clouds form in a shape of your choosing. If you choose to shape them into text, you can write up to two simple sentences. If you choose something that isn't text, it is usually limited to a single entity, symbol or object.
This message can also show up in a more dramatic fashion, with flashing lightning illuminating your cloud canvas. This guarantees all creatures see it. You can also try to hide it from onlookers, weather provided. Other creatures with Ao Shin GBP always notice it. Depending on the weather conditions, creatures may see it. If you are in a desert for instance, clouds will stand out. But in cloudier environs, you can roll a luck check to only deliver your message to desirable creatures.
gods/gods/demigods/ao-shin-the-storm-dra.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demigods/Ao Shin the Storm Dragon/T1 - Cloud Gazing.md

gods/gods/demigods/chrimbus-spirit/chrim.title: Chrimbus Spirit
gods/gods/demigods/chrimbus-spirit/chrim.description: See Santa🎅 for lore.

gods/gods/demigods/chrimbus-spirit/t1-gi.title: T1 - Gift of Giving
gods/gods/demigods/chrimbus-spirit/t1-gi.description: Tags: -You have an innate sense of what would make a meaningful gift to a creature just by looking at them.When you get in trouble for relatively minor misdeeds, you can offer the creature a personalized gift to smooth things over.

gods/gods/demigods/the-spider-queen/t1-t.title: T1 - Technically Legal
gods/gods/demigods/the-spider-queen/t1-t.description: Tags: -The spider queen constantly whispers to you, teaching you ways to break rule systems and get away with it. By considering a particular act, you can think of ways to construe ways to legally justify said act, obfuscate the legality by pleading to the emotions of others or convincing others that the law is of little importance.When doing these things you are treated as though you have Skill Proficiency in +Linguistics㊙ and +Deception, each with a +4 bonus.This also functions for social rules, not just written law.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/t1-call-.title: T1 - Call of Hades
gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/t1-call-.description:
Tags: Su Recharge, Curse
You gain a unique Special Attack, usable 1/day. If you miss or Graze, its daily use is not consumed.Call of Hades
On-hit apply a unique curse to a creature. The creature cannot use any means, magical or mundane, to return back to life if it killed while this curse persists. Backup bodies in an alchemy lab, the favor of gods, a Necromancer💀's advanced rejuvenation, it all matters not.
When you attack a magical "copy" of a creature, such as ninja's shadow clone or a Shadow Projection, it applies the curse to the original creature instead of the copy.
The curse can be removed by performing an elaborate 24 hour ritual to appease Hades👻, which costs 2,000g.If this curse successfully denies an attempt at resurrection, gain 1 GBP.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/t2-visit.title: T2 - Visiting Hours
gods/gods/earthly-deities/hades/t2-visit.description:
Tags: Su You gain the ability to bring back the dead!...Temporarily at least. With a 1 minute ritual you can allow those grieving to say one last goodbye. You have to unambiguously identify a creature that you knew that has died within the past ten years while adjacent to the remains with a keepsake of the creature. Only a small portion of the remains is necessary.
If the creature is willing to return (the creature knows who is bringing them back and who is visiting to make this decision), then a makeshift body that resembles what they looked like in life slowly materializes over the cast time. This does not disturb the remains. The creature is a simulacrum of its former self with a sandy texture to it that slowly crumbles away. A creature knowledgeable of the spell can identify a creature created by this effect with a DC 10 +Religion check. The creature can walk and talk for 24 hours before it completely fades away.
Due to the limited nature of the copy, if the creature suffers 10 points of damage, they immediately crumble and turn to dust, leaving behind the keepsake used in to create the copy.  They cannot Attack, use Su abilities or cast spells.This effect is typically used after soldiers die to give loved ones a chance to say goodbye to their family and friends. It can also be used to collect information that otherwise would have been lost.An individual can only be the target of this effect once.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Shock Shield
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 1 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Zap Buff Action: Free
A shield made entirely of brilliant energy forms in the air and starts floating around you. You can use this shield to take the Block action. At any point during the spell when you take the block action, you can end the spell and zap the attacker. The creature takes (CL) zap damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.title: Ranni's Jar
techniques/magical-techniques/corruption.description:
Level 5 Corruption
Tags: Curse Action: Standard Focus: A mundane glass jar
This is a spell often used to capture people and keep prisoners.  You pop open the jar and you suck a creature into it. They are shrunk down to diminutive size and imprisoned in the jar (will reduces to sicken 1). The imprisoned creature has no ability to escape the jar via any kind of magic (including Teleportation) or attacking the jar from the inside. They can still take any other kind of actions they wish (to heal, buff or communicate their imprisonment) but through no action of their own can they escape.
While the creature inside has no way to escape, all it takes for them to return to their usual size and exact vengeance is to destroy the jar. The jar cannot be fortified to increase its durability, magically or otherwise. As such, it is easily broken. If the jar is unattended, any attack will suffice. If it is being held on someone's person, you must use +Sleight of Hand to steal it or Poise break the creature to knock it free and cause it to shatter.There are a handful of conveniences that make keeping the creature prisoner convenient. The top to the jar only functions for the creature kept inside, allowing the captor to slip in objects such as food or water. This also conveniently lets the creature breathe. The jar only muffles the sounds made from the inside, so special measures would need to be taken for rowdy or supernaturally loud prisoners.

techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.title: Grasping Corpse
techniques/magical-techniques/necromancy.description:
Level 1 Necromancy💀 Tags: - Action: Standard
A corpse reaches out and attempts to Topple or Shove a creature within the natural reach it had in life. The attack bonus the corpse uses is (CL+3) The target is DD for this maneuver.
When used out of combat, this has the subtle tag.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Unga Bunga
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 3 Warfare⚔
Tags: Earth Action: Standard
Dig your hands into the ground and lift an enormous chunk of earth, then throw it at an enemy. It deals 4d8+LvL (18+LvL) and the creature is made Clumsy 1 On-hit.
This attack counts as a +Siege Weapon.

techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.title: Storm of Steel
techniques/martial-techniques/+warfare/l.description:
Level 4 Warfare⚔
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard
Start rapidly spinning and make a Simple Attack against all foes within your reach. You cannot move after initiating this technique. Until the start of your next turn, you have +2 AC. Any foes within your reach at the start of your next turn are automatically attacked again.

techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.title: Call of Hades
techniques/martial-techniques/arc/level-.description:
Level 5 Arc
Tags: Su, Curse
Action: Special Attack

techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.title: Pulverize
techniques/martial-techniques/cataclysm/.description:
Level 4 Cataclysm🌋
Tags: Earth
Action: Special AttackNote: You must be touching the ground to cast this spell.
Tenderize the ground to send your foes flying. Roll to Topple all foes within your reach with a +4 bonus. Compare the result of the attack to the Poise of all enemies. Against all enemies you successfully topple, the creatures are knocked into the air for 1 round.
While airborne, the creature has a speed of zero and creatures get a +4 bonus to Attack against them. Anything that removes Knockdown can also pull the creature out of the air. At the start of your next turn, the creatures fall and are Knocked Down.

techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.title: Gold Pine Resin
techniques/martial-techniques/pupper/lev.description:
Level 1 Pupper
Tags: Buff, Holy, Upcast Action: Swift
Coat your weapon in a syrup with a golden radiance. Attacks with the weapon deal entirely Holy damage, its usual damage, or both, whichever is most beneficial.
Upcast 3 - Whenever you strike a Minion undead with this weapon, it is instantly destroyed (will negates). If destroyed, it is also treated as though it was doused in Holy Water.

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: Chained Oblivion
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description:
A sigil of a name in infernal floats in the air. The burning text intensifies as you approach before it unleashes an enormous fiend with a hankering for destruction.Level 11 Huge Fiend (Anomaly)Resistance - Psychic
Iron WillClaws (S) +15 (+4 MV) 2d8+4 (13) +Drain Life
Multiattack - Make 2 claw attacks.
Innate Techniques - Disintegration, Pulverize, Unga Bunga, Awesome Blow
1/day - Elemental Shield, Roar of the Cataclysm, Shackles of Pain, Vile Vigor, Asphyxiate
Constant - Long Arms
Awaken Fire Necrotic - When the Chained Oblivion are awakened, they explode violently. All creatures within 60 ft take 5d6 (17) fire damage and 5d6 (17) necrotic damage (reflex halves).
Drain Life - The chained oblivion's claw attacks drain a creatures life. On-hit the creature is Drained 2.
Convergence (fire) (necrotic) Su - As a swift action, the chained oblivion can set in motion a process that will all but guarantee the destruction of their enemies. The chained oblivion chooses 2 unoccupied points within 60 ft on the ground within 60 ft of each other. In one point a fiery orb appears. In the other, one covered in bone.At the start of each the chained oblivion's turn, the orbs move 10 ft closer to each other, dealing 5d6 (17) fire or necrotic damage (depending on which orb) to any creature they bump into. When the orbs are adjacent to each other, they fuse and begin to fly around the battlefield. Each turn the orbs move in a line 40 feet, dealing 5d6 (17) fire damage and 5d6 (17) necrotic damage (reflex halves) to any creature they pass through. This effect persists until the chained oblivion is defeated.
With an +Athletics🏊 check, a Dispel effect or any other reasonable effect to prevent the movement of these orbs, their convergence can be halted for one round. This delaying effect happens instead of being completely removed by dispel or completely destroyed through athletics.When the chained oblivion is defeated, the orbs disappear.
Signature Skill - Boo (SS), Big Shot (SS)
Infernal Seal - The Chained Oblivion are a set of fiends that were too powerful to control and too numerous to rule without endless fighting between factions. As such, the Demon Lords👿 decided to seal them away for later use. Powerful creatures that serve the interests of demon lords can summon these creatures in their dormant state, where they appear in some type of magical seal. This sealed form varies from case to case, but is usually large and unwieldy, weighing several tons and is big enough to contained the chained oblivion.
This seal can be broken away with a specific password (which can gleaned through a DC 40 +Planes check), the destruction of a particular object used as part of the seal, or a DC 40 Brute Force check.
Even when the seal is broken, it still takes 2 full rounds (about 12 seconds) for the creature to awaken, during which it is in Stasis. At the end of the second round, they unleash a devastating burst, activating their Awaken ability and ending their turn.
With a +Planes check, you can slow or halt this process as a standard action while adjacent to the seal. A result of 30 or higher slows the process by 1 round and a result of 40 stops it completely and prevents its reactivation for 1 minute.
Defeat - The chained oblivion cannot die from being Defeated. While defeated, they are Invincible. After 1 minute of being defeated, they return back to being in stasis, as per the Infernal Seal feature. During this minute, creatures can determine what the methods are for unsealing the creature again.
Ability Scores - STR +4, DEX +0, LUK +0, INT +0, Wis +2, Cha -1 Languages - Infernal, Common
Equipment - Heavy Armor
Deific Boons - Huge, Huge XL
Feats - Maneuver Versatility, Divine Interference, Signature Skill, Fearsome Finisher, Skill Focus, Demolitionist
Skills - +15 +Perception👀, +15 (adv) +Intimidation😱, +13 +History, +13 +Planes
+17 (+2 huge, +4 Demolitionist) +Athletics🏊
Imprisoned Antaen by Rafael Zanchetin, for Hearthstone

classes/slayer/archetypes/parry-fiend.ht.title: Parry Fiend
classes/slayer/archetypes/parry-fiend.ht.description:
The Parry Fiend trades many of the abilities granted by the original slayer class to pivot the class from an unrelenting aggressor to a more defensive play style. Instead of killing everything that moves, a sentinel focuses more on disruption and setting up combos. The class primarily revolves around parrying enemy attacks.Removes: Glory Kill, Dash, Shredder, Feats, Blood PunchYou no longer have glory kill, so that method of regaining energy is removed.Instead you regain 2 energy when you successfully parry an attack.
You start play with and can craft a circular shield with spinning blades inside of it with 8 hours of work and 100g. This is treated as a tower shield and a 1h weapon that can deal slash or crush damage and has the CM (shove) property. If this shield is destroyed, it repairs itself after 1 round.
In the hands of a Sentinel, the shield also additional properties. It has the thrown property and 2 enchantment slots, one of which is the Returning enchantment, but the returning can be used as an instant action.You can reasonably augment existing shields to also make them better suit your tastes, giving them the above properties.
Any offensive ability that deals damage to you, you can. Roll an attack roll as an immediate action. Against opposing attack rolls, if you match their roll, you negate it. Against anything else if you match the DC of the ability, you negate it entirely (at least for you in the case of AoE effects).
When you successfully parry any ability, you rupture your attacker and any other enemies within 10 ft of them, making them clumsy 2.But how do I determine my attack bonus for parrying?
You use what your melee attack bonus would be against the target. If you are currently flanking the target, add flanking. If your shield has the Bane enchantment against their creature type, add bane.As a free action, spend 2 energy to dash directly adjacent to a creature within 30 ft and crash into them, releasing a powerful shockwave. The target creature and all enemies within 10 ft are staggered (fort negates).Instead of a shockwave, you can instead choose to shove the target.When you make a thrown attack with your shield, it embeds itself into a creature on hit, entangling them. If at the end of the creatures turn it is still entangled by this, it takes your shield attack damage again. If you choose to use the returning property of your shield to parry, shield action etc, this entangle ends.When a creature is a minion, you know. You do not need to make attack rolls with your shield against minions. They are automatically crit by your shield attacks. If you defeat a minion with a shield attack, it can bounce to another minion within 20 ft.
You gain the Shield Focus, Sentinel and point blank master feats.Inscribe a rune upon your shield to give it additional powers that activate when you successfully parry. You can only activate 1 rune when you parry. Choose one at this level and another at level 6 and 10,
Quaking Rune - All ruptured creatures are also staggered. Vengeful Rune - Your next onslaught against a ruptured creature costs no energy. If you are within range, you can use onslaught as an instant action. Celestial Rune - All ruptured creatures are smited by divine power, taking 2d6+lvl (7+lvl) holy damage.
Cursed Rune - All ruptured creatures gain weakness 2 to all damage for 1 minute. Ligma Rune - All ruptured creatures contract ligma.

feats/general-feats/skill-focus.html.title: Skill Focus
feats/general-feats/skill-focus.html.description:
Requirements -Gain the following twice. Choosing either...A. Choose one skill. You roll it with Advantage.
When you take 10 with this skill, you instead take 15. If a feature calls for you to use 10+(skill bonus) as a DC for something, instead use 15+DC.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Close Combat
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 2 Unarmed👊
Tags: Prepared Action: -
You have mastered the art of getting up close and personal to an uncomfortable degree. You can enter the spaces of creatures that are your size or smaller and keep up the pressure by using elbow and knee strikes.
This costs 30 ft of movement, and makes it so your enemy is unable to effectively Attack you. They have Disadvantage on attacks made against you while you share their space. You have disadvantage on any attacks that aren't unarmed attacks.This has no effect against creatures that are larger than you.
Leaving a space occupied by a creature no longer Provokes for you, regardless of the enemy's size.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Axe Kick
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 3 Unarmed👊 Tags: -
Action: Special Attack
Jump into the air and bring your heel down upon your target's shoulder...Or something close to it at least. This Unarmed Attack deals an additional d8 (4) damage and breaks your the bones leading to your opponents arm (fort reduces to sickened 1).
While their bone is broken, every time they use the arm, such as using a shield action, making a Natural Attack or casting a spell using a held Staff Component, they take d8 (4) True Damage and become sickened 1.
This effect can be removed with first aid.

techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.title: Hammer Fist
techniques/martial-techniques/unarmed/le.description:
Level 4 Unarmed👊 Tags: - Action: Special Attack
Grasp your two hands together and bring them down upon your foe. This Unarmed Attack deals an additional 3d8 (13) crush damage and makes the opponent Confused On-hit (will adds 2 to confusion rolls).

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: Vrock
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description:
A sinister looking bird of roughly humanoid shape sheds spores as it scratches its feathers with its claws. As it picks itself with its beak, it notices you and lets out a unholy sound that sounds like a mix of hundreds screaming.Level 6 Large Fiend (Minion)Resistance - Zap, Sonic
Talon (S) +9 (+4 drag, +4 MV, only usable while flying) 2d8+3 (12) Peck (P) +9 2d8+3 (12)
Multiattack - Make 2 talon attacks.
Innate Techniques - Finger Gun
1/day - Most Annoying Sound, Garrote
Constant - Lightning Rod
Static Charge Zap - Vrocks can dance as a standard action in order to build up 1 stack of static electricity. When multiple rocks are in the same combat, they all share the same static counter. This visibly manifests itself as crackling electricity that jumps from vrock to vrock, as though they were Firebender🔥s.
At any point a vrock can spend 1 point of this static to cast Lightning Bolt. By spending an additional point of static they Upcast the spell 1 level as well as increase the DC and CL by 4. By spending more static charges, they can keep increasing these numbers infinitely.
Static can only be charged in combat and not while a vrock Hides.
Scream Scavenger Sonic Mind-Affecting Recharge - A vrock can make their scream sound like any creature they have eaten.
As a standard action, they can scream with all of their voices at once. Non-Fiends👿 within 20 ft of the vrock take 2d6 (7) sonic damage and are dazed (will negates daze). A vrock must eat another creature with a voice to recharge this ability.
Spread the Rot - When a creature makes a Melee Attack against a vrock, it releases a puff of rotten feathers littered with insects and fungus in their face. The creature becomes Sickened 1 (fort negates). This effect can only trigger once each turn, regardless of how many attacks the creature makes. At the end of the creatures turn it is sickened by this ability, it becomes Drained equal to its sicken penalty.
As a standard action, a vrock an affect all creatures within its natural reach with this ability.
Take a Bath - If a vrock is made Wet, then it becomes Sickened 1. If it is somehow thoroughly cleaned, they become sickened 2. While sickened in this way, a vrock cannot Spread the Rot.
Weakness - 6 holy
Ability Scores - STR +1, DEX +3, LUK +0, INT +1, WIS +2, CHA +0 Languages - Infernal, Common, Celestial
Senses - Nightvision, Scent (10 ft, 300 ft carrion)
Deific Boons - from my cold dead head

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description:
A humanoid shaped fiend with horns, wings and intricate armor carries itself with a degree of confidence. As it looms over you, you feel all hope fade.Level 8 Large Fiend (Anomaly)Resistance - Zap
Regeneration - Does not function while a creature exists in its Aura of Dread
Claw (S) +11 (+2 MM Sniping) 2d6+3 (10)
Innate Techniques (CL 9+1 force) - Dispel Magic, Drain Soul (U4)
1/day - Great Gavel, Storm Step, Rushing Winds
Constant - Heavens' Vengeance (U4)

Force Punch Sp Force - As a standard action, a dreadlord can make a melee Spell Attack. It deals 5d8+10 (32) force damage. A creature is pushed a distance away from the dreadlord equal to the damage dealt by the attack (rounded down to nearest 5).Take a Bath -

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: Succubus
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description:
A feminine fiend with curves in all the right places snaps her whip-like tail at friend and foe alike, all thankful for such a thoughtful blessing. Level 9 Medium Fiend (Mastermind)Sweet Essence Healing - Whenever a succubus inflicts drain or Horny, they heal 5 hp.Tail Whip (S) +12 (+10 reach during turn, +8 grapple, +2 drag, +2 topple) d6+3 (6) +1 stack of Horny
Stomp (C) +12 (only usable against Knocked Down targets) 2d8+3 (12) +1 stack of Horny
Multiattack - Make 2 Whip attacks. One against an ally and one against an enemy.
Innate Techniques (CL 10) - Unnatural Lust, Detect Thots, Detect Thoughts, Charming Gaze, Fake Out, Command, Teleblock
1/day - Domination, Feign Defeat, Order 66, The Hand that Feeds (U5)
Constant - Sympathy, Sense Motives
Horny Jail Lewd - On-hit for its attacks, whenever a creature fails a save against one of its spells or when a creature is Charmed by a succubus, it gains a stack of Horny. Horny stacks intensify physical sensation, functioning as Weakness equal to horny value. The succubus' DC increases by a value equal to the horny stacks on a particular creature. Upon becoming horny 3, a creature becomes Staggered for 1 round. Upon becoming horny 6, the creature gets put in Time Out.
These stacks disappear once every succubus is defeated.
Constrict - Drain 6
Kiss Su - As part of maintaining a Grapple, or as a melee attack, a succubus can kiss an enemy to make them Charmed for 1 round and add one stack of Horny.
Sudden Betrayal- The succubus can use +Disguise in place of +Stealth to Surprise, or if the combat has already started, to inflict DD on the turn of the reveal. Only functions once per combat, and only if the succubus started the combat while in a Polymorph effect.
Whipped Into Shape - A succubus' tail functions as a whip. A succubus can use this whip against allies that are a lower LvL than it. Instead of the usual effects, it allows them to count as the succubus' Companion and grant the creature their teamwork feats. This companionship lasts until they whip another creature while they already have 2 companions. They can AoO allies that move within their natural reach.
Rejection Vulnerability - Whenever a succubus fails a CHA Ability Check or Skill Check, they take 1 psychic damage. A creature can automatically do 1+CHA damage to the succubus by insulting their appearance, taste in hats etc (standard).
Weakness - 3 holy
Ability Scores - STR +0, DEX +3, LUK +2, INT +1, WIS +2, CHA +4
Languages - Telepathy, Infernal, Common, Celestial
Polymorph (Su) poly, true - A succubus can match the appearance of any playable race🏁. Transforming into a creature is a standard action, but returning to its true form is a free action.
Senses - Nightvision Tail - The succubus has a prehensile tail that can finely manipulate objects up to 15 ft away.
Profane Gift (Su) Scrying - As part of an intimate encounter. You can confer a gift of +1 to an ability score (max +3) on up to 3 willing creatures. Gifted creatures also receive other effects.
You can telepathically communicate with these creatures over any distance.
They are permanently charmed by you, which cannot be removed without first removing the gift.
You can scry these creatures.
You form a Summoning Contract📜 with these creatures. You can summon one as a standard action. This portion of the ability has the companion tag.
Deific Boons - party animal, mistrust, devil's in the details Speed - 45
Feats - Spell Ambush, Feint Partner, Gang Up, Skill Focus, Perfect Positioning, Take the Hit
Skills - +13 +Perception👀, +17 +Insight🤔, +20 (adv) +Disguise, +20 +Persuasion, +20 (adv) +Deception, +13 +Local, +13 +Planes, +13 +History, +13 Arcana
Art by me!

bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.title: Balor
bestiary/bestiary/fiends/level-folder-fi.description:
A sigil of a name in infernal floats in the air. The burning text intensifies as you approach before it unleashes an enormous fiend with a hankering for destruction.Level 14 Large Fiend (Mastermind) Boss
Immunity - Fire
Recovery
Bleed for Master Su Healing - At the start of the balor's turn, all of its allies within 60 feet without the defeated condition take 5 True Damage and the balor heals for this amount.
Flame Whip (S+Fire) +19 (+10 Reach during turn, +8 drag, +4 MV, +2 Topple) d6+5 (8)+10 fire (+Taste Fear)
Serrated Sword (S) +19 (+10 drain bleed) d6+5 (8) (+Taste Fear)
Multiattack - The balor makes 2 attacks. It dual wields its flame whip and serrated sword.
Innate Techniques (CL 15) - Bladed Decimation, Telekinetic Thrust, Backfire
1/day - Calamity, Wall of Fire (U6), Fire Blast (U6), Warcry, Extreme Speed, Armed Robbery,
Constant - Taste Fear
Quicken Spell - Telekinetic Thrust
Destruction Unbound (Su) Recharge - 1/day when a balor falls below half hp, a chain reaction is triggered inside of it, with an obvious glow to any who can see it. At the start of its next turn, it unleashes a devastating blast that deals 30 true damage to every creature (other than the balor) within 30 ft, and knocking them back 30 ft (reflex haves damage and negates the knockback).
Cruel Critical - When a balor crits, the creature becomes Shaken 2.
Doomed - Enemy minions in combat against a balor are shaken 4.
Head Collector - When a balor melee attacks a defeated creature or lowers a creature's +HP to zero with an attack, and they become defeated, they are decapitated. This can only be done if it deals slash damage.
Equal Opportunity Execution - A balor can use its Fearsome Finisher feat when it defeats or kills one of its allies.Boss Actions: Usable twice per turn
Get Over Here! - Usable at the end of a creature's turn after it exits the balor's Threaten range. A balor can use its Telekinetic Thrust technique to pull an enemy adjacent to it (up to 30 ft), but it deals no damage.
Get Back Up! - Whenever an ally that isn't the balor is Knocked Down or is forcefully moved from its space, it can use its Telekinetic Thrust technique to prevent them from moving or getting knocked over.
Roar - Usable at the end of a creature's turn if it damaged the balor that turn. If they are within 60 ft, it can Demoralize them. If successful, the creature becomes shaken 2. If the creature was already shaken 4, they become Frightened.
Worthless Minion (healing) - At the end of a creature's turn (including its own) a balor can execute an ally that is below 20 +HP or that is a minion to it. When it does so, it heals the creatures remaining hp, or half that if it is a minion.
Holy Tincture - When the balor drops below half hp and its Destruction Unbound ability triggers, if before its next turn it is exposed to Holy Water, the damage of its explosion changes to holy and it damages the balor (with no saving throw).
Weakness - Weakness 5 Holy
Ability Scores - STR +5, DEX +2, LUK +1, INT +1, Wis +2, Cha +0 Languages - Infernal, Common
Senses - Nightvision
Signature Skill - one eye open, quick scan
Equipment - Heavy Armor, Serrated Sword, Flame Whip, Medium Armor
Speed - 40, 40 Fly
Roar (recharge) - A balor can affect its voice as per Amplify at will. As a standard action, a balor can let out a roar that echoes miles. In this roar contains a few words, typically something like "converge on me" or "mission complete, retreat" that all Fiends👿 can intuit its meaning. Usable once an hour.

Feats - Callous Casting, Signature Skill, Skill Focus, Dual-Wielding Versatility, Maneuver Versatility, Fearsome Finisher, Bonded Weapon

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: Goo Gang
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 1 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Figment, Concentration Action: Swift
You create 3 slimy copies of yourself that relentlessly follow a creature of your choosing (even into areas you couldn’t go, such as into the air). While they persist, they each take up a single space adjacent to the creature the most optimally to provide flanking. If they are targeted with a hostile attack, spell or take any damage, they disappear. Their movement is elusive.
These duplicates are treated as though they have all +Teamwork Feats.

techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.title: That's All Folks!
techniques/magical-techniques/goomshroom.description:
Level 4 Goomshroom🍄
Tags: Elusive Action: Standard
Your staff grows to comically large size to move a creature to any space adjacent to you. If the creature is an enemy, it also becomes Clumsy 2 (reflex negates forced movement).

bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.title: Haunted Golem
bestiary/bestiary/constructs/level-folde.description:
You see a statue whose color has faded away with time. Suddenly your sword comes out of its sheathe and starts to swing at you on its own. Once you grab it out of the air, the statue animates and flings you into the air.Level 5 Large Construct/UndeadIncorporeal
Innate Techniques (CL 7) - Icicle, Sky Uppercut (U3), Life Drinker, Never Lucky (U3), Chill Metal, Sanctuary, Barrier, Mud Buddy
1/day - Earth Shatter, Haunted, Fake Out, Foe Toss
Possess Object Su Subtle Recharge - While hiding in plain sight, a haunted golem can covertly possess an item within 30 ft, giving the item a Hover speed of 30 and the ability to communicate telepathically. As a standard action, the golem can make a Melee Attack with the object, dealing either the weapon damage or its unarmed damage, whichever is higher. It can use the weapons special attacks, but otherwise no other types of special attacks.
The possessed object has Poise equal to the haunted golems. When disarmed, the animating force in the weapon disappears and this ability ends. The creature that successfully disarmed the weapon can choose to wield the weapon.
Protector - Whenever an allied Minion is damaged, a haunted golem can choose to move its speed to Threaten the enemy that did the damage. If they already threatened them, they can make a Simple Attack against them.
Protector of the Innocent - A haunted golem can intuitively tell when a creature is a minion. It will not do anything that could cause +HP damage to such creatures.
Ability Scores - STR +3, DEX +0, LUK +0, INT +1, WIS +0, CHA +0 Languages - Common
Hide in Plain Sight - Any abandoned building/ancient ruins
Speed - 30 Land Speed, 30 Hover
Feats - Maneuver Versatility, Directed Disarm, MM Bullying Spell
Skills - +7 +Perception👀, +7 +Deception

bestiary/bestiary/cryptids/level-folder-.description:
Humanoid in shape with cloven hooves and the head of a bull, this creature assesses you before mindlessly charging at your red mage.Level 3 Humanoid/CryptidGore (P) +6 (+2 Seeing Red, +2 Charge, +4 Topple) 2d8+3 (12)
2h Axe (S) +6 (+2 Seeing Red, +2 Charge) 2d8+3 (12) Earthbending (C) +6 (30 ft) 3d8+3 (16)

1/day - Ferocious Howl

Powerful Charge

Summon Ally - 1 Loot Goblin (only while in a dungeon or maze)
Special Attack: All In, cleave, lacerateA-MAZE-ing - Minotaurs are exceptionally good at not getting lost. Once upon a time their people built elaborate mazes between their settlements and the outside world. Most lie in ruin. A minotaur always knows how to get to any point in their maze quickly, and can even physically change the maze with earth bending to create shortcuts. Their tremorsense increases to include any area that can be considered a "maze."
Can't Look Away - Minotaurs have Disadvantage on saves against effects that taunt originating from creatures who are significantly red or bleeding.

classes/barbarian/archetypes/beast-totem.title: Beast Totem
classes/barbarian/archetypes/beast-totem.description:
Embrace your wild side. Beast totem barbarians tend to be furrier and feathery-er than most.You gain the beast trainer's beast companion🐶 class feature. You are limited to choosing the strong type companion. Your companion starts off with 2 adaptation points🧬, and gains no more as it levels. Its Level is your level-1. (yes you can be level 0)Numbers are level requirementsYou and your beast companion gain an additional 40 speed each round that can only be used to climb or swim. As a swift action, you can sprout wings to gain the glide feature for 1 round.
You get knowledge nature proficiency with a +4 bonus. You can use it while raging. You also know the druidic secret language.Gain blindsense (scent, 10 ft). You and your beast companion gain seeking against any creature that does not have full hp.
Choose a specific animal you can transform into and back from as a swift action. Gain a single natural attack that deals 2d6 damage and 3 points worth of abilities from the Polymorph List🧬feature that only apply when in spirit animal form. Once chosen, these features cannot be altered.Your appearance is slightly unnatural for the type of creature you transform into, typically being larger and more dangerous looking with glowing eyes or strange fur patterns.Your companion can also transform into this form as an instant action when you do.You can speak with beasts as though you shared a common language. They are able to much better articulate their feelings as though they possessed the intellect of a simple humanoid, but their instincts, desires and attitude toward you remain largely the same.When your beast companion successfully performs a drag maneuver, it gains an additional 30 speed. It must be able to end this movement with the drag target in a space you threaten if it uses this bonus speed.Whenever you Rage, your beast companion can Rage as an instant action, gaining the benefits of your Rage.

classes/barbarian/archetypes/bronze-tote.title: Bronze Totem (Bronzebarian)
classes/barbarian/archetypes/bronze-tote.description:
An intellectual and cultured individual at heart, a bronzebarian applies a surprising amount of creativity to their techniques and fighting styles. Using the most advanced caveman strategies, bronzebarians set themselves apart from other barbarians.You can use your muscles to make up for your lack of intellect. As long as you have a negative intelligence score, you add your strength to int-based skills instead of intelligence. You can automatically tell when a creature has a negative intelligence score just by looking at them. You may use INT-based skills while raging.Numbers are level requirements
By taking one hand and wrapping it around the opposite wrist, you figure out how to two-hand your fists. When using unarmed strike, the barbarian can use both hands, effectively treating it as a 2h weapon. Gain unarmed combatant as a bonus feat and increase fist base damage to 2d8.You can speak with any creature that has a negative intelligence score as though sharing a common language. He can write in this language, and it is treated as a secret language to those without a negative intelligence score.Creatures with -3 or less intelligence, or that lack an intelligence score, have only very basic thoughts.When a creature makes an AoO against you after you provoke from movement, you increase your speed by 40 that turn. This can happen infinitely. Gain resistance to damage from AoOs.
You can use your vast pool of knowledge to make impromptu repairs by smashing, bending and slapping things. Roll an +Athletics🏊 check as a standard action. If you beat the DC by 5, then the item is permanently repaired. Otherwise it falls apart again after a few minutes and you are unable to attempt "repairing" it again.Simple devices like a shovel or a tire swing only require a DC 10. Average devices like doors or backpacks are DC 15. Slightly complex devices like a toilet or a lamp are DC 20. Weapons and armor are DC 25. Complex devices like factory machinery and other large mechanical devices are DC 30.You can attempt to fix something of a much larger scale, such as a factory on the brink of destruction, or fixing the sword of a huge giant, but the DC increases by 5.You have an inexplicable sixth sense for what lies in the unknown. Before opening the door to a room, walking into a dark cave, or walking into a ghost town, you can always tell one choice piece of information from the following list... How many creatures of significance are within (1, several, many, innumerable) A vague idea of what is happening (a party, intercourse, a heinous ritual, research) The level of the most powerful creature within, and a random thing they like This ability recharges after 5 minutes, and generally cannot be used at the same location multiple times without a significant change occurring.

classes/barbarian/archetypes/gigantotem..description: Become large and in charge.When raging, your size increases to large. At level 6 you can choose to instead become huge. At level 10 you can choose to become massive.Numbers are level requirementsWhenever you take the jump action, create a shockwave affecting all creatures within your natural reach of where you land. Creatures are made clumsy 1.The ground quakes with each step you take. Whenever you take the dash or charge action, you can move through other creatures squares and your movement is [elusive]. Creatures you move through take (5+2*lvl) bludgeoning damage (reflex halves).You cannot attack a creature you step on with this ability.You get a +4 bonus to athletics to break or displace things while raging. Every time you break something with athletics, you gain +1 wrath.When you take the charge or dash action, you can make athletics checks to destroy or displace obstacles such as doors, walls and other barriers as a free action any number of times as long as you continue to succeed. If you initiate combat by doing this, the enemy is surprised.Can only be used against creatures smaller than you.You can innately use the Foe Toss technique at will.
