classes/barbarian/archetypes/superstitio.title: Superstitious Totem
classes/barbarian/archetypes/superstitio.description:
Don't like magic? There's a totem for that. Now you can play the paranoid anti mage.You get arcana proficiency and can use it while raging.
You gain 1 technique point you must spend on the Arc tree. Gain another at level 5 and 9.Numbers are level requirements
You get a +4 bonus on arcana checks.
You see magical auras around creatures constantly. You know the highest level spell a creature can cast just by looking at them. You automatically get a +Perception👀 check to see a creature’s true form vs their DC. If you strike a creature disguising their true form, they revert back to it.
You gain (LvL) Temp HP whenever an enemy casts a spell on you. Gain 2 special attacks Let it Burn - On hit, mana burn 1+(1/2) lvl, or expend the use of a 1/day innate technique. Spellrend - If you land an attack against a persistent Su or Sp effect with HP, such as a wall spell or a summoned creature, you automatically deal the attack's damage to the creature that created the effect too.You have trained your body to react to magic words with violence. When an enemy you threaten casts a spell, you must make an AoO against them. On hit the spell they cast fizzles (fort negates).\

classes/bard/archetypes/bard-of-the-blue.title: Bard of the Blues
classes/bard/archetypes/bard-of-the-blue.description:
Blues bards specialize in music to bring their enemies down rather than bringing their allies up. They play songs that intimidate, fascinate and confound their enemies. Their finales are all about finishing the combat once and for all.Removes inspiration.Blues bards have the bardic performance ability, but with a few key differences. Their performances vary in action type, with some of the more powerful performances requiring a standard action to begin.& They can only ever affect enemies with their performances. Creatures get a new save to end performances at the end of each turn (but not finales). Some performances, like inspire doom and the blues, have no save. Once a creature passes its save against a performance, it becomes completely immune to that particular performance type for 1 hour. They get advantage on saves against other performances. Status effects from performance immediately end when a creature is no longer in the aura, allowing enemies to just leave, or push the bard away. This does not trigger the immunity/resistance to performance listed above. Action: Swift Enemies take a -2 penalty to attack and saves against fear effects.Action: Swift Enemies treat the area of the performance as difficult terrain. This performance is unaffected by high note.Make an attack with a +10 bonus. You can also perform a special attack or technique that involves an attack (including a spell attack) with this finale.Roast your enemies, causing them to falter when it matters most. As an immediate action, you can force a creature within 30 ft to subtract a d6 to a d20 roll (minus luck checks). At level 6 this increases to d8. At level 10 this improves to d10.This ability can be used once per minute. You can ignore the recharge time and use it again if you mana burn 2.Action: Standard Enemies are fascinated (will negates). When used in combat, creatures get a new save at the end of each turn.Enemies are confused until they get an "act normally result."You can gather a crowd of commoners in a settlement and cause them to riot over a specific topic. They grab their pitchforks and torches and start marching to burn something down, kill a scourge to society or something similar. You must continue this performance and lead them to maintain their fervor.A creature outside of the crowd can attempt a persuasion roll (against the Blues Bard's DC with disadvantage) if they can get loud enough to be heard by the crowd. Once this persuasion check is successful, the crowd disperses. If the persuader beats your DC by 5, the crowd turns on you.This doesn't have much practical use in combat unless there happens to be a large quantity of commoners in the area.Action: Standard
Enemies are frightened (will negates).The power of your music is too intense, and everybody must dance to it. Your enemies are stunned (will negates).

classes/bard/archetypes/cheerleader.html.title: Cheerleader
classes/bard/archetypes/cheerleader.html.description:
Cheerleader bards excel at bringing their allies up when times are the toughest with encouraging words and healing effects.The cheerleader only ever gets a singular performance, and allies can choose to gain any one benefit from the performance, deciding at the start of their turn. Below are level requirements for providing a particular benefit. 1 - Raise Morale - Increase allied speed by 10 and give them advantage on saves against fear 1 - Inspire Courage - +2 attack 4 - Song of Healing - Restore 3 hp. 1 - Raise Dongers - ???
A cheerleader can use the aid action as a swift action. They are always grant the improved +2 bonus when aiding in a skill check through their tunes.
You automatically remove all non-Permanent Status effects from an ally within 30 ft of you. They can take a swift or immediate action as an instant action.
Restore (3*lvl) hp to all allies within 30 ft. Defeated creatures healed are not dazed on their next turn.
The music sticks with your allies even after the performance ends. They gain (5*LvL) temp hp. This temp hp disappears at the end of your next turn.
Enemies within 60 ft are pacified for 1 round (will negates). When they are attacked by you or your allies, they get a new save against the effect.

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/p.title: Possessed
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/p.description: A creature who is possessed has another soul inside their body that can exert control over the body. The amount of control can differ depending on the effect from just using their eyes, to taking control of the entire body.In any case, the possessing creature usually leaves their body behind Stunned and vulnerable to attack, unless stated otherwise. The intruder can willingly stop possessing the creature and return to their own body as a free action.
core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/p.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Status Effects/Possessed.md

feats/magic-feats/mm-bullying-spell.html.title: MM Bullying Spell
feats/magic-feats/mm-bullying-spell.html.description:
Requirements - INT +1
The spell does Poise damage equal to the +HP damage it deals. This costs 2 Mana💎. If the spell's target is "1 creature," this only costs 1 mana.Bullying spell cannot be applied to spells that already deal poise damage.

techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.title: Providers Station
techniques/magical-techniques/+cantrips/.description: +Cantrips Tags: - Action: 1 minuteNote: In order to cast this spell, you must have access to the night sky.When the spell is complete, you create an object or small facility that meets the bare minimum requirements for a particular task, trade, or skill, such as a furnace for heating pottery or a lockpick. This item will break if used for anything other than its intended purpose, and disappears after the spell's duration or if exposed to sunlight.You must create facilities that can fit within a 10ft cube. This spell does not provide fuel to run facilities. It may create objects with multiple parts, such as a series of vials and tubes for use in alchemy, but these cannot be separated from the facility without disappearing.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Enchant Sapphire
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description: Level 1 Arcane Tags: - Action: 1 hour Material: 500g worth of sapphire jewels or jewelryYou cast a spell on a Sapphire jewel or jewelry, turning it into a consumable magic item. The effects vary based on where the item goes on the body.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Star Sight
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 1 Arcane
Tags: Prepared Action: -
By spending a standard action concentrating each round, you gain a completely unobstructed view of the sky as though it was a clear night. You ignore things like environmental conditions, being indoors and underground, light pollution etc.
You get +2 bonus on Navigation checks.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Wandering Stars
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 1 Arcane
Tags: Pattern Action: Standard
You unleash the beauty of the cosmos upon a creature as a group of stars swirl around them. They are fascinated for one round (will negates). When their fascination ends (including if they pass their save), you can spend an immediate action to make the stars move, provided you can see the target. You can direct the stars at another enemy within 20 ft.This can repeat indefinitely, but cannot effect the same creature more than once. If you do not spend an immediate action to redirect the spell, it ends.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Nebula
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 2 Arcane
Tags: Light, Force Action: Standard
Conjure a cloud of stardust that illuminates in a 20 ft radius. It obscures vision beyond 5 feet, granting partial concealment. Anything beyond 5 feet grants total concealment. At the end of the spell's duration, it ignites dealing 3d8+CL (13+CL) force damage to all creatures in the area automatically.

techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.title: Lunar Eclipse
techniques/magical-techniques/arcane/lev.description:
Level 6 Arcane
Tags: Dark, Concentration, Recharge, Weather Action: 1 minute
You alter the composition of the heavens in such a way to mimic the effect of a lunar eclipse. The radius of the spell is coated in darkness. All non-magical light sources are immediately extinguished and cease to function while in the spells area. Magical light sources that existed in the area previously, that are cast in the radius or are brought into its radius after the fact must at least match your CL or they fizzle.
Lunar eclipse ends automatically if solar eclipse is cast in its range, cancelling each other out.

techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.title: Natural Geomancy
techniques/magical-techniques/mother-ear.description: Level 1 Mother Earth🍃 Tags: - Action: 1 minuteFor the duration of this spell, you get a mental ping whenever anything happens to the targeted plant or plot of terrain. You are informed what kind of interaction happened, such as whether it was trampled, touched, clipped, watered, etc. no matter how insignificant the interaction. You're also aware of the environmental conditions they are experiencing, such as approximate temperature, humidity, and even noise level.For animate plants, you gain a +2 bonus to nature checks to determine their health and needs, and can identify such mentally and remotely.This spell does not grant visual stimuli.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.title: Astrology
techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 1 Psionics🤯
Tags: Recharge Action: 1 minute Material: 1 scroll or parchmentNote: In order to cast this spell, you must know the target's date of birth, and have access to the night sky.When the spell is complete, you convert a scroll or parchment into a Horoscope. The target can read the Horoscope to gain insight into some of the strengths and failings they may have within the next 24 hours. As long as they have the horoscope on their person, they may add 2 to the natural die roll on any skill check. This cannot exceed the natural 20 limit of a d20. After they use this benefit, the horoscope disappears.A creature that cannot read cannot benefit from their Horoscope. A creature may only benefit from Astrology once per day.

bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.title: Giant Frog
bestiary/bestiary/beasts/level-folder-be.description:
A frog sits on a the waters surface, wary of these large travelers. Suddenly it grows to 10 ft tall and shoots its tongue out at you.Level 1 Large BeastMultiattack - Make a tongue and bite attack.Innate Techniques - Frenzied Leap, Kidnap, Metronome
1/day - Power Overwhelming, Lucky Star
Average Amphibion - A giant frog can Surprise creatures by using its frog shape ability to pretend to be a tiny frog. Creatures must roll a +Perception👀 check against the frog's DC to avoid being surprised.

A group of frogs ride on the back of a massive crocodile. They all hold on for dear life as the croc slides around the battlefield on its belly at high speeds.Level 7 Huge Beast/BeastMan Down! Healing - Whenever the congodile loses a frog, it gains 15 Temp HP. Multiattack - Make 5 tongue attacks

Jaffar - Mind Maze
Frogger - Enfroggen

If a creature Poise breaks a congodile, it can choose to throw off a particular frog instead of the attack's usual effects. When it does, the tossed frog turns into a giant frog. The congodile loses one attack in its multiattack and a particular ability from Peanut Gallery depending on which frog gets tossed.

core-rules,-how-to-play/status-effects/d.description:
At the end of the creature's next turn, it falls Asleep.

gods/gods/earthly-deities/frogg-saran/t1.description:

techniques/magical-techniques/lunar/astr.description:
Level 2 Lunar🌙
Tags: Force, Healing Action: StandardA mote of energy resembling a shining star lands on this spot, dealing 2d8+CL (9+CL) force damage to all enemies (reflex halves). Some of the affected creatures' energy is absorbed and you may divert that energy to an ally within range.The ally restores hp equal to the (3 x number of creatures damaged by the spell).

techniques/magical-techniques/lunar/veng.title: Vengeance
techniques/magical-techniques/lunar/veng.description:
Level 3 Lunar🌙

The DC to Identify Spell Being Cast is much easier for Vengeance due to its distinct visual effect of a skull appearing over your head, making the DC 8.This spell has a 1 minute cooldown.

techniques/magical-techniques/psionics/l.description:
Level 3 Psionics🤯
Tags: Prepared, Recharge Action: -
You can foresee events, but you do not know when it will occur. The first time each day you roll serendipity or a luck check of some kind, you add +4 to this check.

An armored warrior stands vigilant over a crown of people in a marketplace. They have a wide assortment of weapons and gaze at you warily as you pass by, sword arm resting on the hilt.Level 2 Medium Human

A creature can only be affected by this 1/day, no matter how many guards shout.Only Human - Guards have lives outside of protecting a town. As such they will typically not engage against creatures they successfully identify are level 6 or higher without someone else of a similar level commanding them.

A dwarf clad entirely in a peculiar set of stony armor wields to massive shields you wonder how he can even carry. The more you swing, the more you panic as it seems impossible to harm him.Level 3 medium Dwarf⛏ Unique

Can't Go Through It - The wall gets Advantage on reflex saves against +Acrobatics⚖ to avoid AoO. Creatures cannot move through the wall's space through any means. Can't Knock it Down - Any effect that would otherwise inflict knockdown, the wall has advantage against.

Similar abilities based on divine power, like a Paladin😇 smite, are unaffected.

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.title: Strafing
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.description: Strafing is any movement in a threatened space that is not a direct path closer to the target. Usually this means moving to get into Flanking, or trying to position yourself in a better spot to Shove for instance. Strafing Provokes just like exiting threatened spaces.Dev Note: The purpose of this rule is to get melee characters leeway when moving up to creatures, but discouraging free movement around someone. It would be pretty silly if you could move 10,000 feet in circles around someone, but then step away from them and only THEN could they attack you.
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/action-s.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Action System/Movement/Strafing.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.title: Ballista
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.description: Cost: 10,000g Weight: 500 lbsSince ballista are so time consuming to load, it usually requires a team of 4 people to fire a shot each round. 1 person to load the bolt and aim, 2 to crank the bolt back and 1 to call the shots.The three people loading are treated as taking the Aid action to increase the attack bonus of the person calling the shots, essentially granting a +6 bonus with a full team. Once loaded, the person calling the shots makes an Ranged Attack Roll.
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/types-.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Attacking/Types of Attack Rolls/Siege Weapons/Ballista.md

core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/target.title: Target
core-rules,-how-to-play/attacking/target.description: A Targeted ability refers to one where you must select targets to apply the effect, which is not an Attack Roll Roll. Some abilities are particular about what they work on, and will fail if used outside of their scope. You must have Line of Effect and be able to see your target to target them. If you cannot see them, you must target their space with the intention of targeting them.

equipment/equipment-types/repairing-equi.title: Repairing Equipment
equipment/equipment-types/repairing-equi.description:
While there aren't any explicit rules that allow you to break equipment, to maintain realism, some circumstances can cause your equipment to break. This could be using your sword to cut down a tree and lose its edge, or using a shield to block a +Siege Weapon.
When equipment is broken, but not completely destroyed, it becomes unusable for its intended purpose. Any passive abilities (like a shield's Poise) or active abilities (like a sword's cleave) for broken equipment do not function. It requires 10% of the items value in appropriate materials and an appropriate skill for repairing said item (usually +Profession🧑‍🌾). This takes however long it would take someone with that skill to make that much money (see Economics for more details).When an item is destroyed, then it cannot be repaired through traditional means. If it can be repaired at all, it would require special crafting components and a skilled craftsman.

bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.title: Beholder
bestiary/bestiary/aberrations/level-fold.description:
A large floating eye argues with itself as its many eye stalks twitch around and hum with magical energy. If finally decides which eye will be the one to seal your doom and it hums with black energy.Level 11 Large Aberration Boss
All Around Vision - Immune to being flanked
RecoveryBite (P) +12 (+8 exploit) 3d6+1 (11)
Innate Techniques - Dispel Magic
Gaze Su - A beholder has many eyes, but one particularly large one it uses to cancel out magical effects. At the start of the beholder's turn, it decides to focus it's gaze on a single creature it can see (free action). The creature is siphoned for 1 round (will negates). It cannot use its eye stalks ability against this target for 1 round.Eyestalks (Su) - The beholder's extra eyes have the ability to unleash devastating laser beams at creatures within 100 ft. As a standard action it can shoot three of these laser beams at three different creatures. The effect is rolled randomly (reroll duplicates), more details below.Outside of combat, the beholders are able to exert more fine control over its eye stalks, allowing it to telekinetically move objects and disintegrate holes into things with ease. Feel free to change up a few eye beams to make your beholders extra special.Boss Actions - The beholder can perform 2 of the following actions each round. Eyebeam - Fire a random eyestalk beam at an enemy after they end their turn. Exploit - Bite a creature suffering a debilitating status from your eyestalks with a +8 bonus.
Inferior Magic recharge - Roll dispel magic to counter a spell as though you had prepared the action.
Boss Mechanics - Whenever a beholder is staggered, instead of its usual effects, it can can only shoot 2 eyestalks on its turn. When it is dazed, instead it can only shoot 1 eyestalk. When it is stunned, its eyestalk ability is disabled, but it can otherwise act normally.
When a beholder is siphoned, instead of its usual effects, its primary eye closes and it cannot use its gaze.
Whenever a beholder is blinded, instead of gaining the blinded condition, its eyestalk DC decreases by 2. Blurred vision is instead converted into -1 to its eyestalk DC.
Ability Scores - STR +1, DEX +1, LUK +0, INT +4, WIS -1, CHA -1 Languages - Common,
Speed - 10, 35 Hover
Feats - Skill Focus, Speak for the Dead, Defensive Training, Ghostbuster, Blind Fight, Matador
Skill - +16 +Perception👀, +17 +Knowledge🧠 (all, adv Arcana)

bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.title: Blood Dragon
bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.description:
This alien scavenger with no eyes skitters along the ground on all fours, raising its forelegs in response to threats. Only when it is pouncing midair does its target realize the enormous mouth on its underside.Level 5 Huge DragonResistance - Innate Techniques - Twist the Knife
Sneak Attack - Against a DD target, a space crab does an additional 4 damage.
New Home - Against a defeated creature, a space crab can attach to the creature's head and gain control over the actions of the soon to be corpse. After 1 hour, it kills the creature and reanimates it as a zombie as though casting animate dead, but the creature retains its full level. It can then spend all of its actions each turn to command this undead. Only through the space crab's or it's host's death will it detach. When the space crab is killed, the host automatically dies. The space crab must use this on a creature that is initially alive. It cannot use this ability on a creature that was already dead. Use the zombie stat block for generic humanoid host. Hosts can be anything; the space crab just has to get lucky.
What's Poppin? - A space crab can only make an attack roll in the same turn it takes the Jump action. It does not threaten.
Ability Scores - STR -1, DEX +1, LUK +1, INT -3, WIS +0, CHA +0
Senses - +Blindsense, Scent 5 ft
Speed - 35 Land Speed, 50 Fly Enhanced Leap - When the space crab jumps, it moves 30 feet, regardless of its speed, as long as it is not 0.
Feats - Skill Focus
Skills - +2 +Perception👀, +5 (adv) +Stealth

bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.title: Wildfire Wyrm
bestiary/bestiary/dragons/level-folder-d.description: This long serpentine dragon looks like it's made of wood, with a raging fire boiling underneath the gaps in its scales. It's face decorated with a flaming beard, mustache and eyebrows with bony horns.Level 12 Huge Dragon/Plant [boss]AC 28 HP 260 Poise 44 (DRA 2) Fort +16, Refl +18, Will +13Immune - FireRooted [healing] - As a swift action while groundborne, a wildfire dragon can cause roots to shoot out of its legs and burrow into the ground, allowing it to take the total defense action and reduce its speed to 0 this turn.If it remains rooted (aka it doesn't move or isn't forcefully moved), it total defenses again each turn for free. It also regains 20 hp at the start of its next turn. Steady Flight - Dragons cap at clumsy 2 while flying. They can take flight as a free actionStomper - Dragons do not provoke AoOs from leaving a threatened square against creatures that are knocked down.Bite (P) +16 3d8+4 (17)Tail (C) +16 (+free knockdown attempt, +4 knockdown) 2d6+4 (11)Multiattack - Make a claw and a tail attack. Innate Techniques - 1/day - Man Drop, Seismic Setup [earth] - As a swift action, a wildfire dragon can slam the ground with its tail near a creature within reach, causing the earth to crack like a seesaw, sending the creature into the air and causing them to land 30 ft away from their starting position knocked down (reflex reduces to 10 poise damage).Breath Weapon (Su) [recharge] [fire] - 10d6 (35) fire (reflex halves) 60 ft cone. Any greenery in the cone is instantly turned to ash. Trees and other wooden objects are scorched. If an object is already scorched, it turns into ash.The breath weapon recharges when the dragon uses its timber feature.Tail Swipe - As a swift action while grounded, a dragon can make a quick turnaround and swipe at foes it threatens with its tail. Creatures take (10+lvl) poise damage (reflex halves). Poise broken creatures are knocked down.Scale Shatter [fire] - Every time a wildfire dragon drops to a threshold noted in "wooden scales," many scales break rank and explode, embedding themselves in nearby surfaces (and creatures). Creatures within reach take 4d6 (14) pierce damage and creatures within 30 ft take 2d6 (7) pierce damage (reflex halves). Creatures that fail their save have scales embedded in their skin, dealing 2d6 (7) fire damage at the start of their turns.The scales can be removed automatically as a swift action, or as a free action if the creature possesses the medicine skill.Fissure [earth] - If a wildfire dragon senses a creature with its tremorsense while burrowed underground, it can appear suddenly and violently. It shatters the ground within 30ft of the position it exits the ground from. This ability only functions on unsuspecting creatures. When using it, creatures get a perception check (DC 22) to notice. Those that fail to notice are entangled and silenced while crushed inside cracks in the earth and unable to breathe. If a creature rolls at least 32 on perception, they can push them to safety, treating them as though they noticed the fissures.This does not require an action and is intended to be used as an opener in place of stealth.Boss Actions - Usable 1/turn.Timber [recharge] - At the end of another creature's turn, take a bite out of a tree and cause it to fall in a direction of the wildfire dragon's choosing. This essentially functions as a line attack whose distance depends on the size of the tree. All creatures in this line take 4d6 (14) crush damage, are knocked down and entangled (reflex negates). The knockdown condition cannot be removed until the entangled is removed first. Creatures can attempt to escape using athletics as a standard action. Dealing 30 damage to the tree is also enough to free a creature, or 15 slash or fire damage. Cannot be used in consecutive turns (chew your food!). Begone! - Use seismic setup at the end of another creatures turn. Pin - Usable when a creature moves adjacent to a wall while within reach. The dragon makes a melee attack that deals tail damage and entangles the creature on hit. This entangle lasts until the wildfire dragon is no longer threatening the creature or it is poise broken. Friction [fire] - If a creature within reach is currently entangled, a wildfire dragon can end the condition by dragging the length of its entire body against the creature rapidly. This automatically sunders the creatures armor (or shield if the creature chooses), deals 8d6 (28) slashing and fire damage and inflicts a unique T3 affliction.Melted Away - IfBoss Mechanic: Wooden Scales - A wildfire dragon has surprisingly soft and vulnerable scales, so it has developed a unique form of protection. It uses its magic to form a wooden scale exoskeleton on the outside of its body. As the wildfire dragon fights, it gives off heat which burns away these scales, leaving itself vulnerable, but giving it greater mobility.When a wildfire dragon reaches 210 hp, and every time it loses 50 more (160, 110, 60, 10), a layer of the scales explodes violently, activating scale shatter, decreasing the dragon's AC by 1, but increasing its speeds by 10. Healing past this threshold does not allow them to regain this AC or use scale shatter again.From the Ashes - Wildfire dragons must consume the ashen remains of creatures in order to replenish the protection from their wooden scales. They need a supplemental supply of ashes with their usual meals over the course of a week to regain 1 layer of scales. They typically bury themselves somewhere near their supply.Ability Scores - Str +4, Dex +4, Lucc +0, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha +0Dragon Senses - Echolocation (30 ft), scent (10 ft), Darkvision, Tremorsense (30 ft)Ashen One - Whenever a wildfire dragon uses an ability with the [earth] tag, or its timber ability, and a significant pile of ash is on the ground within 5 ft of its AoE, it kicks up a 20 ft radius cloud of ash that persists for 3 rounds.Creatures can see things through 10 ft of ash with partial concealment. Anything past that is total concealment. While within a cloud of ash, creatures without proper protection against harmful gasses are sickened 1 [fort negates]. This is a [persistent] effect. The wildfire dragon cannot be sickened by this.Stache - A wildfire dragons "mustache" hair is quite dexterous, allowing it to perform tasks that require precision, such as sleight of hand. Speed - 30, fly 30, burrow 30 (+10 per scale shatter)Overland Flight - When allowed to fly long distances high in the sky, a dragon can fly 600 miles a day, or 1000 if it fatigues itself and never stops to rest. It can continue moving this fast for consecutive days by becoming drained 1 each day it does.Feats - Blind Fight, ligmaSkills - +15 (+4) perception, +18 athletics, +18 Sleight of Hand,

bestiary/bestiary/giant/level-folder-gia.title: Frost Giant
bestiary/bestiary/giant/level-folder-gia.description:
This reclusive blue giant lives almost exclusively in the frozen corners of the world where the ice never melts. It wields a weapon with a peculiar shape to it and moves along snow and ice with startling speed.Level 4 Large GiantResistance - Cold
Interception - As an immediate action when they wield a hockey stick, a frost giant can parry a Ranged Attack. They can even do this against siege weapons.
Multiattack - Make a combat maneuver👐 and a Melee Attack
Innate Techniques - Cripple, Spartan Kick, Fore!, Put Me In!, Dive, Bull Rush
1/day - Flying Arrow, Frost Armor
Constant - Ice Skating (self)Hockey - Frost giants always carry around a piece of solid ice that can be used as a puck for a game of hockey, or as a deadly weapon when needed.
Frost giants can create these pucks as a standard action, and they cannot exist within 300 ft of another before the one moved into range of the other phases out of existence, as per the rules of the game (Su).
A frost giant can use a puck attack if it controls a puck. It can do as a free action whenever a puck isn't already controlled and within it's natural reach while it wields a hockey stick. A frost giant can pass the puck to an ally as a swift action
A puck cannot be taken without first Poise breaking a giant that controls one. When a creatures loses control of of a puck, it flies a random direction 20 ft. Team Spirit - Frost giants live in tight enclaves and are wildly fascinated with their home team. They take great pride in their abilities and readily accept challengers. They are even willing to accept challenges from people who do not play hockey, with the goal of the challengers usually to score a single goal on the team of giants.
Teams are always played with an equal number of players, usually with at least 4, and players aren't allowed to deal any +HP damage to others. Other than that, there are no hard fast rules. The goal of the players is to pass a wide stretch with a puck. Because the frost giants are exceedingly good at bullying players, they will likely need to think of clever ways to disarm, distract or otherwise get the giants out of the picture. They will also need to maneuver across ice (see Frosty Terrain❄).Giants are pretty big, so their rinks are over 400 ft wide from goal to goal. A start from the center requires 200 ft for the puck to travel.
Ability Scores - STR +4, DEX +1, LUK +0, INT +0, WIS +0, CHA +1 Languages - Common, Giant
Speed - 35, 45 ice skating
Feats - Ricochet Toss, Point Blank Master, Maneuver Versatility, Sentinel, Escape Route, Gang Up
Skills - +6 +Perception👀, +10 +Athletics🏊, +6 +Nature🍃, +8 +Profession🧑‍🌾 (hockey)

bestiary/environmental-hazards/+environm.title: +Environmental Hazards
bestiary/environmental-hazards/+environm.description: What happens when you fall in lava? What does altitude sickness do? Extreme heat? Geysers?There are all kinds of things that aren't exactly creatures. It would be a tragedy if you had to figure out what happens yourself. This section is filled with all kinds of things that can pose a threat to the squishy humanoids ill prepared for what mother earth has in store for them.Note: Many creatures you encounter will be adapted to the environment they are in. You should probably not bother having lava affect creatures that are made of fire or obsidian for instance. These are soft immunities that are not included in the creature's stat block and should be granted based on vibes.

bestiary/environmental-hazards/frosty-te.title: Frosty Terrain
bestiary/environmental-hazards/frosty-te.description:
Adventures bring creatures to all kinds of places, including those in the far northern reaches of the world. This should help you deal with things like snow and ice peppering or covering your battles.Snow Light snow usually not too cumbersome. To an average person it doesn't even submerge their shoes. Light snow only inflicts movement penalties on creatures who are small or smaller, who treat it as difficult terrain.Heavy Snow
Heavy snow is very cumbersome. Usually at least a foot deep, heavy snow counts as difficult terrain unless you are huge or larger. Creatures who are small enough can Hide inside of snow by burrowing inside it.Ice
Frozen lakes or slippery floors to winter caves can cause a problem for clumsy individuals. By treating ice as difficult terrain, any further penalties can be avoided. Attempting to move at full speed requires a DC 10 +Acrobatics⚖ check to Balance. Failure inflicts Knockdown. Attempting to Jump into or off of ice also requires a check (but no more than one check is needed per round).
Some Cryomancy❄ techniques create ice surfaces, and use the creatures DC instead of the base 10 listed here.Any forced movement against a creature standing on ice is increased by 5 ft.

bestiary/environmental-hazards/gravity.h.title: Gravity
bestiary/environmental-hazards/gravity.h.description:
Most of the time, gravity should not be much of an issue, but in particularly strange scenarios gravity can change to be more or less intense. This section should help you navigate such scenarios.Low Gravity Low gravity lets creatures move vertically a lot more freely. It no longer requires a swift action in order to take the Jump action and creatures can automatically jump as far and as high as a creature's Land Speed. Low gravity also negates Fall Damage.
Whenever you force a creature to move in low gravity, such as when you Shove a creature, the distance you move them is increased by 10 feet.No Gravity Low gravity can be very complicated. Many features of the game assume gravity, y'know, exists. The combination of gravity and friction are the foundation of how we understand basic physics. In the absence of gravity, all momentum is practically infinite. If you push yourself, or a creature pushes you, off of a surface, you will continue to move in that direction until acted upon by another force. This can potentially lead to scenarios where creatures unintentionally float off into directions much further than they would like.
Actions that require deliberate force, such as a Shove attack, also have an equal an opposite effect on the shover. All forced movement is increased by 20 ft. This forced movement becomes a Persistent effect that triggers each round without another force at play.
All Land Speed is changed to 30 ft. If you move in a direction, you require anchors in order move in anything other than a straight line. Some locations may still allow you to use Climb🧗 speeds. Fly speeds require air in order to function and thus do not work in the vacuum of space. Zero gravity in aquatic scenarios typically won't have an impact unless it is activated near the water's surface, but otherwise, Swim speeds should function as normal.High Gravity
High gravity restricts movement and affects how much you can lift. Creature's with low STR will be more impeded than others. All creatures with movement impeded by high gravity are Grounded.
Tier 1 - Creatures with -1 STR or less have all of their speeds halved. All creatures can only lift/manipulate 50% as much.
Tier 2 - Creatures with +1 STR or less have all their speeds halved. Creatures with -1 or less STR must roll a DC 10 STR Ability Check each round to move at all. All creatures can only lift/manipulate a 20% as much. Tier 3 - Creatures with +3 STR or less have all of their speeds halved. Creatures with -1 or less STR must roll a DC 15 STR ability check each round to move at all. Creatures with +1 or less must roll a DC 10 check. All creatures can only lift/manipulate 10% as much.The distance of all forced movement is halved unless the creature initiating it is unaffected by the speed penalty of the high gravity. Yes I understand this means muscular psionics are better at telekinesis in high gravity. Why don't YOU try and lift a staff when suddenly it weighs 10x as much.You can create more extreme scenarios by continuing to increase these numbers in the same linear fashion, but tier 3 is already crippling almost all creatures.

bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.title: Magic Resist
bestiary/monster-qualities/defense-trait.description: Referred to as MR. Functions just like DR, reducing damage taken by a flat value, but it only functions against Sp or Su abilities.

classes/skyman/runescape-skills.html.title: Runescape Skills
classes/skyman/runescape-skills.html.description:
For clarity's sake... Everything written in Green is a skill. Everything written in Red is a combat talent you can unlock under that skill. Everything written in Blue is a utility talent you can unlock under that skill. Abilities that are preceded by a number have a level requirement.Prayer (Knowledge Religion) Protection Prayers Su - Gain an additional point of prayer and 5 GBP in a god of your choice, or Frogg Saran🐸 if your WIS is -1 or lower. When you would harmed by an attack or fail a saving throw, you can choose to negate the attack or pass the save by spending prayer as an immediate action.
Piety (Su) - Gain an additional point of prayer and 5 GBP in a god of your choice, or Frogg Saran🐸 if your WIS is -1 or lower. By spending prayer as a swift action, you can give yourself a +2 bonus to all d20 rolls until the start of your next turn. Magic (Knowledge Arcana)
Magical Specialization - Gain magical specialization.
(6) Magic! - Gain access to the telekinetic lift and Alchemize techniques as 1/day innate techniques.
(5) Antimagic - Gain access to the teleblock and superstitious techniques as 1/day innate techniques. Herblore (Knowledge Alchemy)
Quick Brewski - You can craft an alchemical item for 10% of its original price with 1 hour of work 1/day. You must still be able to meet its craft DC. You must still be able to provide odd specific ingredients, such as the tongue in a tongues potion.
(5) Chug - You can drink a potion once per turn as a free action. Fishing (Profession Fisher) Reel 'em In - You can use a fishing rod to finely manipulate objects. You can manipulate anything you could normally carry, replacing any sleight of hand check with profession (fisher). Range 30 ft. Patience - You get a +2 bonus to attack when you attack as part of a prepared action. (4) Fish are Friends (Su) - Using the power of fishing, you can convert aquatic creatures into friends. By catching a specific type of fish with a DC 30 profession (fisher) check, you can get a bonus to an +2 associated skill check when using the fish as a tool, as though they successfully used the assist other action. Unique fish might be able to assist in other ways, this is meant to apply to anything, within reason. This fish transcends its fishy existence to survive outside of water to assist you. It cannot be attacked, but it can be stolen. This kills the fish. A few examples of weird fish upgrades below… Hammerhead - Smithing, construction, you name it Pufferfish (or other poisonous) - For use in creating poisons Monkfish - Good for meditation Archerfish - You can trip with your ranged attacks Sharks - Underwater tracking Bass - Good for dropping sick beats Seahorse - Makes for a good underwater mount Woodcutting (Profession Lumberjack)
One With Nature (Sp) - You gain tree shape as an at will innate techniqueique. You can speak with plants. Axe Man - You gain a climb speed equal to your land speed. If you wield an axe, this speed doubles. Treebane - While wielding an axe, you can make a profession (lumberjack) check to cut down a tree within your reach without even swinging at it as a standard action. DC 10 for medium sized trees, then 10 higher per size above medium. Sentient trees are immune to treebane.
Whenever you use profession (lumberjack) to make money, you're essentially Taking 20. Cooking (Profession Chef)
Amazing Food (healing) - Turn mundane food into AMAZING FOOD. It takes you 1 hour of work and 100g of supplies to cook 5 pieces. They heal 10% hp when eaten on as a swift action, or double that if "savored" as a standard action. If you make more food, the pieces of food made previously perish, but they otherwise remain fresh forever. Tick Eating healing - When you take hit point damage that would defeat you, you can eat a piece of AMAZING FOOD as an immediate action, causing you to instead be set to 10% hp. Must have amazing food to use. Feast [healing] - Mining (Profession Miner) Shaft Mining - As a standard action, you can mine a 5x5x5 ft cube, effectively allowing you to burrow underground. You can only use this ability on unworked stone/earth etc. You must wield a pickaxe to do so.
Whenever you use profession (miner) to make money, you're essentially Taking 20. Break In - You can use profession miner as a substitute for athletics to break things as long as you wield a pickaxe. You get a +4 bonus to do so.\
(8) Vibrations (Su) - As a standard action, you can slam a pickaxe into the ground to gain blindsense (Tremorsense 30 ft) for 1 round. This allows you to see the general shape of things like buildings and caves, even through walls and floors. Construction (Knowledge Engineering) Bridge the Gap (Su) - While you wield a hammer, you have a “bridge speed” equal to your speed that lets you quickly nail together planks and walk along them. This bridge is solid enough for creatures to walk on and lasts until the end of your turn, or the start of your turn if you want your allies to follow. Costs 2g per foot bridged (30ft=60g). You can continue the bridge indefinitely, even as previous sections fall, effectively ignoring gravity, but you must at least start attached to something. Affordable Housing - With an hour of work, you can build a makeshift house with natural materials like dirt, wood and stone. You can remove T1 afflictions with general cures by resting in such a house. (3) Comfort - By creating a home worth at least 2k gold, you can get a boost by resting in this home. You and any allies get temp HP equal to half your skill roll. By spending the gold again, you can make home improvements to improve roll again to gain more temp hp. You can spend 40k gold to take 20 and maximize your comfort. Hunter (Survival)
Speak to Me (Su) - You gain the Wild Empathy feat. You can speak with animals. (3) Box Trap - With 10 minutes of preparation you can set a box trap for a specific creature, or a type of creature. You leave a trail of desirable substances to a box with a stick propping it up. The creature makes a perception check (DC 15+your survival bonus). If they succeed then they notice the unusual and untrustworthy setup. If they fail they are trapped in the box for one minute. Creatures with 0 or more int get advantage on their perception check, and can escape the box using any means at their disposal. Athletics DC to break is equal to the perception check to notice. Agility (Acrobatics) Boost - You can dash as a swift action. You can dash as a free action, but it makes you fatigued. Endurance Training - +10 speed. Parkour - You can jump as a free action 1/turn. When you jump, you ignore fall damage from 60 ft of falling. When you take fall damage, you take 1 damage per 10 ft you fall. (4) Shortcut (Su) - You can squeeze through the tightest of spaces and the smallest of cracks. Even with only a centimeter of space, you can slide through it. You can even comfortably sit in spaces like these indefinitely. You can't effectively navigate while squished in this way, making it only usable to get through very thin surfaces with gaps, like doors and windows. Fire Making (Profession Arson)
Fireproof - You gain resistance to fire damage. You take no damage or penalty to AC while ablaze. You can snap your fingers to spontaneously combust as a free action. The fire is cosmetic and provides light, but no heat.
Meltation - You gain the Melt Firebending Style ability. If you don't have the elemental blast feature, your blast damage is (d6+d6/odd lvl).
Pyrotechnics - You gain a technique point in the pyromancy🔥 tree. You can select this boon multiple times.
Dubstep Ignite recharge - When a creature survives one of your attacks with 5 or less hp, you know. You can spend an instant action to deal 5 true damage to them. Usable 1/minute.\
(5) Solves Everything (Sp) - You gain fire blast as a 1/day innate technique. You increase its range to 120 ft. At level 9 this is usable at will.

classes/skyman/shouts.html.title: Shouts
classes/skyman/shouts.html.description:
Shouts have level requirements listed next to them.Your shout manifests as an incredibly loud shockwave that launches your enemies away from you. Deal 2d6+(d6 per odd LvL) sonic damage to creatures in a 30 ft line in front of you and launch them back 5 ft per d6 you roll (fort halves damage and converts knockback into 20 Poise damage).
Your shout manifests as a Breath Weapon of an elemental damage type. Choose between Fire, Frost, Zap and Poison. Deal 2d8+(d8 per odd LvL) damage of that type in a 60 ft line or a 30 ft cone. The ground beneath where you shouted is suffused with this element for 3 rounds. A creature that moves into or ends their turn in this area takes 10 damage.Creatures that were struck by the elemental breath do not automatically take this damage.
Become Incorporeal for 5 rounds. If you take any action other than movement, you lose your incorporeal status.
Your shout manifests as a violent wind that carries you forward. Move 60+(5 per level) ft in a straight line. Creatures in this line or adjacent to it are set to 1 Poise.
Automatically inflict the Grounded condition on a creature within 100 ft for 1 minute. If they are currently airborne, they plummet, provoking AoOs and taking Fall Damage.
Dragons🐲 are also made Clumsy 2.
Mimic the effects of Call Lightning Storm, but it is not concentration and its damage changes to 2d8+LvL. When you initially shout, and as a free action on each subsequent turn, you can call down a bolt of lightning. After you call down 2+(1/2 LvL) bolts of lightning, this effect ends.
Functions as the Slow Time technique.

classes/skyman/skyman.html.title: Skyman
classes/skyman/skyman.html.description:
The Skyman is a class defined by the signature ability to speak the tongue of dragons and manifest incredibly powerful effects from their words. There's also a healthy amount of jank. It is based on a Bethesda game after all.Choose either Martial Specialization or Magical Specialization.
Then choose a single technique tree within your specialization. Gain a Technique Point in that tree at this level and every odd level after.
You can spend 1 mana as a swift action in order to shout. The effects of which vary based on the shout. Pick a shout from the Shouts page at this level, and at level 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10.
You can shout once per minute and cannot do so while Silenced. Some shouts may have additional restrictions.
The skyman is adept at maneuvering vertical terrain. You can comfortably Balance on the smallest of ledges and walk on and up practically vertical walls. This is essentially like having a Climb🧗 speed equal to your land speed, but you need not use your hands.Your birth was accompanied by the alignment of a particular constellation. Choose a blessing.
Blessing of the Lovers - Get a +2 bonus to all skill checks.
Blessing of the Steed - Get +1,000 Carry Weight. You can take the Swap Item action as a free action once each turn, even if it is not the start of your turn.
Blessing of the Mana Well - You get 1 MR. When this ability reduces damage, recover 1 mana.Choose a talent from the talent list. Gain another at level 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10.

core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.title: Charge
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.description:
Move at twice your speed in a straight line, halting when your foe is adjacent, or at least within reach. Make your attack(s) against a creature (including a Multiattack).
Charging is reckless, so creatures get a +2 bonus to attack against you until the start of your next turn. If your charge gets interrupted for whatever reason, you must make your attack(s) from your halted position. You cannot charge a creature that is already adjacent to you.
core-rules,-how-to-play/actions/common-a.sourcePath: Core Rules, How to Play/Actions/Common Actions/Full Round Actions/Charge.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This badge is meant to resemble bandages, but when the wearer is afflicted with a bleed effect, it automatically negates it.This has a 1 minute cooldown.

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This badge is a symbol of peace. If you perform no action on your turn in combat, you are affected as per Sanctuary until the start of your next turn.This has a 1 minute cooldown.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Baubles/Pricing/2k - 10k/Peace.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This tiny ram icon can be affixed to any piece of medium or heavy armor, increasing your Poise by 5.

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: Baubles are little badges, icons, talismans and whatnot that you affix to your person, providing you with a passive bonus. You can only have one bauble.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Baubles/+Baubles.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Eye Patch
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
A fuzzy patch to place over your eye that wraps around the head, lined with material to block even the harshest light and the pocket-est sand.You take a -2 penalty to +Perception👀. When you are afflicted with the Blurred Vision or Blinded condition, you can move the patch over to to the other eye and ignore the condition.
Certain effects that don't directly target the eyes, like Curse of Blindness make an eyepatch useless.Note: You need 2 eyes for this to work. You can buy normal eye patches to cover wounded/missing eyes for 1gp.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Headwear/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Eye Patch.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Face Mask
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This is a black market item.
This mask is a unique item that can only be created by a Maligner. It looks as thought the skin on someone's face was removed with careful precision and perfectly preserved.
When you wear this mask, you partially transform into that creature, which counts as a +Disguise and grants a +4 bonus skill checks to appear as that specific creature. Putting it on is a FRA, but removing it is a Swap Item action. It does not change your clothes or equipment.It is virtually impossible to acquire masks of a specific creature, considering they are usually harvested from fresh corpses. Masks that are in circulation are typically of deceased individuals. Masks of particularly famous, influential, beautiful or rare creatures are often much more expensive. Even more so if the creature still breathes.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Headwear/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Face Mask.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Full Helmet
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
Counts as heavy armor.A full helmet completely covers the head, including the face, leaving only slits or holes for vision/breathing. Many are decorated with plumage or cosmetic royal/animal iconography.
Full helmets block your peripheral vision, giving a -2 penalty to +Perception👀. Gives a +1 bonus to Fortitude saves.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Headwear/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Full Helmet.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Pointed Hat
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: A colorful pointed hat that makes the wearer feel more magical.Gives the wearer a +1 bonus to CL when using +Cantrips.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Headwear/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Pointed Hat.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Ranger Cap
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
Counts as light armor.This stylish hat has a feather poking out of the top of it.
Increase the range increment of any ranged weapon you use by 5.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Headwear/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Ranger Cap.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Tracking Device
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This tiny device is about the size of a peanut and resonates with psionic energy. You can attune to it by concentrating on it while in contact with it for 1 minute, provided you don't have negative intelligence.More importantly, it can fit inside of a creature's body. With engineering or medicine proficiency, you can implant this device into a creature. The process is painful and obvious, so it can usually only be done on Helpless creatures.
While implanted, you can know the general direction and distance of any tracking device you have attuned to. Each tracking device has a slightly different signal, allowing you to tell which one is which, provided you have the mental capacity to do so. You can be attuned to (1+INT) tracking devices at once.
If the creature ever receives medical attention, a DC 20 +Medicine💉 check also reveals a strange bump, or an unusual ache that indicates where the tracking device is, and it can be removed.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Interesting Items/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Tracking Device.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Banner of Doom
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This flag is inscribed with symbols of Demon Lords👿, prominent criminal organizations or evil mages. Those that exist within 30 ft of the banner while it is planted (a standard action) hear whispers from it, causing them to become shaken 1, unless they are allied with the group the banner's iconography showcases.This has no effect on creatures that are already shaken. If the creature was not already shaken when it entered the area and it leaves the area, the shaken the banner inflicts immediately dissipates as the whispers vanish.
A creature can roll a DC 15 +Athletics🏊 check to push the banner over and disable its effect.

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Summoning Contract
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-scroll" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M19 17V5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H4"></path><path d="M8 21h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-1a1 1 0 0 0-1-1H11a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v1a2 2 0 1 1-4 0V5a2 2 0 1 0-4 0v2a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h3"></path></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: Summoning contracts are written in order for a creature to provide aid to another without following them around all the time. There are always 2 parties involved in a contract: the summoner and the summoned. Typically it is up to the summoner to convince the summoned to sign the contract, as the magic does not work with unwilling creatures. It is possible to find summoning contracts with a signature from a summoned creature, but not a summoner. Contracts are often temporary, being lifted after a certain number of summons, or after a specific task is complete.When the summoned creature signs the contract in blood, so to must the summoner. The summoned creature takes up a [companion] slot while summoned. 1/day as a FRA, you can summon the contracted creature. Creatures summoned in this way always have a pseudo-ethereal translucent quality to them that is easily identifiable (DC 10 arcana). A summon typically only lasts a minute, but can last up to an hour if the summoned creature accepts summoning sickness. The creature also gains summoning sickness if it drops to 0 hp while summoned.Summoning Sickness - A specific type of ailment that occurs as a result of a summoned creature pushing themselves too hard while summoned from a summoning contract, usually by sticking around for too long or being defeated. The creature is drained 2 and cannot be summoned for two weeks, even if the drain is removed.In most aspects, a summoned creature functions exactly as they would if you were fighting by their side in their actual body, with a few key differences. As a magical effect, they can be dispelled (DC 12+summoned creatures lvl). They have all of their gear and any resources that they expend (such as potions) while summoned are still expended when they return to their body. Summoned creatures only have 50% of their max hp.To the summoned creature, when you attempt to summon them, they receive a mental message from their summoner no longer than 2 sentences. They can choose to deny being summoned if they pass a will save (your class DC). If they succeed, they can send 2 sentences back. Otherwise, they enter a trance like state and their spirit leaves their body and appears next to you. If their body takes damage, or is otherwise harmed, then their spirit immediately winks out of existence.A summoned creature can dismiss itself as a standard action. A creature can only be summoned once per day.The more powerful a creature is, the more expensive it is to bind them to a summoning contract.If the contract has a limit on uses, adjust price as below.If the contract has stipulations that limit when the creature can be summoned, halve the cost again. (only summon vs fiends)Ex. Level 1 creature, limited use cases, 3 times. 1,000g.

headers.heading: 1,000*(1+summoned creatures LvL)^2

Doesn't consume one of your bonus AoOs from something like Combat Reflexes.

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Locking
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: On-hit you can lock the weapon in place, entangling the creature struck (reflex negates). While entangling a creature, you cannot use the weapon.

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Mimicing
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: Weapon attacks On-hit against a creature allows the wielder to copy one of the creatures elemental resistance types for one round. You can only have one copied resistance at a time. On hit the wielder has an intuitive sense the creature is resistant to, allowing them to choose.The resistance wears off after 1 minute.

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Radiant
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: The wielder can activate the weapon to use Radiance as an Innate Technique once per day, anchored to the weapon.

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Returning
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
As a free action, you can call your weapon back to your hand. If it is within 60 feet of you it returns instantly. Anything beyond requires 3 rounds. If there are any physical barriers preventing its return, this does not work.
If a creature possesses the weapon (reflex negates).
