equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Amplifying Staff
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: Favored by bard🎸s, this light staff shimmers in the light. If you hold it up to your mouth, it doubles the volume of any vocalizations. By spending a swift action to increase the mana cost of any ability with the healing tag by 1 (or adding a mana cost of 1), you can increase its range by 10 feet, or its radius by 5 ft.Manathirst 12 The range/radius extension can be done as a free action.Manathirst 22 The range/radius extension no longer requires mana.It is a 1h crush weapon. Also comes in a battle staff and light variant, like most staves.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Spell Focus Items/Staves/Amplifying Staff.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Elemental Staff
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This staff has a mana crystal affixed to its end, shimmering with a color that indicates the type of element it favors. All spells with the elemental tag shared by the staff get +1 CL. 1/day it can reduce the mana cost of such a spell by 1.Manathirst 12 1/day you can spend 1 mana to change the elemental damage type of the spell to the stave's elemental affinity.The standard staff is a 1h crush weapon. Also comes in a battle staff and light variant, like most staves.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Spell Focus Items/Staves/Elemental Staff.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Likk'em
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This staff gets a +1 bonus to CL when casting spells from the Frogg Saran (T)🐸 technique tree
This staff has a smug frog carved into the tip of it. Its eyeballs are wheels with numbers inscribed on them from 0 to 9. Whenever you defeat a creature with a melee attack using this staff, or a spell cast using this staff, the staffs eyes start spinning, stopping when they reach how much damage you overkilled the target. If you did exactly enough damage to defeat the creature and the eyes stop on zero, it plays a frog croaking sound and you gain a Luck Dice.
By spending a luck dice, you can innately cast Lucky StarThe standard staff is a 1h crush weapon.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Spell Focus Items/Staves/Likk'em.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Wand, Enhanced
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
Functions as a Wand, Standard, but as follows.
An enhanced wand, in additional to casting a cantrip, allows you to Innately Cast a tier 1 technique 1/day.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Spell Focus Items/Wands/Wand, Enhanced.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Wand, Standard
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This piece of enchanted wood is infused with mana from those adept at magic casting, allowing you to channel their experience through it.While wielding a wand, you can increase the CL of a spell you cast by 1 as a swift action.
A wand comes with 1 cantrip that you can Innately Cast while you wield it.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Spell Focus Items/Wands/Wand, Standard.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Garish Gavel
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This hammer is bejeweled all along its head and has a finish to its wooden handle that makes it sparkle. When you strike it against a solid surface, it is exceptionally loud, even with only a light tap. Everyone can't help but look upon he who slams the gavel.Special Attack: ORDER - Must be directed at a solid object instead of a creature. Taunt all enemies within 30 ft for 1 round.The hammer is a 1h crush weapon the one and done and dueling properties.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/1h Weapons/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Garish Gavel.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Benevolent Blade
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This silver sword has a hilt that shines a radiant gold. This weapon is used to non-lethally dispatch creatures when defeating them since it has no chance of potentially killing them. When you defeat a creature with this weapon, you can spend 1 mana to give them the Time Out condition.
Special Attack: Lifesteal Healing
On hit heal (2+LvL).Manathirst 12 Special Attack: Benevolence (healing) Strike at an ally as the blade transforms into a warming radiance. It grants the attacks damage as temp hp and has no harmful on hit effects.Manathirst 22 You can use the Lifesteal and Benevolence special attacks at-will.The sword is a 1h slash or pierce weapon with the one and done property.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/1h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Benevolent Blade.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Fiery War Axe
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: Favored by veteran Fighter⚔s, this axe is the color of obsidian, with a blade that looks white hot. When pointing the weapon at any creature that is considered a minion to you, it ignites in flames. Against any such foe, the axe deals an additional d10 fire damage.The axe is a 1h slash weapon with the one and done property.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/1h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Fiery War Axe.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Icebreaker
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This mace is a cool blue color and, when wielded, the air around is visibly chilled as though it was exhaling on a cold day. It excels at crushing ice, and can easily smash through any type of icy barrier less than 1ft thick. Anything thicker becomes something of a mining operation. If a creature is frosty, or otherwise mostly made of ice, the mace does an additional 5 damage and makes it clumsy 1 on-hit. It has the following special attack...Rime Time - Make a swipe at the air and target a 30 ft cone. All creatures in the area take 2d6+lvl (7+lvl) cold damage and are made frosty (reflex halves and negates frosty).The mace is a 1h crush weapon with the CM (Shove) and one and done properties.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/1h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Icebreaker.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Impulsive Hammer
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This hammer is eager to smash, and prefers to be swung overhead, resisting other types of swinging motions.When the wielder lands a Crit, the hammer releases a shockwave. The creature you attacked and any enemy within 10 ft are automatically Knocked Down.The hammer is a 1h crush weapon with the CM (topple) and one and done properties.Note: I'm normally all for changing weapons around to suit your needs, but this weapon should absolutely not be allowed to made as a light weapon with the Chink Magnet property. That would be dangerously cheesy.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/1h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Impulsive Hammer.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Quaking Hammer
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This hammer makes the ground shake when it strikes the ground. When a creature disarms you of this weapon, it smashes into the ground at their feet, letting you make a topple attack as an instant action. Get the following special attack...
Fissure Earth - Strike the ground to attack all creatures in a 30 ft line. Compare your attack to every creature's AC in the AoE. If you spend 2 mana, you can make the 30 ft line 15 ft wide.Manathirst 12 Fissure deals an additional 2d6 (7) damage and always does the enhanced version.Manathirst 22
Fissure staggers targets On-hit.The hammer is a 1h crush weapon with the CM (topple) and one and done properties.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/1h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Quaking Hammer.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Scrappy Swordfish
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This fish was subject to a magical ritual akin to taxidermy after all of the useful parts were removed. The fish is a bit small for its kind, but it is certainly as sharp. It remains rigid even when clashing with metal swords. 1/day you can say a brief prayer to Mother Earth🍃 as a swift action and the fish briefly springs back to life. It immediately readies to parry (as per Buckler), allowing you to decide which attack to deflect during the next round of combat.If you worship Mother Earth, you can use a point of prayer to parry with this weapon.The fish is a 1h pierce weapon with the CM (disarm) and one and done properties.Despite being gutted and undersized, the fish is still rather heavy and weighs 20 lbs.Special:
You use +Nature🍃 to craft this item instead of +Profession🧑‍🌾 or Arcana
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/1h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Scrappy Swordfish.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Wheel of Momentum
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This strange item is a large shield-like weapon with glowing blades along its edges that constantly circle the outside of the weapon. Because of this motion, it is ill-fitted to be used for defense. Every time the user misses or grazes an attack roll with it, the blades circle faster and glow more vibrantly, giving the wielder +1 Attack that stacks with each miss. Once you land an attack, the speed resets back to default, removing the attack bonus.This stacking effect cannot be used outside of combat.It is a 1h slash weapon with the one and done and attached property.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/1h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Wheel of Momentum.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Orcish Hammer
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This hammer is infused with the power of the wind itself by orcish shamans. It feels practically weightless while you swing it through air, despite its otherwise unwieldy size. Its wielder can innately cast Storm Step 1/day. The wielder also gains this special attack...Windfury - Attack twice in rapid succession, applying DR only once.The hammer is a 1h crush weapon with the strings attached and one-and done quality.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/1h Weapons/Pricing/10k - 25k/Orcish Hammer.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Ogre Club
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This club has metal plates at its end, each face inscribed with magic sigils to enhance this heavy weapons power. Unfortunately, ogres' propensity for randomness creates a different definition of power than most. While the you are threatening multiple enemies, you get a +2 bonus to Attack, but you decide which enemy you attack randomly among all creatures you threaten.The club is a 2h crush weapon with bewildering blow special attack and the CM (shove) quality.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/2h Weapons/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Ogre Club.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Heavy Metal
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This oversized guitar is made almost entirely out of iron with chrome plating. It weighs 50 lbs and is hilariously impractical as an instrument. In order to even properly play the guitar, the wielder must possess at least +1 STR. It has the following special attack...
Instrumental Destruction Sonic Whack someone with Heavy Metal so hard it breaks and becomes unusable, dealing an additional 2d6 (7) sonic damage. The mana cost of the next technique you use this turn is decreased by your strength score.
You must Mana Burn 1 as a FRA to repair it so it can be played/wielded again.
The guitar functions as a large hammer-esque 2h crush weapon with the meteor swing special attack and the CM (topple) quality.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/2h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Heavy Metal.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Rusty Sword
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This curved iron sword looks as though the black iron exterior could peel off at any moment and is covered with patches of rust. It has a -2 penalty to damage. When used to cut down creatures that can bleed, it changes. The iron in the blood repairs the weapon and then some. Each time you successfully strike a foe, the rust fades and the blade sharpens, adding +1 damage, up to 4 times for a total of +2 bonus damage.The sword is a 2h slash weapon that has the bleed and easily repaired property.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/2h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Rusty Sword.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Sticky Spear
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This long, pointed piece of wood is covered in a sticky sap. The wielder cannot change weapons using Swap Item without first spending a standard action to attach it to another object and pulling it off.
However the spear is very fickle. Whenever you disarm a creature, it leaves you behind and hops directly into your target's open hand.It is a 2h pierce weapon with the reach, CM (disarm) and attached properties.Special:
You use Alchemy or +Nature🍃 to craft this item instead of +Profession🧑‍🌾 or Arcana
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/2h Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Sticky Spear.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Soul Eater
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This black great sword has a red mana crystal in the shape of an eye affixed to its hilt. Any who hold the blade in their hands can feel its blood lust. While wielding this blade, the wielder has Weakness 2 to all damage, but reduces the mana cost of all techniques by 1. This effect cannot prevent Mana Burn. The wielder gets a +2 bonus to Attack with this weapon.
The Soul Eater has 3 enchantment slotsIt is a 2h slash weapon with the bleed and properties.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/2h Weapons/Pricing/10k - 25k/Soul Eater.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: The Dimensional Anchor
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
A literal anchor, clearly for a smaller vessel, that weighs 50 lbs. The anchor passively alerts whoever holds it whenever teleportation occurs within 100 ft of it. It also alerts the holder when they are within 100 ft of a portal. This detection functions through solid barriers, but not Lead.
Whenever you are subject to a Teleportation effect against your will, you can slam the anchor into the ground as an immediate action to negate it.
Enemies the anchor strikes are Anchored On-hit for 1 minute.
The anchor is a 2h crush weapon with the magic crash special attack and the CM (drag) quality.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/2h Weapons/Pricing/10k - 25k/The Dimensional Anchor.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Ogrelord's Whip
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: Unlike the standard Whip, this whip is capable of threatening its full reach off turn, but only your allies. When you make an AoO against an ally, it always does 5 slashing damage and increases their speed by 20 this round. You also gain a charge, up to 3. Each charge you can spend as an free action to increase the bonus of your next attack by +2 (max +6).Charges are lost when you roll initiative.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/Exotic Weapons/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Ogrelord's Whip.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Hunter's Rifle
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This gun has a barrel that grows to comically large size at its tip. You get a +4 bonus on survival checks to track any creature you have hit or grazed with this weapon in the last week.
Special Attack: My Brand - On-hit apply a brand to a creature, physically marking them. You and your companion creatures' attacks do an additional d6 damage until the end of your next turn.
The rifle functions as a 2h Gun.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/Exotic Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Hunter's Rifle.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Ray Gun
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This pistol looks like a child's toy, made of colorful plastic with superfluous details. Pulling the trigger reveals otherwise. It blasts rays of pure energy, dealing force damage instead of a pistol's usual damage. It does not need to be reloaded, but it can only fire 5 times per day.Special Attack: Pack a Punch Creatures within 5 ft of the original target take 2d6 (7) force damage and poise damage. If this poise breaks a creature, it is Knocked Down.
Functions as a 1h Gun.Special:
You use Engineering🤖 to craft this item instead of +Profession🧑‍🌾 or Arcana
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/Exotic Weapons/Pricing/10k - 25k/Ray Gun.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Demon's Grasp
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This green metallic gauntlet has its fingers honed at the tip like claws. Imprinted on the back of its "hand" is inscribed a slur written in infernal against fiends👿. It is exceptionally good at capturing the attention of fiends. When attacking with fiendish allies, they are all taunted by the target of your attack On-hit. Fiends you Grapple are automatically Taunted by you.
When fighting a fiend, every attack with this weapon taunts on-hit for 1 round (will negates).
Allied fiends get a +2 bonus to Attack against any creature you attack with Demons Grasp for 1 turn.The gauntlet is a light slash weapon with the attached and CM (grapple) qualities.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/Light Weapons/Pricing/1gp - 2k/Demon's Grasp.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Anal Probe
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This baton looks unimpressive until you press a button on its side to coat it in a strange liquid and electrify it as a swift action. It can remain electrified for 1 minute before it must recharge for 5. When you thrust it, it seems to magnetize to the target's orifices. You must hold it in 2 hands to keep it electrified.It is a 1h light club when not electrified.When electrified it instead deals 2d6 zap dmg. It also gains a special attack.Special Attack: Terrestrial Exploration Shove the probe in whatever hole the creature is most uncomfortable with. They are clumsy 2 on-hit.Special:
You use Engineering🤖 to craft this item instead of +Profession🧑‍🌾 or Arcana
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/Light Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Anal Probe.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Eye of Moogen
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This knife is molded after the weapons typically wielded by Moogen, The Murderer👁. A black blade whose hilt bears a resemblance to The Eye of Moogen👁. The knife can be used as a proxy for the wielders own vision, allowing them to peek around corners using the blade.
The knife seems to enjoy cutting into flesh and can be used to administer first aid.
Against a creature you administer first aid, or On-hit, you getting a brief image in your head of the last creature the target killed, if any. The knife is a light pierce weapon with the chink magnet property.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/Light Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Eye of Moogen.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Nosey Knife
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This knife makes the wielder feel uneasy, like it knows what its thinking. Whenever you Crit a DD creature, the knife randomly chooses a technique the creature knows to memorize, up to your highest tier technique known. While you wield the knife, you also have that technique memorized without spending memory.The knife has a will of its own, and will memorize new techniques if you keep critting whether you want it to or not.The knife is a light pierce weapon with the conceal and chink magnet property.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/Light Weapons/Pricing/2k - 10k/Nosey Knife.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Boring Blade
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: This mundane sword shows its true power only when the user does not use any fancy shmancy techniques with it. If fact, the sword appears to "activate" glowing with power for a minute when using a technique, but counter intuitively, this is how the sword appears when it deactivates.As long as you have not used a technique in the last minute, it is treated as though it has every special weapon property seen in the weapon rules page, with the exception of reach and ranged weapon properties. It has conceal, bleed, etc. You can use every special attack that doesn't have a specific weapon requirement.Boring blade has 3 enchantment slots.The sword is a light pierce weapon with the chink magnet and the attached property.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Unique Magic Weapons/Light Weapons/Pricing/100k+/Boring Blade.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: +Unique and Magic Weapon
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description: A category for things you make attacks with. Includes staves, swords and bows alike.I'm not opposed to changing some of the details of many of these weapons, like making them 2h weapons/light weapons. Or changing their qualities if you're a grapple focused build to give it CM (grapple) instead of one of its default properties.If you're crafting these items, you can change these details as you see fit. If you're purchasing these items, add +10% to the total cost.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/+Unique and Magic Weapon.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Gear Upgrades
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.icon: <svg class="svg-icon lucide-wand-sparkles" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-width="2" stroke="currentColor" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" height="24" width="24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="m21.64 3.64-1.28-1.28a1.21 1.21 0 0 0-1.72 0L2.36 18.64a1.21 1.21 0 0 0 0 1.72l1.28 1.28a1.2 1.2 0 0 0 1.72 0L21.64 5.36a1.2 1.2 0 0 0 0-1.72"></path><path d="m14 7 3 3"></path><path d="M5 6v4"></path><path d="M19 14v4"></path><path d="M10 2v2"></path><path d="M7 8H3"></path><path d="M21 16h-4"></path><path d="M11 3H9"></path></svg>
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
Some magic items have a scaling component to them called Manathirst, growing more powerful when in the hands of someone who is more powerful.Manathirst features are unlocked when you have 12 and 22 max mana, typically kicking in at level 5 and 10.Magic Items come in two main categories: wielded items and worn items.
Wielded Items: Weapons, staves and shields. These can be mixed and matched to your hearts content, as long as you have the hands to hold them.
Worn Items: These items have dedicated slots. You can only have one worn item in each slot (minus baubles). See chart below for more details.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Gear Upgrades.md

equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.title: Pricing Gear Upgrades
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.description:
This section is mostly for people who are interested in making up new items, or are curious how I decided pricing.Gear prices are generally calculated by what level the creature is expected to obtain them. I took what I considered the average profession bonus of the a character at a given level and then used that to find the value of 4 weeks of work on the Economics page.
I consider an average profession bonus to be 5+1.33(LvL). This estimation assumes that someone will have racial skill bonuses, Skill Focus and other etc additions from class/items/circumstance to eventually increase the skill, hence the 1.3x multiplier instead of 5+LvL. Using this formula, we can make a simple chart.Now obviously we cant have every item cost this value. Legendary weapons crafted by level 1 guys in few months? Nah. We can take these values and multiply them depending on the rarity, power etc. This will create some overlap, as super powerful items for a level 2 character probably aren't that big a deal for a level 10 character.Multipliers can be 1.5x, 2x, 4x or even 10x, 50x for incredibly powerful or rare items. Cheaper items tend to be things that have limited uses each day, are relatively mundane or have a specific niche.
equipment/equipment-types/gear-upgrades/.sourcePath: Equipment/Equipment Types/Gear Upgrades/Pricing Gear Upgrades.md

equipment/equipment-types/the-black-mark.title: The Black Market
equipment/equipment-types/the-black-mark.description:
The black market is not a singular place, but rather a series of vaguely connected organizations that span most of the populated world. Mostly organized by criminals, the black market seeks to serve items that are generally not socially acceptable, or even legal, to sell. This could include things like slaves, blood, connections to Fiends👿 and other such unscrupulous items.
Anyone with the +Local skill is aware of the black market, but it generally takes a contact in order to get access to the black market. Street reputation goes a long way in determining your access. If you are known to bust criminals and hunt down bandits for local governments, direct access is typically impossible.
Often times, the black market isn't available unless you are in a City, as per Populations. Though criminals can be convinced to use creative ways to move items where they are needed if the price is right.

gods/gods/demigods/artemis/t1-crawling-s.title: T1 - Crawling Sins
gods/gods/demigods/artemis/t1-crawling-s.description:
Tags: Su You regularly suffer from vivid nightmares where you experience the hardship that you have caused. You experience the financial troubles of those you have swindled, the relationship troubles your infidelity has cause etc. Only through rectifying your actions, seeking forgiveness from those you have wronged can you assuage the dreams.
Against a willing or Helpless creature, you can also cause them to experience this same condition, manifesting as a unique Affliction. You must be somewhat aware of a specific sin the creature has committed, and the nightmares they experience are related to this event. Not used to this condition, the creature is unable to properly benefit from Rest. Once they repent for this sin, the nightmares stop and they can rest easy, hopefully with them having learned their lesson.

gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.title: Caldera, the Cataclysm
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.description: The Cataclysm is the most outwardly terrifying, hostile and destructive force known to mankind. She is concerned with little more than raw physical strength, twisting this ideology to its absolute extremes and eliminating any and all unable to survive the hostility and violence so common among her and her minions. As such, she is very often held in high regard by eugenicists, anarchists and the unhinged that just want to watch the world burn.One of the few things that the followers of the Cataclysm will always hold in high regard is contests of raw physical strength. Their method of testing your might is typically an arm wrestling contest. This is often used as a last ditch effort by people to save their own skins when faced with overwhelming odds of death.On rare occasions, her followers will kidnap specimens they deem worthy enough. They will be dragged into the demon realm to have all manner of alchemical, magical and genetic experiments run on them to create a creature that is perfectly huge.Caldera herself is a massive muscular woman clad in metal armor who typically stands over 20 feet tall. Her body is covered in all manner of bony spikes, horns and scales. Along her back are dorsal plates that run down her massive tail, giving her stance a forward lean, allowing her to loom over and gaze upon lesser beings with her many eyes.
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Caldera, The Cataclysm/Caldera, the Cataclysm.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.title: Daughters of the Cataclysm
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.description: The Cataclysm is absolutely obsessed with raw physical strength, and constantly throws herself and her followers into situations where they can test their might. This manifests in a particularly strange way, where she sees herself as the perfect being, and so therefore her offspring are the only ones that really have a chance of every topping her feats of strength. The exact circumstances of their creation are unknown, but they typically end up as large muscular demons, and are always women.Unfortunately for these ladies, mom's standards couldn't be higher: They must become stronger than their mother. Since all of them fall short of this goal, she abandons them, giving them some kind of leadership role in her demonic armies and only ever interacting with them sparingly. The only training she ever gives them is physical, so they are usually unprepared for this role.
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Caldera, The Cataclysm/Daughters of the Cataclysm.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.title: T1 - Huge
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.description:
Tags: - Any thing that gives you additional Carry Weight in increments of 100, such as strength and racial features, gives you 1000 lbs of carry weight instead.
You can throw heavy objects, dealing 2d8+STR dmg.
You get a +2 bonus to +Athletics🏊 to Breakout, Brute Force and to Arm Wrestling for each tier of boon you have in The Cataclysm🌋 (ie T1 +2, T2 +4 etc)
Your STR is treated as 2 higher for how you are affected by High Gravity You can tell a creatures STR score just by looking at it

gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.title: T2 - Huge XL
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.description:
Tags: Your Size increases by 1 category. You can swap between this increased size and your previous size as a swift action.
If you already have a feature that increases your size, like the Amazon🏋️‍♀️ Embiggen feature, it instead increases your size by an additional category.
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Caldera, The Cataclysm/T2 - Huge XL.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.title: T2 - Weight for It
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.description:
Tags: -The training never stops. You are constantly under the effects of High Gravity and it does not affect your speed or carrying capacity, no matter the tier.In gravity neutral scenarios (ie gravity is normal), you can temporarily turn off this gravity training as a free action, providing the following benefits.
It no longer requires a swift action in order to take the Jump action and creatures can automatically jump as far and as high as a creature's Land Speed. Low gravity also negates Fall Damage.
You can Dash as part of activating this ability, and as a swift action on each subsequent turn.
Multiply your Carry Weight by 10x You can typically only benefit from this surge of agility for a few minutes at a time, and only a few times a day, lest the gravity training be ineffective.
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Caldera, The Cataclysm/T2 - Weight for It.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.title: T3 - Perfectly Huge
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.description:
Tags: Su
When you flex, you exert a weak gravitational force. Whenever a creature with Line of Effect is affected by forced movement, you can choose to pull them 10 ft closer to you as an instant action after the effect is resolved.
You can cause any unattended loose object you can carry with 1% of your Carry Weight to fly into a free hand.
gods/gods/demon-lords/caldera,-the-catac.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Caldera, The Cataclysm/T3 - Perfectly Huge.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.title: Moogen, The Murderer
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.description: Moogen is the demon lord most often associated with death, darkness and murder. The forces of the Cataclysm will come busting down your door. Moogen's forces will watch you for days, waiting for when your death will have the most impact in inspiring fear and chaos in your family, town or society as a whole. The more impact the death has, the flashier it is and the longer it stains the memory of mortals, the better.Moogen's unique obsession with death has created a unique set of circumstances. Moogen is not a singular entity, but rather a position that can be taken by someone capable of outwitting, outmaneuvering and killing the current Moogen. Moogen delights in the constant dance of death that happens all around her as a result of the tasty allure of this lucrative opportunity.Because Moogen is more of a title, rather than a singular creature, the appearance can vary greatly, but a handful of features are passed down. Moogen always has the same type of white eyes with many circles within that seem to spiral and hypnotize. They always have enormous mouths capable of snapping open and devouring a creature of equal size whole. When undercover, the mouth in excess is covered in skin, but usually it is only partly covered in skin, making it appear as though Moogen has multiple mouths.
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Moogen, The Murderer/Moogen, The Murderer.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.title: T1 - From my Cold Dead Head
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.description:
Tags: Sp, Recharge
You can Innately Cast Memory Movie, but only on a creature that has died within the last minute.
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Moogen, The Murderer/T1 - From my Cold Dead Head.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.title: T1 - Shadow in the Night
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.description: Tags: Su Uhhh
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Moogen, The Murderer/T1 - Shadow in the Night.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.title: T2 - Born in Darkness
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.description: Tags: Su, BuffLigma
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Moogen, The Murderer/T2 - Born in Darkness.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.title: T3 - Shadow Blending
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.description:
Tags: Su
You have Camouflage in any Dim Light or Darkness, even against creatures with Nightvision and Darkvision.
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Moogen, The Murderer/T3 - Shadow Blending.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.title: The Eye of Moogen
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.description: The iconography that Moogen and her followers use is centered around her eyes. They are white with many black circles encircling each other, growing smaller until they become a pupil. It is said that Moogen herself can gaze through any Eye of Moogen, such as those printed onto banners or that are featured in the Moogen (T)👁 spells. As such, great care is taken by any non-worshippers to remove any and all Moogen iconography from places they don't want any prying eyes.
gods/gods/demon-lords/moogen,-the-murder.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Moogen, The Murderer/The Eye of Moogen.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.title: Shira, the She-Devil
gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.description: Shira is the demon lord most known for making deals with mortals, and with subterfuge. A master of disguise, Shira always finds a way to hide amongst the crowd in parties held by those in the highest echelons of society. She will somehow simultaneously be the most beautiful and second most beautiful lady attending the party at once.She delights in the act of giving mortals exactly what they want, but then taking so much more in return. Her deals will always be carefully worded, often with a written contract. She may misrepresent things and lie to get people to sign, and if they believed her, its their fault for not reading the fine print. These devilish tendencies work to break down society by eroding trust, generating discontent and playing off of the selfish desires of mankind. You didn't honestly expect her help to be free, right dearest?Shira prefers a much more appealing and innocuous form to represent herself. She takes on the form of a voluptuous fox-like beastfolk, appearing mostly human, save for the ears and tail. The only thing that would even indicate she is a demon is vertical pupils of her eyes. When in private company, she has a casual attire she likes involving loose purple clothes, and she lets all nine of her tails out. When working, such as attending parties, she tends to dress exceptionally well and hides all but one of her tails.
gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Shira, The She-Devil/Shira, the She-Devil.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.title: T1 - Party Animal
gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.description:
Tags: Su
While at a social gathering, such as a party, festival, ball etc, you can exist in two places at once. This otherwise functions as a ninja shadow clone, but the clone disappears once the event ends or you begin combat.So long as both clones aren't in someone's line of sight at once, people do not question how you pop up so frequently.
gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Shira, The She-Devil/T1 - Party Animal.md

gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.title: T2 - Mistrust
gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.description:
Tags: Su
You gain a new use to +Deception.Sow Doubt - Roll a deception check after a few minutes of conversation (DC 10+creature's level). You can convince this creature that another creature has it out for them and seeks their downfall. They will always view what this creature does in the worst light possible, which can eventually cause great strife in the future.
This will stay the case until someone uses detect intrusive presence (DC 10+your deception bonus). Usually someone only gets a check who is familiar that notices this unusual behavior.For creatures who are close to one another, such as family, friends or allies, the DC increases. Usually only +2 for people they see in a positive light, +5 for allies and +10 for those closest to them.

gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.title: T3 - Devil's in the Details
gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.description:
Tags: Su You gain the ability to write magically binding Fiendish Pacts.A fiendish pact requires an agreement between two parties, typically via writing, but also can be done via verbal agreements. Such pacts bind the 2 creatures to these agreements, with immediate consequences if one does not abide by the agreement.Pacts, like written contracts in real life, are methods of binding 2 parties together to persuade some time of cooperation or exchange. It usually involves exchanging goods, services, information or boons. Typically pacts are formed when someone desires something, but the other doesn't want to grant this desire for free. Both parties mediate until a satisfactory transaction is agreed upon. Then the 2 parties must decide on a punishment for the other should they not fulfill their end of the bargain. Again, the 2 parties come to an agreement on what the other desires. Finally, some type of gesture is taken to finalize the deal, such as shaking hands, returning a bow or signing a contract.Some creatures may take issue with the order in which the parties perform their end of the bargain, but it is inevitably up to the creature with the power to make the pact what order things happen in.Pacts, unlike written contracts in real life, cannot be broken without evading consequence. Pacts are made with magic that does not ask for mediation or a jury. Disobeying the contract immediately afflicts the creature with whatever the punishment is. Any kind of agreement must be within the means of the creature to perform.In the event where someone is unable to hold up their end of the bargain, or does so in a way that is not in accordance with the deal, they are afflicted with punishment immediately. You cannot also say "I will grant you anything you wish" without the ability to grant wishes.Punishments must also be within the means of both parties. You cannot just say "if you don't pet this dog 10 times then you burst into flames and die" without being able to use some type of fire magic. If you agree on a punishment that you cannot inflict, then there is no consequence for not fulfilling their end of the bargain. It us up to you to decide if the other really CAN devour your eternal soul or not.Shira, and her most dedicated, are capable of providing additional boons to those they make pacts with. Contracts without meaning, such as those made between allies to acquire more boons, will draw Shira's ire and are not recommended.
Twist of Fate - The creature gains a luck dice.Lexicon - Give creature information about a subject as though asking Shira herself. The amount of information she gives typically depends on what was done in the contract. Good deeds get the bare minimum to satisfy the contract while deeds that align with Shira's interest are paid in dividends.
gods/gods/demon-lords/shira,-the-she-dev.sourcePath: Gods/Gods/Demon Lords/Shira, The She-Devil/T3 - Devil's in the Details.md

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Acceleration Sigil
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 3 Academy📖
Tags: Sigil Action: StandardPlace a glowing bright sigil on the ground. When a creature steps within 5 ft of it, it activates, launching them 60 ft in the direction they were moving. The creature is sent slightly into the air to fly over minor obstacles and is unharmed unless flung into innately hazardous terrain.

techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.title: Mage's Apprentice
techniques/magical-techniques/academy/le.description:
Level 3 Academy📖
Tags: Companion, Mana Burn Action: Standard
Burn any amount of mana to summon a ghostly mage with (5*mana burn) accumulated HP. It follows your movement, including forced movement, to stay adjacent to you at all times. The apprentice does not Threaten. It wields a singular staff. It is treated as a construct that shares all of your ability scores, AC and saves. It has half your Poise. It shares your LvL, but is always treated as a minion.
During your turn, you can teach this apprentice one of the +Cantrips you know. It immediately casts this cantrip. It's CL is your (CL-10) minimum 1.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Rain Cloud
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 1 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Water, Concentration Action: Standard
You cause a dark cloud to appear above the target and immediately it starts to poor on it, making it Wet. At the start of your next 2 turns, it moves up to 15 feet to the same target again. Any creature in a space underneath the cloud becomes wet.If you spend a standard action concentrating on the spell, you can change the target, or manually move it around 15 ft. This also extends the duration by 1 round.

techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.title: Storm Cloud
techniques/magical-techniques/clairvoyan.description:
Level 1 Clairvoyance (T)
Tags: Zap, Concentration, Persistent Action: StandardYou cause a dark cloud to appear above the target and it immediately shocks the target with a bolt of lightning for 2d8+CL (9+CL) zap damage (reflex halves). At the start of your next 2 turns, it moves up to 15 feet to the same target again. Any creature in a space underneath the cloud takes 2d6 (7) zap damage.If you spend a standard action concentrating on the spell, you can change the target, or manually move it around 15 ft. This also extends the duration by 1 round.
If the current target is Defeated, the cloud stops striking it with lightning and it does not move unless redirected.

techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.title: Gravity Switch
techniques/magical-techniques/god-mode/l.description:
Level 5 God Mode⏰
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard
Temporarily turn off the gravity in an area. Read the No Gravity section of the Gravity page for more details.Because the area is confined, the risk of floating off into infinity is very low.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Family
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description: Level 1 Vampirism🧛 Tags: - Action: Standard Material: Fresh blood of 2 creaturesTake the blood of two creatures and mix them together. The blood then reacts depending on the relation between the two creatures.Unrelated: The 2 blood samples violently explode away from each other. This indicates that the two creatures have no relation to one another. Related: The 2 blood samples remain together. This indicates that the two creatures share a distant ancestry, at least 6 generations back. Closely Related: The 2 blood samples fuse and glow. This indicates the creatures share a close ancestry, or have some other blood ties, such as being converted by the same vampire family.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Summon Swarm
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 1 Vampirism🧛
Tags: Concentration Action: Standard
Summon a swarm of bloodthirsty flying beasts to immediately fly over and harry a creature. The creature takes 2d8+CL (9+CL) pierce damage (reflex halves). While you concentrate, the swarm persists, giving the creature Blurred Vision.If the swarm takes any damage or is the target of a direct attack, it disperses.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Bloody Barrier
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 2 Vampirism🧛
Tags: Healing Action: Swift
Take any amount of True Damage. Convert this value into Temp HP.

techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.title: Aura Sense
techniques/magical-techniques/vampirism/.description:
Level 3 Vampirism🧛
Tags: Mana Burn Action: Swift
You can sense the aura of creatures within 20 ft of you, even through solid barriers (unless the barrier contains Lead). This aura manifests as a colorful glow, revealing to you the creatures size and type (ie Undead💀).

info_showOrphanNodes.description: Show nodes that are not connected to any other nodes.

info_showAttachments.description: Show attachments like images and PDFs as nodes in the graph.

info_allowGlobalGraph.description: Allow the user to view the global graph of all nodes.

info_allowExpand.description: Allow the user to pop-out the graph view to take up the whole screen

info_attractionForce.description: How much should linked nodes attract each other? This will make the graph appear more clustered.

info_linkLength.description: How long should the links between nodes be? The shorter the links the more connected nodes will cluster together.

info_repulsionForce.description: How much should nodes repel each other? This will make disconnected parts more spread out.

info_centralForce.description: How much should nodes be attracted to the center? This will make the graph appear more dense and circular.

info_edgePruning.description: Edges with a length above this threshold will not be rendered, however they will still contribute to the simulation. This can help large tangled graphs look more organised. Hovering over a node will still display these links.

info_minNodeRadius.description: How small should the smallest nodes be? The smaller a node is the less it will attract other nodes.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
